      For \(r\ge3\), let \(\mathbb B_r\) be the balanced bipartite lift of
      \(J(2r,r)\), with

          N = binom(2r,r).

      For every nonempty left shore \(S\),

          |N_{\mathbb B_r}(S)| >= min{N, |S|+r-1}.

      The proof is exact.  For small \(S\), the maximum common-neighbour
      count \(2r-2\) and a second-moment/Cauchy bound give
      \(|N(S)|\ge r|S|\).  For the middle range, the Johnson eigenvalues

          theta_j = (r-j)^2-j

      give largest nontrivial absolute eigenvalue \(r(r-2)\) and the required
      additive surplus.  Complement duality closes the large range.  Hence
      every vertex-disjoint matching of at most \(r-1\) prescribed physical
      Johnson seams extends to a perfect head assignment by Hall/TU.

      This naked extension is strengthened to a literal protected absorber.
      A \(d\)-witness-clear reservoir \(C\) keeps one old occurrence-labelled
      q1/fixed-lower/arbitrary-upper/compiler witness entirely outside \(C\).
      If its collar-safe conflict-free seam graph has \(h\)-surplus expansion,
      every service matching \(K\) of size at most \(h\) extends integrally.
      The completed factor is simple, positive-resident, retains all pinned
      witnesses, and supplies every \(K\)-named new witness.  The difference
      from the old head assignment is a disjoint union of alternating
      circuits.  A separate protected component-fusion hypothesis—an
      alternating circuit lowering macro component count whenever it exceeds
      one—turns such a completion into one spanning cycle; a named formal
      closing edge gives the safe spanning path.

      The q1 return problem also has a uniform exact solution at token level.
      The Laplacian gap of \(J(K,s)\) is \(K\), so

          |partial S| >= K |S|(N_s-|S|)/N_s.

      Therefore every zero-sum integer q1 debt \(b\) with

          ||b||_infinity <= floor(cK/2)

      satisfies all Hoffman cuts in the bidirected capacity-\(c\) graph.
      Directed-incidence TU produces an integral flow, and minimum total load
      decomposes it into unit token paths.  A jointly path-composable
      lower/upper router atlas then restores both q1 decks while retaining
      the newly gained service witness, every all-depth witness, residence,
      topology, and the compiler pins.  The abstract flow theorem is proved;

      The compiler rounding step is likewise discharged after chronology is
      fixed.  In a residual target-to-port graph, the pointwise inequality

          min_left degree >= max_right codegree > 0

      implies Hall by double counting and hence an integral physical

      displaced child target.  The raw Pascal containment graph already has
      left degree \(2r\) and right codegree \(r+1\); the live assertion is the

      The single all-\(r\) sufficient target is the protected Pascal
      reservoir property \({\rm PPR}(r,d)\).  It requires intact generalized

      \({\rm PPR}(r,d)\) holds, then

          nu(2r+1) <= binom(2r+1,r+1)+d.

      The intact \(2 Cat_r\) sectors leave exactly \(2 Cat_r-1\) interfaces

      \(f-1\), not \(2Cat_r-1\).

1927. Lane K has mined the authenticated `k=11,13,15` carriers into their
      exact physical Pascal-router normal form, corrected PPR's topology,
      proved the symbolic Pascal closure rule, and sharply refuted the new
      global `--dup2` proposal.

      For any lower-q1-exact factor on rank `r+1` of `[2r+1]`, fixing a
      coordinate `z` and assuming every component meets both shores forces

          e_AA = r Cat_r,
          e_AB = 2 Cat_r,
          e_BB = (r-1) Cat_r.

      The `A` and `B` shores are linear forests with exactly `Cat_r` paths
      each, and their contraction is a bipartite degree-two router with the
      same components as the physical factor.  Positive residence controls
      the `A` paths but gives no lower bound on the `B` paths.

      The smallest common finite topology is the near-perfect open switch

          (u1,v1),(u2,v2) -> (u1,v2),

      with the one-cut degeneration at `k=11`.  The frozen types are a BB
      opening at `k=11`, a BB fusion at `k=13`, and an AA fusion at `k=15`.
      Their occurrence-level service ledgers are exact:

      * `k=11`: cutting `159-219` loses only lower q1 `155` and lower q2
        `154`, both supplied by compiler boundary pins;
      * `k=13`: cuts `2395-2515,2167-2391` and seam `2515-2391` lose only
        lower q1 `{2135,2387}` and lower q2 `2323`; the seam restores `2387`
        and `[2455,2515,2391]` restores `2323`, while source position 1718
        supplies `2135`; the promoted interior compiler halo 1546--1550 is
        entirely unpinned;
      * `k=15`: cuts `19065-26745,18041-20081` and AA seam `19065-18041`
        leave exactly two upper fragment casualties, `20089` and `28537`,
        both supplied by that seam, and two lower-q1 debts `18553,18033`,
        supplied by the two global boundary cells.  Every other lower fixed
        depth and arbitrary-upper target has a retained-fragment witness.

      This forces a correction to PPR.  The `k=13` and `k=15` path endpoints
      have symmetric difference four, so their formal closing edges are not
      Johnson edges; the `k=13` frozen best-path census has zero physical
      closures among 50 candidates.  The proved boundary-PPR theorem instead
      deletes one terminal tail and one initial head, completes the residual
      physical endpoint matching, and adds a dummy arc only to calculate
      fragment monodromy.  Protected alternating cycles avoid the dummy;
      deleting it gives the literal path.  The dummy is never a physical
      transition.  A supplied near-perfect assignment or the residual
      h-surplus Hall condition is allowed.  With the exact endpoint/suffix
      ledger and any full occurrence-labelled `COMP_d` matching, this gives

          nu(2r+1) <= binom(2r+1,r+1)+d.

      The fixed certificates verify boundary-PPR at `(r,d)=(5,3),(6,3),
      (7,3)`.  This is a fixed-certificate statement, not a parametric
      all-r family.

      A genuine positive recursive theorem is proved.  An all-depth
      zero-frame router with an occurrence-labelled compiler-pin bijection
      remains zero-frame under facet, union, relabelling, fixed common-core
      extension, and the four-sector Pascal diamond.  On intact interiors
      the depth-q resources are exactly

          A=xy+partial T : lower q+1, upper q-1;
          X,Y=x/y+T     : lower q,   upper q;
          B=nabla T     : lower q-1, upper q+1,

      and compiler envelopes have the same shifts.  Relative service
      ledgers also transform linearly, but their literal boundary capacities
      must be reverified; a nonzero boundary debt branches into four
      signature-separated child debts unless it is absorbed internally.

      Pure transport therefore maps a certified depth set by

          E(D)={q:{q-1,q,q+1} subset D},
          E^t(D)={q:[q-t,q+t] subset D}.

      Every finite base band dies.  There is also an exact quantitative
      obstruction to replacing a wholly absent outer lower deck using only
      `s_A` intact-sector seams and boundary cells:

          h^A_(q+1) <= q s_A + b_A,

      while

          binom(2r-1,r-q-1)/Cat_r
          = (r+q+1)/2 product_(j=1)^q (r-j)/(r+j+1)
          >= (r/2) exp(-2(q^2+2q)/r)

      for `q<=r/4`.  Thus `s_A=O(Cat_r)` cannot manufacture an absent
      Gaussian-depth deck; bounded-capacity collar repair needs
      `Omega((r/q)Cat_r)` actions.  This is scoped to an absent deck and
      collar/boundary repair; it does not exclude inherited outer witnesses
      or a bulk PBBS rematching.  Facet transport also consumes one positive-
      run buffer unit.  The exact remaining induction target is the bulk
      regenerative router `BRG(r)`: restore the eroded depth shells, event
      buffer, relative ledger, compiler pins, and near-perfect path topology.

      Claude's `codd.py --dup2` has a correct conditional physical meaning:
      quotient-half witnesses lift to two physical edge-disjoint witnesses
      for each emitted upper target, including short orbits.  But this makes
      the model statewise impossible at upper q1.  In `k=2r-1`, every witness
      of a rank-`r+1` target consists entirely of edges of that upper colour,
      so two disjoint witnesses for every target force

          binom(2r-1,r) >= 2 binom(2r-1,r+1),

      equivalent to `r<=3`.  Therefore `--dup2` is UNSAT for every relevant
      odd `k>=7`, independently of solving.  Its fixed width set also stops
      at `k=29`.  The exact q1 kernel is singleton when the upper colour has
      load one and empty when its load is at least two.  Since the complete
      upper-q1 deck has exactly `Cat_r` excess edges, a one-cycle factor
      always has a q1-safe cut with sharp ledger `(lower debt,upper debt)=
      (1,0)`; only deeper kernels and the compiler remain.  This cut-aware
      lemma replaces impossible global duplication.

      `kernelcount.py` is explicitly noncertifying: it adds a fake closure,
      ignores genuine multi-component structure, fails to reduce wrapped
      edge spans modulo the cycle, uses linear greedy packing with an endpoint
      off-by-one, hard-codes a threshold, and omits unseen targets.  Its
      printed kernel/packing values have no certified inequality direction.

1931. The frozen K16 separated-port catalogue now has an exact fractional

      An independently replayed denominator-four primal circulation of value
      207/2 proves this fractional bound tight.  Equality 104 has exactly two
      integer ledgers: exact-once target service with total dual slack one, or
      one repeated price-one target with total slack zero.  Deterministically
      emitted no-port-capacity CNFs and independently checked compact DRAT

1933. Lane D has implemented the first exact proper-colour separator beyond
      the one-collar marginal Hall theorem and has closed its complete small
      source-cover hierarchy through order seven.

      For a fixed semantic collar gamma, uncovered colour c, and residual

          N_(gamma,Z)(c)

      closure/min-cut).  If h_gamma(Z)>|Z|, alternating reachability returns
      a literal proper colour set C with

      U(15)-covariant, so the algorithm is reusable in all 21 any-unit orbit
      formulas without raw option-ID transport.

      F(Z).  A new bad Z must equal the union of its killed provider supports,
      because otherwise the same obstruction already occurs at order at most
      seven.  Minimum provider size five then reduces the generator to unions
      of at most four observed supports; the 93 subsets of each eight-set
      recover F(Z) exactly.  This is a scalable hyperedge-union separator, not
      enumeration of C(428,8) subsets.

      A second exact argument closes the layer.  Across the 429 tight lower-q1
      colours, the B-source carrier sizes are 7^14,8^415 and the complete
      distinct-colour codegree histogram is

          0^80144, 1^11416, 2^240, 3^6.

      Combined with the phase-aware O80 provider histogram

          5^9630, 6^270685, 7^6293660, 8^772525,

      and dedicated A378/A396 replays (4,340 semantic profiles and 33,600
      collars per representative) whose collar-minimum histograms are both

          5^22400, 6^11200,

      codegree at most three forbids nine killed incidences in eight sources.
      Indeed 45 provider memberships force pair-intersection mass at least
      105; 46 force 110, while codegree gives at most 108.  Equality therefore
      leaves nine five-sets, whose complements are nine pairwise-linear triples
      on eight points.  Each point has triple degree at most three, giving at
      most 24 incidences instead of 27.

      The independent full provider-union replay scans 1,925 semantic profiles,
      22,400 collars, 781,930 semantic source covers and 9,099,000 covers with
      collar multiplicity.  It finds 109,480 eight-incidence candidates and
      8,989,520 nine-incidence candidates; every latter killed graph has
      matching number one.  No 427-colour residual matching is needed, and
      zero violating collars are emitted.  The run completed in 338.65 seconds,
      used 69,792 KiB maximum RSS, no swap, and no SAT/LP/CP solver.
      The A378/A396 minimum-provider replay also used one bounded H100 CPU:
      50.73 seconds, 49,152 KiB maximum RSS, no swap, and no solver.

      Therefore the exact CNF update for this layer is empty: there is no
      order-eight collar no-good to install in any AAAB formula and no changed
      formula justifying a SAT run.  Scope is exact.  The result covers
      representatives A380, A378 and A396 and, through the audited semantic
      unit maps, all nine raw AAAB middle cases.  It does not cover the other
      18 non-AAAB formulas or prove K16 feasibility/infeasibility.

1949. Lane K has proved the reusable full-gap phase-transport theorem.  For
      a phase split `W_i=B_i+epsilon_i z`, the projected interval loads
      `nu(S)=lambda_0(S)+lambda_1(S)` and

          Phi_z=sum_{S nonempty}(2-nu(S))^+

      are invariant under pure retagging.  Exact values along the K16
      frontier are `3 -> 1 -> 0` for the 12,873 partial, append-`0200`, and
      verified 12,875 word; the global five-phase endpoint has `Phi_z=1` at
      `0x4e63`.  Each appended endpoint supplies one inclusion chain of new
      projected OR labels, so the incomparable deficit width two proves the
      fixed-prefix one-append no-go and explains the verified append pair.

      For arbitrary cut/rethread operations, the report proves the exact
      deletion/addition ledger, the OR-convolution boundary monoid, its
      run-energy/Mobius scalarization, and the fixed-length reserve identity

          E(W)-H(W)=binom(N+1,2)-(2^k-1).

      Hence a closed unit-debt cycle cannot eliminate a hole: a successful
      owner-space alternating circulation must carry an open target-space
      path terminating at a row with a duplicate occurrence.  The exact
      K16 holonomy is

          0x4e63 -> 0x287d -> 0xa879 -> 0x4e63;

      all 2,048 sharp radius-three states remain incomplete.

      If variable collars are separated by fixed full-OR gaps, every proper
      target interval meets at most one collar and all cross-collar mixed
      finite differences vanish.  Thus the arbitrary six-cell and widened
      ten-cell UNSAT results are exact barriers for those frozen
      architectures: escape must alter a full-OR gap or rethread across it.
      A literal three-cut block transposition is proved to do exactly this.

      The report also proves (i) an exact occurrence-labelled compatible
      witness-section iff, and (ii) a quantitative port-expansion theorem:
      `|N(X)|>=min(n,|X|+h)` extends every prescribed service matching of
      size at most `h`; its symmetric difference with the old matching is a
      union of alternating cycles.  With protected witnesses, a
      reserve-terminated service path, and a residual completion transparent
      on all service rows, this gives a rigorous one-hole shadow-braid
      descent.  The sole all-k gap is GCR/PAPC: prove that every
      protected PBBS/Pascal noncomplete child contains such a gap-crossing,
      compiler-transparent service matching and remains in the class after
      descent.  This theorem itself did not produce a length-12,874
      completion or an unconditional all-k theorem; subsequent work produced

      arbitrary-value two-to-one fusion theorem now closes every adjacent
      frozen-complement fusion.  No fusion is universal.  Exactly nine

      targets having no outside occurrence and all of its leave-one-out
      intersections.  This is a fusion-only theorem; auxiliary rethreading
      remains outside its scope.

      values to every surviving collar cell while retaining both fixed gaps,
      the entire family is exactly the three profiles

          (4,9,4), (5,8,4), (5,9,3).

      repair family in every profile.  No repair witness can cross either
      fixed gap.  Nested suffix/prefix OR chains give one unique maximal
      physical context for every target and local variable interval.  The
      target-intersection closure normalizes every live variable value while
      preserving its literal witnesses; dead values occur in no repair
      witness and may be sent to the fixed sentinel `0x0001`.  The exact
      common domain has 245 nonzero masks, certified by a 257-clause,

          5/8/4        3749       109268
          5/9/3        4034       127201.

      after choosing one literal interval per repair target.  At a position
      p, intersect all targets whose chosen interval contains p.  The choices
      are realizable if and only if every such intersection is nonzero and
      every target bit absent from its fixed context survives at some
      position of its interval.  Equivalently, with Z_e the union of chosen
      intervals for targets omitting coordinate e,

          intersection_e Z_e is empty,
          I_T is not contained in Z_e

      the target intersections themselves are the realizing 245-domain cell
      values.  There is no further fractional or cardinal-capacity Hall gate.

1961. Lane K has proved the exact external-donor extension theorem and
      applied it to the H38 causal collar.  For any editable support, every
      residual target witness has one undominated literal form: a consecutive
      editable block plus its maximal admissible fixed suffix/prefix context.
      After choosing one form per target, put at each cell the intersection
      of all selected target masks using it.  The forms are simultaneously
      realizable if and only if every such intersection is nonzero and every
      required coordinate survives at some cell of its block.  Equivalently,
      the only projected failures are:

          (i) selected forms with empty target intersection at a cell;
          (ii) selected coordinate-omitting forms covering an entire block
               that needs that coordinate.

      This is the exact Hall analogue; ordinary cardinal Hall is not exact
      because one cell-coordinate can serve arbitrarily many witnesses.  A
      form-selector CNF with sixteen availability bits per cell encodes all
      empty-intersection and coordinate-cover cores.  Reverse availability
      rows canonically expand cells to their selected-target intersections;
      this is equisatisfiable for unbounded change budget.  If the smaller
      support is UNSAT, every donor solution must contain either an incumbent
      containment break or an exclusive-supply break; otherwise resetting the
      donor gives a smaller-support solution.

      For the authenticated H38 word

          SHA 575f9e5b3453618636918cb410cff88390e12c2dd09fc4d635820b40e1bd4880,

      causal12 and expanded13 have the same 94 residual targets.  Causal12
      has 1649 forms.  Adding p6524 removes 20 fixed-crossing forms and gives
      1629 avoiding plus 327 donor forms, total 1956.  The p6524 packet is
      exactly blocks [8,10],[9,10],[10,10] for all targets and the three
      corresponding through-p6526 blocks for 15 targets.  Its nonzero
      intersection closure has 1035 states.  The target bank has 15 empty
      pairs and 5741 minimal empty triples, while 46518 of 53301 donor-form
      pairs satisfy direct binary conflict cuts.  The compact normalized
      ledger is 2164 variables and 37080 clauses.

      The provider atlas's 16 p6524 zero-debt values are exactly

          0x0003 OR s,  s subset 0x9018,

      and all fill only 0x951f.  They are the unique useful zero-debt
      one-edit moves outside causal12 only under the atlas freeze
      {0,111,6522}; this is not a simultaneous-donor uniqueness theorem.
      Their common one-edit effect has three distinct simultaneous closure
      states, so quotienting them to one multiedit value would be unsound.

      The exact expanded13 formula leaves 111 and 6522 editable and permits
      arbitrary nonzero values at all thirteen cells.  It has 2177 variables,
      37093 clauses and 1956 literal forms.  CaDiCaL returned UNSAT in 463.67
      seconds; `drat-trim` returned `s VERIFIED` in 702.484 seconds with
      36736 input clauses and 9084841 lemmas in core.  Therefore every H38
      completion edits outside causal12+p6524.  Stable hashes are

          model 73a426dcb8586ef70dc23902d52caad628a3b63190e411b24f53b144ded8b715;
          normalized model 4fd869f73ddb6b19b1874875adcc8a5e801810d5c37f04b3fe5e2b96aae46bab;
          DRAT 35c7754ffe5c773c4b65d65b560bcb70f3f8e612730275c35c7d75bf18008d19;
          proofcheck a68356b379f4f0f4121760492b90ae388709543628a9abfa530c798eeb27a4d3.

      Expanded14 additionally makes p668 variable.  It still has 94 targets,
      with 2261 forms, 2499 variables and 44368 clauses; its normalized
      ledger is 2485/44354.  Because expanded13 is certified UNSAT, every
      expanded14 solution must make p668 essential by the same strict donor
      cut, although p6524 need not be used.  Expanded14 remained actively
      solving at freeze time, so no SAT/UNSAT verdict or proof-stream hash is
      claimed.  This closes only the named thirteen-cell support, not another
      donor support, arbitrary length 12873, or exact K16.  The global bracket

          12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

1962. Lane K has closed the genuinely non-provider two-edit branch at the
      frozen K16 H2 word and proved the exact exclusive-supply finish theorem.
      For an intermediate word V and prospective last position q, let S_q be
      the holes together with every covered target having no witness avoiding
      q.  For each T in S_q let r_q(T) be the bits not supplied by the unique
      maximal T-compatible fixed context around q, and put

          L_q = OR_{T in S_q} r_q(T),   U_q = AND_{T in S_q} T.

      A one-cell completion at q exists iff U_q is nonzero and L_q is a
      submask of U_q; all working values are exactly the nonzero Boolean
      interval [L_q,U_q].  This includes exclusive covered targets and is
      strictly stronger than intersecting the current holes.

      On a fixed two-position support every residual target has at most three
      undominated forms: left cell only, right cell only, or both.  Maximal
      contexts give an exact form-selector/closure CNF.  Since the source has
      no one-edit completion, each endpoint must pass the strict reset cut:
      some selected form has either an incumbent-containment break or a
      coordinate unavailable from its context, incumbent, and all other
      selected cells.  This is the exact two-cell version of p668
      essentiality.

      The frozen word has SHA

          5234b77101ac1f22ec1802b4e1f5eccb6f0fc6f540efff9bbd0dc92da8c09fe7

      and holes A=0x4879, B=0x6879=A OR 0x2000.  If neither endpoint value
      individually supplies A or B, every final A/B witness contains both
      edits.  Hence both values and every strict bridge cell are submasks of
      A, while the maximal B-context must supply 0x2000.  The exact census is

          216 A-compatible cells in 202 runs (188 of length 1, 14 of length 2);
          13,102 raw bridge supports;
          335 B-context supports on 611 positions;
          330 supports with both endpoints non-provider;
          555,057 exact hole-feasible ordered value pairs.

      Exact literal-form elimination kills 325 supports structurally.  The
      five live supports have 243,567,567,243,567 value pairs and are killed
      respectively by the single exclusive targets

          0x0838, 0x0875, 0x047b, 0x085b, 0x087b.

      An independent direct-interval implementation checks all 2,187 live
      pairs and finds zero universal pairs.  Therefore every hypothetical
      two-edit completion has a provider endpoint.  The existing provider
      result exhausts all provider-first intermediates with at most seven
      holes, so any remaining two-edit completion must have a provider-first
      orientation passing through at least eight holes.  That high-debt
      provider branch remains open.  The provider result file lacks the
      executed binary hash; its first-stage count matches the independent
      atlas, but strict executable provenance would require a capped rerun.
      The new non-provider theorem is independently hash-closed.

      Five exact tiny DIMACS instances and maps were materialized but not
      solver-run; the direct replay proves their UNSAT status.  No heavy local
      or H100 job was launched.  The global bracket remains

          12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

      authenticated length-12873 H1 word

      two and occurs exactly 153 times, split `128+8+16+1` over portals
      `0,4489,6440,12872`, with debt pairs

          {0x4879,0x6879}, {0x2669,0x2e69},
          {0x806d,0xa86d}, {0xce61,0xce63}.

      The union of their complete private source-witness hulls is the
      thirteen-cell support

          [0,1], [4486,4489], [6438,6440], [12869,12872].

      This is minimal only as a source-witness hull; it is not WLOG for a

      covered, so the residual literal problem decomposes into the four

      gives a sufficient canonical alphabet of 216 values inside this
      support.

      For any selected local form per target, put at each active cell the
      intersection of all selected target masks using it.  The forms are
      jointly realizable iff every residual required coordinate survives at
      some cell of its selected interval.  Common bit 6 makes active cells
      nonzero; unused cells take `0xffff`.  This is an exact integral
      literal-interval theorem, not a marginal relaxation.

1963. Lane R has completed a pure-mathematics all-`k` compiler/Shadow--Braid
      synthesis.  Fix a factor-resident rank-`r` middle permutation `T` at
      deadline depth `d`, and let `lambda_d(T)` be the minimum number of
      strict lower targets omitted by a nonzero antecedent `A` with
      `D^d A=T`.  If `u(T)` arbitrary-upper targets are absent from the
      interval-union tower of `T`, then the literal augmentation theorem is

          nu(k) <= B(k)+lambda_d(T)+u(T).

      This fixed-chronology defect is exact.  Candidate target/witness-
      interval pairs form parts of a negative-window conflict hypergraph;
      its inclusion-minimal conflicts have rank at most

          max(d+1,max_p |P_p|) <= r,

      and its independent-transversal deletion number equals `lambda_d(T)`.
      If one independently samples one candidate from each nonexceptional
      target part and `Psi` is the sum of conflict-edge probabilities, then

          nu(k) <= B(k)+u(T)+|O|+floor(Psi).

      The asymmetric local criterion

          p_E <= y_E product_(F~E)(1-y_F)

      gives a full compiler even when total conflict mass is large.  Thus an
      upper-complete resident chronology with bounded conflict mass gives
      `B+O(1)`, while the local-lemma criterion with no exceptional targets
      gives equality.  The decisive proof has an independent adversarial
      audit.  In the robust literal-core specialization ordinary Hall is
      exact only under the full protected `C`--`P` sandwich; for two disjoint
      nested boundary banks its deficiency is exactly the maximum of the
      `(d+1)^2` prefix cuts.

      The deadline slack also has the exact collision identity

          lower holes = lower duplicate excess
                        + rank-r short-window mass - sigma,
          sigma=dW+binom(d+1,2)-sum_(1<=s<r)binom(k,s).

      On the upper side, opening one cyclic component has exact lost-label
      signature `{L_i union R_j:j<i}`.  Its compressed Cartesian envelope is
      covered by an explicit nonzero increment collar of length

          gamma=a+b+1 <= 2(k-r)+1.

      Hence a compiler-ready `c`-component cyclic upper factor gives

          nu(k) <= B(k)+sum_e gamma(e)
                <= B(k)+c(2(k-r)+1).

      This raw collar is not automatically constant.  For `k=2s+3` there is
      an explicit depth-`d`-resident, locally q1-squarefree Johnson cycle with
      `s(s+1)/2` seam-exclusive upper targets.  Any repair by `t` disjoint
      adjacent same-OR pairs creates labels in only `2t` nested endpoint
      chains and therefore needs

          t >= ceil(s(s+1)/(4(k+1)))=(1/16+o(1))k.

      This is scoped only to disjoint protected safe-pair braids; it does not
      refute complete PBBS all-depth factors or overlapping/nonlocal trades.

      The exact odd-to-even deadline arithmetic is

          d(2m+2) in {d(2m+1)-1,d(2m+1)}.

      The adjacent-intersection sector therefore gets its lost run unit for
      free precisely on a deadline drop; a plateau needs over-residence or a
      different repair.  More generally, repeating owner `T_i` exactly
      `y_i` extra times repairs depth-`d` residence iff every internal
      coordinate run `R` satisfies

          sum_(i in R)y_i >= (d+1-|R|)^+.

      Its minimum is an integral stutter multicover `tau_d`, with curvature
      lower bound `tau_d>=ceil(Psi_d/r)`.  At child depth three the frozen
      `k=11,13,15` facet ledgers give `29,72,204`; the first two do not apply
      to the actual depth-two children `12,14`, while `204` is the fixed raw
      `15->16` plateau toll.  No asymptotic divergence follows.

      Finally, one inserted source position loses `d-1` old crossing
      length-`d` cells and creates two endpoint fans with `2d-1` cells, net
      gain `d`.  Thus `s` collar-disjoint physical seam credits plus optimized
      residual compiler deletion `h` give the conditional literal theorem

          nu(k) <= B(k)+s+h.

      The exact all-`k` frontier exposed by this package is boundedness, in
      one physical chronology, of the optimized residence/seam cost and the
      optimized compiler deletion number.  A single failed selector or one
      mixed common-`Q` core is not an unbounded obstruction.  No unconditional
      `B(k)+O(1)` theorem is claimed.

1964. The reorganized K16 H1 basin now has an exact nested-portal
      three-edit normal form and a complete scoped no-go.  Its four
      minimum-debt one-cell portals serve `H=0x2c6d` while deleting one of
      four chains `P<Q`.  If two further edits are genuine source
      `P`-blockers and jointly occur in a final laminar

      then `u,v` must be consecutive in the ordered set of source
      non-submasks of `P`.  Their maximal fixed `P` collar has core `c_P`
      and the exact value condition is

          0<x,y subset P,       c_P OR x OR y = P.

      The maximal fixed `Q` collar is feasible exactly when

          c_Q OR P = Q.

      geometries.  A separator-absorption lemma proves that two edit
      clusters decouple whenever the fixed separator OR absorbs every old
      and new edited value.  The census is

      supports, all exact portal values, and all 119,532,950 ordered

      substitution model: all three cells independently range over every

1966. Lane D has replaced scalar nested-portal scoring by an exact
      interval-transport and reserve-circulation theorem.  For equal-length
      words `w,v`, every changed interval contributes an arc from its old OR
      label to its new OR label, and the signed column obeys

          beta(x)=m_w(x)-m_v(x).

      Hence `v` is universal exactly when

          beta(x) <= m_w(x)-1

      for every nonzero mask.  Equivalently, the transport arcs extend to an
      integral hub circulation whose old-label capacities are the genuine
      occurrence reserves.  Two distinct holes therefore require two reserve
      units even when `P subset Q`; nestedness can share a physical fan but
      cannot make one interval witness two labels.  The natural two-level
      rows are the positive masks in `down(P)` and
      `down(Q)\down(P)`.

1969. Lane R has resumed the pure-mathematics all-`k` attack and obtained
      one unconditional construction theorem, one exact quantitative
      compiler theorem, and one sharp architecture obstruction.

      First, for odd `k`, with

          W_k=binom(k,(k-1)/2),

      the complement-projected step-two PBBS factor gives one literal word
      satisfying

          nu(k) <= 2^(k-1)-1 + ((k+2)/k) W_k.

      Its rank-`m` edge facets are globally rainbow.  At every owner,

          T_i=F_(i-1) union F_i,

      so every PBBS cyclic upper witness is a cyclic interval of the facet
      word.  Each projected component has at least `k` owners, hence there
      are at most `W_k/k` components; opening one facet cycle and appending
      its compressed boundary-grid collar costs at most `k+2`.  Appending
      the strict lower ideal literally proves the bound in one physical
      word.  More generally, with `mu(k,m-1)` the optimum lower-ideal word,

          nu(k) <= W_k + mu(k,m-1) + ((k+2)/k)W_k.

      Literal even doubling `A,{z},z+A` gives, for even `k`,

          nu(k) <= 2^(k-1)-1
                   + ((k+1)/(k-1)) binom(k,k/2).

      Thus unconditionally

          nu(k) <= (1/2+O(k^(-1/2)))2^k.

      No residence, Hamiltonization, compiler, or independent rankwise row
      is hidden in this construction.

      Second, for one fixed chronology, retain at least `M` candidates per
      lower target and let `D_j` be the maximum number of size-`j` minimal
      conflict edges incident with one target part.  An exact part-profile
      local lemma proves a compiler whenever

          1/M <= a product_j (1-a^j)^(D_j)

      for some `0<a<1`.  The elementary sufficient form is

          sum_j D_j ((1+epsilon)/M)^j
             <= epsilon/(1+epsilon).

      The corresponding integral alteration bound omits at most

          floor(N sum_j D_j/(j M^j))

      of the `N` retained target parts.  Multiplicity, rank two and
      linearity alone cannot replace this expansion hypothesis: `q`
      disjoint repeated-pigeonhole banks have `M` candidates per part and
      exact deficiency `q`.

      Mandatory run-boundary cores sharpen the physical compiler.  For
      maximal erosion `P`, every antecedent contains

          F_p=(P_p minus P_(p-1)) union (P_p minus P_(p+1)).

      In a strict depth-`d`-resident Johnson chronology, every `F_p` is
      nonempty.  Pruning candidates to `F(I) subset S subset P(I)` makes
      source nonemptiness automatic and eliminates every unary conflict.
      The remaining size-two conflicts have an exact normal form: a common-
      negative cover of one untruncated `d+1` central window, or one
      candidate negatively covering a positive row of the other.  Hence
      `D_1=0`, and the explicit sufficient coefficient-one condition is

          M>=4 and D_j <= M^2/16 for every j>=2.

      Under an upper-complete resident middle permutation, this proves
      `nu(k)=B(k)`.  The sharper common bound is `M(M-2)/8`.  No known PBBS
      or Pascal chronology is yet proved to meet these candidate-multiplicity
      and pair/higher-codegree inequalities.

      Third, the rank-separation theorem proves the literal-facet route is
      intrinsically too expensive near the deadline.  For any cutoff `s`,
      deleting the `H_(>s)` high-rank cells preserves every lower-ideal
      witness, so

          |A| >= H_(>s) + binom(k,s) + d_s,

      where `d_s` is the truncated monotone deadline.  For odd
      `k=2m+1`, put `M=binom(k,m-1)` and

          delta=min{t:tM+binom(t+1,2)>=Lambda-W-M}.

      Every word retaining all `W` rank-`m` PBBS facets literally has

          |A| >= W+M+delta = B(k)+(M+delta-d).

      Under the explicit eventual side condition

          W >= d(W-M)+d,

      one has `delta in {d-2,d-1}`, with the exact threshold

          delta=d-2 iff
          sigma >= (d-1)(W-M)+2d-1.

      Therefore a `B(k)+O(k)` word can retain only `O(W/k)` high facet
      cells: it must compile a `1-O(1/k)` fraction of the PBBS facet deck
      into overlapping lower-rank source windows.  The literal-facet floors
      at `k=11,13,15` are respectively `793,3004,11441`, all above the
      authenticated lengths `465,1719,6438`; direct even doubling of the
      `k=15` literal-facet floor is at least `22883`, above `12874`.

      Two independent hand audits checked the PBBS same-factor scope, all
      collar and binomial constants, erosion endpoints, the local-lemma
      direction, the exact pair normal form, the adjacent-deadline algebra,
      and the finite implication scopes.  No finite SAT, web access, or
      remote computation was used.  The unconditional half-cube bound is a
      real all-`k` advance, but `B(k)+O(1)` remains unproved.  Its precise
      surviving route is derivative-level PBBS/Pascal chronology plus a
      common compiler whose pair-and-higher interval-conflict profile has
      sufficient expansion.

1974. Lane K has exactly closed the remaining provider/provider two-edit face
      at the frozen K16 H2 word.  For a source hole H and position p, the
      exact source-provider domain is

          Pi_p(H)=[r_p^W(H),H] minus {0},

      where r is the residual outside the maximal compatible source context.
      For a first provider q<-y, put V=W[q<-y], let I(V) be the intersection
      of its current holes, and let R_p(V) be the OR of their maximal-context
      residuals at a possible second position p.  Adding every covered target
      whose V-witnesses all use p gives the exact completion interval
      [L_p(V),U_p(V)].  Its intersection with source-provider role H is the
      single Boolean interval

          [L_p(V) OR r_p^W(H), U_p(V) AND H] minus {0,w_p}.

      This is the oriented form of an exact simultaneous two-site normal
      form: every source hole and every pair-exclusive covered target has
      exactly three possible witness forms, through p only, q only, or both
      across a compatible fixed bridge.  Thus common witnesses and exclusive
      covered targets are retained literally, not through a marginal proxy.

      Every completed provider/provider pair has a canonical orientation
      y subset A=0x4879: choose an edited endpoint in a final A-witness.  The
      frozen provider partition is

          44,421 = 284 low + 44,137 high,
          44,137 = 805 empty-intersection + 43,332 nonempty,
          43,332 = 21,577 noncanonical + 21,755 oriented.

      hole-stage rows.  In 280,030,348 rows, R_p(V) is not a submask of I(V):
      one current hole forces a bit omitted by another, so no second value of

      only strengthen the no-go.

1975. Lane L has supplied the exact signed-cycle-column/positive-cut proof
      behind item 1973 and independently audited its H/A portal component.
      For an equal-length rewrite `w -> v`, put

          beta(t)=m_w(t)-m_v(t).

      This is the integral divergence of the changed-interval arc multiset,
      and universality is equivalent, for every nonzero target, to

          beta(t) <= m_w(t)-1.

      Summing gives the corresponding positive-cut inequalities.  Static
      source-relative columns do not add in general.  If two ordered edit
      pairs have a fixed open gap of OR `0xffff`, however, every interval
      meeting both pairs is `0xffff` before, after either partial edit and
      after both.  Its transport is a zero-divergence loop, so the two exact
      pair columns add coordinatewise on all 65,536 labels, including the
      full label.

      Consequently, for a portal pair P with exact debt set D(P), every
      completing separated repair pair R has strictly positive source-
      relative multiplicity delta on every member of D(P).  Indexing R by
      any debt, especially the rarest provider list, is therefore necessary-
      complete; the all-debt check and exact four-site replay are sufficient.
      The preliminary portal filter is also necessary-complete: an H witness
      meeting one edited site is caught by a singleton installer, while one
      meeting both forces the two new values and intervening bridge to be H
      submasks.  This proves item 1973's negative disposition for exactly the

1977. Lane R has closed the two uniform hypotheses proposed in item 1969
      for the native PBBS compiler atlas, replaced them by an exact
      all-arity lopsided criterion, and independently verified the stronger
      existing PBBS approximation scale.

      First, the reciprocal-height quotient estimate is uniform at growing
      height.  For odd `k=2m+1`, put

          W=binom(2m+1,m),  B_m=W/(2m+1),
          H=ceil(sqrt(2m log(m+2))).

      The exact quotient seam ledger, reciprocal-height sum, and short-cycle
      bound are

          (L_H-W)/W
            <= 2H/(2m+1)
               +4(5H-1) bar_nu_H/B_m
               +2(5H-1) Z_H/B_m,

          bar_nu_H <= C B_m/sqrt(m),
          Z_H <= (2H+2)(2m+1)^(2H+2).

      Since `H log(2m+1)=o(m)`, this gives

          L_H=O(sqrt(log m) W).

      Appending every mask outside the central `2H+1` ranks costs only
      `O(m^(-5/6)W)` by Hoeffding.  Literal even doubling proves

          nu(k) <= C sqrt(log(k+2))
                         binom(k,floor(k/2)),

      hence an unconditional `O(sqrt(log k))=o(sqrt k)` approximation
      factor.  This supersedes item 1969's half-cube bound asymptotically;
      it does not prove coefficient one.

      Second, the native common profile fails already in rank `r-1`.  Cut a
      q1-rainbow complement-projected PBBS factor into `b` depth-`d`
      resident paths, each with at least `d+1` owners.  Counting only
      within-piece candidates, the number of facet parts with list size at
      most three satisfies

          L_<=3 >= max(0,W-(k-1)b).

      The apparent one-cut-per-component consequence `L_<=3>=W/k` is only
      conditional: raw PBBS has short runs and one cut per component is not
      proved residence-safe.  In general, fourfold lists outside `E`
      exceptions require

          b >= (W-E)/(k-1),

      unless genuine cross-seam/exterior sockets are supplied.

      The exact singleton-list statistic is

          |V_{ {x} }|
            = #{internal positive x-runs of length d+1}
              + epsilon_L(x)+epsilon_R(x).

      In cyclic PBBS language this is the per-label exact return-gap
      `2d+1` statistic, not an all-depth support load.

      Third, higher conflicts do not reduce to pairs in the full
      mandatory-core-pruned atlas.  Put

          Q=2^(r-2d-2)-1.

      If `r-2d-1>=1`, then for every `2<=j<=d+1` with `Q>=j-1`, a
      stable-coordinate cube gives exact minimal conflict banks

          D_j(V_{ {x} }) >= |V_{ {x} }| (Q)_(j-1).

      The intervals partition one untruncated central `d+1` window, so the
      full family kills one central coordinate, while every proper
      subfamily is compatible.  At deadline `d=O(sqrt k)`, if the minimum
      full-list size `M` is positive, then eventually

          D_4 > M^2/16.

      Thus the item-1969 all-arity quadratic profile cannot hold on the
      unpruned PBBS/Pascal atlas.  This does not exclude careful pruning or
      probability weighting.

      Fourth, the correct all-arity replacement is candidate-opposing
      lopsided expansion.  Independently choose one candidate per target
      part.  For candidate `v`, let `A(v)` be the conflict events which
      prescribe an alternative value in the part of `v`.  If

          p_E <= y_E/prod_(v in E)c_v,

          sum_(F in A(v)) y_F/(1-y_F) <= log c_v

      for every positive-mass candidate, then an exact integral compiler
      selector exists.  Events which agree in a shared part are lopsided
      nonneighbors; only different assignments oppose each other.  After
      exact unit closure and with residual lists at least `M`, the uniform
      all-arity sufficient condition is

          product_(j>=2)
            (1-(c/M)^j)^(tilde D_j(v)) >= 1/c.

      At `c=sqrt(e)`, the pair-only threshold is

          tilde D_2(v) <= (M^2-e)/(2e),

      but every higher arity must still be charged.  The displayed stable-
      cube bank itself has a convergent geometric pressure when its
      auxiliary list scale dominates `Q`; all other opposing kernels remain
      unbounded by current PBBS theorems.

      Exact physical closure matters.  Conditioning `V_s` to `v` discards
      events prescribing alternatives in `V_s` and contracts events using
      `v`.  Also, two different target labels using the same physical
      interval form a minimal pair conflict.  Hence every compiler selector
      is an injective target-to-interval matching, and forced shallow facets
      reserve their intervals rather than disappearing harmlessly.

      Raw PBBS has abundant tight ports: the terminal-mountain family gives
      `2^(2m-2d-O(log m))` gap-`(2d+1)` roots per rotated label, versus the
      stable-cube scale `2^(m-2d)`.  Under deletion-only opening, a tight run
      survives unless both boundary edges are cut, and at most one tight run
      is destroyed per cut in aggregate.  Neither statement gives the
      per-label survivor bound after the same rethreading enforces residence
      and upper completeness.

      Finally, deep PBBS flag loads are not source sockets.  If a persistent
      flag has owner depth `q>d`, every mandatory core in its central region
      contains a coordinate outside the target; only exterior intervals can
      serve it.  The exact remaining `B(k)+O(k)` theorem is therefore:

      * one upper-complete deadline-resident chronology;
      * compatible envelope-exact shallow conditioning plus exact unit
        closure;
      * exterior/cross-seam lists for deep targets, omitting at most `Ck`;
      * the candidate-opposing all-arity product inequalities in that same
        physical chronology.

      These hypotheses imply `nu(k)<=B(k)+Ck` by the fixed-middle realization
      theorem and literal appending.  No current PBBS/Pascal result proves
      their simultaneous satisfaction.  Two independent hand audits checked
      the growing-height quantifiers, tail exponent, lopsided-dependency
      direction, unit closure, ramp and incidence counts, deep-core scope,
      exact minimal higher conflicts, and all constants.  No finite search,
      SAT, web access, or remote job was used.

1986. Lane K has converted item 1977's candidate-opposing all-arity gate
      into an exact scarce-first deterministic compiler theorem and proved
      the corresponding positive-density law.  No K16 search or finite
      exhaustive computation was used.

      Fix a strict upper-complete `d`-resident rank-`r` chronology `T`, its
      maximal erosion `P`, and the mandatory run-boundary cores `F`.  For a
      selected candidate family `Theta`, put

          N_x = union_{(S,I) in Theta, x notin S} I,
          E_x = {p:x in P_p},
          A_p = P_p minus {x:p in N_x}.

      A canonical-maximality argument now proves that `Theta` is physically
      realizable if and only if this canonical `A` realizes it.  The latter
      holds exactly when

      * every ordinary consecutive component of `N_x intersect E_x`,
        including endpoint components, has length at most `d`; and
      * every selected `(S,I)` and `x in S` has

            (E_x minus N_x) intersect I nonempty.

      Source nonemptiness is automatic from `F_p`.  Thus the complete
      next-occurrence/run-boundary conflict system has a literal run/guard
      normal form at every arity.

      This yields a deterministic collar theorem.  Pairwise separated
      collars of length at most `d`, overwritten by

          F_p subset G_p subset P_p,

      preserve `D^d A=T`; untouched envelope witnesses and local collar
      labels remain literal.  A flat collar of length `ell` with
      `r-d>=3ell+1` has a guarded marker atom producing exactly
      `binom(ell+1,2)` pairwise distinct nonempty labels of rank at most
      `r-d-1`.  Crossing forced witnesses require the full equality
      `A(I)=S`, equivalently both negative exclusions and positive guards;
      positive guards alone are not enough.

      After forcing scarce facet/singleton candidates and exact unit closure,
      give each residual candidate `v` a fixed nonempty physical port list
      `R(v)`.  If every minimal conflict `E` fails Hall internally,

          some E' subset E has
          |union_{v in E'} R(v)| < |E'|,

      then every port-rainbow partial selector is safe.  For the
      target-to-port graph with Hall defect

          delta = max_X (|X|-|N(X)|),

      a maximum matching supplies an integral compatible selector and

          nu(k) <= B(k) + |O| + delta.

      This is exact inside the rainbow-port architecture: `delta=O(k)` gives
      `B(k)+O(k)`, and `delta=0` gives coefficient one.  Port capture is the
      necessary-and-sufficient condition for universal rainbow safety, not
      for existence of some specially chosen unrestricted selector.

      A second, less rigid residual theorem uses deterministic weighted
      pruning.  For `1<c<M`, define

          Sigma_M(v) = sum_{F in A(v)}
                       (c/M)^|F| / (1-(c/M)^|F|),

      where `A(v)` consists of conflicts prescribing an alternative in
      `v`'s target part.  If every residual part contains at least `M`
      candidates with `Sigma_M(v)<=log c`, pruning to any `M` of them and
      applying the atomic lopsided theorem gives an exact compiler.  If a
      part has at least `2M` candidates, average score at most
      `(log c)/2` suffices.  This is the requested all-arity Hall/LLL test
      after scarce ranks and their physical reservations have been forced.

      For `B(k)+O(k)`, all `k` singleton targets may simply be appended;
      the `binom(k,r-1)` facet parts cannot, and all but `O(k)` of them must
      be forced or passed by the residual certificate.  For coefficient one
      the singleton tight-return rows must also be retained.

      Finally, put `b=r-d`,

          Ddeep = sum_{s=1}^{b-1} binom(k,s),
          Qdeep = sum_{s=1}^{b-1} (b-s) binom(k,s),
          C_d = binom(d+1,2).

      If a flat antecedent's own short intervals omit only `h` lower targets,
      its deletion-token set `Delta` and edited-site set `E` obey

          |Delta| >= [Qdeep-(h+2d^2)(b-1)]/C_d,
          |E|     >= [Ddeep-h-2d^2]/C_d.

      For odd `k=2m+1` and `h=o(W)`, with `a=sqrt(pi/2)`,

          |Delta| >= (c_*+o(1))W,
          c_* = 4sqrt(2pi)/pi [phi(a)-a Phi(-a)] > 0,
          |E| >= (4 Phi(-a)+o(1)) W/d.

      In the separated flat-collar architecture with `A=P` off the collars,
      the total collar support is at least

          (4 Phi(-a)+o(1))W,

      and the number of collars is at least the same coefficient times
      `W/d`.  This is an append-only/fixed-antecedent obstruction; it does
      not exclude a nonlocal braid using new cross-boundary intervals.

      Target-independent interval colours also face an exact capacity law.
      In a residual pool `Pcal` with `L` target parts and `e` omissions,

          |Pcal|-|rho(Pcal)| <= (|Pcal|-L)+e.

      On the untouched atlas this is `sigma+e`.  Nonrainbow capture makes
      the colour constant on every component of the interval pair-conflict
      graph, so its graphic rank must be at most `sigma+e`.  The natural
      interval identity colour fails on the proved stable-cube conflicts;
      the `j=3` bank also shows that pair-conflict capture alone is
      insufficient.

      The exact remaining lane is a positive-density PBBS/Pascal compiler:
      after facet/singleton forcing, prove either port-captured Hall defect
      `O(k)`, the weighted good-candidate inequalities with `O(k)` omissions,
      or a positive-density collar/cross-collar target tiling with `O(k)`
      defects.  Catalan all-depth support alone supplies none of these.
      Three independent proof audits checked endpoint runs, canonical
      maximality, crossing-witness equality, Hall scope, residual surplus,
      the `2d^2` ramp count, the `binom(d+1,2)` incidence factor, and both
      Gaussian constants.

1987. Lane R has finished and independently audited the
      matching-supported all-arity compiler route, including the proposed
      Lu--Szekely shortcut.  It gives an exact conditional `B(k)+O(k)`
      theorem and a sharp reason that the current PBBS lists do not yet meet
      it; no unconditional upper bound beyond item 1977 is claimed.

      Let `G=(L,R;E)` be the unit-closed residual target/physical-interval
      graph.  For `0<u<=1`, a saturating fractional matching with
      `x_e<=u` exists if and only if every capacitated cut obeys

          |B| + u e_G(A,R minus B) >= |A|
          (A subset L, B subset R).

      Thus the scalar post-facet/singleton surplus `sigma+k` is only one
      cut and does not prove a spread matching.

      For positive edge weights and the partition function `Z_G` of
      left-saturating matchings, every extendable partial matching `F` has

          Pr(F subset M)=a(F) Z_(G minus endpoints(F))/Z_G,

          Pr(F subset M)/prod_(e in F)x_e
            =Z_G^(|F|-1) Z_(G minus endpoints(F))
               /prod_(e in F) Z_(G minus endpoints(e)).

      The same ratio is the product of conditional/original marginal ratios
      along any ordering of `F`.  Every relative-interior fractional point
      has a maximum-entropy weighted realization, but that fact supplies no
      bound on these permanent-minor ratios.

      If all relevant physical conflicts satisfy

          Pr(F subset M) <= C0^|F| prod_(e in F)x_e,

      and

          Theta=sum_F C0^|F| prod_(e in F)x_e=O(k),

      then a first-moment alteration of one integral matching, followed by
      literal appending of one target from every occurring conflict, gives

          nu(k) <= B(k)+|O|+floor(Theta).

      This charges every arity.  Equivalently

          Theta=sum_e x_e Xi(e),

      so a merely constant local link pressure is insufficient when the
      residual target shore is exponential.

      The Lu--Szekely theorem does apply without negative association in the
      complete uniform injection space.  For `K_(L,N)`, a prescribed
      size-`j` partial injection has

          Pr(F)=1/(N)_j,
          Pr(F)/prod x_e=N^j/(N)_j
             <=exp(j(j-1)/(2(N-j+1))).

      Canonical events then have the incompatible-partial-injection
      negative-dependency graph, and a proved dual domain/range bucket
      cluster criterion retains all arities.

      The shortcut stops exactly at target-specific lists.  The bipartite
      six-cycle has two perfect matchings; compatible canonical edge events
      from opposite matchings are mutually exclusive and satisfy

          Pr(A | not B)=1>Pr(A)=1/2.

      A weighted complete `3` by `3` example also violates the same
      lopsided inequality.  Thus neither list conditioning nor arbitrary
      maximum-entropy weights inherit Lu--Szekely.  Sampling the complete
      injection and forbidding nonedges by unary events is formally valid,
      but the explicit dual-socket calculation demands dense row and column
      lists; no PBBS theorem proves that condition.

      Finally, the stable conflict bank from item 1977 extends from a
      singleton anchor to every retained one-position candidate `(S,{p})`
      with `|S|<=c0-2`, where `c0=r-2d-1`.  If `C` is the stable
      intersection, `y in C minus S`, and

          U=C minus (S union {y}),

      every ordered composition of the remaining `d` positions yields at
      least

          (2^|U|-1)_(j-1)

      minimal size-`j` conflicts through the anchor.  Item 1986's exact
      run-component/positive-guard theorem proves minimality.  Hence
      omitting all `k` singleton targets removes the original bank but not
      the analogous rank-two bank.

      With stable-anchor marginal mass `X1`, at most `R_*<=2k` charts per
      anchor, socket masses `lambda_l`, and

          A(z)=C0 sum_(l=1)^d lambda_l z^l,

      the complete stable-composition mass is bounded by

          R_* C0 X1 [z^d] A(z)/(1-A(z)).

      If every socket mass is at most `lambda`, this is

          R_* C0^2 X1 lambda (1+C0 lambda)^(d-1).

      This exact all-arity sum shows why controlling only `D4` is
      insufficient.  The precise remaining PBBS/Pascal theorem is now:

      * one upper-complete deadline-resident chronology;
      * `O(k)` initial omissions and exact physical unit closure;
      * every capacitated Hall cut for a spread residual matching;
      * bounded permanent deletion distortion on every conflict prefix; and
      * complete weighted run/guard conflict mass `O(k)`.

      Current PBBS results give only the scalar surplus and the explicit
      conflict geometry, not the last three estimates.  Three independent
      audits checked the partition identities, max-entropy scope,
      capacitated cuts, complete-injection constants, Lu--Szekely scope,
      both counterexamples, arbitrary-small-anchor extension, chart
      generating function, and conditional length-one mass identity.

1993. The exact cross-collar lane has replaced item 1985's final
      DRAT/Cartesian-join endgame by a solver-independent owner-capacity
      certificate and has proved the exact wider-support transfer that is
      currently justified.

      In the frozen arbitrary-value joint13 fibre, let `Gamma_b(s)` be the
      residual targets available to canonical meet tuple `s` in collar `b`.
      Every selected witness assignment partitions the 55 residual targets
      by collar.  The exact generic capacities are

          M(-H)     = 7,23,14,12,

          owner Q       5,14, 9,12,
          owner C       5,15, 8,12,
          owner R,C     2,12, 7,11,
          owner R,Q     5,14, 9,11,
          owner R,Q,C   0,12, 6,10,

      where `Q=0x6879` and `C=0xcc61`.  Assigning R to each possible
      owner collar gives, for the seven charts left by item 1982,

          chart  6: 54,33,51,55;
          chart 15: 54,47,42,55;
          chart 20: 54,47,51,54;
          chart 21: 53,46,50,53;
          chart 24: 53,46,50,53;
          chart 27: 53,46,50,51;
          chart 28: 53,46,50,53.

      Hence charts 20,21,24,27,28 are impossible immediately.  Charts 6
      and 15 retain only the equality case with R owned by collar 3.  Both
      are full-span H charts, so every subinterval OR in their H collar is
      a submask of H.  Every Q need has outside-H part `0x4000` or `0x4010`,
      and every C need is `0xcc61`, with outside-H part `0xc000`; Q and C
      are therefore physically unavailable in the H collar.  The Q owner
      ladder forces Q into collar 3 with R.  From that equality row, the C
      totals are respectively

          chart  6: 53, impossible,49,54;
          chart 15: 53,47,impossible,54.

      Thus the exact remaining units are

          -x471,-x480,-x485,-x486,-x489,-x492,-x493.

      Together with item 1982's 22 units, these negate all 29 charts in the
      H exactly-one row.  This is a second proof of the full frozen-joint13
      UNSAT theorem, but unlike item 1985's proof it uses neither SAT/DRAT
      nor a Cartesian coverage-family join.

      A reusable C++ census exhausts `216^2,216^4,216^3,216^4` tuples and
      records the exact single/multiple-owner maxima.  It ran on H100 core
      13 below a unique `/home/amodo/or15/work` directory under 240-second

      maximum RSS and no `/dev/shm` writes.  One independently written

      The companion source-reset projection theorem gives the precise
      extension beyond fixed support.  Let S be the thirteen joint13 cells
      and reset every cell outside S to the authenticated H1 source.  Exact
      interval replay partitions the targets into 65,480 with a source
      witness disjoint from S and the same 55 residual targets.  The reset
      word is universal if and only if its 55 hybrid residual rows hold;
      safe-gap ORs localize these rows to exactly the 29 joint13 charts.
      Consequently, any universal word whose every residual target has a
      witness avoiding its outside-edit set normalizes into joint13 and is
      impossible.  Equivalently, every possible escape must have some
      residual target whose entire final witness family is hit by the
      outside edits.

      This escape condition is necessary, not sufficient.  Unconditional
      outside-cell erasure and arbitrary relocation into S are false: every
      outside cell can create a singleton H witness, and the audited p2/p3

1994. The global provider-first complement to item 1991 now has its smallest
      exact fixed-support formulation, together with a proof that the proposed
      first-column quotient cannot provide the needed global compression.

      At fixed deletion and first position, let `N_u(t)` count intervals
      crossing the changed site with new union `t`.  The singleton interval
      contributes `t=u`, while every label in the support of `N_u` contains
      `u`; hence

          u = intersection {t : N_u(t)>0}.

      Thus the exact signed first column is injective in `u`.  Across all
      deletions, the canonical actions `u=h` for a deletion hole h are all
      genuine and already number exactly

          12,873 * 116,073 = 1,494,207,729.

      Grouping only by supplied-hole signature and output debts is also not
      transition-exact.  In the frozen best deletion word, first position 0
      with values 11373 and 11332 leaves the same debts `{18553,26745}`.  At
      second position 3236 their exact private sets differ by target 11332 and
      their maximal lower masks are 27773 versus 27769.  A capped one-core
      H100 audit found this after enumerating all 27,064 first providers.

      For a fixed deletion and sites p<q, however, the arbitrary-value problem
      is now exact and small.  Maximal compatible p-only, q-only and both-site
      contexts give Boolean intervals

          P_t(u), Q_t(v), B_t(u OR v),

      and every original/private target requires their disjunction.  A target
      chooses one role in `{P,Q,B}`.  For role classes define lower/upper masks
      `L_u,U_u,L_v,U_v,L_z`; feasibility is exactly

          L_u subseteq u subseteq U_u,
          L_v subseteq v subseteq U_v,
          L_z subseteq u OR v,

      plus nonzero/genuine endpoint inequalities.  One 16-bit subset scan
      decides a fixed role assignment.  Pairwise incompatible interval roles
      and the one ternary B-required/P-forbidden/Q-forbidden pattern give a
      Hall-like finite CSP on the affected targets.  Provider-first is the
      additional requirement that some original hole chooses P or Q.

      This conquers the value dimension but not physical supports.  The exact
      census has 12,874 distinct deletion hole sets, 12,874 distinct source
      left OR-chain profiles, 12,874 distinct right profiles, and

          1,066,618,984,872 deletion/unordered-position-pair supports.

      Therefore neither literal first-action enumeration nor one tiny SAT per
      support is feasible.  A new positional theorem—private-witness locality,
      stabbing, or a shared three-position automaton—is required.  This is a
      reduction/obstruction theorem, not a provider-first NO_PASS; the K16
      bracket remains `12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874`.

1996. Lane K has attacked item 1986's constructive positive-density gate and
      proved the exact local Pascal reservoir, its density, and the sharp
      failure of minimum-run boundary ports.  The global rank-stratified
      collision/shadow-copy lemma remains open, so no unconditional upper
      bound beyond item 1977 is claimed.

      First, maximal erosion has an exact shadow-collar dictionary.  For a
      strict depth-`d` resident chronology and

          P_p = intersection_{i=p-d}^p T_i,

      every valid `1<=q<=d` obeys

          union_{u=0}^{d-q} P_(s+u)
            = intersection_{i=s-q}^s T_i.

      Hence the `q` length-`d-q+1` subintervals of a full source collar
      `[c+1,c+d]` are exactly the `q` depth-`q` lower-flag occurrences
      crossing the middle cut `(c,c+1)`.  Across all depths the collar is the
      complete Pascal triangle of `binom(d+1,2)` occurrences.

      There is also a stronger transparency theorem.  If edited blocks are
      separated by an untouched source position and

          F_p subset A_p subset P_p

      on every block, then `A(I)=P(I)` for every interval not wholly inside
      one edited block.  Thus all middle/upper intervals and all external
      lower occurrences are literally preserved; only the internal collar
      triangles can change.  A length-`ell` collar exposes exactly

          (ell-d+q)^+

      depth-`q` occurrences.

      Second, the odd/even new-coordinate phase has an exact triangular
      law.  If a cyclic sector trace has `G` zero owners, `O` one owners, and
      `s` one-runs of length at least `e+1`, its maximal depth-`e` controller
      has short-cell phase counts

          C0 = eG + s binom(e+1,2),
          C1 = eO - s binom(e+1,2).

      A deleted collar of length `ell<=e`, lying inside a positive controller
      run and flanked by retained tag sites, adds exactly
      `binom(ell+1,2)` to `C0`.  There are no cross terms.

      For an odd parent `k=2m-1`, put

          W=binom(2m-1,m), Lambda=2^(2m-2)-1,
          a=dW-Lambda.

      The even child has `W'=2W`, `Lambda'=2Lambda-W+1`, and deadline
      `e in {d-1,d}`; the drop criterion is

          e=d-1 iff 2a >= W+1-binom(d,2).

      In the balanced tag trace, scalar phase feasibility is

          (d-e)W-a <= Q <= (e-d+1)W+a-1,

      where `Q=s binom(e+1,2)+sum collar triangles`.  The child capacity
      inequality makes the reversed gap at most `binom(e+1,2)`.  Taking

          s=max(1,ceil(max(0,(d-e)W-a)/binom(e+1,2)))

      leaves only `O(k)` phase defect.  On a deadline drop this run count is
      below the exact q1 edge-count ceiling `2W/(m+1)`.  This constructs a
      scalar binary phase trace only; the naive one-forward/one-reverse
      Pascal block is not resident in old coordinates, so a physical
      generalized braid remains necessary.

      Third, assume one cyclic Hamilton, q1-exact, positively resident
      generalized Pascal chronology in odd dimension `k=2m+1`, together
      with a declared upper-complete opening package.  Write

          C=Cat_m, W=(2m+1)C, b=m+1-d,
          ell=floor(alpha d),
          4 Phi(-sqrt(pi/2)) < alpha < 1.

      Its eroded `z`-positive and `z`-negative supports have sizes

          (m+1-d)C, (m+d)C.

      Partition each shore into `ell`-collars separated by untouched sites.
      In a collar choose a rank-stratified base

          K_J subset intersection_{p in J}P_p,
          |K_J| <= b-3ell-1,

      include `z` on the positive shore, and add the mandatory cores plus
      private Hall markers.  Every collar interval has label

          K_J union F(I) union {private markers in I},

      so labels are injective within a collar and have rank at most `b-1`.

      If `K_A,K_B` count collar-cell occurrences, then

          K_A >= ell(m-d)C/2 - C(ell-1)^2/8,
          K_B >= ell(m+d-1)C/2 - C(ell-1)^2/8.

      For the two deep target shores

          D_+ = sum_{j=0}^{m-d-1} binom(2m,j),
          D_- = sum_{j=1}^{m-d} binom(2m,j),

      the exact asymptotic densities are

          K_A/(Wd), K_B/(Wd) -> alpha/4,
          D_+/(Wd), D_-/(Wd) -> Phi(-sqrt(pi/2)).

      Thus both shores have positive linear occurrence surplus.  A linear
      opening loses only `O(d^2)=O(k)` cells.  Deletion components have
      length at most `ell`, so

          D^h A = D^h P for every h>=ell;

      the first `d-ell` lower shells, including facets, remain exact.

      Total capacity is not rankwise coverage.  The uniform maximal choice
      `|K_J|=b-3ell-1` misses on each shore a Gaussian tail of size

          (Phi(-(1+3alpha)sqrt(pi/2))+o(1)) Wd,

      so it cannot have `O(k)` defect.  Rank-stratified bases are forced.
      Even after rank stratification, cross-collar collision remains.  If
      `C_+/-` are collision excesses and `H_+/-` deep holes, then exactly

          H_+ = C_+ - (K_A-D_+),
          H_- = C_- - (K_B-D_-).

      The complete lower ledger is

          H(A)=C_<(A)+R_=(A)-sigma.

      Consequently the explicit reservoir and opening package prove

          C_<(A)+R_=(A) <= sigma+O(k)
             => nu(k) <= B(k)+O(k).

      Exact excess at most `sigma`, with zero upper charge, proves `B(k)`.

      Fourth, cross-boundary density is insufficient.  The generalized
      Pascal cross channel has only `2C` boundaries, whose complete
      `d`-halos contain at most

          C d(d-1)+O(d^2)=O(W)

      short cells, versus `Theta(Wd)` deep demand.  A cumulative prefix cut
      gives the stronger forced BB-bulk mass

          (J+o(1)) W sqrt(m),

1997. Lane R has specialized the permanent-minor compiler route of item 1987
      to the mandatory-core PBBS interval graph, proved two concrete
      concentration obstructions, and isolated an exact post-closure
      switching/alteration theorem.  No unconditional upper bound beyond
      item 1977 is claimed.

      For odd `k=2m+1`, put `r=m+1`,

          W=binom(2m+1,m),
          Lambda=sum_(s=1)^(r-1) binom(k,s),
          d=min{j:jW+binom(j+1,2)>=Lambda}.

      In one strict depth-`d` opening, condition the `W` rank-`(r-1)`
      facets on distinct length-`d` columns and pause before the newly
      exposed units.  With `E0=2d^2+1`, the entire rank-`(r-2)` shore has at
      most

          U2=W+2+E0 binom(r,2)

      candidate incidences.  Since its size is `mW/(m+2)`, every saturating
      fractional matching with edge cap `u` and `O(k)` omissions obeys

          u >= 1-2/(m+2)-O(k^3/W).

      If Hall holds, at least

          2(mW/(m+2)-o2)-U2=(1-o(1))W

      rows are degree one, with distinct forced columns.  If these units
      close consistently, the staged rank-`(r-3)` shore still forces

          u >= 1/5-o(1).

      The exact multi-piece interface retains the exceptional-column count
      `xi` and unreserved length-`d` count `h_d`:

          e(rank r-2,R) <= W+2+(xi+h_d)binom(r,2).

      Under common maximal erosion and certified owner footprints, `s`
      nonresident seams give the fail-closed ledger

          xi <= 2d^2+s(d-1)(3d-2)/2.

      Thus the one-piece concentration theorem cannot be silently applied
      to a Catalan-many-component PBBS opening.

      A second exact obstruction rules out the natural independent-pruning
      shortcut.  The deadline column count is

          N0=dW+binom(d+1,2)=Lambda+sigma,
          0<=sigma<W+d.

      On any residual face with `L` targets, `N` supporting columns and `h`
      omissions, `N<=L+sigma+h`.  For product row laws of maximum atom `u`,
      the common-fugacity candidate-opposing inequalities imply, using only
      same-column pair conflicts,

          (1-u)(L/N-u)_+ <= log(c)/c^2 <= 1/(2e).

      Hence on every deadline-dense face

          u >= 1-1/sqrt(2e)-o(1).

      Uniform `M`-pruning fails this common-fugacity certificate for every
      `M>=2`.  This does not exclude asymmetric fugacities or laws supported
      on injective matchings.

      For the latter laws, let `Z_ab` be the weighted matching totals for
      the two statuses of disjoint edges `e,f`.  If `B_H(e,f)` is the total
      weight of pairs `(M11,M00)` in which `e,f` lie in the same alternating
      component, then exactly

          Z11 Z00 <= Z10 Z01+B_H(e,f).

      Therefore `B_H<=(gamma/d)Z10Z01` in every endpoint-deleted prefix
      graph gives, for every conflict `F` of size at most `d+1`,

          Pr(F)/prod_(e in F)x_e
            <=(1+gamma/d)^(|F|(|F|-1)/2)
            <=exp(gamma|F|/2).

      A checkable sufficient switching certificate is `q eta>=bd/gamma`,

      weight is at least `eta` times input weight, and an output has at most
      `b` switching incidences as preimages.  In the actual PBBS interval-
      link graph, alternating components project to connected link
      components.  Every retained tagged stable bank is internally a star

      bridges `F(I') subseteq S subseteq P(I')`; current PBBS support
      theorems give no `Omega(d)` bounded-congestion supply.

      Finally, target-capped alteration replaces raw conflict mass.  If
      conflicts are oriented to target parts with loads `L_S`, one matching

          floor(sum_S min(1,L_S))

      literal deletions.  The report gives the complete background-aware

          nu(k) <= B(k)+|O|+
                   floor(R0+sum_S min(1,G_S^0)).

1998. Lane K has reconciled item 1997c's elementary-event counterexample
      with the proposed even middle-chain waste law, proved the exact charged
      inventory, and isolated the literal odd-to-even overlap obstruction.
      No global lower bound beyond the monotone-deadline theorem is claimed.

      For each left endpoint `p`, stop at the first right endpoint where its
      running OR reaches middle rank.  A nonexistent stop is a stall, an
      overshoot is a jump, same-target occurrences at one right endpoint give
      flat extras, and same-target occurrences at distinct right endpoints
      give ghost extras.  If `h` middle targets are not delivered, then

          L = (W-h)+stalls+jumps+flats+ghosts.

      Thus every universal word has the exact unit-charge identity

          L-W = stalls+jumps+flats+ghosts.

      This is different from compiler short-cell waste and from item 1997c's
      elementary equal-OR containment events.  For K16 the four first-
      delivery units are the three flats `0x4e71,0xcc63,0xce61` and the
      nonlocal ghost `0xc279`; the elementary census instead counts
      `0x6879` and the three flats.  K14 refutes the elementary-event
      `2^(d-1)` law, but not the charged first-delivery formulation.

      An independent endpoint ledger supplies a necessary correction to any
      signature injection.  For one selected witness per middle target,
      classify positions as both endpoints F, left-only J, right-only S, or
      neither G.  Then exactly

          J=S,
          L-W=J+G=S+G=(J+S)/2+G.

      Hence a signature injection must land in one fixed shore `J union G`
      or `S union G`, or carry weights `0,1/2,1/2,1`.  Arbitrary distinct
      flat/stall/jump/ghost labels do not lower-bound length.  The exact odd
      `d=3` words K11/K13/K15 have overhead three and explicitly refute every
      parity-blind unweighted four-signature claim.  Even complement
      disjointness alone also admits an abstract flat overhead-`d` skeleton;
      full occurrence-level OR coupling is essential.

      For fixed marked witnesses `(I_w,S_w,eta_w)`, put

          Q_p = intersection_(w:p in I_w) S_w,
          F   = union_(eta_w=0) I_w.

      A nonzero realizing word exists iff every required old coordinate is
      hit in its witness by some `Q_p`, every marked witness meets the
      complement of F, and `Q_p=empty` implies `p notin F`.  The maximal
      word is `Q_p` plus `z` exactly off F.  In particular singleton `{z}`
      requires an exposed ghost port `Q_p=empty,p notin F`.  This is an exact
      realization criterion for a fixed declared lower/upper witness atlas;
      it does not enforce braid topology, residence, exact owner degrees, or
      absence of unintended occurrences.

      Literal odd-to-even doubling `A,{z},z+B` has length `2(W+d)+1`.
      Reaching `2W+d` must save `d+1` resources.  The strict shared-tail lift
      identifies exactly `d` parent cells, so it must also absorb `{z}`.
      But if `D^dB` is a consecutive distinct uniform deck and `W>=d+2`,
      every source cell `B_p` is forced nonempty; no marked interval has empty
      old projection.  Therefore every strict two-block overlap needs at
      least

          2W+d+1.

      This proves `W_even+4` only inside the strict `d=3` overlap lane.  The
      six-piece `d+1`-ear theorem is the exact distributed escape, already
      realized by even `d=2` optima.

      The new literal ghost seed is exact.  In `answers/k15.word`, rank-seven
      target `0x4279` occurs on precisely `[5290,5292]` and `[6390,6392]`.
      In the verified K16 word its marked lift

          0xc279 = 0x8000 union 0x4279

      is first-middle-delivered on `[11727,11729]` and `[12827,12829]`, both
      starts shifted by 6437.  In this occurrence-preserving transport, the
      parent lower-shadow repeat becomes one child middle ghost.  Simplicity
      of the transported rank-`(r-1)` deck, after removing bounded cross-seam
      supplies, is a clean sufficient condition for eliminating that debt.
      It is necessary only if a separate theorem proves that disjoint other
      defects already consume all `d` baseline units; in general the exact
      budget is `C_carry-a <= d-B_other`.

      Finally, `2^(d-1)` and binary padding

          P(d)=2^ceil(log2 d)

      agree only for `d=1,2,3`.  The first even dimensions with deadlines
      `1,2,3,4,5,6` are `4,8,16,32,52,78`.  At `d=4`, exponential,
      binary-padding, and strict-overlap resource counts are respectively
      `8,4,5`.  A free Boolean seam orbit containing `d` logical states has
      at least `P(d)` members, but no retained theorem proves the free action
      or injects its states into charged owners.  K16 therefore supports only
      an architecture-specific even `+1`, not exponential-in-`d` evidence.
