1997d. The first-middle delivery inventory and bit-phase loss system have
       now been made exact, and they give one global restriction on any
       hypothetical universal K16 length-12,873 word.  For each left endpoint,
       stop at the first interval OR of rank at least eight.  Classify a
       missing crossing as a stall, an overshoot as a jump, a repeated target
       at the same right deadline as a flat extra, and a repeated target at a
       different right deadline as a ghost extra.  If these counts are
       `S,J,F,G` and `H` middle targets are missing, then exactly

           L = (W-H)+S+J+F+G.

       Delivery deadlines are globally nondecreasing even across stalls and
       jumps.  If `Q` is their distinct set, every delivery `[p,q]` obeys

           q-p <= L-|Q|.

       For a universal word of length `W+e`, `|Q|=W+G`, so delivery depth is
       at most `e-G`.  The ordinary monotone-deadline lemma still caps every
       nondelivery column at depth `e`.  With `N=S+J<=e-G`, lower-target
       coverage therefore requires

           Lambda <= (L-N)(e-G)+Ne <= (e-G)(L+G).

       At K16, `L=12873`, `e=3`, `Lambda=26332`.  A single ghost would make
       the right side at most `2*12874=25748`; more ghosts are worse.  Hence

           G=0,  S+J+F=3

       in both forward and reversed inventories of every length-12,873
       universal candidate.  This architecture-free theorem excludes the
       known long-range-ghost pattern but not a different physical waste-three
       word.

       The corrected per-bit phase identity retains an extra-incidence vector.
       For even `k=2r`, let `c_x` count letters omitting `x`, let `loss_x`
       count such endpoints which do not deliver an `x`-free middle, and put
       `E_x=D_x-W/2`.  Universality gives exactly

           loss_x = c_x-W/2-E_x,
           sum_x E_x = r(F+G),
           sum_x loss_x = rL-sum_p |A_p|+r(S+J).

       On the authenticated upper12874 word,

           E=(0,3,4,3,2,0,0,4,4,1,1,1,4,4,0,1),
           sum E=32,
           sum loss=37956.

       Thus only four coordinates are individually tight; the prior
       coordinatewise `loss_x=c_x-6435` and numerical `37968` claims omit the
       duplicate-delivery correction.  The authenticated item-1995 H1 source
       has `(S,J,F,G,H)=(1,0,2,1,1)`, not the stale stall-free three-flat
       partition; its total waste remains four.

       Finally, deterministic containment matchings

           ranks 1..5 -> rank 6 -> rank 7 -> rank 8

       build a waste-three independent-column relaxation covering all 26,332
       real lower and 12,870 real middle targets with at most three nested
       lower targets per column.  Both a three-stall and a three-flat deadline
       closure exist.  This is not a physical word: it omits the simultaneous
       overlap equations between adjacent interval columns.  Therefore any
       valid fourth-waste proof must use those physical overlap/seam equations

       within-column containment do not suffice.  The literal K15-to-K16

1998a. The architecture-free K16 waste-three hypothesis has now been reduced
       to an exact three-hole physical core staircase.  Assume a universal
       length-12,873 word.  Item 1997d makes both orientations ghost-free.
       For each rank-eight target, take the latest left endpoint in its unique
       first-delivery deadline group.  The resulting `W=12870` intervals

           I_i=[p_i,q_i],  0<=q_i-p_i<=3,

       are endpoint-essential, have pairwise distinct left and right
       endpoints, are strictly order-preserving, and enumerate every middle
       target once.  Hence there are exactly three unused left positions `X`
       and three unused right deadlines `Y`.  They obey the prefix condition

           |Y intersect [0,t]| >= |X intersect [0,t]|

       and the exact defect-area identity

           sum_i(q_i-p_i)=sum_(x in X)x-sum_(y in Y)y.

       If `U_X` is the total initial-lower depth in the three unselected
       columns and `R_<` is repeated-lower excess, physical lower coverage
       gives exactly

           26332+R_< = sum X-sum Y+U_X,   0<=U_X<=9.

       Therefore `sum X-sum Y>=26323`.  If `C_a` counts selected cores of
       span at least `a`, rank-seven and rank-six coverage further force

           C_1>=11437,
           C_1+C_2>=19442,
           C_2>=6572,
           C_3>=583.

       Thus full depth three occurs on at least 583 canonical middle
       intervals and cannot be confined to a bounded seam.  This still falls
       far below upper12874's 6,432 full-depth cores and is not a no-go.

       Immediate-lower coverage also forces a near-rainbow Johnson carrier,
       without assuming one.  Choose one witness `[a,b]` for each rank-seven
       target.  At most three targets can have `a in X` and at most three
       further targets can have `b in Y`.  Every other witness has `a=p_i`
       and `b=q_j`.  If a core lay strictly between `j` and `i`, it would
       contain the rank-seven witness internally; its unique eighth bit would
       then have to be private to both distinct endpoints, contradicting
       endpoint essentiality.  Hence `j=i-1` and

           S=T_(i-1) intersect T_i.

       Therefore at least 11,434 distinct rank-seven targets label
       consecutive Johnson edges; at most 1,435 core transitions remain
       unrestricted.  This edge count is feasible and gives no contradiction.

       The exact overlap constraint is also explicit.  For middle labels
       `T_i` put

           K_j = intersection_(i:j in I_i) T_i.

       Every physical realization has nonempty `K_j`, contains each letter
       inside `K_j`, and satisfies

           union_(j in I_i) K_j = T_i

       for every core.  Conversely the maximal `A_j=K_j` realizes the
       declared middle intervals, though not necessarily first-delivery,
       lower universality or upper completion.  The remaining exact gate is
       therefore one ordered middle deck whose common envelopes admit all
       26,332 lower masks in length at most three and the full upper tower.
       The independent-column relaxation omits precisely this coupling.

       A solver-free audit reconstructs the endpoint holes, area, lower
       occurrence ledger, essential endpoints and common envelopes on K10,

       excess 5,844.  On the H1 source it gives area 32,167, unselected depth
       8, repeat excess 5,843 and one middle hole.  No bound changes:

           12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

1999. The exact-dual lane has generalized item 1993's outside-projection
      alternative to arbitrary outside support and has identified both a
      scalable source-kernel tax and two solver-independent normalization
      classes strictly wider than joint13.

      Let S be the frozen thirteen cells and let W_x^S(t) be the fixed-only
      source witnesses of t.  For an arbitrary outside edit set E define

          K_S(E)={t: every member of W_x^S(t) meets E}.

      This is exactly the source residual family R_{S union E}(x).  Every
      target outside K_S(E) retains a literal unchanged source witness, so
      for arbitrary nonzero values on S union E,

          y is universal iff y covers every target in K_S(E).

      Thus the reduction is exact for every support E, not a locality or
      radius assumption.

      Forward and reverse endpoint recurrences independently classify all
      32,616,502 fixed-only source intervals.  Their piercing/packing
      histogram begins

          tau=0:55, tau=1:51,312, tau=2:9,239, tau=3:2,363,

      with the complete histogram frozen in the audit.  The tau-one
      families have common cores C_t.  Their maximum length is eight and
      they cover all 12,860 outside positions.  Hence every outside set E
      obeys the elementary floor

          |K_S(E)| >= 55+ceil(|E|/8).

      A stronger Hall-weighted double count uses

          d(p)=#{t:p in C_t},
          L_e=sum of the e smallest values among all d(p).

      Since sum_{p in E}d(p)=sum_t |C_t intersect E| and every core has at
      most eight cells,

          |K_S(E)| >= 55+ceil(L_e/8).

      The exact load histogram has only 30 positions below load eight, with
      total load 185.  Therefore

          |E|>=30  implies  |K_S(E)|>=|E|+49.

      Example exact floors for e=1,4,10,30,100,1000,5000,12860 are
      respectively 56,57,61,79,149,1185,6794,21017.  These count targets
      that must be serviced through the active support; they are not claims
      that all those targets are holes.  Singleton kernels are exact:
      their sizes range from 56 to 75, with unique minimum at p=6437.

      The individual witness-stabbing escape inequality itself is sharply
      only one.  For any retained support A and outside complement P, if the
      reset projection of a universal y fails, some residual target T has

          |E| >= tau_P(W_T(y))=nu_P(W_T(y)) >= 1.

      But the authenticated source's sole hole H=0x2c6d can be installed at
      any outside position p.  Its complete witness family is then a star
      containing [p,p], so tau=nu=1.  The residual source census has only 58
      intervals, with occurrence histogram 0:1,1:51,2:2,3:1, and every
      nonhole family also has tau=nu=1.  Consequently no bound of two follows
      from one-family stabbing and arbitrary values alone; coupled
      universality/collateral is essential.  The precise next open fibre is
      arbitrary joint13 values plus one unrestricted outside site/value.

      Two exact folds nevertheless eliminate large wider-support classes.
      Put Gamma(v)={T in R:v subseteq T}.  An arbitrary number of outside
      edits reset simultaneously if each new value v either has empty Gamma,
      or is a submask of the source value with the same Gamma column.  There
      are 57,304 position-independent empty-column values and 26,114 further
      same-column strict-submask rows across 5,341 outside sites.  Hence any
      universal escape needs at least one live-column unsafe edit.

      In addition, disjoint contiguous halos on the six exposed joint13
      faces fold into their adjacent anchors whenever all values on one face
      share one Gamma column and their OR dominates the source halo.  Unequal
      face values are allowed.  The audited maximal source-dominated widths
      are 5,4,4,3,4,5, giving a concrete 38-cell support class (joint13 plus
      25 outside cells).  A literal p4490 installation of H shows why naive
      adjacent OR folding without the Gamma condition is false.

      All three results are solver-free, use the authenticated one-hole word
      and exact witness hypergraph, and do not duplicate radius-at-most-three
      or collar594 searches.  They do not prove unrestricted length-12,873
      or K16 UNSAT.  The bracket remains

          12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

      `T*` minimizing the global number of literal catalogue actions whose
      values are submasks of `T*`.  Every completing repair pair has at least
      one endpoint in this rare-debt action set.  Orient that endpoint first,
      using action ID only when both endpoints qualify.  For the resulting
      literal triple state `v` and prospective last site `q`, exact maximal
      collars give

          L_q(v) = OR_(T in D(v)) (T minus c_q^v(T)),
          U(v)   = AND_(T in D(v)) T.

      A literal last value restores every current hole exactly iff

          L_q(v) subseteq z subseteq U(v).

      Because the collar is computed after applying the anchor, this is an
      exact sequential evaluation of `A(x)+B(y)+C(x OR y)` on all six endpoint
      orders; the joint term is not replaced by a marginal.  A zero-only
      position-SOS cut is applied before and after the triple.  Every literal
      inverse hit receives exact ten-class `four_delta`; any positive result
      would then receive a full 65,535-mask word replay.

       witness avoiding the final site q.  The common core of a present
       target's witness intervals is exactly

           J_u(T)=[max witness-left, min witness-right],

       `T in K_q(u)` iff `q in J_u(T)`.  Exact maximal collars over all of
       `K_q(u)`, not only current holes, give a Boolean interval `[L_q,U_q]`

       test only `U_q` when it differs from the incumbent, otherwise test its

2001-K. Lane K has converted the K15 repeated-shadow/K16 ghost lead into an
        exact lower-intersection conservation law, a bounded Pascal-braid
        atom, a conditional bridge--jump fusion theorem, and a complete
        scoped no-go for the frozen one-seam atlas.  No global K16 bound is
        changed.

        Let `T_0,...,T_(W-1)` be a permutation of the rank-r layer of
        `[2r-1]`.  For `1<=q<=r-1`, let `D_q` count the `(q+1)`-windows whose
        intersection does not have rank `r-q`, let `R_q` be duplicate excess
        among valid colours, and let `H_q` be holes in the rank-`(r-q)` deck.
        Exact occurrence counting gives

            H_q-R_q = binom(2r-1,r-q)-W+q+D_q.

        Hence a one-path q1 deck satisfies `H_1=1+D_1+R_1`; for `p` paths,
        `H_1=p+D_1+R_1`.  The authenticated winning K15 chronology is

            (p,D_1,R_1,H_1)=(1,0,1,2)

        with unique repeat `0x4279`, while rows 31--60 are

            (1,1,0,2).

        Thus the proposed ghost-for-defect conversion is exact at palette
        level, and `0x4279` is literally the parent of K16 ghost `0xc279`.
        This does not by itself imply a child first-delivery charge.

        The minimal useful one-seam/one-collar defect has symmetric
        difference four.  Write `U=Q union A`, `V=Q union B`, with `A,B`
        disjoint two-sets.  The six middle states in `[Q,Q union A union B]`
        form `J(4,2)`.  If `N` is a sandwich state `Q subseteq N subseteq R`,
        where `R=U union V`, then the consecutive rotation

            U-N-V -> N-U-V   or   U-N-V -> U-V-N

        keeps all three owners, creates the direct non-Johnson seam `U|V`,
        and preserves the paired lower/upper q2 targets `Q,R`.  This is a
        local atom, not a general multi-seam necessity theorem; external and
        deeper windows still require repair.

        The fixed-atlas common-Q theorem supplies the exact witness-level
        bridge--jump condition.  If `Q_p=empty,p notin F`, the old projection
        from `p` through `t-1` has union `C` of rank `r-2`, and cell `t`
        first introduces two new old coordinates `u,v`, then the maximal
        realization puts the singleton `{z}` at `p` and the chain from `p`
        first jumps from rank at most `r-1` to rank `r+1` at `t`, while every
        declared witness survives.  This co-locates the singleton witness and
        defect charge.  It saves a physical cell only under the additional
        topological hypothesis that `p` is an already counted overlap cell;
        the strict shared-tail lift cannot do this because all its marked old
        projections are nonempty.  Likewise `R_1->D_1` is charge-neutral only
        when the parent repeat actually transports to a child flat/ghost and
        the defect transports to this child jump.

        The complete frozen qualifying atlas is now closed.  Its exhaustive
        source tested 2,300,400 directed pairs and retained exactly 60
        compiler-prefilter rows: 30 at symmetric difference two and 30 at
        symmetric difference six.  There is no symmetric-difference-four
        candidate among these 60.  Rows 31--60 have direct seam rank five,
        not rank six; rank six is their one q2 boundary hole.  They retain
        residence and every upper depth, have lower-hole vector `(2,1,0,...)`,
        ordinary Hall `4946/4946`, yet all full compilers are infeasible.

        A solver-free two-cell certificate explains every failure.  In row31,
        the right q1 target `0x318e` is forced to envelope cell 6437 and the
        q2 target `0x3186` is then forced to cell6436.  Their union is
        `0x318e`, whereas the two envelope cells have union `0x398e`; both
        forced literals omit common pin `0x0800`, contradicting `DA=DP`.
        Rows 31--45 rotate this right-boundary pattern through all 15 pins;
        rows 46--60 are its left-boundary reversals.  An independent audit
        verified the counting signs, consecutive q2 geometry, fusion scope,
        and all thirty common-pin certificates.

        The sharp remaining Pascal lemma is therefore occurrence-level:

        symmetric-difference-four octahedral turn plus an exposed atomic-wing

        and the remaining baseline charges.  The frozen factor refutes this

2001. Lane R has completed and independently audited the item-1997
      prefix-switching/component-pressure attack.  The result is a sharp
      obstruction plus two exact sufficient interfaces, not an unconditional
      `B(k)+O(k)` theorem.

      The same-component alternating-switch injection is valid.  For two
      residual candidate edges `e,f`,

          Z_11 Z_00 <= Z_10 Z_01 + B_H(e,f),

      where `B_H(e,f)` is the weighted mass of `11/00` matching pairs in
      which `e,f` lie in one alternating component.  Hence
      `B_H(e,f)<=beta Z_10 Z_01` gives the cylinder factor `1+beta`.
      Unit closure and Hall feasibility alone do not give the required
      `beta=gamma/d`: weighted `K_(2,2)` is the smallest simple obstruction,
      with its two shore ratios `1/p,1/(1-p)` and maximum at least two.
      Every isolated even cycle has the same two-shore obstruction.  Uniform
      `K_(2,n)` has exact ratio `n/(n-1)`, and arbitrary uniform terminal
      two-row neighborhoods `A,B` have exact ratio

          1 + (|A union B|-1)/((|A|-1)(|B|-1)).

      Thus a terminal two-row socket must satisfy

          (|A|-1)(|B|-1)
             >= (d/gamma)(|A union B|-1)

      when `gamma>0`; this is necessary there, not sufficient globally.
      The raw PBBS reciprocal four-edge criterion is exactly

          F(I) union F(J) subseteq S intersect R,
          S union R subseteq P(I) intersect P(J),

      with explicit edge survival and residual neighborhood equalities
      additionally required after pruning.  No actual PBBS isolated
      rectangle is asserted.

      The deletion-stable positive interface is now exact.  If every
      exceptional full input has `Q` separating certificates, endpoint
      support congestion `rho`, output-incidence congestion `b`, and
      output/input product-weight ratio at least `eta`, then a common prefix
      of `h` matching edges leaves at least `Q-2 rho h` switches and

          B_(H minus Theta)(e,f)
             <= b Z_10^Theta Z_01^Theta
                    / ([Q-2 rho h] eta).

      Consequently

          [Q-2 rho(d-1)] eta >= b d/gamma

      is sufficient for every required prefix when `gamma>0`.  Extra
      non-endpoint pruning must reverify the bank; `gamma=0` requires zero
      exceptional mass directly.  PBBS geometry further proves a genuine
      return gate: two distinct interval columns inside one flat return-free
      hull cannot share a retained target.  Any useful external bridge must
      cross a ramp, leave that hull, or certify an erosion-coordinate return.

      A second exact route uses two saturating matchings.  Fair shore bits on
      their symmetric-difference components obey, for every shore-consistent
      conflict `F`,

          Pr(F) = 2^(-rho(F))
                = 2^(n(F)-rho(F)) product_(e in F) x_e,

      where common/forced edges are excluded from `n(F)`.  Thus the full
      all-arity cylinder constant is two, with no negative-association
      assumption.  A complete signature-packet family gives

          nu(k) <= B(k)+|O_cl|+floor(Pi),

      and the exact fixed-cube invariant is
      `tau_triangle=min_z tau(z)<=average tau<=Pi`.  This groups every arity
      sharing a component signature before paying targets.  It does not
      automatically give `O(k)`: target-disjoint two-shore traps and common
      run conflicts give exact packing lower bounds.  The smallest abstract
      trap is a conflicting `K_(2,2)` shore pair; it survives ordinary
      degree-one propagation but is rejected by complete failed-literal
      closure, so it is not promoted to an actual fully closed PBBS
      counterexample.

      The Pascal audit gives the precise transfer boundary.  Interior
      odd/even charts preserve candidates and event ports, but permanent
      control transfers only if it is hereditary under arbitrary right-
      column deletion; `K_(2,N)` deleting to `K_(2,2)` proves prefix heredity
      is insufficient.  For `c` Pascal cuts and facet depth `D`, safe-column
      excision has

          |U| <= c D(3D+1),       |O| <= 2|U|.

      If split component fragments retain their original correlated bits,
      all safe mixed-depth sector conflicts have total pressure `sum_i K_i`,
      giving

          nu(child) <= B(child)+2|U|+sum_i K_i.

      More generally, target-projection fibre `g`, maximum signature-rank
      loss `h`, and new-collar packet pressure `L` give

          Pi_child <= g 2^h overline(Pi_parent)+L.

      These are additive `O(k)` transfer theorems when the displayed terms
      are `O(k)`.  Current PBBS/Pascal results do not prove those hypotheses.
      On the odd-to-even facet, the required mixed-depth run polynomial is
      not termwise dominated by the standard parent run polynomial: a
      length-`D+1` positive component with distinct positive-marginal
      singleton candidates has one child `D`-horizon term and no parent
      `D+1`-horizon term.  This is only a termwise obstruction; an aggregate
      comparison theorem remains possible.

      The sharp remaining all-k condition is therefore one of the following:
      construct a prefix-fault-tolerant PBBS return/guard bank satisfying the
      displayed `Q,rho,b,eta` inequality, or construct one fully closed PBBS
      two-matching overlay with `tau_triangle=O(k)` (a complete `O(k)`
      signature-packet certificate is a sufficient, separately checkable
      route to this), while controlling Pascal
      projection, binary component mergers, and genuinely new mixed-depth
      collar pressure.  Component count, ordinary Hall, and exclusion of
      four-cycles alone are insufficient.

2002. Lane A has completed the source-independent K16 coordinate phase-run
      audit on the waste-three hypothesis.  It strengthens item 1997d and
      complements item 1998a, but does not raise the lower bound.

      First, if `G` is the number of ghost middle deliveries, every left
      endpoint—not only deliveries—has initial submiddle depth at most
      `e-G`.  The shortened-column sum is

          Lambda <= d L-binom(d,2),   d=3-G.

      At length 12,873 this makes `G>=1` impossible, so in both orientations

          G=0,   N+F=3,   N=stalls+jumps.

      For every coordinate set `X`, concatenating all `X`-free runs gives a
      universal word on the complement and hence

          c_X >= nu(16-|X|).

      For one coordinate, write `c_x=6438+a_x`.  Retaining the flat-extra
      incidence vector `E` gives the exact equations

          ell_x+E_x=3+a_x,
          E in F Delta(16,8) intersect Z^16,
          Delta=24+sum_x a_x,
          sum_x ell_x=Delta+8N,

      where `Delta=sum_p(8-|A_p|)`.  The atom decomposition plus the sixteen
      forced singleton letters proves `sum a_x>=64+8F`; equality is
      physically impossible because it would require at least `16-F>=13`
      distinct eight-singleton contiguous blocks, while sixteen singleton
      sites admit at most nine.  Thus every physical candidate satisfies

          sum_x a_x >= 65+8F.

      The complete coordinate-pair Hall/Farkas cut is

          11 Delta+60N >= 51636.

      It gives `Delta>=4695,4689,4684,4678` on the four faces `N=0,1,2,3`
      and forces at least `671,669,668,666` non-immediate deliveries.  The
      exact all-subset extension is

          sum_p binom(16-|A_p|,h) >= binom(16,h) nu(16-h).

      If `t_x` is the number of `x`-free runs, the audited three-/four-window
      envelopes yield both upper phase-capacity inequalities and the lower
      bound

          3 sum_x t_x >= Delta+8S+J,

      where `S,J` are the stall and jump counts.

      Consequently every length-12,873 candidate has at least 1,561 total
      coordinate-free runs, some coordinate has at least 98, every pair has
      at least 142 (143 on the first two inventory faces), and the total
      adjacent Hamming variation is at least 3,092.

      These coupled marginals still do not prove waste four.  An integral
      independent-column point satisfies the inventory, atom, aggregate-pair
      and numerical phase-run rows at waste three.  Separately, a symmetric
      rational point satisfies every pointwise subset-free cardinality cut
      and static target containment.  Neither gives a common ordered
      delivery trace, and the intersection of the full pointwise hierarchy
      with common-order runs remains open.  Item 1998a's three-hole core
      staircase/common-envelope equations are the exact physical host for
      the next coupling theorem.  The bracket remains

          12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

2002a. Lane R has converted the authenticated repeat-free-parent K16 collar
      problem into an exact source-independent Boolean-Hall gate and has
      independently audited its complete six-opening scope.  No live DIMACS
      or implicit search was rerun, no length-12,873 word was found, and the
      global bracket is unchanged.

      For authenticated length-6,438 K15 parents `X,Y`, write

          A = X[6:6436],
          B = z union Y[7:6432],

      and consider the free-collar reuse word

          Q_0 | A | Q_1 | B | Q_2,
          |Q_0|+|Q_1|+|Q_2|=18.

      This is a literal-word fibre, not a claim that every equality word has
      this form or that the free cells are a legal parent-factor trade.

      The six authenticated openings have the following sharp middle-row
      split.  Seeds 1 and 5 are the only depth-two-repeat-free marked parents.
      Each of seeds 0,2,3,4 has a repeated rank-seven `D^2` label at two
      retained starts separated by at least three.  After adjoining `z`, the
      two earliest rank-eight deliveries have distinct deadlines, so they
      force `G>=1`; item 1997d excludes them as the marked parent `Y` in this
      length-12,873 fibre.  The unmarked parent `X` may still be any of the
      six because every `D^3X` middle row is simple.

      Either surviving `Y` has one retained rank-six `D^2` trace followed by
      its rank-eight `D^3` trace, hence one fixed child jump.  The two bodies
      supply 6,427 distinct unmarked and 6,422 distinct marked middle
      deliveries plus that jump.  The remaining twenty-three left starts
      must cover the remaining twenty-one middle labels and have exactly two
      additional stall/jump/same-deadline-flat outcomes, with no ghost.  This
      is necessary but not sufficient for full physical coverage.

      Arbitrary interval extensions admit an exact cutoff-free normal form.
      Number the eighteen free cells in physical order.  Every interval using
      free cells is specified by its first and last free cell and by the OR
      of a suffix of the preceding fixed gap, all complete intervening gaps,
      and a prefix of the following fixed gap.  Each prefix/suffix OR chain
      has at most seventeen states, so the full arbitrary-extension catalogue
      has at most

          binom(19,2) 17^2 = 49,419

      canonical `(first,last,fixed-OR)` shapes; the generic `4/9/5` layout
      has at most 1,003.  For all six parents, both retained bodies saturate:

          OR(A)=0x7fff,       OR(B)=0xffff.

      Hence every interval meeting two free windows realizes only a full mask
      already covered by a fixed body.  Every at-risk target has a one-window
      witness, reducing the authenticated `4/9/5` catalogue to at most 488
      ports.

      The exact physical crop-hole counts for the six possible `X` bodies are

          27,26,27,26,25,26,

      and for the six old-coordinate `Y` bodies are

          47,46,47,43,43,43.

      Including singleton `{z}`, the twelve item-1997d-valid ordered pairs
      `X in {0,...,5}`, `Y in {1,5}` have 69--74 at-risk physical masks; the
      minimum 69 occurs at `(X,Y)=(4,5)`.  These are complete physical
      interval-OR deficits, not merely canonical derivative-row deficits.

      All twenty-four nontrivial boundary chains (four orientations for each
      of six parents) have exactly eleven nonzero OR states, and every state
      first appears within distance 22.  Body saturation therefore proves
      the existing `maxext=40` port catalogue complete for all 36 ordered
      parent pairs and, in particular, all twelve equality-valid pairs.
      The sharper target-useful minima for the four ordered pairs from
      repeat-free parents `(1,1),(1,5),(5,1),(5,5)` are respectively

          5,6,5,7,

      with 188,212,182,227 useful signatures.  The saved `(5,5)` DIMACS map's
      227 used signatures equal the complete useful catalogue.  Thus a future
      authenticated UNSAT proof for one of these fixed parent/partition
      models has full arbitrary-width scope inside that fibre; SAT still
      requires literal replay.

      The exact completion condition is a Boolean-lattice Hall theorem.  Let
      `T` range over targets outside the fixed-body cover.  Choose one literal
      host `(F_T,Q_T)` for each `T`, where `F_T subseteq T` is the fixed OR and
      `Q_T` is its nonempty interval of free cells.  Put

          U_v = intersect_(T: v in Q_T) T,

      with an empty intersection equal to the full 16-mask.  A nonzero collar
      assignment exists if and only if

          U_v != empty                         for every free cell v,
          T minus F_T subseteq union_(v in Q_T) U_v   for every T.

      The proof is constructive: assign the physical collar cell `C_v=U_v`.
      Conversely every realizing word yields such a host choice and cores.
      Equivalently, for each coordinate `b` define

          D_b = union_(T: b notin T) Q_T.

      Then every cell must lie outside some `D_b`, and every demanded bit
      `b in T minus F_T` must satisfy `Q_T not subseteq D_b`.  This is an
      exact sixteen-colour interval non-cover system across the six shores.

      Ordinary Hall is not exact.  Capacity-one target/cell Hall is not
      necessary because one multi-bit cell can serve several targets, while
      target/signature Hall is not sufficient: one free cell, two residual
      targets and three coordinates already give a perfect incidence matching
      with incompatible target intersections.  The corrected exact master is
      a one-option-per-target independent transversal avoiding zero-core and
      uncovered-demand hyperedges.  Every general obstruction has a
      certificate on at most nineteen selected rows; saturation confines a
      demand certificate to at most ten rows in `4/9/5`, and the complete
      forbidden-option hypergraph has rank at most sixteen.

      This closes the formulation and audit, not the integral selection.
      Neither existence nor infeasibility of the complete meet-cover system
      is proved, and no WLOG reduction from an arbitrary K16 equality word to
      this free-collar fibre is claimed.  The exact bracket remains

          12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874.

      solver-independent source-kernel analysis of the RF495 length-12,873

      interval-triple count nor a value-assignment count.

      If `y` agrees with the source off `P`, then, exactly,

      `{0:3,1:60,2:6,3:1}`; after deduplicating equal `A`-traces it is

      sufficient.  For allowed coordinate envelopes E_p and a

      `b in T-F_T` has `S_T-B_b` nonempty.  This is the order-sensitive

      Lane A adds a human sharp service theorem.  Put

          A=0x18e7 subset B=0x3de7,   B-A=0x2500.

      With one lower port, the unchanged clean corridor supplies only
      `0x2100`, `0x0400`, or zero of `0x2500`, never all three required
      bits.  A `0x9e20` witness needs an edit carrying bit 9 or bit 15, which
      is excluded from both lower witnesses.  Therefore the three holes
      require at least three changed tri-window cells even before collateral.
      The bound is sharp for service: the edits

          p0:     0x18e6 -> 0x18e7,
          p2:     0x1986 -> 0x1d86,

           0x3986,0x398e,0x39c6,0x39e6,0x3bde}.

      irrecoverably loses that unique protected target under monotone edits.
      Hence every completion must delete at least one incumbent one-bit.

      The adversarial audit removed one tempting false branch no-go:
      after `p12871->0x8000`, the target `0x1e64` can be rehosted by

      For a proper-prefix cell `J`, let `U_J` be the union of its maximal
      source envelopes and let `M_J` contain each bit whose complete carrier
      for some middle incidence lies inside `J`.  A lower target `R` is
      individually realizable on `J` exactly when

          R subseteq U_J,
          M_J subseteq R,
          E_p intersect R != empty for every p in J.

      targets, 29,065 right cells and 361,816 incidences.  Its sole
      zero-degree target is

      proper-prefix `0x4c71` cell before running a complete static lower atlas.

2010. Lane R has derived the exact simultaneous physical-host theorem for
      the three state2 debts and has separated the genuine six-block local
      atlas from its twelve provenance labels.  It independently reproduces
      item 2009's fixed-three-plus-one obstruction; no zero-host-free
      chronology was found in the proved scopes.

      For a rank-eight chronology with forced middle windows `W_i` and
      maximal envelopes

          E_p = intersection_(i:p in W_i) T_i,

      choose one proper-prefix host `J_R` for each protected lower target.
      The exact common physical cells are

          K_p = E_p intersect intersection_(R:p in J_R) R.

      A simultaneous integral realization exists if and only if every `K_p`
      is nonempty, every middle window still joins to `T_i`, and every
      selected lower host joins to `R`; assigning `x_p=K_p` proves
      sufficiency.  Thus individual static host existence is only necessary.
      For

          A=0x4c71, B=0x4879, C=0x4c39,

      the common kernel is `0x4831`, with the three private pair-bits
      `0x0040,0x0008,0x0400`.  Joint compatibility reduces exactly to overlap
      cores, six ear-survival rows, and avoidance of combined middle-carrier
      covers outside `0x4c79`.  Pairwise host separation at least four is a
      sufficient joint screen because every middle carrier has diameter at
      most three.

      Complete proper-prefix reconstruction gives

          u0: 0x4879 -> (9717,2), 0x4c39 -> (12164,2),
              0x4c71 -> empty;
          u1: 0x4c71 -> (3279,3),
              0x4879,0x4c39 -> empty.

      The claimed twelve parent-pair rows are not twelve physical rethreads.
      There are exactly six distinct length-three parent blocks, one for each
      unmarked parent `X=0,...,5`, which fit the unique `u1` host at 3279.
      Crossing each with the inert provenance label `Y in {1,5}` gives twelve
      labels.  All six substitutions preserve every middle and upper mask and
      lose no previously covered mask; the best, from `X=5`, leaves 3,984
      lower holes.  Every row still has the singleton Hall obstruction

          {0x4879} -> empty

      (and separately `{0x4c39}->empty`) because the chronology is unchanged.

      A separate independent replay of the 617,568 fixed-three-plus-one
      representations checks all count partitions and reconstructs the sole
      named-host/upper survivor directly.  It is byte-identical to `u0`, so
      its sole zero host is again `0x4c71`.  This confirms item 2009 without
      importing its saved envelope or host flags.

      The result does not cover movable frozen cuts, terminal-flat cuts,
      five-cut/nonstandard rethreads, or the distinct twelve-pair tri-window
      collar family of item 2002a.  The bracket remains

2014. Lane A has abstracted the frozen S4 collar into an exact
      one-provider-per-target theorem, retaining the provider's fixed-body
      OR.  If selected row `t` is `(S_t,F_t,Q_t)`, cell `p` has cap `D_p`,
      and

          K_p = D_p intersect intersection_(t:p in Q_t) S_t,

      then the selected rows have a common nonzero integral realization if
      and only if

          F_t subseteq S_t,
          K_p != empty for every p,
          F_t union union_(p in Q_t) K_p = S_t for every t.

      The canonical assignment `A_p=K_p` is the unique coordinatewise
      greatest realization.  Hence the cell variables eliminate exactly:
      the remaining choice CSP has only two nontrivial forbidden partial
      transversals, dead-cell tuples and selected provider/bit blocker covers.

      For a fixed provider choice, infeasibility always has a selected-row
      core of size at most

          h=max(max_p |D_p|, 1+max_t |Q_t|).

      Both terms are sharp.  In S4, `|D_p|=16` and every semantic support is
      contained in one `4/9/5` block, so `|Q_t|<=9`: every fixed-choice no-go
      has a core of at most 16 rows, and every reproduction failure has one
      root plus at most nine blockers.  This does not commute with the
      existential choices; pairwise target feasibility is false as a Helly
      theorem even for singleton interval options, and laminarity alone is
      defeated by a root interval covered by singleton blockers.

      Two positive induction theorems are proved.  For a selected laminar
      family, equal supports are grouped, ancestor masks are intersected into
      `M_Q`, and a leaf-to-root union `V_Q` gives an exact characterization

          D_p intersect M_d(p) != empty,
          F_t union V_Q = S_t for every t at node Q.

      A nested-mask private-residual-anchor condition is a sufficient choice
      theorem.  Since S4 supports lie in disjoint blocks of sizes `4,9,5`, a
      distinct-support laminar family has at most `7+17+9=33` nodes; any
      laminar proof for all 69 residual targets must therefore use the
      grouped equal-support identities.  More generally, the exact forbidden-
      tuple CSP has a global choice whenever its constraint scopes admit a
      running-intersection tree whose nonempty relations are separator-
      complete after exact semijoin pruning.

      This formalizes the pure S4 residual-coverage collar only.  Seed 4 is
      not an equality-valid repeat-free parent pair, neither the grouped
      laminar selection nor a useful join tree has been established, and the
      K16 bracket remains `12873 <= nu(16) <= 12874`.

      stay forward at depth three, and retaining the directed

      bridge class is

          Q[6389:t+1]^(forward/reverse) Q[12827:],
          6433 <= t <= 12825,

      and has 25,572 rows.  Thus the complete quantifier is 27,439, strictly
      outside the 1,200-row and fixed-three-plus-one fibres.

      shapes 68/69 have 36 valid bases with all five dead.  Thus the exact

      need six and the other 5,683 directly displace at least four.

2019. The unrestricted wedge kill-shape claim used in the provisional
      `(SPILL)` route has an exact counterexample, already at the required
      odd middle rank.  In the simple cycle of `J(9,5)`

          12389, 12489, 13489, 13589, 15689, 15789, 12789,

      coordinate `3` is a wedge at vertex `12489`, and both flanking
      adjacent unions equal `123489`.  Nevertheless the rank-eight target

          Y = 12345689,   |Y|=r+3,

      has exactly two cyclic interval witnesses, with vertex spans

          [12389,12489,13489,13589,15689],
          [12489,13489,13589,15689].

      Their internal edge spans are `{0,1,2,3}` and `{1,2,3}`, so
      `kernel(Y)={1,2,3}` contains the wedge's right edge.  Thus a wedge edge
      can be killed by a rank-`r+3` target; local Johnson-step algebra alone
      does not pin every killer to rank `r+2`.

      This does not refute a narrower theorem for protected all-depth
      factors.  It proves that such a theorem needs an explicit protection
      or dispersion hypothesis.  The empirical absence of higher-rank
      wedge killers at `k=13,15` remains useful finite evidence, and a safe
      wedge may still be imposed as a checkable `(E1)` side condition, but
      the present wedge census does not close `(SPILL)` for all `k`.

2021. Lane A has resolved the mod-2 question raised by the two nonlocal
      upper-complete state2 5-opt carriers.  For a compiler cell `J`, let
      `F_J` be its exact rank-seven family under the mandatory-core,
      joined-envelope and every-cell-intersection conditions, and put
      `h(T)=#{J:T in F_J}`.  If `n_j=#{T:h(T)=j}` and `I=sum_T h(T)`, then

          |Z| = I + sum_(even j>=2) n_j  (mod 2).

      The positive-even correction is essential.  The authenticated old
      G0, depth-three, upper-complete carriers already refute universal odd
      zero parity: `u0` has histogram
      `0^1 1^10057 2^1321 3^55 4^6`, while `u1` has
      `0^2 1^10055 2^1322 3^55 4^6`; both have total incidence 12,888.

      For the two new old-facet-complete carriers `C0,C1`, the stronger
      integer identity is

          h_C1 - h_C0 = e_0x1639 - e_0x1879.

      Their common histogram is `0^1 1^10058 2^1320 3^55 4^6`, total
      incidence 12,887.  Each nonempty family multiset consists of 12,869
      singleton families and the same three initial families of sizes
      `7,6,5`; after removing the common correction to the adjacent-colour
      deck, the only change is singleton `{0x1879}` to `{0x1639}`.  The old
      facets remain uniquely hosted at the identical cells
      `[6607,6609)`, `[9717,9719)`, `[12164,12166)`.  Thus the new blocker is
      an exact unlabelled support token, although 939 occurrence-labelled
      target-family sets change under the genuinely nonlocal chronology.

      No linear F2 unlabelled design marginal can restore an obstruction:
      moving two of the four singleton copies at actual degree-four target
      `0x8c63` to the zero target preserves the complete degree vector mod 2,
      total incidence and family-size multiset while making the abstract
      profile zero-free.  This is explicitly nonphysical, so a nonlinear
      invariant on reachable old-facet-complete chronologies remains open.

      The constructive B+1 gate is now exact.  A pure singleton transfer
      `h'=h+e_z-e_a` closes the sole hole iff `h(a)>=2`; taking `h(a)=1`
      only moves the token.  There are 1,448 surplus incidences on 1,381
      multi-host targets.  Nearest Johnson donors are `0x9439` for hole
      `0x1639`, and `0x8879,0x9869,0x9859` for hole `0x1879`.  A legal G0,
      upper-complete realization of one such surplus-to-hole transfer, plus
      full compiler replay, is the remaining physical lemma.  No K16 bound
      changes.

      three repair sets are nonempty and pairwise disjoint.  Hence their exact

          tau({P0,P1,P2}) = 3.

      and all removal-closure endpoint pairs are unequal.  Arbitrary block

2025. Lane R has independently audited the corrected item-2019 wedge
      counterexample and replaced its false kill-shape step by an exact
      protected-factor theorem.

      The authoritative counterexample is genuinely at odd middle rank:

          C = (12389,12489,13489,13589,15689,15789,12789)
                in J(9,5),
          Y = 12345689,   |Y|=r+3.

      Coordinate 3 is a wedge at 12489.  The only two Y-witness intervals
      have edge spans `{0,1,2,3}` and `{1,2,3}`, so their common kernel
      contains the right wedge flank.  Adding `r-5` common and `r-5` unused
      coordinates gives the same counterexample in `J(2r-1,r)` for every
      `r>=5`.  The target has two witnesses, so “fragile” here means
      nonempty common-edge kernel, not unique witness; the left flank is not
      killed in this example.

      The correct extra PBBS hypothesis is fixed-width all-depth support:
      every rank-`(r+q)` target has an actual directed q-edge witness.  For a
      wedge at `A_i`, a geodesic q-edge witness cannot traverse both flanks,
      because one of the two wedge transitions introduces no new coordinate.
      Hence a target whose old-witness kernel contains the left/right flank
      is exactly the unique left/right outward q-ray union.  No such target
      kills both flanks on a component carrying a q-edge witness.

      This yields a direct constructive spill theorem.  Assign every upper
      target one fixed-width witness and provider component.  If one legal
      wedge flank is cut in each of `b` components, every target losing all
      old witnesses injects into

          (assigned provider component, depth q).

      Therefore

          |L| <= sum_a g_a <= b(k-r-1),

      where `g_a` counts geodesic outward rays at the chosen flank.  For
      `k=2r-1` this is `b(r-2)`.  If the independent `(E1)` condition already
      protects rank `r+2`, the bound improves to

          |L_(>=r+3)| <= b max(k-r-2,0).

      The outward-ray masks form an explicit repair list and may be appended
      literally; no kernel census or rankwise recombination is needed.
      Thus a jointly installable `b=O(1)` protected opening has `O(k)` upper
      spill, which is the requested correct replacement at the `(SPILL)`
      interface.

      The general exact form retains the old-witness kernels.  For any
      jointly admissible opening atlas `A`, let `B_Y` be the tuples cutting
      every provider kernel of Y.  Then an old-witness-safe tuple exists iff

          A not subset union_Y B_Y.

      Under a distribution `pi` on `A`, some tuple loses at most

          floor(sum_Y pi(A intersect B_Y))

      targets.  Only when the complete Cartesian bank is jointly legal may
      this factor as the product of component kernel probabilities.  The
      fixed-width multiplicity bound is

          |K_C(Y)| <= (q+1-t_(C,q)(Y))_+,

      and the binary wedge-side product factor is at most
      `2^(-|G(Y)|)`.

      Both missing hypotheses are sharp.  Arbitrary-width upper support
      alone admits an odd-middle rank-`r+3` target whose unique long witness
      contains both wedge flanks.  Arbitrarily strong cyclic residence alone
      admits a clone-dilated locked ray with minimum positive run `d+1` and
      `2d=Theta(k)` locked fixed-width ray targets.  Hence the linear
      `O(bk)` order cannot be improved from residence plus local fixed-width
      support alone.

      Every loss statement is about old component-interior witnesses; new
      seam intervals can only restore them.  Joint seam legality, owner
      preservation, component reduction to `b=O(1)`, and the common lower
      compiler remain separate obligations.  Consequently this proves a
      reusable upper-spill theorem but not an unconditional new all-k word.
      No finite SAT, exhaustive search, remote job, or web result was used.

      The two depth-three centres have repair-set size six and the seven
      depth-two centres have size four.  Thus the labelled gap-triple count

2028. Lane AD has ported the independently audited RF495 rehost-eight cut
      from the raw 6,369-variable witness model to the complete exact-one
      maximal-provider model, without modifying or relaunching the unique
      base exact-one solve.  A literal append is invalid because four raw
      incumbent rows are dominated inside their `(target,Q)` classes.  The
      sound quotient tags a maximal selector only when its own recorded
      `original_witness` is one of the 75 audited incumbent physical rows.

      The 75 rows collapse to 71 exact incumbent representatives on all 67
      formerly covered targets, with multiplicities `1^64,2^2,3^1`.  The
      erased raw identities are witness IDs `1571,1926,2094,2174`; their
      class maxima `1644,1999,2168,2250` are independently incumbent rows,
      but no dominated identity is promoted.  For each target, `r_T` is
      exactly absence of every tagged exact representative selected for that
      target.  The imported physical rehost-floor theorem implies

          sum_T r_T >= 8,

      because a physically lost exact incumbent representative cannot
      satisfy its own selector implications.  This is a sound possibly
      weaker selector projection, not a reverse indicator for every
      physically available interval.

      The port rebuilds 138 definition clauses and reuses the independently
      audited 612-state/2,221-clause exact threshold counter.  It adds 679
      variables and 2,359 clauses to produce 10,697 variables and 177,821
      clauses.  A structurally separate auditor pins the raw and exact-one
      source audits, matches all 71 fixed-OR/Q/interval semantics, verifies
      the whole 175,462-clause base prefix and all appended clauses, exhausts
      definition and recurrence truth tables, and calibrates the threshold
      on 4,096 patterns.  Verdict is PASS.  The original raw strengthened

2028. Lane R has closed the proposed absorption of the item-2025 protected
      outward-ray spill into positive lower deadline slack.  That implication
      is false, for an exact structural reason rather than a failed count.

      If a nonzero source word `A` and rank-`r` owner path `T` satisfy

          D^d A = T,

      then every source interval of length at least `d+1` has exactly the
      same union as the corresponding owner interval, and every shorter
      source interval has rank at most `r`.  Therefore, for every `|Y|>r`,

          Y in IntOR(A)  iff  Y in IntOR(T).

      A lower compiler change which keeps `T` fixed has zero upper-repair
      capacity.  The scalar deadline slack

          sigma = dW + C(d+1,2) - sum_(s<r) C(k,s)

      counts excess short-interval occurrences, not cells or upper ports.
      The high-cell deletion theorem at cutoff `r` strengthens this: a word
      covering the ideal through rank `r` and containing `H_(>r)` high cells
      has length at least `B(k)+H_(>r)`.  Thus literal upper repairs cannot
      be hidden in `sigma` either.  The exact values for `k=11,...,16` are
      `369,266,1059,392,2928,12284`; their large positive size is purely
      scalar and proves neither upper service nor lower Hall.

      The minimal fixed-opening replacement is the owner-level condition
      `(E1-port)`: every explicit locked outward-ray casualty must retain
      another owner witness or occur on an actual interval crossing an
      inserted seam.  For a fixed final path, different target labels have
      disjoint interval-host families, so the apparent target/occurrence SDR
      collapses exactly to one nonemptiness test per casualty.  At depth `q`,
      `b-1` seams lie in at most `q(b-1)` minimal q-edge intervals, with
      equality when all fragments have at least `q` vertices.  Item 2025
      gives at most `b` casualties at that depth; after q2 `(E1)`, `q>=3`
      and `q(b-1)>=b` for `b>=2`.  Hence raw cardinality passes the seam-slot
      inequality; label coherence is the obstruction.

      The complete fixed-order condition keeps multi-seam witnesses.  For
      fragments in order `pi`, every crossing interval has the exact form

          suffix(P_pi(i)) union
          (union of whole intermediate fragments) union
          prefix(P_pi(j)).

      All casualties must occur in this grid union.  When every fragment has
      full coordinate union, every proper target uses exactly one seam.  In
      the narrower outgoing-socket architecture, put an arc `a->c` exactly
      when that legal seam grid supplies the entire casualty chain assigned
      to `a`.  After deleting `[k]` from these chains (the whole final path
      already witnesses it), zero-cost repair is equivalent to a terminal
      `t` with empty assigned chain and an injective, cycle-free successor map

          f:[b]\{t}->[b],  f(a) in N(a).

      This is equivalently Hall on the forward lists for some order ending
      at `t`; the selected arcs form one Hamilton path.  Terminal emptiness
      is required only in this outgoing-seam subarchitecture, not in the
      full multi-seam condition.

      Lower realization remains a separate conjunct.  It is exactly
      `COMP_d(T)` in general.  In a transparent common-`Q` robust core, the
      residual loss is the ordinary Hall deficiency

          delta=max_X (|X|-|union_(S in X) N_C(S)|)_+.

      Interval lists reduce deterministically to contiguous-port cuts; for
      pairwise distinct left/right physical ports, the two-boundary prefix
      specialization is exactly

          #{S: ell_L(S)<=a, ell_R(S)<=c} <= a+c

      for all `0<=a,c<=d`.  All erosions and lists must be recomputed after
      the final rethread.  If `tau` outward-ray labels remain unhosted and
      `lambda_d(T)` is the exact common-compiler deletion number, the literal
      combined theorem is

          nu(k) <= B(k) + tau + lambda_d(T).

      Thus `(E1-port)` plus full `COMP_d(T)` proves equality; absent port
      rehosting, the protected-ray theorem still gives only the honest
      `B(k)+O(k)` upper spill when `b=O(1)` and the lower defect is `O(k)`.
      No unconditional PBBS/Pascal port bank is claimed.

2029. Lane R has specialized item 2028's exact seam-grid gate to two and
      three components and obtained a complete trace-level classification.

      For an oriented b=2 order `P|Q`, let `lambda(x)` be the first time x
      enters the suffix-union trace from the terminal end of P and `rho(x)`
      the first time it enters the prefix-union trace from the initial end of
      Q.  For a target Y define the first forbidden insertion times

          a_Y=min_(x notin Y) lambda(x),
          b_Y=min_(x notin Y) rho(x).

      Then Y lies in the unique seam grid if and only if

          P_end union Q_start subset Y

      and every `y in Y` obeys

          lambda(y)<a_Y  or  rho(y)<b_Y.

      Equivalently, the complement of Y is a northeast quadrant in the
      two-dimensional insertion-time diagram.  For a nested outward-ray
      chain the barriers are monotone, so after checking the smallest target
      only the newly inserted coordinate must be checked at each depth.  For
      fixed-width depth q, the exact stronger diagonal condition is

          S_i union R_(q-1-i)=Y

      for one valid i.  This is the label-level meaning of the q nominal
      seam slots.

      Hence `(E1-port_2)` is exact: among the two orders and four orientation
      pairs (and, when allowed, the cut banks), one legal seam state must
      satisfy the trace inequality for every proper casualty in BOTH
      component chains.  No casualty SDR remains after the state is fixed,
      because distinct labels have disjoint interval-host families.  A
      necessary but insufficient anchor condition is that the intersection
      of both minimum casualty targets contain the rank-(r+1) union of the
      Johnson seam endpoints.

      Two complementary J(9,5) obstructions make the scope sharp.  The legal
      path germs

          12789,12389,12348,12345 |
          12346,12368,12689,16789

      pass Johnson adjacency and the anchor, but both traces insert `8,9,7`;
      the targets `12345678` and `12345679` are poisoned before their last
      desired coordinate.  Separately, an explicit 13-cycle C1 and its
      coordinate image C2 are vertex-disjoint and component-full, have
      q2-safe cuts and two genuine locked q3 casualties; every C2 vertex
      contains poison coordinate 7, so its trace cannot host C1's casualty.
      The four fixed cut-endpoint pairs are not Johnson connectors.  Thus the
      two examples establish complementary failures, not a counterexample to
      the still-open full conjunction of legal connector plus actual q2-safe
      cycle casualties inside a spanning PBBS factor.

      For b=3 in order `A|B|C`, the exact q-edge host catalogue is

          S_A(h) union P_B(q-1-h),
          S_B(h) union P_C(q-1-h),
          S_A(h) union V_B union P_C(t),

      where the last family satisfies `h+t=q-n_B-1` and exists only for
      `q>=n_B+1`.  This is necessary and sufficient targetwise.  If the
      middle component has full coordinate union, every proper casualty must
      use exactly one seam.  Arbitrary-width repair uses the corresponding
      three unrestricted grids.

      Consequently there is no nontrivial interval SDR upgrade from
      `q(b-1)>=b`.  For a fixed path, occurrence SDR is automatic precisely
      when every target has a labelled host.  Before the order is fixed, the
      exact deterministic problem is the six-case choice of a directed
      two-edge component path whose two seam bundles (and possible two-seam
      bundle) cover every casualty.  This is bundle cover, not ordinary
      matching.

      A three-cycle J(9,5) system with legal seams and full component unions
      has six q=3 interval slots but leaves the actual locked target
      `12346789` unhosted.  Four slots have rank seven and only two rank
      eight, exhibiting the precise failure of scalar counting.  Its three
      cuts are not q2-safe, so it refutes only the q3 slot-to-label
      implication, not a PBBS-specific q2-protected theorem.

      The minimal exact extra conditions are `(E1-port_2)` and
      `(E1-port_3)`.  With `tau_b` trace failures and final common-compiler
      deletion number `lambda_d(T)`, the literal bound remains

          nu(k) <= B(k)+tau_b+lambda_d(T),  b in {2,3}.

      Full trace coherence plus `COMP_d(T)` proves equality.  The lower
      compiler remains completely separate and must be recomputed after the
      chosen rethread.

      provider for those 17 masks has one of exactly 16 right endpoints:

      In one completed linear word, intervals with a common physical left
      endpoint are nested, as are intervals with a common physical right
      endpoint.  Nested intervals have comparable OR masks.  Hence distinct
      equal-rank targets, which form an antichain, must inject into any typed
      anchor system whose classes are nested.

      On the complete 6,089-row raw literal atlas, key a left-collar provider
      by its physical left start, and middle/right providers by physical
      right end.  The exact rank-eight anchors are

          L:start  = 0..3                         (4);
          M:end    = 6434..6444                  (11);
          R:end    = 12868..12872                 (5).

      All 1,770 raw rank-eight provider rows are represented, have nonempty
      support in exactly one collar, and satisfy the key rule.  Their row
      split is 258/1182/330, and all 108,841 same-anchor interval pairs in
      the independent replay are nested.  No raw-to-semantic duplicate
      collapse occurs at rank eight.

      Exact deficiency-one counts hold on every nonempty chain union:

          L       5 > 4;       M      12 > 11;      R       6 > 5;
          LR     10 > 9;       LM     16 > 15;      MR     17 > 16;
          LMR    21 > 20.

      In particular, the unrestricted fixed fibre requires all twenty-one
      residual rank-eight targets but supplies only twenty oriented anchors.
      Therefore no assignment of the eighteen nonzero collar cells is
      universal.  The base exact-one/selector-free run for this exact fibre
      is theorem-redundant and should not be launched or continued.  This
      lane's staged `left4_right5` `/home` root was marked
      `CANCELLED_BEFORE_LAUNCH_THEOREM_REDUNDANT`; it has no started marker,

2037. Lane R has proved a positive protected-ray connector theorem which
      sharply reduces, but does not yet prove, the PBBS port-existence gate.
      For a wedge-flank ray

          w,u_1,...,u_q,   |union|=r+q,

      let `{kappa}=w\u_1`.  Geodesicity forces `kappa` never to reappear
      through the ray horizon and gives

          Y_q = {kappa} disjoint-union union_(i=1)^q u_i.

      Replacing `w` by a rank-r endpoint `v` preserves the literal q-edge
      target exactly iff `kappa in v subseteq Y_q`; when `v~u_1`, this is
      exactly the single key condition `kappa in v`.  Thus one endpoint
      rehosts the complete nested ray chain at every depth.

      For two opened components with service seam `u_1-u_2`, the exact
      active-chain conditions in this canonical endpoint-replacement class
      are

          active(1) => kappa_1 in u_2,
          active(2) => kappa_2 in u_1.

      If both chains are active, Johnson adjacency makes these equivalent
      to the reciprocal exchange

          u_2 = u_1 - {kappa_2} + {kappa_1}.

      For three components in the order

          w_1...u_1 | u_2...w_2 | u_3...w_3,

      the exact canonical keyed-ear conditions are a reciprocal first seam
      `u_1-u_2` and a one-way second seam `w_2-u_3` containing `kappa_3`,
      with inactive chains imposing no key condition.  With all three
      chains active, one of the two seams must be reciprocal in this
      canonical subclass.  These `PRK_2/PRK_3` conditions, plus literal
      residence/erosion and exhaustive assignment of every kernel casualty,
      imply `(E1-port_2/3)` and zero protected upper spill.  They are only
      sufficient for the unrestricted seam grid: an explicit odd-middle
      `J(9,5)` wedge germ rehosts its q2/q3 ray through nonextreme cells even
      though the partner endpoint omits the key.

      The PBBS support/outward-ray theorems prove the key reduction but do
      not prove cross-component key incidence.  The exact **unproved** PBBS
      lemma is existence of a residence-safe active-keyed edge (reciprocal
      when both chains are active), or a spanning keyed-ear path for b=3.

      Pascal transport does not supply it automatically.  The exact endpoint
      transducers are

          tau_nabla(x)=max(tau(x)-1,0),
          tau_partial(x)=min{j:x in Z_j cap Z_(j+1)}.

      A legal `J(9,5)` facet/copy seam loses its parent target because the
      facet departure never returns.  In the canonical Catalan-leave ribbon,
      the selected swapped-tag sibling edge `X_i-Y_i` occurs only at leave
      gap one, while depth-d residence requires every gap at least d; hence
      the direct sibling bank is absent for d>=2.  This excludes only the
      unmodified canonical ribbon, not a nonlocal/root-dependent braid.

      Carrier scope is exact: k11 is b=1; k13 has no proper upper casualty;
      k15 is a positive general seam-grid calibration but not a certified
      wedge/key instance (its old left-cut q1 union is 27257, whereas the
      new seam union is 20089).  The lower `COMP_d(T)` remains independent;
      with compiler deletion number lambda the bound is still

          nu(k) <= B(k)+lambda_d(T).

      Independent adversarial audit is PASS after checking the active-chain,
      kernel, horizon, orientation, canonical-converse, Pascal, J(9,5), and
      finite-carrier scopes.

      each of these masks gives a full 519/519 matching, so the diagonal is
      tight for the canonical shore.

      optimum and the independent repeat-free seed5 optimum, every one of
      the twenty-two masks has exactly one literal short provider.  In the
      canonical answer the nineteen `A5` providers are singleton cells,

      singleton.  The last three lie exactly at the parent rethread cuts;

2044. Lane R has proved the exact flat-phase/Pascal-shift theorem and
      reconciled it with carrier 3, the `19+1+2` Hall tower, and the
      six-piece odd-even lift.

      On a protected locally geodesic rank-`r` event collar, put

          E_q(p)=intersection_(u=0)^q V_(p-u),
          U_q(p,l)=union_(v=0)^(l-1) E_q(p+v).

      If `V_(j+1)=V_j-alpha_j+beta_j`, then

          E_q(p)=V_p\{beta_(p-q),...,beta_(p-1)},
          U_q(p,l)=E_q(p) union
                   {beta_(p-q),...,beta_(p-q+l-2)}.

      Moving the same protected block across `t` net generalized-flat phase
      walls changes its actual horizon from `q` to `q-t`, and every
      surviving width `l<=q-t` cell satisfies

          U_(q-t)(p,l)=U_q(p,l) disjoint-union
             {beta_(p-q+l-1),...,beta_(p-q+t+l-2)}.

      Thus its rank rises by exactly `t`, while widths `q-t+1,...,q` and
      cut-crossing dependency collars are explicit casualties.  The theorem
      uses actual horizon loss, not a raw repeated-owner count.  Johnson
      adjacency alone is insufficient (`12,23,12`).

      For the order-`a` Pascal facet

          P^(a)_i = Z_a union intersection_(v=0)^a V_(i+v), |Z_a|=a,

      the exact maximal-envelope identities are

          E_q(P^(a);p)=Z_a union E_(q+a)(V;p+a),
          U_q(P^(a);p,l)=Z_a union U_(q+a)(V;p+a,l).

      A parent atlas protected and flag-complete through depth `D` therefore
      supplies the depth availability and residence of an order-`a` child
      piece at child deadline `d` and actual phase loss `f` exactly under the
      sharp universal condition

          f+(D-d) >= a.

      This transports maximal envelopes, not an arbitrary literal compiler.
      Literal order-one inheritance additionally requires facet transparency

          P_i intersection P_(i+1)
             = union_(j=i+1)^(i+D) A_j,

      hereditarily on every selected provider, plus a hit of every fixed top
      tag.  Owner realization alone does not imply it: at depth one,
      `A0={x,a}, A1={b}, A2={x,c}` gives owner intersection `{x,b}` but
      inherited overlap `{b}`.

      The shifted-tower Hall theorem says that, under an exact own-label
      right-cell table, shifting Pascal layers `P_a,...,P_b` upward by `t`
      and deleting label sets `D_s` gives deficiency

          sum_(s=a)^(a+t-1)|P_s| + sum_(s=a+t)^b|D_s|.

      Carrier 3 is the exact `a=5,b=7,t=1` calibration:

          L=19u^5+(94+19v)u^6+(293+94v)u^7,
          R=(93+19v)u^6+(291+94v)u^7,
          L-R=19u^5+u^6+2u^7.

      moved block's nineteen-cell bottom diagonal, while `4c29` and

      facet needs no prior phase wall.  On the `15->16` plateau, `D=d`, so a
      facet needs one preceding net phase wall or a depth-`d+1` parent

2052. Lane R has proved the first odd-to-even Pascal terminal-PBP descendant
      in the authenticated `k=11,13,15` lineage and the exact typed
      composition theorem needed for an all-`k` induction.

      The `11->12` six-piece depth-drop is a terminal
      `PBP_drop(6,2)`.  Its inherited facet pieces have

          D=3, d=2, a=1, f=0,
          f+(D-d)=1=a.

      The exact cuts are `66,459`, the B ear is `409` of length three, and
      the oriented order is

          A1R, B1F, A2R, B2R, A3F, B3R,

      with piece lengths `67,409,393,3,2,50`.  The complete upper seam
      replay is

          q1: 089f,08af,0d65;
          q2: 08bf,0d6d;
          q>=3: no casualties.

      The literal seam windows and all five seams are listed in the theorem
      note.  The final chronology still has fixed-width lower holes
      `0525,0964` at q1 and `0524` at q2, so the compiler clause is
      nonvacuous.  Taking `M_prot` empty, the authenticated 926-letter common
      source matches all 1,585 strict lower targets to distinct
      occurrence-labelled intervals, has `Q_871=0800`, and covers all 4,095
      nonempty masks.  This is a terminal fresh-compiler certificate, not a
      recursive port.  The `13->14` construction is a second depth-drop
      calibration with upper casualties `29ce,352e,3b64` at q1 and `29de`
      at q2, singleton `Q_421=2000`, and a universal 3,434-letter word.

      For arbitrary Pascal orders, Lane R proves

          P^b_Zb(P^a_Za(V)) = P^(a+b)_(Za union Zb)(V).

      Cutting between `V_c,V_(c+1)` contributes exactly `a` bridge states

          B_h = Z_a union intersection_(v=c-a+h)^(c+h) V_v,
          1<=h<=a.

      Strict bridge transitions require the corresponding protected
      `(a+1)`-transition collars, and a depth-q child upper seam needs an
      `a+q` base collar.  On each root-to-leaf nested Pascal ancestry chain,
      cumulative order `A_j=sum_(h<=j)a_h` obeys

          E_q^j(p)=Z^j union E_(q+A_j)^V(p+A_j),
          U_q^j(p,l)=Z^j union U_(q+A_j)^V(p+A_j,l),
          q_j+A_j<=D,

      equivalently `f_j+(D_(j-1)-d_j)>=a_j`.  Orders of serial or parallel
      sibling pieces do not add.

      The serial socket theorem is exact: guarded modules compose to a
      terminal PBP when the frozen typed data pass phase/collar survival,
      exact middle ownership, one natural-join common source fibre including
      every cross-interface owner equation, distinct occurrence-labelled
      protected target/cell edges exact under that source, one global Hall
      matching for all casualties, an exhaustive internal/bridge/seam and
      multi-interface upper catalogue, and full residence/end/terminal/tag
      replay.  Relative to full frozen fibres/cell banks, the common-source,
      casualty-Hall, and upper-catalogue conditions are also necessary among
      terminal completions whose upper targets must be middle-interval
      witnesses.  Separate local Hall passes do not suffice; a
      three-position example proves that their common-Q fibres can conflict.

      A child assembled from ported parents is itself ported only after its
      output atlas, full dependency collars, boundary common-Q fibre,
      occurrence-labelled protected matching, and upper sockets are
      separately verified as a typed Definition-1.2 output compatible with
      the next input.  This proves a conditional odd-even composition law,
      not existence.  The exact remaining positive gate is the ported
      plateau-extension lemma: one explicit recursive PBBS/Pascal family
      must realize a one-flat order-one braid satisfying these conditions
      and export a port in the same recursive class.  The known `11->12`,
      `13->14`, and non-Pascal `k=15` fresh compilers do not prove it.

      Three independent adversarial audits PASS after correcting terminal
      versus ported scope, bridge/collar survival, occurrence-labelled cell
      distinctness, child-Q edge exactness, global upper-catalogue scope,
      and typed output compatibility.

2059. Lane R has extracted a literal nonempty typed socket from both
      authenticated depth-drop certificates and proved the correct recursive
      Pascal closure law.

      For `k=12`, the cardinality-one protected occurrence is

          0027 -> source cell [15,15],

      with middle collar

          0617,0437,00b7,01a7,01e5

      and source collar

          0416,0017,0027,00a5,01a1.

      Its central diamond is

          0437&00b7 = 0037 = 0017|0027,
          00b7&01a7 = 00a7 = 0027|00a5,
          0437&00b7&01a7 = 0027,
          0037|00a7 = 00b7.

      For `k=14`, the corresponding occurrence is

          04ca -> source cell [13,13],

      with middle/source collars

          047b,04fa,14da,14ce,12ce,
          043a,005a,04ca,10ca,104e,

      and the same identities with

          04da=005a|04ca,
          14ca=04ca|10ca,
          04da|14ca=14da.

      Both four-transition collars are support-separated.  The literal
      diamond theorem says that after one phase wall and a fresh tag `z`,
      the three source letters

          A, z+B, C

      realize two order-one facet owners.  Their intersection is the exact
      protected lower provider `z+B`, their union is the exact upper-q1
      socket `z+T_center`, and phase credit is

          f+(D-d)=1+(2-2)=1.

      Hence each terminal certificate can now be equipped with a declared
      one-step, one-provider port.  This is cardinality-minimal.  It does not
      by itself give a globally compatible next compiler.

      Repeated pure facets are not a recursive type.  An order-one facet
      lowers upper pair-thickness and literal source-transparency height by
      one, assuming all guards/tag hits survive.  The guarded `J(4,2)` path

          24,23,13,12

      transports upper target `123` to the tagged facet path `z2,z3,z1`, but
      a second tagged facet is the duplicate pair `wz,wz`; it loses every old
      coordinate and is not Johnson.

      The correct invariant is duplex.  For a protected rank-r chronology
      with no singleton positive run, put

          F_i = z + (T_(i-1)&T_i),
          G_i = F_i|F_(i+1).

      Then `F` is a strict rank-r Johnson chronology and

          G_i = z+T_i

      is rank r+1.  Every lower/upper flag, insertion trace, departure key,
      and reciprocal connector returns with the common tag.  If `Q` is an
      order-one-transparent horizon-D source, the pointwise source map

          Q^z_p = z+Q_p

      realizes `F` at horizon D-1 and `G` at horizon D, preserves the whole
      common-Q fibre and every occurrence-labelled protected edge, and has
      exact phase one on `F`.  A reciprocal connector maps to its complete
      guarded L-B-R bridge triad and returns under the natural union mate.

      This yields an explicit infinite sector induction.  Starting from a
      rank-r socket on 2r coordinates, each round adds used tag `z_j` and
      avoided coordinate `y_j`; common-core suspension is the odd step and
      copy avoiding `y_j` is the even step.  After n rounds the socket has
      rank r+n on 2(r+n) coordinates, with the same protected depths and
      source correlations.  This is a true recursive port family, but only a
      sector: it does not exhaust the larger middle deck.

      Relative to a fixed one-flat global skeleton, full plateau closure is
      equivalent to one exact condition.  Join all module source relations,
      the germ relation `Q_child=z+Q_parent`, and every cross-interface owner
      equation; project to child sources.  There must be one projected source
      Q for which the free-cell graph has a matching saturating every lower
      casualty.  Exact middle ownership, the complete upper bridge/seam
      catalogue, residence and boundary replay remain mandatory hypotheses.

      Thus the local port-regeneration obstruction is solved.  The precise
      remaining all-k statement is the PBBS duplex-embedding lemma: embed one
      guarded duplex germ into an exact global plateau skeleton while the
      projected same-Q Hall condition and complete upper catalogue pass.
      This lemma is UNPROVED; no unconditional all-k word is claimed.

      Three independent adversarial audits PASS after correcting ranks,
      hereditary tag hits, intermediate facet sources, endpoint completions,
      source-fibre projection, and even/odd parity quantifiers.

2060. Lane R has resolved the fixed-source compiler algebra and the
      conditional one-step composition for the renewable duplex sector,
      isolating two exact existence gates: a zeroable/redundant source port
      and a bulk mixed-tag compiler module.

      After one common source is fixed, the literal compiler incidence graph
      is right-functional and splits exactly by fresh-tag signature.  A
      no-tag target can use only a no-tag interval; a tagged target `z+X` can
      use only an interval meeting the tagged sector, with old trace exactly
      `X`.  Distinct Boolean labels have disjoint physical host families, so
      the fixed-source Hall condition is pointwise.  The common-source
      quantifier remains essential.

      If a complete rank-r parent lower compiler is retained inside the
      canonical suspension `Q^z_p=z+Q_p`, and the other modules cover every
      no-z child target, all tagged strict lower targets are transported
      except singleton `{z}`.  Since every parent letter is nonempty, no
      internal or cross-tag interval realizes `{z}`.  One pure-tag cell is
      necessary and sufficient.  A canonical position p can be eroded to
      `{z}` without changing an owner window J exactly when

          Q_p subseteq union_(q in J, q != p) Q_q;

      the same redundancy condition on every selected witness interval
      preserves the transported compiler matching.  Existence of one such
      position in a recursive PBBS/Pascal child remains unproved.

      If a full horizon-d parent compiler is cut at b adjacencies, at most
      `b*C(d,2)` distinguished lower witnesses are destroyed.  Exact
      suffix/prefix or multi-seam trace equalities restore them, and one
      pure-tag socket then gives deterministic composition using at most
      `1+b*C(d,2)` occurrence ports.  At d=Theta(sqrt(k)) and b=O(1), this
      is O(k).  This is an exact trace criterion, not scalar capacity.

      Boundary ports alone cannot iterate the two-coordinate duplex round.
      On old ground of size 2r, if every z-bearing cell lies in the renewable
      sector and omits fresh y while every exterior cell is z-free, all
      strict-lower masks `{z,y}+X`, `|X|<=r-2`, must cross a tag boundary.
      With t boundaries there are at most `t*C(d,2)` short crossing
      intervals, versus `sum_(j=0)^(r-2) C(2r,j)` required masks.  Thus even
      O(k) boundaries fail asymptotically.  Under the exhaustive
      internal/boundary dichotomy, a global recursion needs a bulk module
      providing all but `t*C(d,2)` mixed-tag masks under the common source:
      all but O(k) for t=O(1), and all but O(k^2) for t=O(k).  It also needs
      the zeroable port and exact seam traces.

      An independent adversarial audit PASSed the corrected target ranges,
      C(d,2) count, boundary conventions, appendage scope and exhaustive
      mixed-boundary dichotomy.  It also PASSed Sections 4--7 of the parallel
      right-functional/eroded-duplex theorem: Theorem 6.1 is correctly an
      odd-to-even conditional theorem for r>=2, all hypotheses refer to one
      nonempty post-erasure source, and Corollary 7.1 now requires a base,
      typed compatibility, deadline-position preservation, and verified
      intervening parity transitions.

      The three newly reported length-12,873 k=16 carriers with exact middle
      and complete upper replay but Hall deficiency 34/35 fit this theorem's
      boundary exactly.  The carrier statement alone does not say whether
      these are fixed-source right-functional deficiencies or pre-source
      domain-Hall deficiencies.  Only minimization over the entire typed
      source fibre computes `Delta`; in every case the data confirm that the
      carrier theorem is not the compiler theorem.
