2064. Lane AD has closed the complete split-pair endpoint hybrid lattice,
      including the five pairs that were too large for direct `2^c` replay.

      The eight distinct authenticated endpoints are IDs

          151,155,162,178,229,231,233,282.

      Pair equal masks in occurrence order.  The resulting permutation of
      physical positions has nontrivial cycles, and switching a whole cycle
      from endpoint A to endpoint B preserves the row multiset exactly.  The
      23 pairs with at most 16 cycles were exhaustively replayed on H100:

          total subsets             115974,
          middle-exact subsets          46,
          upper-complete subsets        46,
          nonendpoint subsets       115928.

      The 46 positive rows are precisely the two endpoints in each of the 23
      lattices.  The batch wrapper lists 20 pairs; the equally valid runs
      `151_229`, `162_229`, and `229_231` are separate directories.  This
      runner/provenance distinction is now explicit.

      A solver-free residence theorem closes the five omitted pairs:

          pair       cycles   robust arcs   SCC sizes
          151/282       26         153          26
          155/282       23         133          23
          178/282       24         143          24
          231/282       26         157          19,7
          233/282       21          98          21.

      In the common depth-three prefix, every coordinate bit at every row is
      a constant, `x_C`, or `1-x_C`, where C is its occurrence cycle.  A
      bounded trace `0,1^ell,0` with `1<=ell<=3` cannot be reconstructed by
      any four-row maximal envelope.  Each stored local window therefore
      gives an implication between two cycle switches.  Four implication
      graphs are strongly connected.  For `231/282`, the two SCCs are
      `{0,...,18}` and `{19,...,25}`; a robust `0008` window gives the forward
      quotient implication and the exact `0400` trace

          0,1,1,1,0 at rows 3842..3846

      excludes the remaining reverse quotient assignment.  Hence every
      nonempty proper cycle subset in all five pairs has a positive run of
      length at most three and is middle-inexact.  No `2^c` enumeration is
      used for this step.

      This canonical cycle family is WLOG for every pointwise A/B hybrid
      preserving the row multiset on these endpoints.  Exactly 12867 masks
      occur once; the only repeated masks are

          4e71 at 6320,6321;
          cc63 at 12869,12870;
          ce61 at 12871,12872,

      identically in all eight words.  Unique-mask balance forces the switch
      to be constant on every nontrivial canonical cycle, while the six
      repeated positions are fixed and value-inert.  Thus alternative
      duplicate labels add no literal word.  The generic claim would be
      false when repeated occurrences move, and the audits include a sharp
      four-position counterexample.

      Combining the 23 authenticated direct runs with the five polynomial
      certificates proves endpoint rigidity for all 28 unordered pairs in
      the pointwise, multiset-preserving A/B class.  This does not obstruct a
      third parent, new row values, a non-pointwise braid, or another K16
      equality architecture.

      fallback.  For arbitrary one-edge openings, all old upper losses lie in
      an explicit cut-arc list of size at most

2071. Lane R has independently audited the fixed-width wedge facet-seam
      theorem and integrated it with the protected outward-ray, unrestricted
      COMP_d, and typed Pascal/duplex compiler routes.

      The local theorem is sound with four exact scope clauses.  A geodesic
      q-edge occurrence automatically has q smaller than its provider-cycle
      length; one globally assigned fixed-width witness per target suffices,
      rather than componentwise completeness; a component-transversal socket
      cycle is cyclic and does not by itself give a linear word; and socket
      vertices are oriented wedge-flank options.  For a right port with start
      S, old mate E, and departure key kappa=E\S,

          B union S = E union S

      is equivalent to B being Johnson-adjacent to S and containing kappa.

      A new literal linear theorem removes the former safe-root requirement.
      Open the first component at a left wedge flank and every later component
      at a right flank.  If the first seam has union equal to both first wedge
      unions, it repairs the first outgoing and second incoming ray towers
      simultaneously; subsequent one-way keyed-ear seams repair every later
      incoming tower.  This yields a strict linear Johnson path on the same
      vertex deck and preserves every globally assigned upper witness at all
      depths.  In the canonical one-endpoint-reuse class the exact general
      object is a colorful signed Hamilton path: endpoints have types O,I,
      and each seam equals the wedge union on every serviced side.  The
      root-plus-ears normal form is necessary for two active components and,
      up to reversal, for three; for four or more it is sufficient but not
      exhaustive.  With b cuts, at most b lower-q1 labels/multiplicity units
      remain for the compiler, while upper-q1 set coverage survives; upper
      multiplicity need not.

      The assigned-ray fallback remains exact and separate: once a lower
      compiler exists, literal appendage gives

          nu(k) <= B(k) + b(k-r-1),

      or removes the q=2 term under E1.  Lower compiler cells cannot realize
      upper casualties.  Facet sockets instead remove this O(bk) upper bill
      at zero length, but they do not supply the mixed lower compiler.

      The compiler audit distinguishes the old-witness bad boxes
      B_Y^old from UPMBC's exact B_Y^full, which also credits new seam
      witnesses.  PWI and facet sockets are incomparable sufficient opening
      subclasses; both feed the same exact good-opening predicate.  For
      positive deadline slack, a good opening plus the still-unproved pinned
      compiler automaticity theorem implies UPMBC and then FMCC.  The 24/24
      k13 compilation observation remains empirical only.  Once a carrier T
      is fixed, upper owner equations cannot shrink its source fibre; before

      in one unprojected natural join.  Cartesian PWI banks are valid exactly
      when every local option tuple extends through that full join.

      old ground of size 2r its mixed strict-lower block has exact size

          M_r = sum_{j=0}^{r-2} binom(2r,j)
              = 4^r/2 - (3r+1)/(2(r+1))*binom(2r,r).

2076. Root has formalized Claude's closed-form top-bit splice as the exact
      unconditional recurrence

          nu(k) <= 2 nu(k-1).

      For a universal predecessor `X=(x_1,...,x_n)` and new singleton bit
      `b`, the word

          X · [b] · ((x_1|b),...,(x_(n-1)|b))

      is universal: unmarked masks use the first block, `{b}` uses the
      singleton, and a marked mask uses either its marked predecessor
      interval or a predecessor suffix followed by `[b]`.  The construction
      has length exactly `2n`.

      For even `k`, conditional on `nu(k-1)=B(k-1)`, this gives overhead
      `2d(k-1)-d(k)`.  At K16 that is three, hence length12876; it does not
      improve the verified12874 upper bound or decide equality at12873.  The
      claimed constant-three/at-most-four overhead for every even k is
      false because `d(k)=Theta(sqrt(k))`: the recurrence overhead is5 at
      k24,6 at k42, and7 at k64.  The correct general consequence is a
      conditional `B(k)+O(sqrt(k))` even construction.  The odd predecessor
      existence theorem remains open.

2079. Lane B has replaced per-deletion interval reconstruction by one exact
      all-deletion target-block automaton.

      For target `t`, mark cells contained in `t` and split them into maximal
      compatible blocks.  Target coverage is equivalent to existence of a
      block whose OR is `t`.  With one such full block `B`, the exact witness
      core is

          [ min_{a in t} last_B(a), max_{a in t} first_B(a) ]

      when the endpoints are ordered, and empty otherwise.  The exact service
      interval at a compatible site `p in B` is

          [ {a in t : p uniquely carries a in B}, t ].

      Gap sites use only the adjacent block ORs.  Deleting a compatible cell
      updates only its block; deleting a singleton incompatible gap merges its
      two adjacent blocks; deleting inside a longer gap has only endpoint
      service corrections.  Full status changes only at unique-coordinate
      cells, core endpoints only at first/last occurrences, and other-site
      service lows only through coordinates of block multiplicity at most
      two.  This is the exact bounded OR halo requested by the provider-first
      programme.

      A target becomes a deletion hole iff its source automaton has exactly
      one full block and the deleted cell uniquely carries a coordinate in
      that block.  Hence each target contributes at most its rank deletion
      holes and the global K-bit incidence bound is `K*2^(K-1)`.  The new
      target-first replay reconstructs all 116,073 frozen K16 incidences from
      51,154 distinct hole targets; every one has one unique full block and no
      target has more than five hole-producing deletions.  Across those
      targets the reusable catalogue has 14,393,749 compatible blocks and
      17,725,217 compatible-cell visits, versus 1,494,207,729 raw canonical
      position/hole incidences.

      The shared provider engine should now store physical sites as exact
      block/gap position bitsets, accumulate survivor-bit upper constraints by
      core-range counters and lower constraints by essential-site point
      counters, and hand retained site identities to the existing exact
      second sweep.  No transition profile is quotiented.  This is a structural
      reduction and all-hole audit, not an all-deletion radius-two no-go.

2080. Lane AD has resolved the general fixed-width facet-socket existence
      interface up to one explicit sparse dispersion lemma.

      For a fixed assigned upper tower, component openings form a coloured
      directed transducer: a safe root contributes its endpoint, and every
      later wedge opening accepts exactly the alternate facets B satisfying
      B union S=U and outputs its wedge centre.  For a fixed component order
      sigma, a colorful chain exists iff the exact Boolean endpoint product

          Q_(sigma1) T_(sigma2) ... T_(sigmab)

      is nonempty.  Globally, the selected-option degree equations become
      exact after adding the rooted component cuts

          y(delta^-(I))+a(I)>=1

      for every nonempty proper component set I; these rows are equivalent
      to the subtour inequalities and are separable by directed min-cut.
      Ordinary successor Hall supplies only a cycle cover.  Two proved
      positive replacements are robust-quotient Dirac after a safe root and
      Hall plus universally available crossed-successor two-switches.

      Component projection alone is unsound.  A three-colour chamber
      construction has complete bidirected projection, option colour-degree
      b-2, and paths on every proper subfamily, but no full colorful path; a
      local realization exists in J(9,5).  Thus b-1 is the sharp worst-case
      option-level colour-degree threshold.  The k13 census is interpreted
      correctly: 130+52=182 maximum-flexibility all-upper one-seam splices,
      while the distinct all-wedge incidence slice has 52 safe chains and
      quotient incidence 2 in only one direction.

      The new odd-middle obstruction is quantitative.  Q1 completeness and
      absence of monochromatic components give

          D_wedge <= 2W/(m+2).

      Hence a full-rotation unit-voltage factor has at most
      2 Cat_m/(m+2) wedge-bearing components.  A linear chain may use one
      arbitrary safe root, but every other component must bear a wedge.
      Moreover a mutual Dirac core of n=b-1 invariant components must obey

          n ceil(n/2) <= 2(m-1) Cat_m/(m+2),

      so dense Dirac is impossible for n>=2 sqrt(Cat_m).  This does not
      refute the actual PBBS factor, whose theorem gives only b<=Cat_m and
      permits arbitrary voltages; it refutes a Catalan-scale unit-voltage
      all-wedge normalization.  The exact surviving upper gate is a sparse
      option-level Boolean-product/Hall-two-switch dispersion theorem after
      component reduction, or a nonwedge destination-seam theorem.
      Residence, lower-q1 restitution, and the common lower compiler remain
      independent.

      certificates and identified the strongest deletion-independent
      survivor coupling.  Since D3 is a subset of D4, the closed family is

2083. Root extracted the architecture-free hereditary face-trace theorem.
      For every universal word A on V and every face S subseteq V, deleting
      every letter not contained in S leaves a universal word on S.  Hence

          #{i:A_i subseteq S} >= nu(|S|)

      individually for every face.  Summing over equal-size faces gives the
      rank-moment hierarchy

          sum_s C(k-s,a)n_s >= C(k,a)nu(k-a).

      At hypothetical K16 equality, every rank-above-eight letter is a jump,
      so there are at most three.  An exact 16-variable integer audit using
      the proved values through K15 shows that the aggregated moment
      constraints remain feasible; they do not prove a fourth waste unit.
      The ordered individual traces are the useful content.

      In the canonical one-hole word the unique tightest 15-face is 0x7fff
      and has6499 retained letters, only61 above nu(15)=6438.  If an equality
      word has any coordinate in exactly6435 letters, its complementary
      trace is literally an optimal K15 word, giving an exact bilayer normal
      form.  It is not yet proved that some coordinate must be tight.

      The selected ghost-surgery branch also factors into seven Boolean
      front-end choices: the16 admissible p12826 values form a four-cube and
      the8 p6437 common-provider values form a three-cube.  Their invariant
      residual packet consists of six masks with common core0879; the new
      distributed19-cell model encodes this factorization eagerly.

2112. Lane K has reduced the hypothetical complete K17 four-sector carrier
      to an exact tight-staircase/common-cap theorem and specialized it to
      both distributed U insertion and the new balanced cap-two core.  This
      is a conditional compiler theorem, not a K17 carrier or upper bound.

      Put W=24310,L=24313 and Lambda=65535.  For arbitrary starts/deadlines,
      the exact lower-cell surplus is

          Omega=7401-Loss(alpha,tau).

      Besides scalar capacity, rank-chain feasibility needs

          tau1+(tau2-alpha1)_+ +(tau3-alpha2)_+
               +(W-alpha3) <= 3.

      At one-pivot loss7401 the atlas has exactly65535 cells: all24313
      singletons, all24312 adjacent pairs, and16910 tail triples.  Hence its
      OR map must be a bijection onto every nonempty rank<=8 target.  This is
      the exact K17-FRS terminal condition.  The spectral identity

          H_Q=D_Q+R_Q-Omega

      and the corrected labelled zeta moments are proved independently.

      Pre-integration U connectedness is compiler-invisible once the final
      ordered chronology, schedule, baseline caps and pins are fixed.  For
      f=737 fragments inserted separately into distinct YAX junctions, the
      no-new q1 slot count is exactly

          (1429-f)+(5005-f)+2f
            =692+4268+1474=6434.

      Literal use requires the disjoint palette partition

          C(15,8)=C_U dotcup C_YAX dotcup C_cross dotcup {c_*};

      counts alone do not construct the non-edge physical top port.  The
      exact collar charge is orphan cells, not seams:

          Omega_res=Omega-(|K|-|Pi_K|).

      At zero slack every reserved cell must discharge a distinct jointly
      safe lower target.  The1474 insertion interfaces have only crude union
      bounds4422 lower cells/8844 shallow windows; pure quarantine of even
      one crossing cell is impossible at one-pivot zero slack.

      The balanced residual tuple

          (AA,XX,YY,AX,AY)=(5005,5005,5005,715,715)

      contributes sector degree vector(11440,10725,10725,0); the fixed1430-
      path bank contributes(1430,2145,2145,10010).  Literal completion also
      requires vertexwise complementary degrees, complement-rainbow colours,
      and connected2-regular monodromy after contracting1430 nontrivial paths
      plus15015 isolates.  The quotient has16445 components; after opening,
      16444 connectors remain.  Paying one orphan collar cell per connector
      already exceeds Delta17, so almost all connectors must be transparent
      or balanced pins.

      After a complete physical rank8 pin basis, the zero-slack residual is
      41225 targets by41225 cells, with signature demands
      (16383,9949,9949,4944).  In a final sector-complete guarded bank the
      distinct pair cuts are26332,21327,19898,14893 and the triple cuts are
      36281,31276,24842.  More generally, the note gives an exact
      pair-choice-conditioned provider theorem: full two-edge choices
      containing fixed forest edges determine a future upper-aware/resident
      chronology; complete provider domains, target exact-one/cell AMO, and
      maximal-cap equations are necessary and sufficient for its lower
      compiler.  A compact survival-literal CNF is proved for fixed pair
      choices.  Ordinary Hall suffices only inside a matching-closed guarded
      bank.

      Staircase cost depends on the final composed Sigma3 state, not seam
      count.  One-pivot needs rho1=rho2=0,rho3<=7401.  Full composed
      depth-three safety makes the budget automatic; Johnson/q1 balance or
      pairwise seam guards do not.  The currently available lower-rainbow
      2-factor has4413 upper-q1 holes and a large short-run frontier, so it
      fails the carrier gates and is not a compiler input.

2107. Lane AD has formalized the K15-to-K17 forced
      `U | (Y_i A_i X_i)_(i=1)^1430` Catalan braid and reduced it to an
      exact fixed-U native CSP.  This is a block theorem and finite
      construction interface, not a labelled K17 carrier or word.

      Here U is the pure 5005-vertex rank-nine-on-[15] path block, while
      each A_i,X_i,Y_i is a nonempty path block and each of those three
      block families totals6435 vertices.  Hence the chronology has exactly

      owners.  An integral unlabelled skeleton takes715 A-blocks of length4
      and715 of length5, with X/Y lengths9-|A_i|.  All x- and y-runs then
      have length9 and contribute rho=(0,0,0).  This size assignment is an

      In the one-hole lower-q1-rainbow class, internal slot saturation is

          xy:5005/5005, x:6435/6435, y:6435/6435,
          00 internal-U:5004.

      There are exactly1430 external seams.  The macro transition table is

          ++ : X->Y, lower00, upperxy;
          +- : X->X, lowerx,  upperx;
          -+ : Y->Y, lowery,  uppery;
          -- : Y->X, lower00, upperxy.

      A mixed seam would place6436 distinct edges in a6435-colour x or y
      family.  Thus every macro after U has one common orientation.  All
      external seams then have lower tag00, giving exactly6434 distinct
      no-new colours and one no-new boundary hole.

      For forward `U|YAX...`, the exact upper-q1 slot/target ledger is

          00:5004/3003, x:5005/5005,
          y:5006/5005, xy:9294/6435.

      Targetwise, 00 must be covered inside U; x is an exact internal-X
      occurrence transversal; y is the internal-Y multiset plus the U
      endpoint value; and xy is the A-internal plus YA/AX/XY seam union
      support.  Reverse orientation swaps x and y.  Scalar upper surplus is
      not a substitute for these targetwise rows.

      The arbitrary-upper tag classification is also exact for the linear
      common-orientation braid.  In forward orientation: 00 intervals lie
      wholly in U; x-only intervals lie in one X block; y-only intervals
      lie in one Y block or cross only the unique U|Y entrance; every other
      tail interval has tagxy.  A four-field associative summary
      (hit,all-contained,prefix-OR,suffix-OR) composes literal upper replay
      at every depth.  Mixed orientations and cyclic closure require feeding
      their actual extra seams into the same monoid.

      Old-coordinate staircase constraints are much sharper than average
      residence.  The tail starts at absolute position5005.  A tail run of
      length1 or2 would force frontier sums at least15015 or10010, exceeding
      Delta17=7401.  A length3 tail run must start absolutely by7401, hence

      four-edge C3 incidence histogram is

          0^2265 1^2760 2^1290 3^120.

      A late untouched C3 run gives a guarded cut row; its lateness must be
      evaluated in the actual oriented child order.  The exact checker is a
      six-control-state weighted run automaton carrying current-start and
      rho1/rho2/rho3 registers.  An unconditional cut row for all1425 runs
      is only a stronger sufficient subclass.

      After U is frozen, its complete interface consists of its endpoint,
      internal lower palette, every target interval summary, and all
      accumulated/terminal run states.  For fixed legal Y/A/X blocks, a
      forward macro i can precede j iff its X-end old mask equals j's Y-start
      old mask.  Endpoint labels are injective, so this is a partial
      functional digraph.  A spanning order must be one path or an openable

      To construct the blocks, the exact native per-orientation master has

          38610 native AA/XX/YY directions,
          51480 YA containments, 51480 AX containments,
          6435 XY equalities, 9 fixed-endpoint UY sockets.

      It uses19305 tail order integers and40755 target-indexed q1 rows,

      The open gate is simultaneous A/X/Y forest selection, containment

2106. Lane A has solved the arbitrary-start monotone staircase algebra for
      every labelled K17 four-sector UYAX linearization and isolated a sharp
      obstruction to the current contiguous-U order.

      Put W=24310, d=3 and Delta17=7401.  Writing the ordered start
      thresholds as alpha_j=W-delta_j, every scalar-viable schedule
      automatically satisfies

          tau_3<=7401,
          alpha_1>=16909, alpha_2>=20610, alpha_3>=21843.

      Thus every deadline lies strictly before every start, the loss cross
      term vanishes, and legality plus chain alignment are automatic.  If

          m_delta(b)=#{j:delta_j>=W-b-1}

      and rho_j^delta is the latest start a of an interior run [a,b] with

          (b-a+1)+m_delta(b)<=j,

      then exact row-OR replay plus scalar capacity is equivalent to

          min_delta (sum delta_j + sum rho_j^delta) <= 7401.

      A passing delta gives tau=rho^delta and the literal q/s schedule

          s_i=i+#{j:delta_j>=W-i},
          q_i=i+#{j:rho_j^delta<=i}.

      This is an existence criterion for row replay and scalar capacity;
      envelopes, upper shadows, Hall and common-Q remain separate.

      The unlabelled 1430-block arithmetic is compatible with the schedule:
      use715 macroblocks of sizes (U,Y,A,X)=(4,4,5,4) and715 of
      (3,5,4,5).  Every macro has length17, the exact sector totals are
      (5005,6435,6435,6435), and the new-x/new-y runs have length9.  Hence
      only old-coordinate runs enter rho.  If all interior old-coordinate
      runs have length at least4 and every four consecutive rows intersect,
      the explicit zero-loss schedule alpha=(W,W,W), tau=(0,0,0) works.
      The U-prefix schedule tau=(0,0,5005) has exact cell count67931 and
      surplus2396; it is exact iff there are no interior length1/2 runs and
      every length3 run starts by5005, together with the displayed local
      triple/fourfold envelope tests.

      A single interior run [a,b] of length ell<=3 forces the sharp loss

          (4-ell) min{a,W-b-1}.

      Thus singleton, double and triple runs have forbidden start bands
      [2468,21841], [3701,20607], and [7402,16905].  Independently, every
      viable schedule has the forced central envelope plateau

          E_(i+3)=T_i intersect T_(i+1) intersect T_(i+2) intersect T_(i+3)
          for 7401<=i<=16905.

      Global four-local intersection is sufficient.  On the balanced UYAX
      skeleton it reduces to U interiors and the UY/XU collars; YA and AX
      collars are protected by y and x.  A rank-nine Johnson collar has
      intersection size at least6.

      Finally, the 5005-row order

          scratch/k17_pbbs_u_remote_best_20260731/pbbs_u_best.word
          SHA 085a6876191df16cdd8fc0ed09237f023aa5a4a570ea59463301d24339293915

      has persistent interior singleton offsets1642,2177,4988,5001.  Over

      maximum endpoint distance of these four rows is3362, so one singleton

      used as one untouched contiguous U block.  Splitting, cyclically
      cutting, interleaving or genuinely rethreading U remains open; no
      labelled UYAX Hamilton word or K17 upper bound is claimed.

2105. Lane L has reconciled the finite K16 endpoint-reroot/common-cap
      mechanism with the K15-to-K17 four-sector Pascal diamond in one exact
      dimension-uniform Shadow--Braid interface.  This is a conditional
      induction theorem, not an all-k construction.

      For an odd parent of size2r-1, write

          M=C(2r-1,r),  Cat_r=2M/(r+1).

      The odd-to-even shores have sizes M,M; the even-to-odd shores have
      sizes2M-Cat_r,2M; and the odd-to-odd diamond has exact sectors

          |U|=M-Cat_r,  |X|=|Y|=|A|=M.

      If a directed parent factor has an exact facet deck, an occurrence
      transversal of every rank-(r+1) union, and the exact cap-two factor
      between selected indices and rank-(r-2) caps, the literal A/X/Y/U edge
      formulas produce a spanning child Johnson 2-factor whose intersections
      enumerate the complete child lower-q1 deck.  This owner theorem is
      dimension-free for r>=3, but supplies neither child upper coverage nor
      residence or compilation.

      The exact compiler lemma packages the missing quantifiers as SB0--SB4:
      exact middle ownership; the arbitrary-start safe-corridor and nonempty
      envelopes; explicit arbitrary-width upper witness intervals; jointly
      capped positional pins; and one residual injective assignment with a
      single global nonempty common cap.  Chain alignment transfers every
      owner-row upper witness to one physical interval.  At physical length
      B(k), these hypotheses imply nu(k)=B(k).  Separate sector Hall
      matchings, q1 completeness, or scalar capacity are explicitly
      insufficient.

      Parity is tracked literally.  Faceting sends a non-singleton run/gap
      pair (ell,g) to(ell-1,g+1) and needs parent compiler depth d+1 on the
      facet shore.  Union sends it to(ell+1,g-1), uses depth d-1 only for
      d>=1 away from collars, and requires singleton zero-gaps to be excluded
      or repaired.  In a Catalan ribbon, the two new tags have runs g+1 and
      zero-gaps2g-1, hence require

          g>=d,  g>=ceil((u+2)/2).

      Old-coordinate residence and the independent A-factor remain literal
      audits.  Protected block rerooting is exact through internal cut
      supports H=partial[a,b]: a target survives internally iff some H
      avoids the cut set, or else a new boundary ladder recreates it.

      The resulting odd-spine theorem is conditional on the explicit
      terminal hypothesis CSB_r.  An optimum-length regenerative package in
      dimension2r-1 must produce SB0--SB4 braids of lengths B(2r) and
      B(2r+1), plus an auxiliary diamond-ready factor and event/port data for
      the next odd package.  Under CSB_r for all later r, induction is valid;
      CSB_r itself is unproved and already includes integral common-cap
      feasibility.

      The finite reconciliation is sharp.  K16 is a positive protected
      instance: block lengths6389,6437,44 protect all39197 old interval
      values, add six missing masks, and the singleton/common-cap compiler
      gives the exact word.  The K15-to-K17 factor closes owner flow and all
      24310 lower-q1 colours, but has17 cycles,1739 upper-q1 holes,4045 total
      upper holes,60 direct-formula occurrence conflicts, and a separate
      49-cut residence floor on its largest frozen cycle.  It is therefore
      not regenerative.

2151. Lane R has rebased the clean-H transition theorem on item2148's
      matching-first quantifier and independently audited the exact global
      matching/forest/socket reduction.  Put

          K=Cat_m, N_m=(m+1)K=C(2m,m), R_m=mK=C(2m,m-1).

      Every clean-H quotient perfect matching of the complete diamond graph
      lifts canonically to R_m Johnson edges on all N_m middle vertices and
      uses every lower and upper adjacent colour exactly once.  Its
      exceptional restriction has 2(s/3)Cat_a clean-H edge orbits, reducing
      to the locally sharp 2Cat_a contribution at valuation one.  Opposite
      colours are distinct only within each typed family; complemented
      labels can agree across families.  The filter middle endpoints are
      mutually distinct, but nonfilter atoms may still meet them.

      Assume, as for the clean Catalan group, that H has odd order and acts
      freely on the middle rank.  The lift is a spanning linear forest iff
      its quotient occurrence multigraph satisfies

          deg(v)<=2,
          |E(S)|<=|S|-1 for every nonempty middle-orbit set S,

      with loops and parallel pairs counted.  It then has K/h quotient path
      components, K physical components, 2K/h quotient endpoint
      occurrences and 2K physical endpoint occurrences; an isolated vertex
      contributes two port occurrences at the same vertex.  Regular
      matching Hall does not imply this graphic condition: at m=5,h=1 the
      standard BTK perfect diamond matching has degree five at
      E_5={0,2,4,6,8}.

      An invariant closure uses exactly K/h seam orbits and K physical
      seams.  Inside the saturated closure fibre it is one Hamilton cycle
      iff the endpoint occurrence successor is one cycle and total clean-H
      voltage is a unit.  Distinct lower and upper seam-colour orbits give
      the exact cyclic cap-two profile 1^(R_m-K)2^K.  A generic
      symmetry-broken physical splice uses K-1 seams and is one Hamilton
      path iff its contracted seam graph is one path; distinct seam colours
      give 1^(R_m-K+1)2^(K-1).  For h>1 a single physical Hamilton path
      cannot itself be H-invariant.

      The exceptional matching edges need no extension sockets.  Closure
      ports, and any packets decorating exceptional edges, still require
      occurrence-labelled private resources including endpoints, phase,
      gain, collars, hosts and witnesses.  Pairwise middle-endpoint
      distinctness is insufficient.  The audited exact master is (QM) plus
      middle degree/graphic rows (D),(G), literal closure exclusion (CE),
      directed circuit rows (C0)--(C2), and the unit-voltage row (V); the
      socket module is exact only for an exhaustive refinement catalogue.
      A final linear boundary deletes one physical phase occurrence, not a
      full orbit.  Physical guards and the compiler remain separate and may
      break every symmetry.

      Thus residual-Kneser extension is retired.  The sharp all-m gate is
      existence of a quotient perfect matching satisfying the graphic
      forest inequalities and admitting protected private sockets plus a
      unit-voltage closure (or a symmetry-broken path), followed by literal
      deeper-shadow, residence and compiler replay.  No all-m or K17
      existence is claimed.

      Scope correction for the adjacent GK lane: none of this reduction
      uses the retracted assertion that every linear subforest of the
      standard GK projection retains at most W/2 edges.  Deleting a
      vertex's outgoing edge may leave two incoming edges, with a star as
      the minimal obstruction.  The corrected finite tree-DP maxima for
      m=3,...,7 are 13,44,159,588,2188, not 10,35,126,462,1716.  The exact
      indegree census survives.  Item2154's plane-tree theorem now proves
      the corrected deleted fraction tends to 0.356895867892..., but this
      quotient-matching reduction imports neither that edit bound nor the
      retracted W/2 formula.

2142. Lane A has completed the structural K17 unrestricted-completion
      theorem and separated every current fixed-bank failure from global
      impossibility.  No claim that nu(17)=B(17)=24313 is made.

      For one complete occurrence-labelled upper-witness/collar bank Gamma,
      use one common ground set of state-labelled directed Johnson options.
      Tail, head and lower-colour capacities are partition matroids; all
      state/orientation copies of one underlying edge are parallel in the
      physical graphic matroid.  If Gamma is admissible and extension-closed,
      a connected coherently oriented lower-rainbow Hamilton path retaining
      Gamma exists iff P(Gamma) is independent in all four systems and the
      four contractions have a common independent extension of size

          24309-|P(Gamma)|.

      The N-1 selected physical arcs are then a spanning tree; in/out
      capacities force it to be one coherently directed path.  Taking the
      disjunction over an exhaustive refinement of literal certificate banks
      gives the exact unrestricted characterization.  This is not ordinary
      Hall and four separate rank inequalities do not suffice.

      The source-ejection ledger is coordinatewise exact.  For a
      p-component spanning rainbow path forest Q,

          1_[f_c absent]
            = #(nonfactor Q-edges of colour c)+1_[c missing],
          |C(Q)|=|R(Q)|+p,  |M(Q)|=p,

      and

          deg_R(v)+(2-deg_Q(v))
            = sum_(c:v in f_c) 1_[f_c absent].

      Thus one extra ejection creates one component, one exit, one entry,
      one missing colour and one required return, but no scalar slack.  A
      fixed seam of colour c conflicts exactly with a protected source edge
      f_c; a retained unprotected f_c may still be ejected later.

      The resulting unrestricted signed-packet normal form is exact.  Delete
      d physical edges D from Q, orient the p+d fragments by omega, and add
      new literal seams A.  The result is one Hamilton path omitting colour b
      iff the contracted seams form one directed Hamilton path and

          chi(A)=(chi(D) disjoint-union M(Q))\{b},
          b in chi(D) disjoint-union M(Q),
          |A|=p+d-1.

      Upper protection is occurrence-labelled: every target must keep one
      allowed witness inside an oriented fragment or acquire one literal
      crossing witness.  Run lengths compose through exact fragment boundary
      states; reversal reflects [s,s+l) to [L-s-l,L-s), so deadline offsets
      must also be carried.

      Two deterministic topology mechanisms are proved.  First, every
      bounded exact degree/colour/state fibre is connected by conformal
      Graver moves, so failure of all 2x2 switches is only a move-family
      no-go.  Second, a protected colour-balanced square

          x->x', y->y'  replaced by  x->y', y->x'

      absorbs one directed cycle into the root path when the old/new colour
      multisets agree and the extended move stays in the exact guarded
      fibre.  A root-to-leaf tree of such squares is sufficient when old
      supports are disjoint/protected, physical arcs are jointly compatible,
      and every ordered full-vector prefix remains feasible.

      The smallest authenticated live fixed-bank obstruction is the colour
      0x04fb circuit: the provider choice 0x84fb->0x0cfb for target 0x8cff
      conflicts with source edge 0x44fb->0x05fb protected by provider
      0x64f9->0x44fb for target 0x1e4fb.  Hence those two occurrence choices
      satisfy an exact two-literal no-good.  The exact-active2649 bank has
      1,142 such seam/protected-source colour circuits and one forced 9-cycle.
      Hard323 has 37 doubleton seam-colour classes; among its 1,061 surviving
      seam/source collisions, 312 are protected conflicts, 741 are pure
      ejection obligations, and eight already belong to duplicate classes.

      Inside the much narrower frozen 1,838-provider, frozen-orientation,
      minimal-3,336-cut face, tail--colour and colour--head matching ranks
      926/892 imply that adding only canonical source ejections needs at least
      605 further cuts.  Provider reselection, fragment reversal or provider
      release changes the old--old graph, so this is not a K17 lower bound.

      Finally, the note states K17-FRS literally.  If the same final Hamilton
      chronology is upper-complete and admits its exact Q_0,...,Q_24312 FRS
      partition, the audited compiler gives a universal word of length24313.
      The sharp remaining equality gate is one certificate bank with a
      target-size physical four-system extension whose final chronology also
      admits K17-FRS/common-cap compilation.

2143. Root and an independent theorem lane have identified the exact
      all-m cyclic symmetry scale for directed Catalan repair.  Put

          q=2m-1, s=3^v_3(q), h=q/s.

      The Catalan identity

          (m^2-1) Cat_m = 2q C(q-1,m-2)

      and gcd(q,m^2-1)=gcd(q,3) prove h divides Cat_m.  The subgroup
      Z_h=<s> acts freely on all three relevant ranks m-1,m,m+1.  It is the
      largest rotation subgroup having that uniform freeness property.

      The independent orbit theorem proves the sharper full-Z_q statement:
      middle rank is always free; the only shortened near-middle states are
      order-three rank-(m-1) states containing infinity and their rank-(m+1)
      complements, occurring exactly when3 divides q.  Every occurrence
      repair edge is free because its omitted middle shore is free.  Hence a
      full edge orbit hits a shortened colour orbit three-to-one, proving
      that a fully Z_q-invariant exact lower-rainbow/direct repair is
      impossible when3 divides q.

      On free shores, invariant repair matchings are in exact bijection with
      perfect matchings of the orbit multihypergraph.  Invariant spanning
      linear forests quotient to literal path forests and every quotient
      path lifts to h paths.  Closing the quotient into circuits of voltages
      v_i gives exactly sum_i gcd(h,v_i) physical cycles.  A Hamilton lift
      therefore requires one quotient cycle and unit voltage; nonzero is not
      enough at composite order.

      Thus the clean all-m architecture is Z_h-equivariance plus a
      residual Z_s braid.  The residual phases are synchronized tracks, not
      s equal packets: at m=8/K16, for example, K/h=286 is not divisible by
      s=3.  At m=5 one has h=1,s=9, so the older three-copy arithmetic
      ledger is not this nine-sector quotient.  These are reductions, not
      an existence proof for the quotient forest or sector braid.

2144. Root and two independent audits have corrected the exact
      period-three palette scope.  When q=2m-1=6a+3, the shortened lower
      colours are

          {infinity} union pi^(-1)(A),  A in C(Z_(2a+1),a),

      and the shortened upper bank is its complementary (a+1)-set copy.

      orbit forces a partially occupied full-Z_q edge orbit, and the two
      banks are disjoint, so 2 Cat_a is the exact exceptional-bank
      contribution, not in general the global partial-orbit minimum.

      A fixed incident edge orbit has 3^(q/3) unrestricted sections.  At the
      clean scale h=q/s, s=3^v_3(q), it has 3^(s/3) H-invariant phase words
      in 3^(s/3)/s residual cyclic classes.  Only when s=3 is this literally
      one constant choice among three phases; higher 3-primary order is a
      monodromic phase word, not a proved iteration of subgroup sections.

      A separate exact diagnostic strengthens the total full-rotation
      partial-support bound to 3 Cat_a.  The ordinary opposite colour of a
      filter edge recovers its exceptional necklace from its complete
      order-three cosets, so different necklaces have disjoint neighbour
      banks and each needs a distinct ordinary partial compensator.  Equality
      forces Cat_a weighted orbit-demand paths

          L* --q/3--> B --2q/3--> A --q/3--> U*.

      This classifies minimum partial support only.  It is not the
      construction route: item2148 chooses a global clean-H quotient perfect
      matching first, and its exceptional restriction is already extended.
      The a=1 and a=2 phase censuses are diagnostic fixtures, not K16 seam or
      compiler models.  In particular the K16 four changed edge classes are
      not four literal filters; only one changed lower colour is shortened,
      no changed upper colour is, the sectors interlace inside each spiral,
      and the compiler breaks H.

2145. Root has extracted the exact three-primary spiral-braid anatomy of
      the authenticated K16 optimum.  The rank-eight carrier is the
      concatenation of four strict, co-oriented Z_15 spirals with base
      lengths

          426, 426, 3, 3

      and common sheet voltage +4.  They are exactly the A/B lifts of the
      K15 parent's two components of lengths 6390 and45.  Each spiral
      contains all three residual Z_15/<3> sectors; the sectors are
      interlaced through every block rather than forming three independent
      packets.

      Closing the blocks separately gives a fully Z_15-invariant four-cycle
      factor.  Opening the four cycles and inserting three literal Johnson
      connectors gives the Hamilton path used by the optimum.  The fourth
      cyclic wrap has symmetric difference six and is deliberately omitted.
      In general, an odd parent with c strict cyclic components produces 2c
      A/B spiral blocks and asks for 2c-1 linear seams; palette-safe seam
      existence remains the theorem gate.

      The four edge defects do not service the four shortened outer-colour
      orbits one-for-one.  Only one changed lower colour is short and no
      changed upper colour is short; the reroot repairs two holes inside
      long upper-colour orbits.  Thus the numerical equality between the
      period-three floor and the four K16 filters is not a canonical
      edge-by-edge correspondence.

      Symmetry belongs to the carrier, not the final compiler.  Carrier
      covariance under the clean Z_5 action is 12870/12870, the pinned
      envelope has 12852/12870, but the decoded letters have only
      6535/12870 and their multiset has L1 discrepancy3148.  Consequently an
      equivariant common-cap compiler would exclude the known optimum.  The
      scalable architecture must use symmetry to organize the carrier and
      then permit the integral lower matching to break it.

2146. Root's connector lane has isolated the exact palette and voltage
      content of a spiral braid.  If t opened cyclic blocks are joined with
      t-1 physical seams, the contracted block graph is a tree; these seams
      are necessary and sufficient for one linear path.  Both adjacent
      palettes remain covered exactly when the literal load ledger

          L_new = L_closed - L_deleted + L_inserted

      remains positive on each lower and upper colour.  Exact multiset
      preservation is the stronger zero signed-change equation.  Co-
      orientation and Johnson adjacency alone imply neither condition.

      In a clean H-equivariant quotient, every voltage assignment on that
      tree is a coboundary.  Its physical lift is therefore |H| disjoint
      paths, regardless of connector gains.  A connected cyclic lift needs
      one additional protected socket or retained closed walk, and the
      resulting lift is connected exactly when its total voltage is a unit
      modulo |H|.  This is the sharp distinction between the linear K16
      braid (three seams, non-Johnson wrap omitted) and the cyclic m=4
      fixture (genuine protected closure of voltage2).

      Complement pairing exchanges the two palette ledgers, but an odd
      clean group has no self-complementary Johnson edge orbit.  Hence the
      odd 2c-1 seam bank of an A/B doubled braid cannot be wholly
      complement-paired: at least one symmetry-breaking seam is necessary.
      Period-three packets can be inserted neutrally only into distinct
      private sockets with the same physical endpoints and gain.  A Hall
      matching between packets and such sockets is sufficient once the bulk
      skeleton, the nonfilter palette ledger and the protected unit-voltage
      socket have independently been supplied.

2148. Root's quotient-matching lane has removed the residual-Kneser Hall
      gate from the existential construction.  The complete lower--upper
      diamond graph is the bipartite double cover of KG(2m,m-1).  The clean
      subgroup H acts freely on both shores, so its quotient is a balanced
      regular bipartite multigraph.  Hall/Konig supplies a quotient perfect
      matching, and lifting its selected edge orbits gives an H-invariant
      global perfect matching of the physical diamond graph.

      The period-three filters should therefore be chosen after this global
      matching, not prescribed before it.  Restricting the matching to the
      exceptional lower and exceptional upper quotient banks gives exactly
      2 Cat_a clean-subgroup filter orbits when v_3(q)=1.  They cover every
      exceptional colour once, use distinct opposite endpoints within each
      typed shore, occupy exactly one third of their associated full-rotation
      edge orbits, and are already extended by the rest of the same perfect
      matching.  At higher valuation the restriction has exactly
      2 Cat_a s/3 clean-H orbits, each 1/s of a full orbit, but need not use
      only 2 Cat_a full-orbit classes.  After complement-identifying the
      shores, a lower and upper opposite label may coincide; that is not a
      physical palette collision.

      Their physical middle endpoints are pairwise distinct without any
      extra choice.  Distinct exceptional colours differ by whole order-three
      cosets and hence cannot share a rank-m endpoint; lower-filter endpoints
      contain infinity whereas upper-filter endpoints do not.  Thus the
      exceptional palette, marginal Hall and mutual filter-endpoint collision
      gates are all unconditional.  Nonexceptional matching edges may still
      reuse those middle endpoints.  What remains is to select a global
      quotient perfect matching whose complete diamond lift is a spanning
      linear forest with private sockets, compatible wedge/pivot ledgers and
      unit-voltage closure.

      For a fixed preassigned complement-paired filter the residual question
      remains exactly Hall in KG(2m,m-1)-D, equivalently the existence of
      cross-intersecting A,C within V-D with |A|+|C|>|V|-|D|.  That stronger
      universal extension statement is neither needed nor claimed.  The m=8
      replay constructs a quotient matching of size2288, its physical lift
      of size11440, four filter orbits/20 physical filter edges with40
      distinct middle endpoints, and independently verifies the old fixed
      filter residual matching11420/11420.

2149. Lane L has rebased the m4 binary kernel on item2148's global-first
      matching theorem and the cycle-first physical gate.  For any spanning
      clean-H quotient Johnson occurrence cycle C, form the bipartite colour
      incidence graph G(C).  A perfect matching of G(C) is equivalent to an
      exact common transversal contained in C.  Since it selects N/h edges
      from the M/h-cycle, it is automatically a spanning linear forest with
      Cat_m/h paths; the complementary Cat_m/h cycle edges are its connector
      occurrences.  The physical lift is Hamiltonian exactly when C has unit
      total H-voltage.  Thus the remaining carrier gate is one coloured
      primitive-voltage quotient cycle, not prescribed filter extension.

      The arbitrary deterministic m=8 quotient matching demonstrates the
      separation sharply.  Its physical lift has degree histogram

          0^805 1^3890 2^5860 3^2000 4^305 5^10,

      overload2640 and cyclomatic number331.  Global palette Hall is exact,

      In the authenticated m4 fixture, the K0 and K1 common transversals are
      global Z7 quotient perfect matchings of size8.  They share six
      occurrence edges.  The four remaining records form one alternating
      K_2,2 on lower colour orbits {83,85} and upper orbits {97,ab}:

          K0={(83,ab),(85,97)},  K1={(83,97),(85,ab)}.

      Both diagonals are forest-safe, with quotient path profiles7+3 and6+4,

      It is a positive local exchange fixture, not an all-m exchange theorem.
      Period-three filters are derived matching edges, and no H-equivariance
      is imposed on the later compiler.

      A separate optional packet face remains useful constructively.  The

      matching yields d Cat_a vertex-disjoint quotient P4 packets, where
      d=3^(v_3(6a+3)-1); each packet simultaneously services one lower and
      one upper exceptional track.  Its omitted fourth edge is a literal

      sides of the square has exactly zero voltage defect.  A reduced
      unit-voltage cycle containing all sockets plus a residual

2147. Root has completed and independently audited the block-coherent
      GMM/BTK recursion reduction, now rebased on the four-spiral K16
      anatomy.  For a spanning two-sided-rainbow Cat_m-path forest, a cyclic
      endpoint closure is a literal cap-two common refinement iff each
      incoming connector has the same union as the first forest edge at its
      target.  Distinct incoming alpha colours give the full lower floor;
      after tail suppression, distinct smoothed d colours disjoint from the
      beta bank give the extremal base floor and exactly Cat_m directed
      repair ears.

      The gain-closed all-Cat_m modification of the published GMM square is
      impossible: selected ports and direct labels would form a proper
      closed subcycle of the central alternating cycle.  Every viable mixed
      bank has

          t=|X\Y|=|Y\X|>=1,

      exactly t alternating intervals, exactly t retained partners and
      Cat_m-t gain partners.  At the clean quotient scale

          h=(2m-1)/3^v3(2m-1),  p=Cat_m/h,

      the orbit closure of the printed one-port atom supplies at most one of
      p required blocks; if all conjugates are compatible its exact deficit
      is p-1.  Item2148 supersedes the old prescribed-filter extension gate:
      a global clean-quotient perfect matching always exists and its
      exceptional restriction supplies all filter colours automatically.
      Those filters remove equal amounts from all four Pascal shores, so the
      Catalan cross-port demand and the structured GMM deficit are unchanged.

      The minimal common core is now QMF: choose a perfect matching of the
      complete clean-H quotient diamond graph whose entire physical lift is
      spanning, acyclic and degree one/two, hence exactly Cat_m paths.  A
      cyclic closure asks for one generating-voltage endpoint cycle and all
      Cat_m protected ears.  The distinct linear branch asks for co-oriented
      physical spirals joined by Johnson seams, an exact signed two-palette
      ledger, two declared boundary resources, a certified protected-ear
      count and deeper collars, and an asymmetric compatible compiler.

      The positive m=4 Z7 fixture verifies QMF and its cyclic closure:
      quotient paths of
      orders3 and7 close to a voltage-two 10-cycle.  A different m=4 common
      flag forest is a sharp negative fixture: its fixed path 0x95--0xc5 has
      no incoming equal-union connector, despite a Johnson Hamilton closure
      and complete immediate palettes.  K16 verifies only the topology and
      immediate coverage side of the linear branch: four co-oriented Z15 spirals of
      base lengths426,426,3,3 and voltage+4 interlace all three residual
      sectors.  Three Johnson seams make the 12869-edge physical path.  The
      four phase defects belong to the 12870-entry augmented cyclic orbit
      audit which also inserts the absent non-Johnson wrap; the compiler is
      asymmetric.

      No all-m completion follows.  The sharp remaining construction is a
      Hamilton-compatible global quotient matching, followed by either its
      generating-voltage block-wedge closure or a boundary-balanced,
      protected-ear multi-spiral opening.

2140. Lane R has proved the exact surviving connectivity theorem for a
      fixed Catalan endpoint-complement pair of K path forests.

      Let A and B be the two sets of 2K occurrence-labelled ports, paired
      within their retained fragments by P_A and P_B, and let G be the
      Boolean containment graph.  A Hamilton-compatible matching exists iff
      the binary port-degree equations hold together with

          x(A_I,B\B_J)+x(A\A_I,B_J) >= 2

      for every 1<=|I|=|J|<K.  Unequal fragment-block cuts have automatic
      value at least 2||I|-|J||.  Equivalently the contracted selected
      multigraph has graphic rank2K-1.  If f:A->B is the matching and
      Q_f=f^(-1)P_B f, connectivity is equivalently that P_A union Q_f is
      one 2K-cycle, or that P_A Q_f has exactly two K-cycles.  These are
      exact integer characterizations, not claims that the subtour
      relaxation is integral.

      There is a useful universal sufficient test.  Every perfect matching
      is connected iff no proper balanced fragment rectangle and its
      complement both have perfect matchings.  In particular

          nu(G[A_I,B_J]) < 2|I|

      for every proper balanced block makes every perfect matching
      connected.  Conversely, after upper/residence/compiler pruning, a
      nontrivial P-closed shore A_S,B_S with N(A_S) subset B_S traps every
      safe matching and is an exact protected no-go.

      Two constructive certificates avoid the full subtour family.

      First orient all marked and unmarked fragments.  Match each marked
      exit to an unmarked entry by a bijection alpha.  Put an arc i->h when
      the exit of B_(alpha(i)) contains the entry label of A_h.  The factor
      components are exactly the cycles of this permutation digraph, so a
      directed Hamilton cycle is iff connectivity.  More locally, if ab is
      one seam of an existing connected cycle and new fragments have ports
      a_*^-,a_*^+ and b_*^-,b_*^+, the three containments

          L(a) subset U(b_*^-),
          L(a_*^-) subset U(b_*^+),
          L(a_*^+) subset U(b)

      allow ab to be replaced by those three seams.  This inserts one
      marked/unmarked fragment pair and leaves one cycle.  Repeating gives a
      literal ear-decomposable cut certificate.

      Second, for a current rung e=(L_e,U_e), define a socket arc e->f iff
      L_f subset U_e.  A directed socket cycle selecting exactly one old
      rung from each of distinct current factor components is a clean long
      ear and merges those components into one.  A port-disjoint family of
      such ears Hamiltonizes whenever its component--ear incidence graph is
      a spanning tree; its exact ledger is

          sum_T (|S_T|-1)=c-1.

      The converse holds inside the fresh old-supported monotone class when
      every switch is clean relative to the current factor.  Pure clean C8
      banks therefore require c=1 mod3, an arity restriction rather than the
      withdrawn universal parity law.

      Boolean rank-gap-one geometry is decisive.  If e->f and L_e!=L_f,
      then

          |L_e intersect L_f|=m-1,
          U_e=L_e union L_f.

      Thus ears are occurrence-labelled Johnson necklaces whose adjacent
      unions must occur at the selected unmarked ports.  Four containments
      between two distinct m-labels and two distinct (m+1)-owners are
      impossible; repeated-owner C4 token swaps are physically null.  Hence
      C4 descent is not the scalable Boolean mechanism.

      Protection is explicit.  EC1--EC3 require the exact marked internal
      tagged palette, a pairwise-distinct unmarked internal palette, and
      distinct marked endpoint labels equal to its complement.  A rethread
      either freezes one literal witness/corridor support Q and deletes no
      Q-edge at any intermediate step, while satisfying the cited residence
      theorem's seam hypotheses, or it replays every final
      suffix/full-fragments/prefix witness and the exact cyclic DFA product.
      Lower q1 and the complete immediate-upper multiplicity vector are then
      invariant occurrence by occurrence; common-cap compilation remains
      separate.

      The m=2 chordless-C8 factor is the sharp limit.  It satisfies strict
      Hall on every proper marked-port set, is matching-covered and has a
      strongly connected socket cycle, yet both matchings are two-component.
      Its socket component word is ABAB, not transversal, and the rainbow
      palette forces both local retained sides, so endpoint-side choice
      cannot repair the fixed hosting.  More generally, paired-port blow-up
      embeds an arbitrary balanced bipartite Hamilton-cycle instance, so no
      generic Hall shortcut is available.

      Thus choosing cuts/endpoints can enforce connectivity by exhibiting
      the paired-ear insertion certificate or a protected socket-ear
      hypertree.  Catalan cap-two, lower rainbow, marked upper q1 and
      ordinary Hall do not force either.  The exact remaining PBBS/Pascal
      lemma is existence of that protected endpoint bank; no K17 or all-k
      equality is claimed.

2138. Lane AD attacked the full-N uniformly outgoing Catalan repair system
      and proved sharp all-dimension obstructions to the direct
      probabilistic, AH, exterior-parity and canonical BTK routes.  It did
      not prove directed repair for all large m.

      The raw directed catalogue has exactly mK=N records:

          deg(X)=m, deg(host)<=m-1, deg(lower)<=m+1,
          codeg(X,host),codeg(host,lower)<=1,
          codeg(X,lower)<=m.

      Both N-vertex resource shores therefore have average degree exactly
      one.  Universal Boolean parameters do not supply a dense or
      quasiregular nibble core.

      After adjoining q=N-K=(m-1)K dummy tokens, the exact directed gate is
      a rainbow matching of N graph families on the host/lower shores.
      For the full family its union matching number is at most N, while
      rank-two Aharoni--Haxell requires more than 2(N-1).  Thus direct AH is
      impossible even before fixing a K-host bank.  This is scoped to the
      uniformly outgoing subclass; the unrestricted two-choice switch has
      an extra side and endpoint resource.

      In the floor profile, a valid source bank chooses exactly one of the
      two occurrences of each duplicated base colour.  A uniform random
      K-subset passes with probability

          2^K / binom(mK,K) <= (2/m)^K,

      and with probability at least 1-9/K is at replacement distance at
      least K/6.  Independent Bernoulli host sampling at density1/m has
      isolation probability at least1/4 per token, event dependency at most
      m(m-2), variance at most K(m-1), and leaves at least K/8 isolated
      tokens with probability at least1-64(m-1)/K.  Thus the unbiased-bank
      plus o(K) repair and independent-bank plus o(K/m) addition routes are
      closed; correlated source-aware sampling remains open.

      Every physical directed repair has exactly q! perfect matchings in
      the labelled-dummy three-shore hypergraph.  Hence its mod-two
      permanent is always zero and every dummy-antisymmetric exterior sum
      cancels for all m>=2.  The scalarized coefficient
      [s^q product_X x_X] det A divides out this symmetry and remains open;
      no non-TU claim is made.

      The strongest physical theorem is a constant-fraction edit barrier
      for the standard BTK inclusion matching sigma.  For every Dyck prefix
      D of semilength m-3, the middle word D101010 is incident with the
      three forced lifted BTK edges obtained from suffix rows

          001010, 100010, 101000.

      A Hamilton cycle can contain at most two.  These row triples are
      disjoint, so every common-transversal matching mu satisfies

          |{L:mu(L)!=sigma(L)}| >= Cat_(m-3) > Cat_m/64.

      This holds for every coordinate conjugate and rules out exact BTK and
      every o(K)-perturbation independently of hosts, cap-two blocks and
      endpoint thresholds.  More generally any inclusion matching obeys
      the overload cut

          disagreements >= (1/2) sum_v (deg_F(v)-2)_+.

      Finally, a cyclic Latin hypergraph proves that regular degrees, unit
      codegrees and complete pair projections alone cannot force matching.
      Literal Boolean repair avoids its first obstruction: the token-hole
      projection is C4-free, and every first C6 holonomy lies in one common
      (m+1)-top.  A surviving positive theorem must exploit precisely this
      containment geometry in a Theta(K)-scale correlated rethread or a
      scalar unitriangular core.

2139. Lane L has completed the requested finite m=4 directed-Catalan
      proof probe.  The exact split-leave theorem identifies a uniform
      outgoing repair with a spanning 14-path forest on all70 rank-four
      facets whose 56 edges use every rank-three intersection and every
      rank-five union once, together with a coloured cyclic endpoint
      closure.  The incoming closure colours alpha must be distinct; the
      smoothed bases d must be distinct and disjoint from the outgoing
      first-edge colours beta.  This normal form is equivalent in both
      directions, not merely sufficient.

2137. Lane A has completed the exact soft-survival/lower-colour separation
      oracle and, crucially, separated the two completion faces which had
      been conflated in the live K17 seam CEGAR.

      If z is already the final source-cut bank, a partial seam bank is
      lower-colour simple exactly when

          sum_(a:lambda(a)=c) x_a <= z_(e(c))

      for every colour c; the final one-boundary path strengthens this to
      equality with boundary variables.  For an arbitrary residual b-flow,
      the current scaffold cuts are not final.  The exact immutable precheck
      is instead

          F_c + h_(e(c)) <= 1,

      where F_c counts fixed selected seams and h marks a protected old edge.
      Thus repeated fixed seams and fixed-seam/protected-old coexistence are
      fatal, while collision with a currently uncut but unprotected old edge
      is only an eventual ejection obligation.

      The exact unrestricted recourse lift uses eventual releases z,
      tail/head activation states alpha,beta linked bidirectionally to those
      releases and the fixed seams, residual arcs x, and one boundary colour:

          sum_j x_ij = alpha_i,
          sum_i x_ij = beta_j,
          (1-z_(e(c))) + F_c + sum_(ij:lambda(ij)=c)x_ij + b_c = 1,
          sum_c b_c = 1,             z_e+h_e <= 1.

      Once z,F,alpha,beta are fixed this reduces to the three-resource
      tail/head/missing-colour rainbow assignment.  Ordinary Hall is exact
      only for strict colour-back degree completion; a spanning path still
      needs an acyclic skeleton or subtour separation.  A key-inactive head
      is merely key-legal as a reset, not automatically palette/topology/
      residence legal.

      For every old target Y, the soft state is exactly the OR over its
      inclusion-minimal source witness spans.  Complete occurrence providers
      give q_Y=old-survival OR new-service; all-target feasibility requires
      q_Y=1 for every Y or a proved zero primary loss.  Inclusion-minimal
      witness blockers give exact Boolean lazy rows, and a one-seam provider
      assignment psi admits the stated Hall separator.  Multi-seam providers
      require hyperarc/automaton completion and are not ordinary psi columns.

      Applied to the persisted hard323 bank, fixed-seam repeat excess37 is
      already fatal.  Of1,061 present old-edge collisions,312 meet exported
      protected tails; together there are344 bad fixed-scaffold colour
      classes.  The completed soft run is FEASIBLE only: exact source loss
      1,364, seams1,601, cuts2,323, protected tails6,009, and a bounded
      16-edge diagnostic of437 holes 11^303 12^131 13^3.  It has no unlimited
      replay and has319 bad fixed-scaffold colour classes (repeat excess32

2136. Lane K inspected the primary Gregor--Mütze source and closed the
      literal single-port synchronization proposal by an exact sector-Hall
      obstruction.  Source numbering matters: Lemmas12--13 prove the
      constant-weight distance-two and up/down subsequence facts; the
      displayed adjacent-level n->n+1 splice is Theorem15.  Its printed
      induction range is strict and omits the even-central boundary, but the
      displayed four-edge splice is algebraically valid there because its
      middle-level and switched-path children exist.  The theorem below is
      scoped to that boundary application, not to an unprinted source case.

      Put

          A=C(2m-1,m-1), B=C(2m-1,m-2), K=A-B=Cat_m.

      In a common refinement of the lower tight enumeration with one
      distinguished edge in every rank-(m+1) upper block, exactly K of the
      A z-free lower rows must have a distinguished union containing the new
      coordinate z.  The displayed one-port splice creates exactly one such
      row.  The remaining A-1 rows see only B no-z blocks, an explicit Hall
      set of deficiency

          (A-1)-B = Cat_m-1.

      This is invariant under both child choices and their allowed coordinate
      permutations.  The direct duplicate bank is not the failure: the
      removed direct edge and its replacement both have union
      z+a_(n,k+1), so the complete direct-union multiset is preserved.

      The exact viable replacement is a Catalan-port bulk splice.  For a
      direct child edge a-b of union x and a central incidence b-x, the
      Pascal square

          {b0-x0, a1-b1} -> {b0-b1, x0-a1}

      is legal, preserves degrees, preserves direct union z+x, and transports
      one distinguished row across sectors.  Hence a synchronized splice in
      this fibre must use all K direct child edges.  The first local gate is
      facet-pair hitting: the two facets on a direct edge must meet the two
      facets of the same x selected by the central cycle.  It is automatic
      for m=3 and not for m>=4.

      Under the exact floor marginals the all-direct orientation atlas is a
      literal K-by-K-by-K matching core.  Its shores are direct child edges,
      doubled no-z distinguished colours and missing stripped z-colours; an
      oriented Pascal square is one hyperedge.  A perfect matching is iff
      for the two palette bijections inside this square fibre.  One-cycle
      topology remains separate.  Literal contiguous cap-two blocks require
      the further exact adjacency condition that each direct edge meet the
      unique distinguished edge with the same union; floor loads alone do
      not imply this.  A proved block-coherent closure lemma preserves that
      adjacency when each child direct edge already has its equal-union
      partner, its free endpoints are distinct, and the central child hits
      all free facet ports.  Leaf-peelability of the restricted square atlas
      gives a forced repair matching; adding arbitrary all-host edges can
      destroy degree-one pivots though not the found matching.

      The paper's three-level trimming output is independently in the wrong
      jump normal form: it has only same-level distance-two steps, whereas a
      diamond-tight common refinement has exactly
      N-K=(m-1)Cat_m cross steps from rank m-1 to rank m+1 and none within a
      level.  Thus neither the one-port adjacent-level splice nor the
      published three-level trimming construction supplies the required
      leaf-peelable repair core.  A new K-port braid remains open.  Numerically
      the one-port deficits are428 for m=7 and1429 for m=8.

2135. Lane AD has given the exact coefficient-one matching theorem and the
      sharp Aharoni--Haxell scope for the Catalan two-rail switch.

      For a saturating cycle, the complete co-designed switch has exactly
      2mK host-side variables.  Its integral equations are: one record per
      omitted facet, at most one per upper block, at most one per opposite
      seam endpoint, and for each lower colour L the signed replacement row

          base_load(L) - selected_default_load(L)
                       + selected_retained_load(L) = 1.

      There are exactly K+3N=(3m+1)K rows.  This is an iff, and exposes
      why the raw all-N-host problem is signed rather than an ordinary
      disjoint-resource matching.

      After a host injection phi is fixed, its unmatched default colours
      must be distinct.  Their complement D has size K.  Join each omitted
      facet X to either admissible retained colour in D and label the edge
      by the opposite cut endpoint J.  The switch exists iff this graph has
      a J-rainbow perfect matching.  Equivalently, one Boolean side per X,
      unary invalid-side clauses, and pairwise equal-colour/equal-J clauses
      form an exact 2-SAT instance; feasibility is exactly absence of a
      complementary implication SCC.  Along every consecutive hosted run,
      endpoint legality is the threshold law 0*1*.

      Two positive coefficient-one expansion theorems survive:

      * Hall in the retained-colour graph plus
        nu(label-class J)<=1 for every J is sufficient;
      * an endpoint-safe threshold schedule, a lower-colour bijection and
        Hall in the resulting task-to-host graph are sufficient.  In
        particular, if the K hosts are cyclically independent, retained-
        colour Hall alone suffices.  There is no numerical independent-bank
        obstruction because N=mK, although containment and palette Hall
        remain open.

      Direct Aharoni--Haxell is impossible only after this exact K-bank
      normalization.  The fixed-injection rank-two union has matching
      number at most K but AH demands more than 2(K-1); the fixed-bank
      rank-three union likewise demands more than 3(K-1).  One such AH
      stage can service at most ceil(K/2) or floor((K+2)/3) targets, so
      an o(K) final absorber cannot repair the residue.  This does NOT rule
      out an augmented construction retaining all N=mK hosts: its signed
      default-palette equations are not encoded by the naive triples.

      Under the extra complete lower-floor antecedent
      1^(N-K)2^K, the cut-colour graph has maximum degree two on both
      shores.  Balanced paths have one forced matching, even cycles have two
      alternating states, and the remaining endpoint condition is exact
      2-SAT on those cycle bits.  The audited m=3 counterexample has isolated
      omitted facets in this graph.  Abstract degree-two bicycles show that
      marginal Hall, degrees and codegrees alone still do not compose, but
      no new Boolean-rail counterexample is claimed.

      The all-m gate is now precise: construct a saturating cycle and a host
      injection whose unmatched defaults are distinct and whose exact
      implication system is satisfiable, then separately protect upper
      shadows, connectivity, residence and the literal compiler.

2130. Root sharpened the Catalan split-switch gate to an exact directed
      defect-transport theorem.  For a saturating cycle, let
      `b_i=C_i intersect C_(i+1)`.  If omitted facet X is injected into
      block U_i, put `alpha_X=X intersect C_i` and
      `beta_X=X intersect C_(i+1)`.  Uniformly cutting the incoming split
      edge and retaining the outgoing one gives an exact marked lower
      palette if and only if the multiset replacement

          {b_i} - {b_i at selected blocks} + {beta_X}

      is the complete rank-(m-1) layer once.  The intermediate cap-two
      middle cycle then has palette `L+{alpha_X}`, so it is at the lower
      integrality floor exactly when the alpha_X are pairwise distinct.

      If the base word has profile `0^K 1^(N-2K) 2^K`, zero slack forces a
      labelled three-partite perfect matching between the K omitted facets,
      K duplicated base colours and K missing colours.  A hyperedge
      `(X,d,h;i)` means `X subset U_i`, `b_i=d`, and
      `X intersect C_(i+1)=h`.  This is necessary and sufficient for the
      uniform directed repair; alpha-rainbow is the separate intermediate
      floor condition.  Geometrically each selected hyperedge is a lifted
      directed Johnson edge from a duplicate colour to a hole inside one
      Boolean diamond.

      Complete finite replay distinguishes the two m=3 calibrations.  The
      previously published cycle has one general solution but no uniform
      one.  A second fixed cycle has base profile `0^5 1^5 2^5`, exactly one
      split solution, and that solution is uniformly outgoing with distinct
      alpha colours.  Every rooted m=2 cycle is solvable only with mixed
      orientation.  This is an exact reduction and finite base theorem, not
      an all-dimensional matching proof.

2131. The direct OR--Pascal referee completed the algebraic and recursive
      form of item2130.  For arbitrary base loads, selected occurrence-
      labelled repair arcs satisfy the exact transshipment equation

          out_Q(y)-in_Q(y)=a(y)-1

      at every lower colour.  The full directed gate is a perfect matching
      in an N-by-N-by-N hypergraph with shores block, lower colour, and
      omitted-facet-or-dummy token.  Equivalently it is the positive
      coefficient

          [s^(N-K) product_X x_X] per A(s,x).

      A nonzero determinant coefficient is a sufficient signed certificate.
      In the floor case this contracts to the K-by-K-by-K core of item2130.

      The note proves a recursive sufficient invariant: if the balanced
      repair core has a degree-one shore vertex, take its forced edge and
      peel its three vertices.  A sequence of such ears gives a unique
      perfect matching; algebraically it is a unitriangular Laplace
      expansion with coefficient plus or minus one.  The positive m=3 core
      has only seven hyperedges and peels uniquely through five forced
      choices.  Generic Aharoni--Haxell cannot certify the full K-set even in
      principle, because its demanded matching number exceeds K for K>=3.
      The precise recursive target is therefore a saturating cycle with
      floor base word and a leaf-peelable repair core, not generic density.
      Existence of that cycle for every m remains open.

      The expanded note also proves that the same directed data are exactly
      a common refinement of a cap-two middle cycle with a lower tight
      enumeration.  It canonically yields a tight enumeration of all three
      central levels in which every shared sole edge is replaced by the
      literal diamond A,(A cap B),(A union B),B.  Published three-level
      tight enumerations have the right total flip budget, but their
      distance-two steps stay within a boundary level and therefore do not
      supply this diamond normal form.  Complementing the construction
      turns the base floor law into a 0/1/2 law for triple-window unions of
      a rank-(m-1) Gray cycle.

      The final audit sharpens the induction boundary.  A tight three-level
      listing is diamond-normal exactly when every gap between consecutive
      middle vertices contains one outer vertex or a mixed lower/upper pair;
      the three gap counts are forced to K,K,N-K.  Every literal repair
      triple (X,D,Z) is one Boolean square: Z is a facet of X, D and Z are
      Johnson-adjacent, and with p=X-Z the directed block is uniquely

          C_i=D+p,   C_(i+1)=D union Z,   U_i=D union X.

      Common-coordinate lifting preserves such a square and hence preserves
      an old peelable core inside one Pascal sector.  It does not realize the
      bank of new ears in one saturating cycle.  Moreover balanced-forest
      structure is only sufficient, not equivalent, for unique labelled
      three-partite repair; and a balanced full colour-incidence forest can
      force a mixed rather than uniform orientation (the negative m=3
      fixture).  Thus the exact remaining induction is a Catalan-port bulk
      Boolean braid realizing all new square ears coherently.  The published
      one-port recursion has an explicit deficiency-(K-1) sector Hall set.
