2132. Lane R has resolved the connectivity question left by the Catalan
      two-rail split-switch theorem at the exact fixed-fragment level.
      After the K cuts, label the 2K marked and 2K unmarked endpoint
      occurrences and let P pair the ends of every retained rail fragment.
      The compatible new cross rungs form a bipartite containment graph

          p_L -- q  iff  L subset U(q).

      Every perfect matching M in this graph gives a spanning degree-two
      factor.  Its cross lower colours are the marked labels L once each,
      and its cross upper colours are z+U(q) once per unmarked endpoint
      occurrence.  Hence both the exact lower-q1 multiset and the complete
      immediate-upper multiplicity vector are independent of M.  The factor
      components are exactly the alternating cycles of P union M.  Thus the
      precise extra topology gate is a perfect matching M for which P union
      M is one cycle; ordinary Hall only supplies some matching.

      Symmetric differences of port matchings are occurrence-labelled
      common-z alternating closed trails, and are simple incidence C_(2l)
      circuits when their physical unmarked owners are distinct.  A C8 is
      therefore adjacent-palette neutral, but it merges only when its old
      and new rung pairings have the required cycle counts against the
      retained-strand pairing.  Circuit length alone gives no parity law.
      The K hosted split switches force K one-way socket arcs X->J_X, while
      every reverse J_X->X is impossible; the rainbow identity supplies no
      directed return cycles.

      The obstruction is literal already at m=2.  The source rails

          U=(123,124,134,234), C=(23,12,14,34),

      with omitted sets 13,24 hosted in U_0,U_1 and retained endpoint 12 in
      both blocks satisfy every rainbow hypothesis.  The child factor has
      two five-cycles.  Its port graph is a chordless C8 and has exactly two
      perfect matchings; both superpose with P to give two factor cycles.
      The unique cross-rung C8 preserves all ten lower colours and all five
      immediate-upper loads but is 2->2.  A hand-complete table of all twenty
      selected-incidence continuations finds exactly one further initial C8,
      on the marked rail; it too preserves the adjacent palettes and is
      2->2.  Therefore the split-switch hypotheses do not imply C8 or longer
      fixed-fragment Hamiltonization, even with marked upper q1 protected.

      This example corrects item2116: the former claim that every C6
      preserves component parity and every C8 flips it is false.  The clean
      l-component merger l->1 remains valid, but every nonclean circuit must
      use the exact occurrence-port cycle count.  For deeper witnesses and
      residence, a proposed matching must additionally pass the literal
      blocker-clutter ledger and the oriented fragment DFA; common-cap
      compilation remains separate.  The surviving existence problem is a
      protected Hamilton-compatible port matching (or an internal-rail move
      which changes P and passes those same literal guards), not a generic
      C8-connectivity theorem.  No K17 or all-k equality claim is made.

2133. Root completed the colour-incidence graph, determinant, orientation,
      rigid-diamond and abstract-recursion lane.  For a middle Johnson
      cycle P, G(P) has one occurrence edge

          (A intersect B) -- (A union B)

      for every physical edge AB.  A common lower/upper edge transversal is
      exactly a perfect matching of G(P), occurrence for occurrence, and
      the permanent counts them.  The determinant with independent edge
      variables is exact.  Under occurrence degree at most two, feasibility
      is equivalent to every component being shore-balanced: balanced paths
      have one matching and cycles have two.  Hence per(A)=2^c and uniqueness
      is exactly a balanced spanning path forest.  The ordinary determinant
      cancels on C_(4t); an explicit component signing restores absolute
      determinant 2^c.

      In a cap-two cycle, uniform outgoing repair exists exactly when the
      canonical outgoing-plus-sole edge set is itself that perfect matching.
      Distinct cut seams are strictly weaker: if 0 means retained outgoing
      and 1 retained incoming, each maximal hosted run must have form
      0^*1^*, equivalently no adjacent 10.  The mixed m=3 fixture has forced
      signature O,O,I,I,I and five distinct cuts.

      A common transversal yields a tight three-level enumeration only with
      the rigid blockwise opposite upper transversal: sole upper blocks are
      diamonds, while a split block puts its lower and upper subdivisions on
      opposite edges.  This gives distance 4N.  Reusing the same common
      transversal on both layers costs 4N+2K, and a generic P-projected tight
      covering pair need not be common.  The positive m=3 projection has 75
      tight covering pairs but only one rigid common pair.

      The abstract graph obstruction is absent in every dimension.  In the
      full rank-(m-1)/(m+1) inclusion graph, take a BTK perfect inclusion
      matching sigma, a disjoint perfect matching tau, and K=Cat_m tau-edges
      S while omitting one edge from every alternating sigma/tau cycle.
      Since K=N/m<=N-c, this is always possible.  The larger colour graph

          H=graph(sigma) union S

      has profile 1^(N-K)2^K, is a balanced path forest, has unique matching
      sigma and determinant plus or minus one.  This is not a prechosen
      duplicate/hole repair projection, but it is also not the stronger
      physical theorem: H is not sigma alone.

      Every inclusion L subset U has a unique Johnson lift, but unique edges
      need not meet correctly.  H lifts to a middle Hamilton cycle iff its
      lifted graph is connected and degree two at every rank-m vertex.
      Necessarily the N sigma-edges alone form a spanning K-path forest and
      the K S-edges reconnect those paths cyclically.  Standard BTK fails
      this condition for every m>=3: for

          E_m={0,2,...,2m-2}

      the m lower facets E_m-{2j} all lift to edges incident with E_m, so
      deg(E_m)=m.  Even after the Hamilton gate, every doubled upper colour
      must have its two lifted edges share one middle endpoint, and the
      unique matching must have one common cyclic outgoing sign.

      Independent sparse replay for m=2,...,6 finds Psi(sigma) spanning and
      acyclic with exactly K components in every row, but a K-path forest
      only at m=2.  The deterministic full H lifts have zero degree-zero
      holes but overload units 1,5,27,104,387; component counts
      1,2,3,15,44; and incompatible doubled-upper counts 0,2,2,14,46.
      None is connected two-regular.  These are deterministic-choice
      counterexamples, not dimension-wide no-gos.

      The m=3 positive and mixed fixtures independently verify the matching,
      orientation and diamond claims.  The fixed vendored GMM m=4 cycle has
      17 base lower holes but only 14 replacements, so it retains at least
      three holes for every cap-two injection.  A separate exact integrated
      m=4 search ended UNKNOWN at its 900-second H100 cap with no candidate;
      it is not an UNSAT result.  No physical all-m directed-repair theorem
      is claimed.

2129. Thread D completed the exact larger-cut residual-completion theorem
      for the K17 all-target lane and independently replayed the only
      persisted incumbent.

      On directed Johnson arcs, a spanning lower-rainbow Hamilton path is
      exactly a target-size common independent set in the tail, head,
      lower-colour and underlying graphic matroids.  Complete guarded collar
      and literal path-block catalogues lift this to an iff model retaining
      prescribed upper witnesses while permitting extra ejection cuts,
      fragment reversal and provider reselection.  This is a four-matroid
      formulation, not ordinary matroid intersection or a network matrix.

      Its fixed-catalogue incidence projection does have an exact max-flow
      separator.  For forced-incidence set R and desired bipartite degrees b,
      completion exists iff the forced degrees fit, both shore totals agree,
      and for every X on the owner shore and Y on the colour shore

          b(X)+|R intersect E(U\X,Y)|
             <= b(Y)+|E(X,L\Y)|.

      With exact OR guards g, path endpoints p and omitted colour z, this is
      the branch-independent Benders row

          2|X|-p(X)+sum_{E(U\X,Y)} g_e
             <= 2|Y|-2z(Y)+|E(X,L\Y)|.

      Graphic rows turn the incidence solution into one expanded path;
      directed collar, residence and arbitrary-upper legality still require
      the full arc lift and literal replay.

      The reported round-zero 3,636-cut/2,320-seam state was not persisted.
      Its only unconditional conclusion is edge deficit N-1,316; the
      1,315-return ledger is conditional on tail/head/colour/graphic
      independence.  The independently replayed persisted round-three state
      has 1,813 seams, 2,748 cuts, complete upper q1, all 1,838 original
      holes served and 650 remaining upper holes 11^474 12^167 13^9.  Its
      exported forced bank is an 8,571-edge owner-degree-at-most-two forest,
      but has only 8,136 lower colours: 432 colours are overfull and repeat

      intact; at least 435 forced incidences must be released for colour

      The producer also left the last 512 casualty rows unsolved, exported

2125. Root proved the coordinate-deletion hierarchy and identified the exact
      architecture of the current K17 gap. For any coordinate set Q,
      deleting every physical entry which meets Q leaves a universal word on
      the complementary cube. Therefore

          # {i:A_i cap Q=empty} >= nu(k-|Q|)

      and, after averaging over all t-subsets Q,

          sum_i binom(k-|A_i|,t) >= binom(k,t) nu(k-t).

      In particular a length-B(17) equality word can contain any coordinate
      in at most11440 cells. The authenticated25746 lift consists of12873
      top-free and12873 top-containing cells, so its excess1433 is exactly
      the overpopulation of the marked Pascal shore. The companion deadline
      replay finds12869 unmarked rank-nine deliveries on11440 labels; after
      collapsing329 holds,1100 nonconsecutive repeat visits remain, and
      keeping first occurrences creates738 non-Johnson transitions. Thus
      the scalar excess is identified but is not physically deletable.

2126. Root and the direct OR--Pascal referee isolated a Catalan-sized exact
      odd-lift gate. Start from a saturating cycle

          C_i subset U_i supset C_(i+1)

      on ranks m,m+1 of Q_(2m), and inject the K=Cat_m omitted middle
      facets X into distinct blocks U_i. In each split block
      C_i-X-C_(i+1), retain one of the two edges and cut the other. If the
      N-K unmatched lower colours together with the K retained split colours
      biject the complete rank-(m-1) layer, and the opposite cut facets are
      distinct, simultaneous local two-rail switches produce a spanning
      child degree-two factor with every lower-q1 colour exactly once.

2123. Lane A has promoted the colour-back/key-forward protected opening
      into an exact all-target theorem for the one-cut/full-fragment
      catalogue, and separated its sharp algebraic and residence
      obstructions.

      For fixed protected state-labelled cuts e and full-OR component
      fragments, the correct debt universe is

          D(e) = H_F union {old targets whose every old witness is cut}.

      It includes the 1,838 K17 source holes and every newly destroyed old
      target.  A proper new witness crosses exactly one seam.  Fix a root,
      terminal, exact transducer states and an acyclic component skeleton.
      Assign each debt to a destination seam head j, and retain i->j only
      when its literal suffix-prefix service set contains the whole assigned
      fibre.  Then a zero-net-hole, exact-residence braid with lower ledger
      H=1,E=0 exists if and only if, for some assignment psi,

          |N_Gpsi(X)| >= |X|  for every source set X.

      Hall gives a perfect degree cover; acyclicity removes subtours and
      makes it one spanning path.  Conversely every valid braid induces the
      debt assignment because full fragments prohibit a proper witness from
      crossing two seams.  This is an exact equivalence, not a marginal
      provider condition.

      A constructive sufficient form partitions the debts into h jointly
      serviceable bundles.  Rank-two Aharoni--Haxell plus a robust filler is
      valid under

          nu(union_{ell in J} H_ell) > 2(|J|-1),
          |N_G(X)| >= |X|+h  for 1<=|X|<=b-1-h.

      The cyclic version first obtains a fully guarded cycle cover, then
      uses support-disjoint alternating two-seam rectangles to fuse it.
      The same AH inequality on rectangle supports along a contact tree
      preserves owners, the exact q1 palette, every old witness, every
      assigned source-hole fibre and strict residence.  A final opening is
      lossless exactly when its seam is outside the full-universe forced-seam
      set Sigma_*.

      The sharp obstruction is conserved key.  Every strict colour-back/
      key-forward arc satisfies kappa_i=kappa_j and

          t_i=c_i union {kappa},  s_j=c_i union c_j,

      so a connected conveyor is a component-transversal path in the
      corresponding Johnson colour graph.  A strict two-component cyclic
      conveyor is impossible.  The common-key law is scoped: an inactive
      old-casualty destination may reset the key, while source-hole activity
      and key activity must be tracked separately.  Noncanonical multi-cut
      service can evade this strict obstruction.

      Residence is exact in the theorem through a position-aware transducer
      and terminal optimizer.  For strict depth d, colour-back gives a useful
      composition lemma: if every fragment has at least d owners, a positive
      run of length at most d meets at most one seam, so internal plus
      pair-collar checks suffice.  Without this length condition an explicit
      physical three-fragment Johnson example defeats pairwise run Hall.

      This does not prove exact equality in every dimension.  The current
      K17 provider bank for the 1,838 original holes does not yet impose the
      newly created debt fibres, one conserved key (or certified reset
      sites), option equality, subtour exclusion and the exact deadline
      state simultaneously.  Those conditions, followed by the common
      compiler on the same chronology, are the remaining gate.

2122. Lane R has identified the first explicit parity-changing protected
      plateau atom beyond hexagons and the exact obstruction faced by the
      frozen K17 Stage2 service bank.

      Every simple incidence C8 has one of two set-system geometries.  Its
      complete immediate-upper load vector is neutral in exactly three
      cases: a star with one common exterior owner coordinate; a folded
      antipodal star; or an octahedral square with one common exterior owner
      coordinate.  In the antipodal case opposite affected rows already meet
      at the same selected owner, so it cannot be clean on four components.
      Hence every clean four-component neutral C8 is common-exterior.  Such a
      toggle merges four components to one, preserves every lower-q1 colour
      rowwise and preserves the entire immediate-upper multiplicity vector.
      More generally, a common-exterior star C_(2 ell) is load-neutral and,
      when clean, merges ell components to one.

      Literal all-depth protection is exact.  A selected occurrence survives
      if its incidence span avoids the deleted half; five pairwise
      incidence-disjoint occurrences per target suffice for one C8, and
      ell+1 suffice for one C_(2 ell).  This reserve is single-switch only.
      Residence is a separate necessary-and-sufficient cyclic fragment-DFA
      product; pairwise seam tests cannot replace it when short fragments
      occur.  Thus a clean common-exterior C8 with cut-disjoint guards and an
      accepting DFA is a genuine zero-defect parity absorber.  Its existence
      in PBBS is not automatic: the canonical fixed-matching catalogue is a
      restricted core-directed-C4 catalogue and supplies no proved clean
      common-exterior socket.

      The frozen K17 facts sharply refute fixed-bank monotone installation.
      Stage2 serves all1,838 old holes but its3,336 cuts kill the last old
      witness of3,489 targets, with rank profile(1864,1221,386,18).  For the
      3,676 service incidences plus13,600 advertised protected incidences,
      the explicit two-upper/sixteen-lower Hoffman cut has residual ledger

          demand4, lower capacity0, outgoing free capacity2.

      Its repair class contains exactly20 protected incidences; by the first
      all-service state at least two members of that class must already be
      absent, although no named pair is forced.  Independently, the
      authenticated max-retention optimum is13,596/13,600 and loses exactly
      four incidences at provider rows814,1024,1325,1352.  Debt monotonicity
      b>=a holds only for circuit endpoints remaining in this fixed-service
      face.  The four affected new targets have alternate literal Johnson
      intervals, so all1,838 service targets survive, but the same balanced
      factor has6,499 previously-covered upper holes with profile
      (4066,2036,388,9).  Arbitrary b-flow is therefore categorically not an
      all-target protected-circuit theorem.

      The exact positive replacement is a staggered duplex.  Consecutive old
      and new occurrence-labelled guard sections must coexist in balanced
      bridge factors satisfying every Hoffman cut; their symmetric
      differences then decompose into circuits disjoint from the common
      guard.  A full transport additionally needs source/destination guard
      anchoring, an orientation-aware residence-safe ordering of every
      intermediate toggle, exact lower colours, and final compiler/common-cap
      compatibility.  Provider or witness reselection is therefore necessary
      for the frozen Stage2 route.  No K17 word and no claim nu(17)=B(17) is
      made.

2121. Lane K has proved the global odd PBBS slack/component arithmetic and
      replaced the false scalar shortcut by an exact protected-fragment
      theorem.

      Put C_m=Cat_m, W_m=(2m+1)C_m and

          S_m(d)=dW_m+C(d+1,2)-(4^m-1).

      The exact recurrence is

          S_(m+1)(d)=4S_m(d)-d C_(m+1)-3(C(d+1,2)+1).

      The deadline depth is nondecreasing with increments zero or one.  If
      m is not the terminal member of its constant-depth plateau, then

          s_m >= d C_(m+1)/4 + 3(C(d+1,2)+1)/4,

      so s_m>C_m whenever d>=2.  Thus the crude Catalan component bill fits
      scalar slack at every noncritical odd dimension, but this remains only
      a scalar screen.

      The observed claim s_m>C_m/3 except m=4 is false.  A sharp Wallis
      window plus Machin rational bounds proves the exact positive-slack
      counterexamples

          (m,d)=(225669,421),  s_m/C_m=0.0624199861...<1/3,
          (m,d)=(691583,737),  s_m/C_m=0.2020913679...<1/3.

      Exact big-integer replay authenticates both Catalan values, both
      slacks, failure at depth d-1, and C_m-3s_m>0.  All one-third failures
      are terminal plateau dimensions.  Their depth parameters form a
      density-zero shrinking-target set

          {4d^2/pi-5/4} <= 1/(3d)+O(d^-2)

      by Weyl equidistribution; finiteness or infinitude is not claimed.
      The factor-three PBBS bound is exactly

          c_m <= floor((C_m+2a_m)/3),

      and it alone certifies c_m-1<=s_m precisely under the sufficient floor
      inequality C_m+2a_m<=3s_m+5.  At the two new counterexamples even this
      bound supplies no scalar certificate, although the actual c_m may
      still fit.

      The exact lower-q1 conservation law after b cuts, p final paths and n
      non-Johnson seams is

          H-E=p+n,  H=p+n+E.

      Hence one path plus one boundary q1 port forces every seam to be
      Johnson and its colour multiset to be exactly R\{rho}, where R is the
      deleted-colour bank.  For one fixed fragmentation/orientation, a
      protected equality braid is now exactly the P1--P4 system: one
      directed spanning path with all subtour cuts; the R\{rho} palette and
      literal rho port; internal-or-crossing all-depth witnesses; and exact
      arbitrary-start staircase loss Psi_d<=s.  A common-cap assignment is
      still separately necessary.

      A genuine constructive sufficient theorem is also proved.  A forward
      rectangular tail-colour/head atlas satisfying two Hall systems, one
      common strict potential, protected upper cuts and d-clean run guards
      composes into one Hamilton fragment path, recycles every required q1
      colour and has staircase loss zero.  The more flexible guarded-Hall
      theorem allows a closure-aware initial halo of mass M<=s and proves
      exact debt at most M.  Generic Aharoni--Haxell is formally valid but
      globally vacuous on the full two-resource bank for b>=3; the fixed-
      colour Hall/random-injection/atomic-pressure routes are the honest
      criteria.

      This leaves one exact carrier invariant: construct a protected PBBS
      reset-rainbow router (or a separately budgeted critical architecture)
      and then satisfy the boundary rho port and integral common cap.  The
      theorem makes no unconditional all-k or even-dimensional claim.

2120. Lane AD has formalized the K17 deep-provider problem as an exact
      protected four-resource hypergraph followed by a q1-aware residual
      absorber, and has independently audited the strongest current
      certificate.

      For a lower-rainbow source successor sigma, a provider p for deep
      target Z has seam a->b, protected source-edge-tail set K(p), typed
      resources

          tail a, arrival index sigma^{-1}(b),
          colour owner lambda^{-1}(a intersect b),

      and forced physical cut footprint D(p) consisting of those three
      indices.  Two providers conflict on a shared typed resource or when
      D(p) meets K(q) or conversely.  Keep--keep overlap is harmless, so
      treating protected sites as ordinary capacity-one resources is not
      exact.  Once a physical cut bank S is fixed, the exact filter

          D(p) subset S,  K(p) intersect S = empty

      turns the service problem into a 3-uniform rainbow matching on three
      copies of S.  The residual tail, head and deleted-lower-colour shores
      all have size |S|-|M|.  A perfect residual matching closes a 2-factor;
      for one linear path, omit one terminal, one initial head and one
      boundary colour and use |S|-|M|-1 fillers.  Immediate-upper debts are
      real filler tasks with union fixed to the debt; dummy tasks fill the
      remaining slots.  This gives an exact q1 absorber theorem, with
      acyclicity as the remaining topology condition.

      The authenticated protected K17 assignment SHA `3db9e5fc...` serves
      all1,838 deep holes with1,838 distinct tails, heads and seam colours;
      every colour donor is cut and all selected protected spans avoid the
      3,336-edge forced bank.  The span histogram is

          4^1825, 5^12, 6^1.

      Exact replay corrects item2118's pre-opening slot count.  The forced
      bank misses the unprotected source 3-cycle

          (59957,92725,125489).

      Cutting any one of its edges gives |S*|=3337, leaves1499 path macros,
      and therefore needs exactly1498 filler seams.  The fixed-service q1
      ledger is

          source q1 colours destroyed       2206,
          distinct service q1 unions        1784,
          destroyed colours restored         342,
          q1 colours still missing           1864.

      Thus the minimum seam-only residual face fails by

          1864-1498=366.

      Any seam-only continuation of this fixed service selection needs at
      least366 extra protected-safe cuts, even if none creates a new q1
      debt.  This does not exclude provider reselection or restitution by
      later boundary/compiler cells and is not a K17 no-go.

      A frozen one-CPU H100 census of the canonical shortest-witness bank has

          228466 distinct resource triples,
          269968 target-provider records,
          target degree 82..876,
          simple resource degrees (tail,head,colour)=(36,40,33),
          simple pair codegrees=(1,7,7),
          exact cross-target conflict Delta=548.

      The generic sufficient criteria all fail on this canonical bank:
      Haxell asks82>=1096; the uniform dependency-graph LLL has maximum
      charge2.0936704989>1/(2e); and the proved coarse Aharoni--Haxell degree
      corollary asks82>=1770.  These failures are not infeasibility
      certificates.  Aharoni--Haxell itself would require a fixed cut bank
      of at least3(1838-1)+1=5512 at the full-family subset, which remains
      below scalar slack7401 but has not been verified.

      The all-k sufficient lemma is now exact: a cut bank meeting every
      source component, a protected service rainbow matching for every new
      or endangered deep target, a q1-task residual matching of the exact

2119. Lane L has closed the scalar and lower-palette conservation laws for
      a zero-defect same-parity Pascal induction and isolated the exact
      remaining joint obstruction.  This is an exact conditional
      k-2-to-k theorem, not an unconditional all-k construction.

      For parent n=k-2 put

          q=ceil(n/2), W=C(n,q),
          Lambda=sum_{s<q} C(n,s),
          d=d(n), sigma=dW+C(d+1,2)-Lambda,

      let epsilon indicate an even child and c=Cat_q.  The child identities
      and depth recurrence are exactly

          W_k=4W-(1+epsilon)c,
          Lambda_k=4Lambda+epsilon*c+3,
          Gamma=[d+epsilon(d+1)]c+3C(d+1,2)+3,
          D=d(k) in {d,d+1},
          D=d iff 4sigma>=Gamma,
          sigma_k=4sigma-Gamma+(D-d)(W_k+d+1).

      Hence a chronology with deadline-particle loss tau fits the exact
      length B(k) scalar census iff tau<=sigma_k.  For a fixed chronology T,
      the minimum-frontier functional Phi_D(T) is the sharp row/scalar
      obstruction.  The stronger Psi_D(T) also requires legal nonempty
      maximal envelopes; literal uncapped geometry exists iff
      Psi_D(T)<=sigma_k.  Passing either test is not Hall or common-cap
      feasibility.  Calibrations are15->17 budget7401,9->11 budget369,
      12->14 budget392 and14->16 budget12284.

      The parity-unified lower-q1 Euler law is

          H-E=Q-J,

      where Q is palette size and J the number of Johnson adjacencies.  After
      f cuts and j Johnson joins it is H-E=(Q-W_k)+f-j.  Thus an odd spanning
      path has H=1+eta+E and has exactly one boundary hole iff every seam is
      Johnson and E=0.  An even child k=2s instead satisfies

          H-E=1-Cat_s;

      a q1-complete path necessarily has E=Cat_s-1.  In particular K16 has
      the forced repeat reserve1429.  An all-k induction must not demand
      even-dimensional q1 rainbowness.

      The odd four-sector theorem is strengthened from strict gap insertion
      to arbitrary component routing.  With

          M=C(2r-1,r), b=Cat_r, N=M-b,

      a coupled palette-exact acyclic A/X/Y residual factor gives b XY macro
      paths.  If the selected U deck has any c_U-path rainbow cover, a cyclic
      routing of all b+c_U paths by 00 Johnson seams has exact untagged count

          (N-c_U)+(b+c_U)=M.

      Joint colour injectivity makes the cycle q1-exact; opening one seam
      gives M-1 colours and the unique named boundary hole.  Thus U component
      count cancels without any c_U<=b restriction.  PBBS supplies the source
      exact q1 palette, a U occurrence transversal and every all-depth flag,
      but not protected survival after selection, the coupled cap/socket
      factor, endpoint routing, residence or a common cap.

      Pin contraction is scalar-neutral.  If h compatible target/cell pairs
      are fixed, both atlas and target sides lose h and the residual surplus

          sigma_k-Loss(G,H)

      is unchanged.  Caps can still delete incidences, so all domains must be
      rebuilt and one maximal-common-cap transversal must avoid the five
      exact conflict types.  At the K17 tail-start threshold
      G=(W,W,W),H=(0,0,7401), loss equals slack; for any chronology which
      passes residence under it, the residual common cap is forced to be
      bijective after every compatible contraction.

      A genuine obstruction rules out four separate sector compilers.  Even
      granting the empty-tag sector an isolated depth-D band and the entire
      triangular boundary, its deficiency is

          Delta0=Lambda+W-[D(W-c)+C(D+1,2)]>0.

      Therefore at least Delta0 assignments must migrate across statuses in
      one common cap.  The exact missing theorem for this Pascal/PBBS route is
      nonemptiness of one joint occurrence-labelled fibre satisfying
      endpoint/q1, protected upper, particle/envelope and common-cap gates.
      Parent equality alone supplies none of that correlation.

      Two independent theorem referees found no recurrence or parity error

2117. Lane A has proved the exact protected-opening calculus and isolated a
      new lower/upper incompatibility for canonical PBBS wedge repair.

      For arbitrary multi-cut sets, the correct replacement for a one-edge
      cut kernel is the minimal blocker clutter of occurrence-labelled
      witness spans.  A target is missing after an ordered braid iff every
      old supporting component contains a selected blocker and no literal
      suffix/full-fragments/prefix interval realizes it.  The same theorem
      holds dually for intersections.  On one-cut PBBS components,
      homomesy gives full union and empty intersection, so every proper
      upper or nonempty lower cross-fragment target is localized to one
      seam.  The resulting joint-atlas SPILL criterion is exact; product
      factorization is valid only for a genuinely Cartesian legal atlas.

      The lower-q1 ledger is

          H-E=b-j.

      For one Johnson fragment path this is H-E=1, and H=1,E=0 iff its
      seam colours are distinct deleted cut colours.  For an active
      canonical wedge ray w,u,..., departure key kappa=w\u and cut colour
      c=w intersect u, a foreign endpoint v adjacent to u repairs every
      ray depth iff kappa is in v.  Such a repair seam cannot have colour c:
      equality forces v=w.  Thus every exact repairing braid needs a
      remote-colour injection: a seam cannot carry the cut colour of any
      incident component it canonically services.

      Consequences are exact.  A two-component reciprocal seam necessarily
      has H=2,E=1.  A three-component path with both seams servicing both
      incident ports is impossible under H=1,E=0 by a repeated-owner
      argument.  In the keyed-ear shape the only palette pattern not
      excluded is c3 on the reciprocal seam and c2 on the one-way ear,
      leaving c1 exposed, up to reversal.  The positive rooted conveyor is
      now explicit: seam i carries source cut colour c_i backward and the
      next component's departure key forward.  Together with a kernel-safe
      root, exact deadline thresholds, and a common-cap compiler this is a
      zero-loss sufficient theorem for nu(k)=B(k).

      The universal existence of this remote-colour protected braid is not
      proved.  Independently, the frozen K17 11-cycle double-q1 factor has a
      sharp scoped staircase no-go: every one-cut/whole-cycle,
      terminal-start opening has rho2+rho3>=37530>7401; the run-collar
      capacity bound separately requires at least325 cuts to eliminate all
      old run2/run3 occurrences.  Arbitrary starts, multi-cut fragments and
      alternating rethreads remain open.

2116. Lane R has closed the abstract protected-connectivity question for the
      balanced two-extension fibre, and has isolated a sharp obstruction to
      replacing compound circuits by incidence hexagons.

      Let I be the inclusion graph between the equal middle shores, F a
      degree-two incidence factor, and P the literal incidence support of
      selected all-depth witnesses/corridors. Any two factors containing P
      are connected, inside that same protected face, by P-disjoint
      alternating circuits: red/blue degree balance decomposes their
      symmetric difference. Thus a fixed literal guard has unconditional
      plateau-monotone zero-shadow-defect transport. This does not supply a
      desired endpoint or a compiler.

      Forced installation of a proposed new witness bank Q has an exact
      integral criterion. Put P'=P union (Q intersection F), orient addable
      incidences lower-to-upper and removable incidences upper-to-lower, and
      set A=Q\F. A common factor containing P union Q exists iff

          |A intersection delta^+(S)| <= |delta^-(S)|

      for every vertex set S in that protected exchange digraph. This is
      Hoffman's lower-bounded circulation theorem with unit capacities.
      Consequently old and new witness sections admit a literal
      make-before-break duplex handoff iff these cuts hold. Pointwise
      witness multiplicity is insufficient; collective protected cuts are
      the exact obstruction.

      Correction from item2132: the length-only component-parity law is
      false.  A literal two-rail C8 maps two cycles to two cycles, so neither
      “every C6 preserves parity” nor “every C8 flips parity” may be used.
      The exact topology datum is the occurrence-labelled retained-strand
      pairing: after deleting the old half, superpose that pairing with the
      old or new circuit pairing and count cycles.  The explicit H,E factors
      in I(5,2) remain valid endpoints differing by a C12, but parity no
      longer proves that the legal-C6 graph between them is disconnected.
      The separate incidence-protected face having one chordless C8 and no
      protected C6 remains an exact local non-generation example.

      An alternating hexagon preserves the complete immediate-upper
      multiplicity vector iff the three rows have one common exterior
      owner-coordinate. Such a common-exterior C6 is a literal zero-defect
      switch when selected deeper witness spans avoid its deleted edges and
      the full coordinate DFA accepts the newly oriented fragments,
      including cyclic closure. A static bank must have disjoint extended
      supports, including the three exterior-owner incidences; disjoint
      six-cycles alone are insufficient. A sequential loose tree of **clean**
      neutral C6s merges three current components to one at each step and can
      Hamiltonize when its exact retained-strand topology reaches one.  There
      is no separate parity precondition.  This is conditional on the
      displayed clean bank, not an unconditional PBBS theorem.

      The abstract endpoint maps exactly to the literal fragment braid.
      Common physical edges are retained fragments, M\N are cuts, N\M are
      seams, and every changed row keeps its exact lower colour. New upper
      intervals are precisely suffix--whole-fragment--prefix intervals.
      A paired guard has a residual integral completion iff, for all
      A subset C and B subset V,

          b_C(A) <= b_V(B) + e_H(A,V\B),

      with equal total demand and guard degree at most two. The remaining
      endpoint is nevertheless a decorated path-cover problem: exact colour
      rows, protected seam providers, the full product DFA, no subtours, an
      opening, and the external common-cap compiler must all pass together.

      Consequently the authenticated K17 canonical PBBS component count146
      is not by itself an obstruction.  The sharp sufficient target is a
      sparse PBBS witness/duplex-guard selection satisfying every Hoffman
      cut, together with circuit columns whose exact port-pairing cycle count
      reaches one and whose colour/residence fragment completion passes.
      Common-cap compilation remains a separate gate. No unconditional all-k
      equality is claimed.

2115. Root has resolved the common-cap/compiler structural question at the
      theorem level, with both a zero-defect sufficient condition and sharp
      counterexamples to the proposed automatic implication.

      Fix the pinned maximal envelopes and any individually exact residual
      incidence bank H.  A co-selectable trace guard consists of: one bit
      surviving every bank edge through each position; one guarded occurrence
      of every protected-row bit; and, for every incidence e and every bit of
      its target, one occurrence protected against every edge co-selectable
      with e.  These local data imply that every H-supported matching has
      nonempty caps and realizes every protected and selected row exactly.

      If the cells admit an order and each target neighbourhood is an interval
      [ell_S,r_S], an exact compiler exists precisely when

          |{S : [ell_S,r_S] subseteq [a,b]}| <= b-a+1

      for every cell interval [a,b].  Sorting by nondecreasing r_S and taking
      the earliest unused admissible cell is a canonical integral construction.
      The matching matrix is marginally TU in every bipartite graph; the trace
      guards are what make its integral matching physically exact.

      More generally, let B_H be the inclusion-minimal matching-compatible
      common-cap bad-event clutter relative to H.  If a laminar cell-capacity
      family dominates every B in B_H, then its independent cell sets form a
      laminar matroid.  Rado's inequalities

          rank_M(N_H(X)) >= |X|  for all target sets X

      are sufficient, and a target-to-cell-to-laminar-tree integral flow
      constructs the exact assignment.  This is the requested polymatroid/TU
      route, with the logically necessary order `guards first, TU second`.

      The baseline implication is false.  A two-position convex K2,2 has
      scalar equality, ordinary Hall, a permanent owner, and every incidence
      individually exact, but every perfect matching deletes a protected bit.
      The natural direct common-cap LP has x=1/2 and cap bits (1,1/2,1/2), so
      its augmented matrix is not TU.  A sharper chain-aligned Johnson core
      has rows {o,a,u},{o,a,v}, three singleton cells for two targets, and a
      unique marginal matching with surplus one, yet still loses a.  A complete
      k=3 lift contains all six nonempty proper lower targets and 16 cells but
      retains the same obstruction.

      K16 is consistent but not circular evidence for the new theorem.  Its
      compiler schedule spends tau=(0,0,6386), two units above the arbitrary-
      start row-exact minimum rho=(0,0,6384), to expose the singleton at6389.
      It was closed by the exact maximal-cap witness, not a preproved convex or
      laminar bank.  DM support pruning exposes14059 neutral degree-one targets
      and leaves12272/238472; the separate iterative universal closure reports
      14060 and leaves12271/237467.  The particle corridors provide candidate
      trace guards, but neither they nor scalar capacity prove guard survival.

2111. Lane R has completed the theorem-level PBBS endpoint analysis and
      independently reconciled it with items2108--2110.  The principal new
      unconditional statement is the all-r component-neutral Catalan law.
      For an odd-to-odd lift from2r-1 to2r+1, put

          W=binom(2r-1,r), N=binom(2r-1,r+1),
          J=W-N=Cat_r.

      If U has c lower-rainbow path components and A/X/Y form J native YAX
      macro paths, every external seam in a globally lower-q1-rainbow path
      is forced to be untagged and

          00: (N-c)+(J+c-1)=W-1,
          xy:N, x:W, y:W.

      In the strict internal-gap form this is

          (N-c)+2c+(J-1-c)=W-1,
          1<=c<=min(N,J-1).

      Thus component subdivision has zero lower-q1 cost and invariant
      palette slack exactly one.  Cutting an internal U colour transports,
      rather than creates, that unique hole.  A fixed same-label
      Y(T)-X(T) edge cannot simply be subdivided: Y(T)-U-X(T) repeats T, so
      a legal insertion requires global endpoint re-pairing/rerooting.

      The exact untagged endpoint rules are

          Y(T)~X(T') iff T=T';
          X(T),Y(T)~U(V) iff T subset V;
          U(V)~U(V') iff |V intersection V'|=r.

      Lane R also proves a global residence-sufficient endpoint theorem.
      Fix one orientation/reroot per physical macro.  For its coordinate
      word define canonical danger set D(P), and for an entry macro define
      C3(Q)=Q0 intersection Q1 intersection Q2.  Keep only actual
      Johnson/fresh-colour arcs P->Q with D(P) subset C3(Q), and prune them
      by an acyclic macro potential.  Ordinary Hall on nonterminal exits
      versus noninitial entries then gives one macro-Hamilton path; induction
      through the universal111 resets proves the whole physical word avoids
      010/0110 in every child coordinate.  A source-colour injection gives
      lower rainbowness.  This acyclic reset-Hall theorem is genuinely
      global; pair-collar Hall without reset consistency is not.

      Rerooting is now quantified by exact profiles
      (entry,exit,C_i,D_i,colour).  If B0 is the retained guarded graph and
      delta(S)=(|S|-|N_B0(S)|)_+, it suffices that new reroot edges from S
      to entries outside N_B0(S) contain a matching of size delta(S) for
      every S.  The free-port analogue pairs enough odd components to meet
      Tutte.  The exact common missing lemma is to select mandatory upper-
      service reroots so these reset-Hall/Tutte bridge inequalities, colour
      injection, upper path-forest protection, and acyclicity hold together.
      In the separate AD full-factor architecture this selection necessarily
      operates at the1739-service/1740-cut scale; that lower bound does not
      apply to the U shore.

      Finite scope is corrected rather than overclaimed.  The current
      736-component U bank already has a colour-simple full-DFA degree cover
      (path551 plus seven cycles), and a support-five toggle reduces it to a
      path plus six cycles.  Therefore its static pair graph is not the
      reported Hall obstruction; connectivity and the full staircase remain.
      Independently, the distributed tripleflow construction gives an exact
      all-lower-rainbow24310-edge 2-factor with989 components, but it still
      has9103 upper holes and large length-two/three run debt.  Hence neither

      The report passed an adversarial re-audit after corrections to the

2101. Lane L independently audited the monotone-deadline run staircase and
      extended it exactly to arbitrary omitted starts.  The canonical
      theorem is correct in its row-exact/scalar scope.

      Encode start and deadline holes by nondecreasing thresholds alpha,tau:

          x_j=alpha_j+j-1,  y_j=tau_j+j-1,
          s_i=i+g_i,        q_i=i+h_i,

      where g_i=#{j:alpha_j<=i} and h_i=#{j:tau_j<=i}.  Schedule legality is
      exactly tau_j<=alpha_j.  Chain alignment is the separate condition
      g_{i+1}<=h_i.

      For an interior coordinate run [a,b], length ell, row recovery is
      equivalent to the nonempty clean corridor

          q_{a-1}+1 < s_{b+1},

      or h_{a-1}<ell+g_{b+1}.  Thus, for fixed alpha, define

          rho_j^alpha=max{a: [a,b] interior and ell+g_{b+1}<=j}.

      Exact middle replay is iff tau>=rho^alpha.  The b+1 index and strict
      inequality are essential; boundary runs remain automatic.

      The exact loss from the maximum lower-cell supply is

          Loss(alpha,tau)
            =sum_j tau_j + sum_{alpha_j<W}(L-q_{alpha_j})
            =sum_j tau_j + sum_j(W-alpha_j)
               + #{(j,t):alpha_j<tau_t}.

      Hence |C_full|=dW+binom(d+1,2)-Loss.  For fixed alpha, the unique
      legal row-exact scalar minimum is tau=rho^alpha, provided
      rho^alpha<=alpha.  Minimizing this literal loss over alpha is the exact
      arbitrary-start analogue of the root theorem.  Envelope nonemptiness,
      pins, upper transfer, Hall and common cap remain separate.

      On K16 c7be, rho=(0,0,6384) is also the global arbitrary-start minimum:
      moving a start hole early enough to relax the last length-three run
      costs at least6483>6384.  The retained pin schedule tau=(0,0,6386)
      deliberately spends two more cells and has exactly32230 lower cells.

      The fixed K17 first-occurrence and optimized upper-73 sector
      chronologies (SHAs1f320529... and ea103372...) both have tail frontier
      (11440,11440,17824), sum40704, and the decisive bit-7 singleton run
      [11440,11440].  This upgrades the old tail-start rejection to every
      arbitrary start/deadline-hole schedule.  If any alpha_j<=11441, one
      start-loss term is at least12869>Delta17=7401.  Otherwise g_11441=0,
      forcing all three tau_j>=11440 and deadline loss at least34320.
      Therefore each fixed chronology is UNSAT for middle replay plus scalar
      capacity before chain alignment or compiler gates.  This is not a
      no-go for a rethreaded/different K17 carrier.

      The independent replay exhausts5223 legal arbitrary schedules,
      241260 schedule/coordinate traces and11644 fixed-start minimizations.

2100. Lane A has proved the exact dimension-uniform cut-transversal
      criterion for upper-safe block reroots and identified the precise
      boundary of the Pascal two-defect argument.  For an upper target Z,
      let H_T(Z) be the occurrence-labelled family of cut-position
      intervals spanned by its old witnesses.  If a block reroot uses old
      cut set C and x_R(Z) counts its new cross-block witnesses, then

          m_R(Z)
            = #{H in H_T(Z): H intersect C is empty} + x_R(Z).

      Hence the reroot covers a required family U iff

          V_T(C):={Z in U: C hits every old witness span of Z}
             subset supp(x_R).

      This is necessary and sufficient, including old holes by vacuity.
      The exact targetwise redundancy is the interval transversal number
      tau_T(Z), equal by greedy interval piercing to the maximum number of
      pairwise disjoint witness spans.  Any b-cut reroot preserves Z
      internally when tau_T(Z)>=b+1, sharply for a cut-independent internal
      guarantee.  A composition of h two-ended reroots has at most2h old
      breakpoints, so tau>=2h+1 suffices.  Large raw multiplicity or average
      abundance is irrelevant when all spans share one cut.

      At fixed depth q, b separated seams have exactly bq new crossing
      windows; through depth D they have b*binom(D+1,2).  Thus the vulnerable
      plus missing target sets must fit those exact literal ladders, not just
      their counts.  The exact minimum number of reroots is the least h for
      which a reachable Johnson-legal chronology simultaneously has the
      required adjacent-q1 palette and V_T(C_R) subset supp(x_R).

      For the interior one-defect Pascal child, the canonical two new seams
      install alpha=z union Q_(c-1) and beta=z union Q_c and delete
      gamma_-=Q_(c-2) union Q_(c-1) and
      gamma_+=Q_c union Q_(c+1).  If d(U) counts those deleted occurrences,
      the exact q1 condition is m_1(U)>=d(U)+1 for every old colour:
      distinct deleted colours need multiplicity at least2, while a
      coincident deleted colour needs at least3.  The all-depth condition is
      still V_T(C) subset supp(x_R); no such theorem is presently derived
      from the Pascal identities alone.

      Two independently audited central-Johnson counterfamilies show why the
      pointwise condition is indispensable.  One two-ended reroot installs
      both designated q1 holes and loses no old q1 colour, yet destroys two
      higher targets whose witness spans are all cut.  A second family has
      literally unique depth-two witnesses and a degree-three obstruction:
      no Johnson path on the same vertex deck can install the two designated
      q1 colours while retaining those witnesses.  The examples lift to
      J(2r,r) for every r>=10.  Their q1 palette is deliberately incomplete,
      so they refute q1-data-only lemmas, not a theorem exploiting the full
      global Pascal layer.

      Applied to the K17 opposite-choice core, endpoint representative
      changes cannot help.  A successful bounded rethread must change q1
      occurrence geometry and satisfy both the exact occurrence guards and
      the cut/ladders criterion.  The note gives the exact inherited-shore
      interface and the unrestricted two-shore seam formula, while keeping
      run-staircase, lower Hall and common-Q explicitly separate.

      A degree-two factor between rank-6 masks Z and selected indices

2098. Lane K has sharpened the exact common-cap conflict hypergraph into
      candidate-pressure and cutwise theorems.  This is an all-dimensional
      result and does not reopen the solved K16 basin.

      After unary closure and owner orientation, a target transversal is a
      literal common cap exactly when it avoids four conflict families:
      same-cell pairs, minimal middle-bit covers, minimal protected-prepin
      covers, and a selected lower anchor plus a minimal blocker cover.
      Their ranks are 2,d+1,d,d+1.  The canonical atomic lopsidependency
      graph joins two bad cylinders only when they prescribe different
      candidates in a common target part.

      For candidate activities t_v and x_F=product_(v in F)t_v, define the
      opposing survival factor

          Psi(v)=product_(G prescribing an alternative to v)(1-x_G).

      The integral candidate-pressure theorem is

          sum_(v in D_S) t_v Psi(v) >= 1                 for every target S.

      A complementary cluster-expansion theorem uses weights b_v,
      B_S=sum_(v in D_S)b_v and
      T_S=sum_(F meeting D_S)product_(v in F)b_v:

          B_S >= 1+T_S                                  for every target S

      also implies an integral common cap.  For uniform weights and
      single arity j, the honest asymptotic density constants are 1/(j e)
      for the atomic Jensen reduction and (j-1)^(j-1)/j^j for the cluster
      cut; the latter is 1/4 for pairs.  Candidate-level atomic pressure can
      be stronger on heterogeneous atlases.

      These criteria do not follow from bounded conflict rank, list size or
      ordinary Hall.  The m-part/m-cell permutation atlas is feasible but
      lies outside both uniform pressure regimes; the (m+1)-part version is
      UNSAT.  Thus a generic LLL/nibble does not close coefficient one.  A
      PBBS/Pascal proof must supply a carrier-specific low-opposition bank,
      normalized conflict profile, or negatively dependent matching law.

      The exact deterministic fallback is the integral minimal-conflict cut
      system.  Its fractional relaxation has the exact Farkas criterion

          sum_S min_(v in D_S) q_z(v) <= sum_R z_R b_R   for every z>=0.

      Odd-cycle binary atlases show that fractional feasibility and bounded
      rank do not imply integrality, with unbounded minimal obstruction
      support already at rank2.  If the augmented part/cell/conflict matrix
      is TU, the Farkas cuts are integral; alternatively, a conflict-free
      Hall kernel or a Rado matroid satisfying its rank cuts suffices.

2097. Lane R has isolated the exact common-cap existence theorem and the
      strongest currently justified PBBS/Pascal quantitative gates.  This is
      independent of the closed K16 search.

      For a nonempty middle-realizing guard word Q, retain exactly

          H_Q={(S,C): OR_(p in C) Q_p=S}.

      Then H_Q is Cartesian, and common-cap existence is equivalent to the
      existence of Q satisfying, for every lower-target set X,

          |N_G(X) minus N_(H_Q)(X)| <= |N_G(X)|-|X|.

      Thus the coefficient-one guard-loss versus marginal-surplus inequality
      is necessary and sufficient for fixed Q, and existentially over Q is
      an exact compiler theorem.  A checkable sufficient specialization is

          m_Q(S)>0,
          ell_Q(C)=sum_(S adjacent C) 1/m_Q(S) <= 1.

      More generally, if a finite group preserves one physical Q and H_Q,
      target/cell orbit masses admit a transportation flow

          sum_beta z_(alpha,beta)=|L_alpha|,
          sum_alpha z_(alpha,beta)<=|C_beta|,

      then orbit-biregularity gives a saturating fractional matching and
      hence an integral literal compiler.  Equivalently, every set A of
      target orbits must have total target mass at most the total capacity
      of its neighboring cell orbits.  This averages only one physical
      guarded atlas; unrelated multiframe averages remain nonliteral.

      The normalized theorem is stable under literal seam deletion: if the
      pre-opening cell loads are at most 1-epsilon and every target loses at
      most eta<=epsilon of its fractional mass, rowwise renormalization
      preserves cell capacity.  For m uniform guarded incidences and at most
      b deleted incidences per target, b/m<=epsilon suffices.  Aggregate seam
      count is not a substitute for this targetwise inequality.

      Two sharp obstruction families rule out automatic lifting.  The
      complete K_(dr+1,(d+1)r) singleton atlas has interval span d+1,
      permanent owners and maximally uniform marginal neighborhoods, yet
      every matching fills one row and kills a protected bit.  For every Q,
      full-cut guard loss is at least r against surplus r-1; if all guarded
      degrees are positive, some guarded normalized load is at least
      1+1/(dr).  A reflection-equivariant interval family has marginal load
      only 1/h and arbitrarily large expansion, but every two-target matching
      fails at the common central position.  Hence normalized load must be
      computed in H_Q or a Cartesian-guarded bank, never in G.

      The uniform atomic lopsided profile also has a quantitative collision
      barrier.  On K_(L,N), the alternative pair count is

          tilde D_2=(N-1)(L-1).

      The uniform criterion fails for every fugacity c whenever

          (N-1)(L-1)/N^2 >= 1/(2e),

      in particular on every square K_(N,N), N>=2.  For a complete residual
      opposing profile bounded by tilde D_j<=R Q^(j-1), the valid product-law
      sufficient condition is

          u=c/M, alpha=Qu<1,
          R u alpha / [(1-u^2)(1-alpha)] <= log c.

      Same-cell collisions must be included unless the atlas is literally
      cell-disjoint; this product theorem cannot be invoked after silently
      conditioning on a matching law.

      On the native PBBS atlas the stable-coordinate bank gives

          Q=2^(r-2d-2)-1,
          D_j(V_{x}) >= |V_{x}| (Q)_(j-1),

      and eventually D_4>M^2/16, so the old raw symmetric criterion is
      genuinely false.  Tagged internally agreeing events need not oppose
      one another, but current theory supplies neither a post-seam guard word
      and orbit flow, nor targetwise retained mass, nor the complete external
      alternative-bucket bound and list scale M>=2cQ.  Pascal ownership does
      not preserve any of these compiler quantities.  Therefore no all-k
      common-cap theorem is claimed.

2096. Lane L closed the exact variable-staircase P/Q theorem and the
      schedule-level k-to-k+1 recursion.  This is a conditional compiler
      theorem, an arbitrary-P/Q accounting invariant, and an exact tail-start
      parametrization, not an all-dimension existence proof.

      Put

          r_k=ceil(k/2),  M_k=binom(k,r_k),
          Lambda_k=sum_{s=1}^{r_k-1} binom(k,s),

      and let d_k be the least d with

          d M_k + binom(d+1,2) >= Lambda_k.

      Write sigma_k=d_k M_k+binom(d_k+1,2)-Lambda_k.  For the tail-start
      subclass, every schedule is represented uniquely by a nondecreasing
      threshold vector 0<=a_1<=...<=a_d<=M: omit starts M,...,M+d-1 and
      deadlines y_j=a_j+j-1.  The inverse is a_j=y_j-j+1.  Row i then owns

          I_i=[i,i+delta_i],  delta_i=#{j:a_j<=i},

      so every consecutive row block has an interval union.  The complete
      lower-cell atlas is exactly the proper prefixes

          [i,i+ell-1],  0<=i<M, 1<=ell<=delta_i,

      plus every [t,u] with M<=t<=u<=M+d-1.  Therefore

          |C_full|=d M-sum_j a_j+binom(d+1,2),

      and scalar capacity is equivalent to sum_j a_j<=sigma_k.  This is not
      Hall and does not imply a common cap.

      The arbitrary-omission form is also exact.  For omitted starts X and
      deadlines Y, let c(t) be the deadline of the first owner starting at
      or after t, or L if none remains.  Then

          C_full={ [t,u]: t<=u<c(t) },
          A=sum X-sum Y,
          B=sum_{x in X}(c(x)-x),
          |C_full|=A+B.

      Here A is the selected-start proper-prefix area and B is the literal
      omitted-start boundary contribution; triangular credit is not valid
      for arbitrary X.  With Y={y_1<...<y_d}, define

          loss ell=sum_{x in X}(L-c(x))+sum_j(y_j-(j-1)).

      The exact all-k schedule invariant is

          |C_full|=d M+binom(d+1,2)-ell,
          Omega_k=|C_full|-Lambda_k=sigma_k-ell.

      Pin contraction of h distinct target/cell pairs leaves Omega unchanged,
      since it removes h cells and h targets.  This is raw scalar accounting:
      cap-induced incidence loss is not forgiven, residual domains must be
      rebuilt after capping, and multi-cell pin equalities remain guarded.

      Pin contraction is exact only after the positional cap is checked
      against every owner row through that position.  The correct order is
      retime, cap, reserve the physical singleton cell, contract its target
      and cell, then build the residual common-cap graph.  Once the capped
      envelope and the simultaneous lower assignment are exact, chain
      alignment transfers every consecutive-middle-row upper witness to a
      physical interval.  Thus no fixed D^dA=T identity is required.

      The dimension recursion is literal.  For an odd parent k=2m+1 set

          R_-=2 sigma-M-1-d(d+3)/2.

      Then (d',sigma')=(d-1,R_-) when R_->=0, and otherwise

          (d',sigma')=(d,2 sigma+M-1-binom(d+1,2)).

      For an even parent k=2m, put C_m=M/(m+1) and

          R_0=2 sigma-d C_m-M-1-binom(d+1,2).

      Then (d',sigma')=(d,R_0) when R_0>=0, and otherwise

          (d',sigma')=(d+1,
             2 sigma+C_m(m-d)-1+(d+1)(2-d)/2).

      Hence odd-to-even keeps or deletes one threshold, while even-to-odd
      keeps or adds one.  Authenticated parent/child reroot seams may be used
      as threshold candidates only if a child vector obeying
      sum a'_j<=sigma_{k+1} exists there.  The one-pivot heuristic transports
      a by min{sigma',M'-1,floor(M'a/M)} when both depths are positive.  It
      remains subject to the upper audit, positional pin test, residual Hall,
      and common-cap equations.  Calibration is

          k15: (M,d,sigma)=(6435,3,2928),
          k16: (12870,3,12284),
          k17: (24310,3,7401).

      The K16 schedule has A=32224, B=6, |C_full|=32230 and Omega=5898;
      its singleton contraction leaves32229 cells for26331 targets with the
      same surplus.  The carrier-free K17 one-pivot forecast is

          a=(0,0,7401), X=(24310,24311,24312), Y=(0,1,7403),
          p=7404, A=65529, B=6, |C_full|=Lambda_17=65535,
          Omega_17=0.

      Thus any legal singleton contraction would leave65534 cells for65534
      targets and force use of every residual cell.  No K17 chronology, cap,
      upper replay, Hall matching, or common cap is asserted.

      Two independent proof audits found the algebra sound after restricting
      “normal form” to the tail-start subclass and making seam transport
      conditional.  The deterministic replay checks all dimension
      transitions through k=1000, 1996 exhaustive tail-start catalogues,
      5223 arbitrary-omission catalogues, 144 one-pivot endpoint cases, and

2095. Lane K extracted the reusable all-dimensional construction and exact
      common-cap conflict clutter from the now-closed K16 certificate.  This
      is not another K16 basin search.

      First, a one-defect Pascal lemma is exact.  If D^h of an odd-parent
      word permutes the old rank-r layer and D^(h-1), after deleting one
      exceptional entry, permutes the old rank-(r-1) layer, then the unmarked
      D^h shore together with the marked D^(h-1) shore is the complete new
      rank-r layer.  This proves middle ownership only.  A two-endpoint
      reroot changes at most two undirected adjacent occurrences; arbitrary
      upper completeness requires the exact internal-plus-global-ray
      spectrum, including intervals spanning both cuts.  Physical transfer
      also requires chain-aligned row intervals.

      Second, prepins may be capped into the maximal envelope, but every
      multi-cell prepin equality remains protected during residual
      compilation.  Only a one-cell singleton is automatic from
      nonemptiness.  The exact residual conflict clutter has five families:

          same-cell pairs;
          minimal empty-position intersections;
          minimal middle-bit host covers;
          minimal protected-prepin-bit host covers;
          a selected lower anchor plus a minimal blocker cover.

      After unary closure their maximum sizes are respectively

          2, min(r,d(d+1)/2), d+1, d, d+1.

      Choosing an owner bit o_p in every physical envelope and retaining
      only incidences containing o_p wherever their cells pass deletes the
      empty-position family.  Thus the owner-filtered conflict rank is at
      most d+1.  Bounded rank is not bounded dependency: the theorem records
      literal cell load lambda, positive/negative bit-position loads A+/A-,
      prepin load Pi, per-candidate B_j bounds, target-part profiles D_j and
      event dependency Gamma.

      A candidate-specific symmetric certificate is

          e((d+1)Gamma+1) <= m^2,

      after owner filtering and forced-edge closure.  The exact asymmetric
      alternative is the usual product inequality over literal event
      probabilities; a weighted-neighbor sufficient bound and an
      arity-sensitive part-profile product are stated explicitly.  No such
      inequality follows from Boolean rank, Johnson adjacency, depth,
      ordinary Hall, or list size alone.  The rank-two n=m+1 common-cell
      atlas is UNSAT by pigeonhole; even the feasible n=m atlas defeats the
      canonical symmetric and uniform lopsided numerical tests.  A nibble
      therefore needs a new carrier-specific low-codegree/negative-
      dependence theorem.

      The proof-safe fallback is an exact finite cutwise 0-1 system: one
      incidence per target, at most one per cell, and one inequality for
      every minimal conflict above.  Integral separation either returns a
      literal compiler or a finite infeasibility certificate.  With owners,
      every separated cut has width at most d+1.

      The combined Pascal-reroot theorem now says that one-defect middle
      ownership, exact ray absorption, a chain-aligned length-W+d schedule,
      protected prepins, and either a literal common cap, the owner-conflict
      LLL, or the restricted oriented-anchor Hall condition imply a
      universal word of length W+d.  An independent audit corrected the
      prepin and global-ray scopes.  The finite c7be inert/anchor audit gives
      22494 inert and 3838 non-inert lower targets, but is retained only as a
      restricted normal-form calibration; K16 optimality is already item2094.

2095. Lane A extracted the dimension-uniform block-reroot/upper-shadow
      theorem from the solved genuine-fourfilter K16 construction.  For an
      arbitrary partition into oriented and reordered blocks, every
      length-l crossing-window OR has the unique form

          suffix(first block) OR all intervening blocks OR prefix(last block).

      This gives a multiplicity-exact ledger at every window length and,
      after rank filtering, at every upper depth.  If the block lengths are
      n_i, the exact number of (q+1)-windows crossing a seam is

          C_q=(W-q)-sum_i(n_i-q)_+=sum_i min(n_i,q)-q.

      The arbitrary-width interval deck is the common block-internal bank
      plus the corresponding one- and multiseam rectangles.  Hence a reroot
      is upper-complete iff every required target has positive multiplicity
      in the internal bank plus the new cross-block bank.  A convenient
      sufficient form protects every old target internally and assigns every
      old hole to a new boundary ladder.  Nested rays are obtained by growing
      a seam window by one entry on either side at each depth.  Thus O(d)
      seams repair a full tower only for a protected carrier whose residual
      defects lie on O(d) such rays; no dimension-only O(d)-seam theorem can
      repair an arbitrary tower.

      The exact budget separation is also proved.  A reroot itself is
      length-neutral.  The length slack d=B-W, raw deadline surplus

          sigma=dW+binom(d+1,2)-Lambda,

      and actual schedule surplus s=m-Lambda are distinct, with

          0<=s<=sigma<=W+d-1

      for a scalar-viable optimal-length schedule.  Quarantining all physical
      intervals of lengths2..d+1 across h explicitly aligned cuts costs at
      most h*binom(d+1,2) cells, but this is only a cardinality screen and
      proves neither Hall nor common-Q.  For h=O(d) the shallow charge is
      O(d^3)=o(W), conditionally harmless for coefficient one, but exact
      B(k) still requires the ladder identity and one literal common-Q
      compiler.

      The companion theorem formalizes endpoint q1 transport, exact
      singleton-retiming cost, the common-Q fibre/waste identity, a robust
      Hall counterinterface, and clutter-safe/spread sufficient criteria.
      It proves that marginal slack alone cannot provide the common
      quantifier.  For K16 the three block lengths are6389,6437,44; the two
      seams contribute exactly72 shallow windows through depth8, all39197 old
      interval values have internal witnesses, and the ladders add precisely
      the six missing masks.  This is a theorem extraction only; K16 itself
      was already closed in item2094.

2109. Lane L has upgraded the dimension-uniform Shadow--Braid theorem with
      the exact component-neutral odd-to-odd braid law and the coupled
      residual-factor hypothesis needed to make it nonvacuous.

      For an odd parent of size2r-1, put

          M=C(2r-1,r), b=Cat_r, N=M-b=C(2r-1,r+1).

      A linear Catalan tail has b macro blocks and b-1 internal gaps.  If the
      N U-owners form c nonempty paths and c distinct gaps receive two-port
      U insertions, then the untagged lower-q1 slot ledger is exactly

          (N-c)+2c+(b-1-c)=M-1,
          1<=c<=min(N,b-1).

      Hence U component count is neutral: the local change is -1 internal U
      edge,+2 ports,-1 direct seam.  This is initially a slot identity, not
      a palette theorem.  The U-internal, port and retained direct colours
      must be jointly injective.  At an unselected gap the old endpoint
      projections must be equal; at a selected gap they need only be
      contained in the two U endpoints, and injectivity forces them unequal.
      Thus the operation is replacement of an unlabelled macro gap, not
      subdivision of a pre-existing legal edge.  With injectivity, the
      cyclic b-gap version covers all M untagged colours; opening one retained
      direct gap gives the unique linear boundary hole.  Pure-old upper
      targets remain component-sensitive and must have an internal witness
      inside some U path.

      The other three lower signatures have an exact forced residual ledger:

          (AA,XX,XA,YY,AY)=(N,N,b,N,b).

      However the literal separated four-sector choice is structurally dead
      as a macro factor: its cap-two AA graph is 2-regular on the selected A
      owners and therefore consists of sealed cycles.  The correct recursive
      object couples the cap and sockets.  Choose one compatible AA edge for
      each rank-(r-2) colour and binary alpha_i,beta_i selecting XA versus XX
      and AY versus YY, subject to

          deg_AA(i)+alpha_i+beta_i=2.

      Then deg(X_i)=2-alpha_pred(i) and deg(Y_i)=2-beta_i.  Requiring the
      whole residual graph to be acyclic with one X and one Y endpoint per
      component forces |alpha|=|beta|=b and gives a spanning cover by exactly
      b X-to-Y macro paths.  A cyclic ordering of these macros, compatible U
      endpoint containments, direct-gap equalities and one joint untagged
      colour injection is the exact owner/lower-q1 endpoint hypothesis.

      For K17, the authenticated c=737 local cyclic ledger is

          4268 internal +1474 ports +693 direct =6435;

      opening a retained direct gap gives4268+1474+692=6434.  Independently,
      the frozen first-occurrence literal residual graph has the correct edge
      families and1,430 open XY paths but15 sealed AA cycles, with histogram

          3^9,4^2,6,442,455,4067

      and all5,005 selected A vertices trapped in those cycles.  Thus its
      endpoint types already balance; the exact missing factor gate is the
      coupled acyclic cap/socket choice, not U Hamiltonicity.

      This closes only the all-r owner/lower-q1 identity and specifies the
      recursive endpoint hypothesis.  Full CSB_r still additionally requires
      tagged and componentwise upper coverage, residence/collars, the P/Q
      schedule, boundary-hole pinning, one common-cap compiler at length B,
      and a regenerative auxiliary child factor.  No K17 word or
      unconditional all-k induction is claimed.

2150. The middle-levels trace lane has proved the exact decorated-cycle
      normal form for Catalan linear diamond matchings.  On a Hamilton cycle
      `A_i < B_i > A_(i+1)` of `ML(2m-1)`, mark `P=C(2m-1,m-2)` A-turns
      whose unions biject rank `m+1`, and P B-turns whose intersections
      biject rank `m-2`.  The remaining cross choices form a perfect
      matching exactly when the marks alternate by shore, equivalently when
      every unmarked run is even; that cross matching is then unique.  The
      selected turns plus cross matching are a perfect matching of the full
      lower--upper diamond graph and their physical lift has degree at most
      two.

      The exact topology is sharper than the first guessed gap rule.  If the
      cyclic trace has maximal marked/unmarked runs `1^a_t 0^b_t`, the lift
      has a cycle iff every `b_t=2` and every `a_t` is odd.  Otherwise it is
      a spanning `Cat_m`-path forest.  Thus `11001100` is a counterexample to
      the claim that gaps only in `{0,2}` force a cycle.

      The equivalence is necessarily scoped to middle-levels-resolvable
      matchings.  An exact `m=3` perfect diamond matching is frozen whose
      physical lift is a spanning five-path forest, but whose forced
      middle-levels support has four degree-three vertices, so no Hamilton
      middle-levels cycle can contain it.  Hence arbitrary Catalan Linear
      Matching does not automatically normalize to this architecture.
      Middle Levels and GMM tight-enumeration theorems separately supply the
      undecorated cycle or one turn-surjection; neither supplies both turn
      bijections, alternating representatives, and the trace topology on
      one cycle.

2154. The SCD-switching lane has proved the exact diamond-rectangle and
      alternating-switch calculus and completed the true asymptotic GK edit
      distance.

      For every middle set X, the m-by-m rectangle

          R_X = {(L,U): L subset X subset U}

      has perfect-matching occupancy exactly equal to the physical degree of
      X.  An alternating-cycle exchange changes that degree by its
      new-minus-old rectangle intersection.  If the current lift is a
      forest, delete the old switched edges and contract the remaining
      components: the switch is forest-safe exactly when the new attachment
      multigraph is loopless and acyclic.  A fixed period-three filter is
      preserved by switching in the residual graph after deleting its
      endpoints; a clean-H quotient cycle may instead be lifted orbitwise.

      Every inclusion-graph C4 is a hinge rotation inside one unique R_X.
      It preserves the pivot load, changes four leaf loads by
      (-1,-1,+1,+1), and is forest-safe exactly when the two new leaves lie
      in distinct nonpivot components after deletion.  Thus a square cannot
      repair its own pivot overload.

      The formerly published W/2 bound for a linear subforest of the GK
      projection was false: deleting a vertex's outgoing edge can permit two
      incoming edges.  GK components are exactly the underlying trees of all
      rooted plane trees with m edges.  Exact degree-two DP gives deletion
      totals

          Delta_m = 0,0,2,12,51,204,815,3236,... .

      With P=zG,Q=zuH, the bivariate equations

          G=1/(1-Q)+P/(1-Q)^2,
          H=P^2/((1-Q)^2(1-Q-uP))

      prove Delta_m/(m Cat_m)->0.356895867892... .  Therefore every
      bounded-semicycle GK repair still needs Theta(W) switches, with the
      corrected constant rather than 1/2.  The stale claims in the three GK
      notes were updated.

      A wider two-rail construction is also exact.  Select same-rail chords
      on a middle-levels trace and match the residual A rows to residual B
      columns by containments.  The two local displayed degree identities in
      the theorem are necessary and sufficient for all rectangle caps;
      contracting same-rail fragments leaves precisely the cross-edge forest
      test.  Item2150 is the stricter cycle-supported specialization with a
      unique residual matching and exact binary-run topology.

2153. The alternating-turn lane has closed the representative-selection
      subproblem exactly and found the first counterexample to automatic
      interlacing.  Fix an upper occurrence transversal I on a
      middle-levels Hamilton cycle.  Its selected A-turns cut the B-turns
      into P cyclic gaps.  Alternating lower representatives exist iff the
      gap--lower-colour incidence graph has a perfect matching, equivalently
      iff every family of gaps sees at least as many distinct lower colours.
      This is the exact gap--Hall condition; in prefix form it is cyclic
      discrepancy at most one.  It follows automatically from minimum gap
      degree at least maximum colour degree, and reduces to interval-load
      inequalities when the colour occurrence sets are circular arcs.

      Separate surjectivity of both turn maps is not enough.  An explicit

      lower positions carrying the same colour.  The audit enumerates all
      12,288 upper SDRs; their best gap matching has size20 rather than21.
      Exhaustively, all24 Hamilton cycles of ML(5) are two-sided surjective

      interlacing into the cycle.  Two rainbow turn words alone do not close
      the Catalan matching gate.

2155. The supplied-forest physical-lift lane has isolated the exact weakest
      occurrence-level socket/voltage gate and proved that the decorated
      middle-levels construction does not satisfy it automatically.  Let a
      clean-H-invariant spanning Catalan path forest be supplied, with two
      formal endpoint occurrences per quotient path (including two formal
      ports at one isolated vertex), and let P pair the two ports of each
      retained path.  A literal connector selection M gives one physical
      Hamilton lift if and only if:

          every port is used exactly once;
          selected developed Johnson-edge orbits are distinct and avoid F;
          P union M is one alternating occurrence cycle; and
          the cycle's total voltage V is primitive, gcd(h,V)=1.

      More generally, if P union M has occurrence cycles C with voltages
      V_C, the exact number of lifted physical cycles is

          sum_C gcd(h,V_C).

      Equivalently, orient the quotient paths and select connectors
      P_i^+ -> P_pi(i)^- for one cyclic permutation pi, with primitive sum
      of path and connector gains.  Path-tree gains may be gauged to zero
      only with the connector gains recomputed in that gauge.
      This is necessary and sufficient in the invariant retained-forest
      fibre.  Connector-colour injectivity, a filter--connector bijection
      and residual Kneser Hall are not required for immediate coverage;
      collars, guards and compiler cells remain separate literal capacity
      rows.

      The trace test is an exact NO, even after item2153's gap--Hall gate.
      On an authenticated ML(5) Hamilton cycle, I={0,1,3,5,7} and
      J={0,2,4,6,8} select all five upper and lower turn colours, with one
      distinct lower colour in every I-gap.  Thus the fixture passes the
      exact gap--Hall/interlacing criterion.  Its trace

          11100110011001100100

      lies on the forest face and lifts to paths of orders9,4,2,4,1.  The
      isolated middle vertex22 has two formal ports, but among every other
      path endpoint it is Johnson-adjacent only to vertex28.  Hence its two
      ports have only one neighbour port: a literal 2>1 endpoint-capacity
      obstruction.  The independent replay lists all13 legal formal-port
      pairs/12 physical endpoint edges and exhausts zero port perfect
      matchings, zero degree-feasible five-edge sets and zero endpoint
      connector cycles.  Failure already occurs at h=1, before voltage.

      Therefore a recursive middle-levels route needs, in order: a
      gap--Hall decoration, the binary forest face, a cyclic endpoint
      transversal, and primitive voltage.  Separate two-sided rainbows are
      insufficient at the first step, while even a genuine decoration is
      insufficient at the socket step.  Switching or deleting supplied
      forest edges, noninvariant closures, and unrestricted all-m existence
      are outside this theorem.
