2156. The four-transversal rounding lane has classified the standard
      abstract shortcuts and shown that none supplies the missing integral
      Boolean correlation.  The exact positive formulation is a common
      independent set of size `N` in four partition matroids (lower,
      upper, tail, head) and one graphic matroid.  It is genuinely a
      five-matroid problem: an explicit m=3 four-blocker makes the natural
      independence system not 3-extendible, excluding an intersection of
      at most three matroids on the same ground and a direct matroid-parity
      encoding.

      Already at m=2 the ordered resource matrix has a determinant -3
      minor, and the exact matching/cap-two/all-graphic relaxation has a
      half-integral full-rank vertex.  Hence neither TU/bimodularity nor
      recognition as an integral polymatroid intersection (or its
      coordinate projection) can round the existing LP.  Two valid full
      solutions violate basis exchange, so the direct solution family is
      neither a matroid base family nor an equicardinal delta-matroid.

      Even deleting every forest inequality does not restore integrality.
      At m=3 two perfect diamond matchings differing on one alternating
      15-cycle lie on opposite sides of three overload rows; their midpoint
      satisfies every middle cap and is a fractional vertex of the
      perfect-matching-plus-cap polytope.  Thus a two-balanced
      one-factorization also requires correlated integer decomposition,
      not normality of the obvious cap relaxation.

      Conventional local equity is also the wrong strengthening.  Every
      one-factorization of the m=2 crown graph contains a factor with a
      non-equitable local grid, while at m=3 an explicit proper diamond
      factor has physical load three at one middle set.  Conversely a
      Johnson colouring can be locally equitable while monochromatic on an
      outer diamond.  Thus diamond properness and rectangle balance are two
      genuinely coupled marginals.

      The surviving positive routes must exploit cross-rectangle Boolean
      structure, such as a controlled alternating-cycle sequence or the
      decorated trace with gap--Hall.  Generic matroid, parity,
      polymatroid, and marginal-equitability theorems are now scoped out.

2157. Lane L has separated the arbitrary ordered four-transversal exchange
      problem from the middle-levels-resolvable subclass and proved the
      exact augmentation theorem for the latter.  On oriented diamonds the
      general problem is common independence in the lower, upper, tail and
      head partition matroids plus the physical graphic matroid.  For a
      feasible partial set, inserting atom q requires deletion of every
      occupied same-role palette blocker simultaneously and, if q closes a
      physical fundamental circuit, deletion of at least one edge on its
      unique forest path.  Thus its literal exchange object is an AND/OR
      hypergraph, not one alternating path.  A five-atom C5 restriction
      exposes the corresponding odd-circuit inequality; the stronger
      four-blocker, determinant-three and fractional-polytope no-gos remain
      those of item2156.

      For one fixed middle-levels Hamilton cycle C, however, all correlation
      collapses to one ordinary bipartite graph H_C.  Its left shore is the
      A positions plus lower-turn colours, its right shore is the B
      positions plus upper-turn colours, and its edges are the literal cycle
      incidences and the two turn-occurrence maps.  Perfect matchings of H_C
      are exactly Catalan decorations.  Hence this subclass is two partition
      matroid intersection with a TU incidence matrix.  Starting from either
      bare cycle matching, exactly P Berge augmentations between unmatched
      lower- and upper-colour vertices construct a decoration whenever one
      exists.

      Fixing the upper occurrence SDR I and contracting the resulting odd
      position paths gives exactly item2153's gap--lower-colour graph
      Gamma_I.  Thus gap Hall is the fibre of the global H_C matching, not an
      auxiliary sufficient test.  The authenticated ML(7) counterexample
      has |H_C| shore size56 and maximum matching55: its two singleton gaps
      forced by three consecutive unique upper turns see the same lower
      colour.  Both separate turn maps are nevertheless surjective.

      The residual topology has a parity normal form.  Give the literal
      cycle edges their two alternating types.  A decoration has the unique
      forbidden physical cycle exactly when its K residual cycle-edge types
      alternate cyclically.  Consequently odd K makes every decoration a
      forest.  For even K, forest existence reduces exactly to at most
      2Q(Q-1) bipartite matching tests: force an ordered same-type edge pair
      and forbid residual cycle edges on the open arc between them.  A pass
      is equivalent to those two edges being consecutive, which breaks the
      alternating-type face.

      Item2158's positive hexagon transfer has an exact matching update in
      this language.  The two augmentation graphs differ only at six

      occurrence transfers passing the local palette and fragment-boundary

      fixed-upper-SDR simple-support gap--colour forest (coalescing repeated

      edges that become parallel after contraction form a genuine two-cycle.
      This is the exact additional graphic row; transparency alone is not
      enough, as the audited new gap four-cycle on colours65,68 shows.

      This is a polynomial exact decision and augmentation theorem for a

2158. The decorated-cycle recursion lane has proved that the first ML(7)
      gap--Hall obstruction is repairable by one standard Boolean-incidence
      hexagon toggle, and has isolated the exact local invariant needed by a
      gluing recursion.  Starting from item2153's counterexample, the toggle

          (41,105),(49,57),(97,113)
             -> (41,57),(49,113),(97,105)

      gives a Hamilton cycle with explicit upper/lower representative sets
      and a spanning `Cat_4=14`-path diamond lift.  Its mark trace has a
      zero-run of length six, so it lies safely on the forest face.

      More generally, a standard six-port hexagon preserves a fixed
      decoration iff (i) the selected turn-colour multisets on its six
      vertices agree separately on both shores before and after the toggle,
      and (ii) the selected shore types at the three retained fragment
      boundaries alternate after the new pairing.  This transparent-
      hexagon test is necessary and sufficient and carries only finite local
      state.

      The same rule applies componentwise before Hamiltonization: palettes
      are globally exact, marks alternate on each factor cycle, and the
      boundary test is imposed on the three reconnected fragments.  It is
      therefore compatible with the standard cycle-factor gluing stage and
      does not assume a Hamilton cycle in advance.

      The strongest finite recursive state is leaf-peelability: the
      gap--colour graph is a balanced forest, hence has a unique matching
      recovered by leaf deletion.  Every positive decoration in the exact
      m=2,3,4 fixtures is leaf-peelable, including all1,728 decorations of
      the repaired ML(7) cycle.  This property is not automatic under a
      transparent toggle.  Delete the changed old gap edges, contract the
      remaining gap-forest components, and insert the changed new gap
      edges; leaf-peelability is preserved iff this attachment multigraph is
      loopless and acyclic.  One transparent m=4 toggle splits its144 common
      decorations exactly72/72; every failure creates one literal K2,2 gap
      cycle.  Thus the gluing tree must pass both the palette/boundary test
      and this local graphic test.

      The complete m=4 census shows both promise and the exact qualification.
      There are31 alternating hexagons,16 Hamilton outputs,10 decorable
      outputs, and exactly6 toggles admitting a decoration common to both
      sides; all six preserve the forest face.  Four transparent hexagons
      mark all six ports and two mark none.  Therefore a recursive proof may
      propagate a feasible-decoration relation plus a transparent gluing
      tree, but may not freeze an arbitrary SDR through the published
      Middle-Levels gluing schedule.

2159. The two-balanced-factorization lane has audited the exact literature
      boundary and shown that the two classical marginal theorems do not
      couple.  De Werra gives an ordinary one-factorization of the diamond
      graph, with no Johnson control.  Hilton--de Werra gives the optimal
      local `1/2` colour profile on the Johnson graph, with no diamond-shore
      properness.  The combined constraint hypergraph contains the
      determinant-two triangle, so the unimodular-hypergraph theorem does
      not specialize to their conjunction.

      The missing cap-two factorization has two exact equivalent forms.  It
      is a choice of a two-detachment `J^eta` of the Johnson graph and one
      common `d`-edge-colouring proper on both `B_m` and `J^eta`; or it is a
      clique `K_d` in the disjointness graph of cap-two perfect diamond
      matchings.  Acyclicity is an additional marked-clique requirement:
      that clique must contain at least one forest-lift factor.

      Exact small replay gives nine perfect matchings and four
      one-factorizations at m=2; one factorization has three cyclic factors,
      while the other three contain two forest factors.  At m=3 a
      two-balanced six-factorization exists with five forest factors and one
      cyclic factor.  Thus cap-two factorization is plausible but strictly
      stronger than the one-factor Catalan Linear Matching target, and no
      checked theorem supplies it.

2160. Lane K has rebased the Catalan recursion on the ordered
      four-transversal, exact gap--Hall, leaf-peelable support, and the
      boundary-linkage state of item2169.

      The matching-first Pascal theorem is exact. Splitting by one
      coordinate gives two rectangular B-edge directed path forests on A
      vertices,

          A=C(2m-1,m-1), B=C(2m-1,m-2), A-B=Cat_m,

      plus Cat_m residual inclusion edges. Each residual edge has one of
      two orientations with explicit unused-tail/unused-head constraints;
      after contracting the two internal path systems, the residual arcs
      must be acyclic. These conditions are necessary and sufficient, so a
      closed recursive state must retain the two residual colour banks,
      directed ports, and component start--end pairings.

      In the middle-levels sufficient subclass, fixing all block-internal
      representatives reduces alternation exactly to perfect matching in
      the bridge-gap versus residual-colour graph. The stronger recursive
      state makes the entire simple gap--colour support graph a balanced
      forest. Its matching is unique and leaf-peelable. For a transparent
      alternating polygon, delete lost support edges, contract the surviving
      forest, and add every distinct gained support edge: the new state is
      leaf-peelable iff this quotient multigraph is loopless and acyclic
      (parallel quotient edges count). Transparency alone does not imply
      this graphic test. The strict middle-levels incidence graph has no
      squares; its first literal local switch is the six-port hexagon.

      The semilength shell census is also exact. With

          Q=C(2m-1,m-1), P=C(2m-1,m-2), R=C(2m-1,m-3),

      the child turn banks are Q+2P+R and R+2P+Q, while two tagged parent
      copies cover only the mixed 2P bank. In the clean copied-mark
      b-block template the exterior router has exactly Q+R+b vertices per
      shore; in general its exact size is P_child-c, where c parent matched
      pairs literally survive. Thus Q+R+b is template-specific, while the
      unavoidable Q+R extreme-shell support is not.

      Nontransparent bounded switches now have an exact finite state as
      well. A factor-safe alternating 2t-circuit deletes at most t edges in
      each of the physical-incidence, upper-turn and lower-turn augmented
      categories. If the old deficiency is d, the common graph has
      deficiency at most d+3t. For any maximum common matching, a new
      decoration exists exactly when its unpaired terminals are covered by
      a complete directed vertex-disjoint augmenting linkage. From a
      decorated parent there are at most 3t terminals per shore (6t total),
      but paths may be global. Under bounded adhesion, oriented path-fragment
      signatures compose exactly by tree DP in 2^{O(a log a)} states. This
      linkage coordinate must be multiplied with, not substituted for, the
      gap-forest partition, trace/socket/voltage state, and deeper compiler
      guards. Protected occurrences must avoid both the physical circuit
      collar and the matching symmetric-difference support, or be reverified.

      On power-of-two semilengths only the complement-coherent subclass
      reduces to one upper SDR I. If Q=2s+1 and the lower SDR is J=I+s,
      physical alternation is equivalent to every cyclic gap of S=2I mod Q
      being odd. Unpaired lower SDRs remain legitimate, the bad binary-trace
      face remains, and this is not an all-m recursion.

      The exact remaining all-m gate is an accepting joint Pascal gluing
      state: populate the Q+R extreme shells, carry either a transparent
      leaf-safe decoration or the complete bounded-linkage signature, join
      exactly two physical components at each step without splitting, and
      preserve/reverify the trace/socket/voltage and deeper compiler rows.
      The m=2,3,4 data and the repaired ML(7) hexagons are authenticated
      bases only. No all-m existence, arbitrary-CLMT middle-levels
      resolution, coefficient-one consequence, or retracted GK W/2 bound
      is claimed.

2161. Lane R has closed universal forward/backward whole-cycle descent
      negatively and proved the exact compound-switch obstruction, rebased
      on items2150--2159.

      The matching-first gate is the ordered four-transversal of item2152;
      its uniform fractional point satisfies every palette, degree and
      graphic inequality, so only integral correlation is missing.  For two
      perfect diamond matchings P,P', delete the old changed lift A, retain
      F0=Psi(P)-A, insert the new lift B, and contract every component of F0
      to form Gamma.  Then, exactly,

          d_Psi(P')(x)=d_F0(x)+d_B(x),
          beta(Psi(P'))=beta(F0)+beta(Gamma).

      Hence a compound alternating exchange gives a spanning linear forest
      iff it cuts every old cycle, respects every middle capacity, and
      Gamma is loopless/acyclic (parallel pairs count).  The perfect matching
      automatically preserves both outer palettes.  Gamma acyclic means no
      new cycle; it means full acyclicity only after all old cycles are cut.

      The canonical forward/back shift claim is false at the first possible
      dimension.  An explicit m=3 perfect diamond matching has lift

          cycle 123-124-145-135-123

      plus five paths.  The C4's opposite corners 125 and134 each already
      have one retained edge.  Both canonical shifts hit each corner twice,
      raising both degrees to3.  This is the exact rectangle rule: either
      sign is safe iff both opposite corners are isolated after deleting the
      C4.  Yet the alternating square

          (12,1234),(13,1235) -> (12,1235),(13,1234)

      turns the same example into a five-path forest.  Therefore the
      obstruction is to whole-cycle shifts, not arbitrary alternating
      circuits.  At m=2 every matching whose lift contains a cycle is the
      double-transposition type and its opposite corners are isolated;
      four-cycle derangements already lift to paths.  This proves
      minimality.

      For simultaneous signed shifts, every deleted cycle vertex anchors one
      new edge.  Auxiliary multiplicity must fit the exact residual capacity
      2-d_F0(x)-1_{x in S}; after contraction, new circuits are exactly
      directed circuits among the anchors, equivalently the graphic rank
      rows on internal anchor arcs.  If all cycles are selected these rows
      are forest-equivalent; for a proper subset they only certify strict
      cycle-rank descent.

      The fixed-middle-levels subclass must additionally pass item2153's
      gap--Hall test; two turn-surjections are insufficient, and item2150's
      m=3 counterexample forbids treating arbitrary CLMT solutions as
      middle-levels-resolvable.  The negative ML(7) fixture is not absolute:
      item2158's ordinary incidence-hexagon toggle produces an explicit
      Cat_4=14-path decoration.  This repair is not transparent, since the
      source has no decoration.  From the repaired positive cycle, six
      Hamilton-toggle types have common forest decorations and are
      transparent for those supplied states.  A fixed decoration survives a
      gluing hex exactly when its selected local turn-colour multisets agree
      on both shores and the three retained-fragment boundary mark types
      alternate.

      Inside one fixed middle-levels cycle C, the remaining cap-two
      connectivity problem is now exact.  Decorations are the perfect
      matchings of the bipartite turn-augmentation graph H_C, and any two
      are joined by successively toggling the alternating circuits of their
      symmetric difference.  Every intermediate matching remains a
      decoration and has a cap-two physical lift.  If K=Cat_m is odd, every
      decoration is a forest.  If K is even, forest reachability is
      equivalent to perfect matchability of at least one same-type
      forced-pair graph H_C[p,q]; failure of all those Hall tests is the
      complete fixed-support obstruction.  The H_C circuit is a compound
      exact-factor transition, not necessarily one primitive diamond hex.

      Across a recursive gluing tree, the positive state must instead be a
      full occurrence-labelled joint SDR plus a dynamically transparent (or
      boundedly repairable) gluing relation, with a forest-parity/breaker
      row on every component.  Bottom-up pruning of these full states is
      exact; nonempty relations edge by edge do not suffice because sibling
      palette choices can demand incompatible parent states.  If
      leaf-peelability is carried, the separate contracted gap-attachment
      graph must also be loopless/acyclic.  Thus an arbitrary frozen SDR and
      arbitrary published gluing tree are both too weak.

      A genuinely positive composition theorem holds for a static bank of
      pairwise vertex-disjoint incidence hexagons.  Delete all their old
      three-edge matchings and suppose the result is a family of path atoms,
      every atom containing at least one selected occurrence of one global
      decoration D.  Record at each atom port the shore type of the first
      selected occurrence inward.  Then D decorates every point of the
      Boolean toggle cube iff each hex separately preserves both selected
      local turn-colour multisets and every possible new seam joins opposite
      recorded types.  The nonempty-atom guard is what makes these local
      rows compose.

      Topology is independent and exact.  If P_at pairs the two ports of
      each atom and N_S is the chosen old/new seam matching, then

          #components(F_S)=#cycles(P_at union N_S).

      In a free Z_h quotient the developed count is
      sum_C gcd(h,V_C).  Thus the static existence gate is one common full
      occurrence-labelled decoration in the intersection of all transparent
      faces, plus one transition cycle, primitive voltage and the physical
      parity/breaker row.  Edgewise nonempty transparent faces do not imply a
      common state; no Helly property is known.  An affine XOR interface on
      a tree is a clean sufficient special case.  More literally, if the
      bipartite incidence graph between base factor components and the
      disjoint hexagons is a connected tree, a leaf-to-root toggle order
      merges three distinct cycles at every step and ends in one Hamilton
      cycle.  A four-unmarked-position breaker inside one retained atom then
      gives the Catalan path forest.

      Item2169 supplies the exact nontransparent repair layer.  If a
      Hamilton-safe alternating 2t-circuit changes augmented trace graphs
      G->G' and the parent deficiency is e, restricting an old maximum
      matching to H=G intersect G' loses at most 3t edges.  Hence the common
      deficiency and the required augmenting-linkage width are at most
      e+3t.  In the literal simple-circuit turn graph this sharpens to
      e+2t: every deleted selected edge charges a distinct one of the 2t
      switched position vertices.  This recovers width 6 for a hexagon.

      Orient nonmatching edges left-to-right and matching edges right-to-
      left.  Perfection of G' is exactly a complete vertex-disjoint directed
      linkage between the exposed shores.  At bounded-adhesion recursive
      cuts, the exact state is the full oriented path-fragment relation, not
      the scalar deficiency or pairwise reachability.  With b adhesion
      vertices, r exposed pairs and new-edge set A, the safe parameter is
      p=b+2r+2|A| (or b+2r after A is assigned internally), with pattern
      bound 4^p p!=2^{O(p log p)}.  The paths may traverse the whole common
      graph; bounded width is not collar locality.

      This gammoid layer is carried alongside, not instead of, the
      gap-forest connectivity partition, atom boundary/parity state,
      component transition, endpoint sockets, primitive voltage and deeper
      compiler guards.  After a nontransparent linkage the same repaired
      matching must pass all of those rows; separate marginal feasibility
      does not compose.

      Once a forest is obtained, the supplied-forest connector theorem
      applies even outside the middle-levels-resolvable class.  Endpoint
      saturation plus one contracted occurrence cycle and primitive clean-H
      voltage gives the physical Hamilton closure; private guards and the
      compiler remain separate.

      If one unrestricted compound move is allowed, moving every cap-two
      matching to a forest is equivalent merely to existence of one CLMT
      forest matching, by toggling the symmetric difference of P and Q.  The
      stronger open theorem is cap-two reconfiguration connectivity outside
      one fixed middle-levels support, or constructively an accepting all-m
      joint transparent-gluing state.  No W/2 GK bound is used;
      the corrected deletion fraction is
      Delta_m/(m Cat_m)->0.356895867892....

2162. The AD trace/socket lane has translated item2153's exact gap--Hall
      decoration into literal physical occurrences and isolated the
      trace-specific stateful connector gate left open by item2155.  With

          v_(2i)=infinity+A_i,  v_(2i+1)=B_i,

          F_epsilon={v_(r-1)v_(r+1):epsilon_r=1} dotcup R_epsilon,

      edges, not a missing closure bank.

      On the forest face, R_epsilon supplies exactly one terminal residual

      marked run has even length.  Let t_C be the terminal endpoint of q_C,

      outgoing, upper-coherent closure using precisely these hosts exists

          C -> C'  iff  h_C union t_(C') = U_(C')

      has a directed Hamilton cycle.  Lower-floor service additionally
      requires the selected intersections h_C cap t_(C') to be pairwise

      There is one exact positive restricted closure.  If connector edges

      two-regular completion exists iff every maximal marked run is exactly
      11.  It is unique, is one literal Hamilton cycle, and has injective
      lower and upper connector palettes.  Since P/K=(m-1)/2, this face is
      empty for m>=4; at m=3 it forces trace (1100)^K.

      Automatic safe sockets nevertheless fail at the smallest physical
      case.  The genuine m=2 gap--Hall trace 110000 satisfies the strict run
      condition and has both possible endpoint Hamilton closures, but its
      residual socket digraph has only one direction.  Each ordinary
      closure attaches both same-upper providers to one component, so no
      closure is uniformly outgoing.  This separates decoration, forest,
      ordinary Hamilton topology and stateful palette safety exactly.

      Item2158 composes with this result but does not remove the socket
      gate.  A dynamically transparent gluing tree carries the fixed
      decoration; an exact finite boundary state carries the run condition;
      literal component endpoints/terminal hosts carry the socket graph.
      Hence the recursive sufficient state is joint alternating SDR plus a
      transparent gluing tree plus exact trace-run and endpoint-labelled
      socket state.  No arbitrary-CLMT normalization, all-m socket theorem,
      residence theorem or contiguous-OR compiler is claimed.

2164. The trace-switch lane has derived the exact component-Hall deficiency
      derivative under an arbitrary Hamilton-safe alternating circuit and
      proved that greedy short-flip descent is false.  For a supplied
      middle-levels Hamilton cycle C, the exact augmented-matching
      deficiency is

          delta(C)=max_S [lambda_C(S)-|U_C(S)|-kappa_C(S)],

      where lambda counts lower colours trapped inside the cyclic collar of
      S, U is the upper-turn palette used on S, and kappa is the number of
      cyclic components.  An alternating switch has a literal local update
      formula for each fixed S, but the new deficiency is the maximum over
      every old and newly created witness.  Thus repairing one visible Hall
      witness is not a valid potential argument.

      The first obstruction occurs in ML(7).  An explicit Hamilton cycle
      has both turn maps surjective and deficiency one, witnessed by eight
      trapped lower colours against four upper colours plus three cyclic
      components.  Exhaustive literal replay finds no Hamilton-safe C6 or
      C8 switch which lowers the deficiency: the nine safe C6 neighbours
      have deficiencies 1^7,2,3, and the 23 safe C8 neighbours have
      deficiencies 1^14,2^8,3.  There is no C4 in a middle-levels graph.
      The result is sharp in scope: eleven Hamilton-safe C10 switches repair
      the same cycle to deficiency zero, and every fixed-start unoriented
      ML(5) Hamilton cycle has deficiency zero.

      Consequently the recursive route cannot be closed by a universal
      monotone sequence of short flips.  Longer or compound switches,
      transparent gap-forest gluing, and the direct ordered-four-
      transversal route remain open; no global nonexistence statement is
      made.

2165. Lane A has isolated the first explicit integral-correlation cuts
      missing from the ordered-four-transversal relaxation and proved two
      exact positive rounding faces.  At m=2, every integral Catalan linear
      matching satisfies the reciprocal-completion cut

          x_ij+x_ji <= 1.

      The half-mixture of the double-transposition matching and the uniform
      point satisfies both matching shores, every middle cap-two row and
      every graphic inequality, but gives x_ij+x_ji=4/3.  Thus matching,
      capacity and graphic rows do not describe the projection even in the
      smallest dimension.  Suspending on a common (m-2)-core gives the
      dimension-uniform valid escape inequality

          x_(L_i,U_j)+x_(L_j,U_i) <= 1+eta_C(x).

      In the oriented atom model, an explicit lower--upper--tail non-Helly
      triangle yields z_alpha+z_beta+z_gamma<=1, and every strong odd
      resource circuit of length 2t+1 yields sum z_alpha<=t.  These are
      genuine cross-resource cuts invisible to shorewise marginal audits.

      Two exact sufficient rounding theorems survive.  If a candidate atom
      catalogue has bipartite resource-conflict graph, supports a fractional
      lower/upper-saturating and tail/head-cap-one point, and all its arcs
      increase one common middle-owner potential, bipartite stable-set
      integrality produces an acyclic ordered four-transversal.  For the
      hull of two supplied lower--upper perfect matchings and one fixed
      middle order, feasibility is exactly a 2-SAT problem on the
      alternating-component parity bits.  Simple tail/head C4 and C6 faces
      always round, while an explicit suspended C8 is the first obstruction
      in that restricted cycle class.  These are scoped rounding results,
      not an all-m existence theorem.

      The same theorem note independently integrates items2153 and2158:
      for a transparent valid factor switch, a leaf-peelable gap decoration
      remains leaf-peelable exactly when the new gap edges are loopless and
      acyclic after the common gap forest is contracted.  Equivalently its
      exact local rows are |A[W]|<=|W|-1.  Transparency supplies the perfect
      matching; forestness makes it unique and leaf-peelable.  This is a
      transfer theorem, not proof that an accepting transparent gluing tree
      exists for every m.

2167. The long-switch lane has replaced the failed old-witness potential
      by the exact common-core augmenting theorem.  For a switch C->C',
      let H be the intersection of their augmented trace graphs and let M
      be a maximum matching of H of size N-r.  Then C' is decorable iff the
      new graph contains r vertex-disjoint M-augmenting paths covering all
      exposed vertices.  Equivalently, for every left set X, the genuinely
      new neighbours outside N_H(X) must cover the common-core Hall deficit

          |N_A(X) setminus N_H(X)| >= |X|-|N_H(X)|.

      This is polynomial and exact for an arbitrary supplied long or
      compound switch; deletions are charged before augmentation.

      All eleven repairing Hamilton-safe C10 switches of the item2164
      ML(7) fixture have been classified.  Each changes fifteen augmented
      edges and reroutes a common-core deficiency between three and six by
      an explicit complete augmenting linkage.  The repair is therefore a
      synchronized packet, not a hidden one-edge correction.

      A sharp new counterexample closes the remaining naive potential.  A
      Hamilton-safe C6 strictly repairs every old maximum Hall witness, yet
      leaves deficiency one by creating a new three-position witness.  The
      same phenomenon occurs for 26 of the 83 nonrepairing safe C10
      switches.  Thus even monotone descent on all old maxima is false; the
      common-core linkage/no-new-cut row is the correct supplied-switch
      certificate.  No all-m existence theorem for an accepting switch is
      claimed.

2168. The root synthesis has separated the shortest exact implication for
      the full formula from the narrower Catalan central gate.  For the
      linear derivative D, a length W+d word A in the flat-carrier class is
      universal exactly when T=D^d A enumerates the middle rank, the short
      rows D^0 A,...,D^(d-1) A cover every lower target, and the consecutive
      unions D^q T cover every upper target.  This follows from the literal
      identity D^q T=D^(q+d) A.  Together with the proved deadline lower
      bound, any such certificate gives nu(k)=B(k).

      The Catalan Linear Matching Theorem supplies only the central
      immediate-shadow path forest.  It does not by itself supply a safe
      linear chronology, residence, deeper upper shadows, or the lower
      erosion-envelope SDR.  Its logically weakest target is therefore the
      direct ordered four-transversal; the decorated middle-levels trace is
      a constructive sufficient subclass with extra gap-Hall, trace,
      socket and voltage rows.

      Item2167 also makes every bounded gluing switch a bounded-width
      state: a 2t-circuit leaves common-core matching deficiency at most
      e+3t from an old deficiency e.  The required augmenting paths may be
      globally routed, so this is finite width rather than automatic
      locality.

      The exact single all-k statement is named Regenerative Shadow--Braid
      Existence (RSB): in every dimension construct the flat carrier and
      compiler above together with a finite protected-port state which is
      preserved by the odd-to-even and odd-to-odd Pascal braids.  The
      current leaf-transparent bulk router is the next central trace stage,
      but even its proof would still have to be coupled to sockets, deeper
      shadows and the compiler.  Thus no central sublemma is mislabeled as
      the sole missing theorem for the complete formula.

2169. The root finite-state lane has converted item2167's common-core
      matching repair into the exact recursive boundary object.  Orient
      unmatched bipartite edges left-to-right and matching edges right-to-
      left.  The maximum number of vertex-disjoint directed paths from the
      exposed left vertices to the exposed right vertices is exactly the
      maximum matching gain.  For fixed unpaired sinks the linkable source
      sets form a gammoid, namely a restriction of the strict gammoid after
      vertex splitting.  A named source--sink pairing is not one gammoid
      query.

      A Hamilton-safe alternating 2t-circuit changes at most t physical,
      t upper-turn and t lower-turn augmented edges.  Restricting a parent
      matching of deficiency e to the common graph therefore leaves
      deficiency at most e+3t.  Hence a bounded gluing polygon has an exact
      bounded-width linkage state (width at most 3t from a decorated
      parent), although its paths may still travel globally.

      For blocks glued on a tree through bounded adhesions, record every
      realizable oriented vertex-disjoint path-fragment pattern on the
      boundary.  Joining compatible patterns while rejecting repeated
      boundary use, directed cycles and illegal terminal orientations is
      necessary and sufficient.  With adhesion b and r exposed terminals
      per shore the named-terminal parameter is at least p=b+2r, and a safe
      pairing-pattern bound is 4^p p!=2^{O(p log p)}.  The entire pairing-
      resolved table is not computed by one max-flow call.  It must still be
      coupled to the gap-forest connectivity partition, trace/socket/voltage
      and deeper-shadow/compiler states; no accepting all-m tree is claimed.

2170. The physical-lift lane has combined the repaired decorated-ML(7)
      theorem, bounded common-core linkage and the supplied-forest socket
      theorem into one exact recursive state, and has closed the positive
      m=4 fixture physically.

      The forest-producing implication is now ordered correctly.  Start
      with one joint upper/lower occurrence witness: on a two-factor, the
      aggregate cyclic gap--lower-colour graph has a perfect matching iff a
      componentwise alternating lower transversal exists.  Carry that
      witness through a dynamically transparent hexagon tree, discarding
      retained fragments with empty selected subsequences and testing the
      remaining boundary types cyclically in each new component.  Terminal
      Hamiltonicity plus exclusion of the unique binary trace cycle face
      gives an exact Cat_m-path forest.  The stronger leaf-peelable
      gap-forest state is optional but has its own exact loopless/acyclic
      attachment test.

      If a 2t polygon changes representatives, at most t physical, t upper
      and t lower augmented edges change.  From parent deficiency d the
      common deficiency is therefore r<=d+3t.  Item2169's unpaired source
      relation is a gammoid, while its full boundary object is the oriented
      pairing-resolved linkage signature.  Over a supplied tree of adhesion
      b it composes exactly with named-terminal parameter p>=b+2r and safe
      pattern bound 4^p p!.  Paths may be global; this is finite width and
      exact bounded-adhesion composition, not a local-radius theorem.

      Three connectivity coordinates remain independent:

          the graphic partition of the gap forest;
          the common-core oriented linkage/gammoid signature; and
          the physical endpoint pairing, literal socket capacities and
          voltage residue.

      Transparent turn palettes automatically preserve every physical
      socket multiplicity.  With mark indicators x on the three lower hex
      vertices and y on the three upper vertices,

          deg_F(U)=1-y(U)+sum_{L in N_C(U)}x(L),
          deg_F(infinity+L)=1-x(L)+sum_{U in N_C(L)}y(U).

      Projected local palette equality forces each of x and y to be000 or
      111.  It does not preserve the forest path involution.  A literal
      transparent m=4 toggle with all six vertices unmarked preserves the
      socket profile and the same14 legal connectors, but changes their
      closure from one70-cycle to cycles of orders46 and24.  Hence circuit
      and primitive-voltage state cannot be dropped.

      Positively, the displayed decorable ML(7) cycle has a14-path physical
      forest with two isolated paths and a large exact endpoint domain.  The
      unpruned graph has28 formal ports,67 legal port pairs,60 physical seams
      and2,944 port perfect matchings.  Its unique same-component edge
      (54,58) is an immediate subtour; pruning it leaves66/59 and2,704
      matchings.  There are1,192 connected formal closures and exactly298
      distinct physical Hamilton cycles.  Exactly137 have connector colours
      injective on both shores.  One explicit14-connector closure is frozen;
      the resulting70-cycle has lower and upper colour profile1^42 2^14.

      This is a complete symmetry-broken h=1 physical m=4 base and an exact
      finite recursive formulation.  It proves no nontrivial voltage for

      trees and decoration-transparent toggles remain insufficient.

2171. The transparent-gluing lane has frozen the exact leaf-peelable collar
      state and the first obstruction to carrying only a one-bit forest
      flag.  Relative to a prepared common core, a proof-sufficient state
      consists of exact palette ownership, fragment endpoint mark types,
      the residual gap matching, the retained-core boundary-colour
      connectivity partition, and one protected trace guard per prospective
      output component.  A reconnection is accepted exactly when the local
      palettes agree on both shores, the retained marked fragments alternate
      after reconnection, the residual assignment is bijective, the
      contracted attachment multigraph is a forest, and every output
      component retains a trace breaker.  The prepared-common-core and
      future-interface hypotheses are essential for associative composition;
      physical edge-disjointness of the hexagons alone is insufficient.

      This identifies the precise graphic boundary.  If every bundle has one
      effective attachment edge, the transition is ordinary graphic-matroid
      independence.  Disjoint two-edge bundles introduce parity.  Arbitrary
      grouped bundles do not form a matroid in general, so generic two-matroid
      intersection is not the missing theorem.  A useful positive face is a
      private-socket tree: each new bundle is itself leaf-peelable through
      private colours and meets the retained nonprivate core in at most one
      component.

      The standard plane-tree fixtures have accepted exact states for
      m=2,3,4.  At m=4 the unique standard glue has a common leaf-peelable
      decoration whose attachment is the private path

          [18]-g_(19,84)-[20]-g_(21,26)-[24],

      with all six ports marked and protected per-component trace guards.
      This is a genuine positive recursive base, not an induction.  Item2172
      refutes the unmodified standard all-six private-triple continuation at
      m=5; a palette-repaired or nonstandard continuation remains open.  The
      smallest frozen general loss occurs already at m=3,
      where a transparent split creates a four-cycle in the gap graph; its
      inverse merge still has eight accepted states.  The first displayed
      Hamilton-to-Hamilton connectivity-sensitive loss is at m=4.  Thus the
      exact recursive target is a joint alternating SDR together with a
      transparent gluing tree, not separate turn surjections, an arbitrary
      frozen SDR, or an arbitrary published gluing tree.

2173. The physical socket lane has isolated the exact locality hypothesis
      which collapses item2170's unrestricted factorial routing state.  Fix
      a rooted binary refinement of the transparent gluing tree and require
      the final socket Hamilton cycle to be tree-contiguous: the components
      below each proper node form one cyclic interval.  After cutting one
      declared root connector, every node is then one directed chain.  If
      each internal node owns a private literal connector and lower-colour
      bank, its complete socket state is exactly one endpoint triple and one
      gain residue

          ((t_x,U_x),h_x,g_x).

      Bottom-up star products followed by one legal root close are necessary
      and sufficient inside this class.  Private ownership removes the
      global used-colour ledger; without tree contiguity arbitrarily many
      chains and a permutation state remain necessary.

      Primitive voltage is root-local.  For closing-gain set A(t,h) and
      interior gain g, acceptance is exactly

          (g+A(t,h)) intersect Z_q^times != emptyset.

      Any two distinct closing gains hit a unit for prime q, but not for a
      general composite quotient; q=6, A={0,1}, g=2 is an exact
      counterexample.  The physical private socket schedule composes
      orthogonally with the private gap path

          [c1]-g1-[c2]-g2-[c3],

      provided the two resource banks are disjoint or explicitly
      capacity-checked.  Neither privacy condition implies the other.  This
      theorem removes the factorial socket-state obstruction once a local
      schedule is supplied; item2172 shows that a nonstandard palette repair
      is still needed before applying it at m=5.

      reduction and a sharp finite no-go for the most tempting explicit
      conjugations.  The canonical MSW parent is upper-perfect and a
      conjugated complementary parent is lower-perfect.  Their sparse union

      equivalent to explicit Boolean fibre equations and to forced leaf
      peeling which creates no isolated vertex and leaves only even cycles.
      Every perfect matching consists of the forced edges plus one of two
      alternations on each residual cycle.  Physical validity is a separate
      cap-two condition plus acyclicity of the contraction attachment graph.

      for m=3,...,9; from m=4 onward Hall already fails.  Arbitrary coordinate
      conjugacy is stronger: all S_6/S_8 permutations give322/108
      Hall-perfect conjugates at m=3/4 and172/exactly2 physically valid
      conjugates.  The two m=4 witnesses are the fixed-anchor half-block swap
      and its reversal.  That visual rule is exceptional: its exact
      deficiencies for m=2,...,9 are

          0,1,0,14,88,279,1512,4636.

      Multiple cyclic complementary parents need respectively1,2,2,3,5
      copies merely for Hall at m=3,...,7; the displayed deterministic

2175. Lane L has put the component, gap and common-core linkage choices on
      one exact catalogue ground and located the maximal generic integral
      face.  After global palette preparation, private old-socket
      contraction and suppression of private gap trees, let each label t
      carry one factor-component edge c_t, one effective gap edge g_t and
      one source s_t in a fixed directed network with a fixed unpaired sink
      bank.  The accepted label families are exactly

          I(M_comp) intersect I(M_gap) intersect I(M_link),

      where the first two matroids are graphic and M_link is a gammoid
      restriction.  On three copied grounds this is matroid 3-parity, not
      ordinary matroid intersection.  A full pairing-resolved boundary
      signature is still richer than one gammoid; the two-source network
      a->d,b->c has unpaired rank two but cannot realize the named pairing
      (a,c),(b,d).  Item2169 has been narrowed accordingly.

      The maximal generic polynomial face has at most two nonredundant
      rows.  Private gap sockets, or an aligned injective component-to-gap
      edge image, leave ordinary graphic--gammoid intersection.  With q
      factor components, an accepted spanning tree exists exactly when

          r_comp(X)+r_link(T\X) >= q-1  for every X subseteq T.

      This is Edmonds' integral min--max theorem with a forest oracle and a
      vertex-capacitated-flow gammoid oracle.  Symmetrically, private
      linkage leaves two-graphic intersection; if all other rows are free
      and a label contributes two genuine gap edges, the surviving grouped
      problem is graphic matroid parity.

      This boundary is sharp.  Full three-row selection contains perfect
      three-dimensional matching while preserving the component-tree target:
      X-classes are parallel labels on successive edges of one path,
      Y-classes form the second graphic path and Z-classes share linkage
      sinks.  The smallest locally admissible failure has three labels and
      target two.  Its component, gap and linkage parallel pairs are
      respectively bc,ac,ab.  Every two rows have a unique rank-two common
      basis, all three have rank one, and the half vector has objective3/2
      against integer optimum1; the active 3-by-3 minor has determinant2.
      A four-label companion e,a,b,c makes e meet one distinct blocker in
      each row, so inserting e into {a,b,c} requires all three deletions;
      the product is not two-matroid intersection.

      Positively, there is a dimension-uniform private aligned-route
      theorem.  If a globally palette-prepared catalogue superposes for
      every component spanning tree, its gap images are aligned one-edge
      copies with off-core-disjoint private tree appendages, and every label
      owns one path in a globally vertex-disjoint source-to-distinct-sink
      route family, then every component spanning tree passes all three
      rows.  This is an exact all-m implication under the catalogue
      hypothesis, not existence of such catalogues.

2176. Lane AD has completed the exact normalized boundary-state theorem
      combining items2158,2162,2167 and2169.  A gluing node must carry one
      correlated relation, not independently feasible marginals, on five
      coordinates:

          decoration/common-core augmenting linkage;
          the labelled gap-forest connectivity partition;
          the strict trace-run monoid;
          the phase-indexed labelled physical path skeleton; and
          the lower-labelled socket chain-cover profile.

      For a Hamilton-safe 2t-switch, the common augmented deficiency obeys
      r<=d+3t.  With adhesion b, p=b+2r named linkage terminals give the
      safe finite bound 4^p p!=2^{O(p log p)}.  This is exact bounded-width
      composition, but the augmenting paths may be global.

      Under the no-hidden-reopening convention, the gap partition is exact
      and Myhill-minimal for declared forest additions.  The displayed
      strict-run automaton has at most44 states after shore alternation is
      carried by the decoration coordinate.  The physical state must retain
      the residual matching phase of every open unmarked fragment.  The
      unrestricted socket state consists of all disjoint chain covers; root
      acceptance is exactly one legal labelled close.  Tree contiguity
      reduces this to one chain, but is an additional sufficient subclass,
      not WLOG.

      The socket width cannot be dropped abstractly: literal Johnson path
      systems realize every permutation routing, and the n! permutation
      states are completion-distinguishable in the labelled-routing algebra.
      A J(6,3) identity/transposition pair is the smallest calibration under
      the two-path/four-edge specification.  This lower bound is not claimed
      for arbitrary trace-realizable transparent Catalan contexts.

      Item2172 supplies the first recursion-level rejection: both standard
      m=5 Hamilton outputs fail already in the decoration coordinate at
      81/84 turn colours per shore, even though one gluing tree passes both
      local all-six tests.  Thus the finite-state iff remains valid, but the
      unmodified standard private-triple induction does not produce an
      accepting state.  Palette repair or a nonstandard factor/switch must
      precede the gap/run/socket recursion.  No all-m accepting tree,
      primitive voltage, deeper-shadow, residence or compiler theorem is
      claimed.

2177. Lane A has decided the first direct ordered-four-transversal
      polyhedral question negatively and isolated one exact positive
      integral support class.

      At the minimum dimension m=2, let

          P0=(13)(24),
          P1=(1->4->3->2->1).

      Orient P0 as the physical C4

          12->14->34->23->12

      and P1 as the two directed paths

          12->13->34, 23->24->14.

      The half vector z=(P0+P1)/2 is a fractional vertex satisfying all
      lower/upper equalities, every tail/head and middle capacity, all63
      graphic rows, every reciprocal-completion row, and in fact the full
      resource-conflict stable-set polytope.  Hence it survives every strong
      odd resource-circuit cut, including circuits containing zero
      coordinates.  Four zero rows, one reciprocal row and seven independent
      assignment rows have rank12; the oriented fibre is a singleton.
      Dimension m=1 is integral.  Thus strong odd circuits plus all proved
      reciprocal suspensions are not an exact description, even at the
      first possible dimension.

      The same face exposes the first explicit mixed completion--graphic
      cut.  With S=P0 union P1 and Eesc=E(B2)-S, every integral Catalan
      linear matching obeys

          sum_(e in P0) x_e <= 2 sum_(e in Eesc) x_e.

      If there is no escape, the alternating support has only P0/P1 and
      graphic acyclicity forces P1; with an escape, the two reciprocal rows
      bound the left side by2.  The fractional vertex has profile(2,0) and
      violates the row.  This proves that the next facet species must mix
      resource completion with graphic state; resource-only clique/odd
      closure cannot suffice.

      Positively, a weight-N fractional atom catalogue rounds whenever its
      resource-conflict graph is perfect, every conflict clique is contained
      in one resource fibre, and all arcs increase one common middle-owner
      potential.  Perfect-graph STAB integrality gives a stable set of size
      N, and the potential makes its physical lift a forest.  For each
      coordinate c, the sector

          C_c={(L;c,b)}

      is an exact rank-two/TU instance: its resource matrix is the duplicated
      node-edge matrix of the m-regular bipartite inclusion graph between
      ranks m-1,m on Omega-{c}.  It has an integral physical matching of
      size C(2m-1,m-1) in every dimension.  This is a genuine nontrivial
      all-m catalogue, but only a sector.  Outer eligibility requires at
      least m sectors, while every union of at least three sectors contains
      an induced C5; hence every raw outer-covering sector union is
      nonperfect for m>=3.  On the natural atom ground the full matrix also
      has a suspended determinant-3 minor, a nonconformal triangle, a C5
      two-matroid obstruction and conflict treewidth at least m(m+1)-1.
      These do not exclude a nonlocal gadget lift.

      The Chung--Feller/conjugate test is also exact.  The phase-preserving
      group H_m shares one strict phase potential.  Its uniform G-orbit
      average saturates the upper shore and respects tail/head capacity;
      lower saturation is equivalent to

          sum_(L in O) mu_m(L)=|O|

      on every G-orbit O.  This already fails for the full H_3 average at
      the fixed lower resource {1,6}.  For every m>=3 the full H_m catalogue
      contains an explicit three-atom conflict clique, so it is not
      bipartite.  The full S_(2m) orbit contains both directions of every
      atom and has no strict potential.  Reorienting by one global
      coordinate order is a different catalogue; an exact 5601-state DP
      gives two solutions at m=2 and none at m=3.  Thus any positive common
      potential must be middle-owner-dependent.  Item2174's two-parent
      census is consistent with, but logically separate from, these
      all-m orbit obstructions.

      The precise surviving direct gate is a symmetry-broken atom catalogue
      with total fractional weight N, a middle-owner-dependent common
      potential, and either perfect/conformal (or balanced) conflict support,
      or a genuinely mixed resource--graphic extended formulation.  No such
      all-m global catalogue or lift is proved.

2178D. The direct algebraic lane has produced a noncancelling determinant
      enumerator for Catalan linear matchings.  For an ordered atom set I,
      let Lambda,V,H,T be the lower, upper, head and tail indicator matrices
      and C=T-H.  At cardinality N the product

          det(Lambda_I^*Lambda_I)
          det(V_I^*V_I)
          det(H_I^*H_I)
          det(T_I^*C_I)

      is exactly one iff I is an ordered Catalan linear matching and zero
      otherwise.  With distinct heads and tails, the last matrix is I-P for
      a partial permutation P; its determinant is one on directed paths and
      zero exactly when a directed cycle occurs.  Thus there is no sign
      cancellation.  Equivalently, the positive solution enumerator is the
      degree-N four-fold coefficientwise Hadamard product of three partition
      determinant polynomials and one nonsymmetric directed-forest
      determinant polynomial.  CLMT is exactly nonvanishing of this explicit
      multiaffine polynomial.

      Two standard algebraic shortcuts are now sharply excluded.  Global arc
      reversal pairs every solution, so an orientation-blind characteristic-
      two parity specialization vanishes.  More strongly, the directed-
      forest determinant factor itself is not real-stable already on a valid
      m=2 directed Johnson triangle: the specialization is
      1+x+y+z+xy+yz+zx, whose diagonal 1+3t+3t^2 has discriminant -3.
      The final positive support also fails basis exchange.  Thus a direct
      PSD determinant/Gurvits capacity proof is blocked even before, and
      again after, the Hadamard intersection.  The
      audit finds exactly24 positive terms among6^4 lower-complete ordered
      selections at m=2, counts458,544 undirected and9,549,888 ordered
      solutions at m=3, and replays one positive m=4 term.  The identity is
      all-m; its nonvanishing is still open.

      resource footprints.  On the through-strand face this reduces exactly
      to Z_h^s semidirect S_s; outside that face caps, cups and sealed cycles
      require the full pairing state.  This socket state remains a correlated
      coordinate alongside, not a replacement for, the gap partition and

      final relay.  Along either path the occurrence debt is3->2->1->0.
      At a prefix whose only obstructions are isolated defect banks of size
      d, there is no hidden debt iff deleting those banks leaves a perfect
      matching, equivalently rank N-d or the corresponding residual Hall
      inequalities.  These are layerwise flows; imposing nested matchings
      across time would be an unwarranted recourse constraint.  Only the
      terminal210/210 state is decorated.  Its common root/final rank197
      and thirteen augmenting paths discharge the macro debt before any
      downstream matroid is formed.

      This distinguishes routers from fixed-decoration transparent moves.
      The authoritative ML(7) criterion says a hex preserves one fixed D
      exactly when its selected local turn-colour multisets agree separately
      on both shores and its retained-fragment boundary mark types alternate
      after reconnection; leaf peeling adds the loopless/acyclic contracted
      gap-attachment test.  The exact31/16/10/6 census (alternating,
      Hamilton, decorable, common-fixed-D) proves that redrawing an SDR is
      not transparency.  Thus the recursive object is a joint alternating
      SDR plus transparent gluing tree, after an atomic debt-carrying router
      has terminated.

      Contracting the accepted router gives repaired components of orders
      120,132 and the preaccepted ground T={g0,g1}.  On the conservative
      target-one spanning-tree restriction, the component matroid is
      U_(1,2); the exhaustive gap cube is private/free and the compiled
      residual linkage quotient is U_(2,2).  Edmonds' four sums are

          2,2,2,1,

      tight only at X=T, so there is no violating rank partition and both
      singletons are bases.  The exact end-to-end choice is {g1}.  Its own
      replay, not the bonus two-glue closure, gives a210-edge exact-palette
      J(10,5) forest with42 paths and a42/42 colour-injective connector
      matching closing one252-cycle.  The literal h=1 voltage is vacuous.
      The resulting1^168 2^42 profile is multiplicity cap two only: just15
      lower and11 upper doubled connector/forest pairs share a middle
      vertex.  Block coherence and a uniform-outgoing compiler are not
      certified.

      The full cube has an extra Hamilton-safe dependent state {g0,g1}, so
      U_(1,2) is an exact existence restriction, not a characterization of
      every safe subset.  The private objects proved here are gap-owner
      paths.  No global minimum-three-C10 or all-m router theorem is claimed.
      For selected {g1}, deeper shadows, residence and the compiler remain
      unaudited.  The separate full-state audit proves all-depth flag support
      but an immutable31-run depth-two residence obstruction; it does not
      transfer automatically to {g1}.

      The uniform target is therefore not a constant-size packet.  It is an
      ordered controlled-debt packet of bounded-port circuits whose total
      length may grow, while only the live boundary and linkage debt are
      bounded, followed by an ordered fixed-D transparent leaf-peelable
      gluing list.  Item2184 proves why this boundary state is algebraically
      necessary: two full parent determinant sectors already force a cycle,
      and exact contraction must remember both residual acyclicity and the
      absence of an H->T path.  Item2183 proves that an interior rethread,
      not another endpoint permutation, is mandatory for residence at the
      first repaired base.

2186. Lane R has proved and independently audited the exact
      controlled-debt repair-packet selection theorem at the
      palette/matching/topology interface.

      For an augmented occurrence graph A_S on shores of order N, with
      h_-,h_+ actual isolated palette-hole vertices, define

          b(S)=max(h_-(S),h_+(S)),
          xi(S)=N-nu(A_S)-b(S).

      Here xi is the exact correlation debt beyond the forced palette floor.
      A controlled packet has bounded xi, bounded named port/terminal
      adhesion and bounded common-core transition linkage at every literal
      prefix; packet cardinality may grow.  On a support-disjoint unit/unit
      bank, exact selection factors into occurrence Hall flows, a
      support-disjoint lower/upper compatibility matching, a safe maximal
      chain in the port-pairing subset automaton, and one guarded terminal
      linkage.  For overlapping or multi-service circuits, the exact general
      criterion is reachability in the layered state graph

          (remaining lower jobs, remaining upper jobs, used/stage U, sigma),

      where sigma is Markov-sufficient: it determines xi, the full named
      port-pairing/reachability relation, boundary adhesion and every labelled
      transition linkage width.  U has a declared finite acyclic progress
      order.  An arc must service a job or strictly advance U, so q1-neutral
      interior rethreads are represented without inventing palette progress.
      Initial-state bounds are mandatory.  An
      atomic block may defer matching acceptance, but every internal literal
      circuit and its palette/topology/protection rows remain fail-closed and
      the block exports the maximum internal widths.

      Static Hall alone is sharply insufficient.  A 2x2 job/resource fixture
      has a feasible half-vector but no integral macro matching; arbitrary
      grouped banks contain 3DM.  A separate 3x3 fixture shows two
      endpoint-disjoint macro edges can each gain one matching rank while
      their union still gains only one.  Topology is also independent: the
      exact criterion is a safe subset-chain, reducing to an Euler trail only
      under a context-independent Markov relay hypothesis.

      The m=5 packet calibrates the theorem exactly.  Its safe selectors are
      000,001,010,011,111, giving the two orders C1,C2,C3 and C2,C1,C3.
      Prefix matching debts equal the forced hole floors 3,2,1,0, so xi=0;
      the atomic source/final common core has rank197/210 and linkage width13.
      Thus it calibrates w=0, ell=13; no numerical boundary adhesion a is
      claimed without choosing a named-port convention.  The later fixed-D
      glues are a different zero-debt move class: exact transparency is the
      two separate local turn-multiset equalities plus alternation of the
      nonempty retained-fragment boundary types.  The authoritative ML(7)
      31/16/10/6 census confirms that an ordinary repair toggle need not be
      fixed-decoration transparent.

      The K17 common-exterior bank supplies two exact nonterminal state arcs.
      Serial3836 has

          4134=3826+308 -> 4130=3822+308,

      with six common-core augmentations and topology11->9.  Serial919 has

          4134=3826+308 -> 4131=3824+307,

      with four augmentations.  They prove literal excess-neutral and strict
      excess-descent transitions, respectively, but not a complete chain.
      Any path starting at this source needs w>=308, so a uniform bounded-
      width recursion still needs a separately certified bootstrap block.

      This aligns exactly with items2183-2184.  The synchronized m=5 endpoint
      has complete all-depth flag support but intact-path residence is
      impossible because of31 internal length-two one-runs.  Item2188
      supplies a q1-exact residence-clean interior rethread, so central
      residence is not intrinsic.  It still owes21 deeper targets, and
      item2190 proves its fixed path bodies have no endpoint-only resident
      joining.  A further joint interior/socket actuator is therefore
      mandatory on that face.  The Pascal determinant no-go forces
      boundary-deficient rails and an H-to-T reachability state; two scalar
      full-parent solutions cannot be spliced.  The exact remaining existence
      theorem is therefore a uniformly bounded Markov-sufficient
      port/linkage/reachability state and a macro bank whose state graph has a
      complete repair path.  No all-m supply theorem is claimed.

2187R. The root residence lane has proved the exact all-m coordinate-run
      ledger for Catalan linear matchings and their physical seams.

      Let F be a Catalan path forest in J(2m,m), with

          M=C(2m,m), N=C(2m,m-1), K=M-N=Cat_m.

      For each coordinate x, the induced forest on middle sets containing x
      has C(2m-1,m-1) vertices and C(2m-1,m-2) edges: the latter are exactly
      the once-used lower colours containing x.  Their difference is K.
      Hence every coordinate has exactly K runs and the total is2mK.

      Every Johnson seam joining two current path components merges exactly
      the m-1 runs belonging to its common coordinates.  After c seams the
      total run count is therefore

          2mK-(m-1)c.

      A Hamilton path has (m+1)K+m-1 runs.  A cyclic closure has (m+1)K
      runs and total one-mass mM=m(m+1)K, so its average positive-run length
      is exactly m.  Since the compiler threshold is d+1=Theta(sqrt(m)),
      residence has a linear-factor aggregate margin; the open problem is
      redistribution, not capacity.

      Literal m=5 replay gives42 runs per coordinate/420 total in the
      42-path forest,252 runs of average5 in the colour-injective cyclic
      closure, and76 short cyclic runs.  The known optimal k=10 word has a
      depth-two Hamilton carrier with exactly256 runs, matching the path
      formula, and no short internal run.  Thus the desired distribution is
      attained at m=5, but not by intact-path ordering of the synchronized
      forest.  Item2188 now supplies an independently replayed exact-palette
      42-path forest with zero internal residence defects.  It changes119
      matching partners and still owes21 deeper targets plus endpoint
      joining; this finite result is not promoted to an all-m theorem.

2189A. Lane A has formulated the item2183 interior-rethread problem as an
      exact integral object and separated its rigid, integral and genuinely
      correlated layers.

      Pointwise preservation of the joint rank-(m-1)/rank-(m+1) diamond
      matching permits no interior move: the atom (L,U) has the unique
      Johnson lift

          {L+a,L+b},  where U-L={a,b},

      with inverse (X intersect Y,X union Y).  The nontrivial relaxation must
      preserve the two palettes and declared occurrence ports while allowing
      the pairing to change.  For a prescribed deleted matching set R,
      palette completion is exactly Hall in the residual diamond graph;
      owner degrees are exact incidence equations, and physical acyclicity
      is exactly the loopless/acyclic test after contracting F-psi(R).

      The31 old internal 0110 defects form three-edge intervals on the42
      path lines.  Their exact packing and transversal numbers are

          nu=tau=29.

      Only two interval pairs overlap.  Hence every residence rethread
      deletes at least29 old decorated edges and, by palette exactness, adds
      at least29: matching/physical symmetric difference is at least58.  For
      any undeletable edge set Q, deleting its columns preserves
      consecutive-ones total unimodularity, giving the exact integral
      protected-edge packing/covering dual tau_Q; it is infeasible exactly
      when one defective span is wholly protected.

      This floor is not an obstruction to residence.  Item2188's matching
      changes119 partners and satisfies every old-hit and no-new-010/0110
      row.  It leaves the exact two-sided depth-aligned debt list

          13 upper + 8 lower = 21.

      Fixing this matching reduces the central chronology exactly to a
      permutation of42 components, orientations of the nonsingletons, and41
      Johnson seams between consecutive exposed ports.  A position/arc
      0-1 formulation enforces the Hamilton chronology, exact palettes,
      occurrence identities, every depth-aligned flag witness and internal
      residence.  Appending254 nonempty source cells with clipped envelope
      containment, D^2A=T rows and one/two-cell lower-target witnesses gives
      the exact unrestricted common compiler COMP_2(T), not rankwise Hall.
      Thus the remaining two-sided gate is one integral solution of all
      these rows with the item2188 matching fixed.

      For bare equality the service list is smaller: arbitrary-width upper
      replay has12 holes (10 rank7,2 rank8).  The thirteenth depth-aligned
      upper debt1007 already has internal witness

          460,397,271,79,590,844,868

      on component4.  The eight lower-intersection debts likewise belong to
      the stronger two-sided flag face.

      Finally, scalar protected run slack is not sufficient even locally.
      In a protected Johnson slice C+binom(Lambda,s), a successor retaining
      all active deadlines A exists exactly when |A|<=s-1.  Two coordinates
      may separately have arbitrarily long continuation while the saturated
      mixed set A=Q has none.  Under a private commuting repair-port bank,
      the exact positive theorem is instead capacitated Hall.  Together with
      item2187R, this shows aggregate average run length m is ample but an
      all-m theorem must control mixed deadlines, alternating palette
      reachability, physical topology, flags and COMP_d on one chronology.

2189. Lane L has closed the ordering implication which remained between the
      repaired private graphic--gammoid selection theorem and an executable
      fixed-decoration gluing chronology.  This strengthens item2186 only
      at the chronology/boundary-state interface; it does not duplicate its
      upstream repair theorem.

      Let a zero-debt repaired entrance have q components and one fixed,
      occurrence-labelled decoration D.  Freeze one complete correlated
      signature per later collar.  Assume the full permitted Boolean
      interval is D-transparent under the exact two-shore local-multiset and
      retained-fragment boundary-type tests; physical components are exactly
      the blocks of the selected component-edge forest; gap atoms form one
      globally rooted-private old/new cube, or have one effective edge
      aligned with the component edge; and occurrence sources lie in one
      fixed unpaired-sink gammoid.  Finally require root directed acyclicity
      and, at every common-independent prefix, passive-prefix safety plus

          no current H_t -> T_t path before adding T_t -> H_t.

      Under these prefix-closed hypotheses, an ordered component-spanning
      fixed-D transparent list exists iff

          r_C(X)+r_L(T-X) >= q-1                  for every X subset T.

      Edmonds supplies a common independent spanning tree.  Every ordering
      of every such tree is executable: each prefix joins two actual factor
      components, the same D survives, the occurrence-gap graph is a forest
      with its carried perfect matching and hence leaf-peels uniquely, a
      single simultaneous linkage restricts to every prefix, and the
      directed support remains acyclic.  A rooted leaf-edge order or its
      reverse is therefore a deterministic valid list.

      Reachability is load-bearing.  For strict boundary relation rho, one
      legal arc T->H updates it by

          rho' = rho union {(x,y): x rho* T and H rho* y}.

      With q=3, component edges a=01,b=12, private gaps and free linkage,
      every Edmonds sum is2.  Directed atoms a:x->y and b:y->x are each
      root-safe, but whichever is second closes a directed two-cycle.  This
      is the smallest ordering-only failure among root-safe instances which
      satisfy the rank rows.  The lightweight replay exhausts all four rank
      partitions and both orders.

      Relative to universal compatible boundary continuations, the lean
      proof-sufficient correlated collar state has fields

          (delta_boundary, theta_fragment, pi_component,
           pi_gap, mu_gap, Lambda_linkage, rho_reachability).

      Here mu_gap is the exact exposed partial mate relation, not one bit,
      and Lambda_linkage retains named pairings when required.  On the
      prepared face, fixed D, the selected-prefix control, private/aligned
      gaps and the fixed gammoid collapse the active selection problem back
      to the two Edmonds ranks.  A fixed finite catalogue may admit a smaller
      completion-equivalence quotient.  Hidden future deletions, multiple
      effective boundary arcs, predecessor-rooted moves or unresolved
      per-label alternatives restore a deletion-response, reachability-
      router/greedoid, or third partition/grouped row.

      Items2187R--2188 supersede the former interpretation of residence as
      an intrinsic central obstruction: aggregate run margin is all-m, and

2189K. Lane K has proved the quantitative capacity and bounded-live-debt
      theorems for the all-m repair/rethread-bank architecture.

      Put n=2m-1, N_m=C(n,m-1)=n Cat_(m-1),
      s=3^v3(n), h=n/s, and H=Z_h.  Missing turn colours have only free and
      stabilizer-three translation orbits.  Their clean-track counts are

          B_- = s f_-+(s/3)e_-,
          B_+ = s f_++(s/3)e_+.

      A clean-track router needs exactly B_-=B_+, equivalently
      3f_-+e_-=3f_++e_+.  Typewise equality is needed only for a
      full-Z_n type-preserving packet.  If a C10 seed uses five distinct
      H-orbits per middle rail, its h translates are disjoint.  For a fixed
      private/socket reserve S, every equivariant bank satisfies the sharp
      orbit-slot cut

          5B+rho_H(S_epsilon) <= N_m/h
                                  = s Cat_(m-1).

      Raw private cardinality is not a substitute for rho_H.  A proved
      candidate-pressure condition is also supplied: after ordering clean
      track jobs x_i, let Delta_(i,e) be the maximum number of candidates
      for x_i using one quotient rail slot.  If

          |Z_i| > 5(i-1)(Delta_(i,0)+Delta_(i,1))

      for every i, greedy choice gives a literal rainbow quotient matching,
      hence hB disjoint physical circuits.  The complete stabilizer-three
      bank occupies the vanishing quotient fraction

          (5/3) Cat_a/Cat_(m-1),

      while free defects have the exact raw ceiling f<=Cat_(m-1)/5.

      Residence has an unconditional all-m surplus.  Every coordinate has
      Cat_m runs in a Catalan path forest; every component-joining Johnson
      seam merges exactly m-1.  A cyclic joining has (m+1)Cat_m runs and
      average positive-run length m.  For floor h_0,

          surplus_(h_0)-deficit_(h_0)
             =(m-h_0)(m+1)Cat_m.

      Thus h_0=d+1=Theta(sqrt(m)) has large aggregate margin.  General
      rethreads nevertheless require two distinct ledgers.  After freezing
      the turn packet, let d_Z be source-old edges deleted, s_(Z,e) the
      full typed physical footprint, and g_Z the ordered marginal
      short-run gain.  Every strictly separated bank obeys

          sum_Z g_Z=R,
          sum_Z d_Z>=tau_S>=tau,
          5D+sum_Z s_(Z,e)+r_e<=N_m.

      The identity d_Z=s_(Z,0)=s_(Z,1)=t_Z holds only for a simple
      rail-balanced circuit without collars.  Overlapping macros are
      charged exactly by marginal union footprints, not summed abstract
      half-lengths.

      At m=5, the frozen source has tau=29.  Its 54-vertex turn/private
      reserve meets 10 of 31 spans and locks exactly two, so tau_S=infinity:
      a strictly reserve-disjoint rethread is impossible.  This is
      architecture-specific, not intrinsic.  Item2188's independently
      replayed 119-partner endpoint has a 30-cycle diamond-colour symmetric
      difference, preserves both immediate palettes and the 42-path forest,
      and removes all 31 internal residence defects.  No accepted physical
      intermediate-switch trace is claimed.  It overlaps/reconfigures the
      frozen geometry.  Its exact remaining debt
      is 21 deep targets.  Item2190 further proves that the fixed 42 path
      bodies cannot be joined residently by endpoint seams alone: one
      component has two dead pair-safe sockets, and the two forced collars
      cannot both be opened without isolating a 2-cycle.  A further
      interior/socket actuator is therefore necessary.

      Finally, one joint bounded-treewidth interaction graph gives an exact
      controlled-debt DP.  The boundary state carries the common matching
      and terminals, factor pairings, gap perfect matching/forest,
      directed reachability, trace/voltage automata, residence collars with
      an all-same-run bit, private pins and all still-mutable deep witnesses.
      With width w and local alphabet A_m the state count is

          A_m^O(w) 2^O(w^2) (d+2)^O(w).

      The serial orbit specialization has live boundary at most2w+p and bag
      size omega=b+3w+p, independent of packet length for uniform b,w,p.
      Exact bounded-interface block transitions are an alternative to
      bounded treewidth; bounded adhesion alone is not.

      The remaining all-m lemma is constructive, not scalar: build an
      aligned clean-track atlas satisfying the quotient rainbow matching
      after true private-orbit exclusions, redistribute runs with typed
      sublinear footprint, create pair-safe sockets, cover the residual deep
      targets during a residence-compatible connector chronology, and carry
      all resources through one bounded frontier to the ordered
      fixed-decoration gluing entrance of item2189.  No all-m atlas,
      coefficient-one conclusion or equality theorem is claimed.
