2191. Thread D has converted the all-m residence margin into an exact
      integral redistribution gate and independently closed the fixed-body
      endpoint face of item2188.

      The seam identity has the coordinatewise refinement

          R_x=Cat_m-s_x,

      and the final runs of one spanning Hamilton closure are exactly the
      weighted components of the run-atom forest.  This yields exact lazy
      connector cuts: every atom set of total weight below h must have one
      selected x-common seam leaving it.  There is also a formulation before
      the path components are fixed.  For nonempty S inside the x-containing
      owners, let i_x(S) count selected edges internal to S and t_x(S) count
      selected edges which toggle x out of S.  A simple spanning linear forest
      has no strictly internal x-run of length below h iff, for every |S|<h,

          3 i_x(S)+t_x(S) <= 3|S|-2.

      The uniform diamond fractional perfect matching satisfies every such
      row for h<=m+1 and has middle load2m/(m+1)<2.  Thus even the full family
      of internal-run cuts has no fractional capacity obstruction at
      h=Theta(sqrt m); the missing correlation is integral.

      For an inherited forest, every short run has a closed edge span.  The
      minimum rethread support hitting all spans equals the maximum number of
      pairwise edge-disjoint spans by interval min-max, path by path.  After
      such a hit, every new short run crosses an inserted-edge collar.  For
      an exact removed support R, palette restitution is Hall in the
      diagonal-deleted compatibility graph B_R^-, but an actual rethread is
      obtained iff one matching also passes middle degree at most two,
      graphic acyclicity and every collar row.  A determinant-two owner minor
      for m>=3 shows that this natural master matrix is not uniformly TU; it
      is a class-level no-TU statement, not an LP-gap theorem.

      On the item2183 equality face the interval floor is not physically
      attainable.  The29 groups have84 candidate deleted edges and427
      loopless palette arcs.  The exact owner-degree-at-most-two relaxation
      has511 variables/15154 clauses and is proof-producing UNSAT before
      acyclicity.  Thus every two-palette-exact internally clean Catalan path
      forest changes at least30 matching partners.  Item2188 supplies one at
      support119, giving the scoped central bracket

          30 <= s_int <= 119.

      This does not assert feasibility at30 or endpoint/deep/compiler
      compatibility at119.

      On item2188, the solver-free fourteen-locked-component and two-dead-
      socket certificates in item2190 are primary.  Thread D independently
      certified the stronger relaxation with no connectivity, palette or
      deep-target rows: the exact port CNF has472 variables/10619 clauses and
      is UNSAT.  Kissat emitted proof SHA04f1def8; drat-trim extracted and
      reverified a68-clause/12-lemma core (core/proof SHAs fffc31f7/b0a20e5d).

      The complete connector oracle must retain histories, not single seams.
      The exact fixed-width q+1 flag transducer composes capped literal
      prefixes/suffixes.  The separate arbitrary-width compiler oracle carries
      active suffix-union ideals A_T^+ and suffix-intersection filters A_T^-

2191R. Lane R has strengthened the all-m residence ledger coordinatewise and
      isolated the exact joint rethread/connector theorem, with independent
      audit.

      Let K=Cat_m and let s_x count selected cyclic Johnson seams whose
      common intersection contains coordinate x.  Coordinate x then has
      exactly K-s_x cyclic positive runs and total positive mass

          n_x=C(2m-1,m-1)=(m+1)K/2.

      At residence floor h, define short-run deficit D_x and long-run excess
      E_x.  The exact identity is

          E_x-D_x=n_x-h(K-s_x).

      Hence cyclic h-residence needs

          s_x >= K-floor(n_x/h)

      for every x, and summing gives

          sum_x(E_x-D_x)=(m+1)K(m-h).

      For a Hamilton path, if b_x is the number of word endpoints containing
      x, the exact necessary endpoint correction is

          s_x >= K-b_x-floor((n_x-b_x)/h).

      These rows are scalar necessities, not distribution theorems.

      The immediate-palette rethread row also has an exact form.  Index upper
      colours by a source perfect diamond matching.  A set S is exactly the
      changed lower-row support of another perfect diamond matching iff the
      nonloop inclusion graph on two copies of S satisfies Hall.  Physical
      internal h-residence is then equivalent to three additional rows:
      the Johnson lift has degree at most two, is acyclic, and contains no
      full final-graph collar

          X_0,...,X_(ell+1),  1<=ell<h,

      on which some coordinate is absent at both ends and present at every
      internal vertex.  The final-graph qualification is essential: a
      collar may cross several inserted seams.

      There is an unconditional all-m palette-level positive result.  Every
      row and column of the complete diamond graph has
      D=C(m+1,2) incidences.  Removing an arbitrary source perfect matching
      leaves a balanced (D-1)-regular graph, so for m>=2 it has a perfect
      matching.  Hence one may change every source row and hit every old
      short-run collar simultaneously.  The surviving central obstruction
      is entirely in cap two, graphic acyclicity and newly created collars,
      not in immediate-palette restitution.  The sole exception is m=1.

      For a fixed residence-clean forest, endpoint joining and all-depth
      support are exactly one component-order transducer.  It retains the
      used components/orientations, the fully composed coordinate-run
      monoid, the last m middle masks, and every still-uncovered labelled
      lower/upper target.  A marked linear cut is part of the state: at
      depth q it removes exactly q cyclic windows, and a cut of type11
      splits one cyclic run into two exempt boundary arms.  Pairwise
      safe-port Hall is exact only when every component has length at least
      h; short all-one fragments can relay a run across multiple seams.

      The item2188 m=5 matching calibrates the central theorem: exact q1
      palettes, a210-edge/42-path forest, no internal run below3,119 changed
      partners, and21 deeper debts.  A lightweight independent port census
      gives84 occurrence ports,304 formal/293 physical Johnson pairs,
      608 directed Johnson arcs and114 strong one-seam-safe arcs.  Four q2
      debts have no provider in that sufficient one-seam submodel.  The
      stronger item2190 certificate proves endpoint-only joining of the
      fixed bodies impossible by two forced edge-disjoint collars; it is not
      a no-go to another interior/socket rethread.

      The exact recursive state must therefore carry one correlated product:
      occurrence/linkage debt, path pairing and sockets, Pascal reachability,
      the run monoid, last-m owner tail and all-depth debt, the current
      decoration and its transition debt, and compiler/common-Q.  q1-neutral
      rethreads advance an independent
      finite acyclic stage coordinate.  The sharp open supply lemma is a
      q1-exact cap-two/graphic/forbidden-collar rethread plus a bounded-live-
      interface interior actuator and connector chronology accepted by this
      same all-depth state, ending with one exact exported decoration for
      the later transparent list, followed by the common-Q compiler matching.
      Packet size may grow.  No all-m physical rethread/connector construction, footprint bound,
      Pascal-preservation theorem or coefficient-one conclusion is claimed.

      factor-component edges and let N be the fixed linkage router.  For a
      router-vertex set Y, retain exactly those collar labels whose sources
      still reach the sink bank in N-Y, obtaining K_Y.  A common
      graphic--gammoid spanning tree, hence an ordered fixed-D transparent
      component-spanning list, exists iff

      This follows by substituting the vertex-Menger rank formula
      r_L(S)=min_Y(|Y|+|S cap T_Y|) into the matroidal spanning-tree
      partition criterion.  A triangle whose three sources share one router
      bottleneck is the minimal warning that ordinary component connectivity
      is insufficient.

      An all-six-marked incidence hexagon is fixed-decoration transparent
      exactly when its three lower ports have one common external insertion
      label d and its three upper ports have one common external deletion
      label e.  Boundary alternation is automatic.  The two selected owner
      palettes are the forced three-cube faces

          H+d+{ab,bc,ca},   (H-e)+{a,b,c}.

      A prescribed port set extends to one joint alternating SDR iff its
      forced colours are distinct and some upper-turn transversal puts at
      most one forced upper-shore port in each cyclic gap, after which
      deleting those forced gaps and colours leaves a perfect residual
      gap--colour matching.  Thus a coherent component tree plus this one
      forced-port Hall row and router resilience yields the complete
      prepared transparent-gluing implication; local transparency is no
      longer an independent search constraint.

2193. The connector/run-redistribution lane now has an exact linear collar,
      exact endpoint ledger, and two complementary connector min--max
      theorems, together with a sharp obstruction to testing their
      projections independently.

      For residence threshold `h=d+1`, an oriented path fragment is described
      coordinatewise by capped prefix and suffix one-run lengths
      `lambda_x,rho_x` and the all-fragment bit `omega_x`.  Concatenating
      fragments `P,Q` is internally residence-safe exactly when, for every
      coordinate `x`,

          rho_x(P)+lambda_x(Q)=0,

      or one fragment is all one in `x`, or that sum is at least `h`.  The
      collar update is associative.  Dropping the all-fragment exemption
      gives a context-robust sufficient seam relation.  Adding the first and
      last `r` literal vertices and a served-target bitset gives an exact
      associative collar for every prescribed shadow debt of depth at most
      `r`.

      A Catalan path forest with `K=Cat_m` components uses exactly `K-1`
      connector seams in a Hamilton path, and has exactly `2m` positive
      boundary runs.  No wrap window exists.  On occurrence-labelled ports,
      a seam set is one spanning path exactly when it is a port matching of
      size `K-1` and its component contraction is connected; precisely two
      ports remain as the global endpoints.  The exact port-only relaxation
      is therefore the Tutte--Berge row

          o(R-U) <= |U|+2  for every port set U,

      where `+2`, rather than the cyclic `+0`, is the endpoint allowance.

      After enumerating and contracting a bounded service core, the exact
      preoriented acyclic completion criterion is Hall deficiency one,

          |N^+(X)| >= |X|-1  for every block set X.

      With prescribed start `s` and end `t`, this becomes the ordinary
      perfect-matching Hall row on `L=V-{t}` and `R=V-{s}`.  For debts whose
      witnesses cross one residual seam, assigning each debt to its seam
      head gives the exact partition--Hall min--max

          max_psi min_X (|L-X|+|N_{G_psi}(X)|)=|L|.

      One seam may service an entire assigned fibre.  A bounded bank of
      multi-seam debts reduces by enumerating a service core using at most
      the sum of the debt depths in seams.  A bipartite Dirac filler after
      `p` reserved, tail/head-disjoint service arcs is sufficient once the
      residual minimum degree is at least `ceil((n-p)/2)`.

      Off that preoriented face, an exact polynomial theorem is available on
      the prepared private-socket face only.  If a genuine gammoid represents
      the joint port-disjoint traversal/linkage choices, Edmonds' condition

          r_graphic(X)+r_linkage(E-X) >= q-1

      is necessary and sufficient for a spanning linear path through `q`
      service macroblocks with two prescribed endpoint ports.  General
      two-port seam matchings are not a matroid.  On item2189's
      private/aligned/reachability-redundant face, item2192 sharpens the same
      statement: the *same* label set must form a component tree, pass the
      forced-port residual gap--Hall matching, and satisfy router resilience
      `c(K_Y)<=|Y|+1`.  Only then does the ordered fixed-decoration theorem
      apply.  The repaired ML(7) transparent rows remain rethreads, not merge
      certificates; item2171 is the separate finite component-merge base.

      Independent projected conditions are provably insufficient.  A literal
      six-path rank-six Johnson fixture has component graph `K_6`, all15
      seams individually residence-safe, and complete abstract debt Hall,
      yet its port graph is `K_2` disjoint union `K_{1,4}` disjoint union
      `K_5`, of matching number4 rather than5.  Deleting the star centre is
      the sharp Tutte witness.  Exhaustive complete-simple active-port census
      gives no such fixture on at most five components, so order six is
      minimal in that stated class.

      This closes the exact connector interface and identifies the central
      catalogue target: coherent-edge supply plus the *joint* forced-port,
      residence/service, component-tree and router rows.  It does not prove
      an all-m catalogue, a residence-compatible interior actuator, or the
      downstream compiler.  In particular, the fixed item2188 m=5
      42-component endpoint-only face remains impossible before servicing
      its21 deep debts; a new interior/socket actuator is still required.

2194. Thread D has fixed the exact quantifier order for the item2192
      postrepair catalogue and separated rethread, split and merge atoms.

      Fix one prepared prefix-closed private/aligned factor, and let D range
      over literal componentwise joint decorations.  Retain only coherent
      all-six binary MERGE atoms whose six named ports lie in D, giving the
      component multigraph K_D.  Then an executable fixed-D transparent
      component-spanning list exists exactly when

          c((K_D)_Y) <= kappa(Y)+1  for every router deletion Y

      for some D.  Equivalently, one and the same atom support U must pass
      both the aggregate forced-port Hall condition and router resilience;
      separate existential witnesses do not recombine.

      The componentwise forced-port condition is exact.  Choose one global
      upper-colour transversal I containing every forced upper port.  On
      each I-marked factor component form cyclic I-gaps; forced lower ports
      must have distinct colours and occupy distinct gaps.  An unmarked
      component has no forced lower port and stores one of its two residual
      alternating cross-edge phases.  Deleting forced gaps/colours leaves
      one aggregate residual gap--lower-colour perfect matching.  This is
      the precise factor extension of the one-cycle theorem.

      The exact integral master uses availability

          a_t = AND_{p in P(t)} d_p

      and, for every router cut Y and component partition Pi,

          sum_{t live after Y, kappa_t crosses Pi} a_t
             >= |Pi|-1-kappa(Y).

      These are Benders rows, not selector no-goods.  Together with the
      literal decoration/gap equations they are necessary and sufficient.
      The exact score is

          min_D max_Y [c((K_D)_Y)-kappa(Y)-1].

      The finite scope now has clean type discipline.  The repaired ML(7)
      cycle supplies six Hamilton RET rows (four all-six coherent, two
      zero-mark); its 15 split outputs have zero common componentwise
      decorations.  None is a merge certificate.  The independent item2171
      standard-factor atom is a literal coherent binary MERGE with ports
      [19,21,23,25,27,29], labels (d,e)=(6,0), and component change
      28+42->70.  A lightweight replay also gives a three-edge reduced-row
      example where Hall and resilience each have a spanning-tree witness
      but no common witness.

      The surviving all-m supply lemma is therefore to construct one
      Hall-feasible decoration whose actual coherent-merge fibre is
      router-resilient while the same atoms retain physical trace,
      residence, deeper shadows, sockets/voltage and compiler guards.  No
      all-m catalogue or coefficient-one theorem is claimed.

2195. The root matching/router lanes have made both abstract catalogue rows
      automatic on one sharply stated private face.

      Fix an upper transversal whose gap--lower-colour graph is a forest
      with perfect matching M.  Because a forest has at most one perfect
      matching, prescribed lower ports extend to a joint alternating
      decoration iff every forced edge already belongs to M.  Thus on the
      intended leaf-peelable face forced-port Hall is exactly the pointwise
      owner test

          owner_M(g(j)) = ell_j.

      Off the forest face, the exact replacement is a vertex-disjoint
      M-alternating-cycle packing which inserts every forced edge outside M
      and deletes no forced edge of M.  Pairwise-disjoint zero-flux blocks
      M(G_t)=C_t are a useful sufficient specialization.  A four-gap open
      alternating path proves that disjoint triples, interval-convex lists
      and maximum degree two do not suffice without owner alignment.

      Router resilience is also recursive on a separate occurrence-private
      face.  For router-resilient blocks joined by a component tree, with
      pairwise-disjoint private paths for the bridge sources, the exact
      damage identity is

          c(K_Y)-1 = sum_i(c((K_i)_{Y_i})-1) + |D(Y)|,

      where D(Y) is the set of killed tree adhesions.  Private paths charge
      D(Y) injectively to deleted router vertices, so c(K_Y)<=|Y|+1 follows.
      Graph one-sums, leaf insertion and ears are immediate closures; a
      laminar-cut certificate is a weaker alternative.  The P3 shared-
      bottleneck example and the P4/U_{2,3} synergy example prove that a
      component tree, proper-subtree routability and every singleton-
      deletion test are all insufficient without a global privacy state.

      Hence the exact constructive face is one private coherent collar with
      two orthogonal resources: zero-flux/owner-aligned gap-colour blocks and
      node-private (or laminar) occurrence routes.  The former does not imply
      the latter.  These theorems close Hall and router selection after such
      collars are supplied; they do not construct the collars for all m or
      prove residence, deeper shadows, sockets/voltage, the compiler, or
      nu(k)=B(k).

2196. The root direct-four-transversal lane has removed the period-three
      phase-word obstruction for the exceptional palette when equivariance
      is not required.

      For q=2m-1=3(2a+1), write the finite ground set as Z_q and quotient by
      its order-three subgroup.  For every exceptional lower colour
      L_A={infinity} union pi^{-1}(A), choose two fixed representatives from
      distinct quotient fibres in the complementary set B.  The lower
      diamond (L_A,L_A+{x_A,y_A}) and its setwise-complement upper diamond
      service the complementary exceptional colours.  Full quotient fibres
      recover A and the two partial fibres recover the chosen representatives,
      proving injectivity of both nonexceptional palettes and of all physical
      middle endpoints.  The construction works for every 3-adic valuation
      of q and uses 2*binom(2a+1,a) diamonds.

      This is an explicit collision-free partial matching, not a full
      Catalan linear matching.  Residual matching, cap two and acyclic forest
      extension remain open.  Its exact consequence is only that the earlier
      phase-word obstruction was a symmetry cost, not an intrinsic obstacle
      to servicing the exceptional bank in a symmetry-broken construction.

2197. The root coherent-supply lane has proved an all-dimension coherent
      incidence-hex supply theorem and, simultaneously, refuted the tempting
      standard-label-only strengthening.

      For a standard MMM label x=110u0v, y=101u0v, the three upper external
      deletion labels are all 0.  The lower insertion labels are all 2n iff
      u is empty; otherwise the third is ell(u)+2, where ell(u) is the first
      primitive-factor length.  Therefore the standard label is all-six
      coherent iff u is empty.  The resulting rewrite pulls a leaf
      through a degree-two parent.  Its coherent-label graph has a unique
      irreducible normal form in each component and is disconnected for all
      n>=5; at n=5 it is two components of order three.  Thus the canonical
      potential-decreasing MMM arborescence cannot simply be declared
      coherent.

      The full incidence catalogue has a different explicit coherent ECO
      family.  For every Dyck parent D=1u0v of semilength n-1, take the
      support word h(D)=1u000v0 and the hexagon on the three central zero
      coordinates.  Its lower external labels all insert the final
      coordinate, its upper external labels all delete the initial
      coordinate, and its three old factor edges are the three consecutive
      leaf insertions into D.  Every standard MMM component adjacency is
      co-contained in one such ECO hyperedge already in one fixed coordinate
      rotation.  Since the standard auxiliary graph is connected, this
      fixed-rotation coherent ECO two-section is connected for every n.

      In that fixed rotation, the lower and upper forced-colour-face
      collision graphs are the same path forest.  Their only edges are

          D=1p100v  -->  D'=1p010v,

      one for every pair of Dyck words p,v of total semilength n-3, hence
      exactly Cat_(n-2) edges.  A single independent-set choice therefore
      removes all forced-colour repetitions on both shores.  This proves
      colour-level injectivity, not an owner-aligned decoration or private
      occurrence routing.

      This closes coherent component abundance, not simultaneous selection.
      Static hypergraph connectivity does not provide an executable physical
      hypertree, one owner-aligned decoration, private/laminar occurrence
      routing, residence, deep shadows, sockets/voltage or the compiler.
      Exact finite replay for n=3..7 nevertheless finds pairwise vertex-
      disjoint coherent hypertrees with disjoint forced-colour triples whose
      simultaneous toggles are Hamilton, using respectively 1,2,3,8,19
      atoms.  The central trace target is now
      precisely a compatible private ECO hypertree, not more coherent edges.

2199. The root ECO-router lane has reduced physical occurrence conflicts to
      the same one-dimensional path system and exposed the exact grouped-
      rank correction needed by three-component atoms.

      Within the fixed `(d,e)=(2n,0)` rotation, two literal ECO six-port
      supports Z(D) meet
      iff their parents are D_L=1s100t and D_R=1s010t.  They then share
      exactly one old factor edge (two occurrence vertices).  The conflict
      graph is a path forest with Cat_(n-2) edges.  The two
      forced-colour-face overlap graphs are the same path forest; these are
      prospective colours, not occurrence-labelled gap-owner edges.  The
      parity of the number of initial primitive `10` components in the suffix gives two atom
      banks with pairwise-disjoint literal supports.  More generally within
      that fixed rotation, orient every conflict edge to one incident atom
      and assign the shared old
      edge to it; each atom loses at most two shared old edges and all
      residual atom banks are disjoint.  Thus global support packing reduces
      exactly to one local channel-avoidance problem per atom.

      If C(Z) is the set of old factor components met by an atom, its
      component rank is rho(Z)=|C(Z)|-1.  Expand it to rho(Z) unit component
      edges.  A unit-expanded ECO hypertree passes router resilience whenever
      every atom supplies rho(Z) vertex-disjoint source-to-distinct-sink
      paths inside its owned bank and paths from different atoms are
      disjoint (or satisfy the earlier laminar certificate).  This is the
      private tree-sum theorem applied rank unit by rank unit.

      Three-component atoms first occur at paper n=5; the explicit parent
      11100010 has rho=2.  It needs two distinct sources of joint gammoid
      rank two.  Treating the whole hyperedge as one source loses a component
      rank unit and is invalid.  Genealogy alone still proves no routing:
      the literal n=4 parity-zero ECO path on components
      10101010--10101100--10111000, using parents 110100 and111000, admits
      either dedicated paths or a shared unit bottleneck; deleting that
      bottleneck leaves three components.  The exact live router target is
      now the ECO local-channel
      lemma after at most two genealogy-shared edges are assigned away.

2200. Thread D has combined items2195,2197--2199 into the closed recursive
      private-collar state and the exact repair-plus-ECO construction order.

      export the same full occurrence-labelled boundary transfer, one

2215. The even facet-substitution lane has converted the finite
      k=8,10,12,14,16 anatomy into one dimension-uniform conditional

      A perfect Pascal trace system is a partition of the old rank-r layer
      into lower-rainbow Johnson cycles/rooted paths whose edge facets,
      augmented by one endpoint facet per rooted path, partition the old
      rank-(r-1) layer.  The plain vertex traces and top-marked facet traces
      then partition the child middle layer slot for slot.  Basic supply is
      unconditional: two edge-disjoint perfect matchings in the regular
      middle-levels graph project to exactly such a lower-rainbow Johnson
      2-factor, and opening a component turns its deleted edge colour into
      the root facet.  More strongly,

          union_(j=0)^q F_(i+j) = union_(j=0)^(q-1) C_(i+j).

      Hence every internal marked q-shadow is exactly the corresponding
      parent (q-1)-shadow; only the occurrence rays exposed by cuts and
      terminal path endpoints need new sockets.

      The full and partial finite lifts are one one-jump staircase family.
      If the first a middle rows use d physical cells and the rest use d+1,
      exact row recovery is equivalent to

          rho_1=...=rho_(d-1)=0,  rho_d<=a,

      and the scalar lower-cell condition is exactly a<=Delta_(2r).
      The promoted k=8,10,12,14 words have a=0; the k=16 word has a=6386
      and rho=(0,0,6384).  For an initial facet trace the first a depth-d
      owner extensions are automatically top-marked parent caps, except for
      one hinge, while the suffix owners are facets.  This proves the
      mixed-rank slot count and all internal q1/deeper shadow inheritance.

      After these identities the smallest fixed-scaffold compiler gate is
      one simultaneous maximal-common-cap matching.  Ordinary Hall, scalar
      capacity, targetwise providers and the cap/facet containment SDR do
      not imply it.  Its unary first row is the top-singleton socket test;
      k=16 has exactly one pin-safe location, position 6389 at the staircase
      hinge.  A trace-guarded convex bank plus interval Hall is the current
      transparent proof-sufficient replacement.

      Thus the note is a true carrier recurrence, but conditional on
      cut-ray sockets and the common-cap matching.  It changes no
      unconditional k17 or all-k bound.

      slot-preserving facet bridge, and the common-compiler saving.

      For the closed splice

          S_z(X) = X [z] (z union X[:-1]),

      odd parent has excess e, its exact excess above B(k) is

          2e + 2 d_(k-1) - d_k.

      Solver-free depth algebra gives

          d_(2m) <= d_(2m-1) <= d_(2m)+1,

      so an exact parent splice must save d_(2m) or d_(2m)+2 cells, never
      the intermediate value.  A fixed old shore followed by one bare top
      singleton and a uniform tagged tail still leaves B+1 or B+2 under the
      stated middle-anchor hypothesis.  Thus literal flat-tail trimming is
      not the exact recurrence.

      The correct abstract deck is available in every odd parent dimension.
      The balanced r-regular cap/facet inclusion graph has two edge-disjoint
      perfect matchings; projecting their alternating cycles gives a
      spanning lower-rainbow Johnson two-factor.  Incoming edge colours are
      a perfect cap-to-facet matching.  Complete components and rooted path
      blocks can be facetified slot-for-slot, and on a facetified cycle

          F_(i-1) union F_i = C_i

      reconstructs every omitted marked owner one derivative later.  This
      closes abstract factor supply and local rank exchange, but not the
      component/cut ports, tight owner-mode erosions, deep shadows, or the
      physical common compiler.

      There is also an exact cyclic quotient normal form.  On an odd ground
      of order g=2r-1, rotation is free on both adjacent layers and has
      Cat_(r-1) cap orbits.  The quotient inclusion multigraph is again
      balanced r-regular, so two quotient perfect matchings lift to an
      equivariant rainbow factor in every dimension.  A quotient cycle
      (a,v) lifts to gcd(g,v) components of order a*g/gcd(g,v).  This does
      not force a useful quotient partition, primitive voltages, or ports.

      For the exact K16 fixture, the bridge statistic and length statistic

      Here 45 itself is the connected lift of a three-vertex quotient cycle

      shifted-cut path.  This gives the exact nested explanation
      `h=3*15+(3+1)` for this certificate without making either summand a

      More generally every `h` has an equality-length chain one-switch
      schedule: serve the first `W-h` owners at depth `d-1` and the remaining
      `W+h` at depth `d`.  The omitted deadlines are

2215. Lane R has attacked the accepting-root positivity theorem on the raw
      canonical MMM family and found a sharp structural obstruction.

      In paper parameter n=m-1>=2, every canonical upper turn is a rotation
      of 1u1v1 and every lower turn a rotation of 0u0v0, where u,v are Dyck
      words of total semilength n-1.  The cyclic three-forest quotient has
      exactly

          Cat_n-Cat_(n-1)

      classes, all free.  Hence the raw factor attains

          A_n=(2n+1)(Cat_n-Cat_(n-1))

      colours on each shore and misses exactly

          D_n=(2n+1)(n-2)(n-3)Cat_(n-1)/((n+1)(n+2)).

      Its deficit ratio is

          D_n/binom(2n+1,n-1)
            =(n-2)(n-3)/(2n(2n-1)) -> 1/4.

      Thus the raw canonical target coefficient is zero for every n>=4.
      The first deficits are 0,0,3,22,117,550 for n=2,...,7.  At n=5 the
      22 missing colours are two free Z11 orbits, so the obstruction is not
      only period-three.  The degenerate n=1 base is separate and has
      A_1=P_1=1,D_1=0.

      An alternating circuit of length 2t changes at most t turn
      occurrences on either shore.  Therefore every repair beginning at the
      raw factor must satisfy sum_i t_i>=D_n.  This rules out bounded-total-
      support repair of the raw canonical family, not bounded incremental
      repair of an already repaired recursive lift.

      At m=5 the exact frozen three-C10 cube has one positive vertex.  With

          L=(73,146,292),
          r1=y73*x365, r2=y146*x219, r3=y292*x438,

      the product r1*r2*r3 is the six-variable defect monomial.  Every
      proper cube vertex still omits one lower and one upper variable, while
      the full packet has a 210/210 augmented matching, a gap forest and an
      off-face trace.  Positivity already holds on its preglue two-factor of
      component lengths120,132; Hamiltonicity is unnecessary.  Three is
      minimal only in the frozen/audited bounded catalogues, not among all
      possible longer or overlapping two-circuit repairs.

      The scalar component polynomial is terminally exact but is not a
      circuit-transfer state.  The ML7 target-monomial fibre has1728
      decorations; one fixed hex preserves144, and only72 preserve the gap
      forest.  Also [1]P_F=2^(c(F)), while the m5 component cube
      1,1,1,1,2,3,2,1 forbids context-independent polynomial multipliers.
      Exact packet induction therefore uses an occurrence-, residual-phase-,
      fragment-, trace- and linkage-labelled boundary polynomial vector;
      port reconnections act by monomial-weighted 0-1 transfer matrices.

      The remaining positive theorem is macroscopic: construct a recursively
      supplied repaired factor and an orbit-router packet of possibly growing
      cardinality but controlled live boundary adhesion whose terminal
      transfer has positive all-colour coefficient.  No all-m D2F, residence,
      deep-shadow or compiler theorem is claimed.

2209. The root central-scope audit has removed Hamiltonicity itself from the
      weakest Middle Levels trace target, with the required all-one-trace
      correction.

      A spanning ML(2m-1) 2-factor may be decorated componentwise.  Require
      global bijectivity of the upper and lower turn palettes and alternation
      of selected shore types on every marked factor component.  Every
      marked component must contain at least one unmarked occurrence and
      avoid the mixed binary cycle face.  A wholly unmarked component uses
      either alternating residual cross-matching phase.

      Applying the decorated-cycle construction componentwise gives a
      perfect Boolean-diamond matching.  The physical lift is the disjoint
      union of the component lifts.  If f components are wholly marked and
      g partially marked components lie on the mixed cycle face, the exact
      physical cyclomatic number is 2f+g and the component count is
      Cat_m+2f+g.  Thus it is a Cat_m-path forest exactly when f=g=0.

      The all-one exception is real already at m=3: a two-cycle ML(5)
      factor, with one ten-cycle wholly marked and the other unmarked, has
      exact global palettes but lifts to C5 disjoint-union C5 disjoint-union
      5K2.  After this correction, the Decorated Middle Levels 2-Factor
      Theorem implies Catalan Linear Matching.  Hamilton, leaf-peelable and
      transparent-gluing targets are progressively stronger.

      The symmetric-difference theorem also connects any starting 2-factor
      to any accepting terminal 2-factor through alternating circuits, so
      component merging disappears from the minimal central existential
      gate.  Full nu(k)=B(k) still needs all downstream RSB rows.

2212. Lane R has converted the corrected decorated-2-factor target into one
      exact fixed-factor matching theorem and a polynomial preliminary cut.

      For a fixed spanning factor F, form the global turn-augmentation graph
      H_F with shores

          (A occurrences + lower colours),
          (B occurrences + upper colours),

      literal factor-incidence edges and the two turn-occurrence edge
      families.  Its perfect matchings are exactly componentwise Catalan
      decorations, including one of the two independent residual phases on
      every unmarked component.  The accepting matchings are exactly those
      with f=g=0 in the cycle budget above.

      Equivalently, choose an upper occurrence transversal I and form one
      cyclic gap per consecutive I-pair on every marked component.  The
      occurrence-labelled global gap--lower-colour multigraph has a perfect
      matching iff I extends to a componentwise decoration; the matched
      occurrence, not only its colour, determines the trace.

      Before gap Hall, the exact component-balance network

          source -> upper colours -> factor components
                 -> lower colours -> sink

      has value P iff both palettes can be assigned to occurring turns with
      equal upper/lower counts on every component.  This is necessary but
      not sufficient: cyclic gap Hall and f=g=0 remain.  The resulting
      failure hierarchy is absent colour, deficient component flow, gap-Hall
      failure, then forced local cycle face.

      Thus ECO/circuit moves on the central face need repair only colour
      incidence, gap Hall or trace parity; they need not form a connected
      hypertree.  Unrestricted alternating-circuit connectivity does not
      imply bounded/ECO/protected connectivity.  Residence, deep shadows,
      RSB and compiler compatibility remain downstream.

      There is also an exact accepting-root induction.  For each factor
      component C, form the polynomial P_C whose monomials are its locally
      forest-safe marked configurations and whose constant coefficient two
      records its unmarked cross phases.  With one variable per upper and
      lower colour,

          P_F=product_C P_C

      supports an accepting D2F exactly when the coefficient of the
      squarefree all-colour monomial is positive.  Equivalently, the node
      relation consists of disjoint consumed colour-set pairs and composes
      by disjoint-union join; the root accepts iff it contains the full two
      palettes.  This relation is exact but may be exponential.  The sharp
      all-m lemma is positivity of that target coefficient for one explicit
      recursively generated factor family.  The colour-set relation is exact
      only for a fixed factor/component partition; it forgets occurrences,
      phases and ports and therefore cannot transport a common decoration
      through a glue.  Separate rainbows or scalar counts cannot replace the
      full joint relation; the ML7 gap-Hall counterexample passes those
      projections, while the 10-versus-6 census distinction lives in the
      richer occurrence-labelled decoration fibre.

2212AD. Lane AD has independently audited the corrected decorated-two-factor
        target and added three exact reductions beyond the fixed-factor
        relation of item2212.

      The complete local topology has three faces.  An unmarked 2q-cycle
      contributes q disjoint cross edges; a wholly marked component
      contributes two q-cycles and is forbidden; a mixed component has one
      cycle exactly when every positive zero-run has length2 and every
      one-run is odd.  The corrected canonical theorem SHA17e0e5fe passes
      the independent palette, residual-phase, Euler-count and unrestricted
      circuit-connectivity audit.

      Fix an upper-turn occurrence SDR I.  Its consecutive selected-A gaps
      form P left vertices; the gap--lower-colour graph has a perfect
      matching iff I extends to globally bijective componentwise alternating
      lower representatives.  On component C write q_C for its size on one
      shore, r_C for its selected upper occurrences and z_C=q_C-r_C.  If
      every hit component has z_C positive and odd, every gap-Hall extension
      is automatically trace-safe: a bad mixed face would have z_C odd
      one-runs, all odd, but total one-length 2r_C even.  More generally an
      accepted component contributes exactly z_C physical paths, so

          sum_C z_C=Cat_m,             number of factor components<=Cat_m.

      At the extremal Cat_m-component face, omitting one A occurrence on
      every component forces z_C=1; after gap Hall, topology is automatic.

      Dropping Hamiltonicity also changes the support-extension gate.  For
      any perfect diamond matching M, let Theta(M) contain every cross
      middle-levels edge and both support edges of every same-rail diamond.
      M is factor-resolvable iff Theta(M) extends to a spanning ML 2-factor.
      With G'=ML-E(Theta) and b(v)=2-deg_Theta(v), this is the integral
      bipartite b-flow condition

          e_G'(X,B\Y)+b(Y) >= b(X)       for all X subset A,Y subset B.

      Thus Hamilton subtour constraints are replaced by exact polynomial
      min-cut separation.  A literal m3 example proves strictness at the
      supported-object level: a safe decoration of the two Z5 ten-cycles
      has path budgets3+2, but Theta saturates the first cycle, so the same
      matching is supported by a 2-factor and by no Hamilton cycle.

      The exact accepting-root relation is the disjoint-union join of local
      consumed upper/lower palette pairs.  This is the minimal D2F lane.
      The ML7 31/16/10/6 transparent-hex theorem is a stronger recursive
      certificate requiring joint per-shore local multiset preservation and
      alternating retained-fragment boundary types.  Separate rainbows are
      insufficient.  No root-nonemptiness, residence, deep-shadow, socket,
      voltage, compiler or nu=B theorem is claimed.

      The depth-three `k=15` carrier is the splice of two Johnson cycles of
      lengths 6390 and 45.  After filtering the depth-three `k=16` carrier

      traverse those two parent cycles.  The marked rail retains two chunks
      of the large parent cycle and replaces exactly 49 omitted rank-eight
      parent states by 49 top-marked rank-seven facets.

      Both parent components have the same exact cyclic voltage anatomy.
      Modulo coordinate rotation they are quotient cycles of orders 426 and
      3; one quotient circuit rotates the 15 coordinates by +4.  Since
      gcd(4,15)=1, their connected lift orders are 426*15=6390 and
      3*15=45.  Thus 45 is the primitive-voltage lift of three quotient
      orbits, not a universal collar constant.

      Those 49 facets are not an arbitrary repair deck.  The first four are
      the consecutive lower edge colours of one rooted four-edge path in the
      large component, and the remaining 45 are the complete lower-shadow
      cycle of the small parent component.  Hence

                         49 = 45 + (d(16)+1)

      omitted-middle containment graph has a perfect matching, with exact
      degree profiles `1^1 2^17 3^31` and `1^1 2^18 3^29 4^1`.

      their depth-two rows are one complete plain parent middle layer plus
      one complete top-marked lower-facet layer.  Thus `k=16`, the first even
      depth-three case, is also the first audited partial facet substitution.

      In general, the distinct lower edge colours of a Johnson cycle form a
      same-length Johnson cycle one rank lower; those of a rooted path replace
      exactly its nonroot vertices.  This identifies a new exact even-lift
      target: braid one plain parent traversal with top-marked facet
      substitutions on controlled small cycles/rooted paths.  It does not yet
      prove residence, all deeper shadows, or the lower compiler uniformly.

2201B. The AD repair/ECO lane has added the exact ordinary-tree selector
       for the mixed hypertree topology and a sharp collision-phase theorem.

      A component--atom incidence graph is a tree iff there is an ordinary
      tree A on the old components such that every atom support induces a
      connected subtree Q_t=A[S_t] and

          E(A) = disjoint union_t E(Q_t).

      Thus binary ECO atoms are one-edge tiles and ternary atoms are
      two-adjacent-edge tiles.  For fixed A the exact skeleton master is

          sum_{t:e in Q_t} x_t = 1  for every e in E(A).

      If A is a path, mapping interval tile [a,b] to the forward arc
      a-1->b identifies this relaxation exactly with a unit source--sink
      flow polytope, hence it is integral after any fixed unary filtering.
      The path reduction is sufficient, not WLOG.  On the first branching
      tree K_(1,3), the three ternary pair-of-arm tiles have determinant two
      and the unique fractional cover (1/2,1/2,1/2), with no integral cover.
      This is the smallest abstract branching obstruction and explains why
      coherent connectivity plus the uniform LP does not finish selection.

      The common fixed-rotation ECO collision path forest has an exact phase
      CNF.  Use one Boolean phase per nontrivial collision path.  A required
      faithful binary tree edge is automatic if it has an isolated witness
      or witnesses on both path parities; otherwise its clause is the OR of
      its one-sided offers.  If tau(e) is the number of distinct one-sided
      collision paths, then its miss event has exact probability 2^(-tau(e)).
      Therefore

          sum_e 2^(-tau(e)) < 1

      is sufficient, with the exact asymmetric LLL refinement on the
      shared-phase dependency graph.  Uniform multiplicity r suffices for q
      tree edges exactly when q<2^r as a multiplicity-only guarantee; at
      q=2^r a phase-cube construction covers every phase by one bad edge,
      and r=1 is the minimal contradictory (x) AND (not x) fixture.

      These are selection theorems only.  A literal result still requires
      the same subsetwise component-faithful common cube, postrepair upper
      transversal and owner matching, and simultaneous private/laminar
      occurrence realization.  The companion composition audit confirms
      the exact shore convention and separates one-route fixed execution
      from weighted deletion resilience.  The raw m5 obstruction remains
      upstream, while item2201 supplies the exact repaired m5 positive base.

2203. The A topology lane has supplied the exact mixed binary/ternary ECO
      hypertree theorem and its weighted router ledger.

      For selected strict physical hypermerges t touching old component sets
      H_t, form the component--atom incidence graph I(S) and put
      w_t=|H_t|-1.  The atoms execute as component merges in every order and
      end connected iff I(S) is a tree.  Equivalently, they cover all old
      components and satisfy

          sum_{t:H_t subset A} w_t <= |A|-1  for every nonempty A,
          sum_t w_t = |V|-1.

      A rooted incidence tree gives the one-anchor order: every atom meets
      the exposed component set in exactly one component and introduces its
      remaining branches.  Connected two-section alone is insufficient;
      {123,124} is the smallest counterexample.  Assigning one atom to every
      edge of a fixed pull tree is also wrong for ternary atoms, which cover
      two pull edges as one rank-two bundle.  The mixed physical-conflict
      independence system is not generally a matroid.

      The exact router damage is weighted by the same w_t.  If an atom dies,
      it creates w_t additional component pieces.  Therefore a private
      atomic bank must require at least w_t router deletions to disable the
      atom, or the operation must have a literal unitwise decomposition into
      w_t independently surviving component edges.  A single private path
      certifies only binary atoms; ternary atoms need a two-cut/grouped-rank
      certificate.  Under these rows, owner-aligned matching splices and the
      prepared prefix guards, the private coherent ECO collar theorem makes
      every hyperleaf order executable.

      This is an exact conditional selection/composition theorem, not an
      all-n compatible hypertree construction.  Together with items2201--
      2202 it leaves uniform postrepair incidence-tree supply and its
      ownership-indexed local-channel export as the remaining **repair-first
      private-collar** gate.  Items2205--2209 show that these are not gates
      for the weaker terminal decorated-Hamilton existence route.

      The authenticated K15 parent first-occurrence forest has 1,430 residual

      Johnson edge and the 24,310 intersections are all rank-eight colours

2222R. Lane R has converted the authenticated parent-induced K17 Hamilton
       carrier into an exact residual-circuit decoration calculus and has
       separated its live upper-turn mobility from its now-closed flat
       residence branch.

       Contracting each pure U owner and fixed A/X/Y macro gives a bipartite
       Hamilton cycle with the 6,435 rank-eight colours.  A residual
       degree-preserving move is exactly a conformal alternating circuit in
       the rank-nine/rank-eight incidence graph.  Cutting its t selected
       incidences leaves t path fragments; the toggle is Hamilton-safe iff
       the retained-fragment pairing plus the new-incidence matching is one
       cycle.  At each touched port T, with fixed opposite endpoint W, its
       complete upper-q1 derivative is

           U_old union W  ->  U_new union W.

       Thus every circuit is a bundled directed transport on J(17,10), with
       exact load update mu'=mu-out+in.  A desired unselected provider edge
       lies in a simple circuit iff the residual exchange digraph has the
       corresponding directed return path; that path is a valid augment iff
       its fragment monodromy is one cycle and its capped provider debt never
       removes the last old occurrence.  This is the smallest exact
       augmenting-path state.  Ordinary reachability or target flow omits
       monodromy.  Any complete repair of the 1,891 current rank-ten holes
       has switched half-support at least 1,891.

       The complete Boolean-incidence C6 census is exact and independently
       audited:

           applicable C6                         7,225
           Hamilton-safe                         3,625
           Hamilton-safe/provider-safe           1,711
           strict net upper-q1 improvements      1,121
           fill three holes, lose none              15.

       The full (filled,lost) profile is recorded in the audit JSON.  One
       explicit hex already gives 1,891 -> 1,888 while preserving the owner,
       lower-q1 and Hamilton rows.  The fifteen maximum hexes have disjoint
       incidence support and aggregate upper signature fill44/loss0, but
       toggling all fifteen gives four cycles: topology is genuinely
       correlated.  Their exact 2^15 boundary-matching cube has 10,270
       Hamilton states, 10,128 reachable through Hamilton-safe prefixes, and
       a 13-hex prefix-safe packet filling 39 distinct holes with no loss.
       One order is

           14,13,12,9,11,8,7,6,5,4,2,1,0,

       giving the proved fixed-macro upper-q1 route 1,891 -> 1,852.  This is
       not an all-upper completion and says nothing automatic about deeper
       intervals or the common compiler.

       Residence is closed negative for this fixed parent under the flat
       depth-three compiler.  The frozen macros have 605 wholly internal
       length-three runs.  More strongly, over every rank-six occurrence
       transversal, 165 of the parent's 1,425 A-shore 0-111-0 packets use
       four unique rank-six colours, exactly eleven per old coordinate.
       Their avoidance clauses are empty.  Therefore no occurrence choice,
       macro order/reversal or residual flow can repair flat residence.  The
       certified coupled optimum over all occurrence transversals is `180`
       (an attaining literal choice plus independently checked bound-179
       DRAT); the extra fifteen above the solver-free floor are a genuine
       cross-coordinate integrality tax.  The
       dimension-uniform reason is exact in the lower-q1-bijective parent
       class (where singleton runs are impossible): passing from T_i to
       C_i=T_i intersection T_(i+1) shortens every nonconstant coordinate
       run by one; an all-zero or all-one component-coordinate stays
       constant.
       An odd-diamond regenerative state must export parent minimum run d+2,
       or an explicit cut/facet/nonflat compensation set hitting every
       minimum d+1 run.  Occurrence reselection and port flow alone are
       closed; a different chronology, a same-parent cut/facet/value-changing
       compensation, or a genuinely nonflat compiler remains.

2226A. Lane A has proved an exact low-slack expansion theorem for the
       residence-safe marked-component rainbow path and residual port flow.
       If a marked path Q uses h distinct pure-U owners and eta_T(Q)
       incidences at port T, put

           rho(A)=sum_T min(d_T,n_A(T))-2|A|,

           ell_Q(A)=sum_T[min(d_T,n_A(T))
                     -min(d_T-eta_T(Q),n_A(T))].

       Then Q has an integral residual degree flow iff

           rho(A) >= ell_Q(A)

       for every unused-owner set A.  The exact identity

           ell_Q(A)=sum_T min(eta_T(Q),
                              (n_A(T)-d_T+eta_T(Q))_+)

       gives ell_Q(A)<=2h.  Hence only old Hall cuts of slack below 2h can
       be damaged.  At the repaired K17 marked-bank size h=105, the entire
       residual degree-flow correlation is confined to the slack-<210 cut
       bank.  Equivalently, after Q is fixed, residual Hall has the exact
       full/one-missing-star form

           2|F_2(R)|+|F_1(R)|+|A_2(R)| <= 2|R|.

       The note also proves a genuine existence criterion.  For any finite
       family H of residence-safe component Hamilton paths, let C be the
       repeated-U-label arc pairs and W_A the inclusion-minimal arc packets
       overloading a low-slack cut A.  If

           sum_{J in C} N(J)+sum_{A:rho(A)<2h}sum_{J in W_A}N(J)<|H|,

       some path is both rainbow and residual-flow extendible.  A cylinder
       bound gives the displayed probabilistic inequality, and a valid
       lopsided dependency graph gives its asymmetric-LLL version.  The
       deterministic counterpart is a fresh-booster theorem: every
       reachable path cover merges if its flow-safe candidate cross-arcs
       outnumber the arcs carrying its already used labels.  Connected
       completion remains a second exact expansion row, expressed either
       by residual-flow cut avoidance or pair-state subtour cuts; ordinary
       max-flow does not imply it.

       The finite premise changed during the audit.  The old 190-macro
       closure had 32 internal D2 failures.  Six explicit occurrence swaps
       now give a 106-component marked closure with 154 macros, 3815 owners,

2227R. Lane R has derived the exact min--max/matroid/flow boundary for the
       nonflat marked-component path and residual pure-U completion, and has
       incorporated the corrected six-component obstruction.

       Let F be the linear macro-port forest with c components, port demand
       d_t=2-deg_F(t), and c pure-U owners.  Then sum_t d_t=2c.  A clean
       path through m marked components consumes m-1 distinct U owners and
       2m-2 halfports and contracts them to one supercomponent.  The residual
       instance has exactly c-m+1 components, c-m+1 owners and 2(c-m+1)
       halfports.  Thus marked-path contraction is capacity-neutral.  Any
       connected residual completion is one cycle in which the marked bank
       and complementary bank are cyclic intervals; opening one of their
       two crossing incidences leaves exactly one physical interface.

       For a fixed oriented marked order, distinct connector owners exist
       iff the gap-to-owner graph satisfies ordinary Hall.  For a fixed
       labelled chain on a Cartesian residual pair face, degree completion
       is iff, for every unused-owner set A,

           2|A| <= sum_t min(d'_t, |N(t) intersect A|).

       Hence the exact degree min--max is the minimum over typed marked
       chains of the maximum displayed Hall deficit.  Connectivity is the
       separate exact max--min

           max_B min_{nontrivial component unions W} |delta_B(W)| >= 1.

       Pair-specific residence/cap guards require occurrence-labelled
       columns z[U;h,h'].  One column per U, one per halfport, all global
       component cuts, exactly m-1 internal marked columns and all proper
       marked cuts are a lossless necessary-and-sufficient master.  The
       marked induced graph is then a degree-at-most-two tree, hence a path.

       With component orientations fixed, the marked path is a size m-1
       common independent set of the out-partition, in-partition,
       owner-label partition and graphic matroids.  This is a four-matroid
       criterion, not Edmonds two-matroid intersection.  The four parity
       columns

           (g1,c1,u1),(g1,c2,u2),(g2,c1,u2),(g2,c2,u1)

       pass every two-coordinate Hall projection and their half-integral
       quotas, but have no integral pair.  Separate component, owner and
       port Hall tests are therefore insufficient.  Fixing the full
       component order/ports collapses the marked row to ordinary Hall.

       The frozen whole-component K17 instance fails before these Hall rows.
       Independent replay corrects the optimistic all-clean claim: six of
       the 106 marked component closures contain 32 strict internal D2
       length-two runs, all inside optional macros (16 on x, 16 on y).
       Endpoint U connectors and reversal cannot alter them.  Each bad
       component has its unique required macro at an endpoint, so at least
       six component-local forest splits are necessary in this escape class;
       the split/exchange must preserve the balanced component/owner ledger.
       The older endpoint-only splice graph also has an explicit Hall
       deficiency at least49 from50 isolated outgoing states.  No candidate
       graph for the live post-split six-socket instance is yet frozen, so
       it has neither a positive nor negative Hall verdict.

       A fixed common cap can be imposed by pruning to columns it literally
       realizes; then the Hall/cut theorem is compatible by construction.
       A variable cap remains a joint column constraint.  The lossless state
       must retain the full internal upper-load vector, not only deleted
       globally-unique providers, because all occurrences of a nonunique
       target may also disappear.  No K17 word or all-k recurrence follows.

2225H. The exact/O(1) recurrence lane has rebased the odd transition on the
       one-unit residence tax and the joint occurrence-coherence ledger.

       For a cyclic Johnson parent, a proper coordinate run of length
       ell>=2 maps under C_i=T_i intersection T_(i+1) to the run with the
       same start and length ell-1.  Singleton runs vanish and an all-one
       trace is unchanged; lower-edge-colour injectivity excludes singleton
       runs in the intended parent class.  Thus a flat depth-d child needs
       parent proper-run margin d+2, or one jointly certified physical
       cut/facet/nonflat compensation meeting every minimum d+1 packet.
       Merely having a potentially discardable edge per packet is not a
       simultaneous hitting theorem, and a hitting set alone does not close
       port-boundary runs, upper/deep service, or the compiler.

       The occurrence vector is a correlated state, not an auxiliary choice.
       If e_Z is the retained occurrence in depth-two fibre Z and u_Z counts
       its upper-unique providers, its exact deleted-provider debt is

           D_U(S)=sum_Z (u_Z - 1[e_Z is upper-unique]),

       with unconstrained marginal minimum sum_Z (u_Z-1)^+.  Residence
       hyperclauses, the identities of lost/surviving upper witnesses and
       the induced endpoint-port demands use the same one-hot variables.
       Therefore the regenerative state must export the literal occurrence
       choice S decorated by all three rows before the connected U-port
       b-flow.  The scalar marginal minima cannot be pasted together and are
       not final child-hole counts because ports may recreate witnesses.

       Independent literal replay gives the authenticated parent profile

           u_Z: 0^1835 1^2685 2^465 3^20,  marginal debt 505,

       and exact flat residence minimum 180.  The attaining choice has
       twelve packets per old coordinate; the at-most-179 CNF has 22,965
       variables and 44,382 clauses and its retained DRAT independently
       verifies (5,531-clause core, 99,145 resolutions).  This is a packet
       count, not an edit/cell lower bound.

       The saved octahedral r2 parent improves the profile to

           0^1735 1^2865 2^405,  marginal debt 405,

       and exact residence minimum 150.  This previously uncited value now
       has a frozen independent certificate: a literal bound-150 SAT choice
       replays with 150 packets, while the at-most-149 CNF has 22,245
       variables and 42,912 clauses and its DRAT verifies with a 904-clause
       core and 2,455 resolutions.  It remains only a better parent input;
       port completion, deeper service and common-cap compilation are open.

       The all-k conclusion remains conditional but is now stated at the
       correct interface.  A compatible regenerative odd spine with physical
       length B(k)+c, at most h literal word-level holes, and the joint
       occurrence/provider/endpoint plus residence-margin/compensation state
       gives nu(k)<=B(k)+c+h; c=h=0 gives equality.  Raw even splice still
       has Theta(sqrt(k)) excess, so neither this ledger nor owner/q1 flow

        path

            A=L+ab, V=L+bc, B=L+cd,

        with intersection L, union H, lower colours L+b,L+c and upper-q1
        faces H-d,H-a.  Its exact residence guard must also protect the
        separated boundary runs which the packet does not extend.

        In the owner/rank-eight incidence graph there is no C4, so an
        alternating C6 is the smallest closed lower-q1-preserving zipper.
        For a clean m-circuit its signed lower-q2 derivative has m terms and

        occurrence-labelled port-cycle test; the exact residence delta is a
        weighted positive-strand gluing graph, with weights capped at four.
        Precomputed overlapping packet deltas do not add: use direct final-

        The explicit hex with core 0x78a2, active coordinates {0,3,8}, and
        cuts 5607,8324,11990 reorders forward fragments of lengths

        Every exact K17 owner/lower-q1 Hamilton carrier has exactly

2223A. Lane A has frozen the exact influence and probability boundary for
       the authenticated parent-induced K17 port-flow face.  If two
       Hamilton completions differ at c port seams, then for rank-R owners
       on [n] their upper-rank-(R+j) hole counts differ by at most

           c binom(n-R-1,j-1),   1 <= j < n-R,

       while the full-set target is always present.  The complete upper
       tower coefficient is therefore 2^(n-R-1)-1.  Lower depth-q holes
       are q c-Lipschitz, and the total number of short positive runs is
       (R+1)c-Lipschitz.  The proof is exact: upper witnesses are components
       of the cycle induced on the R-subsets of the target, and every lost
       component contains a deleted Johnson seam.

       For K17 the upper coefficients at ranks 10,...,17 are

           1,7,21,35,35,21,7,0,

       so the tower coefficient is 127, q2/q3 coefficients are 2/3, and
       the short-run coefficient is 10.  In particular, any fixed-macro
       Hamilton flow completing upper q1 must change at least 1,891 port
       seams from the authenticated flow; the corresponding necessary
       floors for closing lower q2/q3 are 812 and 338.  A simple alternating
       incidence circuit of length 2s changes exactly s seams.  The
       rank8/rank9 incidence graph is C4-free, so primitive switches begin
       with Boolean C6s.  Connectivity is a separate exact row: contracting
       the 5,005 macro-forest components gives a degree-two multigraph that
       must be one cycle.

       The one-tag upper-q1 part is integral.  Splitting each pure U owner
       into required X/Y slots and free slots gives an ordinary capacitated
       network, with capacity-one incidence nodes and port capacities d_T.
       A saturating flow is iff both tagged palettes are complete.  The
       authenticated required sets have sizes 900/882 and the X/Y port
       banks 984/984.  The first genuine correlation is the untagged row:
       each of 4,021 demand-two ports chooses a pair of U facets, and the
       resulting pair colours must cover all 3,003 pure rank-ten targets;
       owner load two and the one-cycle contraction remain simultaneous.

       On a Hamilton-stable product cube of legal packets, McDiarmid uses
       exactly the coefficients above.  Exact zero follows from the stated
       private-cylinder Lovasz-local-lemma condition

           p_a <= x_a product_(b~a)(1-x_b),

       with the checkable symmetric bound

           e r0 2^(-h) (s0(Delta-1)+1) <= 1.

       This is conditional, not an existence proof: ordinary integral flows
       are not a product measure, a circuit may disconnect the port factor,
       and concentration around a positive mean does not give zero.

       Residence gives an unconditional fixed-parent no-go.  The 165
       unique-colour minimum-run packets remain bad under every occurrence
       transversal and every port flow, so all corresponding probability
       events have probability one.  The exact coupled transversal optimum
       is stronger: minimum internal A-shore debt is 180.  One witness has
       twelve debts on each old coordinate; bound179 is DRAT-UNSAT with an
       independently checked 5,531-clause core and 99,145 resolutions.
       Coordinatewise minimum eleven cannot be attained simultaneously, so

       changing the parent forest is a signed transshipment, not merely a
       circulation.

       If u_Z is the number of physical occurrences in one q2 fibre Z that
       uniquely provide their parent upper union, every one-occurrence/Z
       transversal deletes at least sum_Z (u_Z-1)^+, and this bound is
       attained fibrewise.  The authenticated profile

           0^1835 1^2685 2^465 3^20

       unique-provider debt to 405 and the marginal exact residence debt to

       For a depth-three linear chronology let R2(x) be the latest interior

       lower Hall/common-cap solve in the monotone arbitrary-start fibre can
       finish this fixed owner order.  A feasible rethread must create a

       all but the cut runs into a complementary arc of length at most 3702.
       This statement does not extend to macro permutations or an arbitrary
       nonflat physical compiler.

       The flat parent obstruction is stronger in a different quantifier
       class.  Adjacent intersection in an odd diamond shortens every proper
       parent run by exactly one, so a depth-d regenerative state must export
       parent margin d+2 or an explicit compensation set hitting every

       Occurrence choice also carries upper service before b-flow.  If u_Z

       For any future fixed chronology and schedule, the exact lower gate is

2228K. Lane K has derived the exact lower-compiler interface for any literal
       `K17` two-bank `D2` schedule and calibrated it on the new six-swap
       residence-clean forest.

       For a length `L=W+3` word and proposed `D2` row `Z`, put

           E_p = intersection of all Z_i whose three-window contains p.

       A nonempty base word with `D2=Z` exists iff every `E_p` is nonempty
       and every row is the union of its three envelope letters.  The row
       equation is equivalent to every strictly internal coordinate run in
       `Z` having length at least three.  Once `D2` replays, every interval
       of length at least three is fixed by `Z`; hence all upper/deep witnesses
       on such cells survive every later lower cap.

       If `Z` has `a` distinct rank-nine owner tokens and `W+1-a` distinct
       rank-eight facet tokens, with adjacent unions of rank at least nine,
       every remaining lower target must use a singleton or adjacent pair.
       There are exactly

           residual targets = 41224+a,
           short cells      = 48625,
           scalar slack     = 7401-a.

       Thus `a<=7401` is necessary.  The repaired six-swap closure has 3815
       owner tokens in 106 clean components; a successful 105-owner marked
       path would have `a=3920`, 20391 direct facet rows, 45144 residual
       targets and exact scalar slack 3481.  This is conditional capacity,
       not a path or word theorem.  The fixed-endpoint connector graph is
       now independently closed and forces at least four noncatalogue socket
       actuators.  Hence 3920 is the token-neutral baseline: net extra owner
       count delta changes slack to `3481-delta`.  The detached three-path
       fallback has `a=5810` and slack1591.

       The exact repaired-flow output is a lower-rainbow Johnson cycle split
       into marked path P and complement path Q.  The a-1 internal P
       intersections are then exactly the residual rank-eight targets, and
       the b+1 cross/Q intersections are exactly the direct facet bank.
       Differentiating the marked/facet concatenation gives the marked upper
       turns, one repeated boundary owner, and every complement owner.  Thus
       ordinary degree b-flow is insufficient unless it also exports this
       palette zipper.

       After fixed singleton/pair prepins, the maximal common cap is exact
       iff it is nonempty and replays every `D2` row, prepin and selected
       target.  Because only the singleton, left pair and right pair meet a
       position, the complete inclusion-minimal obstruction clutter has rank
       at most three: cell collisions, empty-position triples, and
       `D2`/prepin/selected-target bit blockers.  Rank three is sharp.  A
       permanent position guard plus fixed row/target hosts gives a stronger
       constructive theorem: every saturating matching in the pruned graph
       is common-cap exact, so ordinary Hall suffices.

       Socket and port choices separate from the compiler only when all
       allowed options preserve the same `Z`, short prepins and guard hosts.
       Otherwise connector columns and cap choices must be selected jointly;
       marginal b-flow plus marginal Hall is unsound.  At each bank/socket
       cut the two mixed envelope letters and four adjacent row equations
       must be replayed globally.  The exact port path, connected complement,
       facet injectivity, upper completeness and actual Hall remain open; no
       K17 word or all-k result is claimed.

2229D. Thread D has extracted the dimension-uniform regenerative theorem
       from the repaired two-bank lane and separated its three exact gates.
       On `Omega` of size `2r-1`, put

           T=binom(Omega,r), U=binom(Omega,r+1),
           M=|T|, N=|U|, B=M-N=Cat_r.

       A Pascal-exact linear macro forest has B edges and N components.  If
       s internally clean marked components admit a residence-safe Hamilton
       path using s-1 distinct pure-U labels, contraction is exactly neutral:

           components left = U owners left = N-s+1,
           sum_T (2-deg_H(T)) = 2(N-s+1).

       This scalar identity is not Hall.  After subtracting every fixed
       socket current, residual degree completion is iff for all port sets Q

           sum_{T in Q} d(T)
             <= sum_U min(b_U, |A_U intersect Q|).

       Connected completion is a further integral pair-column gate: one
       allowed two-facet column per U, exact port degrees, and at least two
       chosen columns across every proper union of fixed components.  Under
       the degree rows these cuts are exactly one-cycle connectivity.  They
       are not claimed TU and cannot be replaced by unconditioned b-flow.

       run monoid and truncated shadow monoid audit switch effects, but do
       not make replay/upper deficiency a Lyapunov function.  Two disjoint

       support-quotient counterexample, not a literal PBBS obstruction.

       same-colour exchange columns cannot be fed directly to Hall: the
       three column divergences are -A+B,-B+C,-C+A, so the only nonempty
       degree-balanced choice is the complete circuit.  Balance is

       (i) On the full guarded state graph, repair with barrier h is
       equivalent to reaching an accepting state inside the Phi(x)+h
       sublevel graph.  If this fails, its reachable sublevel set is a
       checkable directed cut.  The globally computed cost-to-go, tied by
       remaining hop count, is the valid strictly contracting potential;
       raw deficiency need not descend.

       nonbranching unit-debt network, integral max-flow/min-cost flow gives
       an exact repair-or-mincut/cost-dual dichotomy inside that declared
       atlas.  More generally, for a joint guard matroid M and packet
       candidate sets A_i, Rado gives

           q=min_X (m-|X|+r_M(union_(i in X) A_i)),

       turn the rank into max-flow.  Individual provider safety is not
       enough: two switches can each withdraw one of two protected
       providers and jointly uncover the target.  Provider tickets, joint
       guard state, deep-witness guards, serializability and terminal cap
       acceptance are explicit hypotheses.

       packet must export an explicit casualty set of size at most its
       weight; replay exactness alone does not control upper-provider

2237K. Lane K has identified the exact common-cap compiler defect and its
       lossless regenerative state, strictly after physical acceptance.
       For an accepted chronology Z and a literal middle-realizing guard
       word Q, let H_Q retain exactly the short-cell incidences realized by
       Q, together with unconditional direct-service columns.  Then

           V_*(Z)
             = min_Q (|T|-nu(H_Q))
             = min_Q max_X (|X|-|N_HQ(X)|)
             = min_Q max_X (lambda_Q(X)-sigma_G(X))

       is exactly the minimum number of target masks omitted by any literal
       partial common-cap compiler.  Thus V_*=0 iff the common cap exists,
       and appending the V_* omitted masks is an exact terminal repair.

       On a fixed guard transition, write the old/new graphs as a common
       transported exterior plus exceptional cell banks K-/K+.  Every Hall
       cut obeys the identity

           d'(X)=d(X)+|N_K-(X)|-|N_K+(X)|.

       Hence V'<=R iff the new-minus-old exceptional pressure is at least
       d(X)-R for every cut.  Equivalently, if an old maximum partial
       compiler loses ell matched cells and the final guarded graph has
       kappa disjoint augmenting paths, then

           V'=V+ell-kappa.

       The exact recurrent state is therefore the transported literal
       guard/host signature plus the boundary gammoid or pairing-resolved
       linkage relation.  Scalar V is a terminal potential, not a complete
       compositional state.  A bounded new-cell bank yields only
       V'>=V-h; fixed-factor contraction of unbounded V requires an
       extensive commonly guarded packet bank touching Omega(V) resources.
       For a bounded local bank C, the exact finite cut state is the
       2^|C| pressure table

           Pi_L(Y)=max_{N_L(X)=Y} (|X|-|N_H0(X)|),
           def(H0 union L)=max_Y(Pi_L(Y)-|Y|).

       Two concrete reset criteria are proved: a cap-safe augmentor bank
       with |N(X)|>=eta|X|-beta gives
       V'<=(1-eta)V+beta; fractional guarded target mass one, cell load
       1-epsilon, and retained mass 1-eta with eta<=epsilon outside beta
       exceptions gives V'<=beta by matching-polytope integrality.

       blocker profile, its 2h+1 robust margin, and counterexamples proving
       that scalar deficiency, bounded blocker rank and local cell count do

       zipper does not instantiate V_*: its replay and ranks10--12 still

2238K. Lane K has sharpened item2237K to the smallest exported relation and
       an explicit positive-fraction contraction theorem.

       Fix one physically accepted child, one literal common guard Q, one
       transported partial matching M, and its free-cell sink bank.  For
       boundary source subsets A, let r(A) be the maximum number of
       vertex-disjoint alternating A-to-sink paths.  Then:

       - for one fixed exposed set U, the single value r(U) is sufficient;
       - for arbitrary future source subsets with fixed sinks, the strict-
         gammoid rank function r(A) is the coarsest exact context relation;
       - varying sinks needs two-sided named linkability; arbitrary
         pairing-sensitive gluing needs the full oriented pairing-resolved
         relation indexed by the guard trace.

       The smallest scalar summary for a chosen repair fraction eta is

           Gamma_eta=max_A (eta|A|-r(A)).

       In the node-split unit-capacity network it has the exact cut form

           Gamma_eta=max_P
             (eta|B intersect P|-cap(P)).

       Hence Gamma_eta<=gamma iff every boundary subfamily has linkage rank
       at least eta|A|-gamma.  Deleting q protected unit resources raises
       Gamma_eta by at most q; this is the exact stable candidate-pressure
       invariant, while the full rank relation remains necessary for exact
       composition.

       With source-specific entrance menus P_u, Rado gives the exact
       repair count

           kappa=min_X
             (|U|-|X|+r(union_{u in X}P_u)),

       so residual defect D is equivalent to the weakest common-guard cut

           exists Q, for all X:
             r(union P_X)>=|X|-D.

       If pre-repair exposure satisfies |U|<=lambda V+b0 and
       Gamma_eta<=gamma in the same Q/M/sink state, then

           V'<=(1-eta)lambda V+(1-eta)b0+gamma,
           rho=(1-eta)lambda,
           beta=(1-eta)b0+gamma.

       Thus contraction is exactly (1-eta)lambda<1.  A typed bank which
       fully self-heals newly created halo sources and repairs an eta0
       fraction of inherited sources improves this to

           rho=1-eta0, beta=gamma.

       Bounded support cannot meet this for unbounded V: changing h cell
       identities gives V'>=V-h, and a p-vertex separator has linkage rank
       at most p.  The audit also supplies explicit counterexamples showing
       that unions of different guard graphs and unpaired sink ranks are
       unsound.  The missing all-k lemma is now precisely a physically
       replayed Pascal transition with one common guard and uniform
       lambda,b0,eta,gamma satisfying the strict inequality.  K17 remains
       upstream-invalid and is not an instance.

2239R. Lane R has instantiated the guarded unit-debt/Rado/cost-to-go
       theorem on the authenticated K17 occurrence-greedy296 state and
       obtained an exact negative certificate for the complete sound
       balanced residual fibre.

       Condition on the greedy296 occurrence base and its freshly solved
       residual lift.  Every finite compound of pure residual-U incidence
       circuits, with no support or length bound, preserves the 296
       component-interior run signatures.  Independently, 177 rank-ten

       every candidate set is empty and
