       The empty resource separator is the sharp guarded-Rado cut.  The
       formal replay weight of I_296 is478, so the declared hard-defect
       weight is655 after adding the target rows, but this is not a
       distinct-literal append lower bound without casualty sets.  The cut
       excludes the entire fixed-base pure-U fibre, not occurrence-changing
       or genuinely nonflat packets.

       The broader greedy296 donor relaxation does not contradict the cut:
       all1908 rank-ten holes have10--45 raw providers and marginal donor
       max-flow1908, but the selected columns leave4195 owners imbalanced,
       L1=4536, maximum imbalance3.  Raw columns are not closed factor
       packets.  The frozen5433 active hexes belong to the old a736... base,
       not greedy296's801896... base; the exact base-fibre audit shows710
       changed ports and forbids transplanting them without regeneration.

       For a correctly rebased closed packet atlas with hard bank H, soft
       weighted bank S, guard matroid M and candidate sets A_o, the induced
       Rado matroid has

           r_N(Q)=min_(Y subset Q)
             (|Q minus Y|+r_M(union_(o in Y) A_o)).

       Hard acceptance is r_N(H)=|H|.  Conditional on it, the exact
       additive soft service is

           R=sum_(t>=1)(r_N(H union S_>=t)-|H|),

       and total weight minus R is the exact declared leave.  A minimizing
       rank set plus a strict-gammoid resource separator is the finite cut;
       min-cost flow/matroid intersection supplies the cost dual.  Branching
       or nonunit packets require the full guarded state graph and global
       Bellman cost-to-go instead.

       The dimension-uniform quantitative gate is also exact.  If the
       Pascal/base transition gives Phi_hat<=lambda Phi+b0, guarded ranks
       service R>=eta Phi_hat-delta, and replayed new carried casualties
       obey C<=theta R+b1 with theta<1, then

           Phi'<=rho Phi+B0,
           rho=lambda(1-(1-theta)eta),
           B0=(1-(1-theta)eta)b0+(1-theta)delta+b1.

       Thus rho<1, equivalently

           (1-theta)eta>1-1/lambda,

       plus exact hard replay, protected deeper witnesses, bounded exported
       interface and uniformly bounded final physical/terminal charge gives
       B(k)+O(1).  Packet support may grow.  One K17 certificate alone does
       not prove regeneration, and the present broad greedy296 compound
       gammoid remains to be built.

2241ROOT. The central Catalan gate has been rebased from cycle-first fusion
       to forest-first support selection.  For any fixed spanning physical
       linear-forest support R, the desired Catalan diamond selection exists
       iff the occurrence graph between its lower and upper colours has a
       perfect matching.  This is ordinary Hall/Rado and is integral; all
       physical degree and acyclicity constraints have already been paid by
       R.

       The distinction is strict in the first possible case.  For the
       frozen GMM-derived cycle P in J(6,3) and its complement Q, all 6272
       spanning two-factors in P union Q are Hall-deficient, including 176
       double-rainbow Hamilton cycles.  Nevertheless, among 229300
       unoriented Hamilton-path supports in the same union, exactly 28 pass
       Hall.  The displayed support has a unique colour matching and lifts
       to five P4 components.  Therefore requiring the unused edges to
       complete a two-factor was an artificial obstruction.

       The equivalent ordered-diamond four-partite hypergraph has exact
       degrees

           deg(L)=deg(U)=m(m+1),  deg(T)=deg(H)=m^2,

       and maximum codegree m.  Covering the two outer shores leaves
       exactly Cat_m tails and Cat_m heads.  Its relative slack and
       codegree ratio are both Theta(1/m), so generic sparse matching gives
       approximate saturation but not the required exact outer absorption
       or directed-cycle elimination.  These are now the direct central
       targets.

2242ROOT. The bounded-defect central route now has an exact statistic and an
       infinite architecture-specific obstruction.  A lower-tight
       two-level cycle with turn collision excess delta yields a partial
       ordered four-transversal of exact defect `max(1,delta)`.  XOR parity
       forces `delta>=2` whenever `m=2^a-1`; an explicit m=3 cycle attains
       two, so any all-m bounded-defect theorem in this subclass has optimal
       universal floor at least two.

       For a general catalogue matching P of size N-h, the exact central
       defect obtainable by deletion is `h+kappa(P)`, where kappa is the
       minimum number of selected diamonds removed to make the physical
       lift a linear forest.  Hall deficiency alone is therefore not the
       carried state.

       The concrete binary `SatCycle::sat_2` recursion is closed negatively
       for B(k)+O(1).  Its child turn multisets are tag-disjoint and every
       splice changes at most four occurrences, giving

           delta_root >= Cat_(m+1)-Cat_m-Cat_(m-1)
                        -4(sum_(s<m) Cat_s-1)
                      = Omega(Cat_m).

       More generally every stateless sectorwise binary splice changing at
       most eight turn occurrences remains Omega(Cat_m)-defective; nine is
       only the first arithmetically possible interface width.  The live
       route must use an existential Muetze--Su cycle, global non-sectorwise
       rethreading, or a stateful nine-plus-occurrence regenerative reset.

       additionally needs the parent-to-child Pascal transition.  For
       B+O(1), bounded terminal central/palette holes may be appended, but
       every exported defect must reset or contract.

       The actual closed K17 minimum layer has5433 active balanced hexes,
       724 old run-support rows and8403 row--hex incidences.  Row lists have
       size2..34.  The24272 unavoidable incidence resources have load1..7;
       physical incidence-conflict degree is0..10.  In the conservative
       row-designated graph there are17005 edges and degree0..20, while the
       row-interaction degree is0..24.  Thus the full-list LLL fails:

           4 < 2 e * 34 * 20 = 1360 e,

       and the exact bad-event symmetric tests fail as well.  Exact weighted
       alteration is nevertheless strong: its conflict expectation is
       126.166129907..., so some choice leaves at least598/724 rows with
       pairwise incidence-compatible designated hexes.  This is not a
       residence repair: hitting an old support does not prevent a new short
       run, and topology/upper/common-cap signatures are absent.  Moreover
       active hexes directly serve only154/218 static rank-ten rows; all
       27933 marked-safe minimum hexes still leave target63302 without a
       direct one-hex gain.  Longer/compound protected packets are necessary.

       Forest-first selection removes the artificial zero-boundary row.
       An ordered four-transversal with defect delta and c directed cycles
       has middle boundary 1_(tail vacancies)-1_(head vacancies), with
       Cat_m+delta vacancies on each side; deleting one atom per cycle gives
       a forest with Cat_m+delta+c components.  In the unrestricted oriented
       diamond catalogue the exact list size and cross-list conflict degree
       are

           D=m(m+1),  Delta=3m(m-1).

       The full LLL again fails, but alteration followed by one deletion per
       directed cycle unconditionally yields an acyclic partial ordered
       four-transversal of size at least

           floor(N(m+1)/(9(m-1))),

       O(1) cycles and an absorber into the Catalan vacancy banks, jointly

      exact turn width nine on each shore, meeting the first width not
      excluded by the stateless `q<=8` Catalan lower bound.

      The algebraic invariant is matching-floor tightness: after isolated
      palette-hole vertices are removed, the augmented occurrence graph has
      a perfect matching.  A general private translated-cube lemma and the
      exact arbitrary-debt Hall condition are proved.  The complete root
      `C10` census also separates topology: 31 rank-tight singleton macros,
      10 prototype-plus-two-translate triples, 7 with some legal chain, but
      only 3 full eight-state cubes.

      Downstream independence is literal.  One deterministic terminal
      decoration is an exact 42-path Catalan forest, but has 34 internal
      run-two defects and one internal upper q2 hole (mask382).  K17 packet
      3836 has palette/rank descent but loses named rank5/rank11 providers;
      packet919 is all-depth support-monotone but creates a run-two collar.
      The exact full reset therefore also requires halo-separated run-
      automaton, provider negative-part and compiler-Hall guards.  No all-m
      guarded prototype-supply theorem is claimed.

      The same cube pads to every `m>=5` by adjoining a fixed `(m-5)`-set
      to every mask.  It is therefore a dimension-free local atom, but it
      services only a three-partition block: lower holes `H+Q_i` and upper
      holes `H+Q_i+Q_(i-1)`, with the three `Q_i` disjoint triples.  This is
      a sharp shape obstruction for arbitrary debt.  For `p=D/3` admissible
      blocks, candidate-class size `S` and per-class conflict bound `Delta`,
      `S>(p-1)Delta` greedily packs guarded modules.  If `s` is the
      authenticated changed-seam count in the final physical chronology,
      dependency radius `R` gives the conservative translated bound
      `Delta<=s^2(2R+1)-1` and sufficient density
      `rho>s^2(2R+1)D/(3N)`.  The central factor switch has `s=15`, but
      decoration, connectors or compilation may increase the physical
      value.  For bounded `s` and bounded carried debt this is only
      `O(m/N)` geometric density; one unguarded packet can nevertheless
      expose up to `sQ(Q+1)/2` provider occurrences through depth `Q`, so
      density cannot replace exact guards.

      There is also a dimension-uniform unit supply theorem.  Every nested
      pair `L subset U` of ranks `m-2,m+1` is serviced by a padded unit macro,
      with `binom(m-2,3)^2(3!)^3=Theta(m^6)` labelled embeddings and
      `Omega(m^6)` distinct complete boundaried support patterns.  This is
      palette-macro abundance only: being alternating in one ambient factor,
      private reserves, linkage, topology and downstream guards remain the
      exact catalogue filter.

2246. The central Catalan lane now has a literal local absorber for every
      prescribed outer endpoint pair.  For arbitrary

          L in C([2m],m-1),  U in C([2m],m+1),

      an explicit alternating inclusion path of length at most `2m-1` has
      an off matching covering all internal outer vertices and an on
      matching covering the same vertices plus `L,U`.  In each state all
      lifted Johnson endpoints are pairwise distinct, so the local gadget
      is simultaneously outer-exact, tail/head injective and acyclic.
      Exhaustive replay over every pair passes for `m=2..5`.

      This closes local absorbability, not robust packing.  In particular,
      the displayed fixed-filler schedules all require the two boundary
      resources `L+c` and `U-c`.  In independent middle pools of density
      `q=C/m`, a fixed endpoint pair has any usable common filler with
      probability at most `(m+1)q^2=O(C^2/m)`, no matter how many interior
      schedules it has.  The critical `Theta(1/m)` reserve therefore needs
      variable boundary fillers or deterministic correlation, followed by
      a resource-disjoint packing and a directed-cycle switch theorem.

      The same note proves that fixing the canonical BTK one-step tail and
      changing only heads is already impossible at `m=3`: all 120 upper
      bijections have head image at most 14 of 15.  A successful SCD
      rethread must change both tails and heads.

2250ROOT. The Boolean outer absorber now has independently prescribed
          boundary ports.  For every `m>=4`, every pair

              L in C([2m],m-1), U in C([2m],m+1), |L-U|>=3,

          every diamond above `L` and every diamond below `U` extend to a
          two-state alternating absorber of support length at most `2m+1`.
          Its off state covers the internal outer vertices and its on state
          covers those vertices plus `L,U`; in either state all physical
          rank-m resources are distinct.  The proof is a deterministic
          monotone rethread with two independent boundary fillers.  Two
          independently written audits check every endpoint-distance orbit
          and every boundary pair through `m=7`, while the primary audit
          extends through `m=8` (11,489 boundary cases).

          Quantitatively, the fixed-filler family has exactly
          `s!(s+2)!` schedules but a rare common-boundary gate of probability
          at most `(s+2)q^2`.  A two-filler family has exact count
          `s!(s+2)! binom(s-1,2)` and nonvanishing independent boundary
          probability at `q=C/m`.  Greedy resource deletion also packs at
          least `Cat_m` direct absorbers disjoint in all four resource
          classes.  Thus local existence, independent ports and raw
          Catalan-scale capacity are proved; robust corridor packing and
          correlation with the bulk leave remain open.

          Stopping a pseudorandom nibble at `p=m^(-1/3)` gives the precise
          candidate endgame `D_res=Theta(m)=Theta(log N)`,
          `Delta_2,res=Theta(m^(1/3))`, and middle surplus ratio
          `Theta(m^(-2/3))`.  The corridors have enormous schedule entropy
          there, but no exact residual matching theorem is claimed.

2252H2. The critical-reserve boundary question is now split sharply into a
        solved local actuator and an open global packing row.

        For every `m>=3`, every nonincident outer pair `L,U`, and distinct
        independently chosen labels `c,d in U-L`, a colourful lower path
        gives an exact switch with

            R+ - R- = {L+c, U-d, W+d},
            R- - R+ = {W+c}.

        The two-state union has `2t+3` physical middle resources.  This is
        optimal for the prescribed off-diagonal boundary goal: the summed
        coordinate-incidence identity forces `c=d` under nested two-new
        semantics, so `c!=d` requires at least one off-only resource and
        hence at least three on-only resources.  The ordered role tax is
        `(1,2)` or `(2,1)` and can be balanced across `h` off-diagonal
        gadgets at `p+ceil(h/2)` extra slots in the heavier role.  The
        stronger distance-`>=3` theorem independently prescribes the entire
        first and last boundary diamonds; its corrected proof and two
        deterministic audits cover 11,489 boundary cases through `m=8`.

        A deterministic positive bank also exists.  With `K=Cat_m`,
        `N=mK`, and `d0=C(m+1,2)`, there are cross-separated,
        Johnson-independent banks of order

            q=floor(N/(m^2+d0))=floor(2K/(3m+1)).

        Every subcubic endpoint template on these banks has a proper
        list-edge-colouring by labels in `U-L`; all resulting boundary
        resources `L+c,U-c` are globally distinct.  The audited sizes for
        `m=2..8` are `0,1,2,5,13,39,114`.  This is only `Theta(K/m)` and
        does not pack the internal absorber corridors.

        The exact fully-disjoint global no-go is independent of that local
        success.  If a bank has order `b`, the leave has order `r`, and `p`
        complete stored supports reserve all on-only ports, then role
        capacity gives `p<=K+r`.  Absorbing every pair of `r`-subsets forces
        `p>=b(b-r+1)`.  Hence at the critical bank `b=K` every proper
        universal leave `1<=r<K` is impossible under these storage
        semantics.  This does not cover overlapping, dynamic, or
        selector-aware supports.

        The weakest exact surviving interface is a coupled-leave graph
        `P`: the bulk leave `(S,T)` must satisfy that `P[S,T]` has a perfect
        matching.  Boundary-clone Hall plus the explicit ordered

2254AD. The complement-symmetric tight-enumeration shortcut is false at its
        first nonvacuous dimension, but its exact surviving Hall condition is
        now explicit.  A lower-complete Hamilton cycle `C` of `J(2m,m)` is
        exactly the projection of a two-level tight enumeration: choose one
        occurrence of every lower colour and subdivide those edges.  Its
        lower/upper occurrence graph has a perfect matching iff the selected
        occurrences form a spanning `Cat_m`-path forest, hence an ordered
        four-transversal.

        If `C` is complement invariant, complement acts as the half-turn.
        After identifying upper `U` with lower `U^c`, complementary physical
        edge pairs form a simple transfer graph

            D(C) subset KG(2m,m-1),

        and the occurrence graph is exactly its bipartite double cover.
        Thus occurrence Hall is equivalent to `D(C)` having a perfect
        2-matching (a spanning disjoint union of edges and cycles), or

            |N_D(A)| >= |A| for every lower-colour set A.

        Equivalently `i(D-S)<=|S|` for every `S`, where `i` counts isolated
        vertices; one bipartite maximum-matching computation checks all of
        these cuts at once.

        Two-sided surjectivity says only that the minimum degree of `D` is
        at least one, and is insufficient.
        A single plain-complement-invariant Hamilton path is also impossible:
        path reversal would fix its central Johnson edge.

        Complete direct audits give the sharp finite obstruction.  At `m=2`,
        all four complement-half-turn Hamilton cycles have support/rank `3/4`,
        so the symmetric tight class is empty.  At `m=3`, the quotient is
        `K10`; all `9!/2=181440` quotient cycles were enumerated, `88704` have
        unit-voltage connected lifts, and `3024` are lower-tight (therefore
        upper-tight).  None has an occurrence perfect matching; ranks are
        `10^864 12^1440 14^720`.  Every transfer graph is a 15-vertex,
        10-edge forest with five components, so no switch sequence of any
        support can succeed while its terminal state remains complement
        symmetric and tight.  Symmetry-breaking terminal cycles and direct
        asymmetric forests remain open/viable; the theorem does not refute
        Catalan Linear Matching or prove `nu=B`.

2255ROOT. The proposed `p=m^(-1/3)` endgame has been separated into a
          sharp generic no-go and a structured recursive replacement.

          First, logarithmic degree, tiny pair-codegree and even perfect
          outer Hall do not imply a four-resource matching.  A labelled
          four-partite host with one middle label class smaller than its
          forced outer preimage by one can be sparsified so that every
          degree is `(1+o(1))Theta(log n)`, maximum pair-codegree is two,
          and the outer projection has a perfect matching, while no
          outer-perfect hypermatching exists.  On the positive side, a
          balanced outer projection with minimum degree `delta`, same-shore
          codegree `lambda`, and no anticomplete rectangle above `s0` has a
          perfect matching whenever

              lambda(s0-1) <= delta(delta-1).

          Thus the exact residual hypothesis must contain four-resource
          fractional/capacity expansion and transferrals, not only ordinary
          Hall.

          A deterministic balanced subcube supplies those marginal
          capacities exactly.  Fix an `a`-set on `2a` collar coordinates.
          The induced central four-graph is literally the parameter-`m-a`
          problem; at `a=(1/6+o(1))log_2 m` it has density
          `Theta(m^(-1/3))`.  Deleting its resources damages the ambient
          uniform point only in a radius-two trace collar: first-collar
          deficit is `2/(m+1)`, second-collar deficit is
          `2/[m(m+1)]`, and every farther outer row stays exact.  The trace
          quotient has `m^(1/3+o(1))` states.

          The outer half of this recursive interface is now integral.  A
          collar SCD can be chosen with the fixed balanced set as a
          singleton chain.  Its product with any core SCD contains the
          entire child subcube as a literal sub-SCD.  Removing the child
          central flags leaves a perfect matching of all nonchild lower and
          upper resources, and all nonchild on-chain middle owners are
          distinct and avoid the child middle layer.  Hence lower, upper
          and one oriented middle role are solved simultaneously.  The
          opposite middle role and physical acyclicity remain global; the
          canonical product has opposite-corner fibres as large as `m` and
          is not promoted to Catalan Linear Matching.

          The exact next theorem is a radius-two collar rethread which
          repairs the opposite corners while freezing the recursive child,
          or an equivalent four-resource capacity/transferral theorem.

          forest has been closed quantitatively, and the canonical
          whole-cycle-shift finish is too sparse even after cap two.

          For one middle resource there are

          `d^(-3)`, the product `pD` tends to 24, so the symmetric LLL misses

          dependency graph: at `m=3`, endpoint-disjoint complementary events
          satisfy `P(E|not F)>P(E)`.  The exact smallest symmetric dependency
          degree is at least 59, while the LLL threshold `.006183` is below

          two is often forest-compatible, but the canonical forward/backward
          whole-cycle shifts are not a universal finish: only 21,240 of

          leaving 73.52 percent shift-locked.  These results close only the
          routine uniform-PM LLL and canonical single-cycle-shift methods;

2257K. Lane K has resolved the purely numerical logarithmic-residual
       question and isolated an exact absorber-aware replacement.

       The scales

           degree Theta(m), pair-codegree Theta(m^(1/3)),
           middle surplus Theta(n m^(-2/3))

       do not force an outer-perfect matching.  An explicit deterministic
       arithmetic-progression four-graph, followed by a zero-sum clone
       blow-up, has all degrees within a factor two of `Theta(m)`, maximum
       pair-codegree `Theta(m^(1/3))`, the exact relative middle surplus
       `Theta(m^(-2/3))`, and a Hall defect of the same Catalan order on
       each outer shore.  A separate regular affine example has codegree at
       most two and a uniform fractional perfect matching but no integral
       one.  These abstract examples are not claimed to embed in the
       Boolean diamond graph; item2255ROOT separately supplies the stronger
       hidden-middle barrier with a matchable outer projection.

       The positive deterministic theorem starts from an almost matching
       `M` with balanced leave `h`, a perfect endpoint pairing, and complete
       lists of `M`-ready independent-boundary absorbers.  Greedy completion
       holds under the exact ordered collision-pressure inequality

           sum_(j<i) eta_(j,i) < 1,

       and the local lemma gives completion under

           e chi (2h-3) <= 1.

       A checkable deterministic form uses directional cross-list pressure:
       if each full support has at most `b` resources and every resource in
       one list universe occurs in at most a `lambda` fraction of every
       other list, then `e b lambda (2h-3)<=1` suffices.  At
       `b=Theta(m), h=Theta(n/m)`, this demands `lambda=O(1/n)`, or list
       size at least `Theta(n Lambda)` when cross-list multiplicity is
       `Lambda`.

       The exact independent-boundary ledger has a common physical core
       `2d-1`, at most three off-only and five on-only middle resources, and
       full outer support `R+1` per shore.  Hence a generic length-`m`
       corridor bank can universally handle only

           h=O(n/m)=O(K m^(-1/3)),

       while a Catalan-size leave needs average full corridor support
       `O(m^(2/3))`.  Distance-only endpoint Hall is automatic for
       exponential leave sets; ordered roles, off-state alignment and
       corridor packing are not.  Outer perfection also does not remove
       physical cycles.  A supplied palette-neutral replacement is a
       linear forest exactly when physical degree is at most two and its
       edge multigraph after contracting the retained forest is loopless
       and acyclic; fixed-role orientation remains a separate check.

       The exact remaining Boolean theorem is therefore an absorber-aware
       partial matching with leave `O(n/m)`, preinstalled/contained off
       states, endpoint Hall, and cross-list pressure meeting one of the
       proved inequalities, followed by a palette-neutral contraction-safe
       cycle packet.  No Boolean residual matching or `nu=B` conclusion is
       claimed.

        service-level extension of the nine-turn block basis and separated
        it sharply from the remaining physical packet theorem.

        three pairwise unions.  A nonnested residual pair `(ell,u)` can be
        crossed through this block whenever `ell` lies in one block upper
        and one block lower lies in `u`.  Match those two crossed services;
        the remaining two-by-two crown graph always matches.  This is an
        exact four-by-four containment theorem.

        Every one of the six complete ML11 MMM endpoints with a seven-block
        packing passes this rerouter.  There are nine rows in one service
        coordinate orbit.  The canonical ML13 nonnested isolated pair also
        passes, in exactly three rows.  The same relational template has
        therefore survived the first two residual audits.  However, after
        stripping one zero and one one padding coordinate, the three ML13
        service orbits are all disjoint from the unique ML11 orbit.  A
        universal second atom cannot be only one literal padded coordinate
        fixture.

        canonical ML11 endpoint there are 8,345 alternating C10 circuits and

        not implement the Hall rerouter.  A coupled/longer compound or a

2259AD. The complement-symmetric tight-enumeration no-go has a sharp
        asymmetric escape at `m=3`.  Across all 3,024 symmetric lower-tight
        Hamilton sources, the complete physical C4/2-opt census has 57,600
        Hamilton outputs and 26,640 lower-tight outputs, but no occurrence
        rank15.  A strict six-distinct-port alternating C6 succeeds, with
        1,440 successful source-packet incidences in that complete subclass.
        Therefore the minimum removed-edge distance to an asymmetric
        lower-tight Hall-perfect Hamilton cycle is exactly three: distance0
        is the frozen no-go, distance1 is impossible for simple two-factors,
        distance2 is the exhaustive C4 no-go, and an explicit distance3
        witness exists.  The C6 census does not claim coverage of
        repeated-owner degree-four closed trails at distance3.

        The minimum packet is

            {11-13,19-49,25-41} -> {11-19,13-41,25-49}.

        It changes occurrence rank14->15, breaks complement symmetry, and
        preserves the cap-two `1^10 2^5` load histogram on both shores.  Its
        common occurrence core has rank13.  The two disjoint augmenting
        linkages are

            L9-U45-L12-U46,   L17-U57;

        the third added occurrence `(L3,U27)` is unused by the perfect
        matching and pays physical cycle/palette legality.  The resulting
        matching selects the five literal paths of orders `4,2,2,8,4`; the
        independently replayed 35-vertex cyclic subdivision is an exact
        tight enumeration of Hamming length40 and gives the complete ordered
        four-transversal.

        The exact all-m packet theorem is now: for removed/added physical
        sets `A,B`, first enforce the literal load ledger
        `mu'=mu-a+b`; then require physical Hamilton reconnection; finally,
        in the common occurrence graph, require a complete vertex-disjoint
        augmenting linkage for every exposed vertex of a maximum matching.
        Equivalently, for every lower set S,

            |N_B(S)-N_0(S)| >= |S|-|N_0(S)|,

        where the left side means new neighbours outside the common
        neighbourhood.  If the common deficiency is r and the packet
        replaces t edges, necessarily `r<=t`; an old deficiency d also obeys
        `d<=r<=d+t` and `d<=t`.  A successful terminal matching on one
        Hamilton cycle is automatically a `Cat_m`-path forest and ordered
        four-transversal.

        The winning packet is not a standard projected Boolean-incidence
        hex.  All 18,720 lower-tight Hamilton rows in that strict subclass

2260H2. The balanced-subcube product theorem has passed an independent
        literal audit, and the protected-corner and two-coordinate integral
        gates are now exact.

        For the original product-SCD theorem, the unequal-chain formula is
        correct: after swapping the abstract factors, the output cell is
        restored to the original collar/core coordinate blocks.  Every

        in the collar central graph.  If an incident edge is owned by a
        radius-rho collar chain and the child parameter is `b`, it creates

            Q_b(rho)=C(2b,b)-C(2b,b-rho)

        product closure give a protected SCD for every `a>=2`; `a=1` is
        impossible.  Protected CLMs are impossible at `a=1,2`, exist at
        `a=3` (18,444 fixtures) and `a=4` (one literal 56-flag fixture), and
        remain open at `a>=5`.  Protection is not itself a braid: protected
        B6 times B2 has zero child crossing but three degree-three vertices.

        At `a=1`, put `n=m-1`, `M=C(2n,n)`, `N=C(2n,n-1)`,
        `P=C(2n,n-2)`, `K=M-N`, `C=M-P`, and `R=P-K`.  The raw complement
        ledger is `P,N-P,P,N-P,P` plus `K=Cat_n` forbidden
        `empty->{c,z}` singleton seams.  The allowed ledger `P,C,R,C,P`
        forces deletion of all seams and exactly K deep `z->z` flags.  In
        the exact SCD-aligned surgery class, feasibility is one common
        rank-K base of two singleton-port transversal matroids followed by a
        complement linear-forest row.  A supplied child path forest must
        still be adjoined separately.

        Canonical BTK fails this gate solver-independently for every `n`.
        A BTK singleton is a Dyck word; every immediate lower or upper
        neighbour lies on a radius-one chain, while deep `z->z` donors have
        radius at least two.  Both incidence matrices therefore have rank
        zero.  The literal `m=4..8` replay requires ranks
        `5,14,42,132,429`, finds zero throughout, and finds the raw product
        acyclic and tail-injective but with repeated heads and maximum degree
        `m`.  The atom-level fractional recursion still passes.  Non-BTK
        SCDs, nonproduct five-sector matchings and the unrestricted Catalan
        problem remain open.

2260K. Lane K has independently audited the balanced-subcube fractional
       collar completion and the endpoint-bank two-shadow theorem, and has
       rebased the logarithmic-residual result on their exact joint scope.

       Theorem 5.1 of the balanced-subcube note is GO.  Writing `r=m-a`,
       the two signed path families have exact ledgers

           family (5.1): endpoint multiplicity a(a-1)r^2,
                         negative-diamond multiplicity r;
           family (5.3): endpoint multiplicity
                         binom(a,2)binom(r+1,2),
                         negative-diamond multiplicity 1.

       Per ordered orientation the negative losses are respectively

           1/[(m+1)a(a-1)r],
           1/[m(m+1)binom(a,2)binom(r+1,2)],

       and every outer equality and middle inequality checks exactly.  A
       clean-room exact-rational enumerator, independent of the shipped
       audit, passes `(m,a)=(4,3),(5,3),(6,3),(6,4),(7,3),(7,4)`.  The new
       cases have maximum middle loads `13/14,79/84,103/112`.

       The sharpened deterministic theorem is stronger than fractional
       feasibility.  On the complement of the parameter-`r` child reserve,
       every atom has weight at least

           epsilon_[m,a]/[m(m+1)],

       where

           epsilon_[m,a]
             =min{1-m/[a(a-1)r],
                  1-1/[binom(a,2)binom(r+1,2)]}.

       Every middle row has slack at least

           sigma_[m,a]
             =min{(r-1)/[r(m+1)],
                  1/m-2/[a(m+1)],
                  1/(m+1)-2/[am(m+1)]}.

       At `a=(1/6+o(1))log_2 m`, `epsilon=1-O(a^-2)` and
       `sigma=(1-o(1))/m`.  Thus the deterministic separated face has a
       full-support relative-interior fractional point; its lower--upper
       projection is doubly stochastic and Hall.  The signed correction is
       a rational superposition of literal constant-size `1->2` augmentors.
       It is not a disjoint or automatically M-ready bank; family (5.1)
       has a shared cross-state middle label requiring role alignment.

       The endpoint-bank theorem is also GO.  For every `n>=3`, every
       `<=Cat_n` family of middle n-sets is independent in both two-step
       shadow transversal matroids.  The Lovasz--KK cutoff is exactly

           Cat_n <= binom(2n-2,n),

       and at `n=3` the minimum unions for `t=1,...,5` triples are
       `3,4,4,4,5`.  Both matroids have rank `binom(2n,n-2)` and basis
       extension is valid.  For `n>=4` the Hall inequality has an extra
       unit, but this is only one-target resilience.

       Relative to the exact two-coordinate Theorem 6.1, either diagonal
       sector is therefore always feasible separately.  The two extensions
       can choose different child-atom banks `Q^-` and `Q^+`.  The exact
       remaining incidence gate is one common deletion basis (the matroid-
       intersection row), followed by forest-compatible physical
       representatives.  One-sided endpoint Hall is no longer a gate.

       This rebase discharges fractional space barriers and separate
       endpoint Hall only for the deterministic recursive complement.  It
       does not prove capacity after arbitrary `p=m^(-1/3)` thinning,
       integral/off-state-aligned rounding, a common basis, disjoint
       augmentor selection, or cycle elimination.

2263ROOT. The exact two-coordinate Catalan recursion has lost its final
          incidence obstruction.  Only physical forest realization remains.

          Orient every path of an arbitrary child Catalan linear matching
          `F`.  For a removed atom `q`, use its old tail and head as the two
          cross-sector ports.  These maps are automatically legal and
          injective, and replacing the internal edge by the two seams
          preserves every central-trace physical degree exactly.

          The diagonal incidence rows pull back the dual two-step Boolean
          transversal matroids through those tail/head injections.  For
          `n>=4`, a new Kruskal--Katona chord proves

              r_(T^*)(A) >= [Cat_(n+1)/binom(2n,n-1)] |A|

          for every `|A|<=binom(2n,n-1)`.  Edmonds' rank-sum inequality is
          then automatic term by term for the two pullbacks, so they have a
          common `Cat_(n+1)`-basis `Q` for every child forest.  The constant
          vector on child edges lies in the common-base polytope; hence one
          may choose a distribution on common bases with exact marginal
          `Cat_(n+1)/binom(2n,n-1)` on every child edge, and every additive
          risk objective has a basis no worse than this average.

          The one-sided endpoint theorem is independently sharper at the
          finite base: every `<=Cat_n` family of middle `n`-sets is
          two-shadow matchable upward and downward for every `n>=3`.

          With the common basis fixed, the only open central induction row
          is to realize the two diagonal bases as physical side forests:
          maximum degree two, seam-anchor degree at most one, and acyclic
          contracted attachment graph.  If a side forest passes the degree
          cap, its components contain zero, one or two anchors and obey the
          exact charge identity

              (# two-anchor components)-(# zero-anchor components)=Cat_n.

          Literal end-to-end integral recursions pass for child `n=3,4`,
          producing full Catalan path forests at ambient parameters `4,5`.
          They verify exact lower/upper palettes, inherited central degrees,
          both side forests, contracted acyclicity and the full ambient
          cycle rank.  This is finite validation, not the all-`n` side-
          forest theorem.

            depth five contains its complete target layer; and

            actual compiler with third derivative `T`.

        132-component spanning linear forest on the twelve-coordinate middle
        layer.  Its formal endpoint catalogue has 1185 legal connector
        records and every component has at least six component-neighbours.

        303 common edges, 621 removed/added seams, 882 changed vertices, one

        now recursive socket supply and transparent gluing: produce disjoint
        private eleven-coordinate sockets (or an equivalent carried state),
        install the reset without sharing external resources, and join the
        resulting forests.  No such socket abundance/induction is claimed.

2267K. Lane K has independently audited the automatic two-coordinate
       common-basis theorem and rebased its residual synthesis.  The
       verdict is GO: synchronized incidence is closed for every `n>=4`.

       The requested source SHA was

           f43a8ea28db892370a509bf5fcaae65f24e33d0ecfa209f6a5a01716f0d3d53c.

       During the audit the shared note advanced first by adding the
       balanced common-basis distribution and then by explicitly removing
       the empty-family real-binomial ambiguity.  The current source SHA is

           b0979c3c3cbaceda8159c3857f2dc396c0a9b3935bb4d8141e8b333ba2cdda3a.

       The load-bearing Lemma3.1/Theorems4.1/5.1 are unchanged.

       With `B_j(x)=binom(x,j)`, `t=x-n+1` and

           A(t)=sum_(j=2)^(n-1) 1/(t+j),

       the derivative identity is exactly

           B'_(n-2)(x)/B'_n(x)
             =n(n-1)/[t(t+1)+(2t+1)/A(t)].

       Its denominator has derivative

           2t+1+2/A-(2t+1)A'/A^2 > 0,

       so the chord error has no interior minimum.  Both endpoint values
       are nonnegative because `x0<=2n-2` and `R=P-Cat_n`; all Lovasz--KK
       uses have nonempty-family parameter `x>=n` and hence `t>0`.

       For either two-step transversal matroid,

           r_(T^*)(A) >= [C/N]|A|,
           C=Cat_(n+1), N=binom(2n,n-1), |A|<=N.

       Pulling the upper/lower duals back through arbitrary injections
       `tau,eta:E->X`, `|E|=N`, gives for every `S subset E`

           r_tau(S)+r_eta(E-S) >= C.

       Edmonds therefore supplies a common `C`-basis.  For a consistently
       oriented child path forest, tail/head are precisely the required
       injections, and complements of that common dual basis are the two
       saturating diagonal bases in Theorem6.1.  No compatibility between
       the two injection images is needed.

       The constant vector `C/N` lies in both pullback base polytopes.
       Two-matroid-intersection integrality therefore gives a distribution
       on common bases with exact marginal `C/N` on every child edge; every
       nonnegative additive risk has a common basis no worse than its
       uniform-density average.  This supplies no concentration or physical
       side forest by itself.

       A clean-room audit exhausts the exact KK two-shadow cardinality
       profile for every family size at `n=4,...,12`: 3,660,521 sizes in
       total.  It inserts those profiles into the rank formula and checks
       every `a=0,...,N`; all dual-density and Edmonds rank-sum inequalities
       pass.  It also checks the derivative ratio at648 exact rational
       points, strictly decreasing throughout.  The retained JSON is
       deliberately fail-closed on the concurrent source-hash mismatch.

       The residual synthesis is now sharp: fractional capacity, separate
       endpoint Hall and synchronized common-basis incidence are closed on
       the deterministic recursive route.  The only remaining central
       two-coordinate row is physical realization of the guaranteed common
       basis: punctured side degree at most two, seam-anchor degree at most
       one, and an acyclic contracted attachment graph.  The generic sparse
       residual obstruction/corridor-pressure theorem is unchanged.

2268ROOT. The remaining two-coordinate physical topology has an exact
          shore-decoupled sufficient form.

          A side diagonal forest has `N` vertices, `P` edges and therefore
          `H=N-P=C-Cat_n` components, with `C=Cat_(n+1)` seam anchors.  If
          seam anchors have side degree at most one, every component has at
          most two anchors.  Writing `c_j` for the number with `j` anchors,

              c_2-c_0=Cat_n.

          Thus a side with no anchor-free component induces exactly one
          `Cat_n`-edge matching on its double-anchor labels; the remaining
          anchors are singletons.

          Removing the common basis `Q` from the oriented child forest
          makes every retained child segment meet at most one left and one
          right seam.  Its contracted relation is therefore a partial
          matching `P_0` between shores.  For any `Cat_n`-matching `P_L` on
          the left labels, there is a `Cat_n`-matching `P_R` on the right
          labels for which `P_0 union P_L union P_R` is a forest.  Greedily
          join unused right labels in different current components.  Each
          component always has at most two unused right labels, while before
          the final step more than two remain because

              Cat_(n+1)/Cat_n=4-6/(n+2)>2.

          The seam-component incidence graph is a barycentric subdivision
          of this union with leaves adjoined, so the union's acyclicity is
          exactly sufficient for contracted physical acyclicity.

          Hence a sufficient remaining central theorem is shore-local:
          realize a requested Catalan-size anchor pairing by a punctured
          saturating side forest, put every other anchor alone in a
          component, and use no anchor-free component.  The first shore may
          choose any realizable pairing; the second need realize the greedy
          acyclic completion.  This prescribed-pair side theorem is open.
          The finite `n=3` lift has the no-empty form on both shores; the
          retained `n=4` lift has it on one shore and has charge profile
          `c_0=1,c_2=Cat_4+1` on the other, so it proves only the weaker
          contracted criterion.

2269STC. The tight-enumeration subclass of the remaining punctured-side
         forest gate now has an exact fixed-cycle formulation and an exact
         local augmentation theorem.

         Let `H` be a Hamilton cycle in `J(2n,n+1)`.  Its occurrence graph
         has one edge

             (union(e), intersection(e))

         for each physical edge of `H`, between ranks `n+2` and `n`.
         A tight enumeration suppressing to `H` gives a valid punctured
         side forest exactly when this occurrence graph has a matching
         saturating every rank-`n+2` colour; the matching's selected edges
         are automatically a spanning linear forest.  A prescribed seam
         anchor is legal exactly when it is incident with at most one
         selected edge.  Without prescribing the anchor identities, an
         anchor bank of order `C=M-P` exists iff the selected cyclic word
         has at least `Cat_n` runs.

         The published GMM tight-enumeration implementation does not supply
         this stronger object.  For `n=3,4,5,6`, its full occurrence ranks
         are respectively

             6/6, 25/28, 98/120, 385/495.

         At `n=4,5,6`, all deficiency `3,22,110` is already witnessed by
         upper colours of occurrence degree one colliding on the same
         intersection.  No re-marking of those fixed Hamilton cycles can
         work.  At `n=3`, by contrast, there are exactly 48 rainbow
         re-markings and 19 meet the sharp one-nonanchor capacity.

         The local rank theorem is common-core augmentation.  After a
         family of physical switches deletes its old occurrences, take a
         maximum common matching `Q`, of upper deficiency `r`.  The terminal
         occurrence graph saturates every upper colour iff the new
         occurrences support `r` vertex-disjoint `Q`-augmenting paths from
         all exposed upper vertices.  Physical packet disjointness does not
         imply this linkage or one-cycle topology.

         The guess that a strict alternating `C6` improves rank by at most
         one is false.  The complete `n=4` census has 1,477 strict
         six-owner Hamilton outputs, none above rank 27.  Two explicit,
         physically vertex-disjoint `C6` switches give

             25 -> 27 -> 28.

         Their common core has rank 24 and the terminal perfect matching is
         certified by four disjoint augmenting paths.  Its selected edge set
         has 12 double-incidence owners against a nonanchor budget of 14,
         so it has enough unprescribed anchor capacity.  Compatibility with
         the particular anchor images of a recursive common basis, the
         opposite shore and the contracted attachment forest remain open.

2270STC. The universal prescribed-anchor-pair realization proposed as a
         sufficient side theorem is false; the corrected two-shore gate is
         now exact.

         In a no-anchor-free punctured side forest, the `Cat_n` components
         containing two seam anchors are Johnson paths.  If `Pi` is their
         induced anchor matching, then necessarily

             sum_{AB in Pi} d_J(A,B) <= P=binom(2n,n-2).

         Since

             P/Cat_n=n(n-1)/(n+2)<n-1,

         a matching of `Cat_n` maximum-distance pairs cannot be realized.
         Such anchor sets and pairings exist for every `n>=3`.  For `n>=7`,
         fix a two-set `S`: the involution

             A -> S union ([2n]-A)

         pairs the `(n+1)`-sets containing `S` at Johnson distance `n-1`
         and supplies at least `Cat_n` pairs.  Literal `n=3,4,5,6`
         witnesses are retained by the audit.  At `n=3`, omit anchor 15
         and request

             (23,43),(27,39),(29,46),(30,45),(51,60).

         Their distance sum is 10 but the side has only 6 edges.

         Thus the abstract topology theorem remains correct, but its
         arbitrary right matching need not be physically realizable.  For
         a common basis `Q`, let `P^-_Q,P^+_Q` be the families of Catalan
         anchor matchings actually induced by legal no-empty side forests,
         and let `P_0(Q)` be the central partial matching.  The exact
         surviving topology gate is to choose

             Pi^- in P^-_Q, Pi^+ in P^+_Q

         such that `P_0(Q) union Pi^- union Pi^+` is a forest.  This joint
         realizable-pair theorem is open, but it is strictly weaker and
         correctly scoped compared with universal prescribed-pair
         realization.

2271STC. The natural family of physically realizable side-anchor pairings
         is not a hidden matroid or delta-matroid.  The exact atom-level
         side problem is

             base(lower partition matroid)
             intersect base(upper partition matroid)
             intersect independent(pullback graphic matroid)
             intersect physical b-matching degree caps,

         followed by the nonlinear map from atoms to component pairings.
         The anchor-cap row is already a nonmatroid matching system in
         general.

         More decisively, fix retained child edge 0 in the authenticated
         `n=3` collar and exhaust every diagonal bijection.  The no-empty
         physically realizable pairing families have sizes four on the
         minus shore and two on the plus shore.  Both fail basis exchange.
         One literal minus witness is

             X={(1,5),(3,14),(4,6),(7,9),(8,12)},
             Y={(1,13),(2,4),(3,8),(5,7),(9,11)},

         where for `e=(3,14)` no `f in Y-X` makes `X-e+f` realizable.
         Since every feasible set has cardinality five, the same witness
         violates delta-matroid symmetric exchange.  The plus family has
         an independent analogous witness.

         Of the eight minus/plus products, exactly two give an acyclic
         contracted attachment graph, with compatibility relation

             {(0,0),(1,1)}

         after lexicographic indexing.  Two minus pairings have no legal
         plus mate at all.  Hence marginal side feasibility and automatic
         common-basis incidence cannot imply the joint collar.

         The surviving positive theorem must exploit Boolean alignment,
         private path sockets, or carry a bounded component-pair relation;
         it cannot be ordinary two-matroid intersection or one natural
         pairing delta-matroid.

2274STC. In the tight-enumeration subclass, the strict-extremal side row is
         exactly an anchor-supported direct-edge cover.

         Let `H` be a Hamilton cycle on the rank-`n+1` owners and let `J`
         be an upper-saturating/intersection-rainbow marking.  Put

             D=E(H)-J.

         For a prescribed `C`-set `B` of seam anchors, the selected graph
         `J` has anchor degree at most one and every nonanchor degree exactly
         two iff

             V(D)=B.

         This follows pointwise from `d_J(v)+d_D(v)=2`.  Since
         `|D|=C-Cat_n`, the direct-degree profile on `B` is forced to be

             1^(2 Cat_n) 2^(C-2 Cat_n).

         Consequently `J` consists of `Cat_n` anchor-to-anchor paths and
         `C-2 Cat_n` isolated anchors; no anchor-free component exists.
         Its induced anchor pairing is the noncrossing endpoint pairing of
         selected cyclic runs.

         This replaces the false arbitrary-pairing primitive by a local
         object a tight enumeration can actually control: its direct steps
         must form an edge cover supported exactly on the inherited anchor
         bank.  The open recursive theorem is to choose one common basis and
         two such anchor-supported rainbow cycles whose induced run pairings
         are jointly acyclic with the central partial matching.

        side-realization lemma**: choose the automatic common basis, both

       spanning linear forest with P edges whose turn intersections

       every child Catalan path forest and every n, the resulting candidate
       multigraph has exact occurrence degrees

           d(extreme)=n+2,          d(middle v)=n-d_F(v)<=n.

       Edge counting therefore gives the strict Hall expansion

           |N(S)| >= ceil((n+2)|S|/n) > |S|

       on each extreme shore.  Thus each pure side palette has a strict
       saturating matching for every child; the remaining incidence gate is
       only synchronization of the two unmatched middle banks.

       matching H(Q) unmatched for one C-edge child set Q.  These are common
       bases of two child-induced dual transversal matroids.  Degree/anchor
       partitions and the graphic inequalities on the complete three-rail
       support are then necessary and sufficient.  This is a sharper
       matching+partition+graphic target than arbitrary punctured side
       forests; no all-n common-basis/graphic theorem is claimed.

2273AD. The minimum asymmetric `C6` actuator has been rebased on the
        automatic common-basis theorem and its exact remaining physical
        scope is now closed.

        Holding the guaranteed diagonal bases fixed does not rescue one
        literal asymmetric packet.  In the notation

            P=P(a,b,r,c,d), ports ar,br,rd,rc,cd,ac,

        its palette flux is

            Phi_L=e_(H+a)-e_(H+r),
            Phi_U=e_(H+arc)+e_(H+brd)-e_(H+abr)-e_(H+acd),

        and its old lower labels are `H+r,H+r,H+c`.  Hence its old half is
        not a subset of either saturating diagonal matching; reversal moves
        the defect to the new half and complement moves it to the dual
        shore.  Tagged side palettes are a direct sum, so cross-side flux
        cannot cancel.

        There is a second categorical no-go.  Every strict physical
        alternating `C_(2t)` is pointwise degree-balanced: each port loses
        and gains one edge.  Consequently no such `C6` or `C8` can repair a
        side degree collision or seam-anchor degree collision.  It may only
        change topology.

        Topology has an exact all-dimension rank ledger.  For a reduced
        equal-size exchange `A->B`, put `T=S-A` in the complete physical
        support and define `rho_T(E)=kappa(T)-kappa(T+E)`.  Then

            beta(S-A+B)-beta(S)=rho_T(A)-rho_T(B).

        Thus strict descent is iff `rho_T(B)>rho_T(A)`, by that exact
        difference.  The terminal graph is a linear forest iff `T` is a
        linear forest, owner degrees are at most two, and the `B`-multigraph
        after contracting `T` is loopless and acyclic.  Fixed endpoint
        arrows add the exact affine F2 slot equations, including isolate
        slots, unary arrow pins, path-parity consistency and an unconsumed
        slot for every requested exposed socket.  The test must be joint on
        both shores and the central seams.

        For a strict physical `C_(2t)`, the maximum possible cycle-rank drop
        is `t-1`; hence two for a `C6` and three for a `C8`.  The bound is
        sharp at the contraction level.  If residual paths connect the
        endpoints of a nonempty proper subset of the old matching edges,
        the packet removes exactly one cycle per such path; connecting all
        old pairs necessarily recreates one cycle.  These are graph
        sharpness witnesses, not asserted full collar fixtures.

        The asymmetric packet also has an exact simultaneous-compensation
        classification in the complete five-active-coordinate strict-C6
        fibre.  Exactly three opposite-flux rows exist: reverse `P`
        (trivial), one noncanonical mate reducing with `P` to

            A6={rd-rc,bc-cd,bd-br},
            B6={br-rd,rc-cd,bc-bd},

        and the unique forward mate inside the ordered canonical family,
        `P(r,c,a,b,d)`, reducing to

            A8={rd-rc,cd-ac,ad-ab,bd-br},
            B8={br-rd,rc-cd,ac-ad,ab-bd}.

        The first net packet is a palette-neutral physical C6 with drop
        capacity two.  The second is the known common-exterior-star C8,
        has lower palette `{r,c,a,b}`, upper palette
        `{rcd,acd,abd,bdr}`, and has drop capacity three.  Both preserve the
        fixed diagonal bases literally and both preserve the whole degree
        vector.  They are direct simultaneous net exchanges; neither pair
        of invalid constituent C6s is claimed sequentially legal.  Their
        free reduced-circuit role counts are respectively `2/8` and `2/16`.

        The automatic common basis has therefore reduced this lane to one
        exact occurrence/graphic gate: choose diagonal representatives
        containing the old half of a zero-flux C6/C8 and make its global
        contracted new rank exceed its old cut rank.  Degree repair requires
        a different representative-changing packet whose physical port
        multiset changes.  No all-n occurrence supply, side-forest,
        residence, deep-shadow, compiler or `nu=B` theorem is claimed.

        Let Q be a synchronized common basis and Z=F-Q. If the two
        punctured sides are anchor-capped linear forests, star-contracting
        each side component preserves cycle rank exactly:

            beta(Gamma_Q)=beta(H_Q).

        The two shore link sets in H_Q are matchings on the K+C components
        of Z. Therefore Gamma_Q is acyclic iff their union has no
        alternating cycle, equivalently iff the product of the two partial
        involutions has no periodic orbit. The exact signed charge is

            c2^+-c0^+=c2^--c0^-=K=Cat_n,

        and the link count is 2K+c0^-+c0^+. The previously displayed
        scalar forest edge bound is valid but redundant under the two shore
        histograms; alternating cycles are the genuine topology gate. The
        audit now rebuilds literal Gamma rather than trusting the source:
        n=3 has V/E/cc/beta=37/28/9/0 and n=4 has 112/84/28/0. It also
        checks source hashes, outer containment/injectivity and anchor
        uniqueness. Directly pairing consecutive moved child edges is
        impossible: distinct child palettes make the shared middle owner
        the required side colour, and that owner is punctured by Q.

        A fixed-SCD specialization is exact. For an SCD long chain A, let
        H_A be its off corner and mu(Y) the number of off corners equal to
        Y. Then

2275A. Lane A has completed the forest-first/alteration audit of the
       two-coordinate punctured-side gate.  It independently rederives the
       automatic synchronized common basis for every child forest at
       n>=4 and proves the exceptional n=3 base directly.  Thus there is
       always Q of size C=Cat_(n+1) for which both diagonal outer
       matchings exist.  This is incidence only.

       For a fixed Q, one shore is exactly a four-uniform capacity-slot
       hypergraph: its vertices are the P punctured rank-n colours, the P
       rank-(n+2) colours, and two slots at every physical rank-(n+1)
       owner except one slot at each of the C seam anchors.  Matchings are
       exactly side-diamond families with both outer injections, physical
       degree at most two and anchor degree at most one.  Uniformly in Q,

           |V|=2P+2N-C,
           4P binom(n,2)-2C(n^2-1) <= |E| <= 4P binom(n,2),
           Delta <= 2(n+1)(n+2),       Delta_2 <= 2(n+1).

       Aggregate puncture loss is O(Pn), so all but O(n^(-2/3)|V|)
       vertices have degree 2n^2+O(n^(5/3)).  Exact cap-two b-matching and
       exact graphic/Rado forest representatives exist separately; their
       intersection with both outer colours and anchors is still the
       physical gate.

       A genuine asymptotic alteration theorem is proved without
       conditioning on common-basis status.  For uniform C-subset Q, five
       hypergeometric local counts on both shores simultaneously obey

           s=4n/log n, 20n, s, s, 30n

       with probability 1-o(1).  Consequently every slot-hypergraph
       degree is (1+O(1/log n))2n^2.  The standard spread nibble gives a
       P-o(P) matching.  A physical ell-cycle has at most

           N(n^2-1)^(ell-1) 4^ell

       slot lifts, while the nibble cylinder probability is at most
       (polylog(D)/D)^ell.  Taking g=(log D)^(1/3) makes the expected
       number of short cycles o(P); deleting one edge from each short or
       long cycle loses o(P).  Both punctured shores therefore have
       P-o(P) side forests.  Attachment pruning retaining every seam costs
       at most 2C=o(P) additional side atoms.

       The quantifiers do not yet combine.  The exact common-base
       distribution has uniform one-point marginals but no proved tail
       control.  Every Hall cut of an unconditioned uniform Q is nevertheless
       mean-safe.  With A_T={x:N(x) subset T}, k=|A_T|, e=|E intersect A_T|
       and r=R/N,

           |D intersect A_T| =_d e+Hypergeom(N,k-e,R),
           |T| >= k-Phi(k) >= rk+(1-r)K >= E|D intersect A_T|.

       The exact asymptotic bridge is either the closed-cut tail sum (6.16)
       or a common-base cylinder bound

           Pr(A subset Q) <= (C/N)^|A|,   |A|<=30n.

       Either yields one quasirandom common Q and hence the P-o(P)
       physical forest.  Neither is proved.  This is sharper than another
       marginal Hall inequality.

       A two-terminal absorber for residual D,V has at least

           2 ceil(|D minus V|/2)+1

       alternating outer edges.  At maximum distance this is Omega(n), so
       a resource-disjoint local bank handles only O(P/n) arbitrary far
       pairs.  Shared/global circuits remain open.

       Small-n scope is exact: n=2 is scalar-impossible; common Q is
       universal at n=3,4,5,6; one full physical collar is authenticated
       at each of n=3,4; n=5,6 have no frozen full side-forest witness.
       The n=3 fixtures also show that an arbitrary common Q need not be
       physically feasible.  No K17, exact all-n collar, compiler or nu=B
       claim is made.

2280A. The strict direct-edge physical degree law now gives an exact
       correction to the quasirandom-common-basis proposal.  If `Z^-,Z^+`
       are the child edges attached to zero-degree physical vertices on
       the two shores, then every strict no-empty physical bank satisfies

           Z^- union Z^+ subset Q,       |Z^+|,|Z^-| <= Cat_n.

       Consequently any nonempty forced core rules out the unshifted
       cylinder law `Pr(A subset Q)<=(C/N)^|A|` already for singletons.
       This is realized in the authenticated strict `n=3` Boolean
       catalogue: its four common bases are `E-{0}`, `E-{1}`, `E-{5}` and
       `E-{11}`, so eleven edges are forced and no law has all marginals
       `14/15`.  After contracting those eleven edges the residual family
       is exactly `U_(3,4)` and its uniform law is negatively dependent.
       Thus the obstruction is forced nonuniform geometry, not negative
       dependence after the correct contraction; it does not contradict
       the unrestricted equal-marginal common-basis theorem.

       A shifted-cylinder theorem is proved with explicit constants.  If
       the forced core contributes at most half of each of the five local
       thresholds `(4n/log n,20n,4n/log n,4n/log n,30n)`, and the residual
       law has the corresponding nonuniform cylinder bounds and intensity
       bounds `(5,3n,6,6,5n)`, factorial moments give failure exponents
       `(2-o(1))n`, `>2.03n`, and `>1.47n`; all beat `n log 4`.  Hence one
       bank satisfies every local quasirandom row.  This yields the prior
       unrestricted near-forest consequence, but not a strict direct
       representative.

       The strict integral row has one exact positive class.  If a fixed
       root bank and a physical-projection-injective atom subcatalogue form
       a capacity-safe forest envelope, then ordinary bipartite Hall on
       its two palette shores produces a perfect palette matching.  It has
       `P+(N-P)=N` edges on `N+1` rooted vertices, hence is automatically a
       spanning tree and gives the rooted no-empty side.  Constructing
       simultaneous envelopes, a locally diffuse forced core and a
       residual cylinder law for all child forests remains open.

            beta(Gamma_Q)=beta(mu_- union mu_+)
                         =beta(bar(mu_+) on V/mu_-).

        Equivalently the product of the two partial involutions has no
        periodic orbit.  A physical lower packet must meet every old
        alternating cycle and insert quotient-independent links, so its
        size is at least `beta(Gamma_Q)`.  The frozen strict `n=3` face is a
        sharp obstruction: its rooted upper shore and unique lower shore
        share four links, producing four quotient loops.  Rooted upper plus
        independently feasible lower is therefore insufficient.

        The exact SCD synchronization condition is pointwise common
        two-step cap plus opposite first successors.  Edge-disjoint SCDs
        guarantee only the opposite first steps; strict orthogonality is
        incompatible with a shared nonextreme bottom+cap.  Complete `Q4`
        enumeration gives 240 SCDs, 408 almost-orthogonal pairs with 324
        union-cap failures, and 1,236 edge-disjoint pairs, of which 180 are
        common-cap and 144 also give an acyclic opposite-corner graph.
        Hence the known Shearer--Kleitman/DJMS orthogonal or edge-disjoint
        constructions do not by themselves prove the rooted rainbow tree;
        an extra common-cap/rooted synchronization theorem is necessary.

        Item2279ROOT changes the recursive quantifiers but not these rows.
        `F` supplies the strict occurrence/rooted/topology choice, while an
        independent same-parameter `G` supplies the isolated `c`-rail
        guard.  For palettes, topology and component-local residence the
        output family factors exactly as `S_n(h) x G_n(h)`.  Thus every
        immutable-`c` no-go is fixed-filler only.  Conversely item2280ROOT's
        authenticated chained `n=6` output has upper/lower `c0=12,16`, so
        rooted/no-empty is not an automatic propagation invariant even
        though the full direct lift succeeds.  It must be imposed jointly,
        relaxed to a controlled-empty state, or replaced.  No all-`n`
        structural `F`, guarded-filler bank, residence/shadow/compiler or
        `nu=B` theorem is claimed.

2283ROOT. The independent filler theorem factors the entire immediate
        residence row, but also exposes an exact recursion no-go.  For any
        guard h, H(F,G) is h-safe iff the independent filler G and the
        structural three-sector support are separately h-safe; at h=3 the
        cubic CNF splits into disjoint variable sets.  Coordinate/path
        permutations and reversals preserve run spectra, while complement
        only exchanges positive and zero runs.  Therefore a finite bank
        closed under sealed filler lifts contains an immortal seed ancestry
        and cannot meet an unbounded guard schedule unless a seed has no
        finite internal run of the relevant type.

        The positive target is smaller than forever-ahead regeneration.
        The deadline guard h_n=d(2n)+1 is nondecreasing with only O(sqrt n)
        jumps through n.  Between jumps the accepted child itself is an
        admissible filler; only a jump requires a same-parameter guard
        promotion.  In a literal n=5 audit, substituting a known clean
        42-path filler into the structural n=5->6 lift preserves exact
        palettes and 132 acyclic paths and reduces bad cubic windows
        144->100, deleting exactly the 44 copied-c clauses.  The remaining
        13 body plus 87 seam clauses are genuinely structural.  Thus the
        next filler theorem is jump-localized promotion, not symmetry-bank
        selection.

        The ideal finite-bank escape is real at the base.  The five paths

            13-41-35-50, 19-22-14-44, 21-28-56-42,
            25-49-52-38, 26-11-7-37

        are an exact parameter-three Catalan forest; each is a length-three
        geodesic from a set to its complement and flips every coordinate
        once.  Hence it has no internal positive or zero run at any width.
        Generally a Catalan forest has this bi-universal property iff every
        one of its `Cat_n` paths is a length-`n` complement geodesic: no
        internal run of either bit permits at most one flip per coordinate,
        while the exact edge count `n Cat_n` forces equality on every path.
        At `n=4`, a symmetry-fixed exact-cover search over all `20,160`
        unoriented complement geodesics finds fourteen four-edge paths
        which partition all 70 middle vertices and both 56-colour banks.
        Independent replay checks antipodal endpoints and one flip of every
        coordinate on every path.  Thus the bi-universal filler exists at
        `n=3,4`.  An all-parameter antipodal-geodesic theorem would solve
        the independent filler row outright; no larger parameter is
        asserted here.
        Equivalently, one needs a spanning two-level complement-path factor
        whose lower turns are all distinct.  The canonical MSW/Chung--Feller
        factor already supplies the complement paths, all upper turns and
        universal residence; the sole missing filler row there is this
        additional lower-turn rainbow.  The audited same-frame/dihedral
        two-parent repair does not prove it and may also destroy the path
        topology.  Equivalently, the ideal filler is a perfect resource
        matching in the regular complementary-geodesic hypergraph whose
        resources are middle vertices, lower meets and upper unions.
        Uniform weight is already a fractional perfect matching, so this
        fresh-filler route has no residence or LP obstruction; exact
        integral matching is the missing row.  Exhausting all `8!`
        coordinate conjugates and all `1,162` perfect matchings in the 108
        Hall-perfect canonical-plus-one-complement unions at `n=4` finds
        two Catalan linear forests but zero antipodal-geodesic fillers.
        The positive full-bank certificate therefore proves the distinction
        is real: the smallest two-parent family is exactly closed even
        though the complete geodesic hypergraph is SAT at `n=4`.

2285K. The direct edgewise dual-transversal gate has an exact
       matching-loss rank formula and a complete independently doubled
       n=3 classification. For the tail/head injections and direct side
       occurrence graphs, put

           kappa^-(S)=P-nu(G^-[W^-,X-tau(S)])

       and define kappa^+ dually. Then

           r_A(S)=|S|-kappa^-(S),   r_B(S)=|S|-kappa^+(S).

       Consequently the strict uniform-marginal condition is exactly

           kappa^pm(S) <= ((N-C)/N)|S|,

       while the weakest exact direct common-basis condition is

           kappa^-(S)+kappa^+(E-S) <= N-C       for every S.

       This is the matching-interdiction form of item2282ROOT's weighted
       strict balanced expansion. A path-sensitive Hall count sharpens it:
       if U is a maximum-loss witness, g is its surviving-neighbour count
       and iota(S) counts selected initial-tail edges, then

           (n+2)kappa^-(S)+2g <= (n-2)|S|+iota(S).

       Hence any uniform-density failure is confined to a near-starved cut

           2g < iota(S)+2|S|/n.

       Two independent complete enumerators agree on all 458,544
       undirected n=3 Catalan forests and all 9,549,888 coherent
       orientations. Exactly 7,136,784 orientations have a direct common
       basis; upper/lower uniform counts are each 1,242,576; exactly
       364,176 are uniform on both shores. The full common-basis-count
       histogram agrees. Every undirected forest has some common-basis
       orientation, while 160,536 have some both-uniform orientation.

       The exact global minimum individual rank density is 2/3. Literal
       sharp cuts are the upper singleton 0x3e with neighbour bank
       {0x1a,0x1c,0x26} on edges {5,9,11}, and the lower singleton 0x01
       with bank {0x0d,0x13,0x23} on edges {5,6,11}. The best simultaneous
       minimum density is 14/15=C/N.

       Most importantly, one both-uniform orientation has a literal joint
       direct physical extension. Independent replay checks all 2^15 rank
       inequalities on both shores, every co-singleton basis, both palettes,
       anchor caps, maximum degree 2 and zero cycle rank in the complete
       variable physical support. The corrected independent producer,
       rerun with assertions, explicitly deduplicates only parallel labels
       representing the same direct cell and undirected physical edge and
       rediscovers the same support. This proves a strong n=3 DERF base,
       not that every both-uniform orientation physically extends.

       The exact all-n remaining order is: prove the coupled loss inequality
       for a coherent orientation (individual uniformity is only sufficient),
       then choose direct representatives satisfying the anchor partitions
       and graphic row. Residence, deep shadows, compiler and nu=B remain
       outside this result.

2285D. The minimum-three residence row and the strict common-`Q` recursion
       now have one exact synchronized exchange language.  The correct
       two-parent state is

           (F,G,Q,M^-,M^+,R),

       where structural `F` defines the direct catalogues and punctured
       three-sector support, while independent guard filler `G` occupies
       the isolated `c` rail.  For `Q'`, the symmetric difference of the
       old and new direct SDR on either shore is exactly alternating cycles
       plus paths pairing the exposed ports of `Q-Q'` with those of
       `Q'-Q`; using the same `Q'` on both shores is necessary and
       sufficient for the four direct palette equations.

       For a directly redirectable unit swap `Q-e+f`, one alternating path
       has length two on each shore.  The complete structural change is a
       support-minimal physical `5->5` packet: three seam/central edges and
       one representative per shore.  After deleting the five old edges,
       the packet preserves rooted graphic support iff literal caps hold
       and the five new component-quotient edges are loopless and
       independent.  With fixed root completion this is equivalently a
       nonsingular `5x5` fundamental-cycle minor over F2; changed root
       edges must be included in the full minor.

       The exact residence motif on a Johnson three-edge window is

           b_(i-1)=a_(i+1),

       equivalently trace `0110`.  A packet changes only windows meeting a
       deleted or added edge, at most three windows per edge.  Thus pure
       elimination has a bounded literal collar certificate.  Motifs in a
       fixed `c+G` filler are immutable under every structural `Q`/SDR
       packet, but this is fixed-filler scope only: the independent-filler
       theorem permits another guarded `G` without changing structural
       palettes or topology.

       Exact solver-free unit-packet replay gives direct/physical-safe/
       rooted-profile-safe/improving/pure counts

           n=3: 2/1/1/1/0,
           n=4: 9/9/8/2/0,
           n=5: 20/9/9/2/1.

       The `n=5` unit swap `188->67` deletes the structural coordinate-eight
       motif on `(3682,3906,3850,3722)` and creates none.  A broader census
       allowing simple alternating paths of at most three arcs per shore
       has labelled/full-forest/descent/pure counts
       `5/1/1/0`, `72/16/3/0`, `589/39/3/1`.  Conversely, fixed-`Q`
       one-shore circuits of order at most three are physically
       trace-identical on all three frozen rows.

       Exact versus conditional scope is sharp.  Alternating-path
       decomposition, palette transport, the graphic minor and the local
       motif ledger are theorems.  A dimension-uniform supply of short
       Boolean occurrence paths, favourable graphic minors, structural
       compound packets, and right-total guarded fillers remains open;
       abstract matroid/occurrence ladders can force arbitrarily long
       paths, so boundedness cannot follow from matroid axioms alone.

2286D. Strict balanced expansion has now been separated completely from
       common-`Q` selection.  For a fixed undirected Catalan forest, coherent
       path reversal leaves both labelled occurrence graphs and every
       undirected physical candidate unchanged.  It only selects the omitted
       tail endpoint above and the complementary omitted head endpoint below.
       With orientation bit `x_j=0` for `u_j->v_j`, an outer family `A` has
       the exact scaled SBE rows

           R|Gamma^-(A)| + C sum_j[(1-x_j)1_(v_j in Gamma^-)
                                      + x_j 1_(u_j in Gamma^-)] >= N|A|,

           R|Gamma^+(A)| + C sum_j[(1-x_j)1_(u_j in Gamma^+)
                                      + x_j 1_(v_j in Gamma^+)] >= N|A|.

       After removing components with zero or two endpoints in the
       neighbourhood, each is one signed cardinality cut.  Their union is
       necessary and sufficient for simultaneous SBE.  Two ordinary
       weighted min-cuts separate a fixed bit vector and return valid lazy
       Boolean rows.  Flipping one component changes every scaled cut slack
       by exactly `C` times the change in endpoint membership; this is the
       exact preservation/repair criterion.

       The corrected induction order is

           undirected F -> endpoint orientation -> common Q
                        -> two direct SDRs/rooted support.

       A synchronized `Q`/SDR packet with fixed `F` and orientation changes
       no SBE row and cannot repair a failed orientation.  A component flip
       preserves the occurrence catalogue but does not certify the old `Q`
       or representatives; they must be regenerated.  A structural packet
       can influence the next SBE gate only by changing the output undirected
       forest.  The independent filler `G` remains outside this Boolean
       system.

       Exact solver-free replay gives `n=3: 0/2^5` simultaneous SBE
       orientations, even though direct common bases exist, so SBE is still
       sufficient rather than necessary.  At `n=4`, four singleton bits are
       inert and `475/2^10` effective choices pass, hence exactly

       the literal inequality `1008>994`.  This closes the orientation gate,
