2359H2. Item2356ROOT's saturated signed flag/Pluecker lattice is
        independently GO, but the **common-order short-flag subcatalogue**
        does not lift to a nonnegative Markov theorem.  This item is not a
        no-go for the enlarged endpoint-planted catalogue; items2362NCR and
        2365H2 below supply safe one-block order breakers outside its move
        family.

        At residence depth three let a strict flag be

            B+x > B,

        with bottom rank `s>=3`.  Fix `|C|=s-3` and seven fresh labels
        `1,...,6,x`.  The mass-two tables

            X=[C123+x > C123]+[C456+x > C456],
            Y=[C124+x > C124]+[C356+x > C356]

        have identical point degrees at both depths, reflected pair
        signatures, deletion word `(x)`, and every conditioned terminal
        degree `J_(x,i)`.  Their difference is nevertheless the signed sum
        of two literal coupled coatom actions:

            M1=+[C124]+[C135]-[C123]-[C145],
            M2=+[C145]+[C356]-[C135]-[C456].

        The intermediate flags cancel in `M1+M2=Y-X`.  Both endpoints are
        isolated in the common-order nonnegative move graph: their only
        donor bottoms meet in `s-3` coordinates, whereas a short coatom
        square requires an `s-2` common core.  Mass one is degree-rigid, so
        mass two is minimal; two signed packets are also minimal.  The first
        stable packet instance is `d=3,r=7,s=4`; the `s=3` model is its
        unpadded incidence core.

        The exact abstract catalyst number is one.  Adding the flag
        `C145+x>C145` gives the nonnegative path

            X+C145 --M1--> C124+C135+C456
                    --M2--> Y+C145,

        with the catalyst returned.  The two moves use distinct square
        cores `C1,C5`, so even the smallest positive shelling in that
        subcatalogue requires cancellation across filler flags.  Within one
        common-order fixed filler block, complement antisymmetry

            x_(d-1)(F-X)=-x_1(X)

        forbids a nonzero pure-q2 action.  This restriction does not apply
        to label-attached single-block reorders, which preserve U1--U4 and
        residence while producing the primitive reflection defect

            [f0 f1]-[f0 f2]-[p f1]+[p f2].

        This is subcatalogue-level, not a claim that the sparse tables are
        complete decks of an authenticated safe carrier or remain isolated
        after block-order twists.  The exact catalyst calculation remains a
        useful nonnegative common-order fixture.  No bounded terminal
        compiler or `B+O(1)` claim is made.

2360K. Item2356ROOT closes the signed fixed-degree flag lattice, not its
       nonnegative occurrence-labelled lift.  That lift is now classified.

       Let `G=(S,T;E)` be the literal source-anchor/endpoint support graph
       after every owner, trace, residence, pin and common-cap guard.  For
       prescribed integral margins, all alternating even-cycle circuits of
       `G` connect the nonnegative fibre.  Certified physical `2 x 2`
       Pluecker squares connect every fibre iff `G` is chordal bipartite and
       every graph four-cycle is a literal guarded square.  An induced `C6`
       with its two alternating perfect matchings is the first exact missing
       generator.  This is a restricted-support, positivity-preserving
       theorem and is not a restatement of catalogue saturation.

       Pluecker squares have a sharp physical limitation.  If `M` is a
       compiler matching and `Q(M)` is its used physical-cell set, every
       square retains exactly the same two cells, hence preserves `Q(M)`.
       The symmetric difference of two left-saturating matchings consists
       of alternating cycles and cell-to-cell paths, with

           #paths = |Q(M0) symmetric_difference Q(M1)|/2.

       Squares can route the cycles but cannot close one path or decrease
       fixed-basis Hall deficiency.  An exterior unused cell, dummy, or
       other basis-changing return is mathematically necessary.

       On one exact Ferrers chain

           N1 subset ... subset Nm,

       the unmatched count is

           delta=max_j (j-|Nj|)^+.

       Thus two disjoint exterior prefix/suffix banks have conditional
       endpoint cost

           beta_end=max_j(j-|N_j^-|)^+ + max_j(j-|N_j^+|)^+.

       A uniform bound on `beta_end`, together with literal certification
       of every needed rectangle, would give bounded terminal endpoint
       repair.  It is not presently available: Thread D's exact return
       theorem makes the planted tensor's local trace-guarded return graph
       empty, so

           delta_ret,loc=2(d-1).

       The all-depth companion and its first cancellation are also exact.
       For `d>=3`, swapping the first two fillers acts only at `q=d` and
       `q=2`, with the same square orientation.  Taking opposite
       commutators on adjacent filler cores cancels `q=d` and leaves the
       pure depth-two cube

           (e_a-e_b) tensor (e_x-e_y) tensor (e_u-e_v).

       Its one- and two-factor marginals vanish.  After fixing every
       two-way margin, the all-depth-neutral fibre is a bounded
       transportation table; these cubes are its rectangles.  All even
       support cycles are an exact Markov basis, and cubes alone suffice
       under the same chordal-bipartite plus physical-four-cycle condition.
       At `d=2`, the two named layers coincide: the sole action is twice one
       `q=2=q=d` square, there are no distinct internal cores to subtract,
       and this is a bounded base case.

       The cube is still algebraic rather than a literal four-slot macro.
       For each filler core `F`, the two order variants share the unavoidable
       upper-screen owner

           O_F=K union {infinity,c,a,b} union F.

       Hence the canonical realization has two owner collisions before U5
       or nonlinear common-cap Hall is tested.  No shared-owner
       palette/OR/residence-transparent resolver is currently proved.

       The exact remaining theorem is therefore physical: construct an
       exterior trace-guarded Ferrers/circuit bank with bounded `beta_end`,
       a free basis-changing endpoint, and either a shared-owner transparent
       cube/C6 resolver or a modified filler-order actuator; then replay the
       higher-depth cap equations and U5 jointly.  Until then, the new
       theorem gives exact cycle routing but neither endpoint regeneration
       nor `B(k)+O(1)`.

2361AD. The owner-collision/modified-filler-order actuator left open in
        item2360K now has an exact literal solution.  It is a four-packet
        twisted cube, not a noncommutative commutator.

        Fix cube labels `a0,a1,b0,b1,c0,c1` and a neutral filler order `M`.
        Use four canonical mixed-screen packets with

          active pair   third role   internal filler flag
          a0->a1           c0         b0,M,b1
          a1->a0           b0         c0,M,c1
          a0->a1           b1         c0,rev(M),c1
          a1->a0           c1         b0,rev(M),b1.

        Give each packet private `e_i,left_i,right_i`, while sharing the
        core, infinity and delta.  For `t=d+1-q`, let `A_t,B_t` be the first
        and last `t-1` neutral fillers and let `E_ijk(R)` denote the target
        on `a_i,b_j,c_k,R`.  The four exact depth-q deltas are

          E000(A)-E100(A)+E110(B)-E010(B),
          E100(A)-E000(A)+E001(B)-E101(B),
          E010(B)-E110(B)+E111(A)-E011(A),
          E101(B)-E001(B)+E011(A)-E111(A).

        They cancel coefficientwise for every `2<=q<=d`; q1 is zero in
        each packet.  The reverse-neutral twist is what synchronizes every
        intermediate layer.

        This cancellation is physically compatible, not only signed.  The
        four owner banks are pairwise disjoint; their complete lower-q1
        palettes and adjacent-union supports are also pairwise disjoint.
        The combined exact ledger is

          owners                 48d+140,
          lower-q1 colours       48d+136,
          adjacent-union support 80.

        It uses `r+14` coordinates and hence embeds in `[2r]` for
        `r>=max(d+4,14)`.  In four prepared carrier intervals, toggling the
        packets in any order preserves U1--U4 at every intermediate state.
        Their common first/last `d+2` block owners freeze every exterior-
        crossing depth-q window, so the terminal global lower counter is
        exactly the initial counter for all `q<=d`.  Only eight fixed slot
        endpoints remain.

        The shorter common-flag active-label triangle cancels algebraically
        but repeats three q1 socket colours.  Three rainbow-compatible
        filler-axis packets do exist in the bounded bases `d=2,3`.  At
        `d>=4`, three packets are impossible in the normalized common-base
        rectangle/diagonal face: the all-depth equations force a distinct-
        label middle word of length `d-2` to equal its reversal.  The
        arbitrary-core three-square classification is unproved because one
        adjacent Johnson edge has several higher-rank square decompositions.
        Thus neither full canonical nor global minimality is claimed.

        This closes mutual owner/palette compatibility of one constant-size
        all-depth-neutral macro.  It does not plant the four old slots in an
        arbitrary carrier, nor does unaddressed counter cancellation imply
        compiler U5: target/cell labels, capacities, survival/nonzeroness
        and exterior incidences must still admit one full labelled transport
        or terminal Hall matching.  Thus neither regeneration nor
        `B(k)+O(1)` is yet proved.

         replacement.  The reflected pair-degree law in item2357K is exact

         endpoint-planted safe-carrier graph.  In particular, “arbitrary
         overlapping serial walks remain in a quadratic reflection fibre”
         is retracted outside the common-order subcatalogue.

         The full sixteen-schedule census is now exact.  Among the sixteen
         owner-simple common-palette screen schedules, ten preserve q1,
         eight are transition-zero-lower endpoint candidates, six have both
         properties, three minimize deeper support damage, and zero break
         reflection while every block retains one common coatom order.  The
         canonical `{1,3,5,7}` schedule is the unique schedule which is
         simultaneously endpoint-candidate, q1-exact and minimum-damage in
         that unplanted fibre.  This is a screen-only classification, not a
         physical no-go.

         In the authoritative repaired planting, the first `Iab` block has
         omission order

             p,g1,...,gd,g0,

         transition zero is upper, and one may use
         `E0={0,2,4,6,8,10}`.  The untwisted planted packet still has the
         reflected lower current.  For each

             1 <= s <= h=floor((d-1)/2),

         however, swap adjacent omissions `g_s,g_(s+1)` only in the block
         whose active label is `Ica` (old block index 6, new index 5).  This
         preserves the exact owner set, simple topology, both immediate
         palettes, complete interval-OR support and residence.

         If `R_q^s` is its incremental lower current relative to the
         untwisted planted packet and

             psi_s(z)=deg_z(g0,g_s)-deg_z(g0,g_(s+1)),

         then the literal all-d identity is

             psi_s(R_(j+1)^s-R_(d+1-j)^s)=2*1_(j=s).

         More strongly, the diagonal odd current is the primitive filler
         square

             [g0 g_s]+[g_(s+1) p]-[g0 g_(s+1)]-[g_s p],

         and there is no odd current at later reflected depth pairs.  Pair
         squares generate the zero-point-degree pair lattice integrally, so
         triangular induction gives the exact saturated projected lattice

             ker(Z^(pairs)->Z^k) ^ direct-sum h.

         Thus the reflection obstruction is completely removed, even at
         the projected integer-lattice level.  What remains is the
         occurrence-level/nonnegative lift: prepare these order variants in
         actual slots or provide catalysts/alternating ears, and couple them
         to the compiler augmenting-linkage law from item2357K.  The fixed-
         carrier compiler-bypass theorem remains valid, but its “fibre” is
         only a level set of a statistic, not a full safe-move component.

2363R. The complete rational coupled occurrence action below q1 is now
       classified for the enlarged canonical-plus-breaker catalogue.  Fix

           d>=3, r>=d+4, v in {2r-1,2r},
           g=r-d-2, k_t=g+1+t=r-d-1+t, 1<=t<=d-1.

       Let K_t be the kernel of the point-incidence map on rank-k_t
       occurrence vectors.  For the complete injective coordinate-
       relabelling orbit of the canonical common-order packets and the
       endpoint-planted single-Ica adjacent-order breakers,

           span_Q(catalogue actions) = direct-sum_(t=1)^(d-1) K_t.

       Hence the only rational linear invariants of the q=2,...,d decks
       are their layerwise coordinate degrees.  Reflection is not replaced
       by a higher Boolean-harmonic invariant.

       The proof is representation-theoretic but explicit.  On rank k_t,
       the point kernel is H_2+...+H_(k_t), with

           H_j = S^(v-j,j),
           T_j={t:t>=L_j}, L_j=max(1,j-g-1).

       The planted triangular primitive-square theorem supplies the full
       H_2 multiplicity.  For j>=3, pair a canonical action

           [GaP_t]+[GbS_t]-[GbP_t]-[GaS_t]

       with a disjoint-pair degree-j polytabloid.  For every s in T_j,
       choose its positive filler labels as {f1} when L_j=s=1,
       {f1,f_s} when L_j=1<s, and
       {f1,...,f_(L_j-1),f_s} when L_j>=2, filling the other positive
       labels from G and taking all negative mates outside the r-label
       signed lower-action support.  (The physical tensor uses four more
       labels, which are also absent from these four signed terms.)  The
       exact pairing is

           2 * 1_(t>=s).

       These step vectors are triangular on T_j.  Exterior mates exist
       because v-r>=r-1 while j-1<=r-3.  Two independent symbolic audits
       caught and repaired the L_j=1,s>1 suffix corner and verified every
       stable-range label inequality.

       Scope is strict.  This proof is signed rational catalogue span, not
       a nonnegative Markov path, distinct-support reachability, or planting
       in one fixed carrier.  Item2366L subsequently closes the integer
       lattice by a primitive role-swap commutator, so higher-degree torsion
       is no longer open.  The harmonic proof here remains an independent
       check that no higher rational module was missed.  The induced-C6
       support and basis-changing compiler-path obstructions remain.

       The exact q1 boundary is outside the theorem and is genuinely
       frozen.  If q1 holes have endpoint classes of sizes z,ell,rho,b,
       put u_L=min(ell,d), u_R=min(rho,d).  Every current packet preserves

           delta_top = z+ell+rho+b-u_L-u_R
                       -min(b,2d-u_L-u_R),

       and every compiler has deletion number at least delta_top.  Thus a
       regenerative B(k)+O(1) input must already export delta_top=O(1), or
       use a new q1/endpoint-moving packet.  Below q1 the next gate is no
       longer linear invariant hunting: it is a guarded catalyst/circuit
       bank plus an exterior basis-changing return or a direct common-cap
       augmenting linkage.

       Independent audit corrected one proof line in the top-shadow source:
       a deeper consecutive intersection need not have rank <=r-2.  The
       theorem survives because any interior cap containing a missing
       rank-(r-1) target Q is contained in an adjacent rank-(r-1)
       intersection, forcing that intersection to equal Q and contradicting
       that Q is missing.  The corrected source theorem SHA is
       2285d850427e5400c69541a85fd5f4b9a49d005f87b7956085737b7925ebdaac.

2364NCR. The first occurrence-level nonnegative obstruction now has an
         exact returned-catalyst router, with the physical matching
         capacity treated correctly.

         Let the two alternating matchings of an induced `2 ell`-cycle be

             M0={s_i t_i},  M1={s_i t_(i+1)}.

         Add one exterior matched atom `s0 t0`; make `s0` adjacent to all
         cycle endpoints and one pivot source `s_ell` adjacent to `t0`.
         Then

             M0 + s0t0  -->  M1 + s0t0

         by exactly `ell+1` nonnegative quadratic switches.  First open the
         buffer on rows `(s0,s_ell)` and columns `(t0,t_ell)`, sweep the
         catalyst endpoint through `t_ell,...,t_1`, and close on
         `(t0,t1)`.  Every intermediate is a genuine matching and the
         catalyst atom is returned.  The length is optimal: every square
         uses `s0`, all `ell` ordinary rows must change, and the row which
         receives `t0` must change twice to return it.

         Thus one catalyst atom is exactly sufficient for the induced C6
         fibre (four switches), while zero is impossible.  This is a
         cycle-connectivity theorem only.  All square sequences preserve
         source/endpoint marginals and the used physical basis, so they
         cannot lower fixed-basis Hall deficiency or implement an open
         augmenting ear.  The additive-constant route still needs a
         separate exterior basis-changing actuator.

         The planted adjacent-order breakers provide the required
         primitive pair-square directions in projection, but not yet the
         common occurrence address.  The exact next local gate is to plant
         one trace-guarded exterior matched atom and certify the four C6
         hub rectangles on one common-cap bank.  This sharply separates

2365H2. Independent literal replay upgrades the planted adjacent-order
        breaker from a projected reflection escape to the complete formal
        **integral** all-depth catalogue span.  Under

            r>=d+4, k>=r+5,

        with every target rank `r-q`, `2<=q<=d`, between `2` and `k-2`,
        let `partial_j` be the coordinate-degree map on rank-j occurrence
        vectors.  Then

            L_twist = direct-sum_(q=2)^d ker_Z(partial_(r-q)).

        The unit isolator is especially simple.  Twist adjacent internal
        omissions `f_s,f_(s+1)` only in the label-attached `Ica` block.
        Compare that packet with the identically twisted packet in which
        only the extreme filler `p` is replaced by a fresh `p'`, with the
        opposite sign.  The common-order action and every twist-derivative
        row except `q=s+1` are independent of `p`.  The surviving row is

            Q_(K infinity c {f_(s+2),...,f_d})
              (p',p;f_s,f_(s+1)),

        one primitive Johnson square with coefficient one.  Taking
        `s=q-1`, relabelling, and reversing supplies every square at one
        chosen depth and zero elsewhere.  Johnson squares integrally
        generate each fixed-degree kernel, so the direct product is
        saturated; there is no higher coupled congruence hidden behind the
        old reflection law.  A separate triangular/three-cube proof reaches
        the same conclusion and finds no even-middle index.

        This is signed catalogue span, not a physical two-slot lift.  The
        `p` and `p'` copies collide at every planted upper screen and at
        extreme-omission coatoms, so the canonical isolator cannot be
        installed as two owner-disjoint slots.  Nonnegative applicability,
        address compatibility and regeneration remain open.

        The exact U5 boundary is also frozen.  One adjacent twist changes
        exactly `2d+2` marginal compiler-cell signatures per phase.  For
        swapped-owner position `m`,

            D_1={m-1,m,m+d+1,m+d+2},
            D_h={m,m+d+2-h}, 2<=h<=d,

        with `m_old=6d+19`, `m_new=5d+16`.  If `M` is an old optimal
        matching, `ell(theta)` counts its edges lost in a legal new cap
        state and `alpha(theta)` is the maximum disjoint augmenting-path
        count from the retained matching, then exactly

            lambda(T+)-lambda(T-)
              = min_theta (ell(theta)-alpha(theta)).

        `alpha>=ell`, and strict improvement iff `alpha>ell`.  A shore-

2366L. Sharp labelled-lattice upgrade and exact regenerative-interface
       correction.  Item2365H2 used a fresh extreme filler and therefore
       assumed `k-r>=5`.  No fresh role is needed.  If `C_s` is the signed
       correction from twisting adjacent omissions `f_s,f_(s+1)` only in
       the endpoint-planted `Ica` block, then its first row is the only row
       containing `p`, its reflected row is the only row containing `f0`,
       and its later triangular tail contains neither boundary role nor the
       active role `b`.  Hence

           C_s-(p b)C_s  =  e_(s+1) tensor
                              Q_H(b,p;f_s,f_(s+1)),
           C_s-(f0 b)C_s =  e_(d+1-s) tensor
                              Q_H'(b,f0;f_s,f_(s+1)).

       These are primitive coefficient-one Johnson squares.  Using
       `1<=s<=floor(d/2)` covers every depth.  Relabelling and the integral
       Johnson-square theorem give, already in the sharp packet range

           d>=3, r>=d+4, k-r>=4,
           L_d = direct-sum_(q=2)^d ker_Z(partial_(r-q)).

       Thus the complete labelled formal all-depth occurrence lattice is
       saturated: no reflection, higher coupled linear invariant, parity or
       finite index remains.  The commutator has four differently labelled
       packet columns and generally different endpoints/owner slots.  It is
       not a fixed-slot native compiler column, creates no return-Hall edge,
       and leaves q1 unchanged.  Physical nonnegative realization and the
       nonlinear common-cap linkage remain open.

       The regenerative planting ledger is also exact, with one important
       cross-fibre correction.  In the canonical common-order orbit, fixing
       the endpoint and varying the action-invisible active label gives

           q_act=k-r-3

       candidates for one prescribed all-depth flag action.  Its variable
       owner/intersection/union budgets are `3d+8,3d+6,3d+10`; after one
       deadline jump they are `3d+11,3d+9,3d+13`.  Under literal cross-task
       source privacy, greedy owner selection costs `3d+11` per prior task,
       or `9d+33` when both lifted immediate palettes are private.  Shared
       incumbent owners are not 'free' on this disjoint face.

       This menu does NOT transfer to the corrected endpoint-planted
       breaker.  Literal replay with two active labels finds common
       endpoints but different lower actions at every calibrated depth.
       Conversely, the exact nested residence collar belongs to that
       planted fibre, not the canonical menu fibre.  In schedule
       `{0,2,4,6,8,10}`, one private bank of `d+1` labels builds two nested
       Johnson collars, saturates every old boundary run, and leaves only a
       deterministic monotone private-label boundary state.  One collar
       necessarily needs `k-r-4>=d+1`; `H` simultaneous collars require
       `H(d+1)` labels in the common complement of all packet supports.

       Therefore the exact next physical theorem is one of:

         (a) construct the canonical fixed-action packet collar; or
         (b) construct a fixed-action menu in the corrected planted fibre.

       After that identification, the strong `PHE_disj` face is exactly a
       state-expanded physically-simple port matching whose contracted
       quotient is one path, together with residual q1 and concatenated
       interval-OR-deck acceptance.  The weaker exact quantifier is
       `PHE_walk`: expose only the next prescribed safe edge in the current
       chronology.  Neither follows from scalar label surplus, bare Pascal
       Hall, or formal lattice saturation.  Terminal compilation still
       needs a basis-changing exterior return or an exact common-cap
       augmenting linkage.

2367R. Independent audit and compiler-boundary synthesis of item2366L.
       The sharp role-swap isolator is correct under exactly

           d>=3, r>=d+4, |Omega|-r>=4.

       If C_s is the adjacent-Ica twist correction, its only p-row is
       q=s+1 and its only f0-row is q=d+1-s; active role b is absent from
       every correction row.  Therefore

           C_s-(p b)C_s
             = e_(s+1) tensor Q_H(b,p;f_s,f_(s+1)),
           C_s-(f0 b)C_s
             = e_(d+1-s) tensor Q_H'(b,f0;f_s,f_(s+1)).

       The central even-depth case is valid because the nonselected central
       square is fixed and cancels.  The shallow square core has size
       r-s-3 and needs exactly s+7 outside labels; the available number is
       |Omega|-r+s+3, so corank four is both sufficient for this labelling
       and uses no fresh fifth role.  Every primitive square at every depth
       follows, hence the complete integer product lattice is saturated.

       In the central range |Omega|-r>=r-2, a separate harmonic audit gives
       unit, not merely factor-two, depth steps: pair active a with one
       exterior negative mate instead of with b.  Then the b-terms vanish
       and the polytabloid pairing is exactly

           1_(A subset P_t)-1_(A subset S_t)=1_(t>=s).

       This independently checks all higher rational multiplicities in the
       central range; it is not a sharp-corank-four proof because degree-j
       probes need j exterior mates.
       Unit Specht pairings alone would not prove integral saturation,
       because the Boolean permutation lattices do not split integrally;
       the literal role commutators are the decisive integer argument.

       The exact compiler boundary has two independent rows.  At q1, if
       the endpoint classes of missing colours have sizes z,ell,rho,b and
       u_L=min(ell,d), u_R=min(rho,d), the frozen candidate-cap deficiency
       is

           delta_top=z+ell+rho+b-u_L-u_R
                     -min(b,2d-u_L-u_R).

       The source proof was corrected: a deeper consecutive intersection
       may still have rank r-1.  The valid argument is that any interior cap
       containing a missing rank-(r-1) Q lies in an adjacent rank-(r-1)
       intersection and hence would equal an already present q1 colour.

       After an actual physical twist, terminal common-cap behavior is
       still exactly

           lambda(T+)-lambda(T-)=min_theta(ell(theta)-alpha(theta)),

       where ell is the number of old matched edges lost in the new state
       and alpha is the maximum disjoint augmenting-path count from the
       retained matching.  Thus full integral occurrence span does not
       imply one common-cap link.  A regenerative theorem must simultaneously
       realize the signed squares physically, export delta_top=O(1), and
       provide a coexistent state with alpha>=ell (strictly greater when a
       defect must contract).  No B(k)+O(1) claim is made.

2368ROOT. Rebased serial exterior-ear contraction and exact endpoint-chain
          transport.  The buffered-hexagon `B+O(1)` route no longer needs
          one simultaneous Haxell/LLL transversal on its weakest serial
          formulation.  Safe packet moves may overlap at different times,
          the returned catalyst may be reused, and U5 is solved only on the
          terminal carrier.

          The unconditional prospective U1--U4 accounting is now explicit.
          With `q=|Omega|-r-2`, the planted boundary atlas has `q(q-1)`
          options.  One option uses `16d+64` noncommon owner/lower-q1/
          upper-q1/prefix/suffix tokens, and a noncommon token occurs in at
          most `2(q-1)` options of one other atlas.  Under source-private
          common anchors,

              delta_12 <= (32d+128)(q-1).

          Thus every fixed bounded prospective bank clears Haxell once
          `q >> d`.  This is not a fixed-task quadratic menu: the old words
          and generally the lower actions differ.  For one prescribed
          canonical common-order action, the proved menu is only

              q_act=|Omega|-r-3,

          with `9d+33` exclusions per previous source-private task.  No
          action-invisible menu is proved for the endpoint-planted adjacent
          breaker.  Accordingly, “every repair task has Omega(k^2) whole
          packets” remains unproved and is not used.

          The exact surviving quantitative gate is the rank of physically
          certified basis-changing exterior ears.  If U is the exposed
          source set, P_X its legal entrances, and M_ear the strict gammoid
          of trace-/cap-guarded ears to unused physical compiler cells, then
          Rado gives the exact terminal residue

              delta_ear(U)=max_(X subset U)(|X|-r_Mear(P_X)).

          Hence the weakest direct contraction row is

              delta_ear(U) <= rho Phi_k + C,   rho<1.

          A checkable stronger form is

              |U| <= a Phi_k+b,
              r_Mear(P_X) >= (1-A d(k)/k)|X|-gamma

          for every X, which gives

              Phi_(k+2) <= a w0 A d(k)/k Phi_k + O(1).

          This coefficient tends to zero.  The planted integral breakers,
          twisted-cube all-depth cancellation, and returned-catalyst router
          close the signed and cycle parts, but all preserve the used cell
          basis.  Only a genuine exterior unused-cell endpoint can make
          `alpha>ell`; the exact scalar form remains

              lambda(T+)-lambda(T-)=min_theta(ell-alpha).

          Two endpoint coatom transporters were proved directly.  For
          `F={f0,...,fd}` and

              T_i=K union {infinity,a,b,c} union (F-{f_i}),

          take antecedents differing only at

              A0^epsilon=K union {infinity,c,epsilon,f1};

          use singleton staircase `A_j={f_(j+1)}`, put
          `A_(d-1)={a,b,fd}`, `A_d=K union {infinity,a,b,c}`,
          and maximal erosion afterward.  Both have D^d equal to T; their
          only different intervals are the prefixes of lengths `1,...,d-1`,
          exactly the two nested packet chains, while length d is common.
          The fresh-q1 variant replaces the endpoint filler order by
          `(f0,...,f_(d-1),x)` and uses `A_(d-1)={x}`.  Its changed prefixes
          are lengths `1,...,d`; q>=2 is the same chain transport and the
          length-d cell exports a fresh endpoint q1 a/b pair.  Across the
          coefficientwise-cancelling twisted cube, paired private endpoint
          gadgets give `alpha=ell` on the reserved chain cells.  Neither
          variant changes the physical basis, so neither alone supplies the
          open augmenting ear or proves the q1/common-cap Hall row.

          This is an exact conditional contraction synthesis only.  Global
          prospective planting, the exposed-source bound, the exterior-ear
          all-cut rank and one coexistent terminal cap state remain open.
          No `nu(k)<=B(k)+O(1)` claim and no Joos--Mubayi--Smith application
          is made.

2369TSR. The frozen top-shadow Hall gate now has an exact same-parity
         regenerative normal form.  Let `F` be a q1-rainbow spanning
         two-factor in `J(2r-1,r)`, cut its `c` components in colours
         `q_1,...,q_c`, and join the oriented paths by seams of colours
         `s_1,...,s_(c-1)`.  The final path's complete natural q1-hole set is

             {q_1,...,q_c} minus supp{s_1,...,s_(c-1)}.

         If `eta` interior cut colours `q_2,...,q_(c-1)` remain unrecycled,
         then for `d>=eta+2` the exact boundary-bank formula gives

             delta_top <= eta.

         The two outer unrecycled cut colours are contained in their own
         global endpoints and cost zero.  Corollary 2.6 of item2368ROOT
         makes this scalar fact physical locally: two disjoint relabelled
         fresh-q1 endpoint transporters carry those two colours while
         transporting the complete paired q>=2 endpoint chains.

             (z,ell,rho,b)=(0,0,0,1)

         closes to a q1-rainbow Hamilton cycle, and opening any edge of a
         cyclic q1-injective four-sector Pascal child returns the same B1
         state with `delta_top=0`.  The cyclic occurrence-labelled palette
         injectivity remains a hypothesis; no residence, upper-support or
         common-cap conclusion is inferred.  Abstract q1 existence alone is
         unconditional from the Middle Levels Theorem, but compatibility
         with the other Pascal/RSB gates is not.

         endpoints `x+T_0,y+T_last` and no cross-sector repair, inherited
         hole classes obey

             (z,ell,rho,b) -> (2z+ell+rho, ell+b, rho+b, 0).

         Starting from B1 this gives Z-debt `0,2,6,...`, so closure or

         `(0,1,1,0)` and `delta_top=0`; exactly one can be recovered to a
         q1-rainbow two-factor by deleting one seam and closing the two

2370A. Rebase of the single-block order breaker onto the sharp integral
       product theorem, with two new exact physical/compiler obstructions.

       First, the depthwise incidence lattice has a useful independent
       structural decomposition.  For rank s let

           L_s=ker_Z(partial_(s,1)),
           T_s=ker_Z(partial_(s,2)),
           K_2=ker_Z(partial_(2,1)).

       In the stable range there is an exact integer sequence

           0 -> T_s -> L_s -> K_2 -> 0.

       The kernel T_s is generated integrally by the three-dimensional
       octahedral trades

           (e_a-e_b) tensor (e_x-e_y) tensor (e_u-e_v)

       with a fixed (s-3)-core.  The proof is an induction on the ground
       size: the last-coordinate slice is a point-balanced (s-1)-uniform
       vector, hence a sum of Johnson squares; adjoining one fresh paired
       coordinate lifts each square to an octahedron.  At the base
       |Omega|=s+2, indexing by omitted pairs gives

           y_ij=r_i+r_j-T,
           (|Omega|-3)(r_i-T)=0,
           (|Omega|-2)T=0,

       so the kernel is zero.  This is an integral, not only rational,
       generation theorem.  In the canonical unplanted fibre, formal
       cross-flag commutators realize each pure-depth octahedron with one
       spare coordinate.  This factorization is not used to identify the
       endpoint-planted baseline, which has an eight-term rather than a
       four-term action.

       The sharp endpoint-planted full product remains exactly item2366L:
       for C_s=Delta^s-Delta^0,

           C_s-(p b)C_s
             =e_(s+1) tensor Q_H(b,p;f_s,f_(s+1)),
           C_s-(f0 b)C_s
             =e_(d+1-s) tensor Q_H'(b,f0;f_s,f_(s+1)).

       These primitive boundary-role commutators cover every depth and
       prove the complete integral product at corank four.  They also work
       at d=2: the p<->b subtraction cancels the coincident f0-square.

       Second, the twist cannot be manufactured inside one isolated block.
       Its internal q1 colours, after removing the fixed active/core part
       and complementing inside the filler set, are exactly the edge set
       of the omission-order Hamilton path.  Fixed first/last omissions
       orient that path, so equality of the q1 multiset forces the identical
       order.  A physical order actuator must therefore use a second block
       with the same active label, a matching screen bank, or a larger
       q1-compensated circuit.  The proved breaker transports a prepared
       twist; it does not enter the twisted fibre from the canonical source.

       Third, on the complete raw flat phase-common individual-incidence
       bank, an adjacent twist is strictly antitone.  For 1<=s<d it changes
       2d+2 columns per phase, 4d+3 in their union, and kills the complete
       old neighbourhood of exactly the following disjoint 2d columns:

           {c(u+s+1,h):1<=h<=d-s},
           {c(u+s-d-2,h):1<=h<=d-s-1},
           {c(u+s-h,h):1<=h<=s},
           {c(u+d+s+3-h,h):1<=h<=s+1},

       where u=6d+17.  It adds no raw common incidence; every other raw
       common neighbourhood is unchanged.  Hence a matching restricted to
       that fixed raw basis cannot improve.  This does not collapse the
       nonlinear cap-state disjunction.  With M chosen in an old optimizing
       state and ell(theta),alpha(theta) computed for a legal new state,

           delta_terminal-delta_old
             =min_theta(ell(theta)-alpha(theta)).

       A strict gain needs augmenting paths ending at previously unused
       physical cells.  Closed fixed-address squares/cubes/C6 circuits only
       route cycles and cannot supply that boundary.  The minimal remaining
       local theorem is therefore a prospectively planted or multi-block
       q1-compensated order actuator together with a trace-guarded,
       basis-changing exterior return bank.  No B(k)+O(1) claim is made.

2371D. Thread D has frozen a dependency-clean exact derivative and compiler
       interface for the endpoint-planted internal-order breakers.  If
       `C_s=Delta^(s)-Delta^0` is obtained by swapping only
       `f_s,f_(s+1)` in the label-attached `Ica` block, its complete
       all-depth correction is the sum of three explicitly indexed Johnson
       squares: the `p`-row at `q=s+1`, the `f0`-row at `q=d+1-s`, and a
       triangular `a/c` suffix tail at
       `q=d+1-s+h`, `1<=h<s`.  Overlapping depths add; all other rows are
       zero.  This formula is the authoritative endpoint-planted action and
       supersedes the incompatible same-schedule formulas in the older
       adjacent-order note.

       The sharp isolator is the four-column role commutator

           C_s-(p b)C_s
             = e_(s+1) tensor
                 Q_(K infinity c {f_(s+2),...,f_d})
                   (b,p;f_s,f_(s+1)).

       It uses no fresh role.  For

           d>=2, r>=d+4, |Omega|=k>=r+4,

       the relabelled common-order plus internal-twist catalogue therefore
       has the exact saturated integer action lattice

           direct-sum_(q=2)^d ker_Z(partial_(r-q)).

       The integral statement is proved without a modular-index shortcut:
       slice a point-balanced rank-j vector at one coordinate, express its
       zero-sum slice by edge differences in the connected Johnson graph,
       lift every edge difference by one coefficient-one square, and
       induct to the invertible `J-I` base at ground size `j+1`.  Thus no
       parity or finite-index obstruction survives.  At `k>=r+5`, the
       simpler fresh-`p'` two-twist difference gives the same pure square.

       This remains formal catalogue algebra.  The fresh-label pair shares
       every planted upper-screen owner.  The sharp expression has four
       signed columns from two labellings, and within each labelling its
       common-order/twisted columns have coincident owner sets.  Hence there
       is no simultaneous owner-disjoint lift, and no serial lift is
       proved.

       The terminal compiler gate is recorded exactly rather than folded
       into the lattice claim.  For legal complete cap states `theta`,

           lambda(T)=|L|-max_theta nu(G_theta(T));

       after a protected terminal matching `M0`, the same formula holds on
       residual shores.  Taking the union of state graphs is unsound: a
       literal two-target/two-cell `K_(2,2)` has marginal matching rank two
       but exact common-cap rank one.  Along one carryable guard schema
       `rho`, the exact drift is

           delta_rho(T')-delta_rho(T)=ell-alpha,

       where `ell` old matching edges are lost and `alpha` is the maximum
       disjoint augmenting-path count from the retained matching.  This is
       fixed-schema deficiency, not global `lambda`, and full occurrence
       span gives no lower bound on `alpha`.  The live theorem is a
       resource-disjoint/regenerative physical isolator plus a coexistent
       basis-changing return with `alpha>=ell`.  No all-k or `B(k)+O(1)`
       conclusion is claimed.

2372L. The q1 rainbow-sidecar/fresh-endpoint interface now has an exact
       occurrence-routing closure at the unrestricted owner/q1 level, and
       a sharp restricted-host min--max theorem.

       Let F be the direct four-sector theorem's literal q1-rainbow
       spanning two-factor in J(2m-1,m), and protect an edge e=AB of colour
       Q=A intersect B.  Subdividing every Johnson edge at its intersection
       is a bijection between q1-rainbow Johnson two-factors and spanning
       two-factors of the Middle Levels incidence graph.  The Middle Levels
       Theorem plus coordinate transitivity gives a Hamilton incidence
       cycle through A-Q-B.  The symmetric difference of the two incidence
       factors decomposes into closed alternating circuits avoiding those
       two protected incidences.  Toggling the circuits serially preserves
       degree two at every owner and every colour, retains e, and projects
       at every step to a q1-rainbow Johnson two-factor.  It terminates at a
       Hamilton cycle after at most W-1 circuits.  Opening e is exactly B1,
       so

                            delta_top=0,   eta_*=0.

       This starts only after the diamond-ready child factor exists.  A
       literal ML(7) B1 fixture is q1-rainbow but has the sole upper-union
       hole 0x3e, proving that B1 alone does not imply the union-transversal
       and cap-two hypotheses.  The unrestricted circuits may also leave
       the direct four-sector A/X/Y/U edge catalogue.  They do not preserve
       residence, deeper or upper shadows, U1--U4, or a common compiler cap.

       For m>=d+4 and d>=2, a prospectively planted fresh-q1 endpoint
       transporter may be relabelled with T_0=A and its length-d alternative
       equal to Q.  This certifies one candidate cell and transports the
       paired q>=2 endpoint chain.  Selecting Q displaces the cell's old
       alternative, so net q1 coverage still requires that target elsewhere
       in the same terminal cap state.

       On a restricted colour-pure provider bank P whose coexistence system
       is a matroid M, the exact unrecycled interior cut-colour debt is

           eta_M=max_(X subseteq Delta^circ)(|X|-r_M(N(X))).

       Hence eta_M<=C exactly when r_M(N(X))>=|X|-C for every X.  On private
       seam slots this is ordinary capacitated Hall/max-flow: augmenting
       paths lower eta by one and alternating cycles reroute occurrences.
       Full cyclic injectivity is the zero-defect rank row on all cut
       colours.  Crossing slot/resource constraints already fail matroid
       exchange on a three-provider fixture and cannot be compressed into
       this formula.  Independently, the frozen endpoint candidate bound
       sharpens to delta_top<=eta for every d>=1; using a physical fresh-q1
       transporter in that bound requires d>=2 and the displaced-target
       closure above.

       Thus plain cyclic q1 injectivity is closed on the complete incidence
       host.  The live exact theorem is a protected incidence router, or a
       colour-pure provider atlas satisfying the displayed rank row, whose
       occurrences also carry U1--U4 and one terminal common-cap
       certificate.  No residence, full upper-shadow, compiler, or
       B(k)+O(1) conclusion is made.

2373ROOT. The one-cell seam now has an exact literal trace algebra, which
       both validates its one typed socket and refutes the former claim that
       its fan and destroyed-crossing banks can be programmed independently.

       Put the inserted source at zero, let

           L_h=union_(t=0)^(h-1) A_(-t),
           R_h=union_(t=0)^(h-1) A_t,
           Z=L_1=R_1=A_0,

       and index the old length-d crossing cells by

           C_i=union_(t=1)^i A_(-t)
                union union_(t=1)^(d-i) A_t,
                    1<=i<=d-1.

       Then, exactly,

           Z union C_i = L_(i+1) union R_(d-i+1).

       A side occurrence at distance t gives crossing trace `i>=t` on the
       left and `i<=d-t` on the right.  Hence a coordinate outside Z is
       completely forced by the two fan chains.  A coordinate inside Z is
       hidden from both fan values when duplicated on the sides, and its
       crossing zero set can be programmed if and only if that zero set is
       an interval.  Conversely, these conditions reconstruct one literal
       local source word, so this is a characterization rather than only a
       necessary invariant.

       The shared singleton fan is a genuine typed socket precisely when
       its source value is the desired target S and S lies in the legal star
       envelope with all protected rows retained.  It consumes the sole fan
       surplus: after the two chains use 2(d-1) fan cells, an untyped seam
       leaves one fan address, while a typed seam leaves none and only the
       other d-1 raw addresses survive.  There is no unpriced second credit.

       The trace identity gives two sharp no-go statements.  First, if the
       lost C_i repay directly on one nested fan and all crossing owners
       Z union C_i have rank r, those owners are equal; a simple flat row is
       impossible.  A carrier-valid local seam instead has incomparable
       coatoms

           C_i={x} union (F-{f_(i+1)}).

       Second, for one canonical mixed-coatom packet, putting its old
       prefix and suffix chains on the two fans forces

           C_i={a,b} union F

       for every i.  These repeated crossings cannot be the d-1 distinct
       new-phase chain pins.  Thus the scalar one-credit Hall count is
       correct only conditionally; the actual construction needs a
       different cross-packet collar or a genuinely nonlocal exterior
       provider/gammoid route.

2374AD. The one-cell fan ledger has now been separated into its exact
        conditional Hall theorem and its actual twisted-cube trace
        obstruction.

        In one fixed nonzero terminal cap state, after the d-1 crossing
        targets have genuinely been returned on native cells, let O be the
        2(d-1) fan-chain targets, F the 2d-1 fan cells, S_theta the legal
        sinks of the exposed typed target, and

          Sp_theta={f in F: O matches into F-{f}}.

        Then the seam has strict one-credit gain exactly when

          S_theta intersect Sp_theta != empty.

        If O is saturable but this fails, the residual deficiency is exactly
        one.  Equivalently there is a tight set X subset O with

          |N_theta(X)|=|X|,   S_theta subset N_theta(X),

        and X union {h} is the canonical unit Hall cut.  This theorem is
        conditional on the crossing/native/fan rows coexisting in the same
        cap state; marginal fan counts or a union of cap states do not meet
        its hypothesis.

        The canonical OLD-fan/NEW-crossing proposal fails before that Hall
        test.  For one packet, with star payload S_tau subset
        G=K union {infinity,c}, the OLD prefix/suffix fans force

          C_i-S_tau=(G-S_tau) union {a,b,f_1,...,f_d}

        up to the interval-zero programming of star coordinates.  Every
        NEW prefix omits b and every NEW suffix omits a, so no crossing row
        is a NEW-chain pin; the smallest certificate is already one
        crossing row at d=2.

        More strongly, no different pair of twisted-cube chain families
        repairs this.  The eight chain bases are the eight transversals
        {a_i,b_j,c_k}.  Two distinct fan bases differ on some binary axis;
        both labels of that axis lie outside their common star and are
        forced into every crossing cell.  Every OLD/NEW cube-chain target
        contains exactly one label on each axis.  Thus all 56 ordered
        distinct fan pairs have zero crossing incidence to the entire cube
        chain bank.  Repeating one family violates the required
        2(d-1)-target injectivity.  Hence the advertised target-injective
        two-chain four-cube face is closed for all d>=2.  Repetition is not
        a trace no-go for a differently budgeted occurrence-multiset model;
        that model would need a new resource ledger.

        The same-packet fan glue is nevertheless a valid literal owner
        stutter and the typed singleton may be a legal low-rank target; what
        fails is payment of the destroyed strict-lower crossing bank.  The
        remaining route is nonlocal: change the crossing bank and exhibit
        other native cells, leave the cube-chain fan catalogue, or build a
        trace-guarded exterior gammoid return.  No B+1 conclusion is made.

2374H2. The valid Delcourt--Postle `N-o(N)` four-resource matching now has
       an exact bounded Boolean cover-down interface, with its correlation
       gate stated fail-closed.

       On owner rank m, let K have size m-2 and choose fresh a,b,c,s.  With

           A1=X_ab, A2=X_ac, A3=X_bc,
           B1=X_as, B2=X_bs, B3=X_cs,

       orient every A socket as a tail and every B socket as a head.  The
       old phase

           e_a=(D_a,U_acs;A2->B1),
           e_b=(D_b,U_abs;A1->B2),
           e_c=(D_c,U_bcs;A3->B3)

       and the new phase

           f_a=(D_a,U_abs;A1->B1),
           f_b=(D_b,U_bcs;A3->B2),
           f_c=(D_c,U_acs;A2->B3)

       use exactly the same three lower colours, three upper colours, three
       tails and three heads.  Taking e_b as target gives the literal
       gain-one circuit

                  {e_a,e_c} -> {f_a,f_b,f_c},

       whose incidence difference is exactly one aligned target atom.  The
       five-operation serialization

           -e_a,+f_a,-e_c,+f_b,+f_c

       respects tail/head capacity at every prefix.

       The physical q1 wrapper is also classified exactly.  Of all six
       complementary rail pairings, the unique one making both full phases
       a single directed cycle is

           B1->A3, B2->A2, B3->A1  (tau=(13)).

       For three internally vertex-disjoint literal rails with this endpoint
       pairing, opening the same untouched rail edge makes both full phases
       directed paths with the same endpoints.  If the cycles are spanning
       q1-rainbow Hamilton cycles, both opened paths are literal B1 states
       with the same missing occurrence.  The off gain state has two cuts
       and is not itself B1; the q1 sidecar is a separate state Sigma_i
       transported by the full old-to-new phase switch.

       Serially applying r=h-c resource-private packet records to an
       N-h forest gives an N-c directed forest.  On the normalized fixed-Q
       host it changes the exact leave from (h,h,2h) to (c,c,2c).  Every
       step requires the new three edges to be independent after contracting
       the current forest with its off pair removed, plus one literal
       Sigma_(i-1)->Sigma_i opening certificate.  On the strong
       selector-separable face, the smallest residual pair debt relative to
       the declared bank is exactly

           delta(B)=max_(X subseteq L0)(|X|-|N_B(X)|).

       This Hall formula quantifies over every graph matching and includes
       off envelopes, tail/head ports, rails, cuts, opening occurrences and
       current-state graphic composition.  Outside that face the footprint
       problem is genuinely higher-dimensional.

       Delcourt--Postle does not plant these off phases, align its leave to
       comparable L subset U targets, supply the unique rails, or bound the
       literal compiler cost of c unresolved quartets.  Thus this is an
       exact conditional O(1)-resource cover-down theorem, not an
       unconditional B(k)+O(1) result and not a JMS exact-matching claim.

2375A. The common-cap part of the one-cell star-hidden two-fan ear now has
       an exact maximal-word characterization, including mixed exterior
       rows.

       Let P_p be the literal cap at each of

           p in {0,-1,...,-(d-1),1,...,d-1},

       let a physical row J have target T_J and frozen exterior contribution
       E_J, and put

           K_p=P_p intersect intersection_(J contains p) T_J.

       One nonzero common-Q word exists exactly when

           E_J subset T_J,   K_p != empty,
           T_J=E_J union union_(p in J) K_p

       for every row and position.  The word A_p=K_p is the unique
       componentwise maximal realization.  Thus a failed target equality is
       exactly a positive-cover core, while an empty K_p is exactly an
       empty-position core.  Frozen exterior OR contributions must be
       carried as E_J; replacing a mixed row by a wholly local equality is
       unsound.

       For the fan/crossing bank this specializes to

           K_0=P_0 intersect Z intersect all L_h intersect all R_h,
           K_t^-=P_(-t) intersect intersection_(i>=t) C_i
                         intersect intersection_(h>t) L_h,
           K_t^+=P_t intersect intersection_(i<=d-t) C_i
                        intersect intersection_(h>t) R_h,

       with exact reconstruction

           Z=K_0,
           L_h=K_0 union union_(t<h)K_t^-,
           R_h=K_0 union union_(t<h)K_t^+,
           C_i=union_(t<=i)K_t^- union union_(t<=d-i)K_t^+.

       In the cap-free form, the two fan chains must be nested; outside Z,

           C_i-Z=(L_(i+1) union R_(d-i+1))-Z;

       inside Z, each crossing zero trace must be one interval.  The two
       side words are nonzero exactly when

           L_2 intersect all_i C_i != empty,
           R_2 intersect all_i C_i != empty.

       For complementary coatom chains with bases B_L,B_R and fillers
       F={f_1,...,f_d}, put

           G=F union ((B_L union B_R)-Z).

       Their exact target-only crossing normal form is

           empty != Z subset B_L intersect B_R,
           G subset C_i subset G union Z,

       plus the interval-zero condition on each z in Z.  Every filler and
       every base coordinate outside Z is forced into every crossing.
       Endpoint filler thresholds are (1,infinity) and (infinity,1);
       there is no fictitious side position d.  With caps, all forced
       filler/base first occurrences and all chosen hidden threshold copies
       must pass the displayed K-test.  A single typed star common to the
       two endpoint phases needs nonempty Z subset B_0 intersect B_1.

       If N consecutive crossing targets with fixed outside bank G are
       pairwise distinct, then

                             N <= 2|Z|.

       Each hidden bit changes at most twice; equality N=2|Z|+1 would make
       every bit change twice and repeat the initial state.  The bound is
       sharp: turn h bits off successively and then the first h-1 back on,
       giving 2h distinct interval-zero states.  Hence d-1 distinct
       crossings require |Z|>=ceil((d-1)/2), subject to the literal caps.

       Nested marginals already fail at d=2:

           Z={a}, L_2={a,b}, R_2={a,c}, C_1={b}.

       Here K_1^+=empty; the target (R_2,c) is erased by the singleton and
       crossing negative pins.  The typed singleton still consumes the
       unique fan surplus, leaving d-1 physical addresses, not d.  The
       exact remaining gate is therefore one planted cap state containing
       the forced coatom increments and enough persistent hidden copies,
       while retaining all mixed exterior positives and connecting the
       d-1 addresses to the global compiler.  No B(k)+O(1) claim is made.

       old crossing interval with `u` left and `v` right positions,

           I_(u,v)={-u,...,-1,1,...,v},

       if `u+v<=d-1` its transported hull is still a short cell and has

           C_(u,v) union Z,

       where `Z` is the inserted star.  Hence a selected old pin transports
       unchanged iff its target contains `Z`; otherwise it needs a distinct
       return edge.  This is part of common-Q, not a marginal Hall row.

       If a star coordinate has first side occurrences `lambda,rho`, its
       incompatible shorter pins are exactly

           u<lambda, v<rho, u+v<=d-1.

       A zero at the single destroyed split `i` costs exactly
       `i(d-i)-1` shorter cells.  Using coordinates `z_i` to realize the
       distinct coatom crossings `N_i=U-{z_i}` makes the union of those
       rectangles the complete shorter crossing triangle, of size

                         binom(d-1,2).

       This code is literal and gives rank-(r-1) destroyed targets when

           empty != S_tau,
           M_* union M_pin subset S_tau
             subset P_* intersect intersection_(I contains *) S(I).

                         alpha_loc=ell+1,

2377D. The one-cell star-hidden seam has now been reconciled exactly with
       the prepared two-phase coatom boundary theorem and the compiler
       socket ledger.

       Write Z for the star source, C_i for the d-1 destroyed crossings,
       and L_j,R_j for the two fan chains.  The governing identity is

                 Z union C_i=L_(i+1) union R_(d-i+1).

       Hence fan/crossing data are never arbitrary: outside Z the crossing
       traces are forced, while a coordinate of Z has exactly an
       interval-zero trace.  The associated integer incidence matrix has
       Smith form I_(d-1), but its formal rank-d kernel is not a positive
       bank of d programmable sockets.

       There is nevertheless one exact asymmetric phase selector.  For a
       nonempty redundant core C, bases B_0=C+a,B_1=C+b, and prefix flag
       F_i, phase epsilon may be realized by

         Z=B_epsilon,  X_(-t)=C+f_t,
         X_(+1)=B_(1-epsilon),  X_(+t)=C (t>=2).

       Then C_i=B_(1-epsilon)+F_i is the opposite-phase OLD family and
       L_(i+1)=B_epsilon+F_i is the native NEW family.  All d right-fan
       addresses are unused by those assignments.  A source-disjoint
       endpoint carve may supply the opposite-phase family in the same
       terminal state, conditional on literal carrier replay.  This is a
       one-chain, phase-specific statement; R_2,...,R_d have one common
       value and are not d programmable target values.

       The full prepared two-chain coatom packet is false already at d=2.
       Exact prefix/suffix fan realization forces both active labels and
       every filler into every destroyed crossing.  No crossing can equal
       either swapped NEW chain, which omits one active label; in the
       canonical glue all crossings are the same full owner.  The stronger
       frozen AD result excludes every distinct twisted-cube OLD-family
       pairing, so an escape must leave that catalogue, change the collar,
       or use an exterior return.

       Finally, for every exact row or protected pin through the star, let
       T_j be its required value and U_j the frozen nonstar union.  Put

          P_*=intersection_j T_j,
          M_*=union_j(T_j-U_j).

       A nonempty star value Z is legal iff U_j subset T_j for every j and
       M_* subset Z subset P_*.  A literal singleton target S_tau requires
       Z=S_tau; one target common to two phases must meet both containment
       systems and

          M_*^0 union M_*^1 subset S_tau
            subset P_*^0 intersection P_*^1.

       Thus typing the singleton consumes the unique fan surplus.  The
       gross seam gain is d, but only d-1 other addresses remain, and those
       are compiler credits only after a separate pre/post basis bijection.
       The prepared complementary coatom packet fails trace compatibility
       before its Hall row is reached.  No B+1 or signed-lattice conclusion
       is claimed.

2378L. The requested finite-H protected version of the q1 alternating reset
       has an exact rooted-target reduction, but the unqualified extension
       statement is false even for an absolute protected bank.

       Let F be a q1-rainbow spanning two-factor in J(2m-1,m), let P be p
       physical Johnson edges of F to be retained, and let N=C(2m-1,m).
       Protected Hamiltonization is equivalent to existence of a
       q1-rainbow Hamilton target C containing P.  Indeed, after lifting F
       and C to Middle Levels incidence factors, their symmetric difference
       splits into edge-disjoint simple alternating circuits.  The two
       incidences of every edge of P are common and occur in no circuit, so
       toggling the circuits in any order fixes P and stays q1-rainbow.  As
       Middle Levels has no C4, one may take

                   t <= floor(2(N-p)/3)

       circuits.  Conversely, the terminal state of any protected circuit
       route is such a rooted Hamilton target.

       A named adjacent-upper colour R is preserved throughout if one
       common realizing edge AB with A union B=R is added to P.  Terminal
       recreation without a common edge needs an additional circuit-order
       dependency and is not automatic.  An ordered Boolean atom also
       needs one global orientation of C agreeing with every prescribed
       tail/head direction.  Arbitrary-width interval-OR witnesses are
       chronology constraints, not incidence resources, and are outside
       this theorem.

       The rooted-target hypothesis is necessary.  On ground 01234, the
       q1-rainbow factor

         (012,014,134,034,024,012) disjoint union
         (013,023,234,124,123,013)

       contains the protected matching

         P={012-024,013-023,124-234,034-134}.

       Its eight owners, four lower colours {02,03,24,34}, and four upper
       unions {0124,0123,1234,0134} are all distinct.  Nevertheless exactly
       two q1-rainbow factors contain P, both of profile 5+5.  In ML(5), the
       four protected lower vertices force four edges of the complementary
       perfect matching; two further forced edges leave one residual C8,
       with exactly two perfect matchings.  Their complements are the two
       non-Hamilton factors.  Hence there is no protected Hamilton target
       and no alternating basis avoiding those eight incidences.

       The four atoms partition into two legal Boolean-hex O^- pairs, but
       their complete typed packet supports intersect.  Thus the example
       refutes inference from a planted old matching, while leaving open a
       stronger prospectively source-private packet theorem and any theorem
       with a threshold m_0(H).

       Two exact abundance facts survive.  On the odd q1 host, the raw
       Boolean-hex Cartesian fan has (m-1)(m-2) choices, not the even-host
       (m-1)^2; deleting z typed resources leaves at least

                    max(0,(m-1)(m-2-z))

       formal options.  This does not plant O^- or certify component
       merging.  Separately, an incidence edge belongs to exactly the 2/m
       fraction of all Middle Levels Hamilton cycles.  Therefore b<m/2
       literal forbidden incidences leave at least a 1-2b/m fraction of
       Hamilton targets.  If F also avoids them, its reset has a circuit
       basis avoiding them.  Required protected paths are different: the
       counterexample shows that this pure-forbidden count cannot be
       conditioned for free.

       The live bounded-absorber theorem is consequently a joint
       source-private packet/rooted-Hamilton selection, or an applicable
       upper-neutral Boolean-C6 supply theorem which merges a component at
       every nonterminal state.  Raw quadratic menus alone prove neither.
       Residence, deeper shadows and common-cap compilation remain outside
       scope; no B(k)+O(1) conclusion is made.

2379R. The one-cell seam/fresh-q1 integration now has a single exact
       proved/conditional boundary, including the crossing trace, common
       cap, triangular collateral, matching gain and four-sector host rows.

       For a typed star S, two strict old deep chains

         S=O^L_0 subset ... subset O^L_(d-1),
         S=O^R_0 subset ... subset O^R_(d-1)

       can occupy the two nonsingleton fans while the destroyed length-d
       cells carry N_i iff

         N_i-S=(O^L_i union O^R_(d-i))-S

       and every s in S has an interval zero trace across the N_i.  With
       caps and mixed exterior rows, this target-only criterion must be
       replaced by the exact maximal-word test

         K_p=P_p intersect intersection_(J contains p)T_J,
         K_p nonempty,
         T_J=E_J union union_(p in J)K_p.

       Here E_J is the frozen exterior OR contribution; dropping it is
       unsound.  The typed singleton itself is legal exactly when its value
       contains every star-mandatory coordinate and lies inside every
       star-containing cap/target.

       For complementary coatom fans with bases B_L,B_R and filler bank F,
       a common star requires nonempty S subset B_L intersect B_R.  Every
       crossing contains

         G=F union ((B_L union B_R)-S)

       and may vary only through interval-zero bits in S.  Pairwise-distinct
       d-1 crossings therefore require |S|>=ceil((d-1)/2).  Bases and
       crossings are prospective joint data, not independent menus.

       On an abstract private prepared bank, the core matching arithmetic is
       exact.  The old two-chain plus crossing matching has 3d-3 edges; the
       two fans restore 2d-2 OLD targets, one native copy restores every N_i,
       and the singleton supplies one previously unmatched typed target.
       Hence alpha_loc=ell+1.  For the full band one must additionally give
       a basis-neutral return to every selected shorter crossing pin whose
       target does not contain S, and to every other displaced old edge.
       If r_ret is their total number, then

         ell=3d-3+r_ret,  alpha_loc=ell+1

       exactly on a closed affected fibre.  The typed singleton consumes
       one of the gross d new addresses, leaving d-1 unused addresses.

       The canonical two-sided fresh-q1/coatom glue does NOT instantiate
       this theorem.  Its old complementary fans force every destroyed
       crossing to contain both active labels and the entire filler bank;
       the canonical NEW prefix/suffix targets omit one active label and
       part of the filler bank.  Thus the crossing/native incidence is zero
       already at d=2.  In the literal canonical sources all crossings and
       star-diagonal owners are the same full owner U; for d>=4 the owner
       multiplicity alone exceeds the W+1 budget.  The fresh-q1 cells still
       have a useful local property: around a protected edge AB of colour Q,
       two prescribed coatom arcs can be owner- and lower-palette-disjoint
       for m>=d+4, and their two boundary cells can carry the one B1 target
       Q.  They do not repay the deep crossings.

       One exact asymmetric escape survives: in phase epsilon, star
       B_epsilon, left sources C+f_t and right source B_(1-epsilon) make the
       left fan the native NEW prefix chain and the destroyed crossings the
       opposite OLD prefix chain; the right fan has one repeated target
       value.  This is one-chain and phase-specific, not the desired
       two-chain packet.

       A conditional B(k)+1 theorem is now completely explicit: require an
       independent native/cross-packet bank, every triangular return, valid
       simple diagonal owners, depth-d residence, one maximal common-cap
       state, protected upper replay, and a q1-rainbow rooted Hamilton target
       containing the full 2d+1-edge coatom segment.  Equality-stuttering
       then preserves the strict q1 palette and every old upper interval.
       The rooted Hamilton target is genuine extra structure: item2378L's
       ML(5) protected-edge example refutes automatic finite-bank extension.
       No current four-sector theorem supplies all these rows, so there is
       no B+1 or B+O(1) conclusion.

2380ROOT. The ordered-diamond Boolean-hex lane now has an exact positive
       bounded-cycle sidecar and an equally important black-box no-go.

       The ternary Boolean C6 switch is an exact four-resource 2-to-3
       absorber: its old and new phases have identical lower, upper, tail
       and head resources.  In cycle mode a selected target edge on one
       cycle and two partner edges on distinct paths can be toggled without
       consuming a graphic sink.  A fixed bank of such packets can be
       planted before a Delcourt--Postle near-forest is chosen.

       That packet cannot be extracted from an arbitrary near-forest.  The
       system of all old C6 phases is linear, has degree (m-1)^2 and pair
       codegree one, and is itself sparse enough to be declared forbidden
       in the valid Delcourt--Postle colouring theorem.  Even after planting
       one directed physical C4, the residual body can be chosen so that the
       C4 is the unique cycle and no ternary old phase is present.  Thus
       near-perfectness, fixed physical girth, and the full colouring output
       do not force even one post-hoc C6 actuator.

       Conditional cycle contraction is exact.  If every cycle C has at
       least L applicable packets and every physical component belongs to at
       most rho listed packet footprints, a maximal component-disjoint bank
       kills at least

                     cL/(L+3(rho-1))

       of c cycles.  In particular L>=m^epsilon rho contracts cycle debt by
       a factor at most 3m^(-epsilon).  The supply inequality must be imposed
       while the body is selected; it is false for arbitrary DP outputs.

       The new square-collar actuator removes the need to discover a packet
       after the fact for bounded named debt.  Collar one target edge EF by
       a Johnson return path F-X-Y-E and two private old edges AB,CD.  The
       old six-atom state is the disjoint union of the directed C4
       E-F-X-Y-E and AB,CD; the new state consists of the two paths

                     A-F-X-Y-E-D,       C-B.

       Both phases have exactly the same complete typed support.  There are
       [(m-1)(m-2)]^2 collars per target, and a fixed forbidden resource
       removes only O(m^3), so every fixed bank of disjoint named targets has
       private actuators for all sufficiently large m.  Its phase cube has
       cycle count exactly the number of minus bits, and the commuting
       all-plus reset sends bounded central cycle debt to zero without a
       fresh graphic endpoint.

       Consequently the topology coordinate of a bounded regenerative
       sidecar is solved.  If an odd/even spine exports at most H such
       private collared cycles, has length charge s and terminal literal
       charge h, the bounded-spine theorem gives

                         nu(k) <= B(k)+s+h.

       This remains conditional.  The exact missing theorem is guarded
       collar export: the Pascal child must present its bounded cycle debt
       already in the old collared state and carry one chronology satisfying
       residence/erosion, q>=2 witness transparency, and occurrence-labelled
       common-cap linkage through the all-plus phase.  The central resource
       identity alone proves none of those three guards.

2381AD. The question whether a directed cycle itself forces a bounded or
       length-linear four-resource absorber has a sharp negative answer.

       For an ordered Boolean-diamond atom e write its four resources as

                   (L(e),U(e),T(e),H(e)).

       An exact exchange O -> N preserves each of these four resource
       multisets.  In particular, for every physical middle vertex X,

          deg_O^+(X)=deg_N^+(X),   deg_O^-(X)=deg_N^-(X).

       Hence an exchange whose old phase is supported only on directed
       cycle components preserves indegree and outdegree one at every
       vertex in their union.  Its new physical graph there is another
       directed cycle cover.  No support bound changes this: even an old
       phase equal to the whole cycle cannot remove the last cycle.  The
       canonical O(length) kernel move is full reversal, which leaves the
       same physical cycle.  A genuine contraction must import at least one
       old atom from an endpoint-bearing path component, or relax one of
       the four resource equalities.

       The obstruction has an exact literal Boolean family.  For an
       (m-2)-set S and distinct cyclic labels x_0,...,x_(ell-1), where
       4<=ell<=m+2, put

          T_i=S+{x_i,x_(i+1)},
          L_i=S+{x_(i+1)},
          U_i=S+{x_i,x_(i+1),x_(i+2)},
          e_i=(L_i,U_i,T_i,T_(i+1)).

       These atoms form an induced q1-rainbow directed C_ell.  The complete
       ordered-diamond resource box on their four typed banks contains
       exactly the two orientations of each cycle edge.  For any proper
       old subset I, exact balance forces the replacement to be identical.
       For I equal to the full cycle, the only phases are identity and full
       reversal.  Algebraically, if r_i records reversal, tail balance is

             1_I(i) r_i = 1_I(i-1) r_(i-1),

       so a proper I forces all r_i=0, while a full I permits only all zero
       or all one.  Thus every fixed bounded cycle-internal catalogue is
       avoided, and in fact the unrestricted cycle-internal fibre has no
       topology-improving move.  At m=2, ell=4 this C4 uses every rank-one
       and rank-three outer colour, so it is an exact outer-complete
       four-resource factor.  It is the smallest full-factor counterexample;
       Johnson triangles necessarily repeat one lower or one upper colour.

       A stronger all-large-m near-factor no-go uses a Johnson moat.  Delete
       both typed copies of the closed Johnson neighbourhood of the
       protected C4, plus its eight outer resources, then apply the audited
       Delcourt--Postle fixed-girth colouring and delete one atom per long
       residual cycle.  The deleted O(m^2) resources remove only O(D^2)
       host atoms, where D=m(m+1), so the retained forest has size

          (ND-O(D^2))/(D(1+D^(-alpha_g))) = N-o(N).

       Exact tail/head balance cannot cross the moat.  A residual atom also
       cannot carry a protected L_i or U_i: every rank-m extension of L_i
       and every rank-m facet of U_i lies in the deleted closed
       neighbourhood.  Therefore every exact exchange, even with arbitrary
       support in the residual forest, splits across the moat; its protected
       phase is identity or full reversal.  This constructs an N-o(N)
       one-cycle body immune to every exact resource-neutral exchange, and
       hence to every fixed finite catalogue.  It is deliberately not an
       exact outer-complete factor for m>2; that stronger completion scope
       remains open.

       The exact successor-bijection normal form and graphic-rank ledger
       are separately audited: every neutral phase is a Johnson-legal
       bijection from its old tail bank to its old head bank preserving the
       complete lower and upper palettes, and cycle reduction is exactly
       graphic-rank gain after contracting the common remainder.  One-point
       lower/upper flux cancellation is necessary but not sufficient.

       This result is central-resource/topology only.  Residence, deeper
       shadows, prefix/suffix OR decks, star-hidden traces, common cap and
       literal chronology remain independent guards.  The live positive
       target is therefore an endpoint-relative cycle-plus-path exchange,
       not another post-hoc cycle-internal catalogue.

2381ROOT. The square-collar sidecar now has an explicit depth-safe long
       return rail, so residence is no longer one of its three open guards.

       For target edge E=L+delta -> F=L+alpha, choose ordered lists

         x_1,...,x_s in L-{b},
         y_1,...,y_s outside (L+alpha+delta)-{c}.

       Starting at F, successively swap x_j to y_j while retaining alpha;
       swap alpha to delta; then swap y_j back to x_j in the same order.
       The resulting F-to-E Johnson path has 2s+1 edges.  Collaring the
       Boolean-hex target edge with this path gives two exact phases with
       identical lower, upper, tail and head signatures:

         minus: one directed cycle of length 2s+2 plus AB and CD;
         plus:  the paths A-F-(rail)-E-D and C-B.

       On the minus cycle every nonconstant coordinate trace has one
       positive run of length exactly s+1.  On the plus paths every
       nonboundary positive run has length at least s+1.  Taking s=d(k)
       therefore makes both phases flat-depth-d residence-safe whenever
       d(k)<=m-2.  There are exactly ((m-2)_s)^2 ordered rails for one fixed
       packet, and the rail support has width O(d) but adds no word length
       when substituted into an equal-size prepared owner segment.

       The cycle also has an exact wreath normal form.  With

         K=L-{x_1,...,x_s},
         pi=(delta,x_1,...,x_s,alpha,y_1,...,y_s),

       its owners are K plus the cyclic consecutive (s+1)-windows of pi,
       and its depth-s antecedent is the literal cyclic word K+{pi_i}.
       A block of q+1 owners is K plus a consecutive (s+q+1)-window.
       Opening the target edge to obtain the common plus-phase path removes
       exactly q local witnesses at depth q.  The complete local collateral
       over depths 1,...,s is therefore the explicit triangular bank of
       s(s+1)/2 pairwise-distinct targets before endpoint ladders or bulk
       duplicate witnesses are used.

       This leaves two, not three, collar guards: arbitrary-width upper
       interval witnesses and the occurrence-labelled common cap.  The
       return path reorders the same owner bank, so neither follows from
       immediate palette equality.  Prepared-segment existence also remains
       open; no unconditional B(k)+O(1) conclusion is made.

2382ROOT. The exact central four-resource problem has a new
       full-coordinate-rotation quotient certificate through m=6, and the
       m=6 cyclic residue is closed exactly by the square-collar actuator.

       Let C_(2m) rotate all coordinates.  Restrict to diamond edge orbits
       whose projections cover one lower necklace and one upper necklace
       bijectively.  Selecting such orbits is an exact invariant cap-two
       factor iff every lower and upper necklace is selected once and every
       literal middle load is at most two.  For a fixed invariant max-degree
       two support, the remaining outer selection is ordinary quotient Hall.
       Stabilizer weights are essential: a middle necklace of size s hit by
       one full edge orbit receives literal load (2m)/s.

       Exact replay finds full-rotation factors for every 2<=m<=7.  Their
       physical cycle profiles are:

         m=2: forest;
         m=3: two C6s (one quotient C2, voltage gcd 2);
         m=4: forest;
         m=5: forest;
         m=6: twelve C4s (one quotient C4, voltage zero).
         m=7: forest (429 paths).

       The m=6 factor contains twenty-four exact old square-collar phases.
       Their old toggle triples and new toggle triples are separately
       pairwise disjoint.  Applying all twenty-four zero-current toggles
       replaces 72 edges by 72 edges, preserves the complete rank-five and
       rank-seven palettes, keeps maximum degree two and C_12 invariance,
       and leaves no cycle.  The result is a spanning linear forest with
       exactly Cat_6=132 paths.  This is a finite exact central theorem, not
       a full word or all-m construction.

       Dhand's necklace-SCD theorem supplies a natural outer-orbit bijection,
       but does not by itself pay the weighted middle row when the nominated
       middle necklace is periodic.  The sharpened all-m target is a
       necklace-SCD weighted rethreading whose residual cycle orbits carry a
       rotation-closed square-collar bank.
