2383A. The common-cap and resource ledger for a fixed bank of H disjoint
       typed one-cell sockets is now exact, including intervals spanning
       several ears and frozen exterior OR contributions.

       Let V be the disjoint union of live position banks V_s.  For every
       assigned row R, let J_R be its live positions, E_R its frozen
       exterior union, T_R its target, and P_p the cap at p.  Put

           K_p=P_p intersect intersection_(R:p in J_R) T_R.

       One literal nonzero common-Q word exists iff

           E_R subset T_R,  K_p != empty,
           T_R=E_R union union_(p in J_R)K_p

       for every row and position.  The maximal word A_p=K_p works.  In
       coordinate form, every demanded pair (R,x), x in T_R-E_R, merely
       needs one surviving provider p in J_R.  Therefore fixed-assignment
       Boolean common-Q has no higher subset-Hall obstruction.  Every
       failure has one of three certificate types: exterior overflow, empty
       screened position, or one uncovered row-coordinate pair.  Target
       injection, fixed-rank source alphabets and owner/q1 resources remain
       separate matching problems.

       Exact cross-socket trimming is also closed.  Form each one-ear local
       maximum K_p^0, intersect it with every mixed-row target through p,
       then recheck all local reconstructions and the mixed equalities.  The
       untrimmed local words factor exactly when every local ear is feasible
       and

           T_R=E_R union union_(p in J_R)K_p^0

       for every mixed row.  On ordered ears, each spanning interval
       reduces exactly to a suffix union of its first ear, total unions of
       the interior ears, and a prefix union of its last ear.  This is a
       literal fixed-address signature, not only OR-deck inclusion.

       The exact cost units differ:

           added source cells                  H,
           gross short-band cells              H d,
           typed singleton fan credits used    H,
           residual addresses                  H(d-1),
           live source/cap footprint            Theta(Hd),
           full local semantic rows             H R_d,

       where

           R_d=3d-2+binom(d-1,2)=(d^2+3d-2)/2.

       Thus word-length cost is O(H), cap/address bookkeeping is O(Hd),
       and the complete fan/destroyed-crossing/triangular replay has
       Theta(Hd^2) rows.  The H(d-1) address conclusion is conditional on
       the certified crossing/collateral returns; common-Q itself does not
       construct those returns.

       A sharp conditional Pascal planting theorem follows.  Supports of
       radius d-1 whose centres differ by at least 3d-1 are invisible to
       every unprotected row of length at most d+1.  On a resource-private
       candidate catalogue, more than (H-1)(6d-3) certified centres per
       typed task suffice by greedy packing.  If one candidate has at most
       Delta_phys additional conflicts in a later list, replace 6d-3 by
       6d-3+Delta_phys.  Under the final owner-complete, resident,
       upper-complete and lower-augmenting hypotheses, the H ears give a
       universal word of length

                              B(k)+H.

       Owner degree two, q1 injection, connected topology and long upper
       witnesses are explicit joint hypotheses, not consequences of
       geometric separation.  The current private coatom implementation
       uses H(rho-1)=Theta(Hd) auxiliary labels and 2H(rho-1) collar owners;
       this is sufficient, not a universal lower bound.  A formal
       owner-disjoint bank fits when r>=d+4 and

                       r-2+6H+H(rho-1)<=k,

       but accepting Pascal chronology remains open.  The canonical
       complementary two-chain coatom glue already fails the one-ear trace
       row at d=2, so no unconditional fixed-H planting theorem follows.

       A minimal cross-socket core has H=2,d=2.  Each ear is locally the
       constant {a} word.  A mixed row with E={a}, T={a,b} leaves every K_p
       nonempty but has no provider for b.  The dual choice E=T={b} empties
       the touched positions.  Hence local feasibility alone is genuinely
       insufficient, although there is no larger Hall circuit behind the
       failure.

2384ROOT. Every near-optimal universal OR word now has a new
       architecture-free necessary structure: a uniformly short endpoint
       chain decomposition of the entire lower Boolean ideal.

       Let a universal word have length L=W+e, where W=binom(k,r) and
       r=ceil(k/2).  Choose one witness interval for every rank-r target.
       Those W intervals are pairwise noncontaining.  When ordered by left
       endpoint as I_i=[ell_i,u_i], both endpoint sequences are strictly
       increasing and

                         i <= ell_i <= u_i <= i+e.

       Hence every interval of length e+1 contains I_i for its own starting
       index and has union rank at least r.  Every lower target therefore
       has a witness of length at most e.  Group one chosen witness for each
       lower target by its right endpoint.  At a fixed endpoint the suffix
       unions are nested, so the groups are inclusion chains of size at most
       min(e,j).  They partition all ranks 1,...,r-1, and summing capacities
       gives exactly

                    Lambda <= eW+binom(e+1,2).

       Thus the deadline lower bound is the scalar shadow of a stronger
       uniform-chain theorem.  If nu(k)<=B(k)+C, the lower ideal must be
       serialized into at most W+d+C chains of maximum length d+C, with
       Lambda/W=d+O(1).  For even k the correct full-lattice average is

                    2^k/W=sqrt(pi*k/2)+O(k^(-1/2))
                         =2d(k)+O(1),

       not its reciprocal.  Complementation supplies the matching upper
       scale, but pairing and serializing the two shores remains extra.

2385ROOT. Exact zero-defect U5 is no longer the correct terminal target for
       an additive-constant theorem.  It has been replaced by a rigorous
       bounded-eviction row, with the common-cap caveat made explicit.

       In one final literal cap state, let M_0 match every old lower target
       to a realizing physical cell.  Suppose h packet tasks have distinct
       certified cells b_i, and D is the complete set of cells on which old
       M_0 realizations fail after all packets and cap shrinkage are applied.
       Deleting the M_0 edges on D union {b_i} and adding the task tickets
       leaves at most

                         |D intersect cells(M_0)|+h

       old targets unmatched.  No global Hall theorem is needed after the
       complete literal damage set has been certified.  At the terminal
       dimension those casualties are appended once.

       The word "complete" is essential.  A cell which is legal for one
       packet in isolation is not a ticket: assigning its target may shrink
       source letters and invalidate remote matched cells.  Every such cell
       must be included in D.  For regeneration, the total output casualty
       set, including inherited debt, must remain bounded by the same c; a
       fresh c casualties per step would still accumulate.

       There is a second exact weakening.  The auxiliary minus phase carried
       to the next Pascal step and the plus phase compiled as the current
       terminal word may use different compiler matchings and cap states.
       A terminal common-cap assignment need not survive the phase toggle,
       because it is not part of the next state unless explicitly exported.
       Upper witness identities likewise need be phase-common only when the
       transition declares them carried data.

       This validates the user's bounded-eviction insight but not the claimed
       full-ticket spread theorem.  The present coatom catalogue has a
       quadratic prospective menu, while the strongest audited menu for one
       prescribed all-depth action is only linear; some endpoint-breaker
       actions have no proved action-invisible menu.  Uniformly bounded
       complete damage and nonaccumulating sidecar regeneration remain open.

2386H2. The unqualified finite-H same-parity host statement is now sharply
       refuted, and the strongest proof-safe replacement has been separated
       into two exact guarded interfaces.

       Weak typed compatibility means only injectivity on lower, upper,
       tail and head resource shores; it does not include a rooted q1
       extension.  For every m>=7 there are four legal repair targets and
       four legal immutable q1 rails, mutually disjoint on all typed shores,
       whose physical rails form a saturated Johnson C4.  Any degree-two
       factor containing the rails has that C4 as a closed component, so no
       connected spanning factor/Hamilton opening can preserve them.  For
       m>=40 the four target atoms simultaneously meet the fixed-bank C6
       planting threshold m-1>12*4-10.  Thus FH(4) is false even in the
       asymptotic planting range.  This does not rule out a disconnected q1
       two-factor or a stronger compatibility definition which already
       includes rooted extendability.

       A separate cardinality cut is exact.  If the bulk deficit is h and
       the desired residual is CH, gain-one cover-down needs at least h-CH
       packet records; a fixed H-bank works only if h<=(C+1)H.  Hence fixed-H
       planting cannot turn the valid N-o(N) Delcourt--Postle body into an
       O(H) leave.  A growing selector-separable bank aligned to the actual
       post-fixed-bank leave remains necessary.

       The positive interface has two literal physical record types.  HT
       requires a protected route to Sigma_0 and a serial sequence of
       q1-rainbow Hamilton states with a common untouched opening and the
       unique tau=(13) three-rail pairing.  RC uses the resident long square
       collar and distinguishes the actual gain-one off state

          A_i^-=O_i^- union R_i

       from its virtual q1 completion

          Ghat_i^-=A_i^- union {e_i}

       and the actual on state G_i^+=N_i union R_i.  Only
       Ghat_i^- -> G_i^+ has equal typed signature; A_i^- -> G_i^+ gains the
       target.  Pending targets give the exact virtual q1 sequence, while
       the actual and virtual states coincide terminally.  The actual off
       state is the resident cycle opened at e_i, so its surviving internal
       runs retain length at least d+1.  One RC collar has closed typed
       support at most

          2(2d+4)+2(2d+6)=8d+20,

       and the DP body stays N-o(N) whenever (8d+20)H=o(N).

       The compiler conclusion is a matching-restriction lemma.  In one cap
       state, if at most a_d H old rows, b_d H cells and q_d H new rows are
       affected and every other old edge survives, terminal deficiency is

          <= C_cap(d) H,  C_cap(d)=a_d+b_d+q_d.

       This is absolute O(H) only if sup_d C_cap(d)<infinity; otherwise it is
       O_d(H), consistent with item2383A's Theta(Hd) live footprint.  The q1
       object in the conditional theorem is explicitly an auxiliary
       occurrence-labelled sidecar.  Identifying its exterior with the
       literal child chronology is a separate surviving gate.

       The precise open conjunction is now: HT rooted serial extension or
       private prepared RC rails plus terminal endpoint reconnection;
       all-width witness transparency; a growing actual-leave selector bank
       with O(H) Hall deficiency; a depth-uniform bounded cap footprint (or
       bounded terminal eviction); occurrence-by-occurrence sidecar/child
       identification; and regeneration in the next same-parity child.  On
       RC, collar-internal residence is solved; initialization and exterior
       joins remain guarded.  No Joos--Mubayi--Smith exact theorem and no
       B(k)+O(1) conclusion are used.

2387D. The minimal two-star extension of the asymmetric one-chain selector
       is now exactly classified.  At the abstract target/address level a
       prefix selector in phase epsilon and a reflected suffix selector in
       phase 1-epsilon do close the two nested chain ledgers: the prepared
       endpoint cells realize the destroyed OLD chains, and phase reversal
       transposes fan and boundary addresses.  Literal feasibility in one
       common cap is exactly the maximal-word row test

          K_x^epsilon=P_x intersect intersection_(J contains x) T_J^epsilon,
          E_J^epsilon subseteq T_J^epsilon,
          T_J^epsilon=E_J^epsilon union union_(x in J)K_x^epsilon,

       with all K_x^epsilon nonempty.  A fixed star address cannot carry the
       same typed target in both phases unless B_0=B_1; two star addresses
       instead carry {B_0,B_1} and swap.

       This positive ledger does not lift to an equicardinal growing-depth
       carrier.  For every d>=3 and even allowing every redundant source
       copy compatible with the exact one-star fan/crossing equations, the
       exact minimum star separations are

          outward d+1, inward d+1, both-left 2d-1,
          both-right 2d-1.

       Once separation is at least d+1, no length-(d+1) owner window meets
       both stars.  One collar alone then forces the owner flag

          B_0 union B_1 union {f_1,...,f_i},  1<=i<d,

       whose ranks vary.  Therefore every pair of individually exact
       asymmetric selectors fails the D^d equicardinal row for d>=3,
       independently of endpoint returns, compiler matching, or cap
       enlargement.  The closest outward/inward supports have width 3d;
       same-direction minima have width 4d-2.

       Depth two is the unique adjacent exception.  The four sources

          (C+f_1, B_epsilon, B_(1-epsilon), C+f_2)

       give a phase-independent two-owner Johnson edge.  Guards
       D=B_0 union B_1 on both sides make every interval of length at least
       three phase invariant; the complete length-two derivative is the
       Plucker square

          [B_1+f_1]+[B_0+f_2]-[B_0+f_1]-[B_1+f_2].

       It is not self-returning: deleting both stars exposed the old joint
       span J=C union {f_1,f_2}, and no new short cell equals J.  A complete
       d=2 packet therefore needs one external common-cap provider for J in
       addition to the endpoint-chain returns.

       Exact physical ledgers are: source charge +2; gross short-cell net
       2d; scalar net 2d-2 after typing the two stars.  In the separated
       word these are distinct addresses but all have the same plateau value
       B_0 union B_1, hence matching rank one.  In the adjacent d=2 word the
       two inactive plateau addresses coincide, and paying J leaves at most
       one scalar address.  A zero-length version needs two independently
       audited deletion/return operations.  The live O(1) extension must
       therefore alter the physical owner equations--a nonflat bridge,
       facet/deletion collar, or a star that is not itself an exact
       asymmetric selector--rather than add a third marginal assignment.

2387ROOT. The resident Boolean-hex collar has been shortened to its exact
       optimum and its entire internal higher-width interface is now
       explicit.

       For a target atom e=(L,U,E,F), depth h, ordered distinct
       x_0,...,x_(h-1) in L\{b}, and y outside U union {c}, put

          Z=L union {a,d_0,y},
          (z_0,...,z_(h+2))=(a,y,d_0,x_0,...,x_(h-1)),
          V_i=Z\{z_i,z_(i+1)}

       cyclically.  Then V_0=E, V_1=F, and

          V_1 -> V_2 -> ... -> V_(h+2) -> V_0

       is a four-resource-private Johnson return path with h+2 edges.  This
       is shortest possible: q1-upper privacy forces d_0 to be absent at
       the first two cycle vertices, while residence forces an h+1 positive
       run.

       The cycle is a literal small wreath.  With
       K=L\{x_0,...,x_(h-1)}, the source letters W_j=K union {z_j} satisfy

          V_i = union_(t=0)^h W_(i+2+t).

       Hence depth-h factorization is constructive.  Every nonconstant old
       cyclic coordinate has positive run exactly h+1, and the all-new
       paths have no short internal positive run.  Every interval of at
       least three rail vertices has union Z.  The rail-side upper interface
       has only the constant prefix states {F,Z\{d_0},Z} and suffix states
       {E,Z\{a},Z}; the complete plus local >=3 deck is
       {Z,Z\{a}+c,Z+c}, independent of h.  One fixed target and ternary-hex
       choice has exactly

                         (m-2)(m-2)_h

       ordered rails.

       This strictly supersedes the earlier 2h+1 out-and-back rail for
       residence and internal upper support.  It does not finish the
       recursive host: naked unary U3 and U4 equality are explicitly false,
       and exterior last-witness ladders, bounded plus-state compiler
       damage, prepared-host export, and regeneration remain open.
       Terminal-phase decoupling means those cross-phase equalities are not
       required for B(k)+O(1); each phase may instead be certified
       separately.

2388ROOT. A bounded terminal plus-collar bank can now be planted in an
       exact owner/q1 two-factor unconditionally.  The remaining q1 host
       difficulty is decoration and rooted topology, not factor existence.

       Let ML_m be the m-regular containment graph between ranks m-1 and m
       of [2m-1].  If a protected subgraph P has maximum degree at most two
       and

                              |E(P)| <= m-2,

       then P extends to a spanning two-factor of ML_m.  The proof combines
       the sharp middle-shadow surplus

          |N(A)|-|A| >= min(m-1,W-|A|)

       with the capacity-two bound

          sum_U min(2,d_A(U))-2|A| >= min(m-2,2(W-|A|)),

       and an edge-minimal Ore--Ryser obstruction.  Minimality removes every
       protected edge from the witness shore A; the obstruction would then
       require h to exceed the displayed capacity margin, while
       h<=m-2 and h<=2(W-|A|).

       Therefore H pairwise-disjoint plus-phase collar paths of total
       O(Hd) incidence length embed for every fixed H once O(Hd)<=m-2.
       Since d=Theta(sqrt(m)), this holds eventually.  Old-minus and
       all-plus alternatives are not embedded simultaneously unless their
       union is itself 2-bounded.

       This theorem is deliberately only the q1 skeleton.  An arbitrary
       completion may have W/3 components.  It need not cover every paired
       adjacent-upper colour: a frozen ML_4 two-factor covers only 20 of 21
       rank-five colours.  Upper injectivity is not even the correct odd-host
       condition, because W occurrences cover fewer colours with forced
       excess 2W/(m+1); the needed condition is surjectivity.  Global
       residence, arbitrary-width upper witnesses, and bounded compiler
       damage also remain separate.

       The remaining decorated/topological row has an exact normal form.
       Split the protected bank between a perfect matching M_0 and a second
       matching.  It suffices to find a matching Q of size W-s outside M_0
       which contains the protected second-colour edges, covers every
       paired-upper colours up to t named holes, has a forest
       permutation-link graph, and leaves
       a residual perfect matching on the s unused vertices per shore.  Any
       residual completion gives a q1 factor with at most s components and
       at most t immediate-upper holes.  Opening its components destroys at
       most s further upper witnesses, so s+t=O(H) already suffices for the
       additive-constant theorem; exact transparent cuts are unnecessary.
       Conversely, an upper-surjective factor with an
       upper-transparent safe cut in every component yields such a Q with s
       equal to its component count.  Thus the still-open q1 statement is
       exactly an upper-decorated near-factor/safe-cut certificate; the final
       completion is ordinary Hall.

2388L. The square-collar q1 interface has been corrected to respect the
       sealed old C4.  The old phase is not, and cannot be, prescribed
       inside one Hamilton cycle.  The exact prospective target is a
       directed q1-rainbow Hamilton cycle containing the pairwise-private
       all-plus motifs

          A->F->X->Y->E->D,       C->B.

       Reverse H disjoint motifs.  Each reverse isolates its intended
       E-F-X-Y-E sidecar.  After contracting the long plus paths, the
       remainder undergoes H ordinary two-switches, so it has at most H+1
       residual cycles.  The inserted AB and CD edges form a matching;
       hence every residual cycle contains an unchanged nonpacket Hamilton
       edge.  Cutting one such edge per residual cycle gives

          old state = H named C4 sidecars + a linear forest,
          plus state = the Hamilton cycle minus r common edges,
          r<=H+1.

       Both states miss exactly the same r distinct lower-q1 colours.  The
       six local immediate-upper resources of every packet are unchanged;
       an additional literal witness survives only when its realizing edge
       is common and uncut.  Width at least two, residence and common cap
       remain outside this theorem.

       On the odd host |Gamma|=2m-1, the exact fixed-oriented-target menu is

                    M_m=(m-1)(m-2)^2(m-3)=Theta(m^4).

       The load statement has an essential anchor qualification: E,F,
       lower L and upper U occur in every option and have load M_m.  Only a
       nonanchor forbidden unit has O(m^3) load, after target anchors have
       been declared pairwise private.

       This raw menu collapses completely after a Hamilton target is fixed.
       If s is its directed successor map, an aligned plus collar forces

          A=s^(-1)(F), X=s(F), Y=s^2(F), E=s^3(F), D=s(E),

       and therefore uniquely determines b,x,y,c; C->B is only a final
       consistency check.  Thus a fixed directed Hamilton cycle contains
       at most one option for a fixed oriented target (at most two when the
       target orientation is forgotten).  The Theta(m^4) bank is a
       joint-before-target menu, not post-target forbidden-incidence
       abundance.

       The weaker source-factor route has an exact min-max reduction.  For
       the incidence lift P^- of the old collars, put b(v)=2-deg_(P^-)(v)
       and delete its used incidences.  An undirected q1 source factor
       exists iff, for all owner S and lower-colour T,

             e_R(S,Q\T)+b(T)>=b(S),

       with b(O)=b(Q)=2N-12H.  This is ordinary integral b-flow.  It is not
       a typed tail/head theorem: the ordered completion is the three-index
       system z_(q,u,v), equivalently two edge-disjoint incidence perfect
       matchings extending the planted tail and head partial matchings.
       Once such an ordered source exists, the all-plus factor may be
       Hamiltonized by the unrestricted q1 alternating reset, but that weak
       route preserves no named upper witness.

       The first finite case is positive.  An explicit directed ML(7)
       Hamilton cycle contains the canonical m=4 plus collar.  Reverse
       toggling has component profile 4+6+25; cutting common edges (27,75)
       and (39,45) gives old C4+P6+P25 and all-plus P7+P28, both with the
       same 33 of 35 q1 colours.  Exactly one of the twelve fixed-oriented
       menu options occurs.  This refutes a local collar-shape obstruction
       but is not an all-m induction.  The surviving theorem is genuinely
       prospective correlated selection of the target and H aligned motifs,
       or satisfaction of the stronger ordered source-factor system.

2389ROOT. The proposed regenerative pull--cell argument has been audited
       clause by clause.  Its implication is valid, but it is a conditional
       theorem rather than the final construction.

       Proved rows are now: the endpoint-chain necessity theorem; the
       corrected Greene--Kleitman central forest; bounded terminal compiler
       eviction with a complete literal damage set; auxiliary/terminal phase
       decoupling; the shortest resident rotating-hole rail with constant
       internal upper interface; and fixed-H planting of terminal plus
       collars in an exact owner/q1 two-factor.

       Two advertised shortcuts require restriction.  Mütze's prescribed
       pull extension applies to the canonical flippable-pair C6 family on
       its canonical 2-factor; no current theorem identifies the mixed-coatom
       or resident-collar packets with those pulls.  Bounded eviction avoids
       perfect terminal U5 but does not itself prevent sidecar accumulation:
       the total output debt, inherited targets included, must remain bounded
       by the same constant.

       Four genuine bridges remain: O(1) task birth in every recursive
       child; complete packet tickets rather than prospective local variants;
       an O(H)-component host containing the selected collars with only O(H)
       named upper holes; and a uniformly bounded complete-damage/regeneration
       map.
       Quadratic full-ticket menus and O(md) full conflict degree are not
       proved.  The O(md) estimate currently covers only local owner/q1
       resources after mandatory target anchors are declared private.

       The shortest sufficient statement is one bounded-state same-parity
       transition satisfying those four rows.  It would imply
       nu(k)<=B(k)+c by carrying at most c casualties and appending them only
       at the requested terminal dimension.

2390ROOT. The upper-decorated bounded-component gate has an exact Catalan
       connector decomposition.  Relative to one rooted perfect matching
       M_0, an upper-exact graphic-independent near-factor Q of size W-s
       necessarily splits into three layers:

         (i) one occurrence of every rank-(m+1) upper colour, forming a
             rooted Catalan linear forest Q_0 with W-Cat_m edges and exactly
             Cat_m components;
        (ii) Cat_m-s further matching edges whose permutation links form a
             forest on those Catalan components; and
       (iii) an s-edge residual Hall completion.

       Conversely, compatible layers (i)--(iii) give a q1-exact,
       upper-surjective factor with at most s components.  Therefore the
       topological part of the O(1) conjecture is not a final small matching:
       it contains a Catalan-scale connector theorem.  The s-vertex residual
       matching is the easy last row.  Even the unprotected one-component
       face contains the doubly-rainbow Hamilton object isolated earlier.

2391ROOT. The special rotating-hole plus collar passes the full missing q1
       host gate in every exact finite case tested.  For actual depths

                         (m,h)=(4,2),(5,2),(6,3),(7,3),

       exact CNF certificates give a spanning middle-levels Hamilton cycle

2392ROOT. The endpoint-chain theorem now gives a quantitative
       architecture-free rigidity law for every additive-constant word.
       If L=B(k)+C and x_b is the number of lower witnesses assigned to
       middle endpoint b, then

          sum_b (d-x_b)^+ <= C W + O_C(W+k).

       More explicitly the error is

          sigma_d + C d + binom(C+1,2)+binom(d+C,2),

       where 0<=sigma_d<W+d is the scalar slack at depth d.  Hence for every
       fixed eta in (0,1),

          #{b:x_b<=(1-eta)d}/W
             <= ((C+1)/eta*sqrt(8/pi)+o(1))/sqrt(k).

       Thus W-O_C(W/sqrt(k)) middle owners must support genuinely long
       endpoint chains in any B(k)+O(1) construction.  Flatness is not
       forced, but near-uniform recency depth is.

       The same audit closes the proof-writing gap in the fixed-H q1
       planting theorem: the sharp KK scalar surplus now has a complete
       self-contained binomial-expansion/complement proof.  The GK Catalan
       forest and the edge-minimal Ore--Ryser argument also pass independently.

         MATH_AUDIT_ENDPOINT_CHAIN_GK_AND_FIXED_H_Q1_20260801.md

2392AD. The endpoint-bearing positive replacement for item2381AD is now
       exact and support-sharp at the central four-resource level.

       Two distinct donor path components need exactly a ternary 3<->3
       packet: one old cycle edge and one old edge from each path toggle by
       the Boolean hex into two paths.  With only one donor path, every
       support-at-most-three exact exchange still leaves a directed cycle.
       Tail/head balance makes a support-three phase a permutation of three
       head ports.  A fixed point reduces to the impossible nontrivial
       Boolean 2<->2 exchange, so only the two 3-cycles remain.  For one
       cycle cut plus two ordered path cuts, one 3-cycle closes the opened
       cycle through the intervening path fragment and the other closes the
       intervening fragment itself.  For two cycle cuts plus one path cut,
       the two orientations close one of the two cycle fragments.  A
       zero-length intervening fragment would require an illegal loop; the
       other orientation still retains a cycle.  Thus one donor path needs
       support at least four.

       A literal quaternary Boolean octagon attains four.  Let |S|=m-2 and
       choose distinct z,a_0,a_1,a_2,a_3 outside S.  With indices modulo 4,
       put

         L_i=S+a_i,                 U_i=S+z+a_i+a_(i+1),
         A_i=S+z+a_i,               B_i=S+a_i+a_(i+1),
         o_i=(L_i,U_i,A_i,B_i),     n_i=(L_i,U_(i-1),A_i,B_(i-1)).

       Both phases O={o_i} and N={n_i} are four-resource matchings, and
       their exact banks are

         lower {L_i}, upper {U_i}, tail {A_i}, head {B_i}.

       Their undirected union is the alternating C8

         A_0-B_0-A_1-B_1-A_2-B_2-A_3-B_3-A_0.

       If o_0 lies on a directed cycle and o_1,o_3,o_2 occur in that order
       on one directed path, delete the four old arcs.  Writing C_0 for the
       cycle return and P_0,...,P_3 for the path fragments, the new phase
       concatenates them as

         P_0,n_1,C_0,n_0,P_2,n_2,P_1,n_3,P_3.

       This is one directed path.  Therefore the toggle removes exactly one
       cycle, preserves both outer palettes literally, and preserves every
       tail/head degree pointwise; cap two is automatic.  Support four is
       consequently necessary and sufficient for the one-cycle/one-path
       class.  A private fixed bank of H such component pairs toggles
       simultaneously and removes H cycles.

       One fixed oriented octagon target has exactly

         (m-1)^2(m-2)                 on |Omega|=2m,
         (m-1)(m-2)(m-3)             on |Omega|=2m-1

       formal completions.  This is a menu, not a theorem that an arbitrary
       factor contains the required path order.

       The shortest rotating-hole return rail can be made explicitly
       private from the octagon.  Regard o_0 as the target with
       L=L_0=S+a_0, d_0=z, a=a_1; choose distinct x_0,...,x_(h-1) in S and
       y outside U_0 union {a_2,a_3}.  The cyclic label order

         (a_1,y,z,x_0,...,x_(h-1))

       gives an h+2-edge return B_0 -> ... -> A_0.  Every rail upper has y;
       the only return lower without y or z is
       S-x_0+a_0+a_1, so the rail is four-resource-private.  The old cycle
       has every nonconstant run of length h+1, and the new local path

         A_1-B_0-(rail)-A_0-B_3

       has no internal run shorter than h+1.  The exact rail menus are

         (m-3)(m-2)_h on even ground,
         (m-4)(m-2)_h on odd ground.

       One collared quaternary phase has h+6 Johnson atoms and exactly
       2(h+6) Middle Levels incidences.  Hence H pairwise incidence-private
       plus collars satisfy the proved fixed-H q1 two-factor extension when

                   2 sum_i(h_i+6) <= m-2.

       This conclusion is deliberately only an undirected lower-q1/cap-two
       embedding.  A completed two-factor destroys the literal path-
       component status unless openings are chosen.  The exact topology
       condition after contracting its common completion K is

                   r_K(N)-r_K(O)=1,

       together with consistency of all prescribed directed orientations.
       Ordinary Ore--Ryser supplies neither this rooted condition nor the
       global adjacent-upper surjection; it embeds one phase, not a common
       directed four-resource host for both.  The local toggle preserves
       whatever upper palette a valid old host has, but does not construct
       that host.

       OR-word guards remain separate: the rail solves only local residence
       and its internal upper deck.  Exterior join runs, all-width last
       witnesses and a common-cap compiler are not inferred.  Thus the
       central endpoint absorber is closed for a prepared bank, while the
       exact surviving host gate is rooted directed upper-decorated packet
       supply.

2392R. The proposed Mütze packet bridge now has an exact scope and an
       occurrence-level criterion.

       In the literal Gregor--Mütze--Nummenpalo lexical pull family, a
       prescribed labelled subset extends to a canonical gluing spanning
       tree iff its auxiliary plane-tree labels form a graphic forest.  This
       follows by ordinary graphic augmentation; GMN edge-disjointness and
       noninterleaving make the toggles noninterfering.  Pulls may still
       share vertices, so this theorem supplies no owner, witness,
       residence, or cap privacy.

       The packet identification is strictly weaker than literal equality.
       The mixed-coatom phase difference contracts to TWO disjoint Johnson
       C6 rails of one decorated incidence hex, whereas one GMN pull is one
       bipartite incidence C6.  In the rotational MMM standard factor

                 110u0v <-> 101u0v,

       the upper external-delete labels are always common, while the lower
       external-add labels are common iff u is empty.  Hence the full
       two-rail coatom seam/palette signature is possible exactly for
       u=empty.  Its retained fragments must additionally contract to the
       explicit common connector

         {Ad-Bd,Cd-Ic,bc-Ib,ca-Ia,Ibc-Ica,Iab-ab},

       with Iab-ab cut, correct marks, equal complete internal support and
       literal private coatom paths.  The u=empty rotational standard-label
       graph is disconnected for every n>=5.

       There is a separate provenance gate: the exact forest theorem is for
       the GMN lexical P_sigma factor, while the u-profile above is frozen
       for the later rotational MMM f-factor.  No workspace theorem
       identifies their C6, three old edges, six untouched external stubs,
       phase and marks.  The new predicate Prov(g_GMN,g_MMM) records exactly
       this finite occurrence test; the filtered disconnection transfers to
       GMN only after Prov is proved.

       The square collar has a stronger abstract match.  Its ternary 3<->3
       core is exactly one common-delete Johnson rail of an incidence hex.
       A fixed core embeds only when its six literal owners/roles equal a
       verified pull occurrence.  The full resident collar still needs its
       actual common return rail, meeting the switch only at its endpoints,
       with private typed resources and exact boundary ages/marks.  The
       formal ((m-2)_s)^2 count is only for the even J(2m,m) set-theoretic
       rail catalogue, not for occurrences in a fixed pull factor.

       A proof-safe prospective theorem remains.  For a dimension-independent
       |S|<=H bank of already prepared pull expansions, declare the COMPLETE
       interface (ports, stubs, typed resources, terminal partition,
       directions, marks, clipped ages, and exported witness signatures).
       If a labelwise extension bank is hereditarily commuting with that
       interface, then S extends precisely when S is graphic and the
       admissible auxiliary graph contracted by S is connected.  Failure is
       either a graphic circuit in S or, conditional on S being a forest, a
       nontrivial cut crossed only by excluded labels.  Without hereditary
       commutation, pairwise/static edge avoidance is insufficient.

       This closes only edge-level tree augmentation and the exact packet
       embedding predicate.  Producing the prepared occurrences,
       upper-witness protection/bounded terminal damage, common-cap compiler
       tickets and nonaccumulating regeneration remain separate.

2393H2. The bounded-birth bridge now has an exact exposure-complete
       proof-safe state and a
       sharp omitted-debt obstruction.  For a literal certified same-parity
       transition pi, one must carry

         Phi_pull=|D|+|E_pi|+|R_pi|+|Q_pi|+|C_pi|,

       where D is inherited target debt, E_pi is the targetwise exterior
       last-witness casualty set, R_pi is unsealed residence/deadline debt,
       Q_pi is the unprotected q1/upper/topology/endpoint ledger, and C_pi
       is typed common-cap deficiency in one literal cap state under a
       matching saturating every hard task.  Residual rows are canonically
       priority-deduplicated E,R,Q,C.  Inadmissible hard-task states have
       infinite value.  If inherited rows have at most four children and
       the ledger is exhaustive up to b fixed births, then exactly

                         |U_pi|<=4 Phi_pull+b.

       An intrinsic minimum is allowed only over literal certified
       transitions, and the minimizer plus its witness, residence, host and
       cap-matching certificates remain part of the state.

       A rolling-fan obstruction shows why E_pi cannot be replaced by the
       three nested ray states.  Replace one direct Johnson seam by the
       shortest depth-h rotating-hole resident rail and put rolling fans of
       total length n on its two sides.  The old and new paths both have
       injective lower and upper q1 palettes, exact rail residence, and

                         2(n+h+2)<=m-2,

       so the entire displayed path is inside the fixed-H protected q1
       extension theorem.  Nevertheless the rail destroys
       floor(n^2/4) distinct uniquely witnessed local crossing upper
       targets.  With h=floor(sqrt(m)), n=h gives Theta(m) local births on
       an O(h)-size protected path; saturating the protected margin gives
       Theta(m^2).  This is child-local: it lower-bounds global E_pi only
       when the surrounding chronology has no alternate witnesses.

       Two orthogonal exact ledgers are also indispensable.  Odd-diamond
       lifting taxes every minimum parent run by one residence unit (the
       K15->K17 fixture has 1425 minimum runs, 165 forced packets and exact
       optimum 180).  The zero-owner mixed-coatom packet has 2(d-1)
       phase-common compiler rows and no native common neighbour, although
       its owner/q1/deck/residence/topology rows are clean.  A globally
       prepared witness ladder or common-cap ladder may repair either
       exposure; the theorem says that the certificate or its exact
       deficiency must be carried.

       Combining the exposure coefficient lambda=4 with guarded service
       fraction eta and proportional replay casualty theta gives

          rho=4[1-(1-theta)eta].

       Uniform regeneration requires rho<1, equivalently
       (1-theta)eta>3/4, plus bounded additive damage.  Merely proving
       Phi'<=Phi+C with C>0 accumulates and is not an O(1) sidecar theorem.
       The surviving gate is a globally exposure-closed transition,
       sufficiently strong guarded service, and uniformly bounded complete
       compiler damage.  This item does not redo or claim a rooted-host
       theorem and does not prove an all-k additive bound.

2394ROOT. The July 2026 Baggett--Yan interchange theorem is genuine, but its
       role in the coherent-birail proposal is now calibrated exactly.

       Baggett and Yan prove maximal Hamiltonicity for every full zero-one
       fixed-margin fibre.  The coherent token orbit theorem and the physical
       matrix-lift implication are correct under their stated closure and
       quotient hypotheses.  However, the displayed minimization proof uses
       only a path from M_0 to a minimizing matrix, so classical Ryser
       connectivity already supplies its entire abstract graph-theoretic
       input.  Maximal Hamiltonicity adds no force against physical
       structural zeros.

       Three missing quotient statements carry all the OR difficulty:

         * the multi-depth physical state must be one full margin fibre,
           rather than a diagonal subset of separate depth fibres;
         * every required square must lift from every source chronology and
           keep the class closed; and
         * compiler defect must factor through the compressed matrix rather
           than depend on physical cells, cap shrinkage and exterior unions.

       Raw packet menus do not prove these.  In particular, a prospective
       collar has many pre-host choices but at most one aligned realization
       after a directed Hamilton target is fixed.  The filtered canonical
       pull graph for full two-rail coatom packets is disconnected from
       semilength five onward.

       There is also a targetwise exterior obstruction: a shortest resident
       rail placed between rolling fans may keep q1 and rail residence exact
       while destroying floor(n^2/4) uniquely witnessed crossing upper
       targets.  Constant internal prefix/suffix state therefore does not
       imply constant complete external damage.

       CBC(C) remains a useful sufficient theorem, not an equivalence or a
       proof.  Its shortest honest content is physical coherent square
       completeness plus a laminar/convex compiler quotient of bounded
       terminal deficiency.  The B+1 capacity calculation remains positive
       evidence only.

2394K. The shortest rotating-hole rail has an exact upper crossing ledger,
       and it gives a sharp prepared-cut/arbitrary-cut dichotomy rather than
       an unconditional bounded-ticket theorem.

       On the rail's own saturated wrap, q=1 loses U and the packet edge AF
       restores U.  For every q>=2, the q deleted cyclic windows all have
       the single value Z, while the opened rail retains h+3-q internal Z
       windows.  Thus local target loss is zero at every available depth,
       although occurrence multiplicity falls by q.  The rail's internal
       upper triangle has genuinely collapsed.

       For h>=d, no window of length at most d+1 crosses both boundaries of
       the bare rail.  Its exact exterior short-band state is the six
       ladders

          S_u+F, S_u+(Z-d_0), S_u+Z,
          E+P_v, (Z-a)+P_v, Z+P_v,

       with at most 6d-6 ordinary indexed rows but only six compound
       relations.  The complete all-plus Boolean-hex packet has eleven
       directed ray relations.  Its short C-B component additionally has
       the grid S_u+(C union B)+P_v, of size binom(d-1,2) when untruncated;
       hence the complete full-packet relation counts are twelve in the
       short band and thirteen at unrestricted width, after adding the long
       component grid.

       A generic interior Pascal cut is different.  Its old depth-at-most-d
       crossing occurrences number d(d+1)/2.  A literal q1-rainbow Johnson
       path with fresh left/right coordinates makes all of their targets
       distinct last witnesses.  A bare rail destroys all of them; even the
       full packet retains a strict two-sided binom(d-1,2) bank by assigning
       fresh poison labels to the long and short routes.  Therefore bounded
       targetwise exterior tickets are false uniformly in d.  What is
       bounded is only the number of typed ladder/grid relations; each must
       carry a complete occurrence-labelled certificate.

       There is an exact zero-ticket positive face.  If the replaced child
       fragment has total union Z, prefix deck contained in
       {F,Z-d_0,Z}, suffix deck contained in {E,Z-a,Z}, and internal deck
       dominated by the rail, compressed-deck replacement preserves every
       exterior interval union at every width.  Thus planting from the
       outset or exporting a deck-matched prepared port bypasses the upper
       obstruction.  The direct edge FE fails this face because its total
       is U=Z-y.

       The rail has a literal nonzero depth-h antecedent, but exterior
       upper rows and lower pins share one source word only under the exact
       maximal-cap reconstruction equations.  None of these owner-side
       identities changes the one-cell source transport C_(u,v)->
       C_(u,v) union Z_*; the lower common-cap triangle binom(d-1,2)
       therefore remains intact.  The result is a theorem/no-go for the
       fixed-H interface, not a Pascal-host construction or B(k)+O(1).

2398L. The H=1 correlated rooted-target question now has an exact
       directed certificate, an all-dimensional insured opening theorem,
       complete finite bases through owner rank five, and a sharp remaining
       Catalan-connector gate.  It is not yet proved or refuted for all
       sufficiently large m.

       A directed q1-rainbow Hamilton target is equivalent to two incidence
       bijections t,s on the lower colours such that the planted collar fixes
       their tail/head values, pi=s compose t^{-1} is one cycle, and the
       paired unions t(q) union s(q) cover every rank-(m+1) colour.  The
       protected q1 two-factor theorem controls none of the last two
       correlated rows.

       For the bare aligned collar, reversal creates two residual cycles.
       Upper-safe common opening is exactly capacitated Hall with right
       capacities mu(R)-1.  This condition is not automatic: an exact
       m=4,h=1 upper-surjective Hamilton fixture has reverse profile 4+5+26,
       and every common edge on the five-cycle is a unique upper provider.
       This is a counterexample to automatic cutting, not to favourable
       rooted-target existence.

       The safe-cut row can be removed uniformly.  For h<=m-3 choose an
       unused core label r and insert the two-edge connector

                          D -> T -> C,   T=L+c+d-r.

       Both new edges have upper colour R=L+c+d and new q1 colours.  The
       plus collar becomes one directed path of h+7 Johnson edges; reversal
       makes the connector a monochromatic-upper triangle.  One connector
       cut is automatically safe.  Every W-edge upper-surjective target has
       at least

                  Delta+1,  Delta=W-binom(2m-1,m+1)=2W/(m+1),

       repeated-upper occurrences, and Delta+1>h+7 for m>=4.  Hence a
       repeated provider lies on the unchanged bulk path and supplies a
       second safe common cut.  Both phases remain upper-surjective and lose
       the same two distinct q1 colours.  The incidence lift has 2h+14
       edges, so fixed-H q1 factor planting applies when 2h+14<=m-2.

       Exact finite search is positive for every legal bare depth at m=4,5:

          (4,1),(4,2),(5,1),(5,2),(5,3),

       and for every connector-legal insured depth there:

          (4,1),(5,1),(5,2).

       Coordinate transitivity covers every legal relabelling in those
       dimensions.  Independent replay verifies Hamiltonity, q1
       injectivity, the full upper palette, reverse components, and literal
       safe cuts in both phases.  The separately frozen recursive-depth
       census also gives bare completions at (m,h)=(6,3),(7,3), so no
       collar-specific target obstruction is seen through owner rank seven.

       The exact all-m residue is now explicit.  Split the connected planted
       incidence path into literal tail/head matchings P0,P1 and choose a
       perfect M0 containing P0.  A completion with first matching M0 exists
       iff there is a matching Q0 union Q1 outside M0, containing P1, where
       Q0 is an upper-exact rooted Catalan forest of size
       W-Cat_m, Q1 has Cat_m-1 edges and is a forest after contracting Q0,
       and the two unmatched incidence vertices admit one residual edge
       outside M0 and the protected support.  Q0 union Q1 is then a directed
       spanning path and the residual edge closes it.  The insurance theorem
       makes that closure upper-transparent.  Thus the only owner-layer
       theorem still missing is this protected Catalan forest plus
       Catalan-scale connector construction; no additional collar-specific
       cut obstruction survives.

2399AD. The quaternary-octagon OR-word interface is now exact, including
       its sharp local limitation and the two exterior residence joins.

       For every admissible 1<=h<=m-2, write

          W_h=(A1,V1,...,V_(h+2),V0,B3),
          Q=Z union {a3},  Q^o=(Z-{a1}) union {a3}.

       Its distinct prefix, suffix and length-at-least-three interval-union
       decks are exactly

          P(W_h)={A1,U0,Z,Q},
          S(W_h)={B3,U3,Q^o,Q},
          I_>=3(W_h)={Z,Q^o,Q}.

       The first two are strict chains; the third is V-shaped because Z and
       Q^o are incomparable.  Therefore a prepared contiguous long collar
       exports exactly eight one-sided nested-ray relations and one
       full-span Q-grid, independent of h as relation types.  If interval
       width is at most D+1 with D<=h, the grid is impossible.  Including
       the two residual two-owner components gives sixteen directed rays and
       three possible full-component cores Q,U1,U2.  Complete ladder/grid
       certificates plus the explicit internal deck are sufficient for all
       intervals touching this prepared fragment.

       This is not an O(1)-ray theorem at arbitrary width.  On 2m labels,
       for every 2r<=m-3, literal exterior Johnson fans joined to the two
       collar endpoints realize the product family [0,r]^2 after union with
       Q.  Its antidiagonal has size r+1, so any cover by nested rays needs
       at least r+1 rays.  In the actual octagon topology the unchanged donor
       pieces P1,P2 exchange order, replacing the old suffix(P1) x prefix(P2)
       grid by suffix(P2) x prefix(P1).  Explicit simple donor paths exist
       under r+s<=m-4 and give rs old crossing targets not repaid by the new
       local chronology.  A literal m=5,h=1 fixture has the same sixteen
       owners, exact selected-octagon lower/upper/tail/head balance and legal
       collar joins, yet loses the rank-seven target 0123479.

       Scope is essential: the donor fans and the sixteen-owner fixture
       certify logical independence from the local octagon identity only;
       they are not globally lower/upper-rainbow exact factors.  Whether the
       fixed-H ambient-factor extension automatically repays the donor grid
       remains open.  Thus the proved positive statement is a bounded number
       of relation types, conditional on complete donor rectangle guards or
       unaffected duplicate witnesses, not boundedly many named tickets.

       At residence threshold h+1, after ordinary off-end cleanliness, the
       two joins are resident iff the exterior owner at distance t contains

          Lambda_t={z,x0,...,x_(h-t-1)} on the left,
          P_t={a3,x_t,...,x_(h-1)} on the right,
          1<=t<=h.

       These are two nested families but contain h rotating labels.  No
       common-cap or lower compiler statement is made.

       and endpoints, 8d+22 distinct lower colours, the same upper palette,
       residence floor d+1, and the same 8d+49-value local interval-OR
       deck.  The maximal inverse has width 9d+23 and one common cap

                            Q_p=E_p^0 union E_p^1.

       Maximal phases differ at 4d+16 addresses, but the exact minimum over
       all inverse pairs is eight for d>=2 (twelve for d=1).  For d>=2 it is
       attained by using the maximal phase letters only at

          {d+4,2d+5,3d+5,3d+8,
           5d+16,6d+17,7d+17,7d+20}

       and E0 cap E1 elsewhere.  Eight disjoint owner-coordinate obligation
       domains prove sharpness.  Thus the fixed tensor is a resident
       eight-address macro, not a resident three-/four-source-star one.
       Inside the fixed eight-block/seven-screen template, n>=d+2 and the
       owner width 8d+23 are sharp.  Separately, a literal four-source-star
       direct sum exists on support 8d-4 with exact local decks and common
       caps, but its canonical owner concatenation has filler runs d-2 and
       is not resident without buffers.

       The tensor's only local exterior discrepancy is four typed
       occurrences (three set values), one prefix and one suffix per phase.
       Untyped, all four masks already occur in both interval decks.
       Arbitrary tensor-internal block refinements cannot create the missing
       typed occurrences: first/last active-label order makes all four
       opposite-phase side-cell rows empty, and the masks have rank r+3
       while actual inverse letters have rank at most r.

       Two explicit exterior source hosts close the OR row:

                       X_L={a0,a1},  X_R={a1,a2}.

       Phase zero orders their pieces (a0|a1) and (a2|a1); phase one uses
       (a1|a0) and (a1|a2).  Common source corridors through 2d+3 on the
       left and from 7d+19 on the right make the packet-near pieces equal
       the two missing typed masks.  The refinement charge is exactly +2;
       every old interval has an injective equal-OR full-block lift, and the
       same two host caps support both phases.  The typed pair itself returns
       natively under phase reversal, but this does not transport an arbitrary
       protected bank because the two source interval decks are unequal.

       The exact remaining theorem is physical, not another OR identity:
       plant these two exterior hosts so their split orders preserve
       equicardinal Johnson boundary owners, q1, residence/deadlines and the
       prescribed common compiler cap, certify matching-safe contraction,
       and then certify one simultaneous post-phase-replacement matching for
       the entire protected occurrence bank.  With this additional row the
       same two boundaries reverse and Phi<=2 at that transition.  Without
       it, only
       Phi'<=Phi+2 is justified.  No global host, connector supply, or
       B(k)+O(1) recurrence is claimed.

2400A. Monotone one-cell insertion now has an exact positive lower-compiler
       theorem and a sharp source-level obstruction for both canonical
       packet catalogues.

       At a full internal cut, insert a nonempty letter X.  Every old
       contiguous-OR witness is preserved with the same value if and only if

                         X subseteq A_(-1) union A_1.

       In COMP_h exactly h-1 old crossing width-h cells leave the band, and
       the 2h-1 new cells are precisely the singleton X and the two rays.
       Writing B_i^- and B_i^+ for the old left/right prefix unions, their
       values are

                         X, X union B_i^-, X union B_i^+.

       Hence prescribed damaged chains T_i^-,T_i^+ are realized exactly by
       these equalities.  With X variable, the exact common-Q interval is

          union_(sigma,i)(T_i^sigma\B_i^sigma)
             subseteq X subseteq
          (A_(-1) union A_1) intersect P_0 intersect
             intersection_(sigma,i) T_i^sigma,

       together with B_i^sigma subseteq T_i^sigma and X nonempty.

       The decisive positive face is flatness.  Under monotonicity, each
       lost width-h crossing value is exactly the corresponding new
       length-(h+1) middle row.  If the final derivative is flat rank m,
       those lost cells have rank m and therefore carry no edge of a
       strict-lower reference matching.  Release the old edges of the
       2h-2 damaged-chain targets, transport every other matching edge, and
       put the chains plus the new strict-lower task on the two rays and
       singleton.  The displayed nonzero source word realizes all middle,
       transported, protected and ray rows simultaneously, so the exact
       maximal common-Q theorem gives a complete lower compiler with zero
       residual deficiency and a complete damage set disjoint from the
       transported reference matching.  This closes the H=1 compiler row
       under an exact rank-saturated/pivot-rich cut hypothesis.

       The two canonical sources fail the physical continuation in opposite
       ways.  Complementary coatom chains make every internal crossed join
       the same rank-m owner X union {a,b} union G, giving duplicate excess
       at least h-2 for h>=3.  In the canonical shortest rotating-hole
       erosion W_j=K union {z_j}, |K|=m-h-1, every crossing h-cell has rank
       m-1; monotone X is redundant, so no such insertion can give a flat
       rank-m derivative for any h>=2.  The remaining exact construction is
       a noncanonical pivot-rich chain pair: all h-1 internal joins and the
       two endpoint joins must be allowed rank-m owners with the required
       multiplicities/Johnson adjacencies, caps, residence, q1 and upper
       interface.  No all-k existence claim is made.

2401R. The coherent-birail Markov question now has an exact occurrence-
       labelled answer, and CBC has a corrected terminal implication.

       Put 1=Iab, 2=Ibc, 3=Ica and use the three authenticated connector
       slots {12},{23},{31}.  A whole-chain cell x_ij means that i occupies
       the prefix provider chain and j the suffix provider chain at every
       q=2,...,d.  The only structural zeros are x_11=x_22=x_33=0.
       Fixing each slot sum and each prefix/suffix label margin to one leaves
       the two cyclic orientations.  The integer kernel is

          Z(e_12+e_23+e_31-e_21-e_32-e_13),

       so the toric ideal is the principal cubic

          x_12 x_23 x_31 - x_21 x_32 x_13.

       The support is the chordless C6=K_(3,3)-I.  No supported 2x2 exists,
       and the cubic is indispensable and sufficient for every d>=2.
       At d=3, independent depth tables contain four formal sign states but
       only the two diagonal states are physical.  In separate depth-token
       coordinates the same move has degree 3(d-1); the whole-chain token is
       the exact lossless local quotient.

       More generally, for occurrence-labelled slots of the three pair
       types, every chordless circuit is either a C4 using two slots of one
       type or a C6 using one slot of each type.  Thus quadrics plus cubics
       are the complete fixed-margin Markov basis, uniformly in d.  This
       gives the correct CBC replacement:

          closed whole-chain alternating-cycle completeness,

       with degree at most three, instead of physical square-completeness.
       If every applicable C4/C6 has a literal safe lift from every state
       and the class is closed under those lifts, the physical orbit
       projects onto the entire three-label margin fibre.

       Scope is load-bearing.  The all-d same-flag owner-disjoint triangle
       repeats exactly three cross-packet lower-q1 socket colours, so its C6
       is an exact nested lower-provider quotient, not a strict q1-rainbow
       bank.  Distinct-filler rainbow cubics exist at d=2,3.  The
       authenticated uniform all-d strict-rainbow family is the four-packet
       twisted cube: its four cancellation channels and four packet slots
       form chordless C8, with eight structural zeros and one indispensable
       quartic.  This does not prove quartic global minimality; arbitrary-
       core rainbow cubic existence at d>=4 remains open.

       Compiler-defect factorization through the birail matrix is not
       necessary after a literal terminal split certificate is found.
       One route uses separated rank-saturated monotone pivots.  The sharper
       route, detailed in 2402ROOT, splits one actual merged source letter
       X=(A+f_1) union (B+f_d) between mirrored filler traces; its two
       exclusive rays realize both complete coatom chains while every old
       interval OR transports.  Both routes give a literal common-Q
       compiler and use no lambda(phi(T)).  At one split on a baseline-B
       carrier the cost is B+1.  The conclusion is conditional:
       whole-chain connectivity does not produce the required terminal
       source.  The authenticated native 0110 source has no phase-common
       merged host, while the inserted-pivot catalogues are respectively
       owner-degenerate and rank-deficient.

       A dependency-free replay exhausts all 64 C6 binary tables:

2402ROOT. The terminal two-chain compiler damage has an exact nonflat
       one-spare solution, but the authenticated native coatom source does
       not contain its required host.

       Replacing one actual old source letter X by consecutive nonempty
       letters Z,T with X=Z union T preserves every old interval OR under an
       injective full-block transport.  The two exclusive endpoint rays have
       independent bases Z and T.  Therefore, with

          Z=A union {f_1},  T=B union {f_d},  X=Z union T,

       and the already-present outward traces

          ...,{f_(d-1)},...,{f_2},X,{f_(d-1)},...,{f_2},...,

       splitting only X realizes, in distinct cells, every canonical old-only
       target A union P_q and B union S_q for 2<=q<=d.  Physical length rises
       by exactly one.  Every old owner, upper witness and lower matching cell
       survives; only witnesses containing X gain one unit of deadline.  This
       leaves the flat-derivative ansatz and avoids its repeated-owner
       obstruction.

       The fixed-cut criterion is exact: the two chains must be cumulative
       unions on the two physical rays and their bases must union to the
       actual old letter X.  Mere nesting or cap containment is insufficient.

       The host is not native.  In the authenticated 0110 maximal-erosion
       source, no local envelope contains the merged active roles plus both
       extreme fillers; it is rank-short by two.  Exhaustive replay of all
       source-letter splits, both phases and all three connector rows for
       3<=d<=20 finds no two-chain realization (d=2 has one degenerate old-
       phase split but no terminal new-phase split).  Hence B+1 terminal
       algebra is closed conditionally; the remaining local theorem is to
       plant one merged phase-common host with the mirrored trace, or two
       one-sided hosts, inside a protected Pascal child.

2403ROOT. Split-letter preservation supplies a one-transition zero-loss
       reset, but bounded source support alone does not prove a regenerative
       additive constant.

       Simultaneously replacing old letters X_p by blocks whose unions are
       X_p preserves every old interval OR.  New cells are exactly intervals
       which cut one or two replacement blocks at their endpoints.  Hence a
       task bank is carried by a chosen source bank iff its occurrence-
       labelled equality graph to those partial-block cells satisfies Hall.
       This is the exact meaning of bounded binary source support.

       Marking the split boundaries exposes the missing recurrence state.
       Let Phi be the minimum number of marked boundaries which cannot be
       contracted while retaining the protected target/cell system.  If a
       transition reclaims a fraction theta of old essential boundaries and
       creates at most H new ones, then

                          Phi' <= (1-theta)Phi+H,

       so fixed theta>0 gives a bounded invariant.  Without reclaim, only
       Phi'<=Phi+H is valid.  This is sharp: an explicit family adds one
       source-supported singleton task at every step while making every old
       split boundary permanently essential.  Thus the final O(1) theorem
       still needs full reset or positive-fraction contraction; a sequence of
       locally lossless B+1 repairs may otherwise accumulate linearly.

2404ROOT. The rotation quotient removes the entire nonfree parity sector of
       the Catalan connector problem and exposes an exact balanced endpoint
       bank.

       For odd owner parameter m=2h+1, every nonfree outer necklace is an
       antipodal-pair union.  The two half-length shores are exactly levels
       h and h+1 of B_m/C_m.  Their regular quotient has a perfect matching,
       whose development is a set of pairwise vertex-disjoint physical
       edges: middle load one and no cycles.  The sector has size Cat_h.
       Outer-simple candidates cannot mix full and half orbit sizes.  For
       even m every outer orbit is free, so only the full-orbit selector
       remains in either parity.

       Independently, for every exact cap-two central factor, endpoint slack
       y_T=2-deg(T) satisfies

          sum_T y_T=2 Cat_m,
          sum_(T contains z) y_T=Cat_m  for every coordinate z.

       Thus endpoint supply is exactly coordinate-balanced.  This does not
       force the companion alternating C6 needed to raise graphic rank, so
       the full-orbit connector correlation remains open.

           parameter m=12 and literal antipodal factors through m=15.

2405ROOT. The quaternary octagon does not itself solve the Catalan connector
       selector, and the residual factor has an exact rank formula.

       After an upper-exact rooted Catalan forest Q0 with C components, a
       connector matching plus s residual closure edges exists exactly when
       the residual bipartite graph has a perfect matching F whose graphic
       rank after contracting Q0 is at least C-s.  The resulting factor has
       C-r(F) components.  In particular s=1 is a one-cycle port-cover
       condition, not merely ordinary Hall.

       The frozen m=4 Catalan certificate has zero supported quaternary-
       octagon exchanges over all 40,320 orientations and parameterizations.
       Since that octagon preserves upper multiplicities and fixed-size Q0
       rank, it cannot by itself supply the missing connectors.  This is a
       method no-go for the frozen host, not a no-go for pentagonal orbit
       banks or a different selector.

2406L. The pentagonal rotation bank has now been placed exactly inside the
       protected Catalan connector decomposition.  It gives a sharp
       post-hoc no-go, a dimension-uniform port invariant, and a conditional
       four-path absorber, but not an all-m connector selector.

       The even exact central selector and the odd rooted upper-exact forest
       share the Euler defect

          binom(2m,m)-binom(2m,m-1)
        = binom(2m-1,m)-binom(2m-1,m+1)
        = Cat_m.

       Every pentagonal 3<->3 exchange preserves edge count and both outer
       palettes.  Therefore any forest output still has exactly Cat_m path
       components.  Used internally on Q0, a forest-to-forest packet supplies
       zero of the Cat_m-O(1) additional connector edges.  More generally t
       packets gain at most 3t graphic-rank units, so one rotation orbit gains
       at most 6m and cannot reset a generic Catalan-scale subtour deficit.
       The successful m=6,m=8 banks start from correlated selectors and end
       with exactly Cat_6=132 and Cat_8=1430 paths.

       Rooting exposes a stronger invariant.  For an M0-aligned packet the
       unused tail bank X is fixed and the unused head bank changes by

          Y'=(Y-{G,H}) union {B,C},
          chi(B)+chi(C)=chi(G)+chi(H).

       Hence every coordinate port gap g_i=d_i(Y)-d_i(X) is invariant.  A
       residual perfect matching needs g_i>=0; a protected closure adding i
       needs g_i>=1.  The upstream rotation theorem proves the undirected
       endpoint slack one-design sum y=2Cat_m and sum_(T contains i)y=Cat_m,
       but choosing M0,Q0 can split that balanced bank into an impossible
       directed fibre.

       This happens literally at m=4.  An upper-exact rooted Catalan forest
       has gap vector

                         (4,2,2,3,3,1,-1),

       residual matching rank11/14, and exactly one live forest-preserving
       aligned pentagonal pivot.  The gap and rank11/14 are unchanged after
       the pivot.  Thus universal post-hoc pentagonal absorption is false;
       a good degree fibre and high-rank residual matching must be selected
       jointly from the outset.

       There is an exact conditional absorber.  A rooted matching Q of size
       W-4 has exactly four link-path components and any number z of cycles.
       If every current cycle has an M0-aligned prepared pentagonal packet
       whose companion edges/new endpoints use the four distinct paths and
       avoid the protected bank, each toggle removes one cycle and retains
       four paths.  After z toggles Q is a four-component forest.  If the
       four unmatched vertices per shore have a residual perfect matching in
       ML_m-M0 containing the prescribed closure e_*, the completed factor is
       upper-surjective, q1-exact and has at most four components.  The
       remaining all-m theorem is therefore precisely

          degree-admissible protected near-perfect connector matching
        + serial root-aligned pentagonal accessibility
        + four-port Hall with e_*.

       Root-aligned/protected-lower-disjoint local eligibility is not enough.
       The complete authenticated bank has counts

          (m,h)=(4,1): 0/1 extend,
                 (5,1): 9/11 extend,
                 (5,2): 9/11 extend.

       All 23 direct three-edge toggles fail head bijection.  The unique m=4
       packet forces new 52->54 against protected 50->54.  All five negatives
       are forced paired-head collisions.  The 18 positives require
       correlated M1 reselection; each preserves the fixed closure, full
       upper palette and connector rank Cat_5-1.  This is finite positive
       evidence for the joint selector and a minimal counterexample to a
       local-greedy selector.

       Split letters are downstream only.  After the connector and e_* are
       compiled in a contraction-stable deadline/cap state, bounded OR-mask
       debts can be inserted exactly when they are dominated by actual source
       letters, or at cuts satisfying T subseteq A_c union A_(c+1); nested
       rays may use the one-column criterion.  All old interval values and
       the named closure transport.  A split cannot create a missing
       incidence edge, repair the gap invariant, or merge components.

2407H2. The endpoint-carve global rotation has an exact protected-cut and
       split-reset normal form, but it does not automatically reclaim old
       split debt.

       For W=P M Q and W*=M Q P, the common physical cells are exactly the
       intervals internal to P and those internal to M Q.  The lost cells are

          Suf(P) Pre(M Q),

       and the gained cells are Suf(M Q) Pre(P), each bank having
       |P|(|M|+|Q|) cells.  Thus M|Q is untouched; all loss is charged to the
       old P|M cut, including intervals continuing through M into Q.  A fixed
       old matching survives exactly when its lost rows satisfy Hall against
       free equal-valued guarded cells after rotation.

       With

          P=(T=B+f_d,f_(d-1),...,f_2),
          Q=(f_(d-1),...,f_2,Z=A+f_1),

       the new Q|P seam has the two literal flag rays

          alpha_i=A+{f_1,...,f_i},  1<=i<=d-1,
          beta_j =B+{f_j,...,f_d},  2<=j<=d,

       and (d-1)^2 physical cross-grid cells alpha_i union beta_j.  The ray
       values already existed inside Q and P before rotation.  Rotation makes
       Z,T adjacent, so contracting them to X=Z union T proves that both
       flags are partial rays of one marked split and the cross-grid consists
       of full-block lifts.

       If residual Hall survives rotation and contraction of g old essential
       boundaries, including all flag/new-task rows, then exactly

                          Phi' <= Phi-g+1.

       Hence full reset gives Phi'<=1 and a theta fraction gives
       Phi'<=(1-theta)Phi+1.  The antecedent is essential.  For arbitrary t,
       take M=(Omega,C_1,D_1,...,C_t,D_t), with Omega the full union and
       C_i=K+a_i,D_i=K+b_i on private bits.  Every lost cut cell has value
       Omega, so the entire old OR deck survives and the carved seam is
       exact, yet contracting any C_i|D_i destroys the unique target C_i.
       Thus g=0 for all t.  This is an abstract source-word obstruction, not
       a Pascal/Johnson no-go.

2408D. The quaternary-octagon expanded source interface is now exact.  The
       `+2,Phi<=2` theorem repairs its two typed boundary tasks only; it is
       not a complete context-transparent packet.

       For every block `U`,

          Deck(L U R)=Deck(L) union Deck(U) union Deck(R)
             union Suf(L) vee Pref(U)
             union Suf(U) vee Pref(R)
             union Suf(L) vee {tot(U)} vee Pref(R).

       Hence equality of internal, prefix and suffix decks (with equal total)
       is sufficient for every context.  The split octagon fails it.  For
       d>=2 the maximal directed source-deck differences are

                            (2d+1,2d+1),

       while the sharp eight-address differences are

                            (4d+1,6d-3).

       Prefix and suffix each differ by one set value per direction.  The
       sharp banks are a constant number of explicit nested filler rays, but
       arbitrary union-preserving refinements of all current source letters
       still leave exactly 3d-3 masks unreachable in either direction.  This
       is an existential one-target refinement statement; it does not assert
       simultaneous realization of individually reachable targets.

       The exact terminal compiler bank is occurrence-labelled.  Freeze the
       unaffected inherited assignments, discard protected rows with a
       surviving deadline/trace/cap-legal common or exterior alternate, and
       let B be the remaining exposed rows.  With C the free guarded cells,
       extension is equivalent to

                              |N(A)|>=|A|  for every A subset B.

       If inherited assignments are mobile, use the combined graph; if one
       assignment must survive both phases, use the intersection/joint
       two-phase graph.  Taking B equal to the full opposite directed deck is
       a stronger self-contained local-reset condition, not the minimal
       global compiler gate.  Thus raw set differences are not a global Hall
       deficiency lower bound.

       The two exterior hosts do preserve the central owner path exactly.
       Its expanded profile is

                    (r+2,r+1) | r^(8d+23) | (r+1,r+2),

       with residence floor d+1.  The fixed-H theorem plants only the
       16d+44 central q1 edges under H(16d+44)<=m-2.  Four off-rank Hasse
       edges per packet, upper/Catalan completion and prescribed common-cap
       compilation remain separate obligations.

       The inclusion widths of the sharp directed banks are exactly 6 and 7,
       but their native fixed-endpoint ray-cover numbers are exactly 8 and 9.
       Explicit 8/9 target families have pairwise-disjoint complete endpoint
       signatures, so a Dilworth chain cover is not a current-word host
       cover.  Stronger, no number of current-letter splits equalizes the
       decks because of the 3d-3 obstruction above.

       There is nevertheless an exact seven-slot planted-host menu.  Seven
       phase-zero receiver rays partition Delta_1 with lengths

                    d-1,d-1,d-2,d-2,4,d,d-1,

       and six phase-one receiver rays partition Delta_0 with lengths

                    d-1,d-1,d-2,d-2,3,4.

       The seventh phase-one slot is neutral.  Each slot has an explicit
       common old union X_h and split `X_h -> X_h,B_h^epsilon`; all host ranks
       are at most r.  Every X_h is absent from both current sharp source
       words, however.  The exact remaining positive theorem is therefore:

          plant the seven X_h with their literal outward traces
        + preserve owner/deadline/residence and common-cap contraction
        + prove cross-host/post-ray deck equality, or guarded Hall for its
          complete residual occurrence bank.

       Intervals trimming two planted blocks are the first unclosed term.
       Consequently the seven-slot result is a local ray menu, not yet an
       O(1)-split context-transparent recurrence.

2408AD. The split-letter/octagon exterior interface is now fully separated
       into an exact +2 birth theorem, an internal-host no-go, and a strictly
       stronger cross-phase reset gate.

       The four typed profiles satisfy the formal one-host identity

          H_*=Pi_0 union Sigma_0=Pi_1 union Sigma_1,

       but |H_*|=r+4 and its halves have rank r+3, while every exact
       tensor-inverse letter has rank at most r.  First/last occurrence order
       strengthens this: no number of tensor-internal block refinements can
       create any opposite-phase typed prefix or suffix.  The returned
       internal banks also fail literal domination.

       Two prepared exterior letters do close the row:

          X_L={a0,a1},  X_R={a1,a2}.

       With phase orientations

          0: (a0|a1), (a2|a1),
          1: (a1|a0), (a1|a2),

       and common corridors

          R_L=K union F union {z,a2,a3},
          R_R=K union F union {z,a0,a3},

       the packet-near cells are exactly

          {a_(1-epsilon)} union R_L=Pi_(1-epsilon),
          R_R union {a_(2-epsilon)}=Sigma_(1-epsilon).

       This adds two positions relative to the already extended word and
       injectively preserves every old same-phase physical interval by
       full-block lift.  The free caps are X_L at both left positions and
       X_R at both right positions.  If the two host positions themselves
       must be planted, the charge relative to the bare tensor is four.

       The local full-span rectangle is already phase-identical.  Rectangle
       entries present in the old deck transport for free.  For genuinely
       new side-cell targets born from H binary splits, every antichain has
       size at most

                         2H+binom(H,2)=H(H+3)/2.

       Hence an absent [0,r]^2 antidiagonal forces
       H>=ceil((sqrt(8r+17)-3)/2).  The frozen donor-swap rectangle is even
       stronger: an interior a1-poison block prevents every pure refinement,
       regardless of H.

       Native return of the two typed tasks does not by itself reset the
       whole compiler.  The phase source decks are unequal.  At d=1 in the
       sharp inverse, S={z,a3,f0}=Q^0_26 is contraction-safe and occurs as a
       phase-zero singleton, but is absent from both contracted and expanded
       phase-one decks.  For a fixed contract--phase-change--reverse-split
       word, reset is iff the guarded target-to-final-cell equality graph
       satisfies Hall for the complete occurrence-labelled protected bank.
       Therefore Phi<=2 requires, at each transition, one
       simultaneous post-phase-replacement matching for the entire protected
       occurrence bank, in addition to contraction Hall, native typed-cell
       availability and physical owner/q1/residence/deadline/cap legality.
       Under those hypotheses the same two boundaries reverse and reset;
       without them only Phi'<=Phi+2 is justified.
