2409ROOT. The coherent-birail/additive-constant route has been rebased onto
       the exact physical state, and the endpoint-wrap shortcut has been
       sharply delimited.

       For a closed graph Gamma of genuinely physical serial moves, the
       correct terminal bound is

          nu(k) <= B(k)+u(T0)
                   + min_(T in Comp_Gamma(T0)) (chi(T)+lambda_d(T)),

       where chi counts uncontracted split/extra positions and lambda_d is
       the literal terminal compiler deletion number.  The coherent token
       matrix alone does not determine lambda_d.  The smallest authenticated
       structural-zero fibre is C6, with no supported square and one
       indispensable cubic; hence the required local object is a closed
       physical alternating-cycle atlas, not a full-table 2x2 interchange
       graph.  Baggett--Yan supplies abstract full-fibre reachability only
       after that physical lifting/closure theorem is proved.

       The flat prepared endpoint wrap is impossible at B+1.  At B+2 the new
       seam bank is

          2[U] + sum_(j=2)^(d-1)[D_j],

       while the prepared dropped bank is sum_(j=1)^d[D_j]; the exact signed
       exchange is D1+Dd -> 2U.  Thus owner coverage closes only when the
       untouched bank retains duplicate D1,Dd.  Literal dropped/gained-bank
       equality is a stronger hypothesis requiring a second complete Q|P
       seam (four collar blocks when disjoint).  Even then arbitrary-width
       transparency fails generically: the residual is two one-sided rays
       plus a two-sided exterior grid, and an explicit two-cut word loses
       (s-1)(t-1) distinct grid targets.

       The quaternary octagon gives the more promising constant interface.
       After its two exterior hosts, the two source-deck differences have
       sizes 4d+1 and 6d-3, widths 6 and 7, and exact native endpoint-ray
       partitions of sizes 8 and 9.  This yields the concrete remaining
       nine-ray regenerative exterior-ear lemma: make those anchors legal and
       recyclable with chi<=9, preserve the complete exterior language, and
       prove the strict-gammoid all-cut bound

          r(P_X) >= |X|-C0.

       Rado then gives lambda_d<=C0 and hence nu(k)<=B(k)+C0+9.  Ambient
       owner/deadline/residence/common-cap legality and this all-cut rank are
       still open; no unconditional O(1) theorem is claimed.

2410H2. The two-stutter endpoint wrap has an exact cell/window theorem and
       a sharp historical-reset boundary.

       For local collars

          L=Q=(f_(d-1),...,f_2,K,Z),
          R=P=(T,K,f_(d-1),...,f_2),

       the d gained physical source windows of width d+1 have ordered
       multiset

          U,D_(d-1),D_(d-2),...,D_2,U.

       The local L|R bank has d^2 physical cells; this owner bank is its
       width-(d+1) anti-diagonal.  The old dropped bank is not determined by
       the endpoint collars:

          L_k=OR(P[k:d]) union OR((M Q)[0:k+1]).

       Equality with the redesigned bank is an extra literal multiset
       condition, and occurrence-labelled use needs residual Hall.

       The seam is the simultaneous refinement

          X_L=K union Z -> (K,Z),
          X_R=T union K -> (T,K).

       Every palette cell is contraction-safe.  The endpoint U cells omit
       opposite copies of K and mutually insure closure; every internal
       coatom cell contains both blocks fully.  K subset C suffices for the
       owner palette.  Canonical A/B exclusive rays and literal stutters of
       the existing Z,T hold iff K subset A intersect B.

       For a Phi-minimizing old presentation, freeze only relocated
       admissible assignments, put every unfrozen old equality row and every
       new equality task into one free-cell residual Hall graph, and check
       all coupled source/topology/common-cap conditions separately.
       Contracting g old boundaries then gives

                          Phi' <= Phi-g+2.

       Thus full old contraction conditionally gives Phi'<=2.  It is not
       automatic.  Let the two full blocks be

          mathsf R=R,Omega,L,
          mathsf S=R,Omega,C_1,E_1,...,C_t,E_t,Omega,L.

       Rotating mathsf R mathsf S to mathsf S mathsf R gives identical L|R
       collars at the old and new cuts.  Short arms agree literally; every
       longer arm hits Omega.  Arm transposition proves equality of the
       complete OR-deck multiset at every width, and both width-(d+1) banks
       equal the displayed palette.  Nevertheless every private C_i|E_i
       boundary remains essential, so g=0 for arbitrary t.  This is an
       abstract source-word obstruction, not a Pascal/owner no-go.

2410ROOT. The constant-ray and two-stutter routes have exact sharp
       obstructions which further localize the required reset.

       For the expanded sharp octagon source, 8 and 9 are not merely the
       sizes of convenient native ray partitions: they are the exact minimum
       native fixed-endpoint ray cover numbers.  Explicit phase-only targets
       have pairwise disjoint complete endpoint signatures.  More strongly,
       arbitrary block refinements of every current source letter leave
       exactly 3d-3 opposite-phase masks unreachable in each direction.
       Therefore current-letter splitting cannot create source-signature
       conjugacy, regardless of how many such splits are used.  The remaining
       positive route must use newly planted two-sided hosts (at least five if
       one binary host may carry two rays), with literal pairing/common-union,
       owner/deadline/residence/cap, and new-deck guards.

       Independently, the two-stutter rotation has the exact historical-debt
       recurrence

                          Phi' <= Phi-g+2

       only after a simultaneous residual Hall matching and all physical
       guards, where g old essential boundaries are actually contracted.
       A literal two-block identical-collar family preserves the complete
       OR-deck multiset at every width and every short-arm address while
       allowing arbitrarily many private essential boundaries with g=0.
       Thus complete local palette equality and even widthwise full-deck
       equality do not imply Phi<=2; positive reclaim or a planted global
       reset bank is indispensable.

2412C8RA. The relabelled four-block octagon is an exact nonzero
       source-language circuit, and its residence boundary can be repaired
       without adding length; the simple-owner gate remains genuinely open.

       Let Q^0,Q^1 be the unexpanded sharp octagon inverses, let

          alpha=(a0 a2), beta=(a1 a3),
          G_(pi,e)=pi{a0,a1} | pi Q^e | pi{a1,a2},

       and compare phase vectors 0110 and 1001 on
       (1,beta,alpha,alpha beta).  The complete interval-OR multisets agree
       separately at every width and in arbitrary fixed exterior context.
       The three seam grids agree pointwise.  Unlike the stabilized
       doublet, the coherent octagon action is exactly

                              4 g8 != 0.

       Four blocks are sharp inside the S4-relabelled sharp-source fibre:
       there are no signed relations of support 1,2,3; there are 18 circuits
       of support 4 up to global sign, six with nonzero octagon action, hence
       twelve oriented nonzero relations.  The addressed occurrence residue
       has both sparse two-entry rows and four-entry rows (not only
       +/- (1,1,-1,-1)).  Its forced block-pair graph is the connected K2,2
       with edges 01,02,31,32, so uniform block-private tags are forced equal.
       An exact occurrence pairing needs all four edges/both perfect
       matchings; residual widths reach 6d+15 and are not confined to d.

       Owner-row residence has a zero-length repair.  In each guarded block,
       union L_pi plus all fillers into existing source address d and R_pi
       plus all fillers into address n-1-d.  These eight phase-common
       satellite edits preserve the full contextual graded relation and make
       D^d of both macros internally and clipped-boundary resident.  If
       incumbent caps forbid editing, inserting the same two satellites per
       block costs exactly eight positions, independent of d.

       This does not physicalize the circuit as a flat Catalan carrier.  The
       raw concatenated owner histogram is

             r^(32d+92) (r+2)^14 (r+3)^(3d-6),

       with only 8d+24 distinct rank-r values; the zero-length residence
       repair has

             r^(24d+92) (r+2)^6 (r+3)^(11d+2).

       Independently, the four original owner paths have 32d+92 occurrences
       on 8d+24 owners, fourfold lower-q1 duplication, and deduplicated owner
       degree four.  Hence the exact remaining bridge is a rank-correct
       owner/palette quotient weave, not OR transparency or residence.

2413ROOT. The terminal robust two-boundary Hall optimization is now solved
       exactly.  For left thresholds x_i, right thresholds y_j, and a
       pairing pi, let

         C_pi(a,c)=#{i:x_i<=a, y_pi(i)<=c},
         delta(pi)=max_(a,c)(C_pi(a,c)-a-c)_+.

       If L(a)=#{i:x_i<=a}, R(c)=#{j:y_j<=c},
       E_L=max_a(L(a)-a), and E_R=max_c(R(c)-c), then

                    min_pi delta(pi)=(E_L+E_R-N)_+.

       The minimizer pairs increasing x with decreasing y.  A strict
       concordance-removing 2x2 switch decreases every southwest Hall corner
       pointwise, on precisely the rectangle

          x_i<=a<x_j, y_i<=c<y_j,

       and decreases the total corner potential by
       (x_j-x_i)(y_j-y_i).  Hence the abstract birail landscape has no
       nonglobal local minima.

       The canonical two-ray marginals are exactly critical rather than
       deficient: each shore has multiset

                    {0^(d-1),1,2,...,d-1},

       so N=2d-2, E_L=E_R=d-1, and the antitone optimum has zero Hall
       defect.  This removes the terminal two-dimensional Hall optimization
       once arbitrary endpoint pairing is physically reachable.

       The quotient-folded octagon supplies the correct all-depth comparator
       support: it swaps a1,a3 between the same prefix and suffix filler
       chains while already satisfying simple owners, lower q1, Hamilton
       topology, upper q1 and residence.  It is not yet a closed safe edge.
       The exact remaining theorem is owner-legal planting/recycling of its
       two nonnative ray hosts, cut-palette repair, matching-closed common-Q,
       and transport/conjugation to every required adjacent threshold pair.
       A constant fresh host cost per comparator would accumulate and is not
       sufficient.

       obstruction and reduces the physical octagon packet to an exact
       two-ray terminal compiler state; the remaining regenerative gate is
       now isolated.

       On the 8d+24 distinct owner values, each phase has exactly sixteen

       exactly two per phase are upper-q1 complete.  Any audited common-edge
       opening is depth-d resident with nonempty maximal inverse and loses

         P_0={K+za3+F[1,j]},  S_0={K+za1+F[j,d]},
         P_1={K+za1+F[1,j]},  S_1={K+za3+F[j,d]},

       for 1<=j<d and 2<=j<=d.  Hence each phase has exactly two rays of
       d-1 occurrence-labelled targets and certified packet matroid

                            U_(2d-2,2d-2).

       The global minimum-signature cut has L1=6d+4 but loses one upper
       colour and does not use the aligned native anchors.  The aligned-base
       cut has L1=10d+12 and also loses one upper colour.  The upper-safe cut
       has L1=10d+20 and no upper casualty.  With one protected cell for the
       unavoidable lower cut colour, its native local restriction is
       U_(2d-1,2d-1) and its conditional local deficiency is zero.

       There are two exact host interfaces.  Two hosts

         X_L=(K+za3+f1) union (K+za1+f1),
         X_R=(K+za1+fd) union (K+za3+fd)

       carve the two rays, transport every old interval by a full-block

       common split host X=K+za1a3 does the same at additive source cost one,
       but necessarily creates a nonflat one-deadline-jump interface.  These
       are conditional on actual typed host occurrences and one compatible
       transported background matching.

       The terminal ray Hall gate itself is closed.  Both threshold
       marginals are {0^(d-1),1,...,d-1}, so N=2d-2 and the antitone formula
       gives E_L=E_R=d-1 and exact optimum zero.  The precise remaining
       physical theorem is owner-legal host/sidecar planting in one
       matching-closed cap state and its transport to adjacent obligations.

       This is not yet a regenerative graded relation.  For the canonical
       aligned fold and two-host words, the three graded L1 distances are
       10d+12, 4d-4 and 6d+16; the final signed residue has one unit on each
       side at every width 2d+5,...,5d+12.  Common exterior screens do not
       cancel it.  Thus single-endpoint terminal matching is exact after

2415L. The quotient-folded C8 closes the abstract two-ray/common-cap Hall
       row, but it does not close the strict upper Catalan selector.  This
       corrects the scope of "upper-complete" in item 2414R: it means
       support-surjective on sixteen local upper values, not upper-rainbow.

       Every upper-support-complete folded Hamilton cycle has upper load

                              1^8 (d+2)^8,

       and every support-safe opening has

                         1^8 (d+1)^1 (d+2)^7.

       Thus its 8d+23 path edges have rank 16 in the strict upper partition
       matroid and forced-set nullity 8d+7.  No residual or joint ambient
       selector can contain the whole literal path in an upper-exact forest;
       at m=9,d=6 at least 55 of 71 packet edges must be replaced.  An
       independent enumeration reconstructs all sixteen degree-two choices
       in both phases without importing the primary folded enumerator and
       verifies the four complete old/new counter identities for d=2..12.

       The cut faces are distinct.  Minimum signature has L1=6d+4, upper
       support 15 and phase-displaced ray addresses.  The aligned face has
       L1=10d+12 and support 15.  The upper-safe face has L1=10d+20,
       support 16 and displaced addresses.  Hence the attractive 6d+4 row
       is neither upper-safe nor a common native socket.

       Conditional source/compiler closure is nevertheless exact.  Two
       typed endpoint refinements X_L,X_R transport every old interval by
       full-block lift, make every double-trimmed cell phase-common, and give
       2d-2 distinct side cells with a literal diagonal matching.  One
       merged binary host carries both rays at additive cost one, but only
       as a nonflat one-deadline-jump interface; any internal flat split
       creates d rank-deficient owner windows.  The antitone birail marginals
       have E_L=E_R=d-1 and N=2d-2, so their abstract Hall optimum is exactly
       zero.  At a shared cap state theta the honest ambient criterion is the
       matroid-union row

          r_(P,epsilon)^theta(Y)+r_(B,epsilon)^theta(Y) >= |Y|

       for every target subset and both phases; after fixing the ray
       diagonal this is residual Hall on the complement.

       The smallest live physical target is therefore not host planting for
       the current fold alone.  It is a nonliteral upper-strict quotient
       weave changing at least 8d+7 upper incidences while retaining the
       two-ray comparator action and exporting an owner-legal prepared host
       halo/matching-closed cap state.  Support-only upper coverage is not
       ruled out, but it leaves the upper-exact Catalan forest face and needs
       a separate global target-cell proof.

2416ROOT. Ordinary containment Hall is now closed exactly at one row beyond
       the deadline depth, and its residual deficiency at the deadline depth
       is bounded by the triangular boundary slack.

       Put

         D=ceil(Lambda/W),

       make D labelled copies of every rank-r owner T, and join a strict-lower
       target S to (T,j) iff S subset T.  The fractional assignment

         x_(S,(T,j))=1/[D binom(k-|S|,r-|S|)]

       has left load one and uniform right load Lambda/(DW)<=1.  Bipartite
       integrality therefore gives an exact containment SDR for the complete
       strict lower ideal.  Moreover

                            d <= D <= d+1.

       With only d copies, the uniform owner flow has load rho=Lambda/W, so
       every lower family F satisfies |F|<=rho|N(F)|.  Hall deficiency is
       consequently bounded by

         delta_d <= (Lambda-dW)_+ <= binom(d+1,2).

       Thus scalar capacity, lower-set popularity and unrestricted
       containment Hall cannot cause an unbounded additive gap.  This is an
       ideal slot theorem, not a word construction: targets assigned to one
       owner need not be nested, while all suffix ORs ending at one physical
       endpoint form an inclusion chain.  The remaining strengthening is
       chainization plus serialization in one chronology, or equivalently a
       physically closed serial comparator/Markov lift reaching the antitone
       terminal compiler state.  The correct endpoint-chain consequence uses
       the established deadline-depth lemma; it must not be replaced by the
       stronger unproved assertion that every length-(e+1) interval contains
       a preselected middle witness.

2417ROOT. Nested owner chains also have an exact symmetric fractional
       solution at the same depth D=ceil(Lambda/W)<=d+1.  Put

         p_s=binom(k,s)/W  (1<=s<r).

       Then 0<=p_s<=1 and sum_s p_s=Lambda/W<=D, so p lies in the
       independence polytope of U_(D,r-1).  Choose a random rank set R of
       size at most D with Pr(s in R)=p_s.  For each middle owner T, choose a
       uniform ordering of T and retain its initial subsets at the ranks in
       R.  This is one nested chain under T.  A fixed rank-s target S receives
       total weight

         binom(k-s,r-s) p_s/binom(r,s)=1.

       Hence there is a fractional factor with owner load exactly one and
       lower-target load exactly one.  At depth d, replacing p by any
       q<=p with sum q=min(d,Lambda/W) gives a fractional packing whose total
       uncovered mass is exactly

                         (Lambda-dW)_+,

       which is optimal by scalar capacity.  Thus even nested chainization
       has no additional fractional obstruction.  The first unresolved step
       is integral selection of one owner chain per T; after that, the chosen
       chains must still be serialized by one physical source chronology.

2417H2. The quotient-folded C8 terminal Hall row is exact, but a
       phase-common screened source composition cannot realize it.  This
       corrects the isolated-provider interpretation and separates abstract
       matching from physical regeneration.

       The antitone birail theorem was independently replayed: increasing-x
       paired with decreasing-y simultaneously attains every Frechet corner
       lower bound, and a strict concordance-removing switch weakly decreases
       every southwest corner, strictly on its exact rectangle.  The
       canonical ray marginals have N=2d-2 and E_L=E_R=d-1, hence terminal
       Hall defect zero.  This statement is abstract and assumes the ray
       cells are owner-legal and freely pairable in one cap state.

       For signed width-graded interval counters there is a solver-free
       composition law.  If every interval crossing a seam is pointwise
       phase-common, then the signed counter of the concatenation is the sum
       of the two internal signed counters.  Therefore a common screen is
       neutral: it cannot cancel a nonzero internal residue.  Exhausting all
       ray-clean folded Hamilton faces for 2<=d<=12 and adjoining the exact
       opposite two-host provider gives:

         face                    fold L1       screened residual L1
         minimum signature       6d+4          2d+8
         aligned upper-15        10d+12        6d+16
         minimum upper-safe      10d+20        6d+24
         upper-safe + aligned    22d+44        18d+48.

       The last face is nonempty: it has 4d+4 rows, with a canonical forward
       representative at p=4d+10,q=5d+10.  Its per-sign residual width
       weights are 1,2,3,...,3,2,1 on 2d+4,...,5d+13, of total mass 9d+24.
       Thus the isolated host component closes distinct set support, not the
       addressed graded history.  A successful composition must deliberately
       use a phase-sensitive cross-grid, quotient/overlap addresses, or
       transport the residue into a recycled matching-closed ambient bank.

       The two canonical internal plantings on the upper-safe aligned face
       are independently closed.  Whole-host mode creates exactly two
       rank-(r+1) owners at starts 3d+10 and 5d+12.  Base-pair mode keeps rank
       r and residence but forces a triple owner at p,p+1,p+2, hence two
       non-Johnson stutter edges; its directed support residue is 8d-16 per
       side for d>=3 (exceptional value 2 at d=2).  Therefore neither proves
       a strict flat lift.  An exterior/rethreaded two-host construction with
       one protected cut cell and complete contraction/phase Hall remains a
       precise open subcase; under those additional hypotheses chi<=2.

2418ROOT. The exact gap between ideal containment, integral owner chains and
       one physical chronology is now formalized.

       For q>=1, make a hypergraph whose vertices are the strict-lower
       targets and the rank-r owners, and whose atom (T,C) consists of one
       owner T together with one inclusion chain C of at most q named lower
       targets below T.  An integral q-chain factor is exactly a matching in
       this hypergraph covering every target and using every owner once.
       Its deficiency gamma_q is the correct integral chainization
       parameter.  The symmetric theorem in item 2417ROOT proves fractional
       deficiency (Lambda-qW)_+ at q=d and zero at q=D, but ordinary
       bipartite containment integrality does not transfer to these atoms.
       Equivalently, this is capacitated list colouring of the strict-lower
       incomparability graph: target S may use precisely the owner colours T
       containing S, every colour class must be a chain, and each colour has
       capacity q.  Erasing the incomparability edges recovers the ideal SDR
       and locates exactly where total unimodularity is lost.
       Equivalently, adjoining each owner to its selected lower chain turns
       an integral q-chain factor into a partition of the nonempty Boolean
       half `1<=|S|<=r` into exactly W chains of size at most q+1; every such
       W-chain partition reverses this construction because the rank-r
       antichain places one owner in every chain.  Thus the rounding gate is
       a genuine one-sided bounded-uniform-chain problem, close to the
       upper-half uniform-chain conjecture, not a hidden bipartite theorem.

       For a fixed ideal SDR M, if F_T is the family assigned to owner T,
       the exact number retainable without changing owners is

                            sum_T height(F_T).

       At k=5,r=3,d=2 there is a saturated zero-Hall-defect SDR whose five
       pair fibres are {12,13}, {14,15}, {23,24}, {25,35}, {34,45}; each has
       height one, and the five singleton fibres also have height one.  Thus
       fixed-owner chainization loses five of fifteen targets.  Meet/join
       uncrossing is invalid because it changes the named target/rank
       inventory.  Global owner reassignment is essential.

       Even an integral owner-chain factor is not yet a word.  If Q_(j,t)
       denotes the length-t suffix OR ending at j, physical serialization is
       equivalent to the exact sliding cocycle

         Q_(j,t)=Q_(j-1,t-1) union Q_(j,1),  t>=2,

       and then A_j=Q_(j,1) is uniquely forced.  Separate nested endpoint
       tables need not satisfy this recurrence.  A positive extension fact
       is that bounded lower chains whose tops form an antichain always
       inject into distinct rank-r owners by pushing the tops upward in one
       fixed symmetric-chain decomposition.

       Hence the two honest remaining lower gates are

         gamma_d <= (Lambda-dW)_+ + O(1)

       for the integral chain-atom hypergraph, followed by sliding-cocycle
       serialization/common-Q.  This is strictly sharper than “uncross the
       ideal SDR.”

         MATH_THEOREM_IDEAL_SDR_TO_ENDPOINT_CHAIN_COCYCLE_AND_UNCROSSING_GATE_20260801.md
           SHA f1900b4eceea460944b3f45e1a87f98cdc353b517ff034d1bfc5327367f07f1c.

2419AD. The folded-C8 terminal Hall row is zero, but an exact
       source-to-owner incidence theorem now proves that its internal full
       hosts require a linear owner rethread.

       If A is contained in a depth-d source letter at p, then every owner
       row in I_d(p)=[p-d,p] contains A.  Relative to an old owner multiset
       T, let

         h^+(T,T')=|T'|-sum_X min(m_T(X),m_T'(X))

       count new or nonretained owner occurrences after arbitrary
       reordering.  If the new source contains A at positions P, then

         h^+(T,T') >= |union_(p in P) I_d(p)|-n_A(T).

       This statement permits unequal lengths; at equal length h^+ is the
       owner-occurrence replacement count.  It is not a source-letter or
       Johnson-edge edit bound.

       In either quotient-folded C8 phase, the 8d+24-owner bank has exactly
       one owner containing {a1,a3}, namely

         U=K union {z,a1,a3} union F[1,d].

       Hence any internal full host containing {a1,a3} needs at least d new
       or nonretained owner occurrences.  Two such hosts fixed at the
       aligned distance-d addresses need 2d: their two d+1 incidence
       intervals overlap only in U.  More generally internal separation
       h<=d gives floor d+h, while exterior/clipped and relocated designs
       have their own incidence formula.  Thus bounded-support flat internal
       host closure is impossible, although a linear-support length-neutral
       rethread, exterior planting or deadline-(d+2) lift remains open.

       The complementary-anchor spacing itself is exact.  Owner simplicity
       forces q-p>=d, while the cross-host deadline gives q-p<=d, hence
       q-p=d.  The canonical aligned face is upper-support 15 at
       (4d+12,5d+12); the enlarged aligned support-16 face has minimum
       (4d+10,5d+10).  Neither is strict upper-rainbow.  The support-safe
       path has upper-partition nullity 8d+7, a separate sufficient-subclass
       obstruction.  The aligned upper-15 opposite-host composition has
       residual graded L1=6d+16; the aligned upper-safe face has residual
       L1=18d+48.  Phase-common screens cannot cancel these rows.

       A second exact no-go closes the proposed K2,2 pair-shared tag weave.
       On each sensitive d-window, source cancellation forces the hit-tag
       graph to be a matching; owner distinction on the intervening
       (d+1)-window forces a nonmatching.  Three consecutive sensitive
       windows contradict one another for arbitrary staggered supports.

       The live object is therefore a nonliteral, phase-sensitive quotient
       weave which creates the linear owner halo, repairs or bypasses the
       strict-upper dependence, recycles the graded residue, and reaches one
       matching-closed cap state.  Once that state exists, the antitone
       birail theorem still gives exact terminal deficiency zero.

2420A. The folded-C8 single-boundary-rail mechanism now has an exact
       theorem boundary.

       If d+1 consecutive rank-r Johnson owners share a host X of rank
       r-d+1, their residuals form a d-edge path of (d-1)-sets.  At most
       d-1 transitions can be fresh one-way swaps.  A dth transition forces
       a trace 0,1^t,0 with 1<=t<=d-1, so a fully internal host fan violates
       residence.  A single global cut repairs a proposed rail iff its edge
       belongs to the clipping set of every short run.  Address separation
       p_R-p_L=d is only the one-overlap owner-incidence geometry; it does
       not imply this common-cut condition.  The d=4 path

                    abc -> xbc -> ubc -> uyc -> uvc

       has two separated singleton runs and is the minimal warning.

       The bound has a positive sharp form for d>=3.  With disjoint
       (d-1)-sets A,B and one relay c, the path

         S_0=A,
         S_i=(A-{a_1,...,a_i}) union {c,b_1,...,b_(i-1)},
         S_d=B

       is simple Johnson, has separately injective lower and upper q1
       colours, and has only the c-run nonmonotone.  Cutting inside that run
       gives an abstract resident boundary ear.  The owner mechanism is
       therefore real, but endpoint identification with the folded hosts is
       still open.

       The exact physical test is now five rows: common-cut residence with
       certified halos; simple/spanning owner equality; the full signed q1
       occurrence ledger with the cut colour chi recycled; the mixed-row
       maximal-Q reconstruction equalities in both compatible phase states;
       and protected occurrence Hall in one matching-closed background.
       A bare coatom core is not an endpoint source letter: the first/last
       caps must also contain T_0-T_1 and T_last-T_prev.  Thus moving a
       rank-(r-d+1) core to the cut removes the internal pigeonhole but does
       not alone reconstruct owners.

       The remote authenticated recut census closes the passive version:
       for 2<=d<=12 the best folded common recut has boundary radius
       4d+12, and the upper-safe subface has radius 4d+13; allowing all
       sixteen cycles or independent phase cuts does not improve 4d+12.
       A genuine owner/source rethread is necessary.  Conditional on the
       five physical rows, the local ray restriction is U_(2d-2,2d-2) and
       the antitone terminal Hall deficiency is exactly zero.

2420ROOT. Integral owner-chainization now has an unconditional constant-factor
       theorem and a sharp uniform-chain barrier.

       Tomon's rank-symmetric minimum chain decomposition of the Boolean
       lattice restricts below the unique rank-r member of each chain to an
       anchored lower factor satisfying

         |C_T| <= (13/2)sqrt(k)+1 <= 11d(k)

       for all sufficiently large k.  Thus integral nested owners exist at
       O(d) depth; only the sharp coefficient is missing.
       In odd dimension, anchoring adds no further obstruction once a
       W-chain partition of the strict lower ideal is known: every chain has
       one rank-m maximum, and the regular rank-m/rank-(m+1) containment
       graph perfectly matches those maxima to distinct owners.

       Conversely, an anchored h-factor completes by complementation to a
       W-chain partition of the full Boolean lattice with maximum size at
       most 2h+2 for even k and 2h+1 for odd k.  If h=D=ceil(Lambda/W), this
       maximum is strictly below the average chain size 2^k/W plus three.
       Hence sharp D-chainization alone would prove a strong unresolved
       one-sided form of the uniform-chain programme.  It is far beyond an
       ordinary Hall rounding.

       A fixed symmetric-chain decomposition cannot reach the sharp depth by
       splitting: its exact overload is

         E_(k,h)=sum_(j=h+1)^(r-1) binom(k,r-j),

       and splitting at h=D requires at least E_(k,D)/D=Theta(W) additional
       chains, versus only O(d) physical boundary chains.  Global rechaining
       is unavoidable.  The chain-atom set-partitioning matrix is also not
       totally unimodular: three nested targets and the three pair-columns
       have determinant-two incidence minor

         [[1,0,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,1]].

       Therefore the proof frontier is now exact: either round the symmetric
       fractional chain factor with only O(1) extra defect at sharp depth, or
       construct the factor jointly with the arrival-clock/second-endpoint
       cocycle.  Even the former would be a major Boolean-lattice theorem.

         MATH_THEOREM_OWNER_CHAINIZATION_CONSTANT_FACTOR_SHARP_BARRIER_20260801.md
           SHA 575ae4fbc0f62eac8e66aefbb069e1b2dcf2b8baaad5e97629740188d9cd6ea6.

2421ROOT. The folded-C8 physical comparator has a final scoped boundary
       theorem.  An internal rank-(r-d+1) source host lies in d+1 owner
       windows.  Removing its core leaves a d-edge path on (d-1)-sets; depth-d
       residence forbids recycling an inserted coordinate inside the block,
       so d transitions would require d distinct deletions from only d-1
       coordinates.  Thus such a flat host must be clipped by the global
       boundary, actively rethreaded, or placed in the nonflat deadline-jump
       interface.

       Remote H100 censuses for d=2..12 close passive recutting: over all
       sixteen quotient Hamilton cycles per phase, all cuts and orientations,
       the best typed-base boundary radius is 4d+12; upper-safe cuts need at
       least 4d+13.  Independent phase cuts give the same 4d+12.  Hence a
       passive connector cannot expose the existing ray bases.

       There is one useful positive socket.  The smaller host
       X=K union {z,a1,a3} can occur at source position zero without changing
       the owner path.  Splitting it is support-safe and adds three local
       values, but it supplies neither complete ray; the residual in each
       direction is 6d-5.  The exact remaining actuator is therefore an
       active quotient rethread transporting the nested ray rail to this
       clean boundary socket.  Support-upper completeness is sufficient only
       for the universal-support route; a strict Catalan-selector route still
       needs injective upper-occurrence allocation.

2422R. The proposed folded-C8 single-cut rail now has one exact positive
       source theorem and one exact owner obstruction.

       A full minimal host X of rank r-d+1 lies in d+1 owners whose residuals
       form a d-edge walk on (d-1)-sets.  Its d arrival runs cannot all
       survive into a final set of size d-1, so one positive run is strictly
       internal and has length at most d-1.  For aligned full hosts
       p_R=p_L+d, their transition-edge sets are disjoint.  Therefore one
       global cut cannot make TWO INDEPENDENT full-window hosts resident.
       The live architecture must first open the cycle and realize one or
       both hosts as clipped boundary occurrences (or otherwise couple their
       arrival state); passive rerooting of the internal hosts is closed.

       The abstract owner ear itself is real.  For d>=3, disjoint
       (d-1)-sets A={a_i}, B={b_i} and a relay c give

         S_0=A,
         S_i=(A-{a_1,...,a_i}) union {c,b_1,...,b_(i-1)},
         S_d=B.

       This is simple Johnson, its lower and upper q1 labels are separately
       injective, and c is the sole nonmonotone run.  Cutting inside the
       c-run clips the defect.  At d=2 the two lower link colours coincide,
       so that double-rainbow ear has a sharp small-depth exception.

       More importantly, the source-language residue is now positively
       closed on the authenticated folded family.  Let S_0,S_1 be the
       aligned folded source words and G_0,G_1 the opposite two-host words.
       For every 2<=d<=12, the common cyclic cut one letter into S is the
       unique cut satisfying

         D_graded(rho(S_0 G_1))=D_graded(rho(S_1 G_0));

       in the reverse block order it is cut d+3.  Ungraded support also
       agrees.  Before screening, suffix signatures agree while exactly
       3d+8 prefix entries differ.  Prepending either common screen
       {a1,a3} or {z,a1,a3} preserves graded equality and makes BOTH prefix
       and suffix signatures equal.  Hence the screened pair has exactly the
       same unlabelled width-graded OR deck in every fixed exterior word on
       the audited range.  This is not addressed start/end equality.  The
       screen costs one source cell unless an existing collar realizes it.
       The result refutes the interpretation of the earlier 6d+16 row as an
       invariant; the cut and one common screen kill its value/width row.

       What remains is now sharply physical: construct owner-legal clipped
       endpoint source words satisfying the dilation/reconstruction
       equations, the q1 survivor/sidecar ledger, residence halos and the
       screened caps; then provide one matching-closed background state in
       both phases.  Conditional on those rows, the ray packet is
       U_(2d-2,2d-2), the canonical antitone Hall defect is zero, and the
       common-Q compiler follows.  No all-d extrapolation or Pascal-child
       embedding is claimed.

2423K. The folded-C8 two-ray owner plateau has a minimal same-length
       basis-changing escape, but the escape is not width-graded
       transparent.

       Put

         U=K union {z,a1,a3} union F[1,d].

       In the canonical two-host word the common d-position overlap already
       has union U, so its two length-(d+1) owners are both U.  More generally,
       if the maximal prefix and suffix ray witnesses both lie in the common
       overlap of two rank-|U| owners, both owners are forced equal to U.
       Thus any strict escape must rehost an extreme ray and introduce one
       basis coordinate outside U.

       There is an exact escape.  Choose fresh g, a nonempty neutral
       C subseteq K union {z}, and 1<=s<=d-1.  With opposite active labels in
       L_epsilon,R_epsilon, set

         M=K union {a1,a3,g},
         Q_epsilon=(M,L_epsilon,f2,...,f_s,C,
                         f_(s+1),...,f_(d-1),R_epsilon).

       This has the same length d+2 as the two-host reference.  In both
       phases its owners are exactly

         V=(U-{f_d}) union {g}, U,

       a strict Johnson edge with lower colour U-{f_d}, upper colour U+g,
       and exact common maximal envelopes

         V,(U-{f_d})^d,U.

       After forgetting interval width, the directed source-support
       difference is exactly the two folded rays.  Their 2d-2 values have
       pairwise-distinct literal cells and a diagonal matching.  The cap and
       owner state are phase returning, so this solves local owner legality,
       ray Hall and common-Q without a fresh length charge.

       The exact correction is load-bearing.  The neutral gap duplicates
       P_s and S_(s+1), so each directed graded difference has mass 2d on
       only 2d-2 values.  At the optimal end gap s=1 (or its reflection),
       replacing the canonical host word loses exactly two phase-common
       target chains, 2d-2 distinct masks.  If lower cells are restricted to
       widths <=d, U is also lost, giving floor 2d-1.  Full target-width
       support loses exactly 3d rows per phase, and exact multiplicity loses
       3d+1 units.  Hence the packet does not inherit item 2422R's graded
       common-cut identity.

       The remaining theorem is now explicit: find an exterior matching for
       the appropriate 2d-2 / 2d-1 / 3d return bank in one common cap state,
       satisfy the typed V,U owner/palette and residence halos, screen the
       phase-sensitive right boundary, repair the cut colours, and transport
       the returned state to arbitrary adjacent birail obligations.  The
       antitone theorem closes the ray marginal only; it does not supply this
       exterior occurrence bank.  No additive-constant conclusion follows
       yet.

2424D. The proposed aligned folded-C8 one-cut host rail now has an explicit
       rank-balanced local realization and a sharp direct-embedding no-go.

       The exact common-Q test is screened maximal erosion.  For phase owner
       words T^epsilon and common source caps P, put

         E_p^epsilon = intersection of all owners using source address p,
         M_p^epsilon = P_p intersection E_p^epsilon.

       A nonzero capped source exists iff every M_p^epsilon is nonempty and
       every owner is the union of its d+1 incident M rows.  Endpoint
       difference containments alone are insufficient without baseline
       maximal-erosion exactness; an explicit d=3 counterexample is recorded.

       There is nevertheless a literal positive boundary rail.  Put

         C=K union {z,a1,a3},
         D=C union F[0,d+1],
         v=(f2,f_(d+1),f1,f3,...,f_(d-2),fd,f_(d-1),f0),
         T_j=D-{v_j,v_(j+1)}  (0<=j<=d).

       These are d+1 distinct rank-r Johnson owners.  Their pinned maximal
       erosion has exactly 2d+1 source rows, begins with
       X_L=C+f1, ends with X_R=C+fd, and dilates exactly to T.  It is common
       to both phases and residence-transparent relative to the displayed
       predecessor--rail--successor cuts.  Thus the owner rank, local
       residence and source/common-cap equations are genuinely soluble;
       the naive full-host rank ridge is not an invariant.

       The exact palette ledger identifies the surviving obstruction.  All
       d+2 lower seam colours in either joined phase are distinct, but the

2424ROOT. The true optimal lower-cell geometry, including its triangular
       boundary, has an exact fractional nested-chain factor already at
       depth d; the stronger D=d or d+1 owner factor is unnecessary
       fractionally.

       Let h=(Lambda-dW)_+.  Select h cells of the Ferrers board

         {(i,s):1<=i<=d, 1<=s<=i},

       put b_s equal to the number selected in column s, and set

         p_s=binom(k,s)/W,  q_s=p_s-b_s/W.

       Then q lies in U_(d,r-1).  Uniform prefixes inside every middle owner
       with rank marginals q_s give one fractional anchored d-chain per
       owner and target load 1-b_s/binom(k,s).  At boundary address i, a
       one common uniform singleton prefix A_i={pi_i} realizes every selected
       Ferrers cell (i,s) as its literal length-s suffix union.  It restores
       b_s/binom(k,s), and all boundary chains satisfy the sliding cocycle
       jointly.  Every strict-lower target has total load exactly one.

       Thus the LP is exact on W anchored capacities d plus boundary
       capacities 1,2,...,d, whose total is precisely
       dW+binom(d+1,2).  The remaining static issue is integral rounding of
       this triangular chain-atom hypergraph, not scalar capacity or
       fractional nestedness.

2425ROOT. The exact integral triangular deficiency and the best present
       asymptotic rounding are now explicit.  Let Gamma_d^triangle be the
       uncovered target count after choosing W disjoint anchored d-chains
       and d unanchored boundary chains of capacities 1,...,d.  If gamma_d
       is the stronger anchored-only deficiency, then

         (gamma_d-binom(d+1,2))_+ <= Gamma_d^triangle <= gamma_d.

       The upper-half construction of Sudakov--Tomon--Wagner, complemented,
       anchored and truncated, gives for q in {d,D}

         gamma_q <= (Lambda-qW)_+ + O(Lambda k^(-1/16)).

       Hence gamma_D=o(Lambda), gamma_d<=h+o(Lambda), and

         Gamma_d^triangle=o(Lambda).

       So the optimal static tableau is exact fractionally and
       asymptotically exact integrally.  The missing jump is a Boolean
       absorber from sublinear leave to the O(d^2) boundary scale and then
       zero/O(1).  Greene--Kleitman saturation does not provide it: its
       q-norm is minimized, while maximum chain length <=q is equivalent to
       the q-norm taking its maximum |P|.  Cardinality-restricted chain cover
       is a different problem and is NP-complete for general posets.

2426ROOT. Given bounded owner chains, their exact serialization cost is a
       coloured route-inspection invariant in the order-d de Bruijn graph
       over nonempty source letters.

       For each owner-chain (T_i,C_i), let Tr_d(T_i,C_i) be the nonempty
       (d+1)-letter traces with full union T_i whose suffix unions contain
       C_i.  This fibre is always nonempty by a consecutive-clock
       construction.  Choose one coloured edge e_i from each fibre.  If
       chi(z) is the minimum number of extra de Bruijn edges needed to make
       z connected with Euler-path imbalance, then

         minimum serialization overhead = min_(e_i) chi(sum_i e_i).

       In particular zero-sidecar serialization is exactly a connected
       coloured integral circulation choosing one trace per owner-chain.
       If selected trace components end/start at v_i,u_(i+1), their exact
       bridge cost is

         sum_i [d-ov(v_i,u_(i+1))].

       Thus O(1) components generally give only O(d) overhead.  Additive
       O(1) requires total suffix-prefix overlap deficit O(1).  Two
       complementary owners carrying forced full-depth increment chains
       have disjoint trace alphabets and reset distance exactly d, proving
       that individual clockability and bounded component count are
       insufficient.

2427ROOT. The mixed-coatom lower action has an exact nonaccumulation law,
       but only under a strong prospective literal-alignment quantifier.

       Each authenticated twelve-owner replacement is an involution under
       its corresponding active-label transposition (tau_ab, tau_ac or
       tau_bc).  At depth s, after fixing the complete literal base
       B=K union {infinity,c} and the two filler profiles P_s,S_s, its signed
       action is

         [B+P_s+y]+[B+S_s+x]-[B+P_s+x]-[B+S_s+y].

       Hence an aligned prepared route x_0->...->x_t telescopes exactly to
       its two endpoint rails at every depth, and a closed route has zero
       signed lower value-multiset action.  This is not occurrence Hall:
       physical target--cell addresses and common-cap guards are forgotten.

       The q(q-1) planted atlas does not itself supply such a route: it
       varies c,delta while the literal involution swaps fixed a,b, and c is
       part of B.  A separate prospective embedding theorem must align the
       whole bases and filler flags.  For H prospectively planted canonical
       atlases, the audited noncommon-token ledger gives greedy disjoint
       choices whenever

         q > (H-1)(32d+128),

       provided every common token of one atlas is absent from the entire
       support of every other atlas and addresses are also protected.  This
       packs any fixed bank asymptotically, but excludes trace guards and the
       O(d^2) occurrence-incidence footprint.

       The proof-safe implication is therefore still

         nu(k) <= B(k)+u(T_0)+min_T (chi(T)+lambda_d(T)).

       Additive O(1) follows conditionally from an equal-length,
       upper-transparent, resident, prospectively regenerating aligned route
       whose terminal occurrence-labelled Hall deficiency is O(1).  Neither
       regeneration nor that terminal Hall statement is proved.

2428H2. The optimal triangular chain atom system has two exact integral
       projections, but their correlation remains the sharp static gate.

       Fix the Ferrers deficit rows R_i and b_s from item 2424ROOT.  First,
       the residual rank demands binom(k,s)-b_s admit an integral 0--1
       owner schedule with distinct ranks and owner load at most d.  The
       boundary rows themselves can be realized as pairwise-disjoint suffix
       chains of one literal d-letter source prefix, so this projection is
       already cocycle-compatible.  Second, a separate ordinary max-flow
       assigns every named lower target to a containing owner or a Ferrers
       boundary slot, with distinct ranks and the same capacities.  This
       target-level flow need not make the targets at one address comparable;
       the two projections do not combine automatically.

       The complete static address-marginal fractional dual is also
       explicit.  If H_c(w;X) is the maximum w-weight of a cap-c chain in X,
       marginal fractional feasibility is equivalent to

         w(L) <= sum_T H_d(w;L cap down(T)) + sum_(i=1)^d H_i(w;L)

       for every w>=0.  Item 2424ROOT therefore satisfies every weighted,
       ideal, subset and height/Farkas cut in this static projection.  The
       dual does not encode one common physical chronology.  The first
       missing static inequalities are integer configuration ceilings: if F
       has comparability components F_j, exact coverage requires

         sum_j ceil(|F_j|/d) <= W+d.

       This distinction is sharp for general posets.  For each d>=2, take
       W=binom(d+1,2) disjoint lower chains of length d+1 and W universal
       incomparable owners.  The triangular LP is exact, and the natural
       partition is Greene--Kleitman t-saturated for every t, yet the exact
       integral deficiency is

         W-d=d(d-1)/2.

       This is not a Boolean-lattice counterexample and does not reproduce
       the binomial rank profile.  It proves that no general-poset implication
       from fractional feasibility, capacities and all-norm saturation alone
       gives O(1) rounding.

       The precise stronger-subclass absorber is now isolated.  From an
       anchored (d+1)-factor, delete one representative from each long owner
       chain; if all but c representatives partition into d boundary chains
       of capacities 1,...,d, then Gamma_d^triangle<=c.  Thus the live
       Boolean theorem is a disjoint sibling/Johnson-square alternating-route
       absorber producing that representative packing.  Greene--Kleitman
       does not prove it; the unconditional STW bound remains o(Lambda), not
       O(1).  Sliding-OR serialization and upper/residence/common-cap remain
       downstream and are not claimed.

2428ROOT. The canonical terminal birail Hall problem collapses exactly to
       one zero-block count, even under arbitrary physical structural zeros.

       Put m=d-1, N=2m, and take both threshold multisets to be

         {0^m,1,2,...,m}.

       For every pairing pi, not only an antitone one,

         delta(pi) = #{zero-threshold paired to zero-threshold}.

       The lower bound is the southwest corner (0,0).  For the upper bound,
       every other counted pair can be charged injectively to one of the at
       most a positive left thresholds or c positive right thresholds below
       a corner (a,c).  Therefore no ordering of the positive thresholds is
       relevant.  The proof only needs every positive threshold to occur at
       most once per shore; with repetition excesses e_L,e_R it gives the
       robust bound

         t(pi) <= delta(pi) <= t(pi)+e_L+e_R.

       In an arbitrary physical pairing graph H with shores
       L_0,L_+,R_0,R_+ of size m, zero ray defect is equivalent to two
       ordinary perfect matchings

         H[L_0,R_+] and H[L_+,R_0].

       More generally the exact ray defect is a zero-one-cost perfect
       matching value, with cost one only on L_0 R_0 edges.  This eliminates
       the former need to transport adjacent comparators or reach the full
       antitone permutation.

       The four folded target rays have two canonical antidiagonal
       bijections P_0(j)<->S_1(j+1) and P_1(j)<->S_0(j+1).  Each pair has a
       j-independent intersection and union cap, so the target-value algebra
       has exactly the required cross shape.  This is not one addressed
       compiler cell: each antidiagonal edge is a paired two-coordinate
       ticket, its two intervals are adjacent and disjoint, and the displayed
       pair lives across opposite phase words.  A physical use therefore
       needs two compatible cell banks in one endpoint state or an exact
       phase address-isomorphism transporting a complete matching.

       If the typed host is already an actual old source block, the separate
       background-Hall clause disappears conditionally: restrict the old
       matching away from targets reassigned to the ray bank, require the
       lifted cells to remain guard/deadline admissible, and require exact
       common-cap contraction.  Injective full-block lifting then transports
       every remaining old matched interval, and the new ray cells are side
       cells outside that image.  The known two-host packet
       already has a phasewise diagonal U_(2d-2,2d-2) ray matching.  Hence
       the true remaining gate is host embedding/admissibility and bounded
       reset; the cross criterion is needed only for alternative restricted
       physical realizations.

       Hence the remaining C8 theorem is now phase-common/clipped host plus
       compatible two-coordinate endpoint transport plus exterior reset,
       not a comparator network.

2429L. The proposed asymptotically sharp anchored cap-d factor from
       Sudakov--Tomon--Wagner has been independently source-audited PASS,
       with its exact quantifiers and parity rows now frozen.

       Although STW state their headline theorem for the full Boolean
       lattice, Section 2.7 first constructs a literal partition D* of the
       upper half into W chains.  With

         s_k=2^k/W,  K=ceil(s_k/2),  lambda=k^(-1/16),

       all but O(W k^(-1/8+o(1))) chains have length
       K+O(1)+O(lambda K).  Their later Conjecture 3 concerns arbitrary
       prescribed dominated half-chain lengths; it does not make this
       already-proved uniform special case conditional.

       Complement and truncate at d=K+O(1).  For odd k=2m+1, the resulting
       chains have distinct rank-m maxima; the regular rank-m/rank-(m+1)
       containment graph matches them to distinct owners.  No owner is
       deleted in this parity.  For even k=2m, each complemented chain ends
       at its rank-m owner, which is deleted before retaining d strict-lower
       members.  The empty set is deleted globally in either parity.

       Summing only the typical-chain contributions, rather than assuming
       an atypical mass bound, gives

         gamma_d <= (Lambda-dW)_+
                    +O(Lambda k^(-1/16+o(1)))
                 = O(Lambda k^(-1/16+o(1))),

       because (Lambda-dW)_+<=binom(d+1,2)=O(k).  Thus the claimed
       Lambda-o(Lambda) static anchored packing is unconditional.  Exact or
       O(1) leave, integral triangular boundary chains, endpoint cocycle,
       residence, upper guards, topology and common-cap serialization all
       remain outside scope.

2431ROOT. The static triangular-chain leave now has an exact Boolean
       single-hole actuator, together with its correct coloured-state
       obstruction.

       Extend every owner chain by the empty set and its rank-r owner.  If
       X is deleted, its predecessor and successor form a deletion gap.  An
       admissible route starts at an ordinary gap of an underloaded address,
       successively takes targets X_i from pairwise distinct addresses with

         X_1 inside the source gap,
         X_(i+1) inside the deletion gap of X_i,

       and ends at an overloaded address.  Rotate the X_i one address
       backward.  Every address remains a chain below the same owner, every
       target is retained exactly once, internal loads are unchanged, the
       first load rises by one and the last falls by one.  Hence total
       overload drops exactly by one.  If an accepting route exists after
       every earlier rotation, serial descent gives a zero-defect static
       triangular factor.

       Exact route existence is reachability in the finite state graph
       (g,F), where g is the current hole gap and F is the set of already
       used addresses.  A transition chooses a fitting target in a new
       address and advances to its deletion gap; choosing an overloaded
       address accepts.  The F-coordinate is indispensable.  A naive
       unit-capacity address node merges the identity of the entering target
       and can exit through the wrong deletion gap, so ordinary Menger/Hall
       on the projected gap graph is only a relaxation.  The smallest
       literal selected-instance obstruction has two capacity-one owners
       T1=123,T2=345, chain {1}<{1,2} at T1 and an empty chain at T2; neither
       overloaded target fits below T2.  This is not the complete lower
       ideal and therefore only scopes the missing completeness theorem.

       Boolean local supply is already exponential in sqrt(k).  If an
       anchored chain has load ell and gap dimensions g_0,...,g_ell, then

         sum g_j=r,
         sum_j (2^(g_j)-2)
           >= (ell+1)(2^(r/(ell+1))-2).

       Every ordinary gap menu is entirely external to its owning chain.
       Thus an underloaded anchored cap-d chain has one gap with at least

         2^(ceil(r/d))-2 = 2^(Theta(sqrt(k)))

       legal targets.  What remains is not menu size but exclusion of a
       nonaccepting address-coloured interval-closed state family, and
       preservation of that expansion under serial rotations.  A terminal
       closure stranding O(d^2), O(1), or zero overload would yield the
       corresponding improvement of Gamma_d^triangle.  Adjacent swaps
       inside one owner flag cannot do this: they preserve the full
       rank-slot and load vectors.  All statements here are static;
       suffix-OR/Euler serialization remains a separate downstream gate.

         MATH_THEOREM_TRIANGULAR_CHAIN_SINGLE_HOLE_ROUTING_AND_INTERVAL_CUT_20260801.md

2432C8E. The optimal triangular fractional chain factor and the trace-Euler
       reduction meet at a new exact marked-circulation gate; the previously
       chosen canonical clock does not pass it.

       Fix the boundary Ferrers board, with rank multiplicities b_s, and put

          q_s=(binom(k,s)-b_s)/W.

       A marked trace atom is a literal length-(d+1) de Bruijn edge of
       rank-r owner, together with a selected nested subset of its proper
       suffix unions.  The exact joint fractional system has three rows:
       owner mass one for every rank-r owner; residual target load

          1-b_|S|/binom(k,|S|)

       for every strict-lower target S; and literal prefix-state equals
       suffix-state flow at every order-d de Bruijn vertex.  After Sym(k)
       averaging, feasibility is exactly

          q in ST_(k,r,d),

       where ST is the marked-rank projection of the invariant literal-state
       circulation polytope.  Uniform-matroid inequalities on q establish
       the chain factor but do not imply this membership.

       The separation is already literal at k=6.  Here r=3,d=1,W=20,
       b_1=1 and (q_1,q_2)=(1/4,3/4).  The canonical consecutive clock has
       head-rank law (1/4)[1]+(3/4)[2] but tail-rank law
       (1/4)[3]+(3/4)[2], hence nonzero de Bruijn divergence even after all
       owner and coordinate symmetries.

       This is a clock defect, not a fractional no-go.  For each owner T and
       x in T put P_x=T-{x}.  Give weight 1/12 to all six edges

          {x}->P_x, P_x->{x},

       and all six edges P_x->P_y for x!=y.  Every literal vertex balances;
       owner mass is one; each singleton head has mass 1/12 and each pair
       head mass 1/4.  Thus a global singleton receives owner load 10/12 and
       boundary load 1/6, while a pair receives 4(1/4)=1.  The support is
       connected and contains every singleton root.

       and positive ordered-singleton throughput scales to an Euler circuit
       rootable at the common singleton-prefix state.  This incorporates all
       d boundary chains jointly and has identical initial/terminal root
       distribution.  The denominator remains load-bearing: the scaled

       simultaneously round to one trace per owner, one residual occurrence
       per target, one connected Euler trail, and one literal boundary
       prefix.  Flow balance, coloured integrality and topology/rooting are
       three separate gates.

2435L. The order-one stationary marked-trace threshold theorem has been
       independently audited PASS, with its nonempty-alphabet and slack
       conventions made explicit.

       For q=(q_1,...,q_(r-1)), Q=sum q_s and
       F(a)=sum_(s<=a)q_s, one has exactly

         q in ST_(k,r,1)
           iff Q<=1 and F(a)+F(r-a-1)<=1 for 0<=a<r.

       Necessity is the disjoint low-tail/low-head threshold cut under the
       stationary endpoint-rank law.  Sufficiency is fractional Hall on the
       rank graph a+b>=r; every cut compresses to an initial segment.  The
       coordinate q_r=1-Q is a canonical realization of slack on unmarked
       full-owner heads, not a claim about the unmarked-rank law of every
       witness.  Self-coupling means equal marginals and need not be
       symmetric.

       Uniformly lifting each allowed rank pair to ordered nonempty subsets
       A,B of one owner with A union B=T balances every literal state
       owner-by-owner.  The marked load of a fixed rank-s target is exactly

         binom(k-s,r-s) q_s/binom(r,s)
           = 1-b_s/binom(k,s)^(-1)

       at the triangular vector.  The complete positive-depth d=1 list is
       k=3,4,6, with q respectively (1), (2/3), and (1/4,3/4); all three
       admit weakly connected singleton-rooted supports.  k=1,2 have d=0.

       The reflection calculation is also exact.  For a length-k simple
       walk conditioned to end at epsilon=k mod 2, with
       r=(k+epsilon)/2 and maximum M,

         Pr(M>=t)=binom(k,r-t)/binom(k,r),

       by suffix reflection at the first visit to t.  Hence the unpunctured
       lower binomial profile is the survival law of M, and the omitted
       terminal term is 1/binom(k,r), contributed by the unique mountain
       path U^r D^(k-r).

       No statement for d>1, connected support for arbitrary feasible q,
       or one-owner-per-colour integral Euler rounding follows.

2436H2. The STW triangular-chain leave now has an unconditional
        shortest-rotation reserve, and the new pivot-rich packet has an
        exact coloured-hole scope theorem.

        Let n be the Boolean dimension, M=binom(n,ceil(n/2)),
        K=ceil(2^(n-1)/M), C0=ceil(sqrt(n log n/3)), and

          N=n-ceil(n/2)-C0-1,
          Delta_N=2^N-1-S_(d-1)(N),

        where S_j(N) is the sum of the j largest binomial coefficients of
        order N.  In the complemented STW D* system every underloaded
        anchored address is nonterminal.  If Y is its upper-core maximum,
        every proper R subset V_Y gives a high leftover

          Z_R=Y union B_Y union R,
          X_R=Z_R^c=V_Y-R

        in the source bottom gap.  Its still-present terminal-tail address
        is overloaded.  After t rotations at most t members of this bank
        are unavailable; Erdos's u-chain theorem supplies the complete
        remaining source deficit while t<Delta_N.  Boundary addresses use
        the same construction from Y=empty.  Consequently at least

          min(Phi_0,Delta_N)

        direct rotations are guaranteed and

          Phi_out <= (Phi_0-Delta_N)_+.

        Here Delta_N=Theta(2^N)=2^(n/2-O(sqrt(n log n))).  This is a real
        regenerative horizon but not an O(d^2) result: the published STW
        leftover overload remains 2^(n-o(n)).  Separately, the STW random
        chunks admit a simultaneous interval discrepancy refinement.  For
        every whole block B inside one level and Boolean interval slice F,
        mu=|B||F|/|A_t| at least 16(n log 3+2 log n) implies
        |B intersect F|>=mu/2.  Same-rank injection gives that many distinct
        final addresses, but the downstream arbitrary Dilworth choices do
        not colour them overloaded.  The exact post-reserve gate is
        interval-local high-order chain saturation/overload mixing.

        The component/blossom bridge is also exact.  A nonaccepting gap of
        dimension g has binom(g,floor(g/2)) pairwise distinct middle-layer
        address colours initially; the direct-transfer Hall graph must use
        overloaded right neighbours.  Cloning address units is only a
        relaxation because repeated moves change deletion gaps, so the
        full obstruction remains the address-coloured state closure.

        The sharp pivot packet does not remove that obstruction.  Its two
        non-singleton rays are two inclusion chains and can occupy only two
        current address colours.  Every internal ray deletion exposes one
        Boolean-square sibling absent from the packet.  Those 2h-2 siblings
        have exact chain-cover number four for h>=3: odd/even indices on
        each shore.  If four adequate unused boundary addresses realize
        these parity return chains, each canonical ray-slot hole has a
        length-two balancing route whenever its displaced ray target lies
        in an overloaded third address.  This is a conditional
        square-complete ray-slot return bank, not a generic STW absorber.

        At h=d the packet rays have ranks r-d+1,...,r-1, while the terminal
        reserve targets have rank at most N<r-d.  A reserve target can only
        use the packet singleton among newly exposed cells.  Thus fixed-H
        q1 planting physicalizes a bounded selected bank but does not
        contract the exponential task birth or prove B+O(1).

2436R. The new monotone pivot has exact occurrence and common-cap semantics,
       but only after target release is made literal and all rows are placed
       in one exported state.

       At a cut Q_L|Q_R, insert nonempty X.  The convex-hull address map Phi
       preserves every old interval OR iff

         X subseteq Q_L union Q_R.

       In the width-h band exactly h-1 old crossing width-h cells escape to
       width h+1.  The complement of the retained image is exactly the pivot
       singleton and the two h-1-cell rays, of size 2h-1.  If M0 is the old
       matching, U is the set of actual old logical target vertices released
       for those rays, D is the genuinely fresh target set, and psi is an
       injective literal assignment U dotunion D -> F_X, then

         M+ = Phi(M0 restricted to L\U) dotunion psi(U dotunion D)

       is one complete target-to-cell matching exactly when every retained
       M0 edge remains band/guard admissible.  No background Hall problem is
       left: the two cell banks are the exact addressed complement.  In the
       prepared common-core case X subseteq Q subseteq Q_L intersect Q_R,
       every nonsingleton ray value is an old one-sided target.  Thus all
       2h-2 ray target vertices are released, not called fresh; the singleton
       X is released if old and otherwise is the sole new target.  Repeated
       equal masks are one target in the ordinary compiler and redundant row
       equalities thereafter, unless distinct occurrence IDs are explicitly
       part of the left shore.

       A load-bearing language correction is frozen.  Both rays are private
       under Phi.  A canonical one-sided full-block grouping contains the
       grouped-side ray in its image, so it is usable only after release of
       the corresponding old matching edges.  No single such grouping makes
       both rays private.

       The exact common-Q certificate is one maximal-word state.  For every
       position p export lower bound L_p, cap C_p and every matching, owner,
       protected and boundary row R with target S_R, live interval J_R and
       fixed exterior B_R.  Put

         K_p = C_p intersect intersection_(R:p in J_R) S_R.

       One simultaneous realization exists iff every live K_p is nonempty,
       contains L_p, and

         S_R = B_R union union_(p in J_R) K_p

       for every row.  Literal replay of one inserted word between L and C
       proves these equalities, hence proves one common-Q matching rather
       than separate marginal matches.  The minimal interface additionally
       exports old/new words and cut, Phi/E_h/F_X, target IDs and matching
       addresses, U/D/psi, every pivot owner window including endpoints and

       address, width/type and chronology/trace.  Two phases also need their
       common/private address partition under one cap.  Owner simplicity,
       q1, topology, residence and regeneration remain separate physical
       gates; no two-cross folded matching is inferred.

       matching union and one simultaneous maximal common-Q reconstruction.

       edge-simple incidence linear forest.  It preserves literal set-valued
       incidence edges and internal turns, not source positions, exterior
       histories, caps, or arbitrary-width witnesses.  Requiring every P1
       edge in the representative bank Q0 additionally needs globally
       distinct upper colours; owner/lower resource disjointness alone does
       not imply this.

       The split-core source theorem itself passes.  Its 4h+1 letters give
       3h+1 owners, 3h Johnson transitions, and exactly 6h distinct lifted
       incidences.  H copies therefore have 6Hh edges only under an injective
       owner/lower resource embedding.  The small protected-factor threshold
       is exactly 6Hh+b<=m-2 after r=m on [2m-1], where b counts every extra
       protected boundary edge.  The natural phased predecessor class has
       3Hh edges and extends to a perfect M0 by the middle-shadow Hall bound;
       its successor class is then automatically outside M0.  This closes
       only the phase/perfect-class subgate, not Q0/Q1 correlation.

       A shared base B with pairwise-disjoint outside banks uses
       m+(4H-1)h coordinates and supplies owner, lower, and upper
       cross-copy injectivity; 6Hh<=m-2 implies it fits in [2m-1].  Mere
       graph containment still does not plant the literal 4h+1-letter block
       or its h-letter endpoint contexts in one global antecedent.

2438STA. The stationary-trace threshold and private-phase reductions have
         now been jointly audited at literal-state scope.

         The order-one theorem passes unchanged.  For the nonempty trace
         alphabet and q=(q_1,...,q_(r-1)), Q=sum q_s,

           q in ST_(k,r,1)
             iff Q<=1 and
                 F(a)+F(r-a-1)<=1 for 0<=a<r.

         Necessity is the disjoint low-tail/low-head cut under the common
         stationary endpoint law.  Sufficiency is weighted Hall on the
         threshold graph a+b>=r after adjoining q_r=1-Q.  Uniform subset
         lifting inside each owner balances every literal state and gives
         each rank-s target exact load

           binom(k-s,r-s) q_s/binom(r,s).

         Suffix reflection at the first visit to t also passes exactly:

           Pr(M>=t)=binom(k,r-t)/binom(k,r),

         with the unique mountain path supplying the terminal correction.

         For arbitrary d, the private-phase model is an unconditional
         sufficient cone.  Distinct phase-private coordinates make every
         proper cyclic interval proper and make its union grow strictly.
         The explicit cyclic edges

           e_i=(B_i,...,B_(i+d))

         balance because tail(e_i)=head(e_(i-1)); rankwise thinning proves
         the entire coordinatewise downward closure.  The stationary
         first-occurrence increments are nonincreasing, since a zero gap of
         length ell contributes at distances1,...,ell+1.  Hence

           E R_j >= jr/(d+1),
           sum_(j<=d) E R_j >= rd/2.

         The exact singleton-root addresses G,v,G supply one complete
         constant-cap antidiagonal, and two visits with guards G_1,G_3
         suffice for two banks.  The original immediate-letter proof of
         necessity was incomplete, but the statement is true more broadly:
         at j=1 two banks at one occurrence would give distinct equal-rank
         interval unions G_1+f_1 and G_3+f_1 with one fixed right endpoint.
         Such unions form an inclusion chain, so they cannot both occur.
         Thus two visits are necessary for the exact equal-rank banks even
         when longer exterior collars are permitted.

         No d>1 unrooted triangular-cone inclusion, connected support,
         common-cap lift, or one-copy coloured Euler rounding is inferred.
         The rooted frontier in this item is superseded by the exact odd
         top-face obstruction in item2441L.  The quoted finite d=3 LP probes
         remain evidence only.

          bridge have been independently audited at their exact local scope.

          At one authenticated seam the old phase contains the complete

          can use equal-core old cells which the address map merges.
          This finite endpoint statement is authenticated for 2<=d<=12 and
          does not merge the two phases.

          The dimension-uniform bridge does merge the two cross banks in one
          maximal-cap source.  Its owner word

            G1,...,Gd,B,A,H1,...,Hd,D,E

          is a simple rank-r Johnson path on 2d+4 owners, with 2d+3 distinct

          suffixes width d-j, whereas the authenticated endpoint suffix with
          the same mask has width d-j+1.  Exact-width/phase/address guards

            K*_(d+s)=K union {z,a1,f_s},
            K*_(2d+2+s)=K union {z,a3,f_s}

          for 1<=s<=d, and K*_p=E_p off the rails.  Hence the local lower

          matching.  A retained old matching is then disjoint only

2440PTA. The protected upper-tail theorem has been independently audited
         GO, with two necessary protected-bank/connector scope corrections.

         The central Kruskal--Katona statement is exact and sharp:

           |partial X| >= |X|+m

         for every nonempty family of rank-(m+1) sets on [2m-1].  Hall
         consequently extends every collection of at most m distinct
         upper/tail containment tickets to a complete upper-to-tail
         injection.  The threshold is universally sharp for m>=3: prescribe
         the m+1 facets T of one unprescribed R_0 against the distinct upper
         sets T+{b}, with b outside R_0; this deletes every tail of R_0.

         The incidence lift remains only a semimatching.  Distinct root
         owners T give distinct contracted tails, but the forced opposite
         middle corners may collide as heads.  Selecting one edge of every
         upper colour gives a C=Cat_m component directed path forest Q_0.
         Its C-1 connector edges are not an arbitrary unlabelled tree: under
         the endpoint matching constraints they must use the unique free
         outgoing/incoming ports as one directed Hamilton path through the
         components.  This agrees with the independent B+1 certificate
         audit and leaves no residual closure edge.

         The multi-pivot corollary needed correction.  One collar has 3h
         distinct upper tickets, but owner/lower resource disjointness of H
         copies does not imply upper-colour distinctness across copies.
         Therefore the 3Hh<=m Hall extension applies only when the whole
         protected bank is globally upper-distinct.  The stronger
         6Hh<=m-2 protected-factor bound supplies the numerical inequality
         and a compatible perfect phase; it does not create that upper
         distinctness, opposite-head injection, or the directed Catalan
         connector.  Likewise P_1 subset Q_0 is a decomposition of an
         already existing protected certificate, not an existence proof.

2441L. The full private-pattern cone remains open, but bridge reflection now
       gives an exact all-threshold necessary family and sharply refutes the
       proposed joint ordered-singleton root on the odd triangular face.

       For a private configuration P, let

         D_P(J)=|J|+#{x:P_x subset J},
         Z_a(P)=#{cyclic J:1<=|J|<=a and D_P(J)>a}.

       In deficiency coordinates h_t=g_(r-t), direct interval counting gives

         a-sum_(t<=a) h_t(P)=Z_a(P)/(d+1).

       Therefore every mean profile dominating the triangular vector obeys

         E Z_a <= (d+1)(E(a-M)_+ + B_a/W),

       where M is the conditioned bridge maximum and
       B_a=sum_(t<=a)b_(r-t).  Reflection supplies exactly this cut family;
       it does not construct occurrence patterns or coloured addresses.

       The a=1 row is the saturated face

         g_(r-1)(P)=1-c_1(P)/(d+1),

       with c_1 the number of phases supporting a singleton extra pattern.
       For odd k=2r-1 and d<r-1, q_(r-1)=1, so c_1=0 almost surely.  A
       private occurrence G,{f_1},...,{f_d},G forces every extra coordinate
       onto the guard phase, hence c_1=1.  Thus no positive singleton-root,
       and hence no two-guard rooted support, can coexist with exact odd
       triangular domination.  Every actual odd k>=7 has d<=r-2.

       This is not merely a private-pattern obstruction.  A marked trace
       atom has at most one distinct rank-(r-1) suffix.  Saturation
       q_(r-1)=1 forces every positive atom to mark one, whereas an edge
       entering the ordered-singleton state has suffix ranks only1,...,d.
       Its incoming mass is zero, and literal balance kills its outgoing
       mass.  The root must be decoupled, the top face punctured, or the
       state replaced by one already exposing rank r-1.

       The two-guard address semantics itself passes with two refinements.
       Fixed F and owner T determine the unique guard T\F, so distinct guards
       are different owner fibres sharing one state.  Connected positive
       two-sided guard flow is sufficient at repeated fractional scale:
       reserve the two passages after extra denominator multiplication,
       contract them to macroedges, retain one copy of every support edge,
       take an Euler circuit and expand.  Minimum multiplicity may cross-pair
       a figure eight.  In fact literal one-copy preservation is impossible:
       the incoming and outgoing edges of G_i,v,G_i are distinct but both
       have owner F union G_i, while owner-perfect integrality selects one
       edge of that owner.  A physical use therefore needs an auxiliary
       boundary/uncoloured layer, an owner puncture, or different addresses.

       Unrooted private-cone membership, common cap and a different one-copy
       root realization remain open.  No finite probe is used in these
       results.
