2442STA. The fixed-`M_0` protected owner-layer extension has an exact
         coloured-digraph formulation, a literal counterexample, and a new
         acyclic Hall completion theorem.

         Contract `M_0`.  Every nonmatching incidence becomes an arc

           lambda(LV): L -> M_0^(-1)(V)

         coloured by `M_0(L) union V`.  The desired short shore is exactly
         a directed Hamilton path covering every upper colour.  Equivalently
         its binary incidence vector satisfies tail and head degree at most
         one, total size W-1, one covering row per upper colour, and every
         graphic subtour cut

           sum_(e inside S) x_e <= |S|-1.

         This is not a matroid rank problem: directed linear forests fail
         exchange already for

           I={1->2,3->4},
           J={1->3,3->2,2->4}.

         Arbitrary protected extension is false even at the nominal
         threshold t<=m.  At m=3 on [5], fix

           12->123, 13->134, 23->234, 14->124, 24->245,
           34->345, 15->125, 25->235, 35->135, 45->145.

         The protected arcs

           12->14 (upper1234),
           23->25 (upper2345),
           45->34 (upper1345)

         have distinct tails, heads and upper colours and form three
         disjoint edges, but no Hamilton path contains them.  Occupying
         heads14,25,34 makes35 the unique terminal; deterministic port
         propagation forces

           12->14->45->34->13->35

         and `24->23->25->15`, after which15 can enter only the already used
         heads35 or45.  This is a literal proof, independent of search.  A
         simpler two-ticket example shows distinct upper/tail tickets can
         force one common head.

         There is a positive exact reduction after an upper-exact Catalan
         forest Q_0 is chosen.  Its C components have one free outgoing and
         one free incoming port.  If an admissible connector reservoir on
         those components is acyclic, then C-1 connectors forming one
         directed Hamilton path exist exactly when

           |N(X)| >= |X|-1

         for every component set X.  This is the deficiency-one Hall
         theorem: a matching of size C-1 has no directed cycle in the
         acyclic reservoir, hence is one spanning path.  Protected connector
         paths are first contracted and the same theorem applies.

         Therefore `t<=m`, head injectivity, distinct colours and protected
         acyclicity are still insufficient for arbitrary tickets.  The
         pivot phase, `M_0`, upper representatives and acyclic connector
         reservoir must be selected in correlation.  The next lane is the
         special tight-pivot ticket geometry, not generic protected
         extension.

2443C8EXT. The audited double-crossrail forest now has an exact
           occurrence-preserving Hamilton-extension criterion and a stronger
           protected rooted-tail Hall theorem.

           Its protected short shore has p=2d+15 occurrences with upper
           multiset

             M_+^d, M_-^(d+1), R_1,...,R_14.

           Thus its upper rank is 16 and its exact repeated-occurrence
           nullity is 2d-1.  Choose A0 as one protected occurrence per upper
           label and A1=P1-A0.  A protected upper-exact Hamilton extension
           exists iff there is an X of size U-16 common independent in

             M_L/P1, M_O/P1, M_G/P1, M_U/A0,

           followed by a directed free-port Hamilton path of length C-2d
           on the C-2d+1 components of P1 union X.  Hence C>=2d is an exact
           necessary rank condition.  It is also the complete raw scalar
           rank ledger, but does not imply the four-resource common
           extension.

           The upper/tail projection always extends in the asymptotic
           planting range.  More generally, for any protected matching P1
           of size p<=m and any upper-independent representative subbank A0,
           central shadow surplus |partial X|>=|X|+m gives a complete
           upper-to-rooted-tail injection retaining A0 while avoiding every
           rooted tail of P1-A0.  Opposite-head injectivity and graphic
           acyclicity remain exactly the two unclosed contraction rows.

           The compatible root phase need not come from an arbitrary
           protected two-factor.  Orient each protected owner path and put
           every predecessor incidence in P0.  This is a matching of size
           p and extends directly to a perfect M0 whenever p<=m-1 by the
           sharp middle-shadow Hall surplus.  The successor incidences then
           contract literally to the thirteen directed protected paths.
           Thus the full forest needs only 2d+15<=m-1 for the root phase;
           the bare and right-continued bridge versions need respectively
           2d+3<=m-1 and 3d+3<=m-1.  This prospective choice removes the
           generic fixed-M0 ticket obstruction but not the global common
           extension.

           Protecting only the actual bridge has p=2d+3, upper rank4 and the
           same nullity 2d-1.  Therefore the twelve isolated exact
           occurrences add twelve contractions but reduce no connector
           debt.  For native support, global upper exactness supplies their
           twelve values elsewhere and avoids their clipped-residence
           interfaces.

           Finally, shrinking the old terminal maximal-source letter to
           {f_(d+1)} and appending the explicit d-owner exchange collar

             C_t=E-{f_1,...,f_t}+{x_1,...,x_t}

           preserves D^d exactly, leaves both physical cross banks
           unchanged, and extends every old right-clipped filler run to
           length d+1.  It introduces d distinct q1 upper values, so the
           protected path still has upper nullity exactly 2d-1.  The fresh
           x-runs export one nested clipped boundary state; global source
           attachment, exterior compiler transport and regeneration remain
           open.

2444Q1R. The four native lower-q1 deficits of the split-core pivot are not
         forced.  They now have an exact all-h literal repair.

         In the 4h+1-letter source, enlarge the four existing seam/collar
         letters by

           (X_R-x_R)+q^-       -> (B-x_R)+q^-,
           C+X_L+lambda_h      -> (B-x_R)+lambda_h,
           C+X_R+rho_1         -> (B-x_L)+rho_1,
           (X_L-x_L)+q^+       -> (B-x_L)+q^+.

         Every added set belongs to every depth-h owner window containing
         that source position.  Hence the owner row is unchanged.  At the
         four formerly deficient transitions the shared h-letter ORs become
         exactly

           B^-+lambda[1,h-1],
           (B-x_R)+lambda[1,h],
           (B-x_L)+rho[1,h],
           B^++rho[2,h],

         the four owner intersections.  All other shared cells remain tight.
         Both q1 palettes are therefore literal and injective.

         The two repaired letters adjacent to X jointly contain B because
         x_L!=x_R.  Thus the one-letter X insertion remains monotone in
         arbitrary exterior context; every old interval OR transports.
         The pre-insertion U_j, the singleton X, both strict-lower rays,
         residence, support, incidence count and raw charge are unchanged.
         The proof includes h=2 and needs no external lower-q1 host.

         There is an address-optimal two-letter variant: enlarge the
         lambda_1 source position by B-x_R and the rho_h position by B-x_L.
         It repairs both deficits on each shore.  Two changed addresses are
         necessary because the always-nonempty left and right deficits can
         be supplied only from the disjoint ranges [h-1,2h-2] and
         [2h+2,3h+1].  The four-letter form is preferable when preserving
         the displayed lambda/rho singleton cells.

         Scope: this is deck-monotone from the repaired pre-insertion word
         to the repaired post-insertion word.  It is not deck-monotone from
         the old sparse source to the repaired source; a compiler already
         target-labelled on the sparse scaffold must be reoptimized.  The
         native lower-q1 sidecar is zero, but global cap/guard admissibility,
         exterior witnesses and the protected Catalan Hamilton completion
         remain open.

2445STA. The generic fixed-`M_0` protected obstruction disappears for the
         native tight-pivot geometry once its phase is chosen prospectively,
         and the remaining Catalan correlation has a support-first form.

         Let V_0,...,V_ell be a simple Johnson path with distinct
         L_i=V_i intersect V_(i+1).  Put every predecessor incidence
         L_i V_i into M_0.  This matching has size ell and extends to a
         perfect M_0 whenever ell<=m-1.  For every such extension, define
         L_ell=M_0^(-1)(V_ell).  The successor shore contracts exactly to

           L_0 -> L_1 -> ... -> L_ell.

         The terminal root is new by injectivity of M_0.  Hence the
         protected tails and heads are distinct and the rooted links form
         one directed path automatically.  Their upper labels are exactly
         V_i union V_(i+1).  For the tight split-pivot collar ell=3h and
         those labels are distinct; H disjoint copies give H disjoint
         protected paths under 3Hh<=m-1.  The established 6Hh<=m-2 range
         implies this.  Reversing the phase reverses the path.

         Thus the m=3 arbitrary-ticket counterexample is a quantifier
         warning, not a native-pivot obstruction: choose the phase/M_0
         before extending the upper representatives.  The newer native-q1
         source repair leaves this owner path unchanged and removes the
         former four extra lower-q1 tickets.

         There is then an exact support-first certificate.  Any
         upper-surjective directed linear forest R in D_(M_0) containing
         the protected path contains an upper-exact rooted Catalan forest
         Q_0 containing it: retain the protected occurrence for each of its
         distinct colours and choose any R-occurrence of every other upper
         colour.  A subset of R preserves tail/head injectivity and
         acyclicity, and its U edges have exactly C=Cat_m components.

         Finally expose an acyclic free-port connector reservoir on those
         C components.  It joins Q_0 to one directed Hamilton path exactly
         under the one-defect Hall cuts

           |N(X)| >= |X|-1.

         Equivalently, if P is the ell-edge protected pivot path, the
         upper-exact forest row is a common independent set of size U-ell
         in the four contractions

           M_tail/P, M_head/P, M_graphic/P, M_upper/P.

         Their individual residual ranks are respectively

           W-ell, W-ell, W-1-ell, U-ell.

         Hence every marginal rank has room and only four-way correlation
         remains.  This is an exact common-basis formulation, but Edmonds'
         two-matroid min--max theorem does not apply.

         Hence the owner-layer existence target is now precisely

           correlated M_0
             + protected upper-surjective linear-forest support
             + acyclic one-defect-Hall connector reservoir.

         Phase choice, representative selection and topology are integrated
         in this certificate, but existence of the global support/reservoir,
         exterior residence, all-width witnesses, common cap and regeneration
         remain open.

            required by its literal clipped endpoint.

            After its 2d-1 repeated-upper connector occurrences are
            installed, the bridge lies in one distinguished component K_*
            among q=C-2d+1 components.  A generic acyclic one-defect Hall
            matching produces some source component, which need not be
            K_*.  To retain the authenticated left-clipped bridge source,
            K_* must be the source of the final contracted Hamilton path.

            In an acyclic connector reservoir this is equivalent to deleting
            the incoming copy of K_* and satisfying ordinary Hall:

              |N^-(Y)| >= |Y|

            for every component set Y not containing K_*.  The selected
            q-1=C-2d arcs are then automatically one directed Hamilton path
            starting at K_*.  Dually, deleting its outgoing copy gives the
            exact terminal-component criterion.  This is strictly stronger
            than unrooted |N(X)|>=|X|-1.

            Both the bare bridge (p,s)=(2d+3,4) and its literal right
            continuation (3d+3,d+4) have p-s=2d-1, so the same rooted Hall
            cut and connector count apply.  Filtering admissible component
            arcs by any injective increasing potential gives an automatic
            DAG; the remaining exact target is the displayed rooted Hall
            family, with the bridge's exported coordinate/cap guard included
            among the structural zeros.

            The repeated occurrence bank also has an exact support-first
            form.  If one directly constructs an upper-surjective directed
            linear forest R containing the whole bridge path, select one
            representative per upper colour inside R and regard every other
            R edge as an already installed acyclic connector.  Rooted Hall
            on the components of R then completes the Hamilton path without

            C-2d+1 components; each further acyclic support edge reduces that

2447STA. The Greene--Kleitman branching obstruction now has an exact
         protected min--max and an exact Boolean-square detachment gate.

         Let P be any degree-two protected subforest of the pointed-plane-
         tree GK projection.  A forced-edge two-state tree DP computes
         exactly the largest GK linear subforest R_m(P) containing P:
         conditional on the parent-edge bit, take every forced child edge
         and then the largest positive optional gains fitting the remaining
         degree-two slots.  If R_m is the unprotected optimum, then

           R_m-|P| <= R_m(P) <= R_m.

         Hence the protected GK deletion number satisfies

           Delta_m <= Delta_m(P) <= Delta_m+|P|.

         For a fixed O(sqrt(m))-edge pivot bank already aligned with GK,
         Delta_m(P)/(m Cat_m) has the same limit
         0.356895867892... as the unprotected edit barrier.  Thus retaining
         the pivot does not make GK locally close to the desired linear
         factor: a positive fraction of all diamonds must still change.

         Every alternating Boolean C4 is a hinge rotation.  At a hinge X,
         the selected rectangle edges form a partial bijection between
         deleted and inserted coordinates; rectangle squares generate its
         full symmetric orbit, or the symmetric orbit on the unprotected
         spokes when some are fixed.  The hinge degree is invariant.  After
         deleting the changed old spokes, a multi-rewire is acyclic exactly
         when X and all new leaves lie in pairwise distinct components; the
         literal cap test is residual leaf degree at most one.

         For one square with old leaves P,Q and new leaves P',Q', the exact
         branching-potential change is

           -1[d(P)>=3]-1[d(Q)>=3]+1[d(P')>=2]+1[d(Q')>=2].

         This gives a genuine protected, palette-exact, forest-preserving
         detachment actuator when an overloaded old leaf and two slack new
         leaves satisfy the component test.  But the two degree-m
         alternating GK vertices are stars whose neighbours all have degree
         one.  No first applicable square can reduce either extreme load:
         a square hinged at the star preserves it, while a square hinged at
         a leaf would require a nonexistent second selected leaf edge.
         Nonlocal/preparatory rethreading is therefore necessary.

         Finally, endpoint arithmetic is not the obstruction.  Every exact
         outer-palette selector has deficits y_X=2-d(X) satisfying

           sum_X y_X=2 Cat_m,
           sum_(X contains i) y_X=Cat_m.

         Choose Cat_m complementary middle pairs avoiding every protected
         degree-two vertex and put y=1 on those pairs.  This gives an
         integral {1,2}-degree target satisfying all global/coordinate
         ledgers and every fixed O(sqrt(m)) protected capacity.  The open
         gate is correlated realization by one outer-palette matching plus
         acyclicity.  After protected GK pruning it is exactly a residual
         lower/upper/tail/head/graphic completion, the even-ground analogue
         of the head-injective Q0 gate.

         On `[2m-1]`, an upper diamond `(L,R)`, with ranks `m-1,m+1`,
         lifts to the Johnson edge between the two rank-`m` corners of
         `[L,R]`.  Every nonempty family `A` of upper colours has at least
         `|A|+m` available lower colours at distance two.  Hall therefore
         extends any matching of at most `m` prescribed diamonds to an
         upper-exact, lower-injective selection.

         Independently, in the rank-`m+1`/rank-`m` incidence graph, put

           S_2(A)=sum_T min(2,d_A(T)).

         The exact surplus is `S_2(A)-2|A|>=m-1`.  An edge-minimal
         Ore--Ryser argument then proves that every 2-bounded protected
         incidence bank of at most `m-1` edges extends to a selection of
         exactly two middle facets per upper colour with owner degree at
         most two.  Hence a repaired fixed-`H` tight-pivot bank survives
         both marginal completions separately whenever `6Hh<=m-2`.

         The two completions do not synchronize automatically.  Their
         joint binary selector asks simultaneously for one occurrence of
         every upper colour, lower-colour capacity one, and middle-owner
         capacity two.  Its natural matrix already contains the determinant
         `-2` triangle minor on three diamonds through one lower colour.
         Literal Boolean examples show that an outer transversal can force
         owner degree three, while a cap-two completion can force a repeated
         lower colour.  The uniform fractional selector has strict slack in
         both omitted rows, so the remaining obstruction is integral
         correlation, not scalar capacity.

         The standard Greene--Kleitman SCD gives an exact upper/lower-
         rainbow Catalan forest, but one explicit owner has degree `m-1`;

         separate.  The exact next theorem is therefore a protected
         integral solution of the joint upper/lower/owner system containing
         the `O(sqrt(m))` pivot bank, followed by graphic inequalities.

2449A. The address-minimal split-pivot repair has an exact inherited
       two-cap **algebraic** carry, a sharp residence horizon, and an exact
       one-ended source-extension theorem.

       For `h>=2`, `|B|=r-h>=2`, choose interior indices

         1<=j<h,  2<=s<=h

       and enrich only

         lambda_j -> (B-x_R)+lambda_j,
         rho_s    -> (B-x_L)+rho_s.

       These two letters repair all four native lower-q1 deficits without
       changing the owner row, pre-insertion row, either upper-q1 value,
       the two strict ray chains, or local residence.  Two positions are
       minimal.  The canonical menu has `(h-1)^2` choices; the complete
       minimum menu also has one seam choice on each singleton shore, for
       total

         (h-1+1[|X_R|=1])(h-1+1[|X_L|=1]).

       The proof-safe Pascal recurrence is CARRY, not fresh reset.

       * Plateau `(r,h,B)->(r+1,h,B+beta)`: keep `(j,s)` and the same
         literal indices.  Both enriched values/caps and both strict ray
         chains acquire `beta`; `X` stays untagged.  Old-coordinate owner
         traces are unchanged.
       * Jump `H=h+1`: with
         `lambda'=(alpha,lambda)` and `rho'=(rho,gamma)`, use
         `(j,s)->(j+1,s)`.  At the four-block level

           E_H^-       = gamma E_h^-,
           A_H^-(j+1)  = alpha A_h^-(j),
           A_H^+(s)    = A_h^+(s) gamma,
           E_H^+       = E_h^+ alpha.

         Thus both enriched source letters persist literally and their
         global indices both shift by exactly `+2`; `alpha,gamma` each
         retain two singleton hosts.  The inherited rays persist and the
         new ray tops are the old endpoint owners.  The literal suffix is
         `omega_H=(omega_h,{alpha})`.  The index inequalities remain valid
         under arbitrarily many jumps, so the negative cap state has two
         addresses forever.

       No local owner/pre/q1/ray or enrichment-cap equation forces a fresh
       enrichment-site reset.  Signed residence is separate: from disjoint
       depth `h0` banks, all reused jump labels remain resident exactly
       through `t<=h0` jumps, and the oldest pair fails at `t=h0+1` (see
       item2454AD).  Fresh `(1,H)` enrichment is optional and may destroy
       the two old enriched one-cell targets.  At a jump, intervals wholly
       within `E^-`, within `A^-[X]A^+`, or within `E^+` persist; intervals
       crossing the two outer block seams acquire `alpha` or `gamma`.
       On a plateau, untagged parent enriched values need alternate hosts.
       Hence ambient old-target transport and common-Q remain genuine, but
       there is no enrichment-location reset gate.

       The literal one-ended continuation is governed exactly by the
       ordered last-h source letters plus capped signed owner-run ages.  A
       proposed next owner U is source-realizable with native lower q1 iff

         S subset U,
         U-S subset E subset U,
         E intersect (O-S)=empty,

       together with the point cap/mandatory rows and the rule that a bit
       may flip only after age `h+1`.  Iterating this is necessary and
       sufficient.  Free continuation letters then satisfy an exact
       frozen-prefix maximal-word iff: screen every free position by all
       incident target rows, keep the literal prefix fixed, require every
       screened letter nonempty, and reconstruct every row exactly.  An
       absolute maximal erosion does not preserve the prefix; screened
       containment, not cap equality, is the correct condition.

       Finally, no fresh reset is needed for an upper-exact exterior:

         D^(h+q)A_i = union_(t=i)^(i+q) (D^h A)_t.

       Thus higher upper coverage is exactly the consecutive-owner-union
       deck condition, including intervals crossing the pivot boundary.
       The remaining positive theorem is global: construct an
       upper-surjective rooted Hamilton owner path and lower occurrence
       matching accepted by the suffix/run automaton whose complete
       old-sector/mixed-guard bank passes one frozen-prefix common cap,
       together with a shared-bank rebase/rethread before its residence
       horizon expires.  Abstract protected factors do not supply these
       literal addresses or that rebase.

2450R. The prospective Mütze/GMN pull-tree route now has an exact coloured
       formulation and a sharp construction-specific upper-colour no-go.

       In the lexical GMN auxiliary multigraph H_r, binary pull labels y_g
       obey the labelled graphic spanning-tree rows.  Pairwise edge
       disjointness makes every physical incidence affine in y.  A literal
       pivot footprint therefore induces forced-on labels A and forbidden
       labels Z; uncoloured extension is exactly

         A is a labelled forest and (H_r-Z)/A is connected.

       This is not yet a coloured theorem.  Upper colour belongs to the pair
       of final incidences at one lower turn.  Two edge-disjoint pulls may
       use its two different old factor edges, and the mixed difference

         [kappa_gh]-[kappa_g]-[kappa_h]+[kappa_0]

       is generically a nonzero four-colour rectangle.  Thus an exact model
       needs one local pair-state variable per attainable turn state and one
       cover row per rank-(r+2) colour.  A context-free signed colour vector
       on auxiliary labels is valid only under turn-disjointness or a proved
       modular identity.  Under hereditary private-witness safety, Rado's
       graphic rank cuts do give a sufficient prospective provider forest,
       but not an exact description of the general shared-turn family.

       The canonical lexical family is in fact closed negative for all
       large parameters.  Set r=m-1.  Its exact omitted immediate-upper
       count is

         M_r=W_r(r-2)(r-3)/(2(r+2)(2r-1)).

       One alternating C6 changes at most three lower-turn values, while a
       canonical pull spanning tree uses at most Cat_r-1 pulls.  Hence every
       canonical-tree Hamiltonization misses at least

         M_r-3(Cat_r-1)
          = W_r(2r^3-21r^2-11r+18)
             /(2(r+2)(2r-1)(2r+1)) + 3.

       This is positive for r>=11, equivalently m>=12; at r=11 the exact
       residual is 1941.  The bound is telescopic, so correlated/adaptive
       pull choices, a forced auxiliary forest, and cyclic opening do not
       evade it.  A bounded noncanonical prefix editing q turn slots leaves
       the sharpened residual M_r-q-3(Cat_r-1).  Cross-boundary physical OR
       witnesses are outside this projected-turn statement and must be
       charged literally.

       The live prospective formulation is instead joint over (M_0,Q_0,J).
       Choose M_0 containing the pivot predecessor shore; choose Q_0
       containing the successor path and exactly one occurrence of every
       upper colour, independent in tail, head, graphic and upper partition
       matroids; then match the free ports of its Cat_m components by J.  If
       the component reservoir is acyclic and the pivot component is the
       prescribed start, deleting its incoming copy reduces completion
       exactly to rooted Hall

         |N^-(Y)|>=|Y|  for every component set Y avoiding the root.

       This is the sufficient head/topology flow invariant.  Pull labels
       implement it only with one common fixed factor decomposition and
       joint full-turn representative transparency; the arbitrary-M_0
       pivot phase cannot be superposed independently on the fixed lexical
       factor.  PBBS, nonlexical factors, long switches, residence, deeper
       shadows, common cap and compiler remain outside the no-go.

2451L. The owner-layer connector gate now has an exact Boolean cut, one
       optimal born-linear SCD socket sector, and sharp canonical no-gos.

       For a component K of an upper-exact Q_0, let s_K,o_K be its free
       incoming/outgoing roots and J_K=M_0(s_K).  The full port graph is

         K->K' iff K!=K' and o_K subset J_K'.

       If T_X={o_K:K in X}, and e_X counts incoming labels supported only
       by their own component terminal, then exactly

         |N(X)|=|J intersect partial^+ T_X|-e_X,
         delta(Q_0)=max_X(|X|-|J intersect partial^+T_X|+e_X).

       Hence principal-filter cuts, including every coordinate cut, are
       unavoidable.  Raw shadow size cannot control the sparse free
       incoming bank or the self-closing correction.

       There is nevertheless a positive Catalan-scale shell theorem.  For
       every nonempty family X of at most Cat_m rank-(m-1) sets,

         |partial^+ X|>=|X|+m-1.

       This is exact Kruskal--Katona: after complementing, the leading colex
       parameter is at most 2m-3, and normalized matching pays the remainder.
       Thus every Catalan-size terminal bank has distinct containing
       rank-m owner labels even after m-1 labels are forbidden.  It does not
       make those labels the free matched incoming bank.

       More concretely, split [2m-1]=G dotunion {a,z} and fix an SCD of G.
       Its central chains are long R<S<L<U or short S<L.  The four rows

         azR->azS;
         zS->zL (long), zS->azS (short);
         aS->aL;
         L->U (long), L->zL (short)

       form a literal perfect M_0.  Every short chain gives the socket

         aS -> zS,  with physical endpoints aL,azS and upper colour azL.

       These Cat_(m-1) sockets are disjoint in tail, head, both physical
       endpoint banks and upper colour, so they are a born-linear partial
       integral solution of the joint upper/lower/owner-cap/graphic rows.
       This capacity is sharp for one fixed pair: the E lower sets azR can
       use only the D middle sets azS, leaving at most
       D-E=Cat_(m-1) socket rows.  Since Cat_m/Cat_(m-1)=4-6/(m+1), scalar
       coverage needs four funnel classes for m>=6 (three for m<=5).

       A total-order acyclic reservoir satisfies one-defect Hall iff every
       consecutive component arc exists; diffuse expansion cannot replace
       that literal order.  Greene--Kleitman is calibration only.  Its
       unchanged chain-mate selection has m-1 distinct upper colours whose
       arcs all share one head; preserving its coordinate-sum monotonicity
       needs at least ceil(W/(m(m-1)+1))-1 descending resets.  If both free
       banks are the canonical ballot family, a repeated sum layer gives an
       explicit Hall deficiency at least two.  This is separate from the
       stronger authoritative 0.356895867892... positive-density GK pruning
       barrier and does not transfer to a genuinely non-GK funnel support.

       Two literal m=3 upper-exact forests separate the remaining rows.
       One has two components with no connector neighbour, so delta>=2.
       Another has delta=1, but every size-four port matching spends a
       directed two-cycle and no Hamilton connector exists.  Both failures
       are dimension-minimal; m=2 completes on the directed three-cycle.

       The generic ABM bounded-degree rainbow theorem is unavailable:
       colour classes have m+1 edges and Delta=m-1, below the generic graph
       threshold 2Delta for m>=4.  Wdowinski's rDelta-1 examples show the
       parameter-only multihypergraph bound is sharp; Boolean/simple
       structure is therefore load-bearing.

       The live unrooted target is a correlated noncanonical multi-funnel
       upper-surjective linear support R.  The tight-pivot target is
       stronger: choose M_0 containing P_0, make R contain P_1, reserve the
       first protected root as the free incoming root of K_*, and impose
       rooted acyclic Hall after deleting K_*'s incoming copy.  The existing
       protected marginal flows and the SCD funnel prove separate pieces,
       not their joint intersection.

          g_i=2h_0+2i-1,

        extend the two capacities; these two tops are native-q1 aliases and

        the plateau aperture grows to `(empty,S_1+beta)`.  Hence all static
        two-step rotations remain legal when their bottom/replacement
        tickets are carried by the common state.

        The complete forced local collision ledger has only two classes:
        opposite-bank duplicate singleton occurrences for jump labels, and
        ray/native-q1 equalities.  Canonically select D^+/D^- singleton
        copies and native shared q1 copies.  Owner simplicity and both q1
        injections exclude any other packet-local target collision.
        Plateau-tagged old ray/q1/enriched targets, cross-seam jump rows,
        and exterior collisions remain in global Q.

        a literal typed cell for `y`.  The exact surviving gate is therefore
        mutable-bottom occurrence/release transport plus the old-sector
        common-cap ledger, not enrichment-location reset.

2453ODR. The odd upper-diamond synchronization LP is not half-integral;
         its first exact higher-torsion face is now frozen.

         At m=4, a literal 29-column feasible point has fourteen unit
         entries, nine 1/3 entries and six 2/3 entries.  Every one of the
         21 upper rows has load one; the lower-load multiset is

           {1^20,(1/3)^3,0^12},

         and the owner-load multiset is

           {2^9,(5/3)^1,(4/3)^5,1^13,(2/3)^4,0^3}.

         All 21 upper rows, six named tight lower rows and two named tight
         owner rows are independent on the positive support.  Direct
         elimination reduces the fractional subsystem to 3z=1; the active
         determinant is -3.  Thus half-integral odd-cycle decomposition is
         false even before graphic constraints.  No nonzero C6 or other
         linear exchange supported wholly inside that positive face can
         preserve all active rows: any repair must either release a tight
         lower/owner row or import a zero diamond.

         This particular torsion block does have an exact slack-releasing
         escape.  Choosing seven named fractional-support diamonds together
         with all fourteen unit columns gives an integral upper-exact,
         lower-injective, owner-cap-two forest on the same positive support.
         Its owner degrees are {2^11,1^20,0^4} and its fourteen path
         components are listed literally in the note.  Hence the m=4 cubic
         is a barrier to active-face circuit cancellation, not an
         obstruction to synchronization itself.

         There is nevertheless an unconditional exact constant-local
         rounding.  View upper colours as the parts of a partition matroid,
         and lower/owner capacities as degree hyperedges.  Each diamond lies
         in exactly three degree rows.  The upper-bound-only
         Kiraly--Lau--Singh theorem applied to the uniform feasible point
         gives an integral one-per-upper selector with

           lower load <= 3,    owner load <= 4.

         If a protected bank has distinct upper/lower colours and owner
         degree at most two, forcing it and rounding the residual uniform
         point gives the unconditional coarser bounds 4 and 6 while
         retaining the bank.  These are per-resource bounds, not bounded
         total overload: independent uniform rounding has asymptotic
         expected overload e^-1 per lower colour and 4e^-2 per owner, hence
         Theta(W) total.  The remaining theorem is a torsion-escape or
         bounded-total correlated rounding, followed separately by
         acyclicity/rooted connectors.

2454STA. The prospective `M_0/Q_0` problem now has an exact complement-
         Latin form, a clean cyclic quotient, and a Hamilton-birth shortcut.

         First, an upper-turn-surjective Middle Levels Hamilton cycle
         already contains `Q_0` for free.  Choose one occurrence of every
         upper colour from one perfect parity class.  These `U<W` edges are
         a matching and a proper subset of one rooted link cycle, hence a
         forest with exactly `C=Cat_m` components.  A protected pivot path
         with distinct upper colours is retained by choosing its literal
         occurrences.  There are at least `C+1` redundant-provider
         occurrences; if the pivot uses fewer, one outside it safely opens
         the cycle while retaining upper surjectivity.  The remaining
         `C-1` edges are then automatically the directed free-port path on
         the `Q_0` components.  Thus the smallest owner target is only an
         upper-turn-surjective Hamilton cycle containing the correlated
         pivot path.

         Second, complementation eliminates the opaque rooted notation.
         Let C,B,D be ranks `m-2,m-1,m` of `[2m-1]`.  Choose a perfect
         incidence matching

           mu:B->D,  alpha(B)=mu(B)-B.

         For a row `C` and column `B=C+b`, define the symbol

           A_mu(C,B)=C+alpha(B).

         A rooted upper-exact Catalan forest is exactly one cell per row
         with injective columns, injective symbols, and an acyclic directed
         graph `B->A`.  Conversely every `(M_0,Q_0)` gives this unique
         table.  The tight pivot predecessor phase is

           mu(B_i)=B_i union B_(i+1),

         and its prescribed cells are literally the path

           B_0 -> B_1 -> ... -> B_ell.

         For every fixed `mu`, weight `1/(m+1)` on every cell satisfies all
         row, column, symbol and graphic-forest inequalities.  The cell
         graph has no loops and at most one edge per unordered pair; the
         complete graphic proof uses the pair bound for `s<=2(m+1)` and
         the outdegree bound for `2s>=m+1`.  Only integral three-way
         correlation remains.

         The maximal three-free rotation subgroup

           g=(2m-1)/3^v_3(2m-1)

         acts freely on all table resources.  Its quotient B--D graph is
         regular bipartite, so a `G`-equivariant `mu` always exists.  An
         invariant `Q_0` is exactly one atom per row orbit, injective on
         column/symbol orbits, with a loopless quotient forest; quotient
         cycles of any voltage lift to physical cycles.  This is an exact
         factor-`g` prospective construction target, not its solution.

         Three simple rules are now excluded.  Every affine-linear
         translation-covariant point rule collapses to

           alpha(B)=(m-1)^(-1) sum(B)+v,

         and fails incidence legality for every `m>=4`, because every
         residue is a sum of `m-2` distinct nonzero residues.  Making every
         row locally Latin would force, for each coordinate `a`, a Steiner
         `S(m-2,m-1,2m-2)` on the other coordinates; its `(m-3)`-set degree
         is `(m+1)/2`, so this is impossible for every even `m>=4` (first:
         `S(2,3,6)`).  Full rotation also fails whenever `m=2 mod 3`: one
         rank-`m-2` row is order-three fixed but no containing rank-`m-1`
         column can be fixed.

         The complementary fixed-pair Latin view has its own smallest local
         warning.  At every upper set the opposite-dart colour-pair
         multigraph is `(m+1)`-regular on `m` colours.  Local axioms force
         every pair through `m=3`, but at `m=4` the difference table on
         `Z_5` uses only pairs `{1,4}` and `{2,3}`.  Therefore overlap
         correlation between upper intervals is load-bearing.

         Positively, `m=3` has the explicit cyclic base

           alpha({x,y})=(x+y)/2,
           sigma({c})={c,c+1},
           A={c,c+3},

         giving five isolated selected edges, exactly `Cat_3` components.
         The automatic midpoint/Latin mechanism does not extend unchanged.

2454AD. The inherited `K2` split-core recurrence is now frozen at its exact
        proof-safe scope, including the complete descendant traces and the
        first residence failure.  This supplements item2452H2 and corrects
        the unqualified residence sentence in item2449A.

        For every canonical menu pair, the algebraic maps are exact:

          plateau: (j,s)->(j,s),
          jump:    (j,s)->(j+1,s).

        At a jump all four source blocks nest literally, so owner/pre rows,
        both native q1 palettes, rays, local owner caps and the two fresh
        singleton pairs persist.  No Pascal-sector or native-q1 equation
        forces a fresh enrichment-site reset.  A mixed compiler cap can
        still reject inherited addresses, and a barred base pair retains
        only its separately hypothesized exterior singleton hosts.

        Indefinite signed residence is false.  From a disjoint depth-h0
        base, after t jumps (h=h0+t), the complete local traces of a label
        born at jump i are

          tr(alpha_i)=0^(t-i) 1^(h+1) 0^(2h0+2i-1) 1^(t-i+1),
          tr(gamma_i)=1^(t-i+1) 0^(2h0+2i-1) 1^(h+1) 0^(t-i).

        Hence that internal zero-gap is resident iff

          t<=h0+2i-2.

        All labels pass exactly through t<=h0; the first failure is
        t=h0+1 at alpha_1,gamma_1.  The smallest literal counterexample is
        h0=2,t=3,h=5:

          tr(alpha_1)=0^2 1^6 0^5 1^3,
          tr(gamma_1)=1^3 0^5 1^6 0^2.

        The bad 0^5 is internal to the contiguous packet and cannot be
        repaired by any exterior prefix/suffix chronology.  A fresh K2
        site reset changes neither occurrence and does not help; one must
        remove/relocate a shared occurrence or interior-rethread the packet.

        Conditional on a genuine pairwise-disjoint bank rebase at depth b
        with the same exported interface, the optimal latest cadence is b
        further jumps, rebase at depth2b, and thereafter at depths4b,8b,... .
        A single countdown is a constant number of state fields.  No
        bounded-support literal rebase is proved, so this is not a
        constant-additive-cost recurrence.  Under a hypothetical rolling
        pair refresh, first-generation pair i expires at jump
        t_i=b+2i-1: service starts before jump b+1 and then one old pair
        reaches deadline every two jumps.  This calendar is necessary, not
        a compatible packet construction.

        The terminal socket itself is exact: plateau sends (O,a) to
        (O+beta,a+beta), jump sends it to (O+alpha,O), but only for the last
        two derivative cells.  Within the residence horizon and for a
        host-equipped K2 state, the remaining rows are exterior upper/path,
        suffix/gap/terminal acceptance, and one old/deep/common-cap ledger.
        Beyond the horizon, shared-bank residence regeneration is an
        additional essential gate.

2455STQ. The maximal three-free quotient has a sharp residual obstruction:
         its three-primary defect cannot be confined to `O(1)` exceptional
         orbit types.  Let `m=3r+2`, `n=2m-1`,

           s=3^v_3(n),   |G|=n/s,   R=Z_n/G.

         The order-three subgroup of `R` fixes exactly

           (s/3) Cat_r

         row vertices in the complement-Latin quotient and no column or
         symbol vertex.  These fixed rows form exactly `Cat_r` full
         residual `R`-orbits.  Therefore every residual-equivariant row
         selector must symmetry-break at least

           Cat_((m-2)/3)=2^((2/3+o(1))m)

         orbit sectors.  In particular, a clean quotient plus a bounded
         exceptional order-three bank is impossible.

         The exception set is canonical rather than amorphous: its orbit
         sectors are exactly the rank-r rotation necklaces on `Z_(2r+1)`.
         This identifies a genuine smaller-Catalan recursive quotient
         target.  Any viable three-primary braid must expose one phase seam
         per smaller necklace; it cannot export the defect as
         a constant sidecar.  At bare phase level the obstruction is sharp:
         each sector is `R/Kbar` mapping into a free `R`-torsor, so it needs
         at least one successor seam, and the canonical coset section has
         exactly its one wrap seam.  Incidence, Latin injectivity and forest
         constraints may of course require more.

         Positively, the forced block itself is solved for every clean
         equivariant first matching `mu`.  For each fixed row `C`, choose
         any `B=C+b` and use symbol `A=C+alpha(B)`.  The union of fully
         occupied order-three coordinate triples recovers `C` from both
         `A` and `B`.  Hence distinct quotient rows have distinct columns,
         symbols and matched values, and no selected head equals any
         selected tail: the entire forced bank is a matching of isolated
         directed edges.  It occupies only

           binom(2r+1,r)/binom(6r+3,3r)=2^(-(4+o(1))r)

         of the quotient rows.  The surviving problem is therefore a
         relative Latin-forest completion of the overwhelmingly larger
         nonfixed bulk around an exact but Catalan-indexed protected bank.

         The first matching can in fact be chosen under full `Z_n`
         rotation.  Developing one fixed-row cell for `n/3` steps then
         realizes the sharp one-seam section literally: the row wraps but
         its free column advances by the nonzero order-three monodromy.
         Full tail/head orbits can nevertheless overlap.  For sector core
         `C` and phase `b`, overlap occurs exactly when

           alpha(C+b)-b in K-{0}.

         The minimum overlap `c_min(mu)` is the number of smaller necklaces
         for which this holds at every phase.  On each empty coordinate
         triple such a trapped sector is exactly one of the two oriented
         triangle matchings.  Thus phase choice makes the overlap zero iff
         the fully cyclic `mu` has no triangularly trapped necklace; that
         existence statement remains open.  It has an exact protected-
         matching form: every smaller necklace has `r+1` column orbits and
         `3r` good cross-triple edge orbits per column, hence
         `3r(r+1)` good candidates.  One choice per necklace is
         automatically endpoint-disjoint across necklaces.  Trap-free `mu`
         exists iff such a bank extends to a perfect matching in the full
         cyclic `B--D` quotient, equivalently iff its residual graph passes
         ordinary Hall.

         After this bank is installed, every other row orbit is fully free;
         there are no further stabilizer types.  Quarantining the touched
         full-rotation tail and head orbits in their respective roles costs
         exactly `Cat_r` orbits per role.  The number of long row orbits is

           L=(binom(n,m-2)-(n/3)Cat_r)/n,

         and the exact remaining tail/head scalar spare is

           S_role=Cat_m/n-(2/3)Cat_r > 0.

         Every long row retains at least one legal relative atom: only rows
         of triple-occupancy type `3^(r-1)21` can meet the quarantine, and
         each has a unique exceptional extension.  Even when that extension
         lies in both the tail and head orbit banks, two alternative tails
         cannot both map to the unique bad head: they are distinct rotation
         orbits while their two putative matched values are one rotation
         orbit, contradicting equivariant injectivity of `mu`.  Consequently the whole
         residue is one exact free-orbit quotient matching (one atom per
         long row, tail/head injective) plus the forest test after developing
         to the clean `G` quotient and adjoining the fixed bank.  A stronger
         vertex-disjoint quarantine costs `2Cat_r-c` orbits per role, where
         `c` is the full tail/head orbit overlap, and has exact positive
         scalar spare `Cat_m/n-(5/3)Cat_r+c`, but may create
         zero rows and is only a sufficient subproblem.

         A separate free-torsor lemma sharply limits the proposed
         orthomorphism/complete-mapping shortcut.  Every equivariant map
         between free cyclic orbits is `x->x+c`; its displacement is
         constant, so it is not an orthomorphism.  Nonlinear algebraic
         freedom can select quotient atom types or deliberately break
         symmetry, but it cannot hide in within-orbit phases.  Quotient-tree
         voltages are pure gauge, while any quotient cycle still lifts to
         physical cycles.  Thus the protected pivot should be imposed only
         after the bulk relative Latin forest is built.  The theorem does
         not construct that forest or change the finite `nu(k)` status.

2456ODN. The odd upper-diamond selector now has an unconditional protected
         `o(W)` total-defect rounding, and determinant torsion has an exact
         escape criterion.

         Clone every middle owner into two slots.  A diamond `(L,R)` with
         physical owners `T,H` gives four 4-uniform hyperedges

           {R,L,T^i,H^j},  i,j in {0,1}.

         The three vertex types have exact degrees

           2m(m+1), 2m(m-1), 2m(m-1),

         and maximum codegree at most `2m`.  Thus the host is asymptotically
         regular of degree `D=Theta(m^2)` with codegree `o(D)`.  A protected
         bank of `o(m)` diamonds with distinct upper/lower colours and owner
         degree at most two lifts to a hypergraph matching.  Deleting its
         occupied vertices changes every surviving degree by only `o(D)`.

         Pippenger--Spencer edge-colouring then supplies a matching covering
         all but `s=o(W)` upper colours.  Project it, retain the protected
         bank, and choose arbitrary diamonds for the `s` missing uppers.
         Each completion costs at most one lower-overload and two
         owner-overloads, so

           sum_L(d_L-1)_+ + sum_T(d_T-2)_+ <= 3s = o(W).

         This applies to every fixed repaired tight-pivot bank, whose
         diamond length is `O(sqrt(m))`.  It is a direct odd-dimensional
         protected sublinear *total* synchronization theorem (consistent
         with the stronger ordered-diamond near-forest lane), but not an
         `O(1)` sidecar and not an acyclic selector.

         For an active square basis `B` of a fractional face, torsion order
         divides `|det B|`.  Releasing active capacity row `i` exposes the
         integer cofactor direction `adj(B)e_i`, which fixes all other basis
         rows.  The note gives the exact sign-and-slack inequalities under
         which this direction reaches a zero coordinate before any capacity
         violation.  The calibrated m=4 determinant-three face satisfies
         them: releasing owner row `1235` gives a monotone segment from the
         1/3 vertex to the explicit integral Catalan forest.

         Torsion orders are not bounded globally.  A literal 9-by-9 Boolean
         minor inside that face has determinant -3.  Adjoining one common
         `(m-4)`-core to `t` disjoint seven-label copies makes a block-
         diagonal minor of determinant `(-3)^t` whenever `m>=7t-3`.
         Therefore the natural matrix is not totally q-modular for any
         constant q.  This minor statement does not by itself manufacture
         feasible vertices of denominator `3^t`.

         Finally, cubic torsion is not a cyclic-orbit-size effect.  At m=4
         the Z_7 action on rank-five uppers is free, every orbit has size
         seven, and the seven fractional uppers are not one orbit (their
         complementary cyclic distances have multiplicities 1^2,2^3,3^2).
         Hence cyclic quotienting cannot isolate all torsion into
         order-three upper orbits.  The remaining target is an absorber or
         uniform cofactor-escape theorem reducing `o(W)` total defect to
         `O(1)`/zero; graphic and rooted-connector rows remain separate.

2457R. The standard-MMM nine-turn bounded-defect lane now has an exact
       recursive/hypergraph formulation, a finite-state sufficient theorem,
       and a sharp obstruction to the naive Pascal recurrence.  A uniform
       O(1) leave remains open.

       Raw MMM missing turns are cyclic three-forests with all three Dyck
       components nonempty.  Consequently

         D_n=(2n+1)/3 [z^(n-1)](C-1)^3
            =(2n+1)/(n-1) binom(2n-2,n-4),

       giving 3,22,117 at n=4,5,6.  Peak insertion/deletion is an exact raw
       defect recursion.  The consecutive ratio gives

         D_(n+1)-4D_n
          =D_n(-4n^2+58n+42)/((n-3)(n+3)(2n+1)),

       of magnitude asymptotic to 2D_n/n.  Thus four tagged parent copies
       plus only O(1) child correction cannot be the recursion; macroscopic
       cross-sector rebundling or a statefully normalized debt bank is
       necessary.  This is scoped to raw defect replication, not a repaired
       child lift.

       Complement the upper defect shore.  One q9 block is exactly

         Omega=H dotcup G dotcup Q0 dotcup Q1 dotcup Q2,
         |H|=|G|=n-4, |Qi|=3,

       with vertices H+Qi on the lower shore and G+Qi on the complemented
       upper shore.  The unrestricted six-graph has

         |B_all|=(2n+1)!/((n-4)!^2(3!)^3 3!),
         degree=(1/2)binom(n-1,3)^2 binom(n+2,3),

       and normalized maximum pair-codegree O(n^-3).  Endpoint-induced
       banks need not inherit this regularity: n=6 already has isolated
       block vertices.

       If nu_n is the induced block matching number, the balanced leave is

         rho_n=D_n-3nu_n.

       Uniformly bounded balanced block-free independence implies rho_n=O(1)
       by greedy maximal matching.  More generally, the exact finite-state
       induction pads lower masks by a and complemented-upper masks by b,
       lifts the parent matching, and matches the child birth bank plus the
       padded old residual to one of finitely many next residual templates.
       This is the precise finite residual-gadget theorem; its transition
       matching is the missing assertion.

       Every block has zero coordinate syndrome

         Sigma=sum_left 1_A-sum_right 1_C in F_3^Omega,

       and leaves preserve both this vector and shore counts modulo three.
       The exact integer degree rows are

         (d+_j-r+_j)-(d-_j-r-_j)>=0,
         2(d-_j-r-_j)-(d+_j-r+_j) in 3 Z_>=0.

       The best n=5 endpoints carry one swap syndrome e1-e2; canonical/best
       one-glue n=6 carry 2(e1-e2).  Count and syndrome allow a three-pair
       n=6 leave, but the exact no-38-block result proves that a further
       nonlinear cut is active.

       The frozen block leaves are rho4=0, rho5=1, and only rho6>=6; no
       37-block witness was certified.  At service level every block is a
       3x3 crown in the lower/upper containment graph.  Residual closure is
       exactly alternating augmenting-path flow, with Hall deficiency
       max_X(|X|-|N(X)|).  The crossed rerouter closes all audited n=5
       residuals and the named n=6 nonnested pair relationally, but the two
       rows are different reduced coordinate orbits and no all-n finite
       physical basis follows.

       Nine-turn width is a palette ledger, not chronology width: one block
       is three C10 switches and fifteen replaced seams.  Residence, deeper
       providers, topology, occurrence matching, common cap and compiler
       remain separate.  The active-11 full reset proves one fully guarded
       finite socket exists, but recursive private-socket supply is open.

2458D. The prospective oriented-diamond LP has higher torsion even on the
       protected predecessor face, and the residual-C-slot odd-circuit
       rounding route is now sharply closed.

       In full standard form at m=3 there is an exact vertex of denominator
       11, with a positive support minor of determinant -11.  After fixing
       the maximal two-arc correlated predecessor path, the nonempty
       protected face still has a denominator-4 vertex and 289 integral
       completions.  A smaller literal five-column basis has determinant3
       and all-one solution (1/3,1/3,1/3,2/3,2/3).  Hence neither ambient
       nor protected extreme points are classified by half-integral odd
       circuits.

       Even on a half-integral face, eight literal m=3 diamonds form a
       four-colour Q3 compatibility block: weight1/2 has value4 and
       saturates every used L/T/V row with zero y mass, but the support

2459A. The inherited-K2 global transport row is now exact.  It is Ferrers
       and has an explicit common-source OR rail, but it is neither laminar
       nor realizable by an unconditional O(1)-letter local sidecar.

       On a plateau, exactly six source positions acquire beta:

         Z_L={h-2,h+j-1,2h-1},
         Z_R={2h+1,2h+s,3h+2}.

       For every old interval I, its natural child value is unchanged iff
       I avoids Z_L union Z_R, and otherwise is old(I)+beta.  Thus any old
       untagged row meeting those sites has an immediate frozen-prefix
       overflow certificate.  Every one of the 3h native parent lower-q1
       intervals meets the six-site set, so their distinct rank-(r-1)
       values form a 3h-antichain exported to the global occurrence graph.
       If C is nonempty, none has another occurrence in the local plateau
       packet.  The intersection of every displaced target value is exactly
       C; if C is empty, {x_L,x_R} is the exact two-anchor cover.  These are
       negative-cap facts only, not row reconstruction.

       At a jump, for every packet-internal old interval I,

         old(I) -> old(I)
                   + alpha [I crosses E^-|A^-]
                   + gamma [I crosses A^+|E^+].

       Hence the casualty addresses are two suffix-prefix Ferrers grids.
       For a fresh pairwise-disjoint packet their union has exactly

         2h(3h+1)-h^2 = 5h^2+2h

       distinct values, and none occurs inside the child packet: q^- and
       every current lambda_1 occurrence lie on opposite sides of alpha;
       every current rho_h occurrence and q^+ lie on opposite sides of
       gamma.  On inherited shared-bank descendants the address count stays
       exact but values can collide, so all numerical sidecar bounds must
       use the collision quotient.  Mixed packet/exterior intervals are
       additional rows outside this count.

       The first nonlaminar instance is already h=2:

         Z, Z+d^-_1, Z+lambda_2, Z+d^-_1+lambda_2,

       a Boolean diamond whose natural child addresses all contain alpha.
       Positively, for nested marginal chains L_1>=...>=L_p and
       P_1<=...<=P_q, the word

         L_1+P_1,...,L_p+P_1,L_p+P_2,...,L_p+P_q

       realizes every L_a+P_b on [a,p+b-1].  A literal parent-shaped copy
       therefore realizes both complete crossing decks in one abstract
       common source.  It is a physical common-Q only after its point caps,
       owners and every mixed row pass.

       This positive rail costs Theta(h) letters.  In the fresh-bank case,
       a standalone host has at least

         ceil((sqrt(1+8(5h^2+2h))-1)/2)=Omega(h)

       letters by interval count.  For terminal append repair, the plateau
       3h-antichain needs at least 3h endpoint chains.  With t binary seam
       credits the general side-cell antichain bound is

         3h <= 2t+binom(t,2)=t(t+3)/2,

       so t is still unbounded.  Under the named separated-marginal
       architecture, the jump h-by-h subgrid also gives the exact
       K_(h,h) vertex-cover cut |R|+|C|>=h; arbitrary mixed-signature common
       words are not subject to that architecture-local cut.

       Therefore the minimum surviving bounded-defect hypothesis is a
       global injective rehosting of the plateau q1 antichain and the two
       jump diagonal antichains into already-budgeted ordinary-sector cells,
       followed by one simultaneous frozen-prefix maximal-word replay.
       A standalone local O(1) sidecar is ruled out; a clean ordinary-sector
       rail remains viable.  Independently, repeated carry has the sharp
       shared-bank residence horizon of item2454AD, so unbounded recurrence
       also needs residence regeneration.

2460L. The four-row SCD socket lane now has a common-matching
       multi-funnel theorem, an exact Catalan connector recurrence, and
       sharp canonical/product/three-primary interfaces.

       Put C=Cat_m, c=Cat_(m-1), and

         D=C(2m-3,m-2)=(m/2)c.

       Every perfect central incidence matching has exactly c edges which
       add any fixed coordinate.  For disjoint ordered pairs (z_i,a_i),
       use the two-coordinate SCD

         empty<z_i<z_i a_i,   a_i,

       and a product SCD.  Every a_i-add edge then already contains z_i,
       so one common M_0 simultaneously contains three/four full sharp
       capacity-c funnels.  Thus common-M_0 compatibility itself is
       positive; cross tail, provider and topology correlation remain.

       The original four-row matching also contains a mixed-head bank on
       every central S<L: use head zS on a short chain and azR on a long
       R<S<L<U.  All D sockets are injective in tail, head, matched owners
       and upper colour azL, and form an acyclic directed matching.  Its
       exact scalar shortage is

         (C-1-D)_+ = 1,3,6,5,0,... for m=3,4,5,6,>=7.

       This is only a port/colour shell.  A connector needs an alternate
       upper provider and the displayed roots must be literal free Q_0
       endpoints, so the six-unit scalar bound is not a bounded-defect
       Hamilton theorem.

       On every short chain set A=aS,B=zS,C=L.  The same M_0 contains the
       monochromatic triangle

         A->B->C->A,   colour azL.

       The complete cross-block table forces any canonical ordering with
       more than two blocks onto gamma paths C->A->B, with quotient

         S->T iff S subset L_T, S!=T.

       If that quotient has a Hamilton path S_1,...,S_c, then literally

         C_1->A_1->B_1->C_2->...->C_c->A_c->B_c

       uses providers C_i->A_i and 2c-1 colour-certified connector edges.
       This is a local rooted Hall path.  Conditional on a global
       upper-exact extension preserving all declared ports, the residual
       connector mass is exactly

         I_m=C-2c
            =sum_(i=1)^(m-2) Cat_i Cat_(m-1-i).

       Thus the short-core braid pays the two extreme Catalan recurrence
       terms and leaves the internal first-return convolution.  The
       standard GK SCD quotient is rigorously negative: every arc strictly
       lowers coordinate sum, and a repeated sum layer has Hall deficiency
       at least2 for all m>=4.  At m4 the literal cut
       X={24,25,34} has N(X) subset {24}.

       Four disjoint full funnels cannot be block-private.  With U_j/R_j
       the owner/lower reserve of pair j, every perfect matching satisfies

         |F|-|B intersect union R_j|
            <= |union U_j|-|union R_j|=S_4,

         S_4=4Delta_1-6Delta_2+4Delta_3-Delta_4,
         Delta_t=(2t/m)C(2m-1-2t,m-2t),

       and

         2-S_4/c
          =5(m-7)(m-3)(m-2)/[2(2m-3)(2m-5)(2m-7)].

       Hence at least I_m-1 selected heads must recycle through another
       funnel reserve for m>=7.  The sharp-coordinate relation z->a has no
       directed cycle of length <=m; this closes a four-funnel cyclic reset
       but not possible cycles longer than m in larger catalogues.

       The natural nested four-product is also closed all-dimensionally.
       Two nested levels contain Cat_(m-2) disjoint forced same-tail
       conflicts, so four banks retain at most 4c-Cat_(m-2), strictly less
       than C-1 for every m>=22.  This is architecture-specific; a
       nonnested correlated four-funnel remains open.

       Finally, on the clean cyclic route at m=3r+2, the Cat_r residual
       order-three sectors are a positive reserved bank rather than an
       opaque defect.  For any equivariant mu and any K-fixed row C, choose
       any B=C+b and A=C+alpha(B).  Both B and A uniquely recover the full-
       triple core C.  Across all fixed rows the cells B->A therefore have
       injective tails and symbols, no tail=head collision, and form an
       isolated-edge Latin forest.  The counts are

         C(2r+1,r)=(2r+1)Cat_r physical rows,
         (s/3)Cat_r clean-quotient vertices,
         Cat_r residual rotation sectors.

       Reserve this bank and delete the union of its tails and heads from
       both residual roles.  Only a relative free-bulk Latin-forest
       completion remains on this clean equivariant route.  Cat_r sectors
       are still necessary, so O(1) Skolem/three-lift patches are impossible;
       arbitrary non-equivariant multi-funnels are outside that lower bound.

       Tight-pivot completion remains joint: the same M_0 must contain P_0,
       Q_0 must retain P_1 with L_0 as its literal free incoming root, all
       funnel/pivot colours and ports must be reconciled, and the remaining
       upper representatives must preserve the connector ports.  Once the
       ordered endpoint equations hold, distinguished-source Hall is
       automatic; those equations are not yet constructed.

2462K. The standard MMM nine-turn defect and the padded-Q9 repair route now
       have a sharp private-capacity obstruction.

       With N=C(2n+1,n), P=C(2n+1,n-1), and

         D=(2n+1)/(n-1) C(2n-2,n-4),

       the exact surplus-occurrence reserve on either rail is

         S=N-(P-D)=D+2P/n.

       A translated Q9 packet is three disjoint C10 switches, repairs three
       holes, uses fifteen rail occurrences, and consumes nine negative
       tokens per shore.  Therefore pairwise negative-resource-private
       packets leave

         rho >= D-3 floor(S/9),

       whose unfloored form is

         P (n-1)(n-8)/(3n(2n-1)).

       It is positive from n=9 and rho/D tends to 2/3.  Even dropping
       negative privacy while keeping literal cubes vertex-disjoint gives

         rho >= D-3 floor(N/15),

       positive for n>=30 and asymptotic to P/20.  Thus all-but-O(1)
       repair requires macroscopic collateral recycling, overlap, a more
       efficient atom, or a normalized recursive defect state.  Exact
       calibrations are leave1 at n=8 and leave1320 at n=9 for the private
       architecture.  A full turn-load vector, not a hole count, is the
       recursive state; fixed-coordinate defect banks also refute bounded
       balanced-independence as a packing proof.  The terminal private-
       socket Hall theorem remains valid only for a bounded residual
       catalogue.

        owner/palette/common-cap transport, and the mutable-bottom occurrence

        From disjoint base depth b, pair i first expires at

        simplicity, Johnson adjacency, both native q1 injections, central
        K2, rays and socket remain exact.  But the two source edits replace

          2a owners,  2a-2 lower-q1 values,  2a upper-q1 values.

          D^+=(bar D^+,alpha_t,...,alpha_1),

        criterion.  For tau=(alpha z), disjoint owner-support blocks J,K

          O(K)=tau(O(J)),

        followed by equality of the four boundary (intersection,union)

2464A. The ordinary-sector escape from the K2 Ferrers sidecar lower bound
       now has an exact theorem boundary.

       Conditional on an integral triangular parent, the standard
       four-sector lift exports every nonempty old-ground target of ranks
       1,...,m exactly once.  For a top-containing chain

         C=(S_1<...<S_l=A),

       the minimum S_1 is the first vertex of R_C, while
       S_2,...,S_l and mu(A) lie in Q_C^0.  Top-free chains use their
       untagged vertical copies.  Thus all displaced lower targets have
       canonical semantic slots, but the export is already sector-coupled.
       For l>=2 neither direct residual join is legal:

         max R_C=S_(l-1)+xy not subset S_2=min Q_C^0,
         max Q_C^0=mu(A) not subset S_1=min R_C.

       Hence the present four-sector theorem does not provide a literal
       parent source rail or the higher Ferrers rows.

       A contraction-exact ordinary full block is sufficient: replacing
       each old source letter by a consecutive nonempty block of the same
       union transports every selected old interval injectively, hence the
       plateau q1 antichain and both complete jump Ferrers decks, provided
       deadline, owner, mixed-cap and residence guards already hold.  At a
       deadline jump an unchanged parent source has child owners

         V_i=O_i union O_(i+1).

       Consecutive V_i are distinct Johnson neighbours exactly when the
       coordinate deleted at turn i is not immediately reinserted at turn
       i+1.  Global simplicity separately requires all V_i distinct.  For
       coordinate traces v_i=o_i OR o_(i+1), internal one-runs grow by one
       and zero-gaps shrink by one, so child threshold h+2 needs parent
       zero-gaps at least h+3.  The mechanism is jump-only: on a plateau
       the unchanged depth-h windows retain the wrong owner rank.

       In the absence of such a full block, the exact physical theorem is
       matching plus one common maximal source.  For a selected occurrence
       matching M, free-position screened caps are

         K_p(M)=C_p
                intersect intersection_(hard R using p) S_R
                intersect intersection_(selected (T,c) using p) T.

       There is one literal source iff every fixed letter is compatible,
       every free K_p is nonempty and contains its mandatory subset, and
       every hard and selected mixed row reconstructs exactly from the K_p
       plus its frozen exterior.  Equivalently, for the hard-feasible source
       set Q_H,

         delta_sec
           = min_(Q in Q_H) max_(Y subset T)
               (|Y|-|N_(G_Q)(Y)|).

       Hall in the union of different cap states is invalid.  The exact
       separator consists of frozen-overflow, mandatory-deletion,
       positive-cover and empty-position cores.  Already two singleton
       pins {a},{b} on caps {z,a},{z,b} destroy a required background z
       despite a perfect occurrence matching.

       Ferrers target shape alone does not compress this criterion.  At
       h=2 a literal Boolean-diamond menu passes every singleton, row,
       column and total cut but fails an L-shaped Hall cut.  Interval-convex
       occurrence graphs and mutually private row/column rails do have
       exact interval/rectangle cut descriptions, so proving either
       geometry for the actual child sector is a sufficient next theorem.

       The result was independently audited on the semantic/jump,
       common-Q, and Hall-compression sides.  It closes further standalone
       sidecar variants but not the recurrence: the remaining construction
       must realize a matching-closed ordinary full block or satisfy the
       displayed sector-coupled criterion, while residence regeneration
       remains the separate item2454AD/2461H2 gate.

2465DA. Tight odd-diamond augmenters now have an exact global alternating-
        forest calculus, and the protected physical starting object is
        unconditional.

        In the anonymous two-slot odd host, the local `1 -> 2` menu through
        one missing upper has exact order

          16(m+1)m(m-2)(m-1),

        and exact maximum non-target resource load

          8m(m-1)(m-2),

        attained at a fixed target-facet slot.  This independently verifies
        item2462D's physical identity and sharpens its load ledger.

        Applying the audited Delcourt--Postle fixed-cutoff cycle-conflict
        theorem after deleting the `O(sqrt(m))` pivot resources, then
        deleting one unprotected edge from every remaining long cycle,
        gives an anonymous owner-slot physical linear forest containing the
        pivot and having `U-o(W)` edges.  This is an unconditional odd
        starting object.  It is not yet a fixed-M0 tail/head or occurrence-
        labelled lift.

        The exact cover-down object is a clean rooted expansion forest.  For
        `t` tight augmenter nodes and `r` missing-upper roots, there are `t`
        selected auxiliary edges and exactly `t-r` incumbent blocker edges.
        Removing those `2t-r` old edges and installing the `2t` on-edges
        gains exactly `r`; auxiliary uppers are retained, blocker uppers are
        replaced at child nodes, and the root uppers are added.  The physical
        support remains a forest iff the `2t` new projected edges are
        graphic-independent after contracting the retained forest; then the
        component count also falls by exactly `r`.

        Bounded expansion trees of at most `T` nodes have an exact compressed
        footprint of rank at most `5T-1` (old-edge tokens plus increment
        triples).  Aharoni--Haxell on these footprints, or the elementary
        deletion-resilient menu condition, selects mutually commuting trees
        for all missing roots.  For a direct one-node augmenter the footprint
        rank is four and the coefficient is five.  Hence the sole owner-slot
        cover-down gate is now the all-cut expansion/packing inequality for
        the actual Delcourt--Postle leave, plus its contracted graphic row.

        One prepared rooted use is literal: if the old `A->C` edge is an
        isolated component with terminal lower ticket `L' subset C`, while
        `B,D` start two other components, the replacement `A->B,C->D`
        changes three paths into two, preserves the two exterior terminal
        tickets, and consumes exactly `L'=C intersect D` with the lost
        component.

        There is also a sharp absolute cut.  Every atom of a protected
        matching omitting `R` uses at most one of the `2(m+1)` literal facet
        slots of `R`.  An explicit matching of exactly `2(m+1)` atoms
        saturates them all for every `m>=4`, after which no absorber of any
        support can cover `R` while preserving that bank.  Thus expansion is
        a logically necessary premise, not an artifact of the proof.  The
        `O(sqrt(m))` pivot alone is too small to create this cut; an
        unprotected incumbent cut must be released by branching.

2465ST. The Middle Levels short-core proposal now has an exact automatic
        matching theorem and an exact contiguity boundary.

        On G=[2m-3], put

          D=C(2m-3,m-2), E=C(2m-3,m-3), c=D-E=Cat_(m-1).

        For either perfect-matching parity of any ML Hamilton cycle, there
        is automatically a c-set Q of matched edges whose E-edge complement
        matches its lower endpoints bijectively down to rank m-3 and its
        upper endpoints bijectively up to rank m.  The proof is a one-step
        odd-ground common-basis theorem: weight every Boolean incidence by
        1/m.  This gives uniform primal base marginal (m-2)/m and dual
        marginal 2/m=c/D; Edmonds then supplies the synchronized common
        basis, with a balanced distribution.

        If Q is a cyclic interval in the Hamilton order, its complement
        gives all long chains R<S<L<U, Q gives the c short chains S<L, and
        reversing the block yields the exact SCD-funnel quotient Hamilton
        path.  Thus the remaining short-core row is contiguity only.

        The automatic theorem does not prove that row.  Cyclic c-intervals
        and balanced common bases have the same uniform barycentre, but a
        four-element partition-matroid example has common bases {13,24} and
        cyclic intervals {12,23,34,41}, with empty intersection.  For a
        fixed physical matching M, contraction gives the directed graph

          e->f iff S_e subset L_f.

        A common basis Q is intervalizable while retaining M iff both
        induced shores Q and M\Q have directed Hamilton paths with the two
        cross arcs.  A literal ML(5) common basis has two sinks in its Q
        shore, so no fixed-M cycle switch can make it consecutive.  In the
        authenticated matching there are197 common bases but only10 are
        intervalizable; the other parity has192 and40.

        Finite evidence is positive.  All24 unoriented ML(5) Hamilton
        cycles have all10 starts good for both parities.  The authenticated
        ML(7) fixture has5/6 good starts and ML(9) has39/39.  These exact O3
        audits ran only on ssh h100.  The remaining theorem is now precisely:
        construct an ML Hamilton cycle with one cyclic Cat_(m-1)-interval
        common deletion basis, or select the basis jointly with
        matching-changing switches.  Ordinary common-basis existence plus
        generic fixed-matching switches is insufficient.

2465L. The tight one-to-two odd-diamond augmenter now has an exact
       fixed-`M_0` multi-funnel splice and completion boundary, independently
       audited PASS.

       For

         f=(S,L;A,C), e=(R,L;A,B), g=(S,L';C,D),

       simultaneous rooting of f and e forces M_0(L)=A.  Exactly two phase
       types remain:

         C-phase: M_0(L')=C,
           L->L'  maps to  L->P, L'->Q_D;

         D-phase: M_0(L')=D,
           L->H   maps to  L->P, L'->H,

       where P=M_0^{-1}(B), H=M_0^{-1}(C), Q_D=M_0^{-1}(D).  A fixed tuple
       and fixed M_0 admit at most one phase.  The D-phase is the clean
       provider splice: it preserves the old tail/head roles and has exact
       endpoint ledger

         Src(Q+)=Src(Q)-{P},  Term(Q+)=Term(Q)-{L'}.

       Thus it consumes physical source B and terminal D.  The C-phase is
       valid only when f enters terminal L'; it creates L' as a source and
       consumes incoming roots P,Q_D.

       After deleting physical AC, adding AB and DC is forest-safe iff both
       component pairs are nonloops and are not the same unordered pair,
       equivalently iff the two dynamic union-find queries pass.  Every
       successful move gains one edge and lowers the component count by one.
       A bounded prospective bank can plant its two first-matching rows per
       move whenever the protected partial matching has total size at most
       m-1; this does not select the auxiliary providers or certify ports.

       There is an exact simultaneous completion theorem.  For d missing
       upper colours, let n phase-compatible augmenters form a rooted
       dependency forest.  If their n auxiliary providers and the entire
       n-d residual blocker set are disjoint from the protected bank, every
       child target literally restores its blocker colour, all new pairs are
       disjoint from the retained forest, and the final support is graphic-
       independent, then deleting 2n-d edges and adding 2n gives an
       upper-exact Cat_m-component forest.  Pure serial one-to-two execution
       additionally requires future-provider avoidance and the current
       two-query guard at every step.

       Ignoring packing, the exact obstruction is a blocker-colour trap X:
       every candidate targeting X retains a blocker in X.  On a
       private/linkage-faithful at-most-one-blocker catalogue, joint
       completion is exactly d vertex-disjoint target-to-free-sink paths,
       so strict-gammoid rank d/Menger min-cut d is necessary and sufficient.
       Beyond that face, if n_j nodes have j children, the exact leaf ledger

         n_0=d+sum_(j>=2)(j-1)n_j

       exposes the extra demand hidden by marginal Hall.

       The raw Theta(m^4) menu is not an availability theorem: occupying
       both slots of every facet R-a blocks every direct candidate through
       R.  The deleted f is the unique selected provider at S, not an SCD
       duplicate-colour connector.  A three-primary/funnel reserve may be
       attached only through an actually realized free source/terminal
       pair; a frozen reserve edge cannot also be deleted, and quotient use
       needs a full orbit or a charged non-equivariant seam.  Each move
       services exactly one missing upper row and one component merger.
       Once upper exactness is reached, the Cat_m-1 duplicate-colour
       connector braid, pivot Hall, residence, deep shadows and compiler
       remain separate.
