2466R. The standard-MMM four-copy count obstruction now has a constructive
       macroscopic replacement: an exact integral charge flow on cyclic
       Dyck-component triples.  This balances the whole child defect bank
       at palette ledger level; literal paired packet capacity remains open.

       Root a lower raw defect as

         0(1u_0 0v_0)0(1u_1 0v_1)0(1u_2 0v_2).

       Its six Dyck fillers have total semilength n-4.  The three skeleton
       phases have component triples

         A_i=1u_i0v_i,
         B_i=v_i 10 u_(i+1),
         C_i=u_i 1v_i0.

       All are nonempty Dyck, so their masks H+Q_A,H+Q_B,H+Q_C are lower
       raw defects.  Their pairwise unions are upper raw defects by literal
       reverse-complementation; plain complement is insufficient.

       The tempting canonical 3-regular cover is false.  For a nonempty
       Dyck word a, let kappa(a) count its top-level primitive factors equal
       to 10.  With canonical block labels x and maps

         sigma(x)_i=u_i 1v_i0,
         tau(x)_i=v_i 10 u_(i+1),

       the exact lower operator is

         (Aw)(y)=w_y+w_(sigma^-1 y)+sum_(tau x=y)w_x,

       and

         deg(y)=2+prod_i kappa(y_i).

       At n=5 there are eleven P=(1100,10,10) states of degree2 and eleven
       R=(1010,10,10) states of degree4; every canonical block is P+2R.
       Dual weights -2 on P and +1 on R prove that this canonical family
       has no fractional perfect cover.  This independently corrects the
       false 3-regular/uniform-1/3 inference.

       The correction is constructive.  Put

         b(y)=1-prod_i kappa(y_i).

       Marking one top-level atomic 10 has generating function
       C z C=C-1, so sum_y b(y)=0 exactly.  More strongly,

         b=sum_x(e_x-e_(tau x)).

       Thus sending one integral unit from tau(x) to x for every child
       state is an explicit macroscopic cross-sector flow.  At n=5 this is
       exactly the eleven contextual 1010->1100 unit transfers.  No parent
       four-copy approximation or bounded scalar correction is involved.

       Two finite contextual schemas factor the nonlocal flow: ordinary
       Tamari rotations inside a component and top-level-peak transfers
       between components.  They connect every ordered positive
       three-component layer.  After identifying the three record roots,
       the physical palette quotient is connected for n>=5: rooted layers
       overlap at separator translations3 and5, which generate Z_(2n+1).
       At n=4 the charge is zero.  An occurrence-labelled lift retaining a
       chosen absolute root needs a separate reroot-slide datum.

       The exact remaining packet hypothesis is a paired unit transporter
       on each used abstract edge:

         partial^- r_(u,v)=e_v-e_u,
         partial^+ r_(u,v)=e_(RC v)-e_(RC u),

       with all protected guard rows zero.  Under independent directed
       capacities c, exact routing is iff, for every state set S,

         b(S)<=c(delta^-(S)),  -b(S)<=c(delta^+(S)).

       Here b(S)=|S|-|tau^-1(S)|, so a violated cut is an explicit shortage
       of cross-sector sources entering S.

       Shared physical resources require the expanded resource network;
       scalar capacities then give only necessary cuts.  In an uncapped
       certified subgraph, component sums beta(K)=sum_(v in K)b(v) are the
       complete residual basis: exact correction iff all beta(K)=0, and
       minimum signed residual l1 mass is sum_K |beta(K)|.

       Signed flow proves exact marginal balance only.  Nonnegative
       denominator-three weights additionally require 0<=1+z<=3; literal
       block selection requires 1+z in {0,3} coordinatewise.  Residence,
       deep shadows, owner topology, occurrence linkage and common-cap
       compiler remain separate.  The next precise theorem is therefore a
       guarded paired crossed-Tamari/sector-transfer packet with enough
       serializable cut capacity, not another scalar defect estimate.

2467ST. The cyclic-interval common-basis property is not cycle-blind, but
       connectivity can be cleanly separated by a protected pull tree.

       A frozen literal `ML(7)` Hamilton cycle has no simultaneous deletion
       block among all `35*2=70` choices of start and matching parity.  For
       either parity, 13 starts pass the lower deletion matching and 3 pass
       the upper deletion matching, but the two start sets are disjoint.
       Thus neither ordinary common-basis averaging nor arbitrary
       Hamilton-cycle selection proves contiguity.  A deterministic walk of
       3,210 accepted incidence-hex Hamilton-to-Hamilton toggles connects an
       authenticated positive cycle to this zero-block cycle, so the
       property is not invariant under the natural hex-switch relation.

       There is an exact replacement.  Let a spanning Middle Levels
       two-factor be `F=M union N`, and let `Q subset M` already be a common
       deletion basis appearing as one block of one factor component.  An
       `M`-preserving alternating pull is `Q`-avoiding when every contracted
       `M`-edge in its support lies in `M-Q`.  Such a pull changes no
       `N`-edge incident with `Q`; hence it preserves the literal block, its
       two boundary arcs, and both deletion bases.  Therefore any sequential
       `Q`-avoiding pull tree which lowers the factor component count to one
       produces the required Hamilton cycle.  Additional SCD diagonal paths
       or a pivot collar may be included in the same protected bank.

       The revised all-dimensional target is strictly weaker than direct
       Hamilton construction: use a bounded phase reset to isolate a common
       basis as one component, open that component exactly once with a
       block-transparent cross pull, and only then use a complement-supported
       pull tree.  Arbitrary-basis intervalization and cycle-blind switching
       are both ruled out.

       The pre-Hamilton factor now has an exact path-plus-Hall criterion.
       In the contraction digraph H_M, choose a directed Hamilton path on
       Q.  Contract it to one star; a two-factor with Q as one block exists
       iff the residual bipartite digraph on P plus the star has a perfect
       matching (with the star loop removed).  Thus P need not be a
       Hamilton path before the pulls; ordinary residual Hall suffices.

       The canonical lexical factor is unusually positive but not the final
       solution.  For paper parameters n=1,2,3,4, every required-size block
       fitting in a factor component is a simultaneous basis: exact
       good/eligible counts 6/6,20/20,70/70,144/144.  At n=5 all four
       exact-size unions of components are common bases, including
       110+22=132.  At n=6 every component order is even while Cat_7=429,
       so a partial component is arithmetically forced.

       The full n=5 incidence-hex audit then exposes the missing seam.  Of
       11,550 hexagons, 550 are factor-alternating and 176 are
       fixed-matching-coherent component mergers.  Across the four common
       component unions and all 64 component phases, the pull hypergraph
       supported wholly in P is never connected; its best graphic rank is
       zero.  For Q={3,4,5}, Q itself can be connected and 66 cross pulls
       exist, but P has no internal connector.  Hence the canonical route
       needs one block-transparent cross/partial-component seam,
       matching-changing rethread, or compound pull before the protected
       complement tree can take over.

       That seam is now explicit at n=5.  The authenticated three-hex ECO
       rethread is exactly a two-reset plus one protected-pull relay:

         Q_RESET  D=11010100 support [0,5],
         P_RESET  D=11001100 support [1,3,4],
         CROSS    D=11001010 support [2,3,5].

       The first two resets install the terminal parity-one matching and
       leave exactly three contracted components: a 132-edge Q component
       equal to the common-basis endpoint bank of original components
       {0,5}, and Q-free components of sizes 275 and 55.  The last C6 is
       terminal-matching-preserving, uses one old edge from each component,
       and is a pure ternary merge.  It therefore opens Q exactly once and
       concatenates the two complement paths around it.  This proves a
       general one-cut component-relay lemma: after any bounded matching
       reset isolates Q as one whole matched component, one M-preserving
       pure merger meeting that component in one old N-edge makes Q a
       literal block; all later Q-avoiding pulls remain safe.

       The final ML(11) cycle has 460/462 simultaneous starts in each
       matching parity.  The canonical ECO-path ML(13) cycle is stronger:
       1714/1716 starts in each parity are simultaneous, with every upper
       deletion basis valid and only starts 8,9 failing below.  Thus the
       first partial-component parameter is positive.  Literal symmetric
       zero-padding of the three n=5 Dyck words is not the induction: at
       n=6,7,8 it only removes three components and loses terminal-matching
       coherence.  The remaining theorem is a recursively reselected
       bounded phase relay, not a fixed-M complement tree and not literal
       padding.

       The finite selectable family is now closed through the complete ECO
       audit range.  The n=7/ML(15) cycle has 5484/6435 simultaneous starts
       in each parity, including start zero.  At n=8,9,10 the prescribed
       start-zero block passes both deletion shores in both parities.  Hence
       every authenticated fixed-rotation ECO path certificate for 3<=n<=10
       contains the required common-basis interval.  This does not prove the
       all-n ECO path conjecture, but it shows that adding one interval-basis
       constraint has created no new finite obstruction through ML(21).

       The exact recursive state is only one scalar.  After contracting a
       terminal matching M, let partial_Q(N) count second-matching edges
       crossing between Q and M-Q.  In a connected factor Q is one block iff
       partial_Q(N)=2.  Split any resource-disjoint ECO path certificate into
       reset atoms (their new phase contains M) and M-preserving atoms.  The
       resets commute and install M.  Each preserving pull has signed charge

         Delta_Q(Z)=partial_Q(Z_new)-partial_Q(Z_old).

       Therefore the sole extra support equation beyond the existing ECO
       path certificate is

         partial_Q(N_reset)+sum_Z Delta_Q(Z)=2.

       This is exact, not heuristic.  The start-zero finite relay signatures
       are n=5: 4-2, n=6: 4-2, n=7: 4-2, and n=8: 14-12.  At n=8 the 18
       preserving pulls form a literal pure-merger chain 37,35,...,3,1; six
       have charge -2 and twelve charge zero.  Thus the first genuinely
       distributed relay already exists.  The all-n problem is reduced to a
       reselected weighted ECO support theorem; literal padding is neither
       required nor valid.

       For a fixed component order this support theorem is an exact weighted
       unit-flow problem.  Contract vertices through prescribed M even before
       M is installed and give every binary/ternary ECO atom the weight
       "new non-M Q-crossings minus old non-M Q-crossings".  The final
       boundary is the base-factor crossing count plus the sum of selected
       arc weights.  Since binary/ternary tiles are one-/two-step arcs in the
       existing integral path DAG, the sole new recursive row is a
       prescribed-weight source--sink path after the faithful and collision-
       phase filters.  Ordinary DP decides it for a fixed bank; the missing
       proof is that the recursive bank always retains the required weight.

2467CR. A Catalan-scale isolated-provider bank can be planted before the
        odd Delcourt--Postle bulk, but no bounded number of mixed-head
        strata can directly cover an arbitrary upper leave.

        Use the one-funnel mixed-head SCD bank

          B={e_S=(azL,aS;(aL)^0,(azS)^0): S<L=sigma(S)},

        of exact order

          N=binom(2m-3,m-2)=(m/2)Cat_(m-1).

        Its upper, lower and two physical-owner maps are injective, and
        the endpoint banks are cross-disjoint.  Choose exactly

          C=Cat_m,
          p=C/N=4(2m-1)/(m(m+1))=8/m+O(m^-2)

        atoms uniformly and quarantine both slots at both endpoints of
        every chosen provider.

        Exact local star formulas replace the useless `|P| Delta_2`
        estimate.  If `A_R,Q_R` count selected lower two-facets and
        selected physical owner facets of an upper `R`, then

          d(R)-d_P(R)<=4A_R+4mQ_R,

        with candidate counts at most `binom(m+1,2),m+1`.  Dually, for a
        lower `L`,

          d(L)-d_P(L)<=4A_L+4(m-1)Q_L,

        with candidates `binom(m,2),m`.  For a surviving owner slot,

          d(T^i)-d_P(T^i)
            <=2((m-1)Q_T^-+mQ_T^++J_T),

        with candidate counts `m,m-1,m(m-1)`.

        Hypergeometric tails at thresholds

          t_1=24m/log m,  t_2=24m^2/log m

        and a union bound over fewer than `2^(2m+1)` host vertices give a
        deterministic `C`-subbank for which every surviving degree loses
        only `O(m^2/log m)=o(m^2)`.  Any fixed `O(sqrt(m))` pivot forest is
        retained as well.  The residual codegree remains `2m=o(m^2)`.
        The audited short-cycle colouring argument therefore gives a
        physical linear forest of order `U-o(W)` around `C` genuinely
        isolated provider edges.

        The direct tight-augmenter graph is now known exactly.  A provider
        `S<L` reaches

          {aL+b:b in G-L} disjoint_union {azS+b:b in G-L}.

        Hence a target `R` has full-bank degree `0,m,m-2` according as
        `a notin R`; `a in R,z notin R`; or `a,z in R`.  A union of `t`
        coordinate-pair strata reaches every upper target only if its
        distinct compulsory `a`-coordinates have order at least `m-1`.
        Four strata retain the macroscopic zero shore

          binom(2m-5,m+1)=(1/16+o(1))U.

        There is also a sharp endpoint obstruction: for `R=azV`, every
        provider choice in that stratum consumes the same new owner
        `B=R-z`.  If its two slots are unavailable, `R` is blocked even by
        the full bank.  On the private-exterior face, simultaneous direct
        cover-down is exactly a five-partite packet matching on
        `(target,provider,new lower,B-slot,D-slot)`; isolation makes its
        physical forest row automatic.  The remaining exact theorem must therefore
        pre-saturate the zero shore and choose the provider strata, leave,
        and free `B,D` endpoint tickets jointly.  More Delcourt--Postle
        sampling alone cannot do this.

2468D. The standard-GK short-triangle provider has an exact two-rotation
       fixed-`M_0` grammar, but its integral completion is a typed
       Hall/SDR/graphic problem rather than an anonymous capacity count.

       For `S<L=S+x`, set `A=aS`, `B=zS`, `C=L` and freeze

         M_0(A)=aL,  M_0(B)=azS,  M_0(C)=zL.

       The two rotations may choose independent labels `b_0,b_1`:

         U_0=L+b_0,  U_1=L+b_1,  V_1=S+b_1,

         C->A  ->  B->C->P(U_0)  disjoint_union  A->Q(V_1),

       with colours `azL,zU_0,aU_1`.  Thus the non-graphic selection
       factors exactly into ordinary Hall for `S->U_0` and a coloured
       three-partite SDR on `(S,U_1,V_1)`.  The old same-`b` square model is
       only a stricter subcatalogue.  After retained-background pruning,
       `U_0,U_1,V_1` are the three internal injectivity rows.  If
       `V_1=L_T`, then `T` must also be active; the final three-edge bundles
       must be independent in the contracted graphic matroid, and literal
       serialization additionally needs the transient port/union-find
       rows.  A crossed two-colour `2x2` square is the smallest obstruction
       showing that marginal Hall cannot replace the coloured SDR.

       Put `c=Cat_(m-1)` and

         I_m=Cat_m-2Cat_(m-1)=2(m-2)c/(m+1).

       The forward capacity-two projection (all `c` short tops demanded,
       boundary vertices capacity two) holds for every `m>=3` by
       `(m-2)|X|<=(m-1)|N(X)|`.  The reverse projection (all `I_m` boundary
       targets demanded, short tops capacity two) is equivalent exactly to

         |F|<=2|V(F)|

       in the canonical two-parent graph, hence has a polynomial min-cut
       certificate.  An O3 H100 census verifies it for `3<=m<=12`, but no
       all-`m` proof is claimed.  The reverse total slack is
       `2c-I_m=6c/(m+1)`.  Full first-rotation Hall has total slack
       `I_m-c=(m-5)c/(m+1)`, giving exact deficiency one at `m=3,4`,
       equality at `m=5`, and only scalar slack thereafter.

       The exact surviving serial system is: one phase-0 and at most one
       phase-1 service per short chain, phase-1 precedence, the `V_1` head
       SDR and activation closure, background tickets, and contracted
       graphic rank.  Anonymous capacity two is only its projection.

2468H2. The current rolling-refresh two-path bank has an exact literal
        halo/upper-witness interface.  It costs only O(h) protected forest
        resources, but anonymous forest completion does not by itself
        preserve its arbitrary-width source deck.

        After t jumps from base depth b, h=b+t, the current protected paths
        have minimal fixed-address source halos

          J^-=[0,h+t],        J^+=[3h-t,4h].

        Each has h+t+1 letters.  A serviced pair with a=t-i+1 uses the
        literal point tickets

          z^-:a-1, alpha_i:h+a-1, X:2h,
          gamma_i:3h-a+1, z^+:4h+1-a.

        The four non-X tickets lie in the two halos.  If every pivot ray is
        fixed, its support fills [h+1,3h-1], so the proof-safe fixed block is
        the full 4h+1-letter packet.  At every open cut one must export the
        ordered h-letter overlap, capped signed ages, complete prefix/suffix
        OR signatures, and endpoint owner/slot/lower/root state.  Given
        endpoint owner O, retained-overlap OR S, next owner U and entering
        nonempty letter E, the exact set seam row is

          S subset U, U-S subset E subset U,
          E intersect (O-S)=empty, |O triangle U|=2,

        followed separately by point-cap and signed-residence checks.

        Arbitrary upper rows obey

          D^(h+q)A_s = union_(j=0)^q (D^h A)_(s+j).

        Nevertheless each halo contains t(t+1)/2 internal upper interval
        addresses above width h+1.  Thus the two O(h)-letter halos expose
        t(t+1)=Theta(h^2) derived addresses.  Complete prefix/suffix
        signatures are necessary and sufficient for universal crossing-row
        preservation; endpoints and total union are not.

        Old and refreshed phases are alternatives.  For one service the
        changed positions are a-1 and 4h+1-a, and exactly

          a(8h+4-3a)

        packet interval addresses meet them.  At first expiry this is
        (b+1)(13b+9).  Any retained old row through a refreshed position
        omits the fresh z, while the new mandatory letter contains z, so
        even one such row contradicts the maximal common cap.  Release the
        whole old incidence halo and rematch its target IDs in the refreshed
        phase; no fixed-row inversion is used.  Literal controls give 14
        lost old values at h=3 and, at b=2,h=5, 105 changed addresses with
        2/6/18/54 lost targets of old minimum width at most 2/3/5/all.

        The positive compression is exact but conditional.  If

          L_1 superset ... superset L_p,
          Q_1 subset ... subset Q_q,

        then the p+q-1 source letters

          L_1 Q_1,...,L_p Q_1,L_p Q_2,...,L_p Q_q

        realize every one of the pq unions L_i union Q_j.  Hence a nested
        ray/Ferrers halo can carry a quadratic target grid in O(h) letters.
        Its letters, caps and attachment seams must still be legal in one
        common source word.

        Slot-lifting the current two paths uses 2t diamonds and 8t typed
        resources; the full packet uses 3h and 12h.  Adding O(h) compatible
        halo diamonds still meets item2465DA's O(sqrt(m)) protected-bank
        premise and deletes only O(h/m)=o(1) of each raw tight-augmenter
        menu.  Freeze this bank globally.  For expansion trees of at most T
        nodes, rank B=5T-1, exact clean cover-down uses the all-cut

          nu(union_(R in I) Xi(T_R)) >
             (10T-5)(|I|-1)

        for every nonempty missing-target set I, with every witness filtered
        through one fixed source/cap state Q.  After blockers are removed
        and the retained forest is contracted, its projected on-edges must
        also obey |E^+[X]|<=|X|-1 for every nonempty component set X.

        Finally, for caps C_p, mandatory subsets D_p and one selected
        occurrence matching M, the exact maximal common word is

          K_p(M)=C_p intersect all hard-row targets through p
                         intersect all selected targets through p.

        It exists iff D_p subset K_p(M) is nonempty at every free position,
        fixed positions pass the analogous tests, and every hard/selected
        row reconstructs from the union of its K_p.  Occurrence Hall,
        Aharoni--Haxell, graphic independence and these common-cap equations
        must hold for the same Q.  A two-position core with caps {z,a},
        {z,b}, selected singleton rows {a},{b}, and required background
        union {z,a,b} proves that even convex perfect occurrence Hall need
        not preserve the common positive bit z.

        Conditional closure is now short: under one common-cap source,
        interval-convex residual neighborhoods, full boundary signatures,
        the displayed expansion cut and the graphic cuts, interval Hall is
        equivalent to

          |{T:N(T) subset [r,s]}| <= s-r+1

        for every cell interval, and earliest deadline gives the integral
        occurrence assignment.  What remains open is proving these
        trace-convex/one-Q hypotheses for the actual Pascal leave.

2469CR. **Correction / superseded conclusion.**  The mixed-head reservoir
        does have the exact controlled-leave packet cube described below,
        but its proposed balanced residual forest is coordinate-cocycle
        impossible.  The local packet and spread ledgers survive; the
        claimed exact completion does not.  See item2471CR for the exact
        no-go, the minimum two-stratum coordinate repair, and the decorated
        two-factor reformulation.  The separate connector-repeat design
        cocycle is recorded in
        `MATH_THEOREM_CATALAN_CONNECTOR_REPEAT_DESIGN_COCYCLE_20260801.md`.

        Let sigma map every rank-(m-2) `S` in `G=[2m-3]` to its SCD
        successor `L`.  Delete the sigma edge from the containment graph
        between ranks m-2,m-1.  The residual graph is (m-2)-regular, so it
        has a perfect matching beta.  The permutation

          tau=sigma^(-1) beta

        is a derangement.  Its cycle graph has an independent set I of
        order at least N/3, where N=binom(2m-3,m-2).  Since

          C/N=4(2m-1)/(m(m+1))<=1/3  (m>=23),

        choose P subset I with |P|=C=Cat_m.

        For S in P write L=sigma(S)=S+x and V=beta(S)=S+b.  The literal
        tight packet is

          (azL,aS; aL,azS)
            -> (azV,aS; azS,aV) + (azL,L; aL,zL).

        Its new resources are target azV, lower L, and owner tickets
        B=aV,D=zL.  Independence `P intersect tau(P)=emptyset` separates
        the auxiliary/target upper banks and the A/B owner banks; a/z
        signatures separate every other bank.  All C packets are mutually
        resource-disjoint and form an exact 2^C activation cube.

        Uniformly sampling C elements of I has density at most 25/m.  For
        the complete packet interface, reserve two upper and two lower
        resources per packet, both slots at A=aL,C0=azS, and one future
        slot at B=aV,D=zL.  Exact residual star identities are

          d_*(R)=sum_{xy subset R}
             1_[R-xy free](2-rho(R-x))(2-rho(R-y)),

          d_*(K)=sum_{xy subset Omega-K}
             1_[K+xy free](2-rho(K+x))(2-rho(K+y)),

          d_*(T^i)=sum_{x in T,y notin T}
             1_[T-x,T+y free](2-rho(T-x+y)).

        Hypergeometric tails at 64m/log m and 64m^2/log m show that all
        residual degrees lose only O(m^2/log m), simultaneously over the
        exponential host; codegree remains 2m.  Hence Delcourt--Postle
        gives a residual forest of order `(U-2C)-o(W)`.

        The exact resource ledger is sharper:

          residual uppers = U-2C = W-3C,
          residual lowers = W-2C,
          residual slots   = 2W-6C = 2(U-2C).

        If the residual host has a matching saturating all residual
        uppers/slots whose physical projection is a forest, it has exactly
        C path components and endpoint bank exactly B union D.  Activating
        all packets attaches A,C0 as leaves, covers every upper exactly
        once, uses distinct lowers/slots, and produces an upper-exact
        U-edge linear forest with exactly C components.

        Thus the sole owner-layer gate is the **balanced residual forest
        lemma** in this asymptotically regular punctured host.  Its exact
        IP is upper equality + lower injection + slot injection + graphic
        cuts.  Delcourt--Postle is only near-exact.  Ordinary matroid
        intersection does not apply because slot-injective edge sets are
        graph matchings, not a matroid (the three-edge slot path gives the
        exchange failure).

        There is no useful hidden coordinate relabelling for the frozen
        witnesses.  For an oriented owner edge A->B write

          A-B={r}, B-A={s}

        and form the coordinate-precedence graph r->s.  If this graph is
        acyclic, topological weights w give the valid strict potential

          Phi_w(A)=sum_(i in A) w_i.

        Rooted outdegree at most one then forces a forest by the
        minimum-potential argument.  This is a sufficient restricted
        theorem.  Exactly 64 of the 2,252 m=4 feasible assignments pass it,
        but every frozen m=4..8 forest witness has a coordinate-precedence

        For a fixed selected support the exact replacement is a
        witness-dependent path height pi_v with

          pi_v>=pi_u+1 for every selected arc u->v,

        To include the current 2t-diamond refreshed bank P, each physical

        A forced detachment edge forces its partner edge, so the smallest
        atom closure has at most 4t diamonds and 16t typed
        lower/upper/owner-slot resources.  The forced provider, head, tail,

        There is a positive literal transport theorem.  If the two
        refreshed paths occur contiguously in at most two components of an
        acyclic detachment support and the component maximal-source test

          2t+2(h+1)+O(1)=O(h)

        positions.  Every arbitrary-width interval wholly inside either
        halo retains its literal OR, so the Theta(h^2) internal address deck
        costs no extra protected tickets.  The sharp pivot singleton/source

        Complete prefix/suffix signatures determine all crossing values.

        instead cost Theta(h^2) addresses.

          011

2471CR. The one-stratum controlled Catalan leave is now theorem-closed
        negatively, and the minimum singleton-coordinate repair is exact.

        For every physical diamond and coordinate t,

          used_owner_slots_t = used_uppers_t + used_lowers_t.

        Hence every upper-exact odd owner forest with endpoint-degree
        vector E and unused-lower degree vector H obeys

          E_t = H_t + 2 Cat_(m-1).

        The frozen one-stratum packet bank has all 2C final endpoints
        containing its active coordinate a, where C=Cat_m.  It would force

          H_a = 2C - 2 Cat_(m-1) > C,

        although only C lower colours are unused.  Thus item2469CR's
        residual upper/slot-saturating forest is impossible before the
        graphic row.  More generally its matching deficiency is at least

          ceil((C-2 Cat_(m-1))/2).

        The packet nevertheless has an exact support-first form.  With

          D=zL, A=aL, C0=azS, B=aV,

        its three edges are the Johnson path D-A-C0-B, with lower/upper
        colours

          (L,azL), (aS,azL), (aS,azV).

        A balanced residual forest is equivalent to a spanning decorated
        two-factor containing all these paths, every cycle hit by a marked
        middle edge A-C0.  Deleting the C marked edges gives the desired
        C-component upper-exact forest.  The equivalence makes the phase
        boundary explicit: under the frozen SCD basis M0,

          M0(L)=D,  M0(aS)=A,

        so D-A and A-C0 are rooted-compatible but C0-B is not.  Its lower
        colour is aS while neither endpoint is M0(aS).  The packet is
        basis-changing and lies outside the fixed-M0 paired-ear grammar.

        At the coordinate level exactly two active strata suffice and one
        does not.  Use the swapped strata (alpha,beta),(beta,alpha) on
        G=Omega-{alpha,beta}.  A directed Kneser edge S->J, with S,J
        disjoint rank-(m-2) sets and L=G-J, contributes on G

          1_G + 1_S - 1_J.

        A C-vertex Kneser circulation telescopes this to constant degree C
        on every ordinary coordinate.  Splitting its vertices into

          s_alpha=floor(C/2), s_beta=ceil(C/2)

        gives

          E_alpha=C+s_alpha, E_beta=C+s_beta, E_t=C (t in G).

        With c=Cat_(m-1), I=C-2c, the forced hole vector is

          H_alpha=C+s_alpha-2c,
          H_beta=C+s_beta-2c,
          H_t=I.

        It is realized by C distinct rank-(m-1) sets: 2I containing both
        special coordinates, s_alpha-I alpha-only, and s_beta-I beta-only;
        a degree-square switch balances every ordinary coordinate exactly
        to I.

        The construction strengthens to the full typed packet/hole bank.
        Choose an incidence bijection beta and put eta(T)=G-beta(T).  A
        greedy Kneser matching avoids the degree-two eta graph while losing
        at most six vertices per selected pair.  Since C/N=O(1/m), it
        supplies floor(C/2) disjoint pairs.  The condition

          P intersect eta(P) = empty

        is exactly beta(P) disjoint from the auxiliary L(P) bank, hence all
        target, lower and owner resources separate.  For odd C, one
        boundary edge J-S of the balanced one-special hole family is the
        exceptional packet; replacing hole J by S realizes its exact
        chi_S-chi_J endpoint cocycle.  Thus target/provider, lower-hole and
        owner-ticket selection are closed for sufficiently large m.  The
        spanning decorated two-factor remains open.

        This correction should be read together with
        `MATH_THEOREM_CATALAN_CONNECTOR_REPEAT_DESIGN_COCYCLE_20260801.md`:
        that theorem constructs the abstract regular multiset of repeated
        connector uppers, but does not realize it on literal component
        endpoints.

2472AD. The flexible-SCD owner layer has an exact regenerative normal form,
        but literal same-parity renewal still has a growing shadow/common-cap
        interface.

        On the lower roots L_m and owners O_m, fix a perfect incidence
        bijection M0.  An exact M0-coherent upper-exact Catalan forest is
        equivalent to one acyclic partial injection pi on L_m such that

          M0(x) intersect M0(pi(x)) = x

        and x -> M0(x) union M0(pi(x)) bijects dom(pi) to the complete
        rank-(m+1) layer.  Coherence (root indegree/outdegree at most one)
        is essential: physical degree two alone permits A->B<-C.

        The forest has U_m edges and C_m=Cat_m components.  Its lower leave
        and two port banks are not extra state:

          terminals = L_m - dom(pi),
          sources   = L_m - im(pi).

        Each omitted lower colour is literally one component terminal, and
        total physical degree deficit is 2C_m.  Thus the irreducible sealed
        central output is (M0,pi).

        The archived m=4,...,8 witnesses replay exactly with

          (W,U,C)=(35,21,14),(126,84,42),(462,330,132),
                  (1716,1287,429),(6435,5005,1430).

        Their exact phase counts and provenance agree with item2470H2.
        Acyclicity is replayed, not encoded; the exact m=4 option class also
        contains seven cyclic satisfying assignments.  Hence this is finite
        existence, not an all-m selector.

        The exact component braid is now isolated.  A port arc t->s is the
        incidence t--M0(s), with t a terminal, s a source, t!=s,
        t subset M0(s), and the roots in distinct components.  The forest
        extends to one owner Hamilton path iff C_m-1 such arcs form a
        directed Hamilton path on the contracted components.  They use all
        remaining lower colours except one terminal a; the central forest
        already supplies the full immediate-upper palette.  Source,
        residence and cap compatibility are joint path conditions, not
        edge-local port filters.

        For the current 2t-diamond rolling-refresh bank, fixed-M0 atom
        closure forces at most one partner per protected edge, hence at most
        4t diamonds and 16t=O(h) typed resources.  If the two refreshed
        paths are contiguous in at most two selected components and the
        component maximal-source test passes, their literal collars cost
        2t+2(h+1)+O(1)=O(h) positions.  All Theta(h^2) intervals wholly
        inside those halos are then automatic consequences of the fixed
        letters.  Existence of this protected atom-closed selection is open.

        A proof-sufficient k-2->k state has six correlated layers:
        (1) protected atom-closed (M0,pi); (2) rooted component Hamilton
        braid; (3) ordered source/cap skeleton with the split pivot prefix;
        (4) an explicit injective parent-to-child interval map plus a
        rematching of every released/newborn target, together partitioning
        all nonempty child targets; (5) one maximal common word; and
        (6) an exported right socket satisfying the next-state predicate.
        Layers1--5 give one B(k)+1 word conditionally; Layer6 is the actual
        regenerative closure.  The fresh SCD owner forest does not transport
        the old source chronology.

        The deep-upper forest prefilter is exact: a rank-(m+q) target X has
        a width-q occurrence iff q consecutive edge-unions lambda(e_j) are
        contained in X and unite to X.  For the final occurrence matching M,
        one common word is exact at each free source position p with

          K_p(M)=C_p intersect all hard-row targets through p
                       intersect all selected targets through p,

        mandatory D_p subset K_p(M) nonempty, and exact reconstruction of
        every hard/selected row.  Ordinary occurrence Hall does not imply
        this cap condition (the two-position common-positive-bit core
        remains decisive).

        The exported owner schema is constant-arity, but unrestricted
        literal state is not finite.  Fixed-slot crossing coverage uses
        prefix/suffix OR-deck inclusion; two-way equivalence uses equality,
        and addresswise reuse uses the stronger ordered signatures.  Blocks
        of length ell with fixed endpoints/total OR already have
        (ell-2)! distinct two-way classes.  A nested Ferrers rail may still
        compress the structured live halo to O(h); its protected/cap-legal
        embedding is the exact open route.

2473CR. The two exact swapped SCD forests now have a complete colored-
        component switch model, and it exposes a new two-coordinate
        invariant.

        Close each directed SCD path by a typed dummy arc carrying its
        missing lower colour, terminal owner, source owner and one private
        dummy upper.  This augments F(a,z) and its coordinate swap F(z,a)
        to perfect matchings on four common shores: all lowers, all typed
        tails, all typed heads, and true-plus-dummy uppers.  The connected
        components of their two-copy colored incidence overlay are
        therefore independently switchable while preserving all four
        resources exactly.  Coincident physical atoms remain distinct
        colored copies; this is not set-theoretic symmetric difference.

        For a dummy d define

          w_t(d)=1_[t in source(d)]-1_[t in hole(d)].

        The exact red-to-blue component weight is

          Delta kappa_t(Gamma)
            = sum_(blue dummy in Gamma) w_t
              - sum_(red dummy in Gamma) w_t,

        where kappa_t=S_t-H_t+1.  Equivariant dummy labels make every
        dummy-containing component invariant under red/blue plus a<->z;
        components without dummies have zero weight.  Hence, componentwise,

          Delta kappa_a + Delta kappa_z = 0.

        Neutral swapped-forest switching can transfer directed connector
        slack between a and z, but cannot create total slack.  For bits x_i,

          kappa_t(x)=kappa_t(F(a,z))
                     +sum_i x_i Delta kappa_t(Gamma_i),

        so kappa_a+kappa_z is invariant.  The forest row is also exact:
        every augmented hybrid is a directed permutation, and deleting its
        dummy arcs is acyclic iff every directed cycle contains a dummy.
        A phase-labelled, component-consistent all-real cycle Q gives the
        lazy clause that at least one phase-sensitive touched component
        choose the opposite phase.  A candidate using both colors from one
        component is unrealizable and is omitted.

        The authenticated H100/O3 census on the saved m=4,...,9 forests is:

          m     4    5    6    7     8      9
          components
                9   29  147  591  2222   8762
          nonzero
                4    8   28   80   185    489
          base (kappa_a,kappa_z)
              (2,-3) (1,-13) (6,-47) (1,-164)
              (-68,-571) (-467,-2001)
          invariant sum
               -1  -12  -41 -163  -639  -2468
          forest-safe nonzero single switches
                4    8   28   80   185    488.

        Every nonzero component had signature (-q,+q), q>0.  The total
        transferable masses were 5,14,53,165,503,1534, with respectively
        3,2,17,47,102,260 unit components.  Thus the switch cube has fine
        transfer control and almost no one-component graphic obstruction,
        but every saved base sum is negative.  No component subset can make
        both special connector cuts nonnegative, even before cycle cuts.

        This does not refute the two-stratum endpoint-hole theorem: that
        theorem repairs undirected E=H+2c.  It proves that the next directed
        step needs either a base phase forest with nonnegative total slack
        or a non-neutral positive-total-current actuator.  The formerly
        advertised gain-two three-for-three rethread is corrected below:
        after restoring its displaced ordinary target bundle it gains only
        one z-cut unit.  More neutral switching cannot suffice on these
        fixtures.

2474R. Independent phase-detachment and connector audit fixes the exact
        logical boundary and closes two tempting repairs.

        The flexible phase CNF encodes target equality, provider capacity,
        new-head capacity, auxiliary-tail capacity and release at occupied
        old heads.  Retained-tail safety is automatic: original tails are
        aS or L and omit z, while every auxiliary tail contains z.  These
        rows imply exact upper palette, injective lower palette and owner
        degree at most two, but not topology.  A complete m=4 assignment
        with positive variables {2,14,18,22,26,37} satisfies all 282
        clauses and has all 21 upper/lower colours distinct, yet contains
        the physical cycle

          a123 -> a125 -> a145 -> a345 -> a234 -> a123.

        The original decoder prints one cycle/15 components but did not
        fail on them.  Independent fail-closed replay validates the saved
        m=4,...,8 witnesses as genuine forests with

          edges      21,84,330,1287,5005,
          components 14,42,132,429,1430,
          cycles     0,0,0,0,0.

        A valid automatic-potential subcatalogue exists, but excludes the
        reversed-long phases used by these fixtures.  In the unrestricted
        grammar one must retain graphic/subtour cuts.

        The endpoint connector gate is exact.  For a fixed physical forest,
        choose C-1 cross-component endpoint Johnson edges, respect residual
        owner-slot capacity and missing-lower-colour capacity, and impose
        graphic inequalities after component contraction.  All five saved
        forests fail even this orientation-free gate by dead endpoint-slot
        counts 5,18,50,157,638.  The fixed-M0 joint detachment/connector
        grammar fails more generally by the solver-free coordinate cut

          H_z-1-S_z=I_m-1,
          I_m=Cat_m-2Cat_(m-1).

        Degree-only joint regressions return INFEASIBLE for m=4,...,9;
        they are not used as proofs because the displayed cut closes every
        m>=4 before acyclicity.

        The short paired-ear bank supplies only one exact cut unit per
        short chain.  If r first-stage zU-provider rethreads are used, then

          H_z=c+I_m, t_z=c-r, S_z=c+r,

        so r>=I_m-1 is necessary while r<=c.  The exact residual is

          I_m-1-c=((m-5)/(m+1))c-1,

        equal to 5,32,142,571 for m=6,7,8,9.  Anonymous capacity two
        double-counts the displaced ordinary target service.

        The connector repeat palette is nevertheless closed abstractly.
        If K0 is the last lower hole and T-,T+ the final endpoints, the
        C-1 repeated uppers obey

          deg_R(q)=2c+1_[q in K0]-1_[q in T-]-1_[q in T+].

        For adjacent endpoints, adjoining R0=T- union T+ produces a
        C-block rank-(m+1) multiset of constant degree 2c.  The prescribed-
        R0 Gale--Ryser proof is valid for every m>=3.  Its scope is exactly
        a multiset: labelled residual blocks may repeat one another or R0;
        no physical endpoint placement follows.

        Finally, item2473CR gives the sharp conjugate-fibre conclusion.
        Neutral F(a,z)/F(z,a) component switches have
        Delta kappa_a+Delta kappa_z=0 and cannot create the residual total
        slack.  The next actuator must have positive total signed gain after
        every displaced tail/head/palette row is restored, or the base
        forest must already have nonnegative two-coordinate sum.

2474D. The paired-ear and swapped-phase endpoint-current ledgers are now
       corrected and closed at the exact typed level.

       In the full palette ledger a paired short packet occupies the short
       azL provider, a native zU provider, and one ordinary aW target row.
       The ordinary target option displaced by the packet already carries
       one z-containing auxiliary lower tail.  Consequently the apparent
       new z-hole exemption cancels.  After r resource-disjoint packets,

         H_z=c+I_m,   t_z=c-r,   S_z=c+r,

       so each packet gains exactly one z-cut unit, not two.  Since r<=c,
       the exact residual for m>=6 is

         I_m-1-c=((m-5)/(m+1))c-1.

       The packet-independent fixed-M0 test is

         w_z(K)=1_[z in K]+1_[z notin K and M0(K)=K+z],
         Delta kappa_z=sum_(new tails)w_z-sum_(old tails)w_z.

       It proves that one tight augmenter has gain at most one, the aligned
       rooted C6 has gain zero, and every fixed-M0 C6/C8 preserving the
       lower palette has gain zero.  No current catalogue supplies a proved
       gain-two actuator.

       For the conjugate phase route, put tau=(a z).  The local arc current

         j_q(e)=1_[q in lower(e)]-1_[q in physical head(e)]

       makes every tau-closed red-to-blue block a pure transfer:

         Delta kappa_q=0 for q outside {a,z},
         Delta kappa_a+Delta kappa_z=0.

       If D_long is the number of reversed-D long a-options in the standard
       phase forest, its exact initial currents are

         kappa_z=1-I_m,   kappa_a=c-D_long+1.

       A transfer k can pass both distinguished connector cuts iff

         I_m-1 <= k <= c-D_long+1,

       equivalently D_long<=c-I_m+2.  This is impossible for every m>=6,
       since I_m>c+2.  Thus the two swapped forests cannot repair one
       another by tau-closed colored components; they only move a deficit
       between a and z.  This does not contradict the two-stratum cocycle
       theorem, whose Kneser packets change the lower/provider basis and are
       not unions of tau-closed columns.

       The solver-free m=4,...,8 replay verifies every current identity,
       owner degree and individual graphic test.  The next live actuator
       must have positive total current Delta(kappa_a+kappa_z)>0, or leave
       the standard one-stratum SCD basis.  Quantitatively, an external
       packet bank must first pay the exact necessary row

         sum_P (Delta kappa_a(P)+Delta kappa_z(P))
           >= I_m-c+D_long-2;

       only then can neutral conjugate components redistribute the current.

2475L. The endpoint-hole repair is now exact at the degree layer, the
       abandoned finite shared-signature route has a sharp pigeonhole, and
       a different phase-compatible packet bank exists asymptotically.

       For an allowed lower family A, the feasible C-hole degree vectors
       are exactly

         D_C(A)={A x:x in {0,1}^A, 1^T x=C},

       equivalently the positive coefficients of

         product_(K in A) (1+y product_(t in K) x_t).

       All support-function inequalities characterize its convex hull but
       not its integral fibres.  The endpoint law is

         E-2 Cat_(m-1) 1 in D_C(A).

       One active stratum is impossible.  For two swapped strata of sizes
       q,C-q, singleton feasibility is exactly

         C-2c <= q <= 2c,  c=Cat_(m-1).

       Put I=C-2c and J=4c-C=3C/(2m-1), and write q=I+t.  With ordinary
       endpoint balance E_g=C, the exact hole normal form has

         2I both-special holes,
         t first-only holes,
         J-t second-only holes,
         no neither-special holes.

       Degree-square switches balance every ordinary coordinate to I.
       The bounded fractional construction starts at m=7; a Kneser
       circulation plus hole-first avoidance gives an integral full-layer
       realization for all sufficiently large m.

       The old anonymous typed packet is not a k=17 calibration.  Its
       auxiliary and target uppers occupy two disjoint banks of N central
       cores, so

         2C <= N=binom(2m-3,m-2)

       is necessary.  Since

         2C/N=8(2m-1)/(m(m+1)),

       this first holds at m=15.  The requested m=6,...,9 build was stopped
       before compilation or H100 execution.

       The corrected packet uses separate alpha-U and beta-U target shores.
       Put r=m-2 and N=binom(2r+1,r).  A paired block consists of a Kneser
       edge {S,J}, flags b in J,d in S, and abstract resources

         rank r:   S,J;
         rank r+1: G-J,G-S,S+b,J+d;
         rank r-1: J-b,S-d.

       Its exact raw supply and resource loads are

         B0=N(r+1)r^2/2,
         mu_r=(r+1)r^2,
         mu_(r+1)=2(r+1)r^2,
         mu_(r-1)=(r+2)(r+1)r.

       Hence one block conflicts with at most

         Delta=4r(r+1)(3r+1)

       others.  Because C/N=4(2r+3)/((r+2)(r+3))=O(1/r), greedy selection
       supplies C/2 resource-disjoint opposite-stratum blocks for even C.
       For odd C, one flagged standard odd Kneser cycle is resource-
       disjoint and telescopes exactly; a uniform coordinate relabelling,
       not a cyclic translate, avoids the hole bank, and paired blocks fill
       the remaining C-(2r+1) packets.  The independent audit verifies all
       counts, the typed Q<->U and L/V implications, and r=2,...,5 finite
       tables (with a crude sufficient even threshold r>=94).

       Every corrected packet plants the literal local C-phase rows

         aS->aL, zS->azS, L->zL.

       Across the bank these form a 3C-row partial incidence matching.  The
       first exact open row is its common-owner-basis extension

         |N(X)-I_P| >= |X|  for every unplanted lower family X.

       Resource disjointness does not prove this Hall row or membership in
       one SCD.  Even after it, exact residual upper/lower/slot saturation
       plus the no-unmarked-cycle decorated-factor row remains open; current
       DP results give only a near-forest around much smaller protected
       banks.  No decorated factor or contiguous-OR word is claimed.

2476K. The proposed `F(a,z)`/`F(z,a)` hybrid now has an exact physical
       component theorem and a sharp standard-GK ceiling.

       Raw physical symmetric-difference components are not legal switch
       units: they need not preserve named uppers or owner degree and can
       create cycles.  The correct construction closes each rooted path by
       an equivariantly paired typed dummy carrying its missing lower,
       terminal, source and a private upper.  The two augmented factors are
       perfect on four shores.  Connected components of their four-shore
       incidence graph then switch independently; after deleting dummies,
       every true upper remains exact, lowers remain injective and rooted
       indegree/outdegree remain at most one.

       For a selected dummy d put

         w_q(d)=1_[q in head(d)]-1_[q in lower(d)],
         kappa_q=1+S_q-H_q.

       Every conjugate component has

         Delta kappa_q=0 for q outside {a,z},
         Delta kappa_a+Delta kappa_z=0.

       Thus it transports current but creates none.  The exact topology
       row is also finite: the augmented hybrid is a directed permutation,
       and the real support is a forest iff every permutation cycle meets
       a selected dummy.  Each component-consistent all-real cycle gives
       one lazy phase clause; an all-common cycle is an immediate
       obstruction.  These clauses plus the two singleton-current subset
       sum do not replace the later full rooted connector Hall/tree rows.

       In the standard flexible SCD grammar, with D_long reversed-long
       a-options,

         kappa_z=1-I,  kappa_a=c-D_long+1,
         c=Cat_(m-1), I=Cat_m-2c.

       Hence neutral conjugate switching alone is impossible for all m>=6.
       An independent first-stage h provider rethread has exact signature

         Delta(kappa_a,kappa_z)=(0,1).

       After p such rethreads and a neutral transfer r, the exact scalar
       interval is

         I-1-p <= r <= c-D_long+1.

       The GK aligned-C head map psi(R)=R+x has exact image size

         |im psi|=binom(2m-4,m-3)=E-K,
         K=binom(2m-4,m-4).

       Its Dyck-gap generating-function proof and an independent m=3..9
       replay agree.  Thus A_C<=E-K, D_short<=c and D_long>=K-c.  Even
       after all p<=c short rethreads,

         kappa_a+kappa_z <= 3c-K-I+2 < 0  for every m>=10.

       Therefore the complete standard-GK conjugate-plus-short-bank hybrid
       is theorem-closed from m=10 onward.  This is architecture-specific;
       a nonstandard base, third parent or basis-changing open packet is
       not excluded.

       The external C6/C8 search also has a sharp resource filter.  Every
       closed four-resource C6/C8 has coordinatewise zero current.  The
       forward C6 gain has resource surplus one legal atom
       (L,U,T,H=L+y), hence

         Delta kappa_q=1_[q in L]-1_[q in H]=-1_[q=y],

       never positive.  A genuine gain-two actuator must therefore have
       an open/dummy/provider-release boundary satisfying
       Delta used-lower_z - Delta used-head_z >=2 after restoring every
       displaced provider/target row; raw circuit supply is irrelevant.

       Finite calibration: m=4 has an exact 35-root Hamilton path with
       three independent h rethreads and 13 connectors; at m=5 the exact
       base-degree maximum p=10 is below I-1=13.  The m=4 certificate and
       the component census are independently replayed.

2477D. The compact resident facet socket is an all-depth positive hard-pair
       current transporter, but not a closed actuator.

       For every oriented Johnson edge X->Y with insertion label sigma,

         j(X->Y)=1_(X cap Y)-1_Y=-e_sigma.

       Hence every literal rethread has

         Delta kappa_q=#deleted insertions q-#added insertions q,
         sum_q Delta kappa_q=Delta(number of forest components).

       For facets F_i=U-v_i, i=0,...,h, the forward socket current is

         -sum_(i<h)e_(v_i),

       and its complete depth-q lower deck is

         U-{v_s,...,v_(s+q)}, 0<=s<=h-q.

       There is a sharp all-h raw hard-pair construction.  For z outside U
       and x in U-{v_0,...,v_h}, replace

         F_i -> F_i-x+z, 0<=i<h,

       by the facet path.  Then

         Delta kappa=h e_z-sum_(i<h)e_(v_i).

       If no v_i is the other hard coordinate a, this gives
       Delta(kappa_a+kappa_z)=h.  But it deletes the h distinct upper
       children U-v_i+z and replaces them by h copies of U.  Pointwise,

         h 1_U-sum_(i<h)1_(U-v_i+z)=-Delta kappa.

       More generally, every positive outgoing-rooted outside-U current
       unit injects into one distinct child casualty; two exterior seams
       cover at most two.  Incoming extraction arcs can move current inside
       U and must be handled by the full signed column, so this child-star
       theorem is not incorrectly extended to arbitrary two-sided rows.

       Exact-19 calibration: U=70398 has raw

         Delta kappa=e16+e15+e5+e0-e12-e1-e3,

       giving pair gain +2 at (a,z)=(15,16), but with one extra component.
       Lower cleanup raises the component/repeat debt to three and leaves
       seven upper casualties; 70391 has no extendable one-seam provider.
       Thus the finite row is a genuine positive signature, not closure.

       The exact remaining all-m gate is a correlated socket-current plus
       child-provider/repeat-cocycle matching, together with lower-tower
       injection, owner/head capacity, residence, and graphic rows.  No
       all-m packing or positive closed actuator is claimed.

       An independent audit additionally checks

       Applying the bank gives 6362 raw fragments, removes 80 extracted

2479R. Protected extraction of compact resident facet sockets has an exact
       coloured branching theorem, and automatic Catalan absorption is
       false without a correlated exterior absorber.

       If D is the union of deleted occurrences and A the added exterior
       occurrences, then for every immediate-upper colour V,

         n'_V=n_V-|D_V|+|A_V|+h #{s:U_s=V}.

       Thus the h-1 repeated socket copies are locked to the parent colour.
       For 1<=t<=ell pairwise-owner-disjoint sockets in an upper-injective
       forest,

         B(S)=2|S|-delta_F(S)-e_F(S)
             >=t(h+1)-2(C+ell)+1.

       At t=ell=C this is C(h-3)+1, so bare h>=4 extraction is
       supercritical.  The hypothesis that the selected facets are distinct
       is essential; the theorem does not assert that such a bank exists.

       The Catalan endpoint reservoir has mean exactly four facets per upper
       target.  Under the uniform endpoint model the two-facet probability
       tends to 1-5e^-4, but after an independent missing-lower palette the
       direct legal ticket density is only (16+o(1))/r.  Therefore raw
       endpoint support is not protected support.

       For bounded demand loads, one socket candidate part has the explicit
       sufficient Haxell resource-incidence bound

         Psi=((Lambda1-1)(h+1)^2)/(r+1)
             +2((Lambda2-1)h^2)/(r(r+1));

       Psi<1/2 selects pairwise owner/lower-disjoint sockets.  Constant facet
       load gives Lambda2<=r Lambda1/2, so h=o(sqrt r) is locally sparse.
       However a binary Catalan demand bank with perfect facet load two is
       impossible for r>=4 by full column rank of W_(r-2,r-1).

       Residence imposes an additional exact SDR.  Besides the staircase
       lists, every outside-U coordinate must have clean ages on both sides,
       v0 must lie in the left-clean set, and vh in the right-clean set.
       Omitting this condition is already false at h=1.

       A valid positive theorem is hereditary weighted contraction: after
       every reachable occurrence history, complete packets must satisfy

         sum_(child V) w(V)<=rho w(R), 1<=w<=K, rho<1.

       This closes H initial demands with at most KH/(1-rho) packets.  A
       nearby exact m=9 bank of thirty guarded three-facet/two-seam macros
       closes its immediate child cascade but leaves deeper upper holes.  It
       is not an instance of the four-facet/three-seam h=3 compact theorem;
       it only demonstrates that correlated exterior absorption can occur.
       The all-k gate remains a correlated coloured absorber with clean
       guards, graphic chronology, all-depth witnesses, and one
       occurrence-labelled common-Q/compiler matching.

2480D. The v5 30-socket postbank now has an exact global-selector theorem,
       and the frozen 6252-piece face is sharply impossible before the
       ranks11--15 solve.

       For each oriented piece state, a legal seam carries its tail/head,
       lower rank8 colour, upper rank10 colour, residence transition and
       cap transition.  The exact selector chooses one state per piece,
       P-1 seams, directed graphic acyclicity, lower/compiler rows and all
       upper witnesses.  For ranks11--15 the correct row is an accumulated-
       union DFA (equivalently a unit reachability flow after the common path
       is fixed); a one-seam or fixed-q witness atlas is not complete.

       If H is the missing-lower multiset, L the lower repeat-excess
       multiset, R the upper rank10 repeat-excess multiset and T-,T+ the
       endpoint owners, every upper-complete Hamilton path obeys

         |H|=|L|+1, |R|=4861,
         d_R(q)=2860+d_H(q)-d_L(q)-1_[q in T-]-1_[q in T+].

       Thus the connector cocycle is automatic only after the literal lower
       ledger is fixed; its scalar cardinality is insufficient.

       Two independent frozen-face obstructions are exact.

       (i) The 18058 internal edges use only 18005 distinct lower colours:
       53 repeat units, all multiplicity two.  Therefore any intact-piece
       Hamilton concatenation has at least 54 lower-q1 holes (53 beyond the
       forced boundary hole).  Every minimum lower repair must release one
       occurrence from each duplicate pair.  Exactly 52 pairs are
       residual/socket and one is socket/socket: lower colour31968 occurs
       inside socket targets31988 and97508.  Hence at least one authenticated
       socket must split.

       (ii) Even allowing both orientations and ignoring residence/cap,
       seven rank10 holes have no endpoint-pair provider:

         20427,69555,70910,72414,72566,73649,83946.

       All seven are newly lost by the bank.  Named child69555 is among
       them, proving that prebank atlas extendability is not postbank
       physical selection.  The seven need at least six newly exposed
       endpoint owners and at least three cuts.  Hence the intact 6252-piece
       selector is infeasible independently of deeper ranks.

       The exact minimum lower reset takes the 52 residual occurrences and
       one of the socket/socket pair.  Cutting the97508 occurrence is the
       dominating branch: 6305 resident pieces, 18005 simple internal lower
       colours, and internal upper-hole counts

         r10..r15 = 1509,2480,1612,563,104,11.

       The alternative31988 branch has564 rank13 holes and otherwise the
       same deck.  The preferred branch opens four of the seven old raw
       zeros, but69555,72414,83946 remain zero.  Their pair intersections
       have ranks6,7,6, so at least three further endpoint services and at
       least two more ordinary cuts are necessary.  No sufficiency, global
       Hamilton path, common cap, compiler or k17 equality is claimed.

2480A. The `m=9` minimum-residence cut face now has a sharp rank-ten
       obstruction, and the representative eight-facet escape has a complete
       extraction/lower-palette ledger.

       Rank ten is seam-local: if a contiguous owner interval has union U
       of rank ten, every adjacent rank-nine Johnson pair in the interval
       already has union U.  Thus, after the unique old U edge is cut, an
       arbitrary-width witness still requires a new external U seam or an
       internal U edge of a certified macro.  This does not extend to ranks
       eleven and above.

       In the all-minimum atlas there are 243 globally zero possible cut
       colours.  Separately, the option-conditioned audit has fourteen
       components with no fully individually supported minimum option and
       independent unsupported total fourteen (thirteen are forced by the
       global 243 set; the fourteenth is option-specific).  Hence every
       1419-cut fragmentation has at least fourteen unsupported selected
       rank-ten colours, even before degree/topology.  The displayed list of
       fourteen is one minimizing representative, not a universal mask set.

       For an ordered facet rail F_j=U-u_j, adjacent uppers are U, adjacent
       lowers U-{u_j,u_(j+1)} are distinct, and every internal interval of
       length at least two has union U.  At depth three an eight-facet rail
       has exact exterior roles

         L-clean,L>=3,L>=2,L>=1,R>=1,R>=2,R>=3,R-clean.

       Thus exterior feasibility is an exact 8x8 role-Hall test plus
       outside-U cleanliness.  Singleton extraction alone does not prove it.

       On the representative fourteen, 112 selected facets and 178 distinct
       forced boundaries have exact minimum completion

         cuts=1571, pieces=6433, raw lower holes=6433, scalar slack=968.

       Post-cut upper holes at ranks10,...,15 are

         1571,2556,1708,630,128,16.

       All fourteen named rank-ten holes acquire internal rail providers.
       Independent Held--Karp replay proves the exact lower-palette optimum:
       fourteen rail orders have 98 globally distinct lower colours with
       only seven retained-palette collisions, eighty deleted-old hits and
       eleven pre-existing-hole hits.  They fill 91 holes, leaving 6342 and
       scalar slack1059.  Exterior role-Hall/common-Q remain open.

       The fixed rail bank is not an absorber.  Its regenerated necessary
       stateful relaxation has 279 rank-ten zeros.  Freezing the 178 socket
       boundaries and exactly minimizing over 8909 minimum completions still
       selects 32 cuts in that bank; regeneration moves the obstruction to
       289 rank-ten zeros.  The rank-eleven counts11/14 are diagnostics only,
       because the exported decks are truncated at seven owners.

       The old b19 formula is only a support relaxation: it selects4862 of
       8894 patterns, nineteen omissions and4773 positive arc variables,
       with no degree, colour capacity, topology or common run chronology.
       Its optional socket parser is physically incomplete and does not

       The exact replacement is the compound-fragmentation master.  One

       Common-Q remains a later gate.

       The authenticated 30 guarded-three-facet socket bank supersedes the

       holes

         1458,2429,1583,549,101,10

       at ranks10,...,15.  Its colourwise unsupported-child list is empty,

2480L. The resident facet socket now has a corrected all-k protected
       extraction/cascade theorem and an exact two-stratum interface.

       For a compact h+1-facet socket, fixed guard state and facet-disjoint
       protected edge bank P, let A_j be the staircase-age lists, E_j the
       physical position/Johnson-join lists, and

         C_j=(A_j intersect E_j)-B_P.

       Socket existence is exactly

         |union_(j in J) C_j|>=|J|  for every J.

       If guard retention is not fixed, exact feasibility is the finite
       disjunction over guard states.  This corrects endpoint-zero and
       outside-target runs without forbidding a protected edge retained as
       a guard.

       For missing U, its selected facets are independent.  If K contains
       the retained old guards, the exact cut count is

         q=sum_(F in X)deg(F)-|K|;

       two retained guards give the sharp q<=2h.  The raw upper-child count
       is at most q.  More decisively, for T targets, H0 initially missing
       targets, component-merger credit mu, repeated-provider credit rho
       and kappa genuine auxiliary provider slots,

         |Gamma_out|>=((h-1)T+H0-mu-rho-kappa)_+.

       Thus closure needs kappa+mu+rho>=(h-1)T+H0.  One missing target in
       an upper-injective component-neutral forest leaves at least h
       outside holes.  Its collapsed endpoint excess is (h-1)1_U, and
       compensation using only rank-(r-1) lower holes needs at least h
       units when r>=2h+1.  O(1) uncompensated closure is therefore
       impossible for growing h; Theta(h)=o(W) is only the first
       scalar-possible scale.

       On a contracted private single-matroid face, the exact backup gate is

         nu=min_(Y subset Gamma)(|Gamma-Y|+r_M(N(Y))).

       The weighted positive alternative is stateful: if

         Phi_(t+1)-Phi_t<=-(1-theta)w(R_t),

       then sum_t w(R_t)<=Phi_0/(1-theta), subject to online/global
       compatibility, a positive weight floor or other well-foundedness,
       and a separately closing terminal family.

       A prospective positive criterion also survives.  If n allowed
       facets have degree at most two and every vulnerable colour has
       providers on at least a distinct facets, while a random guard-legal
       socket contains each fixed a-set with probability at most pi_a,
       then

         E|Gamma_U|<=floor(2n/a)pi_a.

       For uniform choices and a=2, h(h+1)<n-1 guarantees zero raw upper
       children.  Lower, topology and endpoint rows remain separate, and
       this does not apply to a provider-multiplicity-one frozen factor.

       For a common owner basis M0, supported phases are exactly
       L^p R^(h-p).  The target-facet graph is simple, indegree-one and
       componentwise unicyclic.  At h=3, failure of a four-facet path is
       exactly a triangle factor; 3 not dividing r+1 forces a supported
       socket.  Triangle factors have abstract Theta(h) merger scale, with
       physical joins still separate.

       The two-stratum bank avoids any o(N) typed footprint in the even
       construction.  The present odd-seed proof handles o(N/m)=o(C), or a
       larger reserve if the seed is planted first.  The balanced lower
       family has exact orbit density 8/(m+1), giving avoidance below
       (m+1)/8.  It does not absorb the socket cocycle.  Exact endpoint
       composition is

         d_(H0)+(h-1)1_U+gamma in D_C(A_L-Z_L),

       forcing sum gamma=-(h-1)(r+1).  A correlated extraction boundary,
       residual common-M0 Hall, upper shadows and compiler remain open.

       This complements item2479R: that item supplies Catalan endpoint
       dispersion/Haxell and multi-socket upper-injective cuts; this item
       supplies fixed-boundary Hall, the redundancy/component/auxiliary
       cascade min-max, prospective multiplicity, the common-M0 facet
       graph and two-stratum endpoint-fibre composition.

2481K. The compact resident facet socket has an exact current
       classification and one genuine standard-GK terminal gain-two face,
       but the clean shared-provider architecture is now theorem-closed
       from `m=19` onward.

       For a directed Johnson edge with insertion label sigma,

         j(e)=-e_sigma.

       Hence the forward common-upper rail

         F_0->...->F_h, F_i=V-v_i,

       has intrinsic current `-sum_(i<h)e_(v_i)`, and reversing the rail
       transfers only `e_(v_0)-e_(v_h)`.  The rail itself is not gain two.

       The exact positive face occurs on a long GK chain

         R<S=R+rho<L=S+x<U=L+y.

       A reversed-D option plus an intact direct zU provider contains

         U-[z]->zL-[a]->azS.

       Reversing the same two unoriented edges gives

         azS-[x]->zL-[y]->U

       and preserves lower palette `{L,zS}`, upper palette `{zU,azL}` and
       the entire undirected graph.  Thus

         Delta kappa=e_a+e_z-e_x-e_y,
         Delta(kappa_a,kappa_z)=(1,1).

       This is genuinely basis-changing: old lower-tail assignments
       `(L,U),(zS,zL)` become `(L,zL),(zS,azS)`.  It is degree-legal without
       sidecars when the three-owner motif is a whole component.  As a
       terminal suffix it exports exactly one component, lower ticket K,
       terminal P=M0(K), and lost upper W; closure is a changed-basis
       containment Hall/alternating-linkage row.  The old azR-to-azS
       hole-terminal pair also has to be rematched to new terminal U, and
       fixed-background common-cap admissibility is not automatic.

       The gain-two face is the terminal edge/right seam of the compact
       resident socket with parent B=azL and terminal omitted labels
       `(v_(h-1),v_h)=(x,a)`.  The remaining h-1 facets are a residence
       buffer, conditional on the complete guard theorem and `m>=2h+1`.
       Their extraction exports named upper children and possibly remote
       lower providers.  All returns must pass tail/head/lower/upper
       matching plus the contracted graphic inequalities.  Every full
       socket also spends at least h-1 of the exact C-1 repeat-upper slots.

       Short rethreads and clean terminal sockets compete for the same
       intact direct-zU provider bank.  If p is the short count, b the
       socket count and D_long the reversed-long count, then exactly

         p+b<=I,
         p+2b>=I-c+D_long-2,
         b<=D_long,
         (h-1)b<=C-1.

       Together with `D_long>=K-c`, this has two sharp consequences.  If
       all p=c short gains are already used, the remaining socket bank
       fails from m=14.  Reoptimizing p and b jointly still gives
       `p+2b<=2I<K+I-2c-2` for every m>=19.  The exact normalized gap is

         K-I-2c-2
          =c(m^3-20m^2+33m-6)/(2(2m-3)(m+1))-2.

       Thus the terminal actuator is real but finite-dimensional inside
       the clean standard host.  An all-m route must recycle providers
       already used by short/all-G packets, share repeat-upper apertures,
       gain more than two hard-current units per aperture, or change the
       representative/rooted basis macroscopically.

       pieces.  Its exact necessary-context census has 100 rank10 zero-seam

       followed by all-depth replay and common-cap--not pairwise seams or
       local socket existence.  The proved noncanonical pivot-rich packet

2483L. The v7 socket cascade now has an exact typed-child theorem, a sharp
       resident-junction obstruction, and a conditional buffered
       regenerative closure.

       For a selected family A, upper children must be computed from the
       union of cuts:

         c_A(R)=|P_R-D(A)|+|{e in B(A): union(e)=R}|+h_A(R),

       where h_A counts only additional final providers disjoint from the
       first two terms; a retained old witness is not counted twice.

       Equivalently, every minimal option family whose deleted-provider
       sets cover P_R gives one provider-cover clause.  Singleton
       child-cleanliness excludes only singleton covers and is not
       compositional.  The active demand is typed as (R,beta), with beta
       carrying clipped run ages, common options/guards, residual provider
       sets and protected history.

       If physical correlations are temporarily forgotten, child-clean
       options are arcs star->U and one-child options are arcs V->U.  The
       head-partition and underlying graphic matroids have a common basis
       iff the dependency digraph has a rooted arborescence.  The published
       singleton v7 row passes formally: 99 root arcs,
       14309->75749, and star->14309.  This is only a colour dependency.

       Shared-facet composition has an exact new run formula.  For sockets

         (A_0,...,A_h=F), (B_0,...,B_g=F),

       if coordinate x is omitted at positions p,q, the concatenation with
       the second socket reversed creates bounded run

         L_x=(h-p)+(g-q)-1.

       It is resident iff every such double-omission run meets the floor.
       Disjoint omission banks suffice for one two-socket junction but not
       hereditarily for three or more.  The exact state is the clipped
       suffix age beta.  At position j, a zero for x is forbidden when

         1<=age_beta(x)+j<s.

       Hall after these position-specific exclusions, followed by literal
       beta update, is the correct hereditary path row.

       This criterion sharply kills the displayed base-context closure.
       Parent75749 and child14309 share facet owner10213.  All four frozen
       L3/L4 pairings have coordinate1024 gap2.  The canonical joined word

         74725,67557,10213,13285,14308

       has trace 0,1,1,0,1, upper deck
       75749,75749,14309,14309 and four distinct lower colours.  Residence
       floor4 therefore needs at least two new 1024-positive owners, a new
       omission order, or a nonflat replay.  Thus a clean base14309 socket
       is not a certificate for the typed child exported by75749.

       Independently, fixing the old38 plus the compatible
       generation-three L5 child leaves only17 of200 L3/L4 rows locally
       viable and88 targets with both choices dead.  The prepared
       9094-variable/41823-clause CNF is UNSAT by independent unit
       propagation; H100 Kissat also reports zero decisions/conflicts.
       This is append-only, not a no-go for reselecting the38 sockets or
       adding joint columns.

       A positive buffered-cascade theorem is exact.  If every dependency
       path junction receives an internally resident O(d)-owner bridge whose
       full clipped relation composes, whose union cuts pass all
       provider-cover clauses, and which preserves signed palettes, deep
       history, topology, endpoint and compiler rows, the path contracts to
       one zero-child macro with footprint O(sum h_a+dJ).  Shared sockets
       obey the corrected
       extraction identity

         q=sum_(x in X)deg_F(x)-|E_F(X)|-|K|;

       an equal-h T-chain in the stated two-regular face has
       q=2(h-1)T+2.  The sharpened repeat/cascade row is

         |Gamma_out| >=
           (m_T-mu-rho-tau_T-kappa)_+,

       regeneration, the affine potential row alone gives only

         Phi_t<=theta^t Phi_0+beta(1-theta^t)/(1-theta).

       floor, per-round cost, and a literal terminal atlas below
       Phi_*>=2beta/(1-theta).  For beta=0 the footprint is

       stopping-time L beta term and terminal-atlas cost.  Bounded displayed

2489W. Keeping the shared-bank pivot packet cyclic separates its internal
       incidence/residence algebra from the ambient Catalan connector, but
       it does not make the final opening free.

       One packet cycle has3h+2 Johnson edges and therefore6h+4 edges in
       its middle-levels incidence lift.  Hence H resource-disjoint cycles
       form a 2-bounded bank of size H(6h+4), and the small protected-factor
       theorem plants them whenever

         H(6h+4)<=m-2.

       For fixed H this holds eventually.  Every planted cycle is a
       saturated factor component: all its incidence vertices already have
       protected degree two, so the ambient two-factor cannot connect it
       before a protected transition is replaced.

       On the automatic common-basis face, let R be the fixed projection of
       the cycle/cut/provider casualty bank onto the child-edge ground.  If

         |R|<=aHh+bH,

       then for fixed a,b,H and h=O(sqrt(n)) the exact balanced common-base
       distribution gives a basis Q disjoint from R.  Indeed

         N/C=n(n+2)/(2(2n+1))>n/4

       while |R|=O(sqrt(n)), so E|Q intersect R|<1.  This is an exact
       noncollision theorem only for a bank fixed before Q is chosen; it
       does not supply physical side representatives or a Q-dependent
       casualty set.

       The cycle-opening debt is exact for every h>=2.  Its nonconstant
       cyclic run lengths are

         x_L:2h+2; x_R,p:2h+1; rho_h:h+2;
         every lambda, rho_(<h), and d_i:h+1.

       At every owner cut exactly h+1 nonconstant runs cross, and splitting
       them creates exactly2h positive endpoint fragments shorter than
       h+1.  A seven-edge-class proof gives the same total at every cut, so
       changing the opening cannot reduce the residence debt.

       At the safe J6 cut R_(h-1)->H, oriented as

         H,L_0,...,L_(h-1),M_0,...,M_h,R_0,...,R_(h-1),

       the short start record is

         rho_h:1, d_i:i+1,

       and the short end record is

         p:h, d_i:h-i.

       If J6 is the global prefix, its left record is legal boundary state
       and the only residence obligation is the nested outgoing socket

         p in Y_1,  d_i in Y_1,...,Y_(i+1).

       Its removed lower q1 colour can be the unique Hamilton-path boundary
       colour, while its removed upper q1 colour needs the protected old
       provider or a new splice provider.  For H cycles, between2H-2 and2H
       endpoint sides still need compatible continuation.

       Therefore cyclic retention weakens the packet-specific protected
       Catalan gate: the common basis/bulk connector need not carry the
       packet's internal O(Hh) bank.  It does not shrink the ambient
       Catalan-scale connector.  The shortest B+1 target is now an otherwise
       fully guarded Catalan host with one J6 prefix, the nested outgoing
       socket above, the upper provider, higher-deck witnesses and one
       common cap.  More generally the stated CRS(H,C) socket theorem would
       imply

         nu(k)<=B(k)+H+C;

       H=1,C=0 gives B+1.  CRS remains conditional.
