2490X. The age-composition theorem is an exact quotient of the symmetric
       rank-only fractional marked-trace gate, but not of the downstream
       physical one-copy problem.

       For a type c=(c_0,...,c_d), c_0>0, sum c_i=r, put

         R(c)={c_0+...+c_(j-1):1<=j<=d, value<r}.

       The proof-safe formulation has a type circulation f and explicit
       mark masses m_s(c):

         sum_(c') f(c,c')=sum_(c') f(c',c)=pi(c),
         sum_c pi(c)=1,

         0<=m_s(c)<=pi(c) 1[s in R(c)],
         sum_c m_s(c)=q_s.

       Eliminating m gives exactly the proposal's inequalities

         q_s<=sum_(c:s in R(c)) pi(c).

       This retains the full fractional mark capacity.  Suffix unions are
       nested, so two have equal rank iff they have equal value; using R(c)
       as a set correctly removes duplicate suffix occurrences.

       The reverse lift is literal.  For each named owner T, take ordered
       age partitions T=C_0 dotunion...dotunion C_d.  A c->c' arc is the
       invariant biregular relation C'_(i+1) subset C_i.  Appending C'_0
       updates last-occurrence ages exactly.  Uniform mass on every such
       relation balances every partition state; directed partition cycles
       are genuine periodic nonempty-letter de Bruijn cycles.  Repeating
       this independently for every owner and averaging under Sym(k)
       restores mass one at every literal owner and gives a fixed rank-s
       target load

         [binom(k-s,r-s)/binom(r,s)] q_s
           =[binom(k,r)/binom(k,s)] q_s,

       exactly the required residual triangular load.

       The qualification is essential.  The lift deliberately keeps each
       transition inside one fixed owner.  A connected one-loop type graph
       may lift to W private constant-owner cycles; it does not choose one
       trace per owner, order distinct owners, enforce Johnson adjacency,
       supply q1 palettes, or construct a Catalan Hamilton path.  Literal
       root/comparator imbalance is state-specific and is lost by the age
       projection.  Uniform target marking splits mass across many owners
       and suffix addresses; guarded envelope/common-cap structural zeros
       break the transitivity and biregularity used in the proof.  Hence no
       occurrence-labelled compiler SDR follows.

       The proposal's unit-descent circulation lemma is still required even
       for fractional nonemptiness.  After it, the one-copy coloured-Euler
       lattice/rounding gate, connected rooted support and pins, owner/
       Catalan topology, residence at joins, arbitrary-width upper witnesses,
       occurrence-level common cap and regeneration remain independent.
       The quotient removes a real exponential fractional state nuisance;
       it does not improve the numerical bounds by itself.

2493Y. The age-composition edge variables have an exact Strassen
       elimination.  Put

         P(c)=(c_0,...,c_(d-1)),  Q(c)=(c_1,...,c_d).

       Since an age arc c->c' is exactly Q(c')<=P(c), a type law pi has a
       circulation with both endpoint marginals pi iff

         Q_*pi <=_st P_*pi.

       The orientation is the displayed one: every product-order up-set U
       obeys

         Pr(Q in U)<=Pr(P in U),

       while down-sets obey the reverse inequality.  Conversely Strassen
       gives X<=Y with laws Q_*pi,P_*pi.  At fixed r, Q has the unique
       inverse

         x -> (r-sum x,x_1,...,x_d),

       and P has the unique inverse

         y -> (y_0,...,y_(d-1),r-sum y).

       Thus the coupling lifts uniquely to target/source compositions and
       gives the circulation; no hidden fibre choice remains.

       Combining these cuts with the audited mark boxes gives the exact
       edge-free fractional gate: one distribution pi must satisfy every
       Strassen up-set cut and

         q_s<=sum_(c:s in R(c)) pi(c).

       Two consistency families pass.  A nonincreasing composition has a
       self-loop.  If every entry is positive, rotation

         rho(c)=(c_d,c_0,...,c_(d-1))

       stays legal and satisfies Q(rho(c))=P(c); uniform mass on its
       distinct orbit is stationary even when the rotation period is
       smaller, and literally refreshes exactly the oldest age class.

       The proposed one-row unit-drop law remains insufficient.  For d=2
       and r>=4, a fully marked deficit-gap profile (2,1) fixes

         c_2=2,c_1=1,c_0=r-3.

       It obeys the unit-drop inequality, but the up-set {x_2>=2} contains
       Q(c)=(1,2) and not P(c), so the point mass violates Strassen.  The
       source theorem was patched to add the necessary r>=4 qualification.

       This is an unconditional finite reduction, not feasibility of the
       actual triangular vector.  The global systematic residue structure
       must still satisfy all cuts or supply a monotone coupling.  One-copy
       owner/target rounding, literal connected roots and pins, Catalan
       topology, joins/residence, upper witnesses, common-cap SDR and
       regeneration remain downstream.

2496TG. The terminal-gap Strassen lane now has one general positive theorem
        and one exact obstruction.  For `d>=3`, `r>=d+2`, and `2<=j<=d`, put

          L=r-d-1

        and let `C_j` have entries

          c_0=1, c_1=L, c_j=2,
          c_i=1 for every other i>=2.

        Its full marked profile is

          ({1,...,d}\{d-j+1}) union {r-1}.

        Removing the top mark gives a donor profile `H_j`.  Its zero-fill
        type `B_j` has fresh class `L+1`, the 2 shifted to coordinate `j-1`,
        and terminal zero.  The alternative completion

          D=(L+1,1,...,1)

        contains the same donor marks.  With

          R_p=(L,1,...,1), c_p raised to2,

        there is the exact legal cycle

          C_j -> D -> R_1 -> ... -> R_(j-2) -> B_j -> C_j.

        Thus, whenever a stationary residual law is stocked with one mass of
        `C_j`, two of `B_j`, and one of each `R_p`, changing one `B_j` donor
        completion to `D` replaces the stock by uniform mass on a cycle of
        length `j+1<=d+1`.  The marked marginals are identical.  This is an
        unconditional parametric single-hole actuator, not merely the k54
        example.  An O3 checker replayed 1,168,749 `(d,r,j)` cases and
        42,441,047 arcs through `d=96`.

        however, profile

          {2,3,4,6,37}

          C_*=(1,31,2,1,1,2).

        Any successor must have `Q<=(1,31,2,1,1)`.  The 38 systematic
        profiles are exactly the finite families listed in the theorem.  A
        five-mark profile beginning1 has final gap at least2; one beginning2
        violates the first-coordinate bound; the only four-mark profile
        `{2,3,4,6}` also forces final gap2 after the necessary leading extra
        slot.  Therefore none of the 768 legal successor age types contains
        any systematic profile.  The principal down-set below
        `(1,31,2,1,1)` has P-mass at least76/W and Q-mass zero under every
        completion.  No completion of the k76 systematic residue profiles
        supports a stationary age circulation.

        route.  A protected Catalan/pivot construction must now alter the

        private owner occurrences outside the protected bank, preserve

        cycles in the one-copy coloured-Euler selector.  Mark-neutrality
        supplies the correct marginal interface but none of those physical
        four gates automatically.

2497R. The self-loop/rotation shortcut and the systematic Unit-descent
       proposal now have a complete independent scope audit.

       For a self-loop type, the increasing deficit gaps satisfy

         1<=g_1<=...<=g_m<=r-t_m,  m<=d.

       Hence every supported deficit obeys

         t<=floor(dr/(d+1)),

       and this cutoff is sharp.  The downward self-loop cone has the exact
       nonnegative-weight anti-blocker whose support function is an integral
       longest path on states `(j,t,g)`.  It is not a polymatroid: at
       `(r,d)=(8,2)`, `I={3}`, `J={2,5}` violate augmentation.  For the
       triangular parameters, `d<=r-2` for every `k>=6`, while
       `q_1=(k-b_1)/W>0`; deficit `r-1` is absent.  Thus the single-coordinate
       Farkas separator closes the self-loop cone negatively for all `k>=6`
       (and the all-one type handles `k<=5`).

       Positive rotation orbits are also closed.  Their capacity vectors
       satisfy `a_s=a_(r-s)` by complementary cyclic intervals, and

         a_(r-1)=a_1<=d/(d+1)<q_(r-1).

       Even the union of loops and rotations obeys

         a_(r-1)+a_1/d<=1;

       this separates every odd `k>=7`.  Exact rational H100 LP duals through
       `k=40` agree and show combined-cone feasibility in every tested even
       case, but no all-even theorem is claimed.

       The exact profile-respecting gate is the option-flow system: assign
       every marked row to a containing age type, then require equal incoming
       and outgoing type masses; equivalently impose all Strassen cuts on the
       induced law.  Unit drop alone is false, already for

         d=2,W=3,r=6,n=(2,1,1,1,1),

       whose three forced types leave one source with no successor.  More
       decisively, item2496TG's `k=76` principal down-set proves that the
       actual systematic family admits no completion whatsoever.  The next
       possible route must exchange marked deficits between rows before age
       completion and lift those exchanges as occurrence-labelled alternating
       circuits in a protected Catalan/common-cap host.

       The terminal actuator theorem was independently replayed on H100:
       1,168,749 parameter triples and 42,441,047 arcs pass.  Its `k=54`
       specialization has a shorter exact three-cycle

         (1,21,2,1,1,1)
           ->(22,1,1,1,1,1)
           ->(22,2,1,1,1,0)
           ->(1,21,2,1,1,1),

       with a stationary residual after moving54 donor completions.  The
       theorem wording was corrected: zero belongs to the retained cumulative
       list of `B_j`, not to its positive marked-deficit set.  The independent
       audit also made the anti-blocker nonnegativity, rational-vs-real lift
       scope, rank/deficit coordinate switch, longest-path start/termination,
       and the special `j=2` edge explicit; none changes the verdict.

2498MR. The `k=76` systematic-profile obstruction has the unique minimum
        marked regrouping and an exact constant-size circulation reservoir.
        Pair each of the 76 copies of

          P={2,3,4,6,37}

        with one copy of

          H={1,2,3,5,7}

        and exchange marks `6<->5`.  The new profiles are

          P'={2,3,4,5,37},
          H'={1,2,3,6,7},

        with forced types

          X=(1,32,1,1,1,2),
          Y=(31,1,3,1,1,1).

        This preserves every marked-deficit multiplicity.  A count-neutral
        nontrivial change must touch at least two rows and relocate two marks,
        so the construction is absolutely minimum.  The exact census covers
        all 97 eligible two-row one-mark transpositions against systematic
        donors of sufficient multiplicity, with every unchanged underfull
        row fixed to its canonical leading-zero completion.  In that
        completion face this `6<->5` exchange is the unique stationary hit;
        arbitrary completion/type splitting was not enumerated.  The sole
        four-mark profile is a subset of P and supplies no additional
        genuine transposition.

        More generally, for every `r>=12` at `d=5`, replace 37 above by
        `r-1`.  The two new types and five reservoir types form the legal
        cycle

          (1,r-6,1,1,1,2)
           ->(r-7,1,3,1,1,1)
           ->(r-7,3,1,1,1,1)
           ->(r-6,2,1,1,1,1)
           ->(r-8,3,2,1,1,1)
           ->(r-9,4,1,2,1,1)
           ->(r-6,2,1,1,2,0)
           ->(1,r-6,1,1,1,2).

        Thus this first double-hole obstruction has a uniform constant
        seven-type actuator.  At k76 all five reservoir profiles occur with
        ample stock; removing 76 copies of every cycle type leaves an exact
        stationary residual of mass `6892620648693261354068`.

        The edit is profile-local but not local in canonical residue order:
        the bad interval and donor span are separated by
        `3197838967477067705891`.  Residue labels are not yet physical owner
        order, so this does not affect quotient correctness.  It does prevent
        interpreting the repair as a bounded contiguous residue edit.

        For the protected Catalan/pivot host, marginal arithmetic is now
        exact but physical correlation remains.  One must reserve labelled
        one-copy owners for all seven types, keep them off the pivot/upper/
        common-cap ticket bank, lift every age edge with literal labels, and
        join the resulting cycles by protected component switches.  The 76
        copies form a `Theta(k)` bank, outside the scope of post-hoc fixed-
        `O(d)` common-basis avoidance.  Joint owner/Catalan selection or an
        orbit-compressed lift is required.  No all-depth bounded actuator
        library is claimed.

2499AD. A primitive `Z_17` quotient Hamilton cycle has an exact
        nonwrapping-opening reduction which keeps the physical phase and
        quotient edge index separate.  For a fixed quotient edge orbit all
        seventeen physical cut phases are equivalent by simultaneous
        coordinate rotation, but the1430 edge orbits are not interchangeable.
        Rooting removes one physical edge only: the opened path still has
        seventeen helical quotient laps joined by the other sixteen copies
        of the root edge orbit.  Deleting the whole orbit or checking one
        target representative is unsound.

        Normalize a proper target-orbit witness I to OR(I)=U and put

          P_i(I)={-g:e_i^g lies in int(I)},
          L_i(U)=intersection_(I:OR(I)=U) P_i(I).

        Then phase p of U is lost at normalized cut e_i^0 iff p lies in
        L_i(U).  Hence the cut is upper-safe exactly when every L_i(U) is
        empty for ranks10 through16; rank17 is automatic from the whole
        opened owner path.  A fixed-cut rejection has the exact maximal-
        compatible-block certificate: every maximal block of owners
        contained in S misses one named coordinate of S.

        A rank-s proper witness contains at most C(s,9) distinct owners, so
        its crossing-phase set at one quotient edge orbit has size at most

          ceil((C(s,9)-1)/1430)=1,1,1,1,2,4,8

        for s=10,...,16.  Empty intersection can therefore be certified by
        at most2,2,2,2,3,5,9 normalized witnesses per target orbit, totaling
        at most4921 rows for one safe opening.  The exact lazy row for root
        a, target orbit U and phase p is

          not o_a OR OR_(I:OR(I)=U, p notin P_a(I)) w_I,

        where w_I is channelled to the full labelled interval occurrence.
        A unit `not o_a` learned from one variable-cycle incumbent is invalid
        unless guarded by the full labelled successor/voltage/order state.

        Rank10 has the sharper exact presolve: first every upper-colour orbit
        must occur, and a root edge is safe iff its colour orbit occurs on a
        second selected quotient edge.  Thus

          sum_(a:c(a)=U)x_a>=1,
          o_a<=sum_(b!=a:c(b)=c(a))x_b.

        Since one colour has multiplicity at most10, any complete rank10
        quotient palette has at least318 q1-safe cut edges, but higher ranks
        may reject all of them.

        The saved strict MMM spiral is only a negative calibration.  It has
        voltage1 and a perfect lower rank8 rainbow, but cyclic upper holes at
        ranks10,...,14 are2516,2720,1377,374,51, so no opening is upper-safe.
        This does not obstruct a different decorated quotient cycle.  For
        the exact depth-three age source, strict-upper source intervals and
        nonwrapping owner intervals are equivalent: intervals of length at
        least4 correspond by the four-window identity, while shorter
        intervals lie inside one rank-nine owner.  Lower common-cap
        compilation and the final universal word remain separate.

2500DH. The k76 mark exchange extends to a uniform all-depth double-hole
        actuator.  Fix

          d>=3, r>=d+4, 1<=m<=d-1,
          j=d-m+1, L=r-d-1.

        Start from the full terminal profile

          A=({1,...,d+1}\{m,d}) union {r-1}

        and donor

          H={1,...,d-2,d,d+2}.

        Exchange marks `d+1<->d`.  The new profiles are

          A'=({1,...,d}\{m}) union {r-1},
          H'={1,...,d-2,d+1,d+2}.

        This is rank-count neutral.  They force

          X_0=1, X_1=L, X_j=2, other X_i=1,
          Y=(L-1,1,3,1,...,1).

        For `1<=p<=j-1`, let `R_p` have fresh class L, positive-age entries
        all one except `(R_p)_p=2`.  Then

          X -> Y -> R_1 -> ... -> R_(j-1) -> X

        is an exact legal age cycle of length `j+1<=d+1`.  Its reservoir
        profile is explicitly

          K_p={1,...,d+1}\{d-p+1}.

        Hence any marked law decomposing into a stationary residual plus
        equal mass on these types is stationary after the two-row mark
        regrouping, with unchanged rank-mark totals.  The age-2 excess moves
        right by one coordinate per edge, explaining the O(d) worst-case
        reservoir length; it changes existing traces rather than adding word
        positions.

        The same rule is independently rediscovered by the finite exact
        scans.  At k76 it is the unique one-mark swap among97 candidates in
        the canonical leading-zero completion face.  At
        k89 (`d=6,r=45,m=2,j=5`) the bad profile is

          {1,3,4,5,7,44},

        donor is `{1,2,3,4,6,8}`, and the unique hit among101 candidates in
        that same fixed-completion sense is
        `7<->6`, producing `{1,3,4,5,6,44}` and
        `{1,2,3,4,7,8}`.  This confirms the parametric rule at two depths and
        hole positions.

        The theorem is conditional on jointly stocking the K_p reservoirs.
        This theorem alone did not cover three or more small holes; handoff
        item2503MH now closes their age algebra.  Expanded
        literally, an extreme multiplicity block uses `Theta(kd)` owner
        occurrences, beyond post-hoc fixed-O(d) common-basis avoidance.  A
        protected Catalan/pivot proof must choose donor/reservoir owners and
        the common basis jointly, or use an orbit-compressed lift, then retain
        upper/common-cap tickets and join the labelled cycles in the one-copy
        coloured-Euler selector.

2501D. The exact `k=17` age certificate now has a dependency-clean one-copy
       quotient interpretation and a sharp verdict on the canonical MMM
       host.  Rotation is free on all proper nonempty ranks, so the
       denominator1430 is exactly the owner-necklace count.  The frozen
       1430-position/16-arc type word is balanced and connected and may be
       placed abstractly on a unit-voltage MMM quotient owner cycle.  Once a
       voltage-labelled owner cycle, the word and a root partition are
       fixed, literal age propagation is a TU layered path network with
       weighted state count183232 and maximum layer560.  Rank8 is the lower
       Johnson colour; the remaining coloured rows are ranks2--7.

       The six-row interface has an exact local rectangularization.  With
       both neighbouring partitions fixed, the middle fibre is a Cartesian
       product of two uniform-base intervals.  First-factor swaps change only
       the first suffix; second-factor swaps change the first and second
       suffix by the same Boolean exchange.  On cyclically nonadjacent
       layers this gives a genuine bipartite Hall/TU completion face for
       first-suffix colours.  The complete independent-layer flag-difference
       lattice is saturated, so there is no parity/Smith obstruction before
       path reachability; a modular obstruction can arise only in the pruned
       path lattice `C(ker_Z B)`.  The full coloured payload is state-
       injective, so no payload-transparent rectangle exists.

       Rank7 is more rigid: every such suffix is exactly the intersection of
       three consecutive owners, hence is fixed by the owner cycle rather
       than a partition choice.  The frozen shift-one MMM cycle supplies only
       1001/1144 native rank7 necklaces.  It is also obstructed before colour:
       the certified multiset has436 `c0=1` states, each forcing a distinct
       exact length-four coordinate run, whereas this cycle has only132 run
       orbits of length4.  Thus every ordering of the certified types on this
       owner cycle fails by at least304 units.  For the frozen Euler word the
       best of all1430 relative shifts has372 lag-four violations forward

       The next admissible host must simultaneously have at least436
       length-four run orbits, all1144 native rank7 orbits and a nonempty

2503MH. Canonical terminal profiles with arbitrarily many small holes now
        have one uniform marked-regrouping actuator.  Fix

          d>=3, q>=2, 1<=m<=d-1, r>=d+q+2,
          j=d-m+1, L=r-d-1.

        The q-hole profile is

          A=({1,...,d-1}\{m}) union {d+q-1,r-1}.

        Pair donor

          H={1,...,d-2,d,d+q}

        and exchange marks `d+q-1<->d`.  This preserves every rank-mark
        count and produces

          A'=({1,...,d}\{m}) union {r-1},
          H'={1,...,d-2,d+q-1,d+q}.

        Thus one swap collapses all q holes directly to one.  Their types are

          X_0=1, X_1=L, X_j=2, other X_i=1,
          Y=(L-q+1,1,q+1,1,...,1).

        With `R_p=(L,1,...,1)` carrying a 2 in coordinate p,

          X -> Y -> R_1 -> ... -> R_(j-1) -> X

        is a legal cycle of length `j+1<=d+1`, independent of q.  The
        reservoir marked profile is explicitly

          K_p={1,...,d+1}\{d-p+1}.

        Uniform mass on this cycle is stationary, so any law decomposing
        into it plus a stationary residual passes Strassen with unchanged
        marked marginals.  This improves iterative hole removal from O(qd)
        to O(d) reservoir types.

        The first triple-hole finite cases match the theorem.  At k121 the
        dead type `(1,51,3,1,1,2,1,1)` still has a one-profile completion
        repair.  At k123 (`d=7,r=62,q=3,m=2`), the profile

          {1,3,4,5,6,9,61}

        has neither such a repair nor a stationary hit among156 minimum
        swaps against the existing systematic donors.  The theorem instead
        prescribes donor `{1,2,3,4,5,7,10}` and swap `9<->7`, producing
        `{1,3,4,5,6,7,61}` and `{1,2,3,4,5,9,10}`.  Hence the donor bank must
        be selected jointly; fixed systematic grouping is not a reservoir
        theorem.

        A physical lower bound accompanies the positive algebra.  For a
        Strassen down-set deficit of unnormalized mass a, changing one age
        occurrence improves the cut by at most2, so at least ceil(a/2)
        occurrences change.  An edit of s physical letters affects at most
        `s(d+1)+O(d)` depth-d windows, implying

          s=Omega(a/d).

        Extreme systematic blocks have a=k and d=Theta(sqrt(k)), hence any
        dedicated local sidecar needs `Omega(sqrt(k))` positions.  An O(1)
        literal sidecar is impossible.  This does not preclude B+O(1): the
        required `Theta(kd)` cycle occurrences may be reassigned inside the
        existing W-scale host or handled as a symmetry orbit.

        The protected Catalan/pivot route must therefore choose marked donor
        and K_p reservoir rows jointly with the common basis, lift them on
        one-copy labelled owners, retain upper/common-cap tickets, and join
        their cycle components.  Post-hoc fixed-O(d) avoidance is too small.

       separation between ideal assignment, physical serialization, and a
       guarded external common cap.

       In the ideal `(d+1)`-slot containment graph, every legal partial

       For a fixed clock and pins P, the exact residual defect is

         delta_(tau,P)=max_X(|X|-|N_tau(X)\R(P)|)_+ <= |P|.

       Prefix-realizable triangular factors serialize exactly by a rooted
       trace-Euler problem: minimize the bridge count over one selected
       trace per owner, with connected positive support containing the
       prescribed initial state.  For connected Eulerian support z this
       root penalty is

       Relative to a trace-guarded occurrence basis, the private terminal
       common-cap loss is bounded by

         gamma+kappa_(M0)(a)+q_Pi+delta_0+q_L+q_R.

       Privacy and literal trace guards are necessary: one nonprivate
       spanning singleton can destroy arbitrarily many background targets.
       The resulting B(k)+O(1) implication is therefore conditional on
       integral rooted chainization and one guarded physical basis, not on
       SCD geometry.

       inequality is exact, but necessity requires a stationary coupling at

       maximal-cap equations.  A transition-compatible direct age source
       spells its lower witnesses literally and needs no later lower cap;
       common cap remains only for an external carrier.

2507RS. The donor/reservoir stock left open in item2503MH has an exact
        marked-profile solution.  Regard the W named owner occurrences as
        rows of capacity d and deficit t as a column of degree n_t.  If M
        rows are prescribed full profiles and g_t of them contain t, the
        complete-bipartite residual b-matching exists iff

          M<=W,
          0<=g_t<=n_t,
          n_t-g_t<=W-M for every t,
          sum_t(n_t-g_t)<=d(W-M).

        These conditions are exactly all Hall cuts; no higher-order marked
        stock obstruction exists.

        For every actual canonical bad occurrence `(q,m)`, prescribe the
        bad row A, donor H_q, and all reservoir rows K_p from item2503MH.
        If A is the number of bad occurrences, then

          A<=n_(r-1)<=k,
          M<=A(d+1)<=k(d+1).

        Every non-top mark has supply at least

          n_(r-2)>=C(k,2)-C(d+1,2)>>k(d+1),

        while every missing-slot cut t>=2 has slack at least

          W-n_2>=W-C(k,r-2)>>k(d+1).

        The sole tight cut is t=1.  Donors and reservoirs all contain1, so
        the prescribed rows missing1 are exactly the actual bad rows with
        m=1; their number is already at most W-n_1.  Hence every canonical
        bad/donor/reservoir bank stocks simultaneously inside the original
        W named rows, with no additional marked row slot or owner-role, for
        all sufficiently large k.  Physical chronology positions are not
        part of this statement.

        A second lemma lifts any legal age path of at most d+1 edges, whose
        source terminal classes are nonempty, to distinct Johnson owners by
        deleting one terminal-age token and inserting one globally fresh
        token per edge.  The fresh-token chronology has pairwise distinct
        lower and upper q1 colours.  Any fixed number of such cut actuator
        paths therefore embeds in an owner/lower-q1 two-factor by the
        fixed-H Ore--Ryser theorem.

        Scope is essential.  This closes marked-profile stock, not the
        stronger decomposition of the residual type law into a stationary
        circulation.  The exact remaining age quotient is the integral
        circulation (5.2)--(5.3) in the theorem.  A complete bank may contain
        O(k) paths and O(kd) literal incidences, with Theta(kd) only in the
        long-path extreme, beyond fixed-H planting.  Positive-density or
        orbit-compressed physical planting,
        arbitrary-width upper protection, common-cap payloads and Catalan
        coupling remain open.

2528L. The weakest one-class sequel to the canonical two-buffer no-go is now
       exact, and it has a split positive/negative verdict.

       First distinguish consumable provider occurrences from one literally
       returned separator.  For target loads m, holes D, surplus
       s(t)=(m(t)-1)+, private unit-transfer capacities c, and consumable
       separator occurrences g with menus E_g, put

         gamma(B)=|{g:E_g intersects B}|.

       Exact integral max-flow/min-cut gives

         H*=max_(B subset P)
              (|D intersect B|-s(B)-c(P-B,B)-gamma(B))_+.

       Thus class names and fractional mass do not count; literal occurrence
       tokens do.  If instead one separator is returned after every macro and
       supplies regenerative primitive payloads e_v-e_u on a digraph R, the
       same theorem collapses to

         H*=max_(B:delta_R^-(B)=empty)(|B|-m(B))_+.

       Strong connectivity plus total load at least |P| therefore gives an
       unconditional zero-terminal-boundary absorber through arbitrarily many
       provider moves.  This is the exact weakest positive one-class theorem
       in the returned-unit-root model.

       The newly closed fractional pull clock already clears the static q1
       provider row more strongly than expected.  Put

         W=C(k,r), N=C(k,r-1)<=W,
         b_(r-1)=0, q_(r-1)=N/W.

       If X(T,Q) is supported marked mass from rank-r owner T to coatom Q,
       then every target column sums to1 and every owner row sums to N/W.
       Hence for every coatom family S,

         |S| <= (N/W)|N_X(S)| <= |N_X(S)|,

       so Hall gives a supported integral matching saturating every coatom.
       In the odd central case it matches all owners; in the even central
       case W-N=W/(m+1) owners remain unmarked.  The same statement holds
       separately on every unpunctured rank.  Consequently item2526L's
       protected PH word-slack cut vanishes entirely if coatom identities
       may be globally released and retimed without changing transitions.
       This is a static theorem, not a common nested-flag chronology.

       A second positive theorem removes the earlier raw-word topology
       obstruction at quotient level.  For d>=1,r>=d+3, one complete
       K=1 high class g_(0,r-2), of size C(r-2,d), universally fuses one
       core-free g_(0,r-1) bank, of size C(r-1,d), into one legal type cycle.
       The bipartite raw-necklace incidence graph is connected because its
       2-section is the positive-composition unit-transfer graph; same-type
       outgoing-head switches along a spanning tree serialize and preserve
       occurrence-attached marks.  Equal type is not a labelled recurrence
       rectangle, so named owners and arc payloads remain open.  One
       g_(0,b) copy also has only C(b-1,d-1) terminal coatom-provider
       occurrences; a fixed multiplicity cannot be counted twice against a
       growing protected bank.

       Two sharp failures isolate the surviving correlation row.  Complete
       separator-returning bundled moves q(e_v-e_u) have a fractional
       all-one solution but preserve every integral load mod q, forcing
       (q-1)n holes on qn targets.  Even unit occurrences fail if one global
       clock phase correlates all menus: the averaged cut rank is exactly
       |B| for every B, while either integral phase misses n targets.  In the
       literal even-k (r,d)=(2,1) family, static coatom load is exact but any
       one-copy selector orients K_k and needs k/2 circuit-route arcs (or
       k/2-1 for an open trail).  The latter is central only at k=4.

       Therefore the exact live theorem is a transition-transparent coatom
       retiming class, or a saturated returned-separator unit-root network,
       on the SAME selected one-copy chronology.  Fractional supply,
       quotient fusion and static Hall are now closed separately; their
       labelled owner/state/target intersection, common flags, upper/deep
       witnesses, residence and compiler cap remain open.  No B(k)+O(1)
       conclusion is claimed.

2527A. The residence-first rank-eight-rooted nine-attachment construction
       now has an exact theorem and a decisive fixed-certificate verdict.
       For a rooted row `Q=C0 dotcup C1 dotcup C2`, an attachment state is
       one of the nine aligned incidences `Q subset T`, with
       `C3=T-Q`.  A state transversal uses one state per root and rank-nine
       owner.  A transition from state `e=(q,o,sigma)` through an old-root
       incidence `h=(q,o',tau)` has phase

         delta=sigma-tau mod17

       and is literal iff the rotated next classes `C1,C2,C3` lie
       respectively in old `C0,C1,C2`; the entering coordinate's membership
       in rotated next `C0` and the age-zero refresh equality are then forced
       by the exact owner equation and complete target partition.  Checking
       that membership remains a sound redundant defensive row.  One
       incoming/outgoing transition per selected state makes the through-root
       edges a second perfect matching H.  A single transition cycle with
       nonzero total delta gives one physical cycle.  Equivalently, in a
       common gauge consecutive roots satisfy

         T_(i+1)=Q_i union Q_(i+1),
         C_(3,i+1)=Q_i-Q_(i+1),

       with the three nested survivor containments, while owner exactness is
       exactly bijectivity of the union orbits `[Q_i union Q_(i+1)]`.  In a
       running physical gauge the wrap is voltage-twisted,
       `Q_1430=rho^Delta Q_0`; an untwisted physical wrap would force zero
       voltage.
       Fixed rank2--8 flags, type masses, rank8 turns and depth3 positive
       residence are automatic.  Upper palettes/opening/compiler are not.

       This validates the new quantifier order and shows why the old
       deficiency1341, which froze one owner attachment, was not decisive.

       Root0 is already a singleton cut:
       `Q=255,type8,(C0,C1,C2)=(159,64,32)`; none of its81 geometric

2526L. The proposed unconditional canonical-two-buffer NRFC cocycle is
       false.  The exact replacement is one positive min--max theorem and
       two independently audited infinite cut families.

       For a protected named palette P, baseline provider load m0 and
       literal statewise signed macro payloads Delta_e, terminal hole count
       is exactly

         h=max_(S subseteq P)
              (|S|-m0(S)-sum_e Delta_e(S)).

       Thus an exact-baseline one-root cocycle with cumulative boundary B
       has `h=max_S(-B(S))`; bounded root debt is equivalent to every
       provider-closure cut `B(S)>=-O(1)`.  The two scalar buffer counts
       constrain none of these cuts.

       On the maximal functional private-transfer face this becomes a
       genuine unconditional absorber theorem.  If D is the current hole
       set, s(u) the transferable surplus at u, and c(u,v) the integral
       capacity of a serial-safe provider transport, then

         H*=max_(B subseteq P)
              (|D intersect B|-s(B)-c(P-B,B))_+.

       This is ordinary integral max-flow/min-cut.  It ceases to be a
       network projection when one repair choice independently consumes a
       shared low and a shared high socket.

       The first no-go is topology before payload.  For `d>=4,r>=2d+2`,
       put

         s=r-1-d, q0=C(r-2,d), p0=C(r-2,d-1),
         N=Q^circ_(r,d), T=floor(N/(s p0))+1,

       and take

         A0=q0 T, A_(r-1)=p0 T,
         A_(d-1)=A_(d+1)=N.

       This vector is balanced and meets the exact two-buffer threshold.
       Every decomposition into canonical uniform rotor packages and unit
       packages contains a core-free `g_(0,r-1)`.  All allowed packages
       obey `M_i=M_(i+1)` for `2<=i<d`.  In every deep internal-word block
       `c_2,...,c_(d-1)>=2`, no non-core package occurs; identical source /
       target prefix multisets and product domination force every selected
       edge to raw rotation.  Hence each rotation orbit of

         U2={c:c_i>=2, sum c_i=r}

       is a closed successor block in every canonical decomposition.  The
       number is at least

         kappa2 >= C(r-d-2,d)/(d+1),

       exponential at `r=3(d+1)`.  Together with the buffer complement,
       every successor cover has at least `kappa2+1` components.  These are
       literal zero-capacity subtour cuts, so no provider potential can
       telescope a merge tree that does not exist.

       The second no-go is an actual Boolean named-target boundary.  Take C
       disjoint-tag alternating `PH` common-core modules, each of length

         L=2 ceil((d+2)/2)>d+1

       and realizing `m=L/2` primitive `g_(d-1,d+1)` packages.  Their
       owners are `G+b+(d+1)` consecutive tags and their marked rank-(r-1)
       targets are the exact lower-q1 colours `G+b+d` consecutive tags.
       All `CL` targets initially have load one.  In any one-cycle
       reassembly of the retained sources, a module's tags form linear runs
       of lengths ell_i, so at most

         sum_i max(0,ell_i-d+1) <= L-d+1

       old colours survive.  Charging every noninternal provider to the
       literal outside-closure capacity B_out gives

         h >= C(d-1)-B_out.

       Consequently a merge-tree payload `Pi+E`, with Pi the root-minus-
       leaf component boundary, obeys

         ||Pi_-||_1 >= C(d-1)-B_out-||E_-||_1.

       Since `A_(d-1)=A_(d+1)=Cm`, choosing `Cm>=Q^circ` passes the exact
       scalar buffer hypotheses while bounded outside providers and bounded
       exceptional error force boundary `Omega(Cd)`, not `O(1)`.

       Scope is decisive.  The deep-fibre theorem concerns the explicit
       vector above, not the actual Ferrers inventory.  The Boolean theorem
       is a protected partial/source-retaining bank and does not prove that
       an unguarded global atlas has `B_out=O(1)`.  A live Ferrers-specific
       route must add both word-specific off-fibre circuit capacity and the
       provider-recycling cut expansion on the same selected packet.

2522R. The one-copy NRFC layer now has an exact Hall formulation, a sharp
       infinite multiplicity-one obstruction, and a sharp local buffered
       repair.

       For compatible positive age types `c,c'`, put
       `delta_i=c_i-c'_(i+1)`.  The full owner-changing literal partition
       graph is biregular with

         D^+=C(k-r+c_d,c_d) prod_(i<d)C(c_i,delta_i),
         D^-=C(k-r+c_d,c_d)
              c'_0!/[c_d! prod_(i<d)delta_i!].

       A fixed state's next owners form the exact terminal-star

         (T-D) union E,
         D subseteq C_d, E subseteq [k]-T, |D|=|E|,

       not a full Johnson ball.  Fixed owners at distance `t` admit a pair
       iff `t<=c_d`, with multiplicity

         (r-t)!/[(c_d-t)! prod c'_(i+1)! prod delta_i!].

       Hence full symmetry closes static role-to-owner assignment,
       one-step owner Hall, normalized complete-layer Hall, and every one
       rank separately.  It does not close their common section.  For a
       chosen one-state-per-owner exact-flag transversal `X`, a successor
       cycle cover exists iff

         |N^+(A) intersect X|>=|A|                  for every A subseteq X,

       equivalently iff its ordinary bipartite deficiency

         delta(X)=max_A (|A|-|N^+(A) intersect X|)

       is zero.  Choosing `X` simultaneously with its owner and nested
       named-target resources is OFHT, exactly the multiple-cycle NRFC gate.

       Complete-layer regularity cannot imply one copy.  For every
       `d>=2,K>=0`, the reciprocal pair

         (K+1,2,1,...,1) <-> (K+2,1,1,...,1)

       has no literal two-state cycle even with changing owners: the two
       recurrences force the target age-two cell empty.  Both separate
       layers and owner projections still pass their marginal Hall rows.
       A formal positive-age self-loop is likewise not a literal one-state
       loop.  This is consistent with item2520L's stronger frozen-inventory
       buffer obstruction.

       The primitive adjacent-buffer generator nevertheless has a sharp
       explicit local repair.  With `s=r-d>=2`, its types are

         P=(s-1,2,1,...,1),       H=(s,1,...,1).

       Any owner-simple component containing it has length at least `d+2`.
       Therefore one primitive needs at least `d` additional occurrences,
       regardless of type.  Equality is attained by

         S_0=G+{w},
         S_i=G+{b,v_i}, 1<=i<=d+1, |G|=s-2.

       The owners are the `d+2` distinct rank-r facets of one `(r+1)`-set,
       literal recurrence holds, and every marked rank has injective cyclic
       private-tag prefixes.  The exact unbuffered primitive multiplicity is
       `ceil((d+2)/2)`, realized by the alternating common-core word.

       Thus two extra low-buffer occurrences repair the `d=2` primitive,
       but two arbitrary extra buffers fail for every `d>=3`; there is no
       dimension-independent private-buffer conversion.  The Ferrers stock
       can pay the sharp `Theta(d)` local tax, but global facet packing into
       the prescribed residual named targets remains OFHT/NRFC.  No finite
       computation is used.

2520L. The two canonical aggregate rotor buffers now have a sharp integral
       fusion boundary.  For a uniform package `g_(a,b)`, positive permanent
       core `K=r-b-1>=1` makes the graph of raw rotation necklaces connected
       under legal crossed two-edge switches: adjacent unit transfers connect
       all positive compositions, and `K>=1` supplies exactly the crossing
       slack.  This is necklace-level supply only.  Ports may be reused, and
       owner, palette, upper, and common-cap rows are not automatic.  In
       particular every nontrivial package supplying the top role has `K=0`
       when `d<r-1`.

       The core-free boundary is quantitatively and structurally negative.
       Adding `t` arbitrary occurrences to the complete positive-composition
       bank before demanding one successor cycle obeys

         t >= ceil(kappa/(r+1))                    (kappa>1).

       More strongly, for every `d>=3` there is an explicit balanced
       two-buffer semigroup vector at `r=2d+2` satisfying

         A_(d-1),A_(d+1) >= Q^circ_(r,d)

       whose all-two age type is a forced singleton successor loop.  At
       `d=3,r=8` it is `(20,0,140,0,140,0,0,15)`.  For `d>=4` a second
       construction makes this independent of the decomposition into the
       canonical uniform rotor packages and canonical unit self-loops.  The
       exact obstruction is the product-order Hall system in every frozen
       internal-word fibre; this is an unlabelled age-type occurrence
       theorem, not a labelled-owner or guarded-arc theorem.

       Literal fusion is therefore a paired system: graphic spanning,
       injective low sockets, injective high sockets, all other resources,
       state-independent signed named loads, and serial safety.  Separate
       low/high Hall is false as a joint criterion: the minimal diagonal /
       off-diagonal `2x2` task catalogue passes both projected `K_(2,2)`
       systems and has no joint choice.  On the resource-private,
       payload-zero, serial-safe face, the exact positive theorem is simply
       connectivity of the contracted merge graph.

2521L. The NRFC connector target now has an exact bounded-debt formulation.
       For literal statewise palette deltas, a serial-safe component merge

         C_1,...,C_s -> E

       is a bounded-root cocycle when

         Delta = pi(E)-sum_i pi(C_i)+epsilon.

       Over any merge forest all internal component potentials cancel.  If
       `L` and `R` are its leaves and roots, then

         sum Delta = sum_(E in R)pi(E)-sum_(C in L)pi(C)+sum epsilon.

       Starting from complete protected palettes, terminal missing-colour
       debt is at most the negative `l_1` mass of this vector.  Thus a
       one-root merge tree with boundary debt `rho`, at most `b` exceptional
       macros, and error debt at most `beta` per exception has

         H_terminal <= rho+b beta,

       independently of the number of components.  A chronological variant
       writes `Delta_e=phi(t_e)-phi(s_e)+epsilon_e`.  If the serial list has
       `K` compatible port chains, its boundary is only their endpoints:

         H_terminal <= K max_(x,y)||(phi(y)-phi(x))_-||_1
                       + ||(sum epsilon)_-||_1.

       More sharply, with `||phi||_1<=P` it is bounded by `P` times total
       unmatched-port divergence plus residual debt.  Vanishing signed sums
       around every undirected port cycle are iff an exact zero-error port
       potential exists.

       These extra rows are necessary.  Resource-disjoint spanning-tree
       circuits that each lose one fresh ticket accumulate `c-1` holes.
       Even zero standalone debt does not compose: start each cyclic target
       at load two and let circuit `i` delete one provider of `t_i` and
       `t_(i+1)` while duplicating an already covered reservoir; every single
       audit passes, but the packet deletes both providers of every target.
       Full signed affected-centre closures, not Boolean safe/unsafe labels,
       must therefore be retained.

       The authenticated `k=17` rows calibrate exactly this relaxation.
       The strict-dual assignment `C6` preserves both immediate q1 palettes
       but has nonzero signed payload and leaves physical components
       `24293+17`.  The strict-dual `C12` makes `A` one voltage-15 cycle but
       leaves the physical `A^2` factor as two `12155`-cycles, with one
       missing quotient q1 orbit on each shore.  The non-dual `C16` makes one
       voltage-9 quotient cycle and hence one physical `24310`-cycle; rank10
       q1 is complete and rank7 debt is exactly

         {0x00e0f,0x01547}.

       These are alternative single-circuit outputs, not a serialized
       packet.  They certify one finite connected `H=2` outcome, not an
       all-k potential, NRFC age-cell lift, q2/deep-shadow row, residence,
       or common cap.  The exact all-parameter gate is a prospectively
       selected literal NRFC merge tree with bounded root cocycle (or only

       sharply scoped.  For `r>d>=1`, its formal nontrivial age-signature
       generators are

         g_(a,b)=C(b-a-1,d-a)e_a+C(b-a-1,d-a-1)e_b,
                                      0<=a<d<b<r,

       with exact resource identity

         (d-a)C(b-a-1,d-a)
          =(b-d)C(b-a-1,d-a-1).

       The adjacent coordinates `d-1,d+1` are genuine unit buffers.  After
       rounding a complete internal resource flow, the two residual buffer
       counts agree exactly; `g_(d-1,d+1)` closes them.  With standing
       `L>=H`, the explicit four-coordinate conductor

         min(A_(d-3),A_(d-2),A_(d-1),A_(d+1))>=Q_(r,d)+1

       is sufficient, where

         Q_(r,d)=sum_(u=2)^d u C(r-d+u-1,u+1).

       The canonical Ferrers/binomial vector clears this conductor for
       every `k>=31`.  The exact O3 replay, now hardened so the threshold is
       part of its exit condition, gives first pass23, failures at even
       24,26,28,30, last failure30, and no failure from31 through1000.
       First pass23 is therefore not a monotone threshold.  An independent
       analytic tail begins at `r=64`: `d<=ceil(sqrt r)`, every required
       buffer is at least `2^(2r-6)/r^(3/2)`, while
       `Q<r^2 2^(r-1)`.  Hence the finite range31..126 plus the tail proves
       the universal `k>=31` statement.

       The exact closed gate is only the integral AGE-TYPE/SIGNATURE
       quotient: the canonical residual rank-count vector is an exact
       integer sum of formal short/long/mixed rotor packages, of total
       type-occurrence mass `W`, with zero residue in every rank count.
       It is not a literal `W`-owner multicover.  The primitive mixed
       generator at `(r,d,a,b)=(4,2,1,3)` has type cycle

         (1,2,1)<->(2,1,1),        g_(1,3)=e_1+e_3,

       but any two-state same-owner labelled lift forces
       `C'_1=C_0=C_2`, contradicting disjoint nonempty age cells.  Thus the
       earlier fractional biregular lift may require multiplying the
       aggregate vector; denominator clearing does not prove one copy.

       The weakest remaining theorem is NRFC, Named Rotor Flag-Colouring.
       From some aggregate template `(U,c,J)`, `|U|=W`, choose a successor
       permutation `tau` allowed to rethread primitive packages; biject `U`

         C_(tau(u),i+1)=C_(u,i)-C_(tau(u),0);

       and biject every marked nested prefix to the prescribed residual

       Ore--Ryser completion, residence, upper/deep shadows and common cap

2515D. The complement-dual incidence face now has a dependency-clean
       odd-graph permutation and lattice theorem.  With

         H=C D^(-1) C,  A=C D,

       the matching D is exactly a directed one-factor of the 9-regular
       rank-nine quotient odd graph.  If p(a),n(a) are the incoming and
       outgoing overlap labels at owner a, then occurrencewise

         U(Ca)=C(a)+{p(a),n(a)},
         L(a)=a-{p(a),n(a)},
         C(L(a))=U(Ca).

       Thus rank7 and rank10 multiplicity ledgers are literal complementary
       copies.  The factor successor is A^2.  Hence a Hamilton A gives
       exactly two 715-owner quotient cycles; a connected complement-dual
       quotient factor is algebraically impossible.  If the A voltage is
       nonzero, these are exactly two physical cycles; zero voltage gives34.

       The direct odd-graph cycle lattice has rank5006 and full Z17 voltage
       image.  More precisely, for a D-matching circulation z and edge
       complement c, the support delta `(I+c)z` has rank5005 and zero
       voltage, whereas the oriented D-vs-H delta `(I-c)z` has rank5006,
       one Z/2 transfer defect, and voltage `2 omega(z)`.  Since2 is a unit
       modulo17, the oriented restricted face retains the full Z17 image.
       This distinction removes the apparent contradiction between
       complement cancellation and nonzero A^2 monodromy.

       D-alternating assignment circuits generate all endpoint matchings,
       but not the palette vector linearly.  A switch with changed tails X
       and old heads A(X) changes turns only on `X union A(X)` and is
       rank10-safe iff every exact provider row obeys

         mu_T-loss_T+gain_T >= 1.

       Therefore the rank10-valid Hamilton subface need not be connected by
       serial safe switches.  A surjective Hamilton A has exactly286 repeat
       occurrence units, not necessarily286 distinct repeated colours.
       One non-dual cross rectangle can merge the two parity cycles, but it
       must pass the exact four-ticket provider ledger and the joined
       nonzero-voltage row; the scalar repeat count alone does not prove a
       splice.  Rank10 Hamilton existence and this O(1) coloured rectangle
       are the sharp remaining gates of the lane.

2512L. The positive-density protected-extension gate now has its exact
       owner/lower-q1 min-cut and a sharp asymptotic counterexample.  If P
       is any prescribed simple degree-two incidence bank in the odd
       middle-level graph and Z is a fixed forbidden completion-edge set,
       put

         sigma_(P,Z)(C)=sum_U
           (d_C(U)+z_(L-C)(U)-n+2-p_C(U))_+,
         kappa_P(C)=sum_(x in C)(2-d_P(x)).

       Then P extends to a spanning two-factor avoiding Z iff

         delta_star(P,Z)=max_C(sigma_(P,Z)(C)-kappa_P(C))_+=0.

       This is exactly Ore--Ryser after deleting P and Z.  It is the
       smallest possible expansion hypothesis: necessary, sufficient and
       one b-flow/min-cut computation.  Pairwise owner/q1 disjointness does
       not imply it, even asymptotically.  Around one unused upper owner,
       n-1 vertex-disjoint two-edge paths use distinct lower owners and
       distinct paired-upper colours but saturate a near-complete lower star
       with no incidence back to its centre.  Their 2n-2 prescribed edges
       violate one cut by one in every dimension.

       The same note proves the all-group orbit-weighted Hall theorem,
       scopes coherent quotient lifts to one common phase and literal
       resource-private bundles, and supplies a free cyclic-displacement
       seed for one full template orbit.  Free rotation does not compress a
       split template law: multiplicities remain divisible by the orbit
       size, and varying stabilizers need weighted Hall plus separate coset
       topology.  Above the factor cut, a genuine polynomial integral face
       is laminar-resource matroid intersection with the contracted graphic
       matroid.  Its exact Edmonds row is

         r_lam(X)+r_gr(E-X)>=N.

       The forbidden set must be the same throughout; M0 is a spanning
       perfect matching; forced P1, exact connector count, component Hall,
       final residual matching, surviving arbitrary-width witnesses and one
       common trace-cap bank remain explicit hypotheses.  Nonlocal or
       selection-dependent cap conflicts are not encoded by a fixed Z.

       The input scope was corrected simultaneously: the complete stocked
       bank is O(kd), with Theta(kd) only in the long-path extreme, and the
       age theorem reserves marked row slots/owner roles rather than
       physical word positions.

2513L. The monotone-rotor fractional theorem is independently confirmed,
       but its integral scope has a sharp split verdict.  For r>=2 and
       1<=d<=r-1 every nondecreasing q in [0,1]^(r-1) with sum q<=d lies in
       the normalized same-owner fractional trace cone.  Long and mixed
       positive-composition rotors realize every vertex, with exact masses
       1/binom(b,d) and 1/binom(b-a,d-a).  The canonical left-filled Ferrers
       vector therefore has no invariant fractional trace obstruction.

       For the complete core-free positive-composition type set, however,
       every legal uniform successor is forced termwise to be cyclic block
       rotation.  Owner labels cannot connect distinct type necklaces.  If
       B is the mobile sum and L=d+1, their exact number is

         kappa(B,L)=1/L sum_(q|gcd(B,L))
           phi(q) binom(B/q-1,L/q-1).

       Replacing t positive-composition occurrences before demanding one
       legal successor cycle obeys

         t>=ceil(kappa/[2(r-d)])                  for kappa>1.

       This is an occurrence-edit floor.  It becomes a named-target lower
       bound only with private anchors/no cancellation.  Thus raw
       owner-changing connectors cannot fuse the core-free necklaces while
       disturbing only O(1) loads.

       Positive permanent core remains live.  Every arc used by a complete
       successor permutation has the split form

         a'=(a0+ad-t,t,a1,...,a_(d-1)),
         1<=t<=min(a0+ad-1,K+a0),

       so its exact gate is assignment plus subtour cuts.  In full literal
       scope the weakest integral theorem is one occurrence-labelled
       in/out-one system, every proper directed connectivity cut, all unit
       bundle resources and net named-load equations, plus delta_star=0 for
       a complete fixed guard catalogue.  At type level a connected
       circulation still needs an endpoint-state-conserving representative
       matching.  On a serial-safe macro catalogue this reduces to a
       resource-compatible spanning tree.  Zero/O(1) load disturbance
       therefore needs a payload-transparent spanning reservoir or explicit
       bounded cancellation; pairwise open-strand disjointness supplies
       neither.

2511R. The invariant fractional marked-trace gate is closed by an explicit
       all-parameter rotor theorem.  For every `k>=r>d>=1`, let

         M_(r,d)={q:0<=q_1<=...<=q_(r-1)<=1, sum_s q_s<=d}.

       If `ST_(k,r,d)` denotes the symmetric rank-mark projection of
       normalized nonnegative circulations on literal same-owner labelled
       age states, then

                              M_(r,d) subseteq ST_(k,r,d).

       The proof is complete and constructive.  In suffix-step coordinates
       the monotone polytope has only the zero vertex, the short vertices
       `v_a`, the long vertices `(d/b)v_b`, and the two-support vertices

         ((b-d)/(b-a))v_a+((d-a)/(b-a))v_b,
                              1<=a<d<b<=r-1.

       Short self-loops, cyclic positive-composition rotors, and their
       singleton-rail extensions realize these vertices with the displayed
       coefficients.  Convexity gives every monotone demand vector.

       The quotient-to-literal step is exact fractionally.  For adjacent
       types `c,c'`, a particular labelled pair is legal iff
       `C'_(i+1) subseteq C_i`; type compatibility is iff
       `c'_(i+1)<=c_i`.  The compatibility graph is biregular with

         N_c=r!/prod_i c_i!,
         D^+=prod_(i<d) binom(c_i,c'_(i+1)),
         D^-=c'_0!/[c_d! prod_(i<d)(c_i-c'_(i+1))!],
         N_c D^+=N_c' D^-.

       Weighting every labelled arc by `f_(c,c')/(N_cD^+)` therefore lifts
       every type circulation uniformly on every fixed owner.  Clearing
       denominators yields an integral marked multicover, not a one-copy
       owner chronology.

       For the optimal left-filled Ferrers boundary, with
       `r=ceil(k/2)`, `W=binom(k,r)`,
       `Lambda=sum_(s<r)binom(k,s)`, and minimal `d` satisfying
       `dW+binom(d+1,2)>=Lambda`, put
       `q_s=(binom(k,s)-b_s)/W` and `b_s=0` above the filled columns.
       Then `q in M_(r,d)` and the physical rank-s target load is exactly

             binom(k-s,r-s)q_s/binom(r,s)
                  =1-b_s/binom(k,s).

       Thus the unconditioned invariant fractional triangular/Ferrers
       trace gate is genuinely closed.  A tiny independent O3 replay checks
       6853 rotor legality and marginal instances; the labelled lift,
       vertex list, and Ferrers calculation were separately proved
       clean-room.  The finite checker is not evidence for those symbolic
       steps.

       Scope is decisive.  The theorem does not preserve prescribed
       actuator/donor rows as lower bounds, and does not give one-copy
       owners, an integral target SDR, owner-changing fusion, topology,
       residence, deeper shadows, or common cap.  The physical reservoir
       lane is therefore rebased: if the rotor realization is used directly,
       the first missing theorem is integral occurrence-labelled
       owner/target rotor fusion; after that remain Ore--Ryser spanning,
       residence/deep-shadow replay, and common-cap/compiler compatibility.

2510R. The higher-hole quotient algebra and the first genuinely physical
       stock layer are now separated exactly.

       First, beyond the canonical one-swap theorem of item2503MH, every
       normalized terminal profile

         A=([d+h-1]\H) union {r-1},
         H subset [d+h-2], |H|=h,

       has a count-neutral arbitrary-hole actuator.  Pair each retained high
       mark with a distinct low hole using `[d]` donors.  A base cycle and two
       parity sweeps avoid every adjacent-donor inequality, using at most
       `2d+1` age types and `3d+3` occurrence roles under only
       `d+h-1<=r-2`.  All types have nonempty oldest class.  The independent
       audit also corrects items2498MR/2500DH: their 97/101 uniqueness scans
       are exact only in the canonical leading-zero completion face.

       More importantly, the physical occurrence gate has a positive local
       theorem.  Any strict-positive legal age path of at most d transitions
       has a literal lift to distinct Johnson owners.  Pre-age one future
       deletion in each of the initial classes `d,d-1,...`; insert distinct
       fresh complement labels.  The resulting owner path has pairwise
       distinct rank-(r-1) intersections and rank-(r+1) unions.  This is an
       owner-membership statement, not source-letter residence.

       For Q such paths, define

         eta=(d+1)^2/C(k,r)+d^2/C(k,r-1)+d^2/C(k,r+1),
         theta=f_0(d+1)/C(k,r)+f_-d/C(k,r-1)+f_+d/C(k,r+1).

       Exact symmetric incidence counts plus greedy selection give mutually
       owner/lower/upper-disjoint lifts avoiding fixed banks whenever

         theta+(Q-1)eta<1.

       One arbitrary-hole packet cuts into at most three paths with total
       transition length at most3d.  In the odd middle-levels host its
       incidence bank has at most6d edges and maximum degree two.  Therefore
       the small protected-factor theorem embeds the complete open-body bank
       in a spanning owner/lower two-factor under

         k-r>=d,  6d<=r-2,  theta+2eta<1.

       This is the first unconditional protected placement of all O(d) local
       roles of one actuator packet.  It does not join the cut endpoints,
       impose source-letter residence, or preserve deep/common-cap guards.

       The same spread theorem stocks the complete canonical multiplicity
       bank at the owner/q1 level.  There are at most k bad rows and hence at
       most Q=3k cut paths.  In the triangular regime all three binomial
       denominators in eta are exponential, so for every polynomial fixed
       bank

         theta+(Q-1)eta=o(1).

       Thus all O(kd) open-strand occurrences can be chosen with distinct
       owners and both adjacent palettes.  What remains is not resource
       stock but common factor topology.  For their incidence bank P, put
       b(v)=2-d_P(v), G0=G-P.  Exact Ore--Ryser says P extends to a spanning
       protected two-factor iff, for every S on the lower shore,

         sum_(x in S)b(x)
          <=sum_y min{b(y),d_G0(y,S)}.

       This cut is automatic for the one-packet 6d bank, but is unproved for
       the full dispersed bank.

       All abstract base/parity cycles, with arbitrary multiplicity, fuse
       into one occurrence-distinguished age-type cycle by switches at their
       common D type.  This quotient fusion is not a physical switch: a
       nondegenerate Johnson C4 cannot preserve a strict lower-intersection
       palette.  A literal realization needs a colour-carrying C6/longer
       connector or a prospective global ordering.  The older zero-fill
       single-hole actuator has a separate exact obstruction: every retained
       empty-oldest-class occurrence must end a flat one-copy owner block, so
       U distinct copies force at least U-1 separator windows.  The new
       positive parity packet avoids that obstruction.

       The global orbit-compressed target now has exact cut criteria.  A seed
       packet has collision-free translates under Gamma iff, species by
       species, its resources are internally distinct, have trivial
       stabilizer and occupy distinct Gamma-orbits.  A unit-voltage guarded
       connector then concatenates all translates into one cycle.  After a
       Gamma-invariant forced common-cap matching is deleted, the residual
       matching exists iff its edge-orbit weights satisfy the per-vertex-
       orbit equations

         sum_eta d^L_(eta,O)w_eta=1,
         sum_eta d^R_(eta,O)w_eta=1.

       This is iff by averaging and bipartite matching integrality.  On a
       genuine two-matroid prepared face, a forced set F extends to a common
       basis iff

         min_X [r_(M1/F)(X)+r_(M2/F)((E-F)-X)]>=R-|F|.

       Separate common-cap and basis feasibility may be combined only on
       disjoint resources, when they describe the same completion, or with
       an explicit compatibility certificate.  The general grouped
       three-resource face is outside this two-matroid statement.

       Together with item2507RS, profile stock is closed.  The exact missing
       theorem is one guard-complete orbit-simple positive-age seed rail with
       generator endpoint voltage, a literal lower-palette-carrying join,
       source-letter residence/deep-witness replay, and the compatible
       quotient matching/rank cuts above.  No B(k)+O(1) conclusion is claimed.

2526R. OFHT now has a full-Ferrers terminal-rail Hall cut and a sharp
       anti-nibble theorem, and the proposed finite `k=17` rooted attachment
       model has been independently reconciled with literal phase semantics.

       Let `M_j` be the roles marked at rank `r-j`, and put
       `B_L=intersection_(j<=L) M_j`, where
       `L<=min(d,r-d-1)`.  Exact top rows and the two central-binomial ratio
       products give

         |B_L| >= W [1-L(L+1)(2L+1)/(6r)].

       In a strict positive-age template every state in `B_L` has its final
       `L` cells singleton.  A positive literal successor must copy the
       ordered preceding `L-1` cells and can lie over only the `k-r` external
       terminal-star owners.  After contracting any explicitly prepared
       full-source forced loops, this gives the exact cut

         delta(X) >= |A|-|R_L(A)|                 (A subseteq B_L).

       The full rail/complement cycle-cover test has the equivalent
       two-transversal-matroid form

         r_B(S)+r_C(S)>=|S|                       (S in head ground),

       where both ranks use the full literal recurrence; the owner/suffix
       rail graph is only a necessary supergraph.

       Under conditional `K`-spread inside every owner/type fibre, a rail
       state is nonisolated with probability at most

         mu_L=K(k-r)/(r)_(L-1).

       Hence, with probability at least `1-sqrt(mu_L)`, the exact Hall
       deficiency is at least `(1-sqrt(mu_L))|B_L|`.  At `L=3`, product
       selection has deficiency `(1-o(1))W` with high probability.  Any
       measure supported on genuine OFHT solutions must amplify some
       compatible successor slice over uniform by at least
       `(r)_(L-1)/(k-r)`.  This is not an OFHT counterexample: exact
       nested-target conditioning may create that chronology-first
       correlation.  It does rule out ownerwise and bounded-bias nibbles
       despite exponential buffer multiplicity.

       The concrete `k=17` specialization is sound with exact scope.  Its
       12,870 states are triples `(packet,owner orbit,aligned phase)`, not
       collapsed root/owner pairs.  A source has `8*9=72` raw phase-labelled
       successor candidates.  Exact common-root owner exchange plus all
       three rotated survivor inclusions is necessary and sufficient; the
       refresh equality is then redundant by complementation.  Selecting
       one state per packet/root and owner, and imposing both in/out
       equalities on arc variables, automatically makes the outgoing `H`
       incidences a second perfect matching.  Parallel alignments and legal
       nonzero-phase quotient self-loops must be retained for an unrestricted
       cycle-cover model.  A quotient component of voltage `Delta` lifts to
       `gcd(17,Delta)` physical cycles; zero voltage still gives exact
       one-copy owner/lower coverage in17 translates, while nonzero voltage
       is required only for one connected lift.  In a running gauge the wrap
       is voltage-twisted, `Q_end=rho^Delta Q_start`.

       This finite model closes only fixed-static lower flags, owners, and
       literal depth-three cycle-cover chronology.  Hamilton connectivity,
       upper shadows, opening, and compiler/common-cap rows remain separate.

       The authenticated rooted table `ad9e15f7...` has also now been fully
       replayed in this exact model and is solver-free infeasible: there are
       only912 root turns/7296 state arcs, with761/848 zero-out/zero-in roots,
       and packet-support matching530.  Root0
       `Q=255,type8,(C0,C1,C2)=(159,64,32)` has all nine attachment states
       at outdegree zero.  The model is therefore prospective for a changed
       static rooted partition, not live on the frozen certificate.

2536L. The capacity-one private-stutter supply gate from item2532L now has
       an exact collar/Hall/min-cut theorem and a sharp bounded-sidecar
       boundary.

       Let X^t be a literal age chronology and Xhat^t an individually legal
       same-neighbour alternative at center t.  A selected family is
       simultaneously literal, in every partial phase, iff each adjacent
       selected pair t,t+1 satisfies

         X_i^t triangle Xhat_i^t
             subset B_(t+1) intersect Bhat_(t+1)       (0<=i<d).

       This is exactly the missing fourth labelled transition.  Nonadjacent
       centers are automatically compatible.  On a passing family every
       phase is a Boolean cube, the next newborn masks the previous write,
       and every site's complete d-cell OR ray is invariant under every
       other toggle.  Thus no d-scale positional separation is needed.  The
       depth-one chronology A=(ab|c),X=(ac|b),A,X has two individually legal
       adjacent retimings to H=(bc|a), but their joint phase requires the
       false arc H->H; this is the minimal positive-cell warning.

       For a prescribed transfer path Q_0->...->Q_h, site selection on any
       independent chronology bank is exactly SDR Hall.  In one opened
       parity bank, h candidates per stage suffice; without parity, 3h-2
       candidate centers per stage suffice greedily.  Ordered interval menus
       [a_i,b_i] have the exact gap-two staircase

         rho_0=a_0, rho_i=max(a_i,rho_(i-1)+2)<=b_i.

       Extra unary guards reduce to a precedence DAG only with at most one
       selected writer per guarded resource and old/new/indifferent phase
       reads; acyclicity is then iff.  Multiple-writer guards retain their
       full order CSP.  Laminar supports alone do not prevent a two-cycle.

       The simultaneous compiler row is also exact.  Fix one complete cap
       state theta and a collar-compatible ray-disjoint site tuple P.  Delete
       its complete ray union D(P), pin Q_i to the old long cell lambda_i for
       1<=i<h, and put T_0=T-{Q_1,...,Q_h}.  Private serialization exists iff

         |N_theta(A)-D(P)| >= |A|                 (all A subset T_0).

       The residual matching plus the pins is the initial matching.  Toggle
       in path order and move Q_(i+1)'s edge from lambda_(i+1) to the newly
       changed lambda_i; the final lambda_(h-1) installs Q_h.  Conversely,
       deleting the stipulated pins from any such serialization gives the
       residual Hall matching.  With integral site variables y_ip and
       disjoint rays, the exact Benders rows are

         sum_(i,p) y_ip |R_p intersect N_theta(A)|
             <= |N_theta(A)|-|A|.

       They are combined with physical-center capacity, adjacent failed-
       cross conflicts, and the guard order.  A max-flow oracle separates
       the Hall rows.  The state theta must be common; Hall in a union of cap
       graphs is unsound.  Interval target neighborhoods reduce the cuts to
       cell intervals, and laminar target neighborhoods reduce them to the
       laminar members.

       Two bounded-sidecar faces are now proof-safe.  If all candidate rays
       lie in one residual-coindependent cell bank and the site lists have an
       SDR in a transparent chronology bank, h chosen stutters give the
       whole serialization with at most hd compiler occurrence cells.  For
       one fixed matching M, the occurrence-state relocation network has
       root sites at free ports, unique continuation through M(q), and holes
       as sinks.  H simultaneous background-fixed augmentations exist iff
       its node-capacitated maxflow is H.  If the paths have length at most
       L, the source sidecar uses at most HL stutters.  Precompiled bounded
       macros admit Rado selection only when their full compatibility is an
       independently certified laminar matroid; laminar physical intervals
       alone are not such a matroid.

       All three qualifications are necessary.  Two rays can each preserve
       compiler Hall but jointly overload one cut.  Feasible ray packets
       violate matroid augmentation already on two target rows.  Finally an
       explicit literal d=1 rank-three chain q_i={c,i}, with a doubled X_0
       provider/root occurrence, has min-cut one and a reachable terminal
       hole but a unique N-site relocation path.  Hence even H=1 has no O(1)
       sidecar consequence without bounded route depth.  The live all-k gate
       is now precisely a positive menu inside one coindependent reserve, or
       a bounded-depth fixed-matching relocation flow.  No B(k)+O(1)
       conclusion is claimed.

2538K. The complete all-high local-order atlas has exact integral
       chain-correlated rounding, but an arbitrary bounded robust pin bank
       separates marked coverage from balanced suffix multiplicities.

       Let L_j=C([2m+1],m-j), and let

         rho_j=|L_0|/|L_j|
              =C(m+j+1,j)/C(m,j).

       Uniform deletion is a feasible flow in the layered Boolean
       containment network.  Splitting every target node and imposing the
       integral bounds floor(rho_j),ceil(rho_j) makes the network integral;
       hence one can choose one full order path at every root and realize
       those floor/ceiling loads simultaneously at every depth.

       Prepared flags have the exact residual max-flow criterion obtained by
       subtracting their node loads from those bounds.  Balanced completion
       is not automatic.  For p_i=S+{a_i}, i=1,2,3, one common robust order
       beginning a_1,a_2,a_3,s_1,... makes all three flags share

         T_j=S-{s_1,...,s_(j-1)}

       at every positive depth.  Whenever

         j(j+1)<(m-j+1)log 2,

       rho_j<2, so the allowed cap is2 and the pinned load is3.  This gives
       Omega(min(d,sqrt(m))) unavoidable balanced-load excess and rules out
       an O(1) balanced-defect theorem for arbitrary common-order pins.

       Marked one-copy coverage nevertheless stays exact.  For every
       nonempty A subset L_1, Lovasz--Kruskal--Katona gives

         |N(A)| >= |A|+m+1.

       Thus deleting h<=m+1 prepared roots leaves Hall.  Match all L_1
       targets to flexible roots, then propagate the resulting token
       multiplicities downward using normalized matching.  Every lower
       target occurs at least once, and the prepared flags remain fixed.

       This complete/adaptive atlas may use W-h+1 orders.  It does not round
       the support-optimal random global-order menu or preserve owner/turn
       Hall.  A literal two-rank determinant-two path minor shows that
       fractional marginals and separate rankwise SCD matchings do not
       synchronize by TU; it is not a no-go for the full sampled menu,
       whose extra root-order columns may repair the minor.  The exact live
       gate is a sampled-menu path-splicing/absorber theorem compatible with
       owner/turn Hall.

       There is a separate turn-interface quantifier gap.  An ordered-shift
       candidate from a prepared tail p to q_beta uses the prepared order at
       both roots.  If the first d-1 labels of q_beta in its selected mixed
       order are w_1,...,w_(d-1), survival is equivalent to

         w_1=z_2,...,w_(d-2)=z_(d-1),
         w_(d-1) in {z_d,...,z_m}.

       Only m-d+1 of the (m)_(d-1) head prefixes work.  Under independently
       uniform head orders, the expected retained list at one prepared tail
       is at most

         (m+1)(m-d+1)/(m)_(d-1),

       which is O(1) at d=3 and tends to zero for fixed d>=4.  Thus fixing
       O(1) prepared tails does not transport the complete-table Omega(m)
       portal lists into the final mixed selector.  One must freeze many
       heads or prove cross-order head robustness in the final table.

       The complete/adaptive atlas can rigorously take the first option.
       For t task tails put

         R0=m+1-(t-1)d,
         ell0=min(R0,floor((m+1-t)/t)).

       Freeze ell0 certified head roots per tail to the same prepared order.
       The whole tail-plus-head bank has at most t+t ell0<=m+1 roots, so the
       sharp protected chain theorem still completes every marked suffix
       row exactly.  Every task tail has ell0 literal ordered-shift turns
       with pair-codegree one; after any b foreign rows, at least ell0-b
       survive.  For fixed t, d=O(sqrt(m)), b=O(d), this is a linear robust
       portal list.  This closes the prepared tail-list interface in the
       complete atlas at the cost of a linear frozen-head halo.  It does not
       place the residual paths inside the small sampled menu or prove
       residual fractional turn Hall.

2539K. The symmetric-chain collapse of the unrestricted all-high selector
       is independently audited and sound for the exact marked selector LP.
       Every symmetric chain of B_(2m+1) has a unique rank-m root.  Reading
       it downward supplies that root's deletion word; arbitrary remaining
       deletions below a short chain are legal and are left unmarked.  Since
       the SCD partitions every high level, each target at every rank
       m-1,...,m-d+1 is marked exactly once.  The optional rows
       y_(f,j)<=x_f are load-bearing: this is not a theorem that all physical
       suffix occurrences have uniform multiplicity.

       Bounded prepared flags are also closed at selector level without
       extending one literal SCD.  Lovasz--Kruskal--Katona gives

         |partial^+ X| >= |X|+2m+1-r

       for every nonempty rank-(r-1) family X.  Hence any h<=m+1 arbitrary
       prescribed root flags may be quarantined unmarked while a flexible
       chain forest covers every high target once.  For occurrence-labelled
       forced variables y_(f_i,j)=1 in the same range, the exact condition is
       target injectivity: transfer each unique target mark from its flexible
       provider to the prescribed occurrence.  Fully marked prefixes from
       distinct roots are therefore feasible exactly when they are pairwise
       vertex-disjoint; two such prefixes cannot concatenate.

       Descending-linear-forest compatibility belongs to the different
       unlabelled edge-set factor problem.  At every interface the exact
       condition is a prescribed matching plus residual Hall; for at most
       m+1 saturated fragments, strict shadow surplus makes residual Hall
       automatic, and arbitrary unlabelled fragments may concatenate.
       The threshold is sharp: m+2 pairwise disjoint marked root edges can
       occupy every provider of one rank-(m-1) target.  Thus the remaining
       object is a transition-compatible protected selector, not an SCD
       existence theorem.

       The SCD does not place its paths in the small random global-order
       support atlas and does not imply legal successor turns, balanced
       owner/root flow, Euler topology, upper shadows, or residence.  It also
       does not cure the distinct balanced-unmarked face: three common-order
       pins force cap excess on Theta(min(d,sqrt m)) ranks.  Finally, robust
       ordered-shift portals require the prepared order at both tail and
       head, so fixing O(1) tails alone does not transport the linear list.
       No O(1) word bound follows from the SCD or fractional marginals.
