2540H3. Portal-first selection closes the raw graphic-scattering row but
        does not close the protected upper-exact host.  Under one coordinate
        order, ordered shifts and monotone pivots strictly increase the
        coordinate-sum potential.  With distinct tails they form a forest on
        the unmerged SCD chains; for a bounded robust bank, Hall selects
        distinct heads outside every task tail, making the bank a raw-chain
        matching.  In a literal allowed merger graph G, a selected forest A
        extends exactly when G/A is connected.  This is the precise positive
        effect of choosing portals before contraction.

        The SCD selector collapse removes another apparent obstruction.  If
        both endpoints of every chosen ordered-shift portal are frozen to the
        same prepared order, the turns remain legal.  The protected SCD
        selector quarantines these 2h endpoint flags and still marks every
        high target exactly once whenever 2h<=m+1.  It does not make the
        flexible flags into a balanced legal turn factor.

        A raw Johnson portal is not automatically a canonical GMN pull label.
        A literal lift must identify the alternating C6, all old/new
        incidences, all six external stubs, tail/head/upper roles, collar
        ages and every protected OR occurrence.  Edge-disjoint pulls may
        share a lower turn; their generic mixed colour difference

          [L+c+d]-[L+b+c]-[L+a+d]+[L+a+b]

        is nonzero.  Hence uncoloured pull forestness does not preserve
        immediate palettes or a complete upper witness deck.  Within a
        hereditarily transparent labelled bank, the exact pull finish is
        again connectivity after contraction.  After an upper-exact rooted
        Catalan forest is supplied, the exact rooted chronology finish is
        ordinary Hall on free component ports after deleting the protected
        source's incoming copy, together with acyclicity.

        The canonical lexical Mütze/GMN route is sharply impossible for this
        upper-exact task from m=12 onward.  With r=m-1 its base misses

          M_r=W_r(r-2)(r-3)/(2(r+2)(2r-1))

        immediate-upper colours.  A pull changes at most three turn values
        and a pull tree uses at most Cat_r-1 pulls, leaving

          M_r-3(Cat_r-1)>0

        holes for every r>=11, exactly1941 at the threshold.  Prescribing a
        portal forest or opening the final cycle cannot improve this.  The
        surviving route is a jointly selected nonlexical (M0,Q0,J): protected
        phase, upper-exact Catalan forest, acyclic rooted-Hall connector
        reservoir, and hereditary palette/collar/OR-token transparency.
        Compiler, lower, common-cap, exterior residence/regeneration and an
        additive-constant conclusion remain outside scope.

         A_delta/A_(delta+1) >= rho,

2542C. Exact age-fibre synchronization now has a sharp state-complexity
       boundary.  For a partial initial fibre F and collar B_1,...,B_q,
       legality is equivalent to hitting by time t every coordinate whose
       possible initial age exceeds d-t; the terminal state is common iff
       every unhit coordinate has F-constant initial age.  A static type
       with p positive age blocks needs p-1 distinct nested boundaries for
       a unique-fibre address, so a fully positive reset needs all d.

       Along a simple Johnson collar

         T_t=T_(t-1)-alpha_t+beta_t,

       the first min(q,d+1) departures satisfy

         alpha_t in C_(d-t+1).

       Fresh entrants cannot mature quickly enough.  Thus d+1 continuous
       owner changes require a protected departure queue through
       C_d,...,C_0.  This is an unavoidable Omega(d) interface-state cost,
       but not an Omega(d) additive-length cost: a nonflat carrier can spend
       the transitions on distinct owners.  The smallest surviving
       synchronizer is therefore a rolling guarded reset which refreshes
       every unfixed coordinate while consuming and regenerating that queue,
       preserving upper palettes and the terminal occurrence matching.

2543L. The item2536L compiler-supply row now has an exact strict-gammoid
       formulation and a sharp positive Boolean root-slot face.

       For one fixed complete cap state theta, let M_theta be the
       transversal matroid on compiler cells.  A cell deletion set D
       preserves a target-saturating compiler matching iff

         r_(M_theta^*)(D)=|D|.

       Thus safe deletions are exactly a strict gammoid.  Its girth is

         1+min_(empty!=A subset T)(|N_theta(A)|-|A|),

       so this is an occurrence-labelled Hall/linkage theorem, not scalar
       capacity.  At depth one, task selection is exact matroid
       intersection after the candidate-to-cell pullback.  Raw multi-cell
       ray packets remain nonmatroidal.

       On the rank-separated Boolean root-slot graph, put one cell(q,j) at
       every rank-m root q and depth j, adjacent to every rank-(m-j) subset
       of q.  Deleting every slot above any root bank P with

         |P|<=m+1

       preserves all rank layers simultaneously.  Indeed layer j survives
       any D_j-1 deleted roots, D_j=binom(m+j+1,j), and
       min_j(D_j-1)=m+1.  This uniform threshold is sharp: the m+2 roots
       over one rank-(m-1) facet isolate it.

       The exact physical lift is now explicit.  One common cap state must
       contain disjoint trace-guarded root-slot injections at every depth;
       non-Boolean targets need one ray-disjoint fixed matching; and every
       candidate ray may meet slots only above a declared hazard-root set.
       Then the whole ray bank is coindependent whenever

         |P_0 union union_p H(p)|<=m+1.

       For H task lists of size L_0, hazard width a, preblocked count h_0
       and full cross-task conflict degree Delta, each list retains

         ell=floor min{
               L_0/[1+Delta(H-1)],
               (m+1-h_0)/(aH)
             }

       options such that every one-per-task choice is collar-compatible
       and the union of all option rays is compiler-coindependent.  This is
       nonempty under the corresponding two unit inequalities and is
       Theta_H(m) for the ordered-flag scale, conditional on a nonadjacent
       chronology planting (or another bounded failed-cross row) and the
       width-one physical stutter lift.

       The static prospective version is unconditional and stronger than
       separate rankwise surplus: plant H tails and

         ell_stat=floor min{
           [m+1-(H-1)d-b]/[1+3(H-1)^2],
           (m+1-H)/H
         }

       resource-compatible ordered heads per tail, freeze them on at most
       m+1 roots, then complete the flexible flag atlas.  Every lower target
       is assigned to a flexible occurrence, so the entire prepared flag
       bank is coindependent in the static occurrence matroid.  This does
       not yet identify an ordered owner transition with a same-neighbour
       stutter or put it in one transition-compatible physical cap state.
       Also, the known 3(H-1) bound is only a resource-conflict bound;
       chronology centers must be supplied separately.

       A cut-complete laminar compiler gives a second exact face:

         sum_p |R_p intersect J|
            <= |J|-#{t:N(t) subset J}.

       If every coefficient is 0/1 and the induced site sets are laminar,
       these are a laminar matroid and Rado is exact.  For an uncontracted
       depth-d>1 ray the full cell cut has coefficient d, so this criterion
       normally requires packet contraction, depth one, or one cell per
       branch.

       Finally, rank surplus cannot replace occurrence depth.  A literal
       depth-one declared catalogue on k=2m+1 has nonadjacent,
       occurrence-private sites and distinct site owners, yet its fixed-M
       relocation network is the unique path

         q_0 -> q_1 -> ... -> q_(m+2).

       It embeds under k->k+2 and grows by one site, despite the ambient
       m+1 protected root surplus; q_0 and q_(m+2) are even
       Johnson-adjacent.  The example does not claim privacy of the doubled
       root provider or exhaust all ambient legal sites.  The exact positive
       recursive state is a constant-height occurrence funnel (ordinary
       gammoid/maxflow) or the more general bounded disjoint-path predicate
       with a zero-stretch child injection robust to every child deletion.
       One compulsory site per lift accumulates linearly.

       Hence the supply theorem is genuinely positive on the static and
       root-slot faces, but the transition-compatible root-slot/stutter lift
       or a zero-stretch occurrence funnel remains open.  No O(1) sidecar or
       B(k)+O(1) conclusion is claimed.

       with optimal guard-state size and no duplicate-owner cost.  Put
       n=d+1, choose disjoint K,L={lambda_1,...,lambda_n},

         K+lambda_1,...,K+lambda_n,

       the 2n private letters.  They are 2n distinct rank-r sets forming a
       simple Johnson cycle.  Their adjacent intersections and unions are
       the cyclic intervals of lengths n-1 and n+1, so both immediate

       exactly n=d+1; K is permanent.

       and exports the identical rho queue.  The L half regenerates the

       lambda_n->rho_n step consumes C_0 and lets rho_1 mature to age d.
       Thus this is the queue-complete one-step extension of the pivot
       normal form, not literally the same d-step packet.

2545B. The established SCD of the cyclic quotient Boolean poset gives a
       common integral point for exact high-target selection and all
       coordinatewise flag-flux rows.  For n=2m+1 the rotation action on
       rank-m roots is free.  Every quotient symmetric chain has one
       rank-m root orbit.  Choose coherent nested representatives down its
       high segment, extend short chains unmarked, and translate the whole
       flag through all n rotations.

       This uses every named root once and gives, for every deletion
       position j and coordinate x,

         H_j(x)=binom(2m+1,m)/(2m+1)=Cat_m.

       Every lower target orbit belongs to one quotient chain.  If its
       stabilizer has size h, every named target is offered h times; mark
       one occurrence and leave h-1 unmarked.  Thus every named high target
       is marked once despite periodic lower necklaces.

       At depth d=3 the rail states are single coordinates, so these uniform
       positional marginals are the full rail-balance equation, not merely
       a necessary projection.  All state graphs are rotationally
       isomorphic.  In the representative graph G_0, colour a legal edge by
       its rank-(m+1) owner orbit.  Those owner orbits are also free and
       number Cat_m.  A rainbow perfect matching in G_0 is therefore
       equivalent to a rotation-equivariant owner-exact cycle cover.  For
       k=17 this is one1430x1430 quotient rainbow matching.

       The older necklace obstruction only forbids within-orbit Johnson
       turns; this theorem requires cross-orbit Hall and does not contradict
       it.  The direct full-age SCD obstruction also remains: only the high
       slab is solved.  Statewise Hall/rainbow, component voltage, lower

       theorem balances positional histograms but not complete ordered

2546S. A fixed static connector expander cannot supply the protected portal
       theorem, even outside the canonical lexical factor.  At one physical
       factor turn, arbitrary subset compatibility makes all reachable
       incidence pairs an affine binary space of constant weight two.  Such
       a space has at most four members.  Hence a root-faithful Cartesian
       connector host has root degree at most three; even requiring only
       every complete spanning tree to lift forces a root-local cut of size
       at most four.  A bounded number of physical sockets leaves a constant
       bound (at most 4^s-1), so no fixed C6/C10/even-circuit host of this
       kind has connectivity omega(d).

       The viable non-Cartesian quantifier order has an exact positive
       reservoir.  For any perfect containment matching M_0 between the two
       equal middle shores, the free-port graph

         L_out -> K_in iff L subset M_0(K), L!=K

       is (m-1)-regular on both shores and decomposes into m-1 perfect
       matchings.  Its arcs are alternative columns, not simultaneously
       toggleable circuit-star edges.  Bounded protected port deletion
       causes only bounded ordinary matching deficiency.  The live theorem
       is therefore a jointly selected nonlexical (M_0,Q_0,J): an upper-
       exact rooted Catalan forest followed by one acyclic free-port matching
       satisfying the contracted Hall cuts.  Static edge connectivity is
       the wrong robustness scalar.

       always matchable except for the unique t=1 diagonal.  Hence every
       fixed-table statewise Hall row is TU; there is no fractional/integral
       gap there.  Prepared turns extend iff the same residual capacitated
       Hall cuts pass after deleting their resources.  A margin-h version
       gives a concrete robust sufficient condition.

       Globally, choosing the flags is exactly a root-coloured circulation
       on nodes (ordered rail, bottom core): one arc (f,beta) per root,
       exact node balance, exact high-suffix marks, and the degree-one
       diagonal guard.  The complete Boolean host has a symmetric common
       fractional point satisfying roots, literal turns, every high suffix

       A literal depth-four two-option face on one free root orbit has flags

         f_t=(q_t;t,t+1,t+3),  g_t=(q_t;t,t+2,t+3).

       root-plus-rail matrix is nonintegral on a restricted Boolean atlas;

       For a fixed table, owner-exact chronology is exactly a common base

2553M. The proposed complement-list regularization of the depth-three
       punctured-containment blocks has an exact Steiner characterization
       and an infinite parity obstruction.  Put v=2m-1 and k=m-2.  If a
       proper Johnson colouring assigns every k-set A a colour c(A) outside
       A, then for each colour x the class

         F_x={A:c(A)=x}

       is a (k-1)-packing on V-{x}.  Counting (k-1)-subsets gives

         k|F_x| <= C(v-1,k-1).

       Summing over all v colours is equality identically, so every class
       must attain equality: F_x is a Steiner system S(k-1,k,v-1), and the
       v pointed systems partition all k-sets.  Conversely such a pointed
       Steiner decomposition gives exactly the required colouring.

       A fixed (k-2)-subset would lie in (m+2)/2 blocks.  Hence the colouring
       is impossible for every odd m>=5; m=5 already demands the nonexistent
       S(2,3,8).  The m=3 derangement and m=4 midpoint/perfect-matching
       examples are the first positive calibrations.  The full divisibility
       family is j | C(m+j,j-1).  At the target k=17 semirank m=8, the j=6
       block count is C(14,5)/6=1001/3, so this regular face is impossible
       there too.  A Steiner S(k,k+1,v) gives a sufficient lift; the Fano
       S(2,3,7) and Witt S(4,5,11) explain m=4,6.  This kills only that
       uniform complement-list route to block regularity.  It does not
       refute nonregular Hall blocks, functional attachment, or the full
       quotient co-design master.

       hex fan.  Write

         e_right=(L,U,E=L+d,F=L+a),

         U=L+a+d.

       A fan option (b,c), with b in L and c outside U, has old-pair tail
       set

         T_right(b,c)={U-b, L-b+c+d}.

       A reverse option (b',c') has

         T_left(b',c')={U-b', L-b'+c'+a}.

       The first member cannot cross-match the other's second member,

       First-to-first equality forces b=b'; equality of the remaining sets
       would give {c,d}={c',a}, impossible because d and a are the distinct
       members lying in U-L.  Thus the typed tail sets never agree.

       while every other resource is held fixed.  This removes all
       (m-1)^4 pairs only from that zero-extra-quarantine face.

2566R. Bare linearization of the complete-reversal reset packet has a
       uniform quadratic collateral family.  In the sharp-coordinate
       normalization, its maximal depth-d antecedent is the explicit
       four-block rank-(d+1) Johnson cycle

         delta+C -> ... -> delta+X,
         X+u_1,...,X+u_d,
         alpha+X -> ... -> alpha+C,
         C+y_1,...,C+y_d.

       Every coordinate enters exactly once.  The x and c labels have
       positive source runs 2d+1, alpha and delta have runs d+1, and u,y
       are singletons.  Hence every preceding zero run has length at least
       2d+1.

       It follows that every cyclic source interval of width w<=2d has a
       globally unique OR-value, of rank r-d+w-1.  At any cut exactly w-1
       such width-w intervals cross.  Therefore every linearization loses

         sum_(w=2)^(2d) (w-1) = d(2d-1)

       distinct values with no other internal cyclic witness.  This is
       Theta(d^2)=Theta(k), so there is no internally safe cut and no O(1)
       internal residual.  A protected global host must duplicate this
       explicit rank-graded family, reflect the exterior socket, or use a
       compensating packet.  The theorem does not say the values lack
       witnesses elsewhere in a spanning carrier.

       An independent H100 O3 census of every cut for d=1..30 finds the
       stronger finite pattern

         min lost = d(7d+1)/2,
         max lost = d(7d+3)/2,

       with 2d minimum cuts, 2d+2 maximum cuts, and no safe cut.  These full
       formulas are retained as exact finite evidence; only the uniform
       d(2d-1) short-family bound is promoted as an all-d theorem.

       For one packet let M=4d+2 and protect its M roots, M lower-q1

       a footprint matching of size at least

         ceil(N_min/[3M^2]),
         N_min=min_{s=r-1,r,r+1} binom(k,s).

       The exact harmonic greedy bound is

         floor(1/[M^2(sum_s 1/binom(k,s))])+1.

       For k=17,r=8,d=3 the two bounds are 34 and 39.  At
       k=2m+1,r=m,d<=c sqrt(m), this is

       simultaneous factor planting nor deep/compiler guards.

       The isometric-wreath law also gives a long-return edit floor.  If G
       differs from a wreath factor G0 in J owner edges, then G has at most
       (2d+1)J length-(2d+1) paths with Johnson-adjacent endpoints.  Hence
       h distinct resident return packets require J>=h/(2d+1).  The floor
       is sub-Catalan at d=Theta(sqrt(m)); correlated factor extension,
       rather than scalar edit count, is the real gate.

       A common-undirected host is a useful stronger interface for a local
       phase switch against a frozen exterior.  If both phases induce the
       same connected undirected path/cycle and disagree on one packet edge,
       orientation rigidity forces complete reversal of the entire touched
       component.  One one-phase residence audit then transports every
       packet--ambient crossing interval, every derivative inventory and
       every phasewise compiler matching.  It transports addresses; it does
       not give one literal fixed-address common cap.

       The authoritative global-reversal quotient theorem weakens the
       existential same-parity interface further.  A complete child
       certificate consists of its source/owner chronology, physical host,
       all upper witnesses, final opening, occurrence-labelled compiler,
       endpoint data and guards.  If the induction state and transition are
       closed under simultaneous reversal of all those objects, then

         [H0]=[H3],  [H1]=[H2].

       It is enough to construct one oriented complete child and reflect
       the entire certificate.  The compiler graphs and predecessor
       gammoids are isomorphic, so no matching in G+ intersection G-, no
       fixed-address common cap and no common phase basis are required.
       Nor must both phases be planted simultaneously on one common
       undirected host.  These common rows survive only for a local packet
       reversal, a named one-sided socket, or relative phases among several
       components/packets.

       The obvious two-edge component splice is unavailable on the
       squarefree upper-q1 face.  If old edges ab,cd have distinct unions
       U1,U2 and cross edges ad,cb preserve {U1,U2}, then b,d (or a,c)
       are two rank-r subsets of U1 intersection U2, forcing a degenerate
       equality.  An exact connector therefore needs support at least 3 or
       a globally compensated palette change.

       The one-packet incidence-degree row is independently closed:
       opening one packet edge has a phase-common q1 two-factor host for
       m_ML>=8d+4.  It does not force upper surjectivity, few components,
       residual residence or compiler feasibility.  Item2567M separately
       closes only the marginal second-facet projection, not the rooted

         M0(psi(R) intersection phi(R))=psi(R)

       for every R, with the induced lower colours, rooted tails and heads
       all injective and the arcs psi(R)->phi(R) graphic-acyclic.  It also
       does not close arbitrary-width upper rows.

       linearization loses at least d(2d-1) internally unique cyclic OR
       values.  Whole-component reversal makes that debt phase-symmetric
       but does not repay it; the exterior must be reflected or provide
       ambient duplicate witnesses.

       In the reversal-quotient lane the remaining rows are: one-oriented
       upper-aware/low-component packet planting; one-oriented exact
       topology/opening; repayment of the explicit cut family; one complete
       upper-witness bank and one compiler matching; and orbit-total Pascal
       regeneration.  The support>=3 bound still applies to any exact
       palette-preserving topology join, but common-undirected two-phase
       realization is not required.  Global reversal removes only one
       global phase bit.  For individually fixed component labels this is
       epsilon->epsilon+1 and leaves c-1 relative bits.  If reversal
       permutes components by an involution P, the action is instead
       epsilon->1+P epsilon; its orbits still have size at most two but the

       repair holes, matching deficiency, component count or cut collateral.

       The minimal multi-copy Pascal interface is an occurrence-labelled
       boundary torsor.  If copy orientations satisfy
       epsilon_u+epsilon_v=b_e on the gluing graph, a joint orientation
       exists iff every cycle has XOR sum zero; named one-sided sockets are
       unary constraints and must agree under path propagation.  Thus a

2568L. The opened-reset exterior safe-cut conjecture is false without an
       explicit compensation bank.  For the component containing the
       phase-common packet path, let `K` be the legal cut gaps and, for each
       old arbitrary-width target `S`, let

         B_S = K intersection (intersection of the internal-gap sets of
                 every packet-avoiding old witness of S),

       with `B_S=K` if no such witness exists.  The exact least casualty
       count is

         b* = min_(c in K) #{S : c in B_S}.

       Equivalently a <=b cut exists iff `K` is not covered by the union of
       all `(b+1)`-fold blocker intersections.  Whole-component reversal
       only reads each surviving undirected arc backwards, so orientation
       cannot improve this row.  The sharp conditional selector is

         b* <= floor((sum_S |B_S|)/|K|).

       In particular, two gap-disjoint packet-avoiding witnesses outside an
       exceptional bank make every cut safe for the nonexceptional targets.
       The phase-common q1 factor supplies no such blocker-dispersion bound.

       Item2566R gives the unconditional source-row compensation floor.  For
       each packet seam `s`, its forced family `L_s` has

         |L_s| = d(2d-1),
         #{T in L_s : rank(T)=r-d+t} = t,  1<=t<=2d-1.

       With complete ambient witness cores `B_(s,T)` and admissible exterior
       cuts `K_s`, the exact optimum is

         beta* = min_s min_(c in K_s)
                   #{T in L_s : c in B_(s,T)}.

       If no ambient witness exists, every core is `K_s` and
       `beta*=d(2d-1)`.  Thus neither a better seam nor the opposite
       orientation gives `O(1)`.  The absolute payment modes are a
       rank-graded ambient duplicate/compensating/new-join bank, or a
       nonlinear cyclic contraction which postpones payment until its
       eventual opening.  Reversal of the complete chronology transports an
       already paid certificate; it is not a third payment mode.

       This is an upper/source witness theorem only.  Endpoint run-age
       inequalities remain the residence row.  A fixed-word duplicate
       occurrence does not by itself give a compiler/cap.  Quotient induction
       needs one oriented compiler and cap, then reflects them; intersection
       Hall remains only for a literal local switch against frozen addresses.
       The independent proof audit passes these scope separations and
       explicitly specializes the ML host to `r=m,k=2m-1`.

2569L. Lane L is rebased on the global-reversal quotient, superseding the
       fixed-address compiler rider in item2568L for existential same-parity
       induction.  Build one complete oriented child state: source and owner
       chronology, complete upper-witness bank, residence-valid opening,
       occurrence-labelled compiler matching and cap, ordered endpoints, and
       every named guard/sidecar.  Reflecting this whole tuple gives the
       opposite representative bijectively.  Therefore

         H0 ~ H3,   H1 ~ H2

       in the quotient, and no matching in `G+ intersection G-`, no
       same-address cap, and no phase-common exterior witness locations are
       required.  One matching in `G+` and one nonempty oriented cap suffice;
       their addresses reflect to `G-`.

       The exterior blocker and all-cut compensation theorems are unchanged.

         K- = R(K+),   B-_S = R(B+_S),   D-(R(c))=D+(c),

       so it adds neither a constraint nor a gain.  For one oriented host,

         b* = min_(c in K+) #{S:c in B+_S},

       and the source payload still has exact optimum

         beta* = min_s min_(c in K+_s)
                   #{T in L_s:c in B+_(s,T)}.

       With no ambient/new-join compensation this is `d(2d-1)`, with `t`
       targets at rank `r-d+t` for `1<=t<=2d-1`.  Global reversal copies
       the paid or unpaid ledger; it never pays it.  A direct one-oriented
       terminal construction may use new join witnesses instead, but must
       certify them before reflection.

       The exact quotient hypothesis is reversal closure of the full state,
       transition equivariance, orbit-totality for at least one
       representative, and invariant charged debt.  Prefix/suffix banks,
       endpoint ages, ordered sockets and fresh-coordinate names must be
       reflected/swapped with the state.  A named one-sided socket, frozen
       physical address, or selective flip remains outside the quotient;
       `c` independently phased components with individually fixed labels
       retain `c-1` relative phase bits.  If reflection permutes component
       labels, it still removes at most one simultaneous binary choice.
       The three return paths disappear only as a phase-comparison
       certificate, not when they physically attach the chosen child.

       Finally, the corrected head-injective theorem is used only as a
       disjoint second-facet projection.  It does not close the fixed-M0
       lower/root--head--graphic correlation; that joint row remains open.

2569D. The one-copy coloured-Euler lane now has an exact reflection/fusion
       dichotomy and an exact parity theorem.

       For the open support-four Johnson square

         V1->V2->V3->V0  versus  V0->V3->V2->V1,

       the owner and named lower/upper palettes agree, but

         partial(new-old)=2(e_V1-e_V0).

       Reversal changes no undirected edge and is zero modulo2.  In a
       directed one-factor, any orientation-only batch which remains a
       one-factor reverses whole old components or none; component count
       and length multiset are invariant.  Exact two-boundary q1
       preservation forces the two exterior owners to coincide, giving
       only one reversed closed component.  The frozen k17 MMM cycle has
       zero consecutive literal square occurrences among all24310 starts;
       independently W=24310=1 mod3 forbids a disjoint three-edge-square
       tiling.  The H100 scan and independent replay are frozen under
       `scratch/threadD_k17_open_c4_reversal_20260801/`.

       The reset plus long-return cycle repairs every internal row but not
       topology: it is one 4d+2-cycle and its inverse, with isomorphic DM
       decomposition, all cyclic derivative/OR inventories and internal
       compiler incidence.  Whole reflection is therefore an exact gauge,
       not an actuator.  Every eventual linear cut still has the absolute
       d(2d-1) internally unique OR debt; the phase-common q1 path host does
       not repay it.

       The resident q-port construction supplies the genuinely nonlinear
       actuator.  Its H2 state has q resident port cycles and H3 has one;
       the support-changing q-gon rethread gives

         q -> 1,   Delta c=-(q-1),   relative sign=(-1)^(q-1).

       Hence odd q preserves component parity, while q=4 is the smallest
       literal parity-changing actuator (q=2 is the closed doubleton) and
       uses 8d+8 atoms.  Available arities Q give the exact abstract
       semigroup

         c_final=c_initial-sum_q n_q(q-1).

       Omitting one q-gon connector instead gives one Hamilton path from
       B_(j-1) to A_j, boundary e_Aj-e_B(j-1), and exactly the named q1
       deficits L_j,U_(j-1).  The closed switch is matching/DM-rank neutral
       (one alternating C_(2q)) but raises graphic rank by q-1.

       The first exact graded upper current is at width d+3:

         D_(d+3)(H3)-D_(d+3)(H2)
           =sum_i ( e_[S+Y+z+a_(i-1)+a_i+a_(i+1)]
                    -e_[S+Y+z+a_i+a_(i+1)] ).

       Nevertheless every negative value retains another H3 occurrence,
       and all longer H2 port intervals already equal the complete port
       support.  Therefore the fusion direction has the stronger setwise
       theorem

         Deck_OR(H2) subset Deck_OR(H3):

       it deletes no last internal upper witness.  It is not graded-deck or
       derivative/source transparent; those rows, exterior cross-windows,
       voltage and the terminal compiler remain.

       Finally, global reversal quotients the *complete* induction
       certificate: [H0]=[H3] and [H1]=[H2].  Thus the correct existential
       transition is directly

         [q-component orbit]=[H2] -> [H3]=[one-component orbit].

       Build one oriented child and one terminal compiler, then reflect the
       whole word/witness/matching certificate.  Hall in a fixed-address
       G+ intersection G- is required only for a genuinely local switch
       against a frozen exterior or a named one-sided socket, not for this
       quotient induction.  Global reversal leaves component count, holes,
       relative phase data and cut debt invariant.  If component labels are
       fixed individually, it removes only the diagonal phase bit and leaves c-1
       relative bits.  In general it acts by epsilon -> 1+P epsilon for an
       involutive component permutation P and removes at most one binary
       choice.

       Remaining: a one-oriented one-copy host for the whole q-port bank;
       the joint fixed-M0 lower/root + head-injective + graphic correlation
       (the corrected head theorem closes only its disjoint second-facet
       projection); terminal lower-derivative/compiler feasibility;

2570AD. The reset--return packet has a sharp linear-source interface, now
        stated in the correct global-reversal quotient.

        Same-edge opening gives two reverse `4d+2`-root paths with the same
        surviving q1 and accumulated-union inventories.  The exact
        owner-producing antecedent has length `5d+2`; its derivative
        restitution occurrence charge is `d(d+1)/2`.  That occurrence
        ledger is not target completeness.

        More generally, after a source cut append the first `ell` cyclic
        cells, `0<=ell<=2d-1`.  Among the internally unique short cyclic
        values, the exact number still absent is

          sum_(w=2)^(2d) max(0,w-1-ell)
            = binom(2d-ell,2).

        Thus the bare cut has debt `d(2d-1)`.  The canonical owner-exact
        `ell=d` tail still has `binom(d,2)` forced losses: rank `r+u`
        has exactly `u` for `1<=u<=d-1`.  A one-sided cyclic continuation
        clears this forced family only at `ell>=2d-1`, which creates `d-1`
        extra depth-d owner occurrences.  Additional long losses may remain.

        The exact ambient-duplication criterion is occurrencewise.  If
        `mu_c(T)` is cyclic multiplicity minus surviving packet-internal
        multiplicity and `N_+(T)` counts nonpacket-internal intervals in
        one oriented ambient word, then the cyclic inventory survives iff

          N_+(T) >= mu_c(T) for every T.

        One consecutive disjoint bank needs at least `2d-1` letters to have
        enough interval occurrences for the bare forced family, or at least
        `d-1` for the canonical-tail residual.  Two antipodal linearizations
        cover every forced width-`<=2d` value abstractly, but literal copies
        repeat owners and palettes.

        There is a sharp direct socket alternative.  Put
        `B=A_(c-1) union A_c` at the source cut.  If every inserted connector
        letter lies in `B`, every crossing OR value is restored, with witness
        width shifted by the connector length.  Conversely the unique
        width-two value `B` forces this screen.  In a flat rank-r depth-d
        chronology with `d>=2`, it also forces

          connector length <= d-2;

        otherwise a length-(d+1) window lies wholly in the rank-(r-d+1)
        set `B`.  This is necessary, not sufficient: owner/q1/residence/cap
        legality remains literal.

        Global reversal changes the compiler quantifier.  For `m>=8d+4`,
        choose the unconditional q1 host once.  If one oriented complete
        source state has upper coverage, residence, `N_+>=mu_c`, one
        terminal compiler/cap matching and a regenerative interface, then
        reflecting the whole word and all occurrence addresses supplies
        the opposite representative.  No fixed-address matching in
        `G+ intersection G-`, no common exterior, and no second ambient
        check is needed.  The invariant opening ledger is the chosen
        `mu_c`: bare gives at least `d(2d-1)`, canonical restitution at
        least `binom(d,2)`, and arbitrary overlap must be evaluated exactly.

        This quotient leaves component count, holes and opening debt
        unchanged.  With `c` independently named component/socket phases,
        it removes at most one binary choice.  If component labels are
        fixed it leaves `c-1` relative parities; in general it acts by
        `epsilon -> 1+P epsilon` for an involutive component permutation.
        Directed voltage is negated.  The owner-current/age and
        common/intersection Hall tests therefore remain only for a local
        packet flip against frozen exterior or a named relative socket.

        The corrected head-injective theorem is not used to close the host:
        its disjoint second-facet projection leaves the joint fixed-M0
        lower/root + head + graphic correlation open.  The surviving
        positive target is one oriented upper-surjective low-component
        source, one ambient-loss repair, one terminal compiler/cap, and
        reversal-closed regeneration.

2571C. The complete-reversal cut collateral now has an exact coefficient-one
       payment at the local owner/q1 level.

       Prepending the last `d` cyclic source cells is the canonical linear
       depth-`d` overlap: it has length `M+d`, produces exactly the `M=4d+2`
       packet owners once each, and duplicates no owner.  It restores every
       lower and middle target.  Its complete remaining deck leave is exactly
       two upper Ferrers triangles:

         B_X union X[1,i] union X[j+2,d],
         Omega minus U[i+1,j+1],       0<=i<=j<d.

       Each triangle has `binom(d+1,2)` targets.  Their rank histograms are
       `rank r+t: t` and `rank r+d+t: t`, `1<=t<=d`; hence the exact full
       leave is `d(d+1)`, with no target of rank at most `r`.

       Two explicit static Johnson paths cover all of it.  The X-gap path has
       `2d` owners around one central edge; the U-gap path has `3d` owners
       around a length-`d+2` geodesic.  Together they use exactly `5d` distinct
       owners and `5d-2` distinct lower and upper q1 colours.  Four permanent
       markers separate both banks from each other and from every packet
       owner/q1 resource.  The sole bank upper colour containing every marker
       is exactly the opened packet's omitted upper-q1 colour.  Every internal
       positive run already has length at least `d+1`, but both ends of both
       banks are clipped.  A standalone cyclic host therefore needs four
       one-sided collars, not two.  Conditional on a resource-simple
       four-collar realization, the banks use at most `9d` owners and the
       packet-plus-bank incidence footprint is `26d-2`; `m>=26d` is the
       corresponding small-protected-subgraph threshold.  The earlier
       `7d`, `22d-2`, `m>=22d` count applies only when two ends are genuine
       global endpoints or have certified nested ambient continuations.

       Thus the former quadratic target family needs no `O(k)` appended
       letters: it is covered by `O(d)` protected owner positions inside the
       ambient coefficient-one carrier.  The banks are invariant under the
       phase reversal.  Still open is the global protected twin-bank host:
       join the packet and both banks into an upper-complete carrier, preserve
       exterior all-width witnesses, and retain one oriented terminal
       compiler/cap, then reflect the completed certificate.
       No additive bound or global host is claimed.

2576H3. Lane H3 now has a sharp asymptotic protected-host/fusion statement,
        including the corrected four-boundary scope and the finite endpoint
        warning.  It does not close the global Boolean host.

        First, simultaneous global reversal remains the correct existential
        quotient: construct one oriented child with all certificates and
        reflect it.  No fixed-address common exterior/compiler intersection
        is required.  Relative socket phases, component count, terminal
        opening and named one-sided sockets are not removed by this quotient.

        At the abstract component level, mixed q=3 and q=4 fusions remove the
        fixed-arity residue.  For c components, c!=2, the q4-dominant counts
        reaching one component are

          c=1 mod3: N4=(c-1)/3, N3=0;
          c=0 mod3: N4=(c-3)/3, N3=1;
          c=2 mod3, c>=5: N4=(c-5)/3, N3=2,

        and c-1=2N3+3N4.  Only the serial relay types

          3->3, 3->4, 4->4

        are needed.  If every node has a regenerated occurrence-labelled
        socket, a hereditary all-width cut signature, consistent relative
        phase, private named resources and one terminal compiler, bottom-up
        guarded fusion is exact.  The standard-core census is

          Bcore=(2d+2)(3N3+4N4)<(8/3)(d+1)c.

        With c<=Cat_m and Cat_m=2W_m/(m+1),

          Bcore/W_m < 16(d+1)/(3(m+1)).

        Hence O(Cat_m*d)=o(W_m) precisely in the relevant regime d=o(m),
        and is O(W_m/sqrt(m)) at d=Theta(sqrt(m)).  This is a scalar capacity
        theorem.  The frozen literal q-port packet has height one; it does
        not prove socket regeneration.  Its exact missing datum is a
        hereditary cut signature recording every boundary-age state,
        arbitrary-width witness ticket and named guard needed by the parent.

        The corrected reset/twin-bank collar is charged once at the terminal
        opening.  The raw packet plus banks has 9d+2 owners.  Two collars give
        11d+2 only with two certified ambient continuations; a standalone
        four-collar module has at most 13d+2 owners, conditional on literal
        collision-free fillers, q1 colours and continuation edges.  It must
        not be multiplied by the number of fusion nodes or residence cuts.

        There is an exact second route.  Every nonconstant maximal positive
        run of length at most d gives its circular interval of possible cut
        gaps.  A cut set D produces internally resident path atoms iff it
        stabs all these intervals (plus one opening on each otherwise uncut
        cycle).  The atom count is

          a(D)=|D|+u(D).

        Rejoining is not ordinary Hall.  A seam simultaneously consumes an
        oriented exit, oriented entry, deleted lower colour, boundary-age
        state, upper/all-width occurrence tickets and any guard/compiler
        resource.  Shared atom orientations and a connectivity/subtour row
        are part of the same master.  The exact optimized quantity is

          tau_join(F)=min |D|

        over interval transversals whose complete state-expanded endpoint
        master is feasible.  It may exceed the residence-only tau_d(F).
        Aharoni--Haxell expansion of the complete packet menus is sufficient
        for the resource-disjoint row, but connectivity remains separate.

        The scalar cut density has a clean dichotomy.  If

          M_t(F)<=A W/k, 1<=t<=d,

        for the exchange-label lag coincidences, then

          tau_d(F)/W<=Ad/k,
          a(D)/W<=Ad/k+c(F)/W.

        Equivalently, if every short-run count b_s is at most a Cat_m and
        c(F)<=kappa Cat_m, then

          a(D)<=(ad+kappa)Cat_m,
          a(D)/W_m<=2(ad+kappa)/(m+1).

        Native O(1)-support endpoint seams therefore preserve the
        O(Cat_m*d)=o(W_m) owner budget.  A private Theta(d)-collar per cut
        costs O(Wd^2/k), which is Theta(W) at d=Theta(sqrt(k)).  Conversely,
        beta W pairwise disjoint defect intervals force cut density at least
        beta.  Immediate q1 completeness does not distinguish these regimes.

        Crucially, lag spread bounds only the residence cut.  The missing
        asymptotic theorem must jointly choose, among minimum or priced
        near-minimum transversals, one whose boundary-age packet hypergraph
        expands, whose orientation variables agree and whose successor is
        connected.  Choosing an arbitrary minimum transversal and matching
        afterward is false.

        The authenticated k=17 factor makes the failure literal.  It has all
        24310 owners, all 24310 rank-8 lower q1 colours, all 19448 rank-10
        targets, seven components, and residence optimum tau_3=3807 avoiding
        all 26 protected internal gaps.  This is

          3807/24310=0.15660...=0.8874...(3/17),

        consistent with O(d/k) but not an asymptotic theorem.  For the
        deterministic rightmost-greedy protected-gap-avoiding optimum
        emitted by the cited audit, the raw
        Boolean atlas has 56,790 seams and perfect matchings in every
        two-shore projection.  After only a necessary relaxed residence
        screen, 13,174 seams remain, 1,289 deleted colours have degree zero,
        368 blocks have no outgoing candidate, 368 have no incoming
        candidate, and the block--colour matching rank is only 2518/3807.
        Thus this fixed minimum decomposition cannot be rejoined by ordinary
        Johnson seams even before ranks 11--13, connectivity or the compiler.
        Other minimum cuts, priced nonminimum cuts, interior rethreading and
        resident multi-edge seam gadgets remain open.

        The current exact conclusion is conditional.  A full protected child
        follows from either (i) a hereditary guarded q3/q4 fusion forest or
        (ii) a jointly selected O(Wd/k) cut plus endpoint master, together
        with preservation of ranks 11--13, exterior all-width tickets and one
        terminal compiler.  Fixed-M0 lower/root, head injectivity and graphic
        correlation remain joint.  No lower compiler, arbitrary exterior
        witness theorem, regenerative socket atlas or all-dimensional host
        is claimed.

2573D. The nonlinear q-port lane now has an exact q=4-dominant hierarchy
       theorem, with the arithmetic separated from the regenerative host.

       With only q=4 fusions, the maximal number of moves and best residual
       component count are

         N4=floor((c-1)/3),
         c4*=c-3N4 in {1,2,3},

       according as c is 1,2,0 modulo3.  Hence pure q4 reaches one component
       iff c=1 modulo3.  With q3 also available, every c except2 reaches one
       in the minimum ceil((c-1)/3) packets.  The q4-dominant schedules are

         c=1 mod3: N4=(c-1)/3, N3=0;
         c=0 mod3: N4=(c-3)/3, N3=1;
         c=2 mod3, c>=5: N4=(c-5)/3, N3=2.

       The last schedule must stop at five components and use 5->3->1.
       Every {3,4}-ary fusion tree obeys c-1=2N3+3N4.  Its successor sign is
       (-1)^N4, and N4=c-1 modulo2, so there is no further parity obstruction.

       A proof-safe physical theorem is conditional on a private,
       packet-closed hierarchy: each parent has a literal H2 port occurrence
       on distinct child components; the H3 output regenerates a legal parent
       port; named owner/lower/upper/tail/head resources are private; every
       exterior join passes the residence trace test; and every noninternal
       old upper witness survives or has a protected copy.  Bottom-up fusion
       then preserves one-copy resources and residence, while upper support
       is monotone by Deck(H2) subset Deck(H3).  The graded current is not
       monotone.  A disjoint hierarchy reserves exactly

         R_d=(2d+2)(4N4+3N3)

       packet atoms, giving a sharp capacity obstruction for this private
       implementation only.

       For the optimal schedules the atom coefficients are respectively
       `(4c-4)/3`, `(4c-3)/3`, `(4c-2)/3` in residue classes1,0,2.
       They are minimal: replacing two q4 packets by three q3 packets keeps
       component reduction six but raises the coefficient from8 to9.

       Keep every nonroot node cyclic and open only the root.  The open
       q-gon then exports exactly one lower and one upper q1 deficit.  For an
       authenticated complete-reversal source cut, appending ell cyclic
       cells leaves the exact forced short family

         C_d(ell)=binom(2d-ell,2), 0<=ell<=2d-1.

       Thus the bare cut has d(2d-1), while the canonical owner-exact ell=d
       tail has binom(d,2).  This is paid once, not once per fusion, only if
       all internal substitutions remain cyclic.  For the canonical overlap,
       the exact full leave is two Ferrers triangles of total size d(d+1).
       The protected twin banks pay all of it on `5d` raw owners, with no
       source letters beyond the mandatory `M+d` antecedent.  A standalone
       cyclic host needs four collars and at most `9d` bank owners; `7d`
       requires two certified ambient continuations.  Hence the forced
       self-supply ledger is not an unavoidable
       final hole count.  For an arbitrary terminal q-port source the
       binomial formula does not apply; the exact row is N_+(T)>=mu_c(T).

       The sharp remaining theorem is regeneration: isolated q-port H3 is
       not automatically a fresh H2 occurrence after arbitrary child
       interiors are substituted.  Exterior sealing, one terminal cap,
       voltage and named pins also remain.  The construction is one-oriented;
       no phase-common compiler is assumed or required.

2572L. Lane L has integrated the exact `d`-overlap/Ferrers twin-bank
       payment.  The earlier blocker theorem remains exact for a bare packet,
       but its `d(2d-1)` debt is no longer the live construction frontier.

       The canonical overlap uses exactly the unavoidable `M+d=5d+2`
       source positions and produces the `M=4d+2` packet owners once each.
       It restores every target of rank at most `r`.  Its complete leave is
       the two Ferrers triangles of item2571C, total `d(d+1)`.  The protected
       `2d`- and `3d`-owner paths witness every leave target.  If their
       internal witness arcs remain contiguous and the final cut is exterior
       to them, the updated local compensation optimum is

         beta_can = 0.

       This does not change the bare value `beta*=d(2d-1)`: the overlap
       changes the casualty family and the banks make every remaining core
       empty.  The exact unconditional cost is `5d` raw bank owners.  Both
       ends of both banks are clipped: a standalone cyclic completion needs
       four collars and at most `9d` bank owners, conditional on jointly
       collision-free fillers, q1 colours and continuation edges.  The `7d`
       two-collar count applies only with two certified ambient continuations.
       “Zero appended letters” means no source positions beyond the mandatory
       `M+d`; the global host must reserve these `O(d)` owner positions.  The
       H100 audit certifies only raw resources and internal residence.

       After deleting every target with a cut-immune module witness, let
       `T_ext` be the remaining old exterior target bank.  Its exact live
       optimum is still

         b_ext* = min_(c in K) #{S in T_ext : c in B_S^can}.

       The twin-bank theorem gives no bound on this quantity.  At
       `m>=26d`, fixed-protected-subgraph extension supplies a spanning
       owner/lower-q1 two-factor containing a resource-simple four-collared
       packet and banks.  The smaller `m>=22d` threshold is conditional on
       two certified ambient continuations.
       It does not supply upper surjectivity, low component count, protected
       joining, exterior all-width preservation or the terminal compiler.

       Therefore the new target is one oriented coefficient-one resident,
       upper-complete host which embeds and joins the packet plus both banks,
       preserves the exterior deck, and has one terminal compiler/cap.
       Global reversal then transports the complete certificate; no
       fixed-address cross-phase intersection is required.  The corrected

       search, additive bound or global host is claimed.

2578L. Lane L has closed the exact endpoint-superchain question for the
       deterministic rightmost-greedy protected-avoiding 3,807-cut
       decomposition emitted by the cited audit,
       and has separated it from the still-live recut/gadget and fresh
       compiler routes.

       For an oriented resident block let prefix/suffix ages be capped at
       four.  The necessary relaxed endpoint atlas rejects a seam only when
       two adjacent non-all-one blocks already bound a positive run of
       length at most three.  All-one blocks are left completely free for a
       later capped automaton.  Consequently every seam in every globally
       resident intact-block superchain lies in this relaxed atlas: longer
       lookahead, regrouping and transitive closure cannot add a rejected
       first seam.  Reversal is an anti-automorphism preserving the named
       lower colour, so the zero-out and zero-in physical block sets are the
       same 368 isolated blocks.

       The exact fixed-decomposition ledger is

         raw atoms                         56,790
         necessary-relaxed atoms           13,174
         pairwise-robust atoms               9,618
         zero deleted rank8 colours          1,289
         block--colour matching              2,518/3,807
         block--block matching               3,364/3,807.

       A linear path needs 3,806 distinct joins and can waive only one
       deleted colour.  Hence at least 1,288 lower rows need non-atomic
       service.  The fixed blocks have internal-witness holes

         ranks10..17 = 2423,3116,1297,249,12,0,0,0

       respectively.  Rank10 was complete before cutting, is seam-additive,
       and 1,456 of its 2,423 casualties
       have no provider even in the necessary relaxed atlas.  Ranks11 and
       above are not seam-additive; they require the ordered
       suffix/full/prefix union automaton or literal final replay.  The
       1,288, 368 and 1,456 numbers are correlated obligation counts, not
       additive gadget lower bounds.

       Thus an endpoint superchain cannot repair the canonical cut family.
       A genuine whole-seam escape must alter an old interior, cut or
       interface and export literal owner ports, lower debits/restoration,
       the capped residence transfer, ranks10--17 union decks, topology and
       protected-bank effects.  Retaining all old cuts, any pure refinement
       needs at least 65 additional splits.  On the at-most-one-split per
       original block face the bound is144; restricting to isolated blocks
       and allowing one linear opening gives184 (185 if all1,289 rows are
       charged).  Even the incompatible union of every one-split state of
       every isolated block leaves568 original zero rows.  These are fixed-
       cut statements: another protected-avoiding minimum transversal can
       still have cardinality3,807 and different endpoint rows.

       The endpoint obstruction is pre-compiler.  The fixed square one-
       pivot compiler has dual strict-gammoid rank zero only conditional on
       a target-saturating fixed-cap matching.  Valid target-cell pins must
       be allowed and jointly extendable before contraction.  The 3,807
       blocks define no physical source cells or cap state, so after any
       successful recut/gadget chronology one must rebuild the maximal
       antecedent, Adm_A and perfect common-cap matching from scratch.

       The separate boundary audit records the four clipped bank profiles.
       In the frozen factor the only old-end failures are PX-left:x1 and
       PU-left:u1.  The proposed PX-right/PU-left two-collar layout still
       leaves PX-left:x1 under the actual other continuations.  Four collars
       are ambient-independent only for the four old clipped runs and remain
       conditional on collision-safe Johnson realizations, private q1
       resources, no new short runs and legal outer continuations.  Source
       start c omits owner edge c-1; only start4/edge3 and its reflected
       start11/edge10 complete-29 templates are materialized.

       proof-interface corrections.  First, the unconditional q-port plus four-collar host

       `38d+13` is conditional on two certified ambient continuations.
       Second, a q-port fusion can re-pair runs even when seam bits agree.
       Its proof-safe old-run bound is `qm`, not `2q`.  At `m=9`, two q4 or
       three q3 fusions can alter at most 72 or 81 old run components, so an
       already-installed fusion hierarchy leaves at least 5688 or 5679 of
       the 5760 best-open defects.

       The complete C6 census has 4,667,520 oriented keys, 3,379 protected
       three-component fusions and 405 rank-ten-safe rows.  Every component
       triple uses at least two of components 0,1,2, so no three initial
       packets cover all seven components.  Exact regeneration over all 405

       Beyond that prefix-safe dynamic no-go, all 2,642 safe

       The surviving route must change support: a prospectively planted

       result, not an all-k or k17-word no-go.

2580K. The K17 cut/seam handoff is now reconciled across the three distinct
       fixed faces, and the next theorem is one joint integral selector.

       First, the protected-C6 component rule has its final proof-safe form.
       For a switch with six retained stubs and old/new stub matchings,

         Delta components = c(S union M_new)-c(S union M_old).

       The exact census contains every value -2,-1,0,+1,+2; shore parity is
       not an invariant because the retained matching is arbitrary.  The
       only implication used without extra hypotheses is: if the three
       removed owner edges lie in three distinct old components, then the
       switch has Delta=-2.  Dynamic regeneration of all 405 individually
       q1-safe 7->5 children leaves only five live children, 12 ordered
       5->3 moves (six unordered grandchildren), and zero safe 3->1 move.
       Prefix-safe three-C6 descent is exhausted, but preparatory moves,
       temporary/final-net q1 debt and larger support are separate faces as
       recorded in items2577A and2579D.

       Second, the canonical SCD and protected-factor endpoint counts are
       not interchangeable.  The right-end-greedy 1,419-cut SCD split has
       6,281 resident maximal-source pieces.  Its 10,022,670 legal oriented
       pair arcs leave exactly 322 of 1,419 rank-ten colours unsupported;
       the rank-ten seam-union argument makes this a global no-go for every
       order/orientation of those fixed pieces.  Requiring the seam lower
       colour also to be one of the missing colours raises the integrated
       count to

         720 = 322 + 398,

       where the extra 398 have resident providers only through already
       consumed lower colours.  Both results are scoped away from, and do
       not exclude, alternative minimum cuts, added cuts, interior rethreads
       or other SCD factors.

       Indeed the later SCD interior-split audit makes that scope literal.
       Every canonical 322 row is supported somewhere in the one-split
       union; a 192-cut common rebuild has no rank-ten support zero.  More
       sharply, a coupled minimum-cut segmentation starts with 19 zeros and
       an 18-extra-cut common rebuild gives 6,299 pieces with zero rank-ten
       support rows.  It still supplies no degree assignment, path,
       all-width chronology, exact global residence or compiler.

       The protected seven-component factor is a different host.  For its
       deterministic rightmost-greedy 3,807-cut split, the raw atlas has
       56,790 directed atoms and a conflict-free forced union of 795 seams.
       That union is pre-residence: all 281 unique-lower seams are incumbent
       cut edges, forbidden by their private short-run collars; 46 are also
       sole raw rank-ten restorers.  The necessary relaxed atlas has 13,174
       atoms, 1,289 zero lower colours, 368 dead outgoing and 368 dead
       incoming blocks, and projection ranks 2,518/2,518/3,364.  A linear
       atomic assembly therefore has at least 1,288 deficient ordinary
       projection obligations.  This is not a gadget count and not an
       invariant: exact minimum-cut exchange reaches 984 zero colours.

       The support-two and dense-refinement results are positive only at
       their stated layers.  The union atlas on 20,477 extra-cut options has
       3,194,008 pair supports and gives every one of the 2,025 old singleton
       rows a column; exactly 110 old colours are pair-only.  Its dense SAT
       is prospective because a unary provider can be destroyed by another
       selected split.  The selected 3,805 cuts were then rebuilt literally,
       yielding 7,612 pieces and colours.  The relaxed atlas has 243,424
       atoms, no zero physical piece or lower colour, and perfect physical
       unoriented TH, TC and CH matchings of size 7,612.  Nevertheless exactly 187
       pieces have incoming support only in one orientation and outgoing
       support only in the opposite one; the common-orientation q1 CNF is
       unit-UNSAT.  Independently, exactly 78 of its 5,094 cut-killed
       rank-ten targets have no relaxed-resident provider.  Thus this fixed
       dense refinement fails both shared orientation and upper completion.

       A later literal cut-choice incumbent, independently replayed but not a
       terminal search verdict, preserves zero q1 piece/colour rows and all
       three perfect unoriented projections while reducing the two counts to
       94 and 28.  Its combined singleton objective is 122 instead of 265.
       This proves cut sensitivity, not common orientation, upper completion,
       functional Hall or a chronology.

       The next independently replayed literal bank reaches zero
       common-orientation and zero relaxed rank-ten singleton rows while
       retaining all three perfect physical q1 projections.  Bank/audit SHA
       prefixes are 5b4fe2d1/199ab886.  Its exact simultaneous
       tail/head/colour formula is nevertheless UNSAT.  The verified core has
       14 original clauses, five lemmas, two degree-two colours and four
       directed seams.  After reversal quotient, both required colour edges
       meet the same physical socket of the central piece: colour exactness
       needs both while socket degree one allows at most one.  This rejects
       only the fixed zero/zero bank.  No chronology, compiler or word is
       inferred.

       Directly changing only the three visible core pieces cannot work: all
       240 combinations were replayed, 20 retain every singleton row, and all
       20 are q1-UNSAT.  One global cut replacement on base piece1268 breaks
       the first bow tie while preserving zero/zero singleton support, but
       the new bank has a verified 15-clause/seven-lemma core.  Thus cut CEGAR
       is functioning and remains constant-core, but no convergence theorem
       is claimed.

       The relaxed atlas has an exact undirected socket-graph normal form.
       Common-orientation singleton support is nonisolation of both sockets;
       rank-ten values label the same edges; the full q1 row is a coloured
       perfect matching using every socket and selected lower colour once.
       Pure refinement preserves every old legal edge, adds the canonical
       internal edge for each new socket pair, and cannot create endpoint or
       rank-ten zeros.  Moreover any already feasible coloured q1 matching
       extends by those canonical edges.  For the old 187+78 fixed bank, a
       provider-only repair retaining its socket identities needs at least
       159 new seam atoms.

       The exact live theorem is iterated cut CEGAR around the current small
       core: add an alternative provider, change a central socket incidence,
       or replace a selected colour, then rerun the exact coloured matching.
       The eventual joint selector must also choose one
       minimum cut network path or priced refinement, every literal subpiece
       and orientation/state,
       and occurrence-labelled seams.  The same integral variables must
       enforce self-closure of every newly cut lower colour (one named linear
       hole), tail/head capacities and owner degrees, a connected acyclic
       path, rank-ten multiplicities, the ordered suffix/full/prefix witness
       automata at ranks11+, protected typed pins and the exact 17-coordinate
       residence product.  Only after literal physical replay is the common-
       cap compiler imposed.  A positive result must construct this selector;
       a negative result needs a Hall/DM/Benders cut valid across cut choices.
       In the lex-rooted support-two union and the replayed dense banks,
       singleton nonemptiness and pairwise perfect projections are not
       sufficiency certificates; a different selected cut face may still
       have singleton zeros.

2580H3. Lane H3 has rebased the protected-host theorem from the accidental
        `P-2^d` scalar identity to recuttable closed packets and robust
        functional expansion.

        For a coherent upper-q1-exact/lower-rainbow Catalan forest, cutting
        `t` edges gives

          P=Cat_m+t,
          H=t+A(F)+B_F(D),
          P-H=Cat_m-A(F)-B_F(D).

        Thus the lower square is structural and the upper gap is a
        cut-dependent deep last-witness ledger.  At the same
        `m=9,d=3,t=1419,P=6281`, one authenticated cut has gap 8 and another
        gap 226; refinements can have H>P.  The complete unchanged
        minimum-fragment face also has at least 14 unsupported selected
        rank-ten colours, so it cannot be repaired by reordering its fixed
        pieces.

        A local two-cut/socket column counts as one ordinary matching edge
        only after every secondary palette casualty, boundary-age state,
        prefix/suffix/internal deck ticket, fixed-M0 root, protected
        resource and topology effect is closed inside one functional site.
        On that face the exact residual defect is

          max_(X subset Z) (|X|-|N(X)|).

        Singleton support alone can leave defect |Z|-1.  If quotient
        topology is not hereditarily sealed, the exact theorem is instead
        target--site packet matching plus the literal final degree and
        graphic inequalities.  A bounded-radius alternating packet theorem
        gives local repair, but a bidiagonal chain proves that two-cut
        locality and even global perfect matchability can require a
        Theta(|Z|)-length exchange.  No raw multi-resource system is called
        a generic matroid.

        The literal dense refinement is the positive finite rebase.  Its
        7,612 pieces have no relaxed-resident unoriented endpoint or deleted-
        lower singleton zero and all three physical TH, TC and CH projections
        are perfect.  This is not a functional core.  Exactly 187 old-outer-
        endpoint pieces need one orientation for incoming support and the
        opposite orientation for outgoing support, so the exact common-
        orientation q1 CNF is unit-UNSAT.  Independently, exactly 78 of 5,094
        rank-ten casualties have no relaxed-resident atomic provider.

        A subsequent literal cut-choice incumbent preserves the three perfect
        unoriented projections and reduces these two counts to 94 and 28.
        The next independently replayed bank reaches zero/zero, but its exact
        three-resource q1 matching is bow-tie UNSAT: two required colours have
        only two physical edges meeting one socket.

        For the original fixed bank, the sparse-zero absorber theorem was
        conditional on first changing the refinement or repairing the 187
        orientation defects.  The zero/zero bank removes that singleton
        prerequisite, but the theorem still requires a future q1-SAT cut bank
        to freeze one oriented functional graph G on
        N+N vertices.  Call G h-robust when every balanced deletion of size
        at most h leaves a perfect matching.  This property is equivalent
        exactly to

          |N_G(X)| >= min(N,|X|+h)  for every nonempty X.

        If the exceptional upper targets match to disjoint closed absorber
        sites, each absorber deletes at most a balanced core pairs, all
        surviving core atoms persist, and G is h-robust for
        h=a|Z|<N, then every exceptional target is absorbed and the residual

        For

        The sharp MTF verdict is only H=1.  Along B,C,D,A the

        The reuse w occurs at gap two.  The exact saturated-MTF criterion

        only reverses whole components.  Thus the square is a literal

        q=2 remains the degenerate closed-doubleton case.

        Internally, reversal preserves every interval OR.  Against a fixed
        source exterior, the complete defect is exactly four nested rays:

          X union B <-> X union A,
          X union U1 <-> X union U3,
          A union Y <-> B union Y,
          U3 union Y <-> U1 union Y.

2583H3. Lane H3 has converted the new undirected socket lemma into the exact
        refinement-regeneration theorem and isolated its necessary extra
        hypothesis.

        For the relaxed two-block residence projection, compatibility of two
        physical sockets is symmetric.  Purely splitting a resident piece
        while retaining every old cut has four monotone effects: old outer
        socket ages only rise; every old seam remains legal; the two new
        sockets are joined legally by the old factor edge; and this canonical
        edge supplies exactly the new lower colour and the factor-upper value
        removed from the piece interior.

        This gives a conditional two-cut singleton-support theorem.  A raw
        Johnson socket edge whose lower colour is already selected becomes
        relaxed-legal after cutting the first inward gap at each nonsingleton
        endpoint.  If those gaps are allowed and unprotected, a labelled raw
        witness-edge cover E* of isolated sockets and rank-ten zeros uses at
        most 2|E*| cuts.  Choosing one witness per old singleton task gives
        the conditional first-bank ceiling

          2(187+78)=530.

        This is monotone set cover, not Hall and not a final seam selection.
        The required protected-safe witness cover has not been audited.

        The stronger positive theorem starts after a coloured socket selector
        exists.  For every further cut g, retain all old selected seams and
        add the old factor edge e_g across g.  The new selector is

          M_D = M disjoint_union {e_g:g in D}.

        Contracting the e_g recovers the old functional core and component
        topology.  Expanding them gives literally the same physical owner
        word, so every chronology-functorial residence, interval-deck,
        erosion and compiler certificate transports.  In an opened directed
        forest, ordering each split piece's children in traversal order gives
        the lexicographic potential (phi(P),child index).  This is the exact
        zero-damage a=0 absorber case; robust Hall is unnecessary on the
        contracted quotient.  A certificate naming an old piece as an
        indivisible protected atom still requires that cut gap to be declared
        transparent.  Boundary-changing packets need exact family-residual
        Hall or the earlier uniform h-robust inequality.

        Before the first selector, let nu_3(C) be the maximum matching in the
        three-resource socket/socket/lower-colour hypergraph extending the
        prescribed protected selector bank (equivalently, contract that bank,
        delete its conflicts and add its rank back), and put

          delta_3(C)=P(C)-nu_3(C).

        Every pure cut supplies one disjoint canonical atom, hence delta_3 is
        nonincreasing.  If every reachable positive-defect state has an
        allowed bundle of at most q0 cuts which strictly lowers delta_3, then
        at most q0 delta_3(C) cuts produce a lower-exact socket perfect
        matching.  Once this rank is full, the analogous immediate-upper
        ticket debt is also nonincreasing; bounded ticket-improving bundles
        give the corresponding linear descent.

        The q0 hypothesis is essential.  The later 7,612-piece bank has zero
        isolated sockets, zero rank-ten provider rows and perfect pairwise
        projections, yet its exact q1 selector is UNSAT on a verified

       live dense-cut q1 CEGAR.

       First, for a fixed cut bank C the exact functional-Hall defect is

         delta_FH(C)=min_(integral z,u)

       It vanishes if and only if the orientation-consistent coloured q1

       minus lost distinct neighbours under a replacement q, then

         nu(B_q) >= n-D+a

       holds if and only if

         kappa_q(X) >= d(X)-D+a  for every X.

       Hence one-unit progress must improve every maximum-deficiency shore
       and obey all near-critical nonloss inequalities. Adding providers for
       one returned core is neither necessary nor sufficient.

       Second, monotone pure refinement does have a guided termination
       theorem. Let delta_3=p-nu_3 in the physical
       socket/socket/lower-colour hypergraph, and let lambda be the minimum
       number of commuting additional cuts in a bundle which strictly lowers
       delta_3. A cut from a minimum bundle either lowers delta_3 or leaves it

       lexicographic potential. Full singleton refinement makes lambda finite
       and gives the coarse q1-only ceiling W-p=16698. This theorem permits
       neutral preparatory cuts. It does not apply to the live one-for-one

2585AD. Lane AD has separated pure dense refinement from the genuinely
        chronology-changing support and frozen exact residence/all-width
        guards for any future q1-SAT bank.

        For a rank-nine owner fragment P, the signature

          Sigma(P)=(total OR, prefix-OR chain, suffix-OR chain,
                    internal interval-OR deck)

        has an exact associative concatenation law.  Each prefix/suffix
        chain has at most nine values, so activating one old edge can expose
        at most 81 old upper masks in total and at most (q+1)^2 at rank 9+q.
        The independent 17-coordinate run transducer is also associative.

        An extra cut made inside an already resident coarse piece is literal
        factorization.  If its old factor edge is selected between the two
        children, it contracts to the identical owner word (or reversal) and
        preserves topology, residence and every interval width.  Only extra
        cuts whose canonical edge is not selected are active.  This does not
        apply to closing one of the original residence cuts, which can
        regenerate the short run it hit.

        More generally, for the old factor F and any final degree-at-most-two
        chronology F', let A=E(F)\E(F').  Every old witness avoiding A remains
        a literal interval of F'.  The exact old-channel residual is

          Z_F(A)={U: every old witness of U meets A}.

        For the authenticated protected factor,

          |Z_F(A)| <= 1806+81|A|,

        with layer bounds

2588K. Lane K has finished the proof-grade termination audit for the live
       dense-cut q1 CEGAR and separated the monotone, fixed-face and
       depth-two statements.

       The exact global score of a cut bank C is the functional-Hall defect

         delta_FH(C)=min_(integral z,u)
           max_X (z(X)-u(A_X(C)))_+.

       It is zero exactly at an orientation-consistent coloured q1 cover.
       For a fixed master, a replacement raises matching rank by a prescribed
       amount iff its signed neighbour current satisfies every old Hall
       shore, not merely the returned core.  Consequently named-provider
       degree is not a termination potential; the authenticated rule stalls
       at round02 while the bank remains DRAT-UNSAT.

       A positive termination theorem survives on the different, monotone
       pure-refinement face.  Each pure cut adds two private sockets, one
       private colour and their canonical triple while retaining all old
       atoms.  With delta_3=p-nu_3 and lambda the minimum size of a commuting
       improving cut bundle, choosing a cut from a minimum bundle strictly
       lowers `(delta_3,lambda)` lexicographically.  Full singleton refinement
       makes lambda finite and gives the coarse q1-only ceiling16698.  This
       theorem does not apply to one-for-one recuts, which delete atoms.

       On the fixed round02 one-recut face, the exact dual-fan persistence
       lemma is local.  If sockets s=L3669 and t=L3670 remain forced, no
       direct s--t seam appears and every residual edge incident to either
       socket still has colour114930, then changes elsewhere cannot help:
       deleting old arms only shrinks the stars and edges disjoint from
       `{s,t}` do not enter the two-socket/one-colour Hall cut.  Thus a recut
       can invalidate the literal fan only by a direct seam, a non-114930
       incident arm, or forced-role relocation.

       The exact partition is now proof-audited.  Among the13043 clean
       one-recuts,13030 noncentral banks retain the fan,12 noncentral banks
       genuinely create a different-colour escape and are all DRAT-UNSAT,
       and the sole clean central recut `1834:9924->9923` retains the fan and
       is DRAT-UNSAT.  The other eight central recuts fail local rows: seven
       have a lower-colour zero and `1835:9933->9932` has tail/head and
       common-orientation zeros (and is separately q1-UNSAT).  Hence the
       fixed-face q1 Hamming lower bound is exactly at least two.

       The first depth-two shell is also closed.  The twelve visible escape
       recuts have66 formal pairs; one selects two alternatives in base2251
       and is incompatible.  Literal replay gives65 compatible, zero-265-
       clean banks with65 distinct socket-atlas signatures.  All65 complete
       q1 formulas are UNSAT and all65 DRAT proofs independently verify.
       This closes only pairs selected entirely from the visible-arm menu.
       It does NOT close a visible arm plus a neutral global rerouter, two
       individually invisible recuts whose joint child activates a seam,
       dirty-single compensation, central-role combinations, added pure
       cuts, or circuit rethreads.  Therefore it gives no Hamming-three or
       unrestricted C6/C8 lower bound.

       Core-guided pricing compresses the twelve first children to four
       primary retained-mask rows.  The source seam files are headerless:
       the exact directed counts are `e00:118996^6`, `e06:14820^6`,
       `e11:87145^36`, and
       `e01,e02,e03,e04,e07,e08,e09,e10:115308^28`; `e05` has
       `115308^28` plus one pendant `117348` row, total29.  After physical
       reverse-pairing these are respectively 3,3,18 and14 pairs, with the
       `e05` pendant unpaired.  All four principal rows are literal dual
       fans.  Their locked pairs are

         A: (127188 at p1507,119028 at p2078), colour118996;
         B: (14821 at p3505,14828 at p3789), colour14820;
         D: (115310 at p3924,119404 at p7179), colour115308;
         C: (87147 at p1790,119913 at p6616), colour87145.

       For each locked pair Y, `nu(S[Y])=0` and `Gamma(Y)={c}`, so
       `1<|Y|=2`.  The `e05` pendant misses both locks.  Hence the exact local
       breaker oracle is: a non-core-colour arm at one lock plus a
       resource-disjoint core arm at the other, the direct lock-lock seam,
       or locked-role relocation.  Same-colour spoke growth and leaf-only
       pendant edits cannot help.  This compression is for the labelled
       local core, not for the full child banks.

       The exact Hamming-two master needs a two-resource activation channel.
       For an anchored central--leaf seam e, let G_e be the complete
       non-colour availability predicate after forced contraction (endpoint
       roles/states, Johnson/residence, leaf-socket survival and fixed local
       resources), and K_e membership of gamma(e) in the selected
       lower-colour bank.  Under leaf-locality, e exists exactly when
       G_e AND K_e.  With two
       noncentral recuts, geometry can be supplied by one recut while the
       other selects the colour.  The joint seam can therefore be absent
       from BOTH singleton socket graphs even when neither recut is one of
       the twelve visible escapes.  This proves that the 21-anchor
       reduction is conditional and that the exact pair master must join

       together with central-role columns and joint local-debt compensation.

       Four common local price rows are proof-safe only when the labelled
