2586H3. Lane H3 has frozen the exact Boolean coloured-socket
        rank-improvement interface and rebased it on the completed round02
        radius-one audit.

        Let M be any seam matching containing a literal fixed protected seam
        submatching P.  For every resource-disjoint entering seam family X
        avoiding P, let

          D_M(X)={m in M: rho(m) meets rho(X)}.

        Then the protected matching rank is exactly

          nu_P(H)=|M|+max_X (|X|-|D_M(X)|).

        The lower bound replaces every blocker by X; comparison with a
        maximum protected matching gives the reverse bound.  Thus rank rises
        exactly when a closed alternating collision component has positive
        entering-minus-blocker surplus.  The component can branch: a sharp
        four-new/three-old tree shows that an ordinary augmenting path is not
        necessary in the three-resource socket/socket/colour hypergraph.

        A single escape seam has at most three incumbent blockers.  If those
        blockers have a companion completion without reaching another
        incumbent atom, at most four entering seams give surplus one.  This
        is exact for the first blocker shell; longer alternating cascades
        remain possible.

        Every q-cut packet is normalized by its q canonical self-closing
        seams.  Its matching deficiency falls by exactly its maximum surplus
        beyond that lift.  In particular, two pure cuts repair a
        deficiency-one state only with one additional surplus unit.  At the
        coloured-matching layer a bare three-for-three C6 or four-for-four C8
        is rank-neutral.  A concrete three-on/two-off or four-on/three-off
        packet augments iff the entering seams are mutually resource-
        disjoint, their COMPLETE incumbent blocker set is precisely the two
        or three deleted seams, protected resources are avoided, and the
        final zero-row/residence/topology/ticket/collar guards pass.

        The round02 core is the dual fan

          s=L3669, t=L3670, st absent,
          N_colour({s,t})={114930}.

        Its exact local breakers are a direct st seam, two disjoint arms of
        distinct colours, or a forced-role rethread.  A different-colour arm
        alone need not raise rank: an explicit balanced six-socket/
        three-colour example kills the dual fan with surplus zero.

        The finite fixed-face boundary is now exact.  Of 16,667 one-for-one
        extra-cut replacements, 13,043 preserve the zero-265 ledger.  Twelve
        noncentral banks create genuine different-colour socket escapes and
        all twelve complete q1 formulas are independently DRAT-UNSAT; another
        13,030 clean noncentral banks retain the dual fan.  The nine central
        base-piece recuts split into seven lower-colour failures, the
        `9933->9932` tail/head/common-row failure, and the sole clean recut
        `9924->9923`,
        which retains the fan and is DRAT-UNSAT.  Hence q1 Hamming radius
        one is closed on this fixed one-split-per-base replacement face.
        Added pure cuts,
        two-replacement packets, other base-cut families and circuit
        rethreads remain outside the theorem; no C6/C8 lower bound follows
        there.

        The first visible-arm radius-two strategy is closed too.  The twelve
        noncentral escape substitutions have 65 compatible unordered pairs;
        the missing formal pair chooses two alternatives in one base piece.
        Every one of the 65 literal pair q1 formulas is UNSAT and now has an
        independently verified DRAT proof.  This closes only a pair chosen
        entirely from the visible-arm menu.  It does not close a visible arm
        plus a neutral global rerouter, a joint-only off-tight seam invisible
        in both one-change children, dirty-single compensation, or a true
        incidence C6/C8 forced-role relocation.  Every such candidate still
        needs a protected positive-surplus closure and all guards.

        The exact Hamming-two anchor has a necessary third branch.  For two
        noncentral recuts, raw Johnson/residence legality of a central--leaf
        seam is controlled by at most one recut, but membership of its lower
        colour is controlled by the global cut bank.  Thus every joint fan
        breaker contains (i) a central-base recut, (ii) a single-child
        socket escape, or (iii) a cross-activated seam exposed geometrically
        by one recut and coloured only by the other.  Reduction to the twelve
        clean escape rows is valid only if both single children are zero-265
        clean and branch (iii) is excluded.  Otherwise dirty-single
        compensation and joint colour activation are live.  The exact pair
        master is therefore the unfiltered raw central-seam atlas joined to
        the cross-colour incidence relation.

        The finite q1 closure is a matching-rank no-gain statement only after
        a separate certificate that the normalized incumbent deficiency is
        one.  Without that certificate a child can gain one rank unit while
        remaining imperfect.

        Hereditarily, if every positive-defect state has a complete-support-
        kappa guarded two-cut/C6/C8 packet of positive normalized surplus,
        at most delta_3 packets, 2 delta_3 new cuts and kappa delta_3 charged
        protected support reach a coloured socket perfect matching.  This is
        the exact conditional bounded regenerative theorem.  Existence of
        such bounded surplus packets in every Boolean state remains open, as
        do exact noncanonical residence, selected upper tickets, topology,
        deeper decks, exterior windows and the terminal compiler.

2589H3. Lane H3 has corrected the proposed Hamming-two anchor theorem.  The
        exact statement is a fixed-role ordered cover, not an unconditional
        reduction to twelve visible or 21 named recuts.

        For an anchored central socket y, let R_D(y) be the residual arm
        atlas satisfying every non-colour predicate after forced contraction
        (endpoint role/state, Johnson/age, leaf-socket survival and fixed
        local resource guards), K(D) the selected lower-colour bank, and

          E_D(y)={e in R_D(y): gamma(e) in K(D)}.

        Under the literal leaf-locality hypothesis, if compatible noncentral
        recuts g,h change distinct leaf bases, then
        every joint-only arm has exactly two resources: one recut i moves
        the leaf geometry so that e lies in R_(C_i)(y), while the other recut
        j supplies its colour gamma(e)=n_j.  The arm is absent from the base
        and both singleton selected atlases.  Conversely every such
        geometry-mover/colour-supplier pair creates a joint-only arm.  All
        new final arms are the union of singleton arms which survive the
        other recut and these joint-only arms.

        The cases are read in priority order: (i) a central base is recut,
        so its age/state is rebuilt literally; (ii) otherwise a singleton
        child already exposes the final arm, possibly while locally dirty;
        (iii) otherwise the arm is the geometry-colour cross-activation
        above.  Forced-role relocation is a separate C6/C8 rethread exit.
        Two noncentral recuts cannot create the direct central seam because
        both central endpoint states and its already selected colour remain
        fixed.

        Local admissibility is a third, independent condition.  On the
        complete occurrence/activity row universe put w_r(D)=z_r(D)-a_r(D).
        The exact pair debt is

          w_r(C_gh)=w_r(C)
                    +[w_r(C_g)-w_r(C)]
                    +[w_r(C_h)-w_r(C)]
                    +[w_r(C_gh)-w_r(C_g)-w_r(C_h)+w_r(C)],

        and joint cleanliness requires this to be nonnegative for every row
        active in the final bank.  The interaction bracket includes joint
        witnesses, witness destruction and newly active fragment/colour
        demands.  Individual cleanliness is neither sufficient nor
        necessary without a cross-deletion-stability hypothesis.

        Therefore the 21-anchor list (nine central recuts plus twelve clean
        visible arms) is exhaustive only if central roles remain fixed,
        geometry-colour cross-activation is excluded, and every unary arm
        participating in a clean pair is already individually clean.  Under
        the stronger assumption that both singleton children are clean, the
        central side collapses to the sole clean recut
        `1834:9924->9923`, so the sharp necessary list has 13 members.
        `1835:9933->9932` is separately q1-UNSAT but locally inadmissible:
        it has one zero tail state, one zero head state and one
        common-orientation zero.  Even the clean 13-anchor classification
        does not reduce the pair audit to the 65 visible-visible unions; a
        neutral router can be the second recut.  The exact next master is
        the unfiltered post-contraction non-colour availability atlas joined
        to colour supply and the literal joint debt ledger, followed by full
        q1 and protected-surplus tests.

2590K. Lane K independently proof-audited the new OFHT/antichain-top SCD
       synchronization and accepts it with a strict static-versus-literal
       boundary.

       With role types, marked positions and named target resources fixed,
       OFHT is exactly a resource-exact cover by compatible directed-cycle
       atoms.  This is a cycle-cover formulation, not a one-component
       theorem.  For a fixed flag table, integral head--owner columns extend
       to distinct predecessors exactly when every predecessor Hall row
       holds.  The Rado reduction is valid only after fixing a functional
       head--owner bijection and retaining the stated tail-neutrality
       hypotheses; the unfixed problem remains three-partite.

       The antichain-top static lift is exact under three load-bearing
       conditions: the role chains are nested and rank-consistent, every
       named target is globally distinct, and the nonempty maxima form an
       antichain.  A fixed SCD then places those maxima on distinct chains,
       whose rank-r members give distinct containing owners; empty roles use
       the remaining chains.

       The central-matching extension proof is valid.  For n=2h+1, every
       perfect matching between ranks h and h+1 extends to a full SCD.  At
       band radius t the new comparison edges have weight 1/(h+t+2), while
       each old-chain identity edge has weight (2t+2)/(h+t+2); all rows and
       columns sum to one, so an integral perfect matching extends or stops
       each chain symmetrically.  Therefore either parity matching of any
       Middle Levels Hamilton cycle may be used as the SCD central matching.

       Combining these statements closes simultaneously, for k=2r-1 and
       free role/owner assignment, every prescribed antichain-top static
       target chain, every rank-r owner, and one connected alternating
       Middle Levels incidence skeleton.  It does NOT say that the static
       state assigned to owner T_i has root q_i or that consecutive states
       satisfy the cellwise age shift.  Thus the opposite parity matching is
       not yet an OFHT successor matching.  The first remaining joint row is
       literal statewise chronology; on the all-high face it is exactly a
       resident Johnson Hamilton cycle with the required consecutive-
       intersection decks.  Fixed owners/orders, upper shadows, opening,
       common-cap/compiler and every O(1) conclusion remain open.

       The local facet absorber arithmetic also checks exactly:

         D=(k-r) binom(r,d+1),
         lambda=binom(r-1,d),
         lambda/D=(d+1)/(r(k-r)).

       Uniform weight 1/D is only a fractional owner cover; it gives no
       integral global absorber factor or correlated named-target packing.

       the authenticated round02 `114930` dual fan on the fixed
       distinct-base Hamming-two recut face, and has frozen the complete
       local-row census of that generator.

       other.  The complete unfiltered projection finds 67 recuts creating
       154 raw unselected seam occurrences.  The inverse creator--supplier
       join contains zero compatible nonanchor pairs.  Hence every breaker
       contains one of exactly 21 anchors: all nine central alternatives or

       The resulting product has 350,007 raw anchor--partner jobs, 184
       incompatible same-base jobs, 181 duplicate anchor--anchor generations
       and exactly 349,642 unique compatible banks.  The adopted complete

2593K. Lane K independently audited the facet-absorber mixed-star theorem.
       The canonical sufficiently-large positive result passes, with three
       proof-scope repairs now frozen in the source: the star reductions
       assume `k>=r+1`; the literal primitive module stays in its source
       regime `d>=2,c>=1` (hence `q=d+2>=4`); and discarding both Ferrers
       corrections uses the eventually valid inequality `c-1>d`, not merely
       `c>d`.

       Complementation identifies a facet block with a q-edge star in the
       complete `(k-r)`-uniform hypergraph.  The exact partial-simplex
       divisibility lattice has only the scalar row `q | W`; this is not a
       growing-pattern design existence theorem.  The explicit `(q+1)`-
       state common-core module is owner-simple and internally target-simple,
       and

         W=Aq+B(q+1),  B=W mod q,  0<=B<q

       whenever `W>=q^2-1`.  This removes scalar owner-count divisibility
       only; selecting a whole-layer mixed q/(q+1) decomposition remains the
       explicit external lemma of Section5.

       A maximal q-facet matching leaves at most

         (q-1)W/(r+1)

       owners.  For the canonical primitive coordinate,

         q A_(d+1)/W -> (pi/2) exp(-pi/4)=0.716...<0.717.

       Since the owner-packing capacity tends to one, every specified
       **owner-only** count `t<=A_(d+1)` has pairwise owner-disjoint length-q
       facet blocks for all sufficiently large canonical k.  This theorem is
       exact for the primitive owner projection but
       does not choose named targets, accommodate a preused owner bank, or
       allocate the `d` short buffers per primitive.  Item2597F corrects the
       physical buffered ledger and shows why `t=A_(d+1)` is not an
       inventory-feasibility statement.

       Owner and target selection cannot be separated.  For q>=5 there is
       an explicit family of m owner-disjoint blocks sharing a core C and a
       `(q-2)`-tag set I.  Every cyclic order emits at least q-4 rank-(c+2)
       targets from the common pool `{C union e:e in binom(I,2)}`.  Thus

         m(q-4)<=binom(q-2,2)

       is necessary for target simplicity.  The maximal family has
       `m=Theta(k)`, whereas the threshold is `Theta(q)=Theta(sqrt(k))`, so
       that particular owner matching is unlabelable for every cyclic order
       and every low parameter choice.  This refutes universal post-hoc
       labeling of an arbitrary owner matching; it does not say every owner
       matching fails or rule out co-designed block/order selection.

       For any positive-density selected matching, the potential-menu load
       obeys

         R >= (eta exp(pi/4)/4+o(1)) q^3.

       Hence the theorem's displayed symmetric independent-label LLL test,
       which needs `R=O(q^2)`, fails by order q, and a rule forbidding every
       potential overlap is a factor q too sparse.  This does not exclude
       every asymmetric, lopsided or correlated LLL argument.

       The exact live primitive row is joint selection of owner-disjoint
       facet blocks, cyclic orders and low parameters against the ACTUAL
       allocated residual/protected target bank.  Scalar capacities are not
       proved sufficient for an arbitrary allocation.  If such a joint
       interval-spread family exists, Corollary9.1 gives a zero-added-
       occurrence owner/target-simple lift of this primitive inventory only.
       Whole-layer owner factorization, other packages, component fusion,
       residence, upper decks, protected interfaces and compiler remain
       separate.  No O(1) conclusion is made.

           exact protected q1 rank defect)

        clean partner.  The seven dirty base-1834 anchors have seven

2597F. The facet interval-spread lane has corrected its primitive inventory
       and proved the exact sparse joint theorem.

       Put `q=d+2` and `c=r-d-1`.  A length-`q` literal facet module realizes

         g_(d-1,d+1) + d e_(d-1)
           = e_(d+1) + (q-1)e_(d-1),

       not the primitive package alone.  If `t` modules are used and `B` of
       them have length `q+1`, their exact resource consumption includes

         A_(d+1):       t,
         A_(d-1):       (q-1)t+B,
         slack L-H:     dt+B,
         rank c+2:      qt+B,
         owners:        qt+B.

       Hence every buffered realization satisfies

         t <= A_(d+1),
         (q-1)t+B <= A_(d-1),
         dt+B <= L-H,
         qt+B <= n_(c+2).

       Canonically `A_(d-1)/A_(d+1)->1`, and

         q^2 A_(d-1)/((q-1)W) -> (pi/2)e^(-pi/4).

       The buffer-coordinate ceiling is therefore `Theta(W/q^2)`, not
       `A_(d+1)=Theta(W/q)`.  The slack and other ledger rows may lower the
       actually available count.  The latter equality reading also independently
       fails the target capacity because

         q A_(d+1)/C(k,c+2) -> pi/2 > 1.

       There is an exact joint owner/order/label selection in the abstract
       candidate resource hypergraph at the smaller scale.  For
       `K_s=C(k,s)`, put

         Gamma = q^2/W + 1/K_c + 1/K_(c+1)
                 + sum_(j=2)^(q-2) q^2/K_(c+j).

       Exact transitivity gives these as the candidate resource-degree
       fractions.  Greedy selection proves every `(t-1)Gamma<1`, and the
       canonical estimate `Gamma<=17q^3/W` gives every

         t <= W/(18q^3)

       for all sufficiently large `k`.  An unavailable owner/target bank is
       admitted by the single weighted row `Psi+(t-1)Gamma<1` written in the
       theorem note.  Physical realization still requires the primitive and
       short-buffer occurrence bank and all ledger rows, especially
       `dt+B<=L-H`.  This row is primitive-module-only and does not imply
       OFHT.

       A one-shot fixed-uniformity nibble cannot be cited across the final
       factor-`q` gap.  In the owner-plus-high-target hypergraph, for `q>=5`
       and
       `P subset Q` of ranks `r-2,r-1`, respectively,

         deg(P,Q)/deg(Q)=2/(r-1),
         deg(P,Q)/deg(P)=2/(k-r+2).

       Its edge size is `R=q(q-2)`, so

         R deg(P,Q)/deg(Q) -> pi/2.

       More invariantly, for maximum degree `D=X_0q/K_(c+2)`,

         R Delta_2/D >=
           2q(q-2)K_(c+2)/((r-1)K_(r-1))
           -> (pi/2)e^(-pi/4) > 0.

       The natural object is a labelled multihypergraph; quotienting the
       uniform reversal duplicates leaves these ratios unchanged.

       Thus the nested-chain pair incidence is `Theta(1/(qW))`, not
       `O(q^4/W^2)`.  The relative codegree tends to zero only at reciprocal
       edge-size scale.  A specialized chain-contracted `q`-round nibble or
       an SCD chronology theorem is the exact remaining interval-spread gate;
       none is claimed.

2597F2. The facet interval-spread lane has proved a local prime-slope
         factor-`q` amplifier and isolated its exact global boundary.

         Choose a prime

           q/3-1 < p < 2q/3,

         put `s=q-p>=2` and `m=(p-1)/2`, and take one common core `C`, one
         common copy `I=F_p`, and pairwise disjoint private `s`-sets `X_[a]`
         indexed by nonzero slopes modulo sign.  In slope block `[a]`, start
         with the arithmetic cycle `0,a,...,(p-1)a` and insert two
         distinguished private tags in nonadjacent gaps.  Every common-pool
         interval then has length at most `p-2`.

         For a `j`-set `S` in `F_p`, the translation-invariant moment

           Phi(S)=j sum_(x in S)x^2-(sum_(x in S)x)^2
                 =a^2 j^2(j^2-1)/12

         is nonzero for `2<=j<=p-2` and recovers the progression step up to
         sign.  Private-tag intervals are block-private.  Thus the `m`
         modules have pairwise distinct owners and all named targets; their
         low rank-`c` and rank-`(c+1)` targets are separated by their two
         distinguished private tags.  The complete frame uses

           c+p+ms <= c+q+q^2/8 <= k

         coordinates for all sufficiently large canonical parameters.

         Its exact resource deck has `mq` rank-`r` owners, `m` targets at
         each of ranks `c,c+1`, and `mq` targets at every rank `c+j`,
         `2<=j<=q-2`.  Hence any `F` mutually resource-disjoint frames give
         `Fm` modules, and

           F=Omega(W/q^3)  implies  Fm=Omega(W/q^2).

         This is conditional: the required global family of
         `Omega(W/q^3)` frames is not proved, buffer reservation and all
         downstream OFHT rows remain separate, and no global conclusion is
         inferred.

         The pointed-flag contraction sharpens the comparison but does not
         remove that boundary.  Each module is one `q`-edge consisting of
         its `q` nested target-to-owner flags, so one prime-slope frame is a
         resource-conflict-free matching of `m=Theta(q)` such edges.  For
         the unrestricted base hypergraph,

           D=(c+2)(c+1)(k-r),
           Delta_2=c+1,
           q^2 Delta_2/D -> 0.

         These are single-edge completion statistics.  A generic matching
         need not preserve the common `(C,I)`, slope and private-set frame
         correlations; distinct flag vertices can also share a constituent
         resource, and the low ranks are outside the contraction.  Thus a
         `q`-round conflict-free nibble still needs a separate audited
         growing-uniformity theorem, or whole-frame degree/codegree bounds.

2597F3. The facet interval-spread lane has isolated the two low ranks after
         a fixed owner/high-simple module packing and proved their exact
         conditional Hall theorem.

         For module i put

           H_i={C_i+h:h in V_i},
           P_i(h)={(C_i-b)+w:b in C_i, w in V_i-{h}}.

         A complete low labeling exists iff there is an H-SDR `(h_i)` for
         which every module subfamily J satisfies

           |union_(i in J) P_i(h_i)| >= |J|.

         This is ordinary Hall; replacing union cardinality by matroid rank
         gives the exact Rado form.  The selected rank-c target uniquely
         recovers `(b_i,w_i)`, and membership in `P_i(h_i)` enforces
         `w_i!=h_i`.

         Let `Delta_H` and `Delta_P` be the maximum numbers of modules which
         offer one fixed H or unrestricted P target.  Incidence counting
         gives the robust sufficient certificate

           Delta_H <= q,
           Delta_P <= c(q-1).

         High simplicity alone supplies only

           Delta_H <= floor((k-c-1)/2),
           Delta_P <= floor(C(k-c,2)/2).

         Each occurrence of a low candidate supplies two distinct
         rank-(c+2) extensions through the cyclic neighbours of its tag;
         this proves the bounds.  Canonically they have orders r and r^2,
         so they do not imply the sufficient thresholds.

         The first threshold is exactly sharp.  For prime-power `q>=4`, put
         one module on every affine line of `F_q^2`, all over one common
         core.  Distinct lines meet in at most one point, so every owner and
         every high interval target is distinct.  There are `q(q+1)`
         modules but only `q^2` H targets, and every fixed H or P candidate
         occurs in `q+1` modules.  For `c>=2`, the P multiplicity condition
         still holds; only `Delta_H=q+1` breaks Hall.

         The note also freezes a smallest common-core `q=4` instance:
         twelve explicitly listed edge-disjoint four-cycles on eleven tags
         at `(k,r,c)=(16,8,5)`.  Its 48 owners and 48 rank-7 targets are
         distinct, but its twelve H menus have only eleven rank-6 targets.
         The point multiplicities are four or five, so again
         `Delta_H=q+1` while `Delta_P=5<=15`.  Edge counting rules out a
         tag union of size at most nine; at size ten, eleven four-cycles
         would leave one edge of K10 and contradict even degrees.  Hence
         eleven tags and twelve modules are minimal in this class.

         All named-resource and primitive-coordinate scalar rows of the
         `(16,8,5,4)` instance are slack.  The separate short-buffer row
         `24<=L-H` must still be supplied.  The result neither constructs
         the owner/high packing nor changes the prime-slope frame theorem,
         whose private tags already control both low ranks by design.

         theorem now has an exact contraction-flow formulation and its
         first sharp capacity obstructions.

         For a fixed perfect central matching M on ranks m,m+1 of
         B_(2m+1), label q->M(q)-a in D_M by departure a.  Length-d
         resident windows form an age-window lift.  A root/role-exact
         zero-one circulation in this lift is equivalent to a literal
         all-high cycle cover realizing the prescribed intersection chains;
         the ordinary root subtour cuts are exactly the one-Hamilton-cycle
         row.

         Every such flow obeys

           D_x = |{q:M(q)-q={x}}|
               <= floor(C(2m,m-1)/d).

         The equality is coordinate conservation and the inequality is the
         positive-run residence cap.  A prescribed fixed-depth deck jump
         S+{x}->S consumes one distinct x-departure.  Hence arbitrary
         antichain-valid chains are not serializable: cap+1 root-anchored
         chains give a no-go for every 2<=d<=m.  The smallest instance is
         k=5,m=d=2 with three chains; k=7,m=d=3 has a six-chain version
         using only proper targets.  Independently, no target-free
         depth-two resident Hamilton cycle of J(5,2) has rainbow adjacent
         unions.

         Cyclic parenthesis matching supplies a rotation-equivariant
         perfect central matching with exactly Cat_m added-coordinate edges
         of every label, and the central-extension theorem puts it in an
         SCD.  Conditional on a concrete Ferrers chain-to-root assignment,

           |R| <= sum_(x in union_(q in R) A_j(q)) c_x

         for every free-root family R.  These Hall cuts are necessary and
         sufficient and the network is TU.  Rotation-equivariant nonempty
         lists clear all of them integrally, one label of each coordinate
         per root orbit.  This is only the coordinate/departure layer.

         For `m>=3,d>=3`, the first exhibited loss of network TU is
         cross-depth rooted-window coupling, not coordinate capacity.
         Coupling two proper deck depths has the explicit three-column
         determinant-two minor in the theorem.  The head equations
         h(q,a)=M(q)-a, resident overlap, and subtour cuts are separate later
         rows and are not used in that minor.  At `d=2` the displayed minor
         is unavailable.  Fractional Ferrers symmetry does not produce the concrete
         equivariant lists needed by the positive corollary.  No canonical
         Ferrers OFHT factor, mixed-pull residence theorem, compiler, or

2601N. The growing-uniformity audit has closed the theorem-scope question
       for the pointed-flag contraction without claiming the global frame
       packing.

       For module data `(C,V,sigma)`, one pointed flag records its bottom
       `(c+2)`-set, all later singleton additions through its rank-`r`
       owner, but not the ordered first pair or the omitted predecessor.
       Hence its exact completion degree is

         D=(c+2)(c+1)(k-r).

       Adjacent flag bottoms meet in the core plus one common tag, giving
       exactly `c+1` completions; nonadjacent flags determine the core and
       order and have codegree at most one.  Therefore

         Delta_2=c+1,
         q^2 Delta_2/D=q^2/((c+2)(k-r))->0.

       More sharply, summing the `q` adjacent and all nonadjacent pair
       links inside one edge gives internal star overlap `O(q^-4)`.  The
       repository's growing-rank isolated-bite lemma therefore applies
       unconditionally to the plain flag hypergraph.  Plain flag matching
       was not the hard gate anyway: direct greedy selection supplies more
       than `W/q^2` complete-flag-disjoint module edges by the diverging
       factor `(r)_(q-1)/((c+2)(c+1))`.

       The contraction does not encode named-resource equality.  Distinct
       pointed flags can share one constituent target or owner.  A fixed
       high target lies in

         E q / binom(k,s)=exp(Theta(q log q))

       module edges, while `D=Theta(q^6)`.  Thus the pair-conflict degree
       for the actual resource packing is superpolynomial in the base
       degree, and all standard fixed-uniformity conflict-free black boxes
       remain out of scope.

       Gould--Kelly Theorems 1.4 and 1.6 do not repair this.  Their hierarchy
       fixes the uniformity, and the simple full codegree of the plain flag
       hypergraph gives the independent quantitative bottleneck

         B<=D^(1/(q-1))=1+o(1),

       making the stated polylogarithmic leftover bound trivial.  The
       explicit Alon--Bollobas--Kim--Vu growing-rank criterion fails because
       `e^(2q) Delta_2 log D/D -> infinity`.

       Finally, the exact product-residual calculation explains why the
       time-zero ratio cannot simply be iterated.  A bite of `Theta(W/q^3)`
       modules removes `Theta(q^-2)` of every high palette.  Conditional on
       one flag surviving, a completion still needs `(q-1)(q-2)` distinct
       pointed resources.  After `s=Theta(q)` product-like bites its
       expected residual degree is

         D(1-Theta(s/q^2))^((q-1)(q-2))
           =q^(6+o(1)) exp(-Theta(q))=o(1).

       This is not an impossibility theorem for correlated selection.  The
       exact remaining positive target is an `Omega(W/q^3)` packing of
       mutually resource-disjoint prime-slope frames, or an equivalent
       interval-spread/correlated-residual theorem; each proved frame then
       supplies `Theta(q)` modules.

2602B. The proposed shortcut that every collision of two prime-slope frames
       must cluster into `Omega(q)` coincident resources is false. Two
       frames may use the same core `C`, disjoint outside supports except
       for a private four-set `J`, and put `J` into one private gap block in
       the orders

         1234,   2413.

       Their two- and three-element interval-set families are disjoint,
       while the whole four-set is an interval in both. All intervals using
       an outside tag, all owners, and both low targets are different
       because the remaining supports are disjoint. Hence the full decks
       meet in exactly the one rank-`(c+4)` target `C union J`.

       The construction is legal for all sufficiently large canonical
       parameters: choose a prime `q/4-1<p<q/2`, so `s=q-p>=6`, and use
       `2(q+q^2/8)-4<k-c` to plant both supports. This leaves the global
       frame-packing conjecture open, but forces any clustered/transverse
       strategy to solve the singleton transverse class by a genuine
       interval-spread or correlated-residual theorem.

2605CF. The correlated-frame lane has replaced the local prime-slope
        amplifier by a fixed-base subset-core frame with exponentially many
        modules in `q`.

        Put `q=d+2`, `c=r-q+1`.  Partition

          [k]=D dotcup G dotcup V,
          |D|=a>=1, |V|=q,

        fix `beta in D`, an oriented cyclic order of `V`, and distinct
        `w,h in V`.  For every `X in binom(G,c-a)`, take the facet-module
        core `C_X=D union X` and literal source core

          K_X=(D-beta) union X.

        The standard length-`q` word has one `P`, `d+1` `H` states, one
        primitive `H`, and `d` short `H` buffers.  Every owner and every
        named target of this module has intersection with `G` exactly `X`.
        Thus all

          M_a=binom(k-a-q,c-a)

        modules are simultaneously owner-simple and target-simple at every
        required rank, including both low rows.  The same order and low tags
        may be reused; no slope moment, private tag partition, or low Hall
        matching is needed.

        The common deleted point is essential.  Deleting a varying element
        of `X` would lose recovery of `X` in the primitive-P target.  Sharing
        `V` does not share occurrences: one frame consumes exactly

          e_(d+1):M_a, e_(d-1):(q-1)M_a, L-H:dM_a,

        with named rows `M_a,M_a,qM_a,...,qM_a`.  Hence no source-capacity
        row is evaded.

        The ratio `M_(a+1)/M_a=(c-a)/(k-a-q)` is below one, so `a=1` is
        optimal.  There

          M_1=binom(k-q-1,c-1),
          M_1/W ~ 2^(-(q+1)) exp(-pi/16).

        Therefore a physically requested `Theta(W/q^2)` primitive bank has
        the formal local quotient

          Theta(2^q/q^2)

        singleton-base frames plus at most one partial frame.  The old
        `k-r=Theta(q^2)` marker frame is the special case `a=c-1`; the
        prime-slope frame has only `Theta(q)` modules.

        This maximum local quotient is **not** a viable prelabelled global
        packing.  Writing `B_i=D_i-beta_i`, the primitive-P deck is exactly

          {S in C([k],c): B_i union {w_i} subset S,
                           S cap ({beta_i} union (V_i-w_i))=empty}.

        Two such cylinders have the exact mandatory/forbidden intersection
        criterion.  Within one fixed `B`, pairwise disjointness forces the
        distinguished tags to be distinct and orients every pair by
        `w_j in F_i` or `w_i in F_j`.  Each frame has outdegree at most q,
        so a fixed-B family has at most `2q+1` frames.  Globally,

          number of prelabelled a-frames <=(2q+1) C(k,a-1).

        Hence `a=1` permits only `2q+1=o(2^q/q^2)` frames and is ruled out.
        If `U_a` is this frame bound times `M_a`, then for

          a=lambda q/log q+O(1),
          log(U_a/W)=(lambda-log 2)q+o(q).

        Thus bases below `(log 2-o(1))q/log q` are also insufficient by
        this exact low-cylinder capacity, while bases above
        `(log 2+o(1))q/log q` merely clear that necessary scalar test.

        The owner deck gives a stronger no-go throughout the small-base
        range.  For omitted tags v,v', two owner cylinders collide exactly
        when the mandatory sets are cross-compatible and their union has
        size at most r.  If `a_i+a_j+2q-2<=r`, this simplifies to:

          complete frames i,j are owner-disjoint iff
          V_i cap V_j=empty and
          (V_i subset D_j or V_j subset D_i).

        Hence a uniform small-base family has pairwise disjoint tag sets,
        at most `floor(k/q)` frames, and at most

          O(qW/2^q)=o(W/q^2)

        modules.  In particular the low-cylinder threshold still lies in a
        provably impossible complete-reservoir range.  A complete frame
        approach would have to jump to `a>(r-2q+2)/2=Theta(k)`; no no-go is
        claimed there.

        Partial reservoirs have an exact cross-conflict decomposition.  For
        two fixed frames, every pair of omitted owner tags is one partial
        matching, and every pair of cyclic intervals at one high rank is
        one partial matching.  Thus owner/high conflict is the union of

          Q=q^2(q-2)

        partial matchings; fixed P,H add two.  Every module conflicts with
        at most Q modules in the other reservoir.  The two-reservoir optimum
        is exactly `|R_i|+|R_j|-nu(H_ij)` by Konig, while the multi-reservoir
        problem is the named-resource set-packing ILP.  Different orders on
        the same D,V already contain the identity owner matching X<->X, so
        pairwise degree and internal simplicity alone force no accumulated
        gain.  The exact live target is a correlated choice of frame
        signatures and partial core-index families with total
        `Omega(W/q^2)`; the current unconditional general bound remains the
        earlier `W/(18q^3)` joint greedy extraction.

        Two global routes remain proof-safe: pack prelabelled frames with
        larger or mixed bases, or pack only owners/high decks and choose
        `b,w,h` afterward using the exact low-rank Hall theorem.  The latter
        still needs its Hall/multiplicity hypotheses; high simplicity alone
        is insufficient by the affine-line counterexample.

        Pairwise resource disjointness between different fixed-base frames,
        aggregate primitive/short-buffer allocation, physical chronology,
        component fusion, upper shadows, global residence and compiler
        remain open.  No all-k upper bound follows.

2608MR. The fixed-base subset-core amplifier has now been audited across
        different reservoirs.  For a frame `(D,V,beta,sigma,w,h)`, every
        individual row occurrence is exactly a partial-assignment cylinder

          Q_s(R,F)={S in binom([k],s):R subset S, S cap F=empty}.

        The choices are `(D-beta)+w / beta+(V-w)` for primitive `P`,
        `D+h / (V-h)` for primitive `H`, `D+J / (V-J)` for a cyclic
        interval, and `D+(V-v) / v` for an owner.  Therefore the exact
        collision tensor between any two frames is

          |Q_s(R,F) cap Q_s(R',F')|
            = 1[(R union R') cap (F union F')=empty]
              binom(k-|R union R'|-|F union F'|,
                    s-|R union R'|).

        Same-rank cylinders inside one frame are disjoint, and every common
        resource recovers a unique module on each side, so this is also the
        exact bipartite module-conflict multiplicity tensor.

        The tensor refutes the proposed intact-frame packing.  For
        singleton bases, if `r>=2q` and `k-r>=2`, any two frames have
        compatible owner facets with required union at most `2q` and only
        two forbidden omissions.  Hence they share an owner.  Canonically
        this holds for all sufficiently large `k`, so at most one whole
        maximum reservoir can be selected, not `Theta(2^q/q^2)`.

        The exact `k=17,q=5,c=5` boundary is also closed.  Each singleton
        reservoir contains `binom(11,4)=330` modules and has row sizes
        `330,330,1650,1650,1650` at ranks `5,...,9`.  The owner intersection
        vanishes exactly when the tag sets are disjoint, the markers are
        distinct, and neither marker is a tag of the other frame.  Then the
        entire six-coordinate supports are disjoint, and the residual
        collision spectrum is exactly

          rank 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9: 10 / 10 / 125 / 25 / 0.

        Thus no two intact 330-module reservoirs coexist; the ten common
        primitive-P targets alone form a ten-edge module matching and force
        at least ten module deletions.

        There is also a first exact partial extraction.  For two frames on
        disjoint six-coordinate supports, all cross-colliding first-frame
        module indices form four disjoint profile layers:

          P / H / rank7 / rank8: 10 / 10 / 25 / 5.

        Deleting these 50 modules on one side and retaining all 330 modules
        on the other gives 610 pairwise owner/target-disjoint modules.  A
        rowwise matching of sizes `10+10+25+5=50` proves by Koenig that this
        deletion is optimal.  Thus a three-frame 973-module extraction must
        use three pairwise intersecting supports: any disjoint support pair
        plus an intact third frame is capped at `610+330=940`.  The note
        gives the exact all-parameter analogue `B_perp` in (7.7).

        A complementary ceiling rules out the simplest iteration.  If many
        frames are separated only by disjoint exact traces of their
        persistent core on a common marker bank, Vandermonde gives total
        size at most `M_1=binom(k-q-1,c-1)`, exactly one reservoir.  At k17
        that ceiling is 330.  Therefore the 610 gain genuinely uses
        row-dependent collision clustering, and reaching the target 973
        requires a three/four-frame cylinder transversal or another
        correlated ownership rule.

        The asymptotic cylinder transversal is now solved at the required
        order.  For singleton supports `A,A'`, put `E=A'-A`.  Every resource
        of a module `X` has outside-`A` trace exactly `X`; membership in one
        second-frame occurrence cylinder `(R',F')`, where
        `R' dotcup F'=A'`, therefore forces

          X cap E = R' cap E.

        Only `L=q^2-2q+2` traces arise, one per second-frame occurrence
        cylinder; the `q` first-frame starts do not add a factor.  Uniformly,
        a prescribed trace on `b` coordinates occupies at most
        `C 2^-b` of a reservoir.  Independent random `(q+1)`-supports have
        the exact bounded moment

          E 2^|A cap A'|
            = sum_t binom(q+1,t)(q+1)_t/(k)_t = O(1).

        Hence an ordered random frame pair has expected bad-module count
        `O(M_1 q^2/2^q)`.  Sample
        `R=floor(2^q/(4Cq^2))` frames and delete every module colliding with
        any module of any other sampled frame.  Ordered-pair overcounting is
        safe, its expectation is at most `RM_1/4`, and the survivors are
        pairwise resource-disjoint.  Since
        `M_1~2^(-(q+1))exp(-pi/16)W`, at least
        `Omega(W/q^2)` completely labelled modules remain.

        An independent stress-test verified the collision-to-trace step for
        `P,H`, every high interval rank and owners, the uniform trace
        constant, exact overlap moment and multiple-frame deletion
        accounting.  This closes the former factor-`q` owner/named-target
        packing gate at order scale.  It does not give an arbitrary leading
        constant or protected-bank version, allocate source primitives or
        short buffers, serialize/fuse components, or prove the upper,
        residence or compiler interfaces.

2616CYL. The post-pruning Johnson-connectivity row is now sharply separated.
        On one fixed outside support, the exact trace quotient is the Boolean
        cube with each level completed to a Johnson graph.  Deleting `s`
        trace cylinders leaves one quotient component of order at least
        `2^b-(b+1)s`; its physical lift is connected, and the exact number of
        lifted adjacent-core sockets is frozen for both cover and same-level
        trace edges.  Hence one opposing frame, with `s=O(q^2)`, removes only
        an exponentially small amount from the giant of one reservoir.
        Pairwise-disjoint supports whose total size is below the central
        outside buffer have an exact connected product giant with loss
        `O(sum_i |E_i|s_i2^(-|E_i|))`; this reaches only `O(n/q)` supports,
        not the exponentially many overlapping sampled supports.

        This cannot be iterated from density alone.  Periodic trace-level
        deletion uses `O(2^b/b^(1/4))` cylinders and `O(b^(-1/4))` core mass
        while forcing every fixed union of components to have
        `O(b^(-1/4))` mass.  More concretely, an authenticated facet-menu
        construction defeats common-base conditioning: choose `Theta(q)`
        opposing singleton frames with the same beta and pairwise disjoint
        outside q-sets.  Their actual owner co-singleton rows delete only
        `O(q^3 2^-q)=o(1)` of the base reservoir but make the full-trace bit
        on every outside q-set component-invariant, yielding
        `2^Theta(q)` survivor components.  All supports meet at beta, so the
        support-intersection graph is a clique.  These extra components may
        be tiny, so a random-support `1-o(1)` giant remains possible.

        In the genuine independent-support distribution, all outside
        supports are distinct and have pairwise overlap `O(q/log q)` whp.
        A fixed core is deleted with probability `O(alpha)` and a fixed
        Johnson edge is separated with probability `O(alpha/q)` at sampling
        rate `alpha 2^q/q^2`.  The periodic separator has these same first-
        moment orders, so average density/degree remains insufficient.  The
        exact random gate is separator anti-cover: no positive-measure
        survivor set may have its entire external Johnson boundary inside
        the sampled cylinder union.

        More sharply, even a proved Johnson giant would not finish physical
        fusion.  For distinct packet cores every pure mixed window has
        outside trace `X union Y`, never old trace `X` or `Y`; hence no
        adjacent-core pure splice is protected-chain transparent.  The
        unique fixed-phase all-width rank-correct open port is a co-oriented
        same-odd-tag `H-H` kissing seam.  Its labels are fresh, and one cut
        in each alternating cycle leaves a second `P`-endpoint seam that
        cannot be rank-correct at all widths.  A labelled ambient duplicate
        bank, prospective unmarked port, or source-changing multi-core
        cancellation packet is indispensable.

        Thus the old target splits into two independent theorems: random
        transverse-cylinder separator anti-cover and a labelled chronology
        converter.  Connectivity alone is no longer a sufficient bridge.

2620K. Lane K has rebased the corrected stationary pull clock onto an exact
       integral coloured-rotor face and separated the remaining correlation
       from post-rounding topology.

       For any exact table assigning one strict named-target chain of length
       at most `d` to every rank-`r` owner, each owner-chain has a literal
       Cartesian hinge rectangle of de Bruijn traces.  The owner and every
       declared lower-target occurrence are constant over the rectangle.  If
       one protected root path is fixed and the residual rational balance is
       supported inside these rectangles, a lower-bounded network with one
       fixed-unit owner arc per role rounds it integrally.  Thus this face
       selects one trace per owner and one occurrence of every named lower
       target without an integer gap.

       The fixed-head specialization is exact, not merely sufficient.  For
       occurrence roles `i` with fixed heads `h_i`, let

         a(v)=|{i:h_i=v}|.

       Literal balance is precisely a capacitated role-to-tail matching with
       demand `a(v)`, hence iff

         |X| <= sum_(v in N(X)) a(v)

       for every role set `X`.  A connected selection exists iff distinct
       legal role options contain a spanning-tree skeleton `R` and the
       residual role graph passes the same Hall inequalities with exact
       demands `a-b_R`.  Pinned roles retain the original all-role head
       vector, subtract their literal tail-use vector, and are contracted
       only in the graphic row.  On the rigid full-depth, globally distinct
       face, `a=1`; the criterion is exactly a directed cycle cover in the
       explicit predecessor graph, and zero-sidecar chronology is exactly a
       Hamilton cycle.

       After any integral labelled selection, tail-fixed rerouting factors
       into independent bipartite perfect matchings indexed by the literal
       `(d-1)`-letter spine.  A cyclic admissible head permutation, connected
       transparent spine-pool incidence, or protected transparent fusion
       tree merges all Euler components into one rooted circuit while
       preserving every owner and named target.  Disconnected pool incidence
       is an exact obstruction only for that move class.  If fusion stops,
       the exact sidecar is the sum of `d-overlap` reset distances; `O(1)`
       components alone gives only `O(d)`, not `O(1)`.

       Generic fractional-to-integral rounding is false (determinant-two,
       `K4`, saturated-age and off-central even-`r=2` examples), so the pull
       clock and SCD marginal selectors cannot simply be intersected.  The
       single proof-safe remaining lower-side lemma is the **triangular
       rooted hinge-tree lemma**: choose one owner/target-exact static flag
       table, one protected root and guarded literal options whose
       role-to-tail graph has a Hall-safe spanning-tree skeleton (equivalently
       on the broader hinge face, root-conditioned integral flow plus a
       transparent fusion certificate).  This would give zero sidecar.
       Upper interval decks, residence, exterior chronology and the terminal
       common-cap compiler remain separate unless encoded literally in the
       option menus.

2622K. Lane K has attacked the Hall-safe-tree lemma directly and obtained
       the sharp cutwise criterion, a zero-charge absorber face, an exact
       Boolean uniform-fibre reserve, and two literal obstructions to a
       generic matroid/degree proof.

       Fix a static owner/target-exact table.  Role `i` has fixed head
       `h_i`, legal tail list `N(i)` and head-demand

         a(v)=|{i:h_i=v}|.

       For a tail shore `Y`, define

         f(Y)=|{i:N(i) subseteq Y}|,
         kappa(Y)=a(Y)-f(Y).

       The base table is matchable iff `kappa(Y)>=0` for every `Y`.
       The function `kappa` is submodular and its zero shores form a lattice.
       If a distinct-role tree reservation `R` uses tails `t_i`, its exact
       escape charge is

         chi_R(Y)=|{i in R:t_i in Y, N(i) not subseteq Y}|.

       The reservation is Hall-safe iff

         b_R(v)<=a(v) for every v,
         chi_R(Y)<=kappa(Y) for every Y.

       This is necessary and sufficient, not a relaxation.  On a tight
       shore, selected tails in `Y` are exactly the roles whose full lists
       lie in `Y`; the crossing role labels are forced by the two sets
       `F_Y={i:N(i) subseteq Y}` and `H_Y={i:h_i in Y}`.  If `F_Y=H_Y` for
       one proper nonempty tight shore, every balanced selector is
       disconnected.  Conversely, a distinct-role spanning bank of
       singleton-tail sockets has `chi_R identically 0` and is an exact
       zero-charge absorber.

       Extendable partial matchings are not a matroid already on `K_(2,2)`.
       On the saturated `dW` face, every head is rigid and distinct, and a
       Hall-safe tree exists iff the ordered predecessor digraph has a
       directed Hamilton cycle.  Even strict `+1` Hall expansion on every
       proper role set, minimum degree two and strong connectivity do not
       suffice: the three-role bow tie

         N(1)={1,2}, N(2)={1,2,3}, N(3)={2,3}

       has only the identity and adjacent-transposition matchings.  A second
       literal Boolean family has eight exact depth-two owner/target roles
       and `2^(s+2)` legal leading letters per role, yet ordered spine
       matching leaves exactly two disjoint directed `C4`s.  Thus raw
       Boolean menu size cannot control chronology.

       Boolean containment still supplies a precise positive face.  In the
       complete rank-`a`/rank-`b` fibre of an `n`-set, put

         D=binom(n-a,b-a), E=binom(b,a), g=gcd(D,E),
         p=D/g role copies, q=E/g head-capacity copies.

       For a head shore `Y` and
       `Z(Y)={K:N(K) subseteq Y}`, its exact Hall charge is

         kappa(Y)
           = q|Y-N(Z)| + e(L-Z,N(Z))/g.

       Hence only the empty and full cuts are tight, and every proper cut
       has at least one integral unit.  A reserved tree is Hall-safe exactly
       when `u_R(Y)-r_R(Z(Y))<=kappa(Y)` on every `Y`; in particular the
       cutwise one-charge condition is sufficient.  Sparse canonical head
       banks are not complete fibres, so this does not finish the table.

       The occurrence-level rail theorem identifies the missing structure.
       Fixed heads factor into spine-conditioned Boolean interval graphs.
       Fibre Hall is exact; minimum role degree at least maximum head-token
       degree is one easy sufficient test.  More powerfully, if the rail
       multigraph is balanced and connected and every local transition
       fibre is complete, any rail Euler tour is a literal owner/target-
       exact Hamilton rotor with zero sidecar.  Local alternating rectangles
       give the weaker absorber form; Woodall's directed Ore inequality is
       an independent degree-pair sufficient face.  The standard `B7` SCD
       dead flag is only root/target exact before owner assignment, but it
       correctly proves that unordered Boolean degree does not imply rail
       Hall.

       Therefore no unconditional canonical skeleton is claimed.  The
       exact remaining lower lemma is now the **ordered spine-spread
       absorber**: choose the canonical owner/target-exact table together
       with either a cut-charge-respecting distinct-role tree, or a cycle
       cover with payload-transparent rectangles joining all cycles.
       Complete local fibres, the Woodall face, and singleton-tail private
       sockets are rigorous sufficient subclasses.  Upper interval decks,
       residence, exterior opening and common-cap/compiler feasibility stay
       separate.

             -> (4165,6460,8806,18632).

       order has topology 1->1->1 but temporarily changes N+ as
       4199->4233->4165.  Thus the witness needs temporary lex-primary
       residence debt but does not force temporary topology debt.  The eight
       removed quotient edges strictly interlace, so the gain is a union-port
       effect and cannot be obtained by adding primitive residence deltas.

       existence of a decreasing packet; certified list/load bounds give the
       practical sufficient inequality.  Raw Boolean circuit degree omitting

       Write an oriented Middle Levels Hamilton cycle as

         T_i --p_i--> X_(i+1) --q_i--> T_(i+1),

       where p_i is the deleted coordinate and q_i the inserted coordinate.
       If q_i=x and p_j=x is the next flip of x, then x occurs in exactly
       the projected owners T_(i+1),...,T_j, and hence

         run_x = (dist(q_i,p_j)+1)/2.

       Therefore depth-d positive residence is equivalent to every oriented
       insertion-to-next-deletion same-label gap being at least 2d+1.  The
       dual zero-run threshold is 2d+3.  The Middle Levels projection already
       gives every rank-(r-1) q1 colour exactly once, so a (2d+1)-long-run
       Middle Levels cycle would close topology, lower q1 and residence at
       once.  This is only a residence reduction: rank-(r+1) unions, deeper
       upper shadows, literal source factorization and the compiler remain
       separate.  For k17 it also gives an exact oriented-motif CEGAR
       interface, weaker than imposing symmetric all-pairs label spacing.

2626K. The private closing-port gate now has a sharp answer.  A strict
       central one-copy rectangle is impossible, but one reusable
       rank-defect-one aperture gives an exact regenerative escape.

       Fix a common ordered rail `w`, put `R=union(w)`, and write

         Q_i=R union c_i

       for the support of the predecessor token of port i.  If two ports
       with distinct rank-r owners T_0,T_1 admit both crossed assignments,
       then

         Q_0 union Q_1 subseteq T_0 cap T_1.

       Hence two rank-(r-1) supports must satisfy

         Q_0=Q_1=T_0 cap T_1.

       In a strict q1-simple one-copy table this repeats a lower colour, so
       NO nondegenerate pair of ordinary central ports can splice.  This
       rules out any correction bank consisting only of such ports,
       regardless of its size or the Middle-Levels flip gaps.  More
       generally, with e_i=(r-1)-|Q_i|,

         |Q_0 triangle Q_1| <= e_0+e_1.

       The inequality is sharp.  Its smallest escape is a nested
       defect-(1,0) pair.

       The complete occurrence-level port algebra is also exact.  For a
       rail w, form the bipartite graph B_w between predecessor-token
       occurrences ending in w and closing roles beginning in w.  Two
       ports splice iff they are opposite edges of one occurrence-labelled
       K_(2,2); the crossed edges are the possible parent ports.  Therefore
       rail support is hereditary, and every ordinary correction lineage
       stays inside one C4-generated edge component.  Membership in that
       component is necessary but is not sufficient without fresh catalyst
       occurrences.

       A complete port box L x G has the exact sandwich test

         union_(g in G) P_g subseteq cap_(p in L) c_p,
         union_(p in L) c_p subseteq cap_(g in G) T_g.

       Boxes are regenerative:

         (L_0 x G_0),(L_1 x G_1)
             -> L_0 x G_1 or L_1 x G_0.

       Two fresh copies of a target box reset both endpoints of an arbitrary
       compatible active box; one copy can reset only one endpoint.  This
       gives an exact port-count/state recurrence, not a marginal count.

       The minimal positive construction is explicit.  Choose |R|=r-3,
       distinct b,a_0,...,a_(s+1), and one ordered rail w with union R.  Put

         c_*= {b},              Q_*=R+{b},
         c_j= {b,a_j},          Q_j=R+{b,a_j},
         T_j=R+{b,a_j,a_(j+1)}, P_j={b}.

       Starting with p_* -> g_0, splice the child p_j -> g_j and always
       retain p_* as the new closing predecessor.  The exact crossed tests
       are

         c_j subseteq T_(j-1),  c_* subseteq T_j.

       Thus the same aperture token performs every merge.  For
       r>=d+2 and 1<=s<=r-1, all displayed rank-r owners and all ordinary
       rank-(r-1) lower supports are pairwise distinct; Q_* is the sole
       rank-(r-2) support.  Adding a fresh z to one common rail block and
       every owner raises r by one, preserves every cap equation and keeps
       the defect exactly one.  This is an infinite same-parity
       regenerative PORT-STATE family.

       Equivalently, for a fixed anchor c_*, put an arc g_i->g_j when

         c_j in [P_i,T_i] and c_* in [P_j,T_j].

       A prescribed collection of children admits the anchored sequential
       merge iff this digraph has a directed Hamilton path from the anchor
       role.  This is the weakest exact port-diversity condition on the
       anchored face.

       The one remaining lower recursive lemma is now sharply scoped:
       embed this suspended aperture/path state into both complete Pascal

2629K. Lane K has composed the persistent Pascal aperture with the
       monotone one-cell pivot and folded the directed-history master into
       the resulting regenerative state.  The exact conclusion has one
       negative correction and one positive conditional bridge.

       For the literal pivot block, the post-insertion owner path is

         M_0=X+alpha+ell+lambda[1,d-1],
         M_j=X+alpha+lambda[1,d-j]+rho[1,j]  (1<=j<d),
         M_d=X+alpha+mu+rho[1,d-1].

       but the final native lower colour is

         J=M_(d-1) cap M_d=Q_*+alpha.

       Therefore the proposed automatic repayment by the opposite fan is
       FALSE: the literal block has no interval equal to J.  The left fan
       N=X+alpha+lambda[1,d-1] already existed at shorter width and is only
       promoted to the exact head width.  The pivot preserves every old
       interval-OR witness, but by itself is compiler-neutral rather than a
       Hall improvement.

       There is nevertheless an exact exterior discharge port.  With
       R={rho_1,...,rho_(d-1)}, x_0 in X and fresh nu, use

         c_*=X,             c_1=X+alpha,
         D_0=(X-x_0)+ell+alpha,
         T_0=X+R+ell+alpha,
         D_1=(X-x_0)+alpha+nu,
         T_1=X+R+alpha+nu.

       Both cap endpoints are `{x_0}`, both crossed containments hold, and
       the ordinary child support is R+c_1=J.  This is a literal protected
       occurrence outside the pivot block.  If the aperture transition is
       the actual globally opened owner edge, its omitted colour is J and
       the same exterior occurrence discharges both the aperture debt and
       the path endpoint colour.  If the transition remains internal, those
       are two distinct obligations.

       The correction does not accumulate with dimension.  Any carried
       central value widehat(H) can be installed as the left fan and changed
       into exactly one next aperture debt J'.  Rank and depth suspension
       preserve that one-debt state.  This proves a conditional `B+1`, hence
       `B+O(1)`, bridge provided a global owner/target-exact Pascal host:
       (i) opens precisely the aperture edge; (ii) embeds the exterior J
       occurrence; (iii) transports the full lower matching in one common
       cap; and (iv) rebuilds two children with exactly one active star.
       Naive concatenation of two separately charged children retains two
       stars and is not a length recurrence.

       Residence now has an exact closed state rather than a raw blocker
       list.  A directed Johnson transition `(a,b)` acts on the newest-first
       insertion history by

         tau_(a,b)(h_1,...,h_d)=(b,h_1,...,h_(d-1))

       exactly when `a` is absent from the history.  Path relations compose;
       a cyclic chronology is positive-resident exactly when its relation
       has a consistent fixed point.  For paths of length at least d, the

       following edge can delete mu immediately.  The all-k protected state

       their exact collars), as well as payload, rail/cap and topology.

       This specializes exactly to the k17 three-history master because

       The finite k17 CNF is only a calibrated sufficient face: connectivity,

2630A. Lane A has converted the phase-free k17 history master into an exact
       pull-ear state theorem, and has isolated the obstruction to treating
       that finite state as a bounded all-depth recursive interface.

       Put q=2r-1.  The rank-r owner action of Z_q is free, since
       gcd(q,r)=1, so every directed quotient dart carries its physical phase
       intrinsically.  In canonical owner frames a dart

         e=(u,v;a_e,beta_e,delta_e)

       acts on the newest-first depth-d insertion history by

         U_e(h_1,...,h_d)
           =(beta_e,h_1-delta_e,...,h_(d-1)-delta_e),

       with event cost

         kappa_e(h)=1[a_e in {h_1,...,h_d}].

       On any selected equivariant quotient cycle cover, the sum of these
       costs is exactly the number of bad transition orbits, and its full
       development has q times as many bad physical occurrences.  Zero cost
       is equivalent to every positive coordinate run having length at
       least d+1.  For an exact weighted run potential through intermediate
       short components, one must additionally retain the component-length
       and constant-present-core token; the event register alone is exact
       only for zero-versus-positive feasibility.

       Directed ears form a weighted semigroupoid.  If M_P records the
       deterministic history transformation and accumulated event cost of
       an ear P, then M_(PQ)=M_P tensor M_Q in the min-plus semiring, and a
       closed component has debt min_h M_C(h,h).  A proof-safe event collar
       needs only the first d framed transitions, the last d insertions, the
       total frame transport, and the internal event debt.  An ear of length
       at least d resets its output history, but its first-d guard cost still
       depends on the incoming history, so tail reset alone is not a
       regenerative existence theorem.

       Arbitrary opening/reversal requires the bi-history socket

         Omega=(past insertions, future deletions).

       Reversal exchanges the two halves and negates voltage.  Thus an
       orientation-free packet exports the forward and reverse ear
       relations; one-sided insertion history is insufficient.  In the
       co-oriented case, changing s connector darts can affect only the
       first d successor owners after the new heads, giving an exact sd-row
       locality bound before overlaps (3d for C6 and 4d for C8).

       This makes the earlier two-pull/packet theorem rigorous on a fixed
       history face.  Freeze a canonical history assignment h and let G_h
       contain exactly the darts satisfying U_e(h(u))=h(v).  Every directed
       one-factor in G_h preserves h, event debt is a linear dart cost, and
       a resource-zero circuit has the literal sum of its inserted costs
       minus deleted costs, plus the explicit whole-component correction.
       Consequently the prepared-tree/MST descent remains valid when all
       candidate pulls lie in one G_h, their resource/cap ledgers return,
       and overlapping supports are replayed by exact symmetric difference.
       Without a common h, connector weights are state-dependent and the
       correct replacement is a relation-labelled gluing-tree dynamic
       program, not a scalar MST.

       The state form is uniform in d but its information is not bounded.
       Zero-debt owner histories already distinguish at least binom(r,d)
       recently inserted d-sets.  More sharply, truncation from depth d+1
       histories to depth d has no transition-equivariant section: the
       omitted oldest label is the next datum shifted into the guard, and
       two histories with the same first d-1 registers but different last
       register force contradictory section values.  Therefore three labels
       are exact for k17 depth3 but fail at depth4.  A growing-depth induction
       must export the new oldest label, retain a longer past/future socket,
       or use a certified reset whose entrance guard domain is also
       controlled.

       This closes the state interface, not the supply theorem.  Still open
       are existence of a negative protected circuit/ear packet, literal
       upper-q1 cap multiset return (cap orbits may be shortened), topology
       and unit voltage, deeper upper shadows, source/erosion, and the common
       compiler.  The finite k17 master remains an exact d=3 SAT face only;
       no SAT/UNSAT or all-k existence conclusion is inferred.

2632A. Lane A has integrated the heptagonal `C14` supply theorem with the
       protected Pascal/pull-ear recurrence.  Raw central packet supply is
       no longer the local target; the exact selectable object is a
       cap-balanced, bi-history-completed ticket.

       For a literal upper cap U let L(U) be its current multiplicity and
       put s(U)=L(U)-1.  A packet Z has signed cap change

         Delta_Z(U)=number of new U rows - number of old U rows.

       The exact support and multiset rows are respectively

         s + sum_Z Delta_Z >= 0 coordinatewise,
         sum_Z Delta_Z = 0.

       Equivalently orient each changed cap as old -> new.  Decomposing the
       transfer digraph into cycles and open paths proves that the minimum
       passive backup count is

         b(Z)=sum_U (-Delta_Z(U))_+
             = ||Delta_Z||_1/2.

       Cycles need no backup; every open-path source spends one surplus unit
       and its sink receives the replacement unit.  Thus cap surplus is a
       transported state, not unexplained slack.  For an ordered compound,
       support at every intermediate step is exactly prefix nonnegativity;
       terminal-only support is weaker.  Shortened cap orbits require the
       literal developed or stabilizer-weighted ledger, not unweighted
       quotient counts.

       The authenticated k17 2,822 -> 2,754 packet has voltage 5 mod 17,
       four transported cap orbits and three open cap paths.  Its removed
       orbit representatives 13783,27447,28075 each have load two, and the
       surplus credits move to 13727,28331,43755.  Hence b=3 in the free
       quotient, or 51 literal physical backup occurrences.  Immediate
       upper support is exact, but the cap multiset is not returned.

       The residence coordinate is orthogonal.  The completed ticket stores
       the forward/reverse history morphism of every retained ear, its
       connector labels and frames, whole-component tokens, and every reset
       entrance domain as well as its constant output.  For seven long,
       co-oriented ears, the seven positive seam-collar inequalities and
       their deletion-dual inequalities are necessary and sufficient.
       Coprime voltage changes the developed topology but introduces no
       extra history phase on free owner orbits.  Reversed or short ears use
       their full literal bi-history relations.

       These coordinates form an exact fixed-depth product state

         (factor/ports, cap surplus, voltage, component permutation,
          positive/negative history relations, whole-component tokens,
          protected/exterior occurrences).

       A finite completed-ticket catalogue has an exact zero-one
       circulation formulation: choose each private task once, conserve
       internal history states, obey cap-surplus and occurrence capacities,
       and impose the declared topology/voltage and connected root.  This is
       a characterization, not an integrality theorem.  On a common G_h the
       history costs are scalar and the prepared-tree/MST descent applies;
       otherwise the recurrence is a relation-labelled gluing-tree DP.

       The quantitative sufficient supply theorem is now sharp.  If every
       admitted task/socket fibre has Omega(k^7) completed tickets, each
       ticket uses O(d) nonprivate resources, and each resource has load
       O(k^6) (equivalently total conflict degree O(d k^6)), fixed-H greedy
       planting works whenever H d=o(k).  These completed-ticket hypotheses

       A bounded-load twisted subatlas or a private matching of moving

       The source heptagon note was also narrowed at its exact boundary:

       theorem and sharpened its protected Pascal interface to an exact
       cap-prefix/history product monoid with a literal local backup-ticket
       selector.  This confirms the rebase: raw central `C14` supply is

       All cap-current statements are literal physical-cap statements, or

       stabilizer weights or physical expansion.  For packet P define

         Delta_P(U)=terminal new-minus-old multiplicity at cap U,
         b_P(U)=max over prefixes of the negative cumulative current.

       Then initial duplicate slack s keeps every prefix upper-complete iff

         s >= b_P coordinatewise.

       These data compose exactly:

         Delta_(AB)=Delta_A+Delta_B,
         b_(AB)=max(b_A,b_B-Delta_A).

       A balanced regenerative cap word has Delta=0 and b<=s.  For one
       simultaneous circuit its minimum duplicate demand is

         beta=sum_U(-Delta(U))_+=||Delta||_1/2.

       On the exact cap-multiset face the occurrence transport is a wreath

       Natural successor transport with a preserved extension role forces

         z_i=rho^(a_i)z_(i+1), hence z_0=rho^h z_0.

       A free cyclic action therefore forces h=0 on that face.  Coprime

       The global repeat scalar is favorable but insufficient.  For
       `k=2r-1`, every upper-complete degree-two owner factor has exactly

         sum_U(M(U)-1)=2W/(r+1), W=binom(2r-1,r),

       duplicate cap units.  Since one cap has load at most r+1, at least
       `ceil(2W/[r(r+1)])` physical caps repeat.  At k17 this is4862
       physical or286 quotient units, with at least32 repeated quotient
       caps; the authenticated terminal factor has160.  This does not put

       The k17 2,822->2,754 C14 is the exact calibration.  It has h=5,

       `13783,27447,28075`, and adds one at each of

       The local history-address row is also exact.  For a cap U and
       endpoint connector `U-alpha -> U-beta`, let H_I,H_D be recent
       insertion/deletion collars and F_D,F_I future deletion/insertion
       collars.  A literal biresident ticket exists iff

         H_I union F_D subset U,
         (H_D union F_I) cap U = empty,

       both old cross-collar inequalities hold, and distinct alpha,beta lie
       in `W_U=U-(H_I union F_D)`.  The oriented menu has exactly

         |W_U|(|W_U|-1) >= (|U|-2d)(|U|-2d-1).

       A conflict-graph selector and explicit greedy bound now plant any

       audit are now exact.  In any selected undirected Johnson two-factor,
       a physical positive run `0,1^ell,0` with `ell<=3` is forced by its

       therefore gives one sound all-negative primary clause of arity at
       most four.  Component reversal, quotient cut, phase and voltage do
       not affect the clause, and every depth-three residence violation
       yields one.  Length-one runs are already forbidden by the exact-one
       facet row; the live lazy rows have arities three and four.

       Exhaustive materialization is nevertheless the wrong master.  An
       independently hardened O3 H100 census of the complete marker58

       clauses, over 2.1 billion literals.  Thus lazy separation or the
       compact directed-history automaton is necessary; the present
       cumulative blocker banks are exact sound CEGAR cuts, not an ad hoc

       The same note proves the precise voltage-localization lemma using the
       fragment ledger.  A rethread preserving the orientation of every

       nonzero edge is insufficient, and h=0 alone is insufficient if a
       path reverses or topology splits.

2636K. Lane K has completed the same-parity coprime-voltage transport audit
       and isolated the exact remaining induction row.  In one free cyclic
       cover, opening two child cycles at e0,e1 and crossing them by
       f01,f10 gives

         V_parent = v0+v1+
           delta(f01)+delta(f10)-delta(e0)-delta(e1).

       A common physical lift of the four endpoints exists exactly when the
       final four-term correction is zero.  Hence a phase-coherent Pascal
       rectangle has V_parent=v0+v1: a parent-native unit plus a zero
       companion transports the unit, while two equal units give 2v, a
       unit for every odd (including composite) parent modulus.  Boolean
       ordered-rail/cap compatibility alone does not impose this phase row.

       There is no functorial transport between the natural deck groups.
       For odd n, every homomorphism Z_n -> Z_(n+2) is trivial.  Thus
       the old quotient voltage by itself cannot seed the next dimension.
       A symmetry-breaking parent-native pump is necessary unless the
       Pascal port exports a coherent integer phase lift.  A fixed lifted
       total survives every later odd modulus exactly when it is
       +/-2^a; +/-1 is the clean interface.  All later tickets must then
       have exact integer-zero displacement, not merely zero modulo the old
       dimension.

       After that seed, any number of fixed-z repairs preserves voltage only
       when each COMPLETE ticket—including cap backups, history collars,
       aperture discharge, opening and join seams—retains fragment
       orientations, outputs the declared one-cycle and has total
       displacement zero.  Zero holonomy is not a component-total shortcut:
       merging component voltages1 and2 in Z_9 with zero seam charge gives
       voltage3 and three physical cycles.

       The persistent aperture needs a new gauge-invariant state.  For open
       path P and accepting closure-gain menu D_acc, put

         K_acc = omega(P)+D_acc.

       It closes without a fresh pump iff K_acc meets the unit group.
       With nondeterministic terminal histories, the exact object is a
       correlated relation among cap/history state, closure total and the
       private closing edge; independent marginals are unsound.  A
       zero-current ticket can change the answer by changing this closure
       relation, so it must protect/regenerate K_acc or a chosen accepting
       unit closure.

       At composite n=2r-1, the rank-r owner and rank-(r-1) lower-facet
       actions are free.  Rank-(r+1) cap resources can have order-three
       stabilizers, so their current must be physical or stabilizer-weighted.
       The cap/history/phase labels compose at fixed dimension, but the
       Pascal node must export explicit cap-coordinate and history-state
       reindexing maps.

       The exact missing lemma is now the phase-lifted private Pascal
       aperture lemma: jointly realize a parent-native dyadic total, the
       one-copy lower payload and literal crossed ports, a protected
       accepting unit aperture closure, cap/history reindexing, and complete
       fixed-z zero-integer-holonomy repair tickets in the same oriented
       fragment chronology.  This would pay one ancestral pump.  Without
       it, the first failed parent-native unit or aperture row genuinely
       requires a fresh pump or closure-menu rebuild.  Upper shadows,
       residence, one-star consolidation and the terminal compiler remain
       separate.

2637K. Lane K has decided the minimal phase-coherent Pascal K2,2 aperture
       face: it is a transporter, not a fresh voltage pump.

       Let W be the common ordered rail, H=Stab(W), and write the left and
       right rail phases as ell_i and r_j.  Every literal port gain has

         delta_ij = ell_i-r_j+h_ij,  h_ij in H.

       Therefore the old-versus-crossed square holonomy is

         delta_01+delta_10-delta_00-delta_11 in H.

       For the protected pivot rail
       W=({rho_1},...,{rho_(d-1)}) with d>=2, H is trivial, because a
       translation fixing one singleton is the identity.  Hence the
       square holonomy is automatically zero modulo the parent modulus.
       With endpoint-difference integer lifts it is exactly zero over Z.
       This conclusion uses the literal ordered rail, not an abstract
       component or raw-port count.

       If the two parent-native ported child totals are w0,w1, either
       crossed edge may be retained as the private aperture, but every
       accepted cap/positive-history/negative-history/private-edge tuple
       has the same voltage coordinate

         w_out = w0+w1.

       Thus the accepted closure-total set is empty or the singleton
       {w0+w1}.  Cap/history postselection can reject an orientation but
       cannot tune its voltage, and a failed closure cannot be repaired by
       choosing another lift of the same singleton-rail port.

       This gives an exact positive amplifier.  Equal co-oriented inputs
       epsilon*2^a double to epsilon*2^(a+1), and a live input plus a zero
       companion preserves it.  These totals are units for every odd,
       including composite, parent modulus.  But the inputs must already
       be parent-native.  Doubling never repairs coprimality:

         gcd(N,2w)=gcd(N,w) for odd N.

       Connected siblings are also insufficient.  Modulo15, inputs1 and4
       give only the oriented sums +/-1+/-4 in {5,-3,3,-5}, all nonunits.
       Gauge changes and generator rescaling preserve this obstruction.

       Consequently the minimal four-edge/one-aperture face cannot
       discharge the fresh-pump row.  The exact next construction must
       supply either (i) one parent-native dyadic child tuple already
       correlated with its cap/bi-history/private closure, or (ii) a
       completed larger actuator with nonzero holonomy eta satisfying

         w0+w1+eta = epsilon*2^a.

       Such an actuator needs an extra phase-split endpoint/closure
       occurrence or a larger circuit.  Subsequent fixed-z repairs may be
       zero-holonomy, but they cannot substitute for this first actuator.
       Upper decks, ambient residence, source transport and the compiler
       remain separate.
