       and obtained an explicit bounded-load fixed-z local ticket atlas.
       The exact signed fragment identity is

         V(F')-V(F)
          = sum_j (epsilon_j-1)V(P_j)
            + sum_new delta(e)-sum_old delta(e).

       Thus same-oriented retained fragments, one output quotient cycle and
       zero directed seam displacement are proof-safe sufficient conditions;
       reversed fragments require the displayed signed correction.  In the
       actual fixed-z retained-path orientation P_i:x_i->y_(i+1), old seams
       are y_i->x_i and new seams y_i->x_(i+1).  Their phasewise intrinsic
       shifts are zero, and after every endpoint gauge their sums agree by
       cyclic reindexing of the x endpoints.  Hence there is no hidden
       central phase mismatch.  Every sidecar seam still belongs in the
       complete-ticket displacement ledger, and a Pascal modulus change
       still needs a child-native unit seed.

       For one rooted task (X,a), choose two disjoint length-d deletion
       banks in X-{a} and two marker banks outside X.  Restricting the
       fixed-z roles gives exactly

         N_d=(r-1-2d)_2 (k-r-2d)_4 (k-r-2d-4)=Theta(k^7)

2640K. Lane K has closed the one-phase-split Pascal aperture face and the
       finite-holonomy arithmetic.

       Rephasing one endpoint occurrence together with every incident edge
       is only a vertex gauge: entry gains change by +eta, exit gains by
       -eta, and every closed voltage is unchanged.  For a fixed edge orbit,
       path lifting also gives a unique landing.  On the singleton pivot
       rail, the difference between two same-role landing gains lies in
       Stab(W)={0}.  Thus neither another representative nor a same-rail
       duplicate is a pump.

       A genuinely new parallel closure orbit is different.  If its gain
       differs from the ordinary closure by the coherent integer eta, its
       two completed totals are exactly

         w, w+eta.

       After fixing one cap/positive-history/negative-history/private-edge
       state xi, the actual accepted fibre is an arbitrary subset of those
       two branch totals.  The split translates the named endpoint state by
       eta; because the pivot singleton rail has trivial stabilizer, a
       nonzero split cannot preserve the same literal xi.  It may export the
       translated state as a distinct correlated branch, but phase, cap,
       histories and private edge cannot be marginalized.

       The universal odd-modulus arithmetic is exact.  For a fixed carried
       total w and any finite jointly accepted coherent-integer fibre H,

         every odd N has a unit in w+H

       iff one completed total w+h is a signed power of two.  Otherwise
       choose one odd prime divisor of every non-dyadic branch and multiply
       them to obtain a composite counter-modulus.  Hence a neutral one-split
       branch is universally useful exactly when |eta|=2^a; eta=+/-1 is the
       ideal case.  Consecutive values alone do not suffice ({5,6} fails
       modulo15), and no fixed bounded offset menu repairs arbitrary
       inherited w by the CRT.  At one fixed modulus an arithmetic
       progression menu needs Jacobsthal length j(N), which is unbounded.

       This determines the size threshold precisely.  In a multigraph, a
       separately supplied parallel closure can already pump if its dyadic
       branch and translated boundary state are jointly accepted.  In the
       one-copy simple occurrence graph, a split must be returned by a
       role-converting circuit; C6 is the first possible alternating
       support.  Every C_(2t), including C6 and C8, confined to one rigid
       ordered rail still telescopes to zero holonomy.  Therefore the first
       unexcluded simple actuator is a genuinely rail/role-converting C6,
       not a larger same-rail menu.  No Boolean accepted C6 is claimed.
       The existing seven-row C14 supplies raw coprime holonomy (choose
       h=1) but still needs its correlated cap-backup/bi-history/private
       closure completion.

       Source/envelope transport, arbitrary upper shadows and the terminal
       compiler remain explicitly outside this result.

       rays form one old cycle and one step-two new cycle.  All positive and
       negative runs have length at least d+1.  The two phases have identical
       lower and immediate-upper multisets and zero relative displacement.
       The complete local cycle has

         28d+35 Johnson edges = 56d+70 incidence edges.

       Fixing the banks and w_i leaves the exact atlas

         (r-1-2d)_2 (k-r-2d-7)_4 (k-r-2d-11)=Theta(k^7).

       After privatizing the one role-free Q_0 prefix, every nonprivate
       occurrence fixes at least one role and has load K_1 k^6.  Hence a
       forbidden nonprivate bank Q removes at most K_1 |Q| k^6 tickets, and
       every fixed nonprivate socket position exposes Omega(k) literal
       profiles.  This is genuine local spread, not an ambient extension
       theorem.

       The local cycle is saturated and remains a separate component in any

       leaves paired old/new protected paths with the same two exposed

         sigma_0 + sum_P z_P sigma(P)=0.

       the group row and the canonical protected-order predicate.  This is

2643AD. Lane AD has frozen a factor-parameterized, fail-closed flat-source
       and lower-compiler pipeline for the first future residence-capable
       k17 factor.  For a directed opening `T_0,...,T_(W-1)`, its unique
       pointwise-maximal depth-d antecedent is

         P_p = intersection_{max(0,p-d)<=i<=min(W-1,p)} T_i.

       A nonempty antecedent exists iff every P_p is nonempty and every
       owner is restored by `P_i union ... union P_(i+d)`.  On a Johnson
       cycle with d<r this is exactly the directed-cut bracket condition for
       internal positive runs of length at most d.  The implementation scans
       all 2W directed openings and directly replays the formula at the
       selected cut.

       Every source interval of length at least d+1 is exactly the
       corresponding nonwrapping consecutive-owner union.  Thus all upper
       rows are audited from the owner deck, while strict-lower targets live
       only in occurrence-labelled cells C of length at most d.  Their exact
       incidence criterion is

         S subset union_{p in C} P_p,
         M_C subset S,
         S intersect P_p nonempty for every p in C,

       where M_C consists of owner bits whose complete maximal carrier set
       is contained in C.  The pipeline enumerates this literal graph,
       computes Hopcroft--Karp, the canonical Hall shore and full contracted
       DM SCCs.  Hall is necessary only.  The simultaneous common-cap ALO
       CNF is exact: source-position nonemptiness, owner restoration, target
       provider ALOs, outside-bit exclusions and target-bit supply clauses.

       A factor-path word can be emitted only after a same-run CNF is

       interface deliberately requires one connected simple exact-facet,

       antecedent certificate, not cyclic residence; protected provenance,

2644K. The first role-converting fresh-voltage actuator is now explicit:
       a phase-split quotient `C6`, not `C8`, `C10`, or the raw `C14`.

       Let `n=2r-1`, let the required history depth be `d`, put `h=d+1`,
       and assume `r>=3h+1`.  Set `s=r-3h-1`.  Choose a cyclic rank-`r`
       set `A` with one-run lengths

         (h,h,h+1+s)

       and zero-gap lengths

         (h,h,h+s).

       If `p_i` is the first one and `q_i` the first following zero of run
       `i`, define

         R_j=A-{p_0,...,p_(j-1)}+{q_0,...,q_(j-1)}.

       Then `R_3=tau A`.  The quotient triangle

         R_0 -> R_1 -> R_2 -> tau R_0

       has coherent integer voltage `+1`; its complete reversal has `-1`.
       The forward and reverse tail/head matchings have relative permutation
       a 3-cycle, so their overlay is literally one alternating quotient
       `C6`.  Its development is one physical `3n`-cycle; the physical
       overlay is one alternating `6n`-cycle because `3n` is odd.

       The construction is fully occurrence-labelled.  All `3n` owner
       roots, all `3n` rank-`(r-1)` intersections, and all `3n`
       rank-`(r+1)` unions are distinct.  Forward and reverse use exactly
       the same physical lower and upper occurrences.  Every positive run
       has length at least `3h`, and every zero run at least `3h-1`.
       Cutting one physical closing edge and its opposite therefore gives
       two internally bi-history-safe paths, the same omitted q1 pair, and
       branchwise private closures.  The two nonmixed accepted tuples have

         cap state (z,b)=(0,0), histories R^+ or R^-,
         private edge e or e^op, and voltage +1 or -1.

       Hence each fixed oriented-private-edge fibre contains a signed power
       of two and is a unit for every odd modulus, including composites.
       The earlier support-three orientation-flip no-go remains correct only
       when the closing endpoint is the same physical root.  It does not
       apply here: the third quotient edge ends at `tau R_0`, and the
       developed component is a long cycle rather than a Johnson triangle.
       The four-run `C8` construction remains valid as a nonminimal backup;
       no central `C10` is needed.

       This closes the local child-native pump and its exact cap/history/
       private-edge correlation.  It does not plant the `3n` roots inside
       a global owner factor or prove that an exterior fixed-`z` ticket
       accepts the exported endpoint histories.  Source/erosion rows,
       upper ranks beyond q1, exterior cross-windows, and the terminal
       common-cap/compiler remain separate.  Conditionally on that ambient
       socket, the protected product monoid proves that all later cap-neutral
       zero-holonomy fixed-`z` tickets preserve voltage one and the private
       closure.

       freezes every clean block and its persistent hole.  Hence

       essential; representative-only cleanliness is unsound.  The clause
       width is at most min(1198,2*C(s,9)); an empty support gives a scoped
       empty clause.

       The rank-13 target-local DFA has exactly 1,094 states: reset, accept,
       and every nonempty hole set of size at most four.  Eager replication
       is unnecessary.  A shared first-arrival oracle uses one 8-bit coupon
       mask from each quotient start and at most 34,763,300 constant-time
       transitions to decode ranks 13 through 17 simultaneously.  On the
       authenticated floor1751 factor, the sole missing rank-13 orbit has
       715 clean owners, 377 clean blocks, and a canonical clause of width
       749.

       Explicit Johnson-walk countermodels cover every rank-s target while
       missing a rank-(s+1) target for s=13,14,15.  Thus adjacency plus one
       upper rank does not justify a monotone implication; ranks 14--16
       remain explicit decode rows.  The examples repeat owners, so an
       owner-once strengthening is not excluded.

       source/envelope existence, lower compilation, or a universal word.

2646A. Lane A has reduced the opened fixed-`z` seven-ear ambient gate to one
       literal endpoint-conditioned corridor certificate and has separated
       relative displacement from the fresh-pump interface.

       Delete the same connector Q_j in both fixed-`z` terminal cycles.  The
       resulting protected paths run

         P^epsilon : y_(j+1,d) -> x_(j,d)

       and expose the same literal partial socket relations.  On a fixed
       boundary-state table, any one capacity-faithful co-oriented spanning
       corridor in the reverse endpoint direction expands both paths to one
       cycle.  Exact histories and every named facet/cap occurrence row are
       then inherited from the state table.  Reusing the same physical
       corridor makes every ambient fragment and seam cancel termwise, so

         V(P^1 C)-V(P^0 C)=V(P^1)-V(P^0)=0.

       Thus the corridor has no old/new relative pump debt even when its
       absolute quotient voltage is nonzero.

       The literal construction is exact.  Fix a closing join and a forward
       order, split fragments into tail/head shores, and delete final tail
       and protected-root head.  A perfect matching (equivalently Hall
       deficiency zero) materializes the spanning corridor exactly on a
       capacity-faithful state expansion.  Order-free, the joins are a
       common size-(n-1) base of the outgoing, incoming and graphic matroids,
       plus every physical resource row.  A capacity-one row q is redundant
       on the matching face iff every two disjoint q-edges leave a
       four-endpoint deletion with no perfect matching.  Star fibres give a
       clean Boolean sufficient subclass, scoped to occurrence tokens unless
       token-to-literal-cap projection is injective.  A phase-common residual
       two-factor plus a literal transparent fusion tree is a second
       sufficient construction.

       Absolute corridor residue is also exact on the fixed-rail face.  For
       one fixed physical state table, protected head p, final tail z and
       closing join e_*, K's same-rail formula gives

         sum_(e in Q) delta(e)
           = sum_(u!=z) ell_u - sum_(v!=p) r_v  (mod H),
         H=Stab(W).

       Hence all rooted common bases have one image in A/H; no coset
       saturation is claimed.  For the singleton pivot rail at d>=2, H=0
       and the residue is literally fixed.  The equivalent general test is
       that every signed closed walk (or every matching-alternating circuit)
       has label in H.  Changing the closing join, final tail or physical
       table remains a genuine escape.

       The exact non-coboundary interface is finite-state but must use the

       package and topology.  A pump word is valid iff the product automaton
       reaches an accepting one-cycle configuration at the required exact
       residue.  Numerical voltage alone is insufficient.

       K's new twisted three-run C6 now supplies literal local branches

         (0,0,R^+,f_+,+1),  (0,0,R^-,f_-,-1).

       It must not be appended disjointly to an already spanning corridor.
       Choose one branch and a literal embedding first; its opened 3n-root

       common base must then close the complete exact resource ledger and

         kappa_(epsilon,iota)+delta(e_amb)+sum_(e in Q)delta(e)=t.

       This is necessary and sufficient.  The local identity (z,b)=(0,0)

2647AD. Lane AD has frozen the exact existential-opening Benders interface
       from a resident combined-master model to determinant factor
       primaries.  The recourse quantifier is over all 2W directed physical
       openings.  A fixed-opening source, upper, Hall or common-cap failure
       is not an unguarded factor cut: with a stable directed endpoint
       selector a_omega, a proved failure cube G_omega gives only

         not a_omega OR negation(G_omega).

       Without opening selectors, an incumbent may be excluded only after
       every opening is definitively closed.  The universally safe fallback
       is the complete signed primary-assignment no-good.  On the
       authenticated marker58 exact-facet face, exactly1,198 of the35,713
       determinant primaries are selected, so the shorter clause

         OR_(j in selected incumbent) not x_j

       fixes and excludes exactly the incumbent factor.  Counters, darts,
       Horn histories and rank11 summaries are auxiliary and absent from
       semantic factor cuts.  Any unknown common-cap opening forbids a
       global no-good.

       The source stage has a much stronger bounded projection.  For a
       cyclic short positive run R=0,1^ell,0, let B(R) be its ell+1 bracket
       edges.  A flat depth-d opening exists iff the intersection of all
       B(R) is nonempty.  If empty, at most d+2 runs and at most
       (d+1)(d+2) physical edges witness emptiness.  Retaining those paths
       in a connected degree-two cycle preserves the obstruction, so the
       disjunction of the negated nonfixed primary activators is globally
       valid.  This is a single-cycle/one-cut theorem, not an independently
       opened forest theorem.

       For one Hall-deficient opening with exact shore A, old neighborhood
       N and delta=|A|-|N|, the valid extended row is

         a_omega -> sum_(C notin N) q_(omega,A,C) >= delta,

       where q is linked to an actual P/U/M/nonempty candidate from A.  A
       raw DM defect or optimistic envelope activation is not a primary
       row.  Missing upper targets likewise require an exact path/DFA
       witness channel, a guarded full cube, or the all-opening fallback.
       Common-cap UNSAT requires an independently verified guarded proof
       core.  SAT reaches word emission only after model/clause replay,
       exact D3 replay and both exhaustive 2^17-1 scans.

2648K. The twisted phase-split `C6` unit pump now has a proof-safe ambient
       planting interface with A's opened fixed-`z` seven-ear corridor.

       A first candidate proof used uniform `S_n` conjugation.  That rank-
       layer calculation is not an ambient-voltage theorem: arbitrary `g`
       changes the cyclic deck generator to `g tau g^-1`.  Cover-preserving
       affine conjugates have exact loads only on their individual orbit
       strata.  The unconditional escape is instead deterministic.  Fix the
       equivariant pump first.  Every owner of the complete seven-ear local
       cycle contains

         C0=X-(Dx union Dy union {a,b,c})

       and is therefore within Johnson distance `2d+3` of its anchor X.  A
       common lower facet or immediate-upper cap puts incident local/pump
       owners within one further Johnson step.  Hence the two complete local
       banks are occurrence-disjoint if

         d_J(X,O_P)>2d+4.

       Since the pump has `3k` owners for `k=2m-1`, an anchor avoiding fixed
       z exists whenever

         3k sum_(j=0)^(2d+4) C(m,j)C(m-1,j) < C(2m-2,m),
         m>=max(3d+4,2d+13).

       This holds for all sufficiently large m when d=O(sqrt m).  It keeps
       the pump in the original child cover with voltage +1; it is not a
       non-equivariant physical relabeling.  The exact opened seven-ear
       counts are `26d+32` owners, `26d+31` lower facets/upper occurrence
       tokens and `52d+62` incidence edges.  Closed pump plus opened A has
       `3k+26d+32` owners and `6k+52d+62` incidences.

       This closes local separation but not a spanning host.  A completed
       owner/lower factor is already degree-saturated, while the open pump
       alone has

         6k-2=12m-8>m-2

       incidences, so the small protected-factor theorem is categorically
       inapplicable.  After deleting the closed pump shores and fixing the
       disjoint A bank, exact owner/lower completion is the residual
       Ore--Ryser b-factor:

         sum_(x in S)b(x)
           <= sum_y min(b(y),d_G(y,S))

       for every residual lower shore S, with b(v)=2-d_Q(v).  A violated
       shore is the first exact ambient obstruction.

       Post-hoc two-edge fusion is also sharply impossible on the exact
       lower-rainbow face: equality of the old/new two-facet multisets
       forces the two old lower colours to coincide.  The corrected minimal
       private-edge-preserving route is a ternary Boolean hex through a
       nonprivate pump edge e_o and two prepared host edges.  Three distinct
       old components merge to one; owner/lower/immediate-upper/tail/head
       inventories are exact.  Biresidence is iff the three positive and
       three negative directed-history collar tests pass.  Unit voltage is
       retained iff the signed new-edge sum equals the old-edge sum,
       automatic only for one coherent physical hex lift.  The original
       private edge e_* remains untouched.  Raw supply is guaranteed by

         3k>6|B|+2d+1,
         (m-1-|B_L|)(m-2-|B_R|)>lambda_Q,
         lambda_Q<=|Q|(m-1),

       but these inequalities do not place the two partners on distinct
       residual components or satisfy their histories.

       More generally, mark two pump edges: persistent e_* and planting
       e_o.  Put `C_P-e_o`, the opened A path and all residual fragments in
       one ordered literal table.  Exact degree/resource/history/palette
       rows plus

         sigma_bg = sum_(F!=P_P)lambda(F)
                    +sum_join delta(e)-delta(e_o) = 0

       expand to one resident owner/q1-exact cycle of absolute voltage +1
       in both A phases.  A's old/new relative displacement is already zero;
       the pump is used only for absolute child voltage.  On a capacity-
       faithful rigid-rail table, ordinary rooted Hall plus one evaluation
       of the fixed background charge is sufficient.  Otherwise the charge
       and resource rows remain part of the exact functional matching.

       The smallest missing theorem is now a prospective pump-aware rooted
       host: satisfy the residual b-factor/resource rows, expose the two

       make the coherent nonpump background charge zero.  Deeper upper

2649A. The pump-first common-base row and the prospective new-phase Boolean
       hex now have exact augmented-Hall certificates.

       First reserve one physical twisted-C6 pump.  With

         B_m(R)=sum_(j=0)^R C(m,j)C(m-1,j),  k=2m-1,

       a prescribed-z seven-ear anchor outside the complete pump occurrence
       bank exists whenever

         3k B_m(2d+4)<C(2m-2,m),
         m>=max(3d+4,2d+13).

       This is an unconditional sufficient Johnson-ball separation, not a
       characterization.  It holds eventually for d=O(sqrt m), and every
       local ticket at the chosen anchor then has zero pump collision.

       On any fixed capacity-faithful ordered table B0, let F be the joins
       killed by one of the two endpoint histories or a zero-residual
       join/port occurrence.  For a left shore S define

         D(S)={v in N0(S):E0(S,v) subset F},
         kappa0(S)=|N0(S)|-|S|.

       The encoded spanning corridor exists iff

         |D(S)|<=kappa0(S)  for every S.

       Thus the correct damage unit is a completely destroyed head, not a
       deleted arc.  The exact weighted sufficient row is

         sum_(v in N0(S)) min(1,
           [H_(S,v)+sum_q Lambda_(S,v)(q)]/m_(S,v))
           <=kappa0(S).

       The global minmax Delta_P is exact within any declared exhaustive
       capacity-/charge-faithful table family.  If charge is
       matching-dependent it must be state-encoded or solved jointly; Hall
       alone is only the uncharged topology/resource certificate.  Exact-one
       occurrence rows require both no-avoidance and pair-deletion audits.
       An abstract triangular unique-matching family shows that even
       cross-ticket occurrence load one does not force an accepted corridor;
       Boolean-specific accepted-table expansion remains necessary.

       The sharper prospective construction prescribes the three NEW-phase
       edges of one chosen literal Boolean hex directly.  The old phase is
       used only for its central resource and integer-voltage identities.
       Its resource equality covers owner in/out degree, lower and immediate
       upper palettes, and tail/head occurrences; directed histories,
       edge-private tokens and seam sidecars remain literal new-phase rows.
       The residual-vector comparison is valid only on one explicitly common
       literal host; equality of vectors does not identify two differently
       guarded phase hosts.  For a finite Z_n lift, coprime total voltage is
       enough for one lifted cycle, while exact integer zero background is the
       stronger regenerative state.
       This reduction is for one physical, non-equivariant pump edge; an
       orbit-closed pump needs a multi-corridor theorem.

       If P3:F->E is the opened pump path, the final cycle is equivalent to
       exactly two residual paths

         Q1:D_c -> C_bc,   Q2:B_bc -> A_b,

       in the cyclic order

         A_b -> F P3 E -> D_c Q1 C_bc -> B_bc Q2 A_b.

       Assign residual fragments to these two roles, order each role, and
       build the block-diagonal raw table B0^(2).  After literal filtering,

         D_a^(2)(S)={v in N0,a^(2)(S):
                       E0,a^(2)(S,v) subset F_a},
         kappa_a^(2)(S)=|N0,a^(2)(S)|-|S|.

       The two corridors exist iff

         |D_a^(2)(S)|<=kappa_a^(2)(S)  for every S.

       Minimizing the maximum defect over the physical hex, two-block
       partition, two orders, endpoint states and charge-faithful expansion
       gives Delta_hex; the prospective completion exists in that family iff
       Delta_hex=0.  The family must be proved exhaustive for an unrestricted
       equivalence.  Role separation is necessary: pairing D_c to A_b and
       B_bc to C_bc has an untyped perfect matching but closes two cycles.
       Marginally feasible history states may likewise have no common state.

       The direct new phase eliminates post-hoc functional-partner codegree
       and three-old-component escape.  It does not prove Delta_hex=0,
       common histories, zero partner-closure integer charge, deep upper
       shadows, source/envelope transport, terminal compiler or regeneration.

2651K. The prospective direct-new-phase pump has an unconditional
       owner/lower-q1 residual extension for d=O(sqrt m) at all sufficiently
       large m.  The post-hoc mutual-codegree and three-component-escape
       gates from 2648K are not part of this row.

       before ambient completion.  The direct phase is the opened pump plus

       incidences: four beyond the closed pump, or six beyond the open pump.

       either phase saturates the same three lower facets.

       The twisted pump has internal incidence degree at most three and
       external cross-degree one on both shores.  Excluding at most six b
       labels and one c label leaves at least

         (m-7)(m-3)

       literal partner choices whose four nonpump owners and two nonpump
       lower facets are all outside the pump shores.  Strengthening the
       deterministic anchor separation from radius 2d+4 to 2d+5 makes this
       bank disjoint from the opened seven-ear path; the Johnson-ball bound
       remains eventual for d=O(sqrt m).

       For every residual shore S, with T=(L-F_P)-S and A=F_P disjoint-union
       T, put c_A(Y)=(j_A(Y)-m+2)_+.  The protected Ore inequality is exactly

         kappa(A)+rho_O(A) >= 2p+omega_Q(A),

       where omega_Q is nonnegative protected cut waste.  Small shores close
       by degree/codegree, Tanner localization leaves one polynomial shore,
       and the two opposite Lovasz-Kruskal-Katona branches close it.  With

         D=(m-1)(m-2),
         G=(m-1)/(m-2)(2p+q*),
         B=2m^2 G/(2m-1),
         a_m=(m^2-10m+12)/(4(m-1)),
         c_m=(m-2)(m-3)/(m(m-1)),

       turn the partition cycle cover into one cycle.  A Hamilton cycle on
       all admissible state copies is the wrong object.

2654K. The cycle-factor alternative to robust partition-Hamiltonicity is
       exact, but it needs a protected compatible switch basis which is not
       supplied by the residual LKK/Ore theorem.

       Let F be an accepted partition cycle factor containing the two marked
       direct-new-phase contractions.  A local binary pull or ternary
       Boolean hex is represented by its complete old/new occurrence
       support, history collars, protected resources and additive exported
       ledger.  If a family T is support-private (or serial-hereditary) and
       every member is a certified maximum merger, then T merges F to one
       marked cycle exactly on the incidence-tree face

         sum_(e in A)(|e|-1) <= |union A|-1  for every nonempty A subset T,
         sum_(e in T)(|e|-1) = |C(F)|-1.

       Binary pulls reduce this to an ordinary conflict-compatible labelled
       spanning tree.  Ternary C6 moves require a spanning loose/incidence
       hypertree and preserve component parity; connectedness of their
       2-section is insufficient.  A raw C6 is admitted as a ternary edge
       only after its three deleted projected edges are proved to lie on
       three distinct current cycles, since the corrected general stub
       delta ranges over -2,-1,0,+1,+2.  Pairwise disjoint deleted edges are
       also insufficient: full occurrence/history supports must be disjoint,
       or applicability must be hereditary.

       For a fixed pre-guard catalogue and component shore S, let P_F(S) be
       the crossing certified switches and let H(p) be the protected-resource
       hazard set of p.  Every protected bank of size at most h leaves the
       safe component hypergraph connected iff

         tau_F(S)>h

       for every nontrivial S, where tau_F(S) is the transversal number of
       {H(p):p in P_F(S)}.  If one resource appears in at most lambda_S
       crossing hazards, the proof-safe sufficient row is

         |P_F(S)| > h lambda_S.

       This is the precise O(d)-bank resilience target.  It certifies only
       the frozen catalogue; internal preparatory moves may create new
       cross-cut packets unless closure is proved.  Dynamically, the exact
       termination condition is a safe strict component coarsening at every
       reachable nonterminal factor.

       The residual LKK proof sees only projected owner/lower multiplicities.
       A component-state refinement preserves every degree, codegree,
       protected incidence and Ore/LKK shore while rejecting every
       cross-component switch.  Thus LKK gives marginal projected factor
       existence only--not state lift, switch-cut expansion or compatible
       topology.  The exact next theorem is joint residual factor plus a
       protected occurrence-labelled switch basis.  Upper shadows,
       residence beyond encoded histories, integer charge and compiler stay
       separate.

2656L. The Goddyn--Gvozdjak full-cube long-run theorem does not directly
       transfer to the middle levels.  For n=2m+1, any cyclic cube Gray code
       whose repeated coordinate flips are separated by at least m has a
       forced 2m-edge lower excursion through zero: the nearest retained
       middle vertices on its two sides are distinct rank-m vertices.  They
       are consecutive after middle-level restriction and cannot be adjacent.
       Complementation gives the same obstruction at rank m+1 through the
       all-one vertex.  Thus literal restriction and one-edge-per-excursion
       contraction both fail for every sufficiently large Goddyn--Gvozdjak
       code.

       Quantitatively, transferring R=n-O(log n) to a run floor 2d+1 by
       bounded block compression would require maximum block length

         R/(2d+1)=(4/pi+o(1))d=Theta(sqrt n),

       while the forced extreme excursion has length 2m=Theta(n).  The GG
       product-stream invariant is parity in Q_a, not the rank-sum condition
       |x|+|y| in {m,m+1}, so restricting the merged stream destroys the
       orbit identity used for Hamiltonicity.  Transition separation also
       controls coordinate labels, not the signs of weight changes.

       The exact missing bridge is a nonlocal run-preserving excursion braid:
       after deleting outside vertices, globally pair lower and upper ports
       by containment edges, join the retained path forest into one middle-
       level Hamilton cycle, and schedule the new chord colours at separation
       at least 2d+1.  Componentwise contraction cannot do this; an equitable
       monotone-segment form would need maximum half-segment length at most
       (4/pi+o(1))d.  Thus the GG theorem has ample scalar run reserve but no
       present rank-compatible adjacency bridge.

          R_x = C + 1_(x in M) - 1_(x in D).

        Hence `R_a=C+1`, `R_b=C-1`, and every other coordinate has exactly

        forest component from `b` to `a`; there is no diffuse aggregate
        residence charge.  The positive deletion forests and complemented
        zero forests give an exact residence test: every component order
        must be at least `d+1`.  Since `C+1>=r`, the split coordinate still

        A sufficient local implementation is to join two `b` components and
        split one `a` component into two pieces of order at least `d+1`, with
        the analogous condition on zero sections if dual residence is used.
        The fixed-boundary existence theorem does not yet ensure this local

        At owner level a local lollipop is a two-cut segment rethread.  It

        residence and every upper shadow.  Fix one perfect parity matching
        `mu` in the Middle Levels incidence graph.  Contracting it turns the
        alternating path into a directed Hamilton path on coatoms, with

          L -> L'  iff  L subset mu(L'),  L != L'.

        This root-link digraph is `(r-1)`-regular in both directions.  The
        owner word is the vertex-label word `mu(L_i)`.  Positive residence
        is exactly the requirement that every internal component induced by
        `x in mu(L_i)` have order at least the residence floor.  An arbitrary
        upper target `U` occurs exactly when one component induced by
        `mu(L_i) subset U` has union `U`.  At rank `r+1` this collapses to one
        coloured arc.  There are exactly `W-1` such arcs: the omitted linear
        opening/wrap is not silently counted as a provider.

        There is also an exact guarded two-cut route to `h=1`.  Open an
        exact-q1 cycle at `AX` and write its owner word as `W0=S R`, where a
        second cut is `YB`.  If the new seams satisfy

          old colours (M,N) -> new colours (D,N),  D != M,

        reversing `S` gives the physical current `-[M]+[D]` and the required
        fixed boundary `A=M union D`.  The complete arbitrary-width loss is
        not heuristic: it is exactly

          C_-(S,R) minus ( U(S) union U(R) union C_+(S,R) ),

        where `C_-` uses suffix unions of `S` plus prefixes of `R`, and
        `C_+` uses prefix unions of `S` plus prefixes of `R`.  Emptiness is
        necessary and sufficient for preservation of all old union support;
        when the old opening is upper-complete it is therefore necessary and
        sufficient for the new opening to remain upper-complete.  Positive
        residence is preserved exactly by one explicit three-case aperture
        test on the leading blocks of `S` and `R`.  Thus a cut pair passing
        the cross-grid and aperture rows closes central topology, residence
        and all upper ranks at once.  Existence of such a pair and the named

2670RL. Immediate-upper multiplicity is now an exact external-chord current,
        not a generic cover statistic.  For a rooted Hamilton owner path and
        a rank-`r+1` target `R`, let `u_R` be its actual adjacent-union
        multiplicity, `a_R` the number of path endpoints below `R`, `m_R`
        the indicator that the omitted root lies below `R`, and `g_R` the
        number of selected edges whose intersection lies in `R` while both
        owners lie outside.  Then

          u_R - 1 = g_R - ( h_r + a_R - m_R ),
          h_r = C(r+1,2) - 2(r+1) + 1.

        Hence q1 upper completeness is equivalent to the pointwise external
        load inequalities.  The total slack is exactly `Cat_r-1`.  The proof
        uses only the used-root ledger and facet degree sums, so it remains
        valid for one path plus any number of directed cycles before subtour
        elimination.  Every edge is externally counted `C(r-2,2)` times;
        locally this is the invertible `KG(r,2)` transform.

        The ordinary h1 projection has a second exact form.  Delete roots
        `M,D`; let `p_R` be ordinary internal providers, `g_R^P` ordinary
        external chords, `a'_R` the total degree deficit among the owner
        facets of `R`, and `d_R=1[D subset R]`.  Then

          p_R - 1 = g_R^P - ( h_r + a'_R - m_R - d_R ).

        This includes the possible double deficit when boundary owner `B`
        is also a selected `D` neighbour.  At K17 the threshold constant is
        26, total ordinary external current is 510,468, threshold sum is

        gate is a very tight balanced design and the identity is available
        before connectivity.  It is equivalent to the provider row; it does
        not yet construct the integral path or address deeper uppers.

2671BP. The immediate-upper/root palette has an exact robust two-copy

        copies of every rank-`r+1` upper colour to the remaining roots,
        there is a transversal basis containing every primary upper token

        saturates every used root.  Up to `p` prescribed token-root diamonds

        correlated with the primary selector.  An authenticated K7 primary

2672BP. Endpoint-aware Catalan excess has an exact coordinate design law.
        For a rooted path, with `s_R=u_R-1`, endpoint-incidence count `e_x`
        and omitted-root indicator `m_x`,

          sum_(R contains x) s_R = 2 Cat_(r-1) - e_x + m_x.

        For the ordinary h1 projection, with owner-deficit load `q_x` and
        omitted-root indicators `m_x,d_x`,

          sum_(R contains x) s_R = 2 Cat_(r-1) - q_x + m_x + d_x.

        Every such degree sequence is abstractly realizable as an
        `(r+1)`-uniform excess multidesign.  At K17 there are explicit simple
        cyclic designs: one rooted profile with 4,861 distinct repeat
        colours and one ordinary profile with exactly 4,860 distinct repeat
        colours.  Both use only multiplicities one and two and satisfy every
        endpoint coordinate margin.  An independent O3 H100 replay
        enumerates all 1,144 rank-ten rotation orbits and verifies both
        profiles literally.

        Averaging one literal lollipop over all coordinate relabellings also
        gives a strict point in the convex hull of joint endpoint/topology
        objects; the K17 ordinary per-colour fractional margin is exactly
        `4860/19448=1215/4862`.  This is joint but unpinned after relabelling.
        The explicit repeat designs and robust transversal basis are
        separate positive objects: their unproved common refinement is the
        owner-degree-two/path realization.  Therefore no q1 solution or
        K17 word is claimed.

2673ROOT. The residual owner-degree flow has an exact closed-shore and
        free-endpoint form.  After a primary one-per-upper selector `Q0`,
        let `A` be its unused roots and `c_T` the remaining owner capacity.
        For an owner shore `Y`, let `I_A(Y)` count residual roots whose all
        `r` extensions lie in `Y`, and `J_A(Y)` those with exactly one
        extension outside.  Integral residual completion exists exactly
        when

          2 I_A(Y) + J_A(Y) <= sum_(T in Y) c_T

        for every `Y`.  This is the rootwise dual of the prior max-flow:
        roots with at least two outside extensions never enter a minimum
        deficiency certificate.

        If `Q0` is a linear forest with target owner degree two, the same
        condition is

          2 I_A(Y) + J_A(Y) + |boundary_Q0(Y)|
            <= 2 components(Q0[Y]).

        The right side minus the selected boundary is literally the number
        of free induced-path endpoints.  An independent replay of the fixed
        K7 deficient selector finds a minimum closed shore with
        `I=4,J=10,c(Y)=15`, hence defect three; in forest form its left side
        is 25 and its right side 22.  Thus the theorem explains the exact
        authenticated deficiency rather than merely agreeing in total.

        A spanning primary forest has `Cat_r` components.  With `t` omitted
        roots, a saturating residual completion has `Cat_r-t` edges;
        requiring the same graphic rank is equivalent to a contracted
        `t`-path cover (one rooted path for `t=1`, the ordinary h1 two-path
        core for `t=2`; `t=0` closes one cycle).  The remaining q1 theorem
        is therefore a protected primary forest satisfying the closed-star
        endpoint inequalities and this coloured path-cover rank.

        Eliminating the residual-root set gives exact linear Benders rows
        on the primary diamonds themselves.  For
        `w_Y(L)=(2-|N(L) minus Y|)_+` and primary diamond `e` with root
        `L(e)` and two owner endpoints, put

          alpha_Y(e)=number of endpoints of e in Y - w_Y(L(e)).

        Then `alpha_Y(e)>=0`, and residual completion is equivalent to

          sum_(e in Q0) alpha_Y(e)
            <= sum_(T in Y) b_T - sum_(L notin O) w_Y(L)

        for every owner shore.  An independent K7 replay gives LHS 22 and
        RHS 19 on the authenticated deficient selector, exactly the known
        flow defect three.  Thus a failed residual flow now returns a
        literal linear cut for the one-per-upper primary master.

2674BP. The exact fixed-margin q1 exchange boundary is now explicit.
        In the Boolean containment graph between roots of rank `r-1` and
        owners of rank `r`, any two incidence sets with the same root and
        owner degrees are connected by alternating simple even-circuit
        toggles.  Chordless even circuits are the exact Markov generators.
        The literal q1 change of one circuit is supported only at its
        touched roots and is the signed difference of their old and new
        owner unions, so the guarded hexagon scorer extends without loss to
        all higher circuits.

        Alternating `C6`s do not generate every fixed-degree fibre.  Fixing
        a rank-`r-2` core and `ell` petals gives an induced `C_(2ell)` whose
        degree-one margin fibre consists of exactly its two alternating
        matchings.  For `ell>=4` it contains no hex move, so `C8` is already
        indispensable.  More general cyclic-window cores give induced
        circuits through length `4r-2`.  Thus the positive K17 C6 annealing
        is a useful local search but any universal connectivity claim must
        admit higher chordless circuits or separately prove that the full
        positive degree-two fibre simulates them.

        Closed residual shores also have a quantitative density certificate:

          C(r,2) I_A(Y) + C(r-1,2) J_A(Y) <= e_J(Y).

        Hence a linear-forest shore of Hall defect `delta` exposes at least
        `r(r-1) delta / 4` host Johnson chords.  This is an `Omega(r^2)`
        repair reservoir per defect unit, not a claim that an exposed chord
        lies in a legal protected or q1-improving circuit.

        There is an exact fixed-primary no-go.  For every shore `Y`,

          sum_(e in Q0) alpha_Y(e)
            = sum_(T in Y) deg_Q0(T)
                - sum_(L in used(Q0)) w_Y(L).

        Root--owner fixed-margin circuits preserve both terms, and therefore
        preserve every primary Benders row.  The K7 defect-three selector
        cannot be repaired anywhere inside that circuit fibre; the primary
        used-root support, owner degrees, or provider marking must change.

        The weakest support-changing move is a circuit in the dual
        owner--upper incidence graph.  Encoding each primary upper colour by
        its two owner facets makes every upper degree two.  A dual Boolean
        `C6` preserves every upper and owner degree while transporting three
        primary roots.  With core `S`, its roots change from

          S-x_ab+a, S-x_bc+b, S-x_ca+c

        to

          S-x_ab+b, S-x_bc+c, S-x_ca+a.

        Its exact Benders delta is the old `w_Y` sum minus the new one.
        Root collisions, omitted roots and primary-forest topology remain
        literal guards.  Coordinatewise `1_L+1_R=1_T+1_H`, so the complete
        upper palette and owner degrees force the used-root coordinate
        margins; the dual move acts only inside that necessary fibre.

2676RPC. The regenerative pull--cell route now has two exact audit repairs
         and one sharp single-credit reduction.  Let

           T_0,...,T_(W-1)

         be an all-owner Johnson Hamilton path whose distinct edge
         intersections omit the lower root o.  Its unrooted owner path
         lifts to a perfect rooted incidence phase iff

           o subset T_0  or  o subset T_(W-1).

         The forward predecessor phase requires the terminal containment;
         the reverse phase requires the initial one.  Therefore the
         unrooted closed-shore flow and contracted graphic rank do not by
         themselves recover M_0: the phase-specific endpoint aperture is a
         separate row.

         Literal component overlap also needs a global rather than pairwise
         audit.  If component i has depth-row length ell_i and overlap o_i,
         place it at

           a_(i+1)=a_i+ell_i+d-o_i.

         The final source charge is exactly

           chi=sum_i g_i + sum_i(d-o_i),

         but nonadjacent block images i<j meet whenever

           sum_(q=i)^(j-1)(ell_q+d-o_q) <= ell_i+d-1.

         With full overlaps, one intermediate ell<d already causes a
         nonadjacent identification.  At d=3, three one-cell components
         occupy [0,3],[1,4],[2,5], so a block-1 pin and block-3 pin can be
         the same physical singleton while both adjacent pairwise tests
         pass.  Pairwise port Hall is therefore only a candidate generator;
         source letters/caps, all capacity-one addresses, upper occurrences
         and the composed residence/history state must be replayed on the
         one global word.

         The charge formula has a decisive B+1 consequence.  If the unique
         nonowner cell is already in the pivot/reset component, chi=1 iff
         every Catalan join has full d-overlap.  A separate deficient
         exterior-reset join or second nonowner forces chi>=2.  Hence a B+1
         regeneration must co-locate the one-in/one-out aperture relay with
         the existing pivot/boundary credit.

         The exact remaining hypothesis is named RQPHR_c.  It asks, on one
         reachable reversal orbit, for a rooted protected Catalan forest;
         a globally guarded full-history free-port Hamilton order; the
         co-located singleton reset; complete exported recursive rows; a
         terminal plus state with complete damage and repair complexity at
         most c; and quotient regeneration, including even terminal
         children.  The owner-preserving rethread which identifies the
         aperture colour with the omitted endpoint root is itself part of
         the OPEN reset clause.  Every existence clause is explicitly OPEN.  If one
         compatible infinite odd spine satisfies it, bounded eviction and
         terminal-phase decoupling give

           nu(k) <= B(k)+1+c,

         while the charged carried sidecar remains one.  The c=0 case is
         the conditional B+1 target.  Terminal casualties may be forgotten
         only when the auxiliary successor independently closes every
         exported row associated with them.  This is not an unconditional
         protected-host, K17-word, or all-k theorem.

2677K. The protected Catalan--pivot connector package is now corrected and
       proof-audited.  For every `m>=3d+1`, the sharp monotone pivot gives
       an unconditional protected rooted path of `3d+1` owners with simple
       lower and upper turns, internal owner residence, and occurrencewise
       all-width upper transport.  If a final rooted matching shore is
       already an upper-surjective Hamilton path containing that packet,
       choosing one occurrence of every upper colour produces an exact
       `U`-edge rooted Catalan forest with `C=Cat_m` path components, and
       the complementary `C-1` edges are automatically its directed
       free-port component Hamilton path.  This is the born-connector
       equivalence; it removes a post-hoc connector choice but does not
       construct the correlated Hamilton path.

       Two previously missing guards are now load-bearing throughout.
       First, an unrooted rainbow owner Hamilton path using all lower roots
       except `o` lifts to a perfect predecessor phase exactly when `o` is
       contained in its terminal owner, and to a perfect successor phase
       exactly when `o` is contained in its initial owner.  Before the
       phase is chosen this is the condition `o subset s or o subset t`.
       The closed-shore flow and contracted graphic rank do not imply it.
       A literal `m=3` replay supplies a counterexample in which all those
       rows pass but `o` lies in neither endpoint.

       Second, iterated literal `d`-overlap is a global-address quotient,
       not a list of pairwise seams.  If an intervening block contributes
       `n+g<d` new depth positions, the two nonadjacent blocks overlap in

         max(0,d-(n+g))

       source positions; an uncharged isolate creates `d-1` such
       identifications.  Source `d`-rails control factorability, whereas
       clipped owner-coordinate histories control residence.  Letters,
       caps, pins, upper occurrences and aggregate owner histories must all
       agree on the final global quotient.  Pairwise port Hall is only a
       candidate generator.

       The direct sufficient gate is now `PCPS(m,d)`: prospectively build
       one nonflat pre-insertion word whose final depth row is the protected
       upper-surjective owner Hamilton path plus one boundary nonowner,
       while the preword already has the complete all-width upper deck, the
       clipped owner histories accept, the terminal common cap accepts, and
       the prepared cut regenerates.  Then the Catalan forest and all
       `C-1` connectors are born inside the chronology.  The cleaner but
       stronger literal decomposition is `PCF+GOP+CAP`: a source-decorated
       upper-exact forest, a globally consistent full-`d`-overlap component
       Hamilton order, and the terminal common-cap/one-credit discharge.
       Exact source surplus is

         sum_i g_i + sum_i(d-o_i).

       Hence the direct `B+1` face has full `d`-overlap at every internal
       Catalan join and its sole nonowner at a global boundary.

       The factor-first cycle-cover escape also survives, but only under
       stronger physical guards.  `Q0` plus a perfect free-port matching
       gives a component cycle cover.  A connector-only safe-merger
       incidence tree may fuse it, and a final connector opening may
       linearize it, provided switch supports are globally address-closed
       or hereditarily literal, all upper-witness changes are computed on
       the actual sequential chronologies, the final owner-history state
       accepts, the one-credit aperture equation holds, and the opened
       rank-`m-1` root is literally a maximal pivot-ray target (or another
       explicit cell) in the common cap.  On this rooted face endpoint
       containment is automatic from fixed `M0`; on every unrooted
       substitute it is an extra row.  Ordinary connector Hall, Ore/LKK, or
       a pairwise seam atlas proves none of these physical conditions.

       Thus the exact remaining direct lemma is `PCPS(m,d)`.  The exact
       remaining factor-first package is `PCF+CPH+CSB+TOW`, with `TOW`
       carrying global addresses, sequential all-width replay, composed
       owner residence, aperture charge, and typed opening.  The corrected
       fractional pull-clock closes only marginal circulation and supplies
       neither package.  No `B+1`, all-k equality, K17 word, compiler, or
       regeneration claim is made.

2677A. The integral coloured-rotor gate now has an exact one-copy min--max
       theorem and a separately audited odd-central owner projection.  This
       item uses only the corrected pull-clock theorem, SHA
       `7302724eb8b405c2bf1efcc743a1de06809cd1f9b3134e07ba8aa6933b631b21`:
       `A_delta/A_(delta+1)>=rho`, `Delta_(j+1)/Delta_j<=rho`, and
       `theta=1/rho`.  No reversed-ratio derivation is cited.

       Fix one exact owner/payload table.  If free role `i` has a literal
       Cartesian tail/head menu `A_i times H_i` and the protected root has
       boundary `eta`, put

         ell_A(X)=number of i with A_i subset X,
         r_H(X)=number of i with H_i intersect X nonempty.

       A one-copy selector exists if and only if

         ell_A(X)-r_H(X) <= eta(X)

       for every literal state set `X`.  This is the exact Hoffman closed-cut
       family; polymatroid intersection/transshipment is integral and selects
       one tail and one head of every role, hence every owner and fixed named
       payload exactly once.  A connected selector exists exactly when one
       can reserve distinct-owner legal arcs which, with the protected root,
       span the used states, and the residual rectangles satisfy the same
       cuts with `eta` shifted by the reserved boundary.  This gives one
       Euler component and zero sidecar.

       Before owners are attached, a strict full-depth payload table has the
       functional owner colour

         kappa(j,i)=S_(i,d) union A_(j,1)

       on every legal de Bruijn predecessor `j->i`.  Exact payload, state,
       and owner use is therefore exactly a rainbow directed cycle cover;
       zero-sidecar balance is a rainbow Hamilton cycle.  A cyclic `q`-way
       reassignment of selected heads is an exact fusion iff every new arc
       exists and its complete owner-colour multiset equals the removed one.
       Pairwise rectangles are only a sufficient move class: the odd affine
       `Z_N` atlas has a rainbow Hamilton translation but no nontrivial
       rectangle move from its rainbow identity cover.

       Generic fractional rounding is rigorously false.  The four even-
       parity triples on three two-point shores give a half-integral exact
       point, complete pairwise projections, determinant two, and no rainbow
       cover.  More generally `kappa(j,i)=j+i mod N` is rainbow-Hamilton for
       odd `N` and has no rainbow cover for even `N`.  However the Boolean
       union colouring excludes the two-by-two intercalate exactly, so this
       abstract hole is not a canonical Boolean counterexample.  If an
       integral balanced selector instead has repeated owners `m`, a
       hereditarily realizable unit packet bank contracts to one copy exactly
       under

         m(X)-|X| <= capacity(delta^+ X)

       for every owner set `X`.

       On odd `k=2r-1`, any integral residual lower-chain table containing
       the complete coatom row has exactly one coatom maximum per role.  The
       balanced `r`-regular middle-levels incidence graph then assigns all
       rank-`r` owners bijectively.  Every one protected incidence extends;
       multiple pins obey an exact Hall-damage row, and all owner assignments
       are connected by protected alternating circuits.  A circuit is a
       literal chronology move iff its replacement has zero total state
       boundary.  Thus owner repetition is not a separate odd-central
       marginal obstruction after integral chainization.

       The decisive gap is now sharply localized: select one integral
       triangular chain table, owner attachment and root for which the
       Hoffman deficit is nonpositive, plus its connected spanning-skeleton
       version.  The corrected stationary clock averages over these choices
       and does not prove their common existence.  The independently audited
       aggregate obstructions also do not refute it: for `k>=31` the canonical
       age vector is already in the integral rotor semigroup, and the rigid
       rotation holes freeze noncanonical data.  Finally, `O(1)` Euler
       components alone gives only generic `O(d)` reset cost; `B(k)+O(1)`
       still needs one component or total overlap deficit `O(1)`.

2679RPC. `OPEN-2` and the endpoint part of `OPEN-3` now have an exact
         complete-state macro reduction and a sharp integral face.  For
         fixed literal blocks at starts

           a_(i+1)=a_i+ell_i,

         consecutive full-d rail equality already forces every letter at a
         nonadjacent shared address to agree: any such address lies in all
         intervening adjacent overlaps.  This does not rescue a
         state-forgetting port graph.  It requires one common realization
         of every component and leaves capacity-one addresses and aggregate
         history genuinely global.

         The exact address-local sufficient repair is the exclusive core.
         The first and last blocks have private source cores of length
         ell_i; an internal block has core length

           q_i=max(ell_i-d,0).

         Pin intervals wholly inside these cores cannot collide across
         components, and an internal core contains q_i(q_i+1)/2 interval
         addresses.  The count alone does not prove target-correct OR
         values; short internal components have no private pin capacity.
         More generally, after quotienting all candidate occurrences to
         global interval addresses, the exact number of unmatched compiler
         tasks is

           Delta_pin=max_Y (|Y|-|union_(t in Y) Gamma_t|).

         Thus Delta_pin=0 is the minimal fixed-order address condition;
         exclusive cores are only a convenient decomposed sufficient face.

         Put the ordered d-rail, rooted free-port certificate, and exact
         propagated aggregate-history state in one seam token.  Each
         component realization is then a coloured macro-arc.  Fix the pivot
         first, terminalize one arc whose final owner contains the omitted
         root o, and add the virtual closure c:tau->beta.  A valid full-d
         component order exists exactly when one arc of every residual
         component colour together with c is balanced and weakly connected,
         with the terminal arc the unique entrance to tau.  An Euler circuit
         cut after c starts at beta and ends with the aperture arc; whole-
         state reversal gives the opposite endpoint phase.

         On the literal Cartesian complete-state face, reserve distinct-
         component arcs R, including the terminal arc, so {c} union R spans
         the used state set V_*.  For each remaining component let its menu
         be A_K times H_K and put eta_R=partial({c} union R).  One integral
         selector exists exactly when

           #{K:A_K subset X}-#{K:H_K intersect X nonempty}
             <= eta_R(X)

         for every X subset V_*.  Equivalently the maximum deficit Delta_R
         is nonpositive.  This is the exact Hoffman/polymatroid one-copy
         criterion; the spanning skeleton supplies connectedness and hence
         zero reset sidecar.

         Cartesianity cannot be dropped.  At d=1 one owner U union V has
         the two literal orientations U->V and V->U.  Their half--half law
         is balanced and their tail/head projections pass Hall and unpaired
         gammoid rank, but neither integral choice is balanced.  The
         Cartesian hull creates loops U->U,V->V with the wrong owner.  Thus
         the minimal general object is the pairing-resolved transition
         relation, not one unpaired strict gammoid.  Arbitrary such colour
         classes already contain directed Hamilton cycle.

         There is now a stronger support-first alternative.  Start with one
         rooted owner Hamilton path T and its path incidence support S.
         Protected graphic-Rado deficiency

           delta_F(S)=max_A(|A|-|E(A)|+kappa_F(A))

         equal to zero marks an upper-exact Catalan forest Q_0 inside S.
         Since S is a path, Q_0 has C contiguous components and S-Q_0 is
         exactly their C-1 connector path.  Next combine all post-insertion
         windows, selected old crossing windows, upper occurrences and
         compiler intervals in one maximal-erosion instance.  Its exact
         nonnegative defect Delta_er is zero iff every envelope is nonempty,
         contains its lower pins, and covers every prescribed union.  Then
         A_j=E_j is one global source word.  Restricting A to a component's
         depth interval plus d trailing letters automatically births its
         literal source block; consecutive restrictions share the same d
         letters.  No separate component antecedent or nonadjacent letter
         guard remains.

         Thus the support-first central gate has five quantitative rows:

           Delta_R<=0, delta_F(S)=0, Delta_er=0,
           Delta_pin=0, H=empty.

         They respectively construct a connected completed owner/history
         chronology, mark its upper-exact Catalan forest, lift the common

         correlated integral selector), not the current hinge menu unchanged.

         A quantitative c=0 certificate is now explicit: one pivot

2680A. Protected integral rotor rounding and fusion now have an exact
       fixed-table theorem, and the current literal hinge obstruction has
       been separated from the true completion gate.  This entry uses only
       the corrected stationary pull clock
       `MATH_THEOREM_TRIANGULAR_PULL_CLOCK_CORRECTED_20260801.md`; no
       conclusion is drawn from the invalid reversed-ratio derivation.

       Compile each physical packet's literal order-`d` state, clipped
       coordinate run ages, named upper-witness occurrences, exterior
       signature and private interior into one interface state.  Suppose
       every free role `i` exposes an actual full packet product

         A_i x H_i,

       with rolewise invariant owner/lower/upper resources, and let the
       fixed protected bank have boundary `eta`.  Then a protected one-copy
       integral selection exists if and only if

         #{i:A_i subset X} - #{i:H_i intersects X}
              <= eta(X)

       for every interface-state set `X`.  This is the exact Hoffman/
       transversal-polymatroid criterion on one fixed table; rational
       clockability across different tables is irrelevant to it.

       Connectedness is also exact.  Reserve packets from distinct roles
       whose union with the fixed bank spans the exact used support, shift
       `eta` by their boundary, and apply the same cuts to the remaining
       roles.  Such a skeleton exists if and only if a connected protected
       selection exists.  More generally, the analogous at-most-`c`
       forest criterion is exact.  A connected selection has zero route
       sidecar.  Merely `O(1)` components is insufficient: the two de
       Bruijn loops `0^d,1^d` can require reset cost `d`.

       On an integral selector, a cyclic head permutation of one free packet
       from each of `q` components fuses them exactly when all replacement
       packets exist in their completed role products.  Owners, lower
       targets, named upper witnesses and literal histories then persist
       rolewise.  For additive protected signatures, universal head
       permutation is transparent exactly when the signature is a
       coboundary.  On a general cross-role compatibility graph this means
       zero alternating holonomy on every cycle; `2x2` curvature tests
       suffice only when rectangles generate its cycle space.  A chordless
       six-cycle is the smallest warning against a bare rectangle test.

       Sharp obstructions are explicit.  A two-state protected selector can
       have one exact disconnected cover while its unique connected cover
       loses the sole protected resource.  A three-state completed-rectangle
       system has connected fractional support but only two-component
       integral covers.  Literal residence has the sharp four-port pattern
       `(1,L-1,L-1,1)`: the old joins have lengths `(L,L)`, while the crossed
       fusion has `(2,2L-2)`; at `L=3` total positive mass six is minimal.
       Therefore one-copy, protected fusion and residence acceptance are
       separate gates.

       The old empty/proper-depth hinge menu also had a saturated internal
       `d`-state and hence repeated its owner.  This local defect is now
       removed constructively.  For every strict chain

         empty != S_1 < ... < S_ell < T,  |T|=r>=3,

       choose `y in S_1` and, when `ell<d`, `x!=y` with
       `S_ell union {x} != T`.  For every `A subset S_1-{y}`, use

         B_0=(T-S_ell) union A,
         B_t={x} for 1<=t<=d-ell,
         B_(d-q+1)=S_q-S_(q-1).

       The full owner is `T`, the last `q` suffix unions are exactly `S_q`,
       and both adjacent `d`-state unions are proper.  Empty chains also
       have a two-sided-unsaturated singleton trace for `r>=3`; `r=2,d>=2`
       is the sharp exception.  The menu has exactly
       `2^(|S_1|-1)` distinct literal tail tuples, not necessarily that many
       distinct tail-union masks.

       A final exact obstruction identifies the remaining positive object.
       On one de Bruijn transition, a fixed depth-one suffix target fixes
       the last letter; after the overlap spine is fixed, every literal tail
       has one head.  Hence no single-transition fixed-q1 relation contains
       a nontrivial two-sided Cartesian endpoint product.  Completion must

       non-Cartesian selector with its own integrality theorem.

2681K. The weakest protected Catalan--pivot host clause now has an exact
       fixed-data factorization.  Fix the complete post-insertion depth
       chronology, every prescribed window occurrence, pin and cap, the
       global address quotient and accepting non-set history state, a

       The exact Rado deficiency is

         delta_F(S)=max_X (|X|-|E(X)|+kappa_F(X)).

       Independence is load-bearing only after all witness ownership,
       pins, caps, `F`, and history labels have been frozen.  A representative
       choice that activates a new row recouples the two sides and lies

       `W-U=Cat_m`.  The corrected endpoint phase is explicit.  For terminal

         M0(X_i)=T_i,  M0(o)=T_(W-1),  S={X_i T_(i+1)}.

       `X_0 -> ... -> X_(W-2) -> o`, and its colours are precisely the

2683ROOT. Two ambient clauses on the weakest `B+O(1)` route now have exact
          integral forms.

          First, the single-transition fixed-q1 obstruction has an
          unconditional multi-edge replacement.  For adjacent rank-r owners

            T-=R union {a},   T+=R union {b},

          choose an ordered nonempty partition
          `R=D_1 dotcup ... dotcup D_d`, guards `y in D_1,z in D_d`, and use

            ({a} union A,D_d,...,D_1,{b} union A'),
            A subset D_1-{y}, A' subset D_d-{z}.

          This is a genuine two-cell Cartesian macro.  Its owner windows are
          exactly `T-,T+`; its tail misses `y`, its head misses `z`, and its
          fixed middle state has union `R`, so no adjacent owner is forced
          twice.  The two literal shores have sizes
          `2^(|D_1|-1)` and `2^(|D_d|-1)`.

          In one frozen global placement, every contiguous interval row is
          left-only, right-only, or contains the whole fixed core `R` and is
          independent of both endpoint choices.  Point pins/caps and fixed
          address inequalities have the same separation.  Hence PCPS
          Boolean/erosion filtering preserves a Cartesian product; the
          rooted Rado choice remains independent because owner chronology,
          root incidence and upper colour are fixed.  This is not asserted
          for a nonconvex row or a new non-set automaton with joint endpoint
          action.

          Cutting a Middle Levels Hamilton cycle at a prescribed omitted
          root `o` and orienting toward an incident terminal owner `T*`
          gives the corrected phase

            M0(L_i)=T_i, M0(o)=T*,
            T_(W-1),...,T_0=T*.

          Pairing consecutive owners gives root-distinct supporting
          incidences and nontrivial opposed-hinge rectangles on every owner
          when W is even, and on every owner except the protected terminal
          singleton when W is odd.  The triangular depth obeys `d<=r-3` for
          every `r>=5`.  Thus the nonrectangular owner casualty is at most
          one and the owner/lower-root projection is a connected aperture
          path.  Literal connectivity is still open: the entering coordinate
          `b` occurs at source position `d+1` and must remain in the next d
          owners, so arbitrary interpair joins can fail at linearly many
          seams.

          Second, deficit-one predecessor repair now has an exact
          one-in/one-out calculus.  For a frozen accepted table with baseline
          capacities b, one input token at x repairs all roles iff

            |J| <= b(N(J)) + 1_(x in N(J))

          for every role set J.  When the global deficiency is at most one,
          the exact repair aperture is the intersection of all deficit-one
          neighborhoods.  An output token y is legal iff

            |J| <= b(N(J)) + 1_(x in N(J)) - 1_(y in N(J))

          for every J, equivalently y belongs to no augmented-tight
          neighborhood.  Every repairable input has an output because the
          augmented matching has one unused capacity copy.  At genuine
          deficiency one the token cannot be exported unchanged.  If
          `b=m+eta`, the selected packets plus protected bank have boundary
          exactly `1_y-1_x`; balanced extra components may remain.

          Disjoint deficit-one shores have additive deficiency, so the
          screened-collar obstruction can replicate within one slice and
          cannot be repaired by one token.  Temporal accumulation is
          different.  Add the literal Markov-complete suspension relation
          from an output at depth m to an input repair state at depth m+1.
          One token survives exactly along a path in this layered relay
          graph.  Since every layer is finite, compatible paths for every
          finite horizon are equivalent by Koenig compactness to one
          infinite spine.  Left-totality is unnecessary, but separate
          frozen witnesses at each depth do not imply a path.

          Fractional pull-clock membership is closed upstream but supplies
          neither the integral repair aperture nor a relay edge.  K17 now
          has a connected full 19,448/19,448 immediate-upper circulation,
          and independent scoped circuit descents substantially reduce
          residence while retaining owner/q1 rows; these scalar achievements
          cannot be combined unless they coexist on the same frozen
          complete-state input/output slice.

          The exact remaining physical hypothesis is one compatible
          finite-horizon family (equivalently one infinite spine) whose same
          frozen slices have global deficiency at most one, a physical
          output suspending into the next repair aperture, a connected
          protected skeleton, global source/address/history and compiler
          closure, and bounded terminal defects absent from exported fields.
          No `B+O(1)`, `B+1`, word, or new value of nu(k) is claimed.

2685K. The Protected Catalan--pivot Row-2 target now has an exact
       factor-first reduction, and the new K17 chain table removes a
       previously separate finite obstruction.

       First, an upper-exact rooted Catalan forest cannot itself have a
       bounded number of components: it has U edges on W roots and hence
       exactly W-U=Cat_m path components.  The bounded object must be an
       ambient turn factor.  For a full-immediate-upper protected factor F,
       all marking and deletion take place in its rooted successor shore
       T(F)=M1.  If lambda_R is the eligible multiplicity of upper task R,
       b_R=lambda_R-1, K0 is the set of factor cycles not already opened by
       an ineligible turn, and N_R is the set of K0-cycles containing an
       unprotected deletable occurrence of R, then a protected upper-exact
       Catalan forest exists if and only if

         |X| <= sum_(R:N_R intersects X nontrivially) b_R
                for every X subset K0.

       Thus a one-cycle upper-covering factor is automatic, while an
       s-component factor exports exactly at most 2^s-1 omission cuts.
       Scalar repeat surplus alone is insufficient.  Independently, the
       sharp 3d-turn pivot collar extends to a spanning factor whenever
       6d<=m-2, preserving internal collar residence.  The exact remaining
       all-m gate PBCOH_s is to make that factor upper-covering, bounded-
       component (or transparently pull-connected), accepting at its two
       collar boundaries, and omission-Hall feasible.  Forest-first
       connector matching has the exact deficiency criterion only on the
       explicitly edge-separable port face; common-cap, shared-witness and
       global-address rows still require a product theorem.

       Second, the materialized K17 depth-three table is independently
       replayed on the residence-2018 lollipop phase.  It has 24,310 rows,
       chain-length histogram (1748,3899,18663), covers all 65,535 lower
       targets exactly once, uses every rank-eight root and rank-nine owner
       exactly once, and every assigned root-owner edge belongs to the
       selected 48,620-incidence factor.  Therefore equitable lower
       named-target allocation is closed at K17 d=3.  The live finite
       lower-side row is literal chronology/state balance; it remains
       coupled to residence and the upper decks.  The coexistence with full
       opened immediate-upper coverage and residence debt 2018 is finite
       calibration only: it supplies no serialization, zero residence,
       deeper-upper closure, common-cap compiler, word, or all-m recurrence.

2685A. Simultaneous deficit-one copies now admit an exact conditional
       cross-depth fusion theorem, and the explicit K17 chain table exposes
       the first literal-state cut which that theorem must escape.

       A protected factor-critical module contains a literal root-to-socket
       path using every local resource except one root role and leaving one
       outgoing socket capacity.  A jointly occurrence-compatible bridge
       consumes that socket and the next module's omitted role.  Therefore a
       spanning path forest on p modules with c paths telescopes p local
       deficit pairs to exactly c exposed root--socket pairs.  A Hamilton
       path leaves one pair; a Hamilton cycle leaves none.  This bounds live
       deficit, not support or word cost: at least p-c bridges are necessary.

       Under port-complete internal root-by-socket relations and a universally
       matching-compatible bridge atlas, balanced one-copy completion is
       exactly quotient Hall,

         |N+(S)| >= |S|.

       The exact quotient defect is

         max_S (|S|-|N+(S)|)_+.

       After reserving a spanning c-path forest, the complete residual
       balance bank has only 2^c Hall rows.  Connectedness is separate: a
       residual perfect matching must be one cycle; for fixed c this is an
       exact check of at most c! matchings.  The four-role predecessor
       obstruction has the spanning factor-critical path 1->3->0->2, so
       literal bridges 2_t->1_(t+1) would cancel arbitrarily many copies.
       Boolean/Pascal supply of those complete-state bridges is unproved.

       The 24,310-row K17 table from item2684ROOT was independently replayed.
       Its chain-length histogram is (1748,3899,18663).  On the strict
       canonical disjoint-increment functional-rotor face, a three-chain
       with bottom rank s has ordered state signature (1,7-s,s).  A legal
       predecessor rotates this to (s,1,7-s); another three-chain can supply
       it only for s=1.  Hence the 18,646 three-chain heads with s>1 have at
       most 5,647 short-chain predecessor roles.  This is one explicit Hall
       shore of deficiency at least 12,999.  Every three-level chain
       partition on the same compressed levels has deficiency at least
       9,503 on this canonical face.

       Occurrence-wise, for a flag L_U<M_U<U attached to owner
       phi(U)=U+z_U, a canonical predecessor V must satisfy

         L_V=M_U-L_U,
         M_V=U-L_U,
         V=U-x+z_U for some x in L_U.

       Thus table selection and lower-target ownership are solved, but the
       canonical strict state bank is decisively impossible.  The proof-safe
       next gate is to catalogue enriched occurrence-labelled menus E_i for
       the frozen rows.  On certified Cartesian submenus A_i x H_i, balance
       is exactly

         ell_A(X)-r_H(X) <= eta(X)

       for every complete-state set X; rooted Euler completion additionally
       requires a distinct-row spanning skeleton and the shifted residual
       cuts.  Equivalently, factor-critical modules/bridges must genuinely
       change complete literal states rather than merely permute the
       canonical increments.  Residence is part of those complete states;
       arbitrary-width upper witnesses and common-cap/compiler closure remain
       separate downstream gates.
