2686ROOT. The K17 rank-compression proof now has an exact all-dimensional
          static generalization and a sharp first obstruction.

          Let P_i be disjoint unions of complete Boolean ranks, with size
          N_i and binomial-weighted rank law alpha_i. A joint nested random
          chain having the uniform distribution on every P_i exists if and
          only if

            alpha_0 <=_st alpha_1 <=_st ... <=_st alpha_q.

          Sufficiency is one common quantile coupling of the ranks followed
          by prefixes of one uniform permutation; necessity is cardinality
          projection. Separated rank intervals satisfy this automatically.
          The resulting LYM inequality is

            sum_i |A intersect P_i|/N_i <= 1,

          so the width is max_i N_i. Appending the complete rank-r owner
          level therefore gives W anchored chains whenever every block has
          size at most W. For arbitrary partial/Ferrers blocks, the exact
          replacement is normalized Hall

            |N_Q(F)|/|Q| >= |F|/|P|

          at every adjacent containment graph. Greedy consecutive whole-rank
          packing plus this theorem gives an unconditional all-k anchored
          chain factor of depth at most 2d+1.

          At K19, W=92,378, Lambda=262,143, d=3 and h=0. Rank nine occupies
          one full block. Any consecutive cut of ranks one through eight
          fails because

            sum_(s=1)^7 C(19,s)=94,183>W,
            C(19,7)+C(19,8)=125,970>W.

          The minimum capacity casualty is 1,805. More strongly, all 48
          capacity-feasible ordered assignments of the complete ranks to
          two blocks fail stochastic order, and the analytic threshold cut
          proves this without computation. Thus K19 has no depth-three
          whole-rank normal compression, although this does not refute an
          arbitrary uncompressed depth-three chain partition.

          The unconditional static repair is the four-block split

            [1,6] | [7] | [8] | [9],

          with loads 43,795, 50,388, 75,582 and 92,378. It yields W anchored
          chains of depth at most four, i.e. one extra static payload level
          and zero casualties. In the canonical rank-separated same-depth
          repair, rank seven must split:

            P0=[1,6] union X,
            P1=(rank7-X) union rank8,
            33,592 <= |X| <= 48,583.

          The subsequent fixed-triple choice

            X=rank7 - {S:H subset S}, |H|=3,

          has |X|=48,568 and satisfies normalized Hall on
          P0->P1->rank9 by exact orbit transport. Thus this finite
          same-depth clause is closed. More general all-k partial
          interlacing remains open under the normalized-Hall criterion.

          Consecutive unsplit packing cannot yield d+O(1): a central band of
          Theta(sqrt(k)) whole ranks, each between W/2 and 3W/4, forces
          Omega(W sqrt(k)) unused block capacity, hence g(k)-d(k)=
          Omega(sqrt(k)). The first odd failure of even d+1 blocks is K121,
          with d=7 and g=9. This no-go is scoped to consecutive unsplit
          blocks. Interlacing genuinely helps: an exact K31 four-block
          stochastic partition succeeds where consecutive packing needs
          five. All-k d+O(1) stochastic blocks remain unproved.

          Static chainization still supplies no literal overlap/Euler
          serialization, endpoint aperture, global address/history guards,
          residence, upper/common-cap/compiler closure, or same-frozen-slice
          regenerative relay. No B(k)+O(1) conclusion follows.

          For a fixed chronology tau, put

            x <=_tau y

          N(y) is contained in N(x). Replacing a selected x by an omitted y

          upsets. Deficiency is supermodular, so maximum witnesses uncross

          invariant product-order upset. For such an upset U, target

            |R_tau(U)| <= |Gamma_r(U)|.

          Top cancellation gives the sharp odd-dimensional oriented-shadow
          inequality |F|<=|Gamma_tau(F)| on the last two ranks. A terminal
          orbit swap is universally nonworsening only under predecessor-menu
          containment plus weight dominance. Distinct interior menus are
          incomparable, so witness-independent Ferrers bubble sorting cannot
          prove the adaptive theorem.

          6,659,211,024 at K41 while satisfying the capacity hypothesis. At
          K121 it uses exactly d=7 blocks but has deficit

            26,797,240,071,313,150,869,734,178,805,578,123.

          existential clause. Exact positive repairs are:

            K11: one pair-orbit of deliberate underfill, depth 3;
            K46: a five-orbit balanced-core later menu, depth 4;
            K121: two bottom orbit blocks plus full ranks 55..60,
                  depth d+1=8.

          The K121 global flow succeeds even though its second mixed block
          has a strict normalized-Hall obstruction to rank55. A separate
          sparse product-Hasse-DAG flow agrees with the dense encoding and
          saturates Lambda=2^120-1. Balanced setwise-core orbits also give
          unconditional d+5 capacity with only O(k^2) types; terminal and
          interior cuts refute fixed serpents, while the K46 adaptive menu
          shows that one min-cut-aware repair can work.

          The exact remaining static theorem is adaptive chronological-upset
          expansion with at most d+C blocks. It is unproved and lies on the
          near-uniform Boolean-chain frontier. It supplies no literal overlap,
          address/history, residence, common-cap, compiler, or regeneration.

2695ROOT. The Dong--Mao interval theorem gives a large partial central
          diamond bank, but not either central bank required by the common
          base.

          Dong--Mao prove a full interval bank only when

            n >= (ell+1)r+ell.

          The central substitution (2m,m-1,2) fails for every m>=2 and lies
          strictly in their open Problem 4.2 range. Their result must not be
          cited as a central maximum-packing theorem.

          It does give a genuine partial absorber. Stratify by all patterns
          on 2m-5 fixed coordinates and use the critical B5 cycle-lemma bank
          in the remaining five-coordinate fibres. The resulting one-bank
          size is

            D_m=2 C(2m-5,m-1)+10 C(2m-5,m-2),

          with exact density

            D_m/(C(2m,m)/2)
              =m(3m-4)/((2m-1)(2m-3)) -> 3/4.

          It is maximum on this frozen-fibre face and reaches full capacity
          at m=3. Two copies remain cardinality-insufficient for every m>=6.

          The corrected two-bank theorem is exact. Complementary banks
          automatically satisfy the lower, upper, tail and head partition
          rows. Their union is an ordered four-transversal exactly when its
          physical Johnson graph, equivalently the cross-bank overlap line
          graph, is a forest. Conversely every Catalan linear forest
          alternately edge-colours into two such banks. Bank sizes obey

            W/2-W/(m+1) <= b_e <= W/2.

          A fixed ground bipartition cannot force the graphic row: coverage
          forces both sides to size m, and the m lower colours A-{a} all
          force the same middle vertex A, of degree m>2. Thus naive
          coordinate parity is excluded for m>=3; selected-graph or
          state-dependent bipartiteness remains viable.

          The unproved common-base clause is simultaneous complementary
          lower/upper palettes, within-bank middle matchings, and an acyclic
          aggregate overlap graph on the same protected host. Dong--Mao
          supplies none of this cross-bank correlation.

2696A. Dong--Mao's 2026 interval-packing theorem and the new central
       complementary two-bank reduction are now independently audited
       against the literal common-base gate.

       The primary theorem is exactly

         nu_(n;ell,ell+r)=binom(n,ell)
         when n >= (ell+1)r+ell.

       For central diamonds `(n,ell,r)=(2m,m-1,2)`, this would require
       `2m>=3m-1`, false for every `m>=2`; these parameters lie strictly in
       Dong--Mao Problem 4.2's open central range.  The two-bank capacity
       ledger is exact: with `K=Cat_m`, `N=mK`, `W=(m+1)K`,

         b0+b1=N,
         W/2-W/(m+1) <= b_e <= W/2,
         Delta0+Delta1=2K.

       These are necessary rows, not a feasibility characterization.

       The two-bank graph theorem passes.  Complementary lower and upper
       palettes make each bank a middle matching; their union consists of
       isolated vertices, alternating paths, and even alternating cycles.
       Componentwise orientation gives the four static resource rows, and
       acyclicity is exactly the graphic row.  Conversely every Catalan
       linear forest alternately edge-colours into two such banks.  Deleting
       one edge per cycle gives only a c-defect forest.  Recolouring or
       reversing a cycle leaves the union and its cycle count unchanged, so
       Dong--Mao supplies no circuit-complete absorber.

       The proved theorem can nevertheless seed noncentral fixed-core
       slices.  A slice with fixed core intersection i is
       `P_(n-h;ell-i,ell-i+2)` and is bottom-saturating when
       `n-h>=3(ell-i)+2`.  Hence K19/H3 certifies exactly the full-core
       `i=3` slice of 1820 bottoms; K21/H8 certifies direct slices `i>=5`
       (and the opposite extreme `i=0` by complement), while the
       load-bearing `i=4` slice fails by one.

       Item2695ROOT's stronger five-coordinate stratification is also
       incorporated: one literal central bank has

         D_m=2 C(2m-5,m-1)+10 C(2m-5,m-2)

       intervals and exact middle-capacity density
       `m(3m-4)/((2m-1)(2m-3))->3/4`.  This is a genuine partial static
       common basis and is optimal on the frozen-fibre face, but two copies
       are already cardinality-insufficient for `m>=6`.  It supplies no
       complementary palettes or resource-neutral exchange atlas.

       A fixed coordinate bipartition cannot supply the central banks for
       `m>=3`: coverage forces both coordinate shores to size m, and the m
       lower sets `A-{a}` force degree m at the middle vertex A.  The correct
       parity is selected-graph dependent.  Given bank label beta, derive a
       componentwise vertex phase pi and orient `uv` from u exactly when
       `pi(u)=beta(uv)`; the remaining exact topology rows are the graphic
       cuts `|E(S)|<=|S|-1`.

       Common-base insertion is conditional and now fully qualified.  The
       bi-packing must embed with protected and noncentral roles into one
       exact owner--named-payload table; Cartesian rotor menus must preserve
       all four central labels and guards; fixed Johnson endpoints must not
       be conflated with variable rotor states; and cycle deletion requires
       a rebuilt boundary and a fresh Hoffman audit.  On that face the exact
       cuts `ell_A(X)-r_H(X)<=eta(X)` complete the state row.  The K11 C10
       Smith-2 gadget confirms that static intervals plus a primitive
       chronology circuit alone do not remove literal torsion.

2697ROOT. The adaptive chronological-upset lane now has an exact
          interval-profile target, a sharp multiboundary obstruction, and
          two proof-safe repair/no-go theorems.  The all-k `d+C` clause
          remains unproved.

          On the balanced setwise-core quotient, target type `(i,j)` has
          the clipped owner interval

            I(i,j)=[max(i,p_-), min(R-j,p_+)].

          Vertex Hall is equivalent to

            E_tau(J) <= cap(J)

          for every owner interval `J`, where `E_tau(J)` is the maximum
          exposed-root mass over chronological upsets contained in the
          clipped northeast rectangle `Q_J`.  The maximum over proper
          sub-upsets is essential: at K9 all 15 complete rectangles pass,
          but one proper upset has `130>126`.

          For root banks with palettes `A_t`, signed local reserves
          `rho_t=cap(A_t)-w(R_t)`, and carried suffix palettes `S_(t+1)`,
          the exact global deficiency is

            sum_t [cap(A_t intersect S_(t+1))-rho_t].

          K9 is the first exact obstruction to independent local-bank
          certification: its banks pass `125/125` and `5/21`, but overlap
          20 exceeds reserve 16, giving deficit 4.  The same identity
          recovers the K46 interior deficit 64,633,068,796.

          A literal bounded-component palette sidecar is impossible.  Any
          q-block chronology has a top-rank upset with at least

            ceil((1/3) ceil(R/q))

          palette components, hence Omega(sqrt(k)) at q=d+O(1).  Aggregate
          interval profiles or another compressed history are necessary.

          Complete collars do not repair bad lower blocks.  Every
          pre-collar block must itself match into the owners.  A dedicated
          collar of width L has scalar waste

            E_L=(2/3+o(1)) L^3/k,

          so d+O(1) forces `L=O(k^(1/3))`; the K121 choice `L=d-1`
          loses `0.1316552642... sqrt(k)` blocks asymptotically.  Exact
          scalar depths are K121 `8=d+1` and K201 `11=d+2`.  Moreover every
          K121 depth-eight factor with that layout has at least

            65,819,038,470,988,494,034,825,456,661,865,107

          lower-carrying chains which skip rank 55 (`0.3434407704... W`).
          Thus K121 is genuinely global skipping, not a reset with a
          bounded exceptional sidecar.

          For containment-monotone chronologies, exposed roots in distinct
          times are incomparable and

            |R_tau(U)|-|Gamma_R(U)|
              <= sum_t (|R_t|-width(R_t)).

          Hence every failure has comparable co-timed roots.  Splitting
          their block at an intervening rank is a pure monotone refinement
          which strictly improves that witness.  The `q+r-1` termination
          bound requires the stronger global rank order, not merely
          containment monotonicity.  On the frozen K41 ascending-mask
          chronology, every zero-, one-, or two-rank-cut refinement fails,
          while cuts `{17,18,19}` give exact flow `2^40-1`; three cuts are
          necessary and sufficient only on this frozen face.

          The exact remaining hypothesis is an all-k construction with
          `d+C` blocks satisfying every interval profile, equivalently a
          constant-cost root-chain breaker with aggregate overlap history.
          Static success would still not imply literal overlap,
          address/history, residence, compiler, or regeneration.

2698ROOT. The K17 ordinary-recoupling/status-relay payload face has an exact
          square perfect-matching normalization.  This sharpens, rather
          than replaces, the independently replayed compound relay-path
          theorem.

          Let the 18,646 distinct hard-row bottoms be real left tokens, add
          1,748 dummy left tokens, and take as the right shore the 1,748
          free rows plus 18,646 hard slots.  A real bottom B_a sees free row
          f exactly when B_a is a strict subset of R_f, and sees hard slot v
          exactly when B_a is a strict subset of M_v.  Every dummy sees all
          hard slots and no free row.  Both shores have size 20,394.

          A perfect matching materializes the table literally: a real token
          at f gives `(B_a,R_f)`, a real token at v gives
          `(B_a,M_v,R_v)`, and a dummy at v gives `(M_v,R_v)`.  Conversely
          every exact bottom-relocated table gives this matching, uniquely
          modulo dummy labels.  It preserves every named target, owner and
          root and forces the exact histogram `(0,7395,16915)`.

          Hence the outer payload polytope is bipartite-matching integral.
          Dummies may be quotiented: saturate all real tokens and all free
          rows, with capacity one on hard slots.  Its exact Hall cuts are

            |N_F(X)|+|N_H(X)| >= |X|,
            |N_F(X)| >= |X|-16898.

          Restricting shorts to an admissible bank A replaces the second row
          by

            |N_F(X)|+|N_H(X) union A| >= |X|+1748,

          together with `|A|>=1748`.  Any additive short-slot seed objective
          is therefore one exact min-cost matching.

          The feasible 1,748-element short-slot sets are bases of the
          cotransversal matroid `(M/F)^*`, where M is the real-bottom
          transversal matroid and F is the required free-row set.  This
          gives an exact alternating-circuit/exchange oracle.  A private
          socket-ticket transversal matroid would yield a genuine Edmonds
          common-base criterion, but the actual shared long-tail/head,
          flag, common-cell and degree system has not been proved matroidal.
          This warning is sharp already for three abstract short colours:
          socket menus `a:(1,1), b:(1,2), c:(2,1)` make `{a}` and `{b,c}`
          feasible but neither augmentation of `{a}` feasible, violating
          matroid exchange.

          Atomic status relays are alternating four-cycles with one dummy;
          longer donor paths/cycles are ordinary alternating matching
          circuits.  The authenticated path
          `29->520->2117->F15856` is the existing nontrivial calibration.
          The fixed round-47 table still has 5,969 socketless short roles,
          so none of these outer integrality statements is a `1S`, source,
          compiler, residence, upper, or word certificate.

2701A. The new movable-bottom matching theorem contains the Boolean
       interval actuators exactly, but the authenticated K17 suffix table
       has a sharp saturated-`C10` obstruction.

       For a fixed consecutive suffix `M<U`, decorate a legal bottom edge
       by the induced other middle

         chi(B;M,U)=B union (U-M).

       Two bottom matchings on the same bottoms and suffix slots lift to
       identical lower/upper/tail/head interval palettes iff their `chi`
       multisets agree.  Thus the hub `C6`, aperture `C8`, and saturated
       `B_5 C10` are literal alternating circuits of the TU bottom matching:
       the `(M,U)` suffix and its owner/root stay fixed occurrencewise,
       while `chi` is deck-preserved but changes address.  This is sharp;
       fixing both middle vertices occurrencewise fixes the lower as their
       intersection and leaves no nonidentity interval trade.

       On the frozen K17 depth-three table, 18,646 eligible bottom tokens
       and 10,025 consecutive `6<7<8` suffix slots give the exact census

         raw/native C6 = 96,619/246,
         raw/native C8 = 287,269/16,
         saturated B5 C10 = 0/0.

       The native `C6/C8` moves replay the full target partition, fixed
       suffixes, owner/root rows, histogram and `chi` deck.  But no sequence
       of bottom relays can create the missing `C10`, because relays do not
       change the suffix catalogue.  Hence the combined `C10+C6` absorber
       is impossible on this frozen bottom-only face; suffix rethreading or
       another table remains live.  The positive moves are lower-band
       payload circuits only and assert no common state, reset, residence,
       upper, topology or compiler compatibility.

2702A. The cotransversal short-bank theorem has an exact matroidal socket
       partner only on a genuinely private, or more generally Rado,
       ticket face.

       Let `G subset E x T` be a literal compatibility graph from candidate
       short slots to completed tickets.  If distinct tickets have disjoint
       complete owner/address/history/cap/guard footprints, the feasible
       short sets are the transversal matroid `M[G]`.  If residual ticket
       conflicts are the independent sets of a matroid `N` (laminar
       capacities suffice), they instead form the Rado matroid `R(G,N)`.
       For target size `r`, the exact criterion is

         r_Mshort(X) + r_R(E-X) >= r  for every X subset E.

       Equivalently, ask for common bases after rank-`r` truncating both
       matroids; in K17 `r=r(M_short)=1748`, so only the socket/Rado side
       needs nontrivial truncation.  A protected Boolean actuator footprint
       `P` composes with this theorem through deletion minors on `E-P`.

       The current movable-bottom Boolean `C6/C8/C10` actuators do NOT
       realize this `M_sock`: every proved circuit is dummy-free and fixes
       the dummy-matched short set pointwise.  They are internal routers in
       one `M_short` fibre.  A valid bridge must be a dummy-bearing completed
       actuator with one unary exported short and a private or matroidal
       history footprint.

       Nor may the actual shared-state socket system simply be declared
       matroidal.  In the authenticated relaxed-nine catalogue, the unique
       sockets for shorts 4183, 4218 and 4250 give the exact augmentation

       hereditary partial shared-socket layer, not of the family extending
       to complete canonical K17 cycle covers.  The verifier binds the
       frozen input SHA, all 2188 rows and all 1426 shorts and replays PASS.

2703ROOT. The one-movable-layer lemma extends exactly to arbitrary
          chronology block sizes and now has a full carry-state
          factorization.

          With `b` movable bottoms, `f` mandatory receivers, `h` optional
          frozen suffixes and `d=f+h-b` dummies, the square augmented graph
          has a perfect matching exactly when

            |N_F(X)|+|N_H(X)| >= |X|,
            |N_F(X)| >= |X|-(b-f)

          for every real-bottom set X.  Its optional carry sets are the
          bases of `(M_B/F)^*`, a strict gammoid.  For a fixed chronology,
          the complete multilevel successor problem remains one bipartite-
          integral matching; there is no intrinsic multilevel payload
          nonintegrality.

          Let `L=M_B/F` and let

            K=Q_A/(A^+ union Bhat)

          be the contraction of the successor transversal of the entire
          earlier prefix.  A current layer can be frozen without killing
          all earlier completions exactly when

            r_L(X)+r_(K^*)(H-X) >= r(L)  for every X subset H.

          This carries the full prefix rank oracle, not a bounded scalar.
          A literal two-slot Boolean example shows that even the complete
          balanced type vector, owner palette, owner interval and scalar
          reserve do not determine future viability.

          The exact B5 composition is now also closed on the static
          payload face.  Every used `C10` is a 5-cycle and every used `C6`
          is a 3-cycle between the same bottom tokens and fixed suffix-slot
          occurrences.  Prescribing any finite union of these cycles and
          deleting its equal shores leaves one residual rectangular graph;
          both modes extend, or neither does, under the same two Hall
          families.  Thus the undecorated containment carry and realized
          exposed base are unchanged by

            5 C4 -> C20,
            5 C4 + 2 K2 -> P22 + P2,
            15 C4 + 2 K2 -> P62 + P2.

          The first three-socket fusion `C6` fixes its tail--upper suffix
          pairs, not its displayed head--upper pairs.  It is therefore an
          untyped one-layer relay, not automatically a directed fixed-head
          carry relay.

          The exact protected interface is pointwise equality on H of the
          two contracted rank functions

            r_M(F union X)-r_M(F),
            r_Q(C union X)-r_Q(C),  C=A^+ union Bhat.

          Equivalently the two modes have the same `L` and `K`.  Equality
          of every exported receiver column is a checkable sufficient
          lift.  If a protected signature is inherited from its slot, it
          must be constant on each actuator 5-cycle or 3-cycle.  Four-row
          palette equality and unchanged occupied support are not enough:

2704A. The dummy-bearing Boolean socket actuator has an exact positive
       projection but a dimension-uniform full-signature obstruction.

       On a completed hard-slot table, write the resource vector as one
       fixed contribution per suffix slot plus one moving incidence
       `sigma(B,v)` per real bottom edge.  Two bottom/dummy matchings have
       the same completed ledger iff their sums of moving incidences agree.
       For the Boolean relay, `sigma(B,v)` is the unit vector of

         chi(B;v)=B union (U_v-M_v).

       Hence the support-minimal short-basis exchange is the dummy C4

         {u-v0, B-v1} <-> {B-v0, u-v1},

       where `M_i=B+x_i`, `U_i=B+x_i+z`.  It changes the short set
       `{v0}<->{v1}`, preserves the exact target partition, and has the
       same moving label `chi=B+z`.  Punctured hub C6 and C8 modules give
       completed-ledger `U_(1,3)` and `U_(1,4)` partition blocks; mutually
       complete-footprint-disjoint copies form a transversal direct sum.
       The saturated B5 C10 does not puncture: its two removed chi labels
       are different.

       This is NOT yet the requested full common-state ticket.  In the
       typed active real-interval ledger, every coefficient-one fixed
       suffix has the coordinatewise identities

         H(M_v)+s_v=1,   U(U_v)+s_v=1.

       Therefore exact preservation of either the typed head or typed upper
       palette forces `Delta s_v=0` for every slot.  The obstruction is a
       free cokernel row, not parity or B5 core flux.  It survives arbitrary
       support size, overlapping moves, and every dummy-free C6/C8/C10
       companion.  Thus no B5, B6, or larger fixed-suffix circuit can both
       change a basis of `M_short` and preserve the full typed guard/cap
       signature.

       Two completed endpoint modes contract to one private `U_(1,2)`
       socket ticket only after each has a literal common-state replay,
       their exterior and globally named ledgers agree, and the UNION of
       their alternative footprints is private from every other ticket.
       Internal predecessor/successor identities and flags may differ
       because the modes are never co-selected.  The canonical long/short
       roles of the minimal C4 cannot be adjacent in a source chronology;
       a fixed-order internal two-mode collar needs at least five roles
       `g0,e0,g1,e1,g2`.  This is a lower bound, not an existence theorem.

       Consequently the first admissible full-signature escape is not a
       larger frozen B5 actuator.  It is a joint-master transposition of an
       ENTIRE short packet and an entire long packet, including suffix,
       owner/root, state, history, caps and guards.  That move lies outside
       the fixed cotransversal `M_short=(M/F)^*` face.  Constructing its
       literal five-role collar and a rank-1748 private packing is the exact
       next gate.

2705ROOT. The preliminary sidecar warning in 2703ROOT is now sharply
          scoped and the local exterior-reset problem is closed.  Only
          using the emitted `P2` as the next target with the SAME base
          forces the lower/tail duplicate.  A cross-core exterior handoff
          exists and is overlap-minimal.

          Write

            F_(S,a)(x,y)
              =(S+x,S+a+x+y; S+a+x -> S+x+y).

          For `m>=6`, choose `|R|=m-5`, one five-set K, one d-pair X,
          and distinct `q,s,c,z,a,b` off `R union K`.  Put

            C1=R+q+s,  S1=R+s+X,
            C2=R+c+z,  S2=R+c+X.

          Socket 1 uses core C1, markers `(a,b)`, pivot q and fresh c;
          socket 2 uses core C2, markers `(a,s)`, pivot z and fresh b.
          Then

            F_(S1,a)(c,b)=F_(S2,a)(s,b)

          is simultaneously the first emitted sidecar and one exterior
          old atom of the second opener.  Cancelling it leaves a five-old/
          five-new Boolean trade.  Including the two C10 compressors gives

            10 C4 + 3 K2
              -> P22 + P2 + C20 + K2
              -> 2 P22 + P2.

          All four named decks agree, both banks match, the net replacement
          has 15 atoms per side, `Delta beta=-10`, and only one P2 survives.
          Two distinct opener C6 phases cannot share two atoms without
          coinciding and undoing the first move, so one shared atom is
          minimal.

          The relay iterates cleanly.  For every `1<=t<=m-4`, private
          pivots q_i and the recursion

            S_(i+1)=S_i-s_i+c_i,
            b_(i+1)=s_i,  c_(i+1)=b_i

          give

            F_(S_i,a)(c_i,b_i)
              =F_(S_(i+1),a)(b_(i+1),c_(i+1)).

          The exact phase sequence is

            5t C4 + (t+1) K2 -> t P22 + P2,

          with `21t+1` table atoms, `7t+1` changed atoms per endpoint,
          `Delta beta=-5t`, support `m+4+t<=2m`, and one live sidecar at
          every intermediate phase.  The distinct lower/tail invariant is

            D0=X+T+b0,
            D1=X+T+c0,
            Di=X+(T-s_(i-1))+b0+c0  (i>=2).

          A period-three pointwise reset repeats one of these rows and is
          illegal; the fresh address sequence is load-bearing.  Thus the
          theorem gives a linear clean chain, not an extensive host.

          Prescribed payload planting is also exact beyond the two raw Hall
          rows.  For `r=|B0|=|R0|`, `r_H=|R0 intersect H|`, define

            s1(X)=|N_(F union H)(X)|-|X|,
            s2(X)=|N_F(X)|-|X|+(b-f).

          Both actuator modes extend iff, for every `X subset B-B0`,

            s1(X)>=|N(X) intersect R0|,
            s2(X)>=|N_F(X) intersect R0|+r_H.

          The module shore sizes are 5,8,18,21.  Uniform Hall slack is
          cumulative across a disjoint bank.  In contrast, if all old modes
          are a submatching of one incumbent augmented perfect matching,
          every phase vector extends with ZERO slack.  For fixed B0, the
          deletable receiver shores are exactly the bases of the rank-r
          strict gammoid dual to the remaining receiver transversal.

          Protected clone abundance has a sharp negative answer.  Colour a
          C10 slot by whether its distinguished point lies between its two
          rim neighbours in a fixed order.  Every C10 is bichromatic: the
          least point kills all-median, while all-extremal would alternate
          signs around an odd five-cycle.  Thus even two signatures can
          eliminate every transparent C10.  Conditional on g clone-good
          endpoint cores, the Johnson conflict theorem still plants at
          least

            ceil(g (m-2)(m-3) / (2(3m^2-14m+13)))

          disjoint closed sockets.  Hub C6 clones obey unrooted triangle
          Ramsey, but a named target edge xy needs the rooted condition

            A_xy={z:sigma(xz)=sigma(yz)=sigma(xy)} nonempty,

          and simultaneous targets need Hall on `xy~z`.  Neither follows
          from finite signature cardinality.

          The weakest remaining actuator host is therefore exact: one
          incumbent-aligned, clone-good B5 bank on the SAME frozen carry
          base; rooted opening Hall; a cover by O(1) clean relay chains (or
          a collision-free splice of the linear chains); and pointwise
          equality of all address/history/reset/residence/upper/source/
          compiler receiver columns.  The K17 frozen suffix catalogue still
          has zero C10 sockets, so it cannot instantiate this host without
          suffix rethreading.  The all-k carry-rank chronology and literal
          serialization also remain unproved.

            prescribed Hall erosions: 334,575;
            signature orders: 120;
            two-socket relays: m=6..30;

       exact no-singleton chain table with histogram `(0,7395,16915)`.
       Explicitly, `C_M` has16915 elements, `C_R` has4862, and
       `B=R-C_R` is an M7 basis.  Match L into C and M into B.

       for `b in B,r in C_R`, use `B'=B-b+r`, `C'=C-r+b` exactly when the
       rank7/root and low-receiver matchings both extend.  Weighted Edmonds
       intersection may price receiver-intrinsic root/menu scores and
       protect fixed data by matroid deletion/contraction; it cannot price
       a socket property tied to the chosen matching edge and does not yet
       choose compatible occurrence witnesses.

2714ROOT. The address-transport replacement for pointwise clone equality is
          now exact, and the remaining all-k host obstruction is quantified.
          For local old/new bottom assignments

            mu_0,mu_1 : B -> V,

          let `(alpha,beta)` be the bottom/slot restriction of one
          exterior-fixed isomorphism of the complete carried relational
          interface.  A protected toggle exists exactly when

            beta mu_0 = mu_1 alpha.

          This is a paired-interface theorem.  It becomes ordinary
          double-coset membership only after bottom/slot factorization is
          proved; histories may couple the shores.  For one compatible
          regenerative spine, a strictly weaker selected-certificate form is
          exact: it need transport only the chosen current and earlier-prefix
          matchings, realized carry, aperture/reset/history/residence,
          upper/source/supplier witnesses, and used capacity-one cells.  Full
          rank-oracle conjugacy is needed only for every-carry universality,
          and a phase hypercube has its separate coherence condition.

          The exact unmatched assignment-port obstruction is

            delta_if = min_(alpha,beta)
              |{b : beta mu_0(b) != mu_1 alpha(b)}|.

          It is a port count, not automatically a source-letter cost.  On the
          raw fixed-bottom/fixed-slot assignment interface, an opened
          C10+C6 module has `delta_if=8`; p footprint-disjoint modules have
          `8p`, corresponding to sixteen scalar lower/tail mismatches per
          module.  Thus O(1) fresh exceptions per module accumulate sharply.

          Local partial address maps glue if and only if they agree on every
          actual intersection and create no accidental image collision.
          Relay groupoid transports glue universally exactly at zero cycle
          holonomy; for one selected certificate each cycle need only fix the
          selected state.  A clean path has no internal cycle holonomy but its
          endpoint monodromy must satisfy the reset relation.  Crucially, an
          abstract relay path is not a global address certificate: short
          depth components can create nonadjacent source-block intersections,
          so all actual overlaps and whole-prefix histories must still replay.

          The topological and rooted deficits are also separated exactly.  A
          clean path forest with p opened modules and e relay identifications
          leaves `p-e` live P2 topology ports.  Under complete opener-footprint
          privacy, the number left unopened is the Hall deficiency

            delta_raw-b lambda >= Delta > 0.

          Outside right-private factorization, the full conflict packet has
          three proved complete-factor certificates.  For a rational
          role-normalized law x,

            lambda_x(c)=sum_(d conflict c)x_d <= 1/2

          on every positive candidate gives an integral transversal by
          denominator clearing and Haxell's 2Delta theorem.  For uniform
          part sizes d_s, define

            eta_s=sum_(t!=s)c_st/(d_s d_t).

          The asymmetric local lemma gives a transversal whenever

            eta_s+eta_t <= 1/4

          on every live conflict pair.  Finally, if complete footprints have
          rank at most R, the Aharoni--Haxell condition

            nu(union_(s in I) H_s) > (2R-3)(|I|-1)

          gives a rainbow matching.  Every literal address/history resource
          must count toward R.

          There is an explicit boundary/codegree surrogate.  If a type-j
          boundary uses b_(phi,j) resources, one such resource deletes at
          most ell_(phi,s,j) candidates of role s, a retained candidate uses
          at most q_(phi,j) resources, and each retained resource has load at
          most L_(phi,j), then boundary erosion is at most

            e_(phi,s)=sum_j b_(phi,j) ell_(phi,s,j)

          and maximum candidate conflict degree is at most

            sum_j q_(phi,j)(L_(phi,j)-1).

          Thus positive post-boundary menus of common size D with

            D >= 2 sum_j q_(phi,j)(L_(phi,j)-1)

          give a full phase factor.  All bulk-boundary and bulk-bulk
          conflicts must be witnessed by the counted resources.

          The weakest proved aggregate route needs no pointwise expansion.
          Put

            M_x=sum_({c,d} conflict)x_c x_d.

          Independent sampling has expected M_x selected conflict edges, so
          one selection has at most floor(M_x).  Deleting one endpoint role
          from each conflict yields an independent partial bank.  Across the
          two phases a common deletion of size at most

            floor(M_0)+floor(M_1)

          suffices.  For shared-resource conflicts,

            M_x <= (1/2) sum_u L_x(u)^2.

          Therefore M_0+M_1=O(1), together with one jointly compatible
          conjugate terminal completion of the exceptional shore, is enough
          for the static bounded-sidecar layer.  It does not itself construct
          that completion.

          The bare odd-central owner row is not the obstruction.  The
          r-regular rank-(r-1)/rank-r Boolean incidence graph decomposes by
          repeated Hall into r perfect owner allocations, nine at K17.  A
          packet-family averaging corollary chooses one common allocation if
          the average two-phase zero-menu plus collision energy is O(1).
          This requires an admissible protected packet and bounded boundary
          for each allocation being averaged; a compressed-normal
          common-basis fibre does not automatically contain the bare
          one-factorization.

          The urgent pull-clock objection is correct for the newly pasted
          derivation in item2580B.  The ratio

            p_s/p_(s-1)=(k-s+1)/s

          decreases.  Its reversed bounds do not prove x_(delta,j)>=0, and
          (1-rho)^(-1) is negative because rho>1.  At K15 the bad directions
          fail exactly:

            rho=3,  A_2/A_3=13/3>3,
            Delta_2/Delta_1=5/7<3.

          The authoritative correction uses

            A_delta/A_(delta+1) >= rho,
            Delta_(j+1)/Delta_j <= rho,
            theta=1/rho<1,

          and the positive geometric denominator rho-1.  These inequalities
          prove nonnegative coefficients and pull cost at most one.  A
          separate monotone-rotor vertex decomposition plus biregular
          labelled lift proves the same q in ST membership without any
          ratio algebra.  Hence the newly pasted proof is retracted but the
          symmetric rank-only fractional theorem survives.

          Fractional trace membership still enters the replacement packet
          only through an UNPROVED literal map into one fixed host and actual
          boundary, with unit mass per role, actual resource loads at most
          one, and every declared balance/history row.  Static Haxell/LLL
          rounding need not preserve Hoffman balance.  The Cartesian
          fixed-table rotor theorem applies only when all private rows remain
          on that network face; otherwise a distinct-role spanning skeleton
          plus residual Hoffman cuts, or a literal row-preserving fusion, is
          still required.

          The exact remaining all-k host lemma is now: construct uniformly
          on one compatible spine a new protected common-basis table, exact
          inverse parent, common owner allocation and bounded complete
          boundary satisfying a full-factor certificate above, or bounded
          two-phase collision energy plus one joint bounded exceptional-shore
          completion.  Then, simultaneously on that same host and spine,
          supply integral connected chronology, endpoint aperture/reset,
          physical birail cross matchings and zero-block collapse, the
          literal monotone pivot/two rays, residence/upper/source legality,
          bounded total compiler eviction and even terminal children.

          Under those still-unproved joint hypotheses, existing accounting
          gives only the conditional bound

            nu(k) <= B(k)+a+C_term.

          Uniform a,C_term would yield B(k)+O(1).  No unconditional
          B(k)+O(1), B+1 or new exact value of nu(k) is proved here.

2720ROOT. Adaptive protected recourse now has an exact matching/Rado
          contraction theorem, a sharp representation-dependent
          counterexample, and a quantified missing all-k hypothesis.

          Embed every parent and child supplier graph in one authenticated
          semantic head universe, giving inactive heads private dummy
          suppliers.  For any fully recomputed child and integer D,

            delta(child) <= D

          holds if and only if every semantic shore Q satisfies

            g_child(Q)-g_parent(Q) >= kappa_parent(Q)-D.

          This prices every near-tight shore; expanding one incumbent DM
          shore is not sufficient when representation recourse erodes
          another shore.

          Fix a parent maximum matching M of rank r.  In one fully replayed
          child let

            M0 = M intersect E(child),   |M0|=r-q.

          If that same child contains p pairwise vertex-disjoint
          M0-augmenting paths, simultaneous toggling gives

            rank(child) >= r-q+p,
            delta(child) <= delta(parent)+q-p.

          The augmentation surplus is p-q.  For maximal p it is the exact
          rank gain.  Another parent maximum matching can lower q and
          maximal p together; it may simplify a nonmaximal certificate but
          cannot improve the intrinsic exact surplus.  Paths from distinct
          completions, or paths colliding on any literal resource, cannot
          be pooled.

          Hence, for Phi equal to supplier deficiency,

            q <= a0 Phi+b,
            p >= (a0+eta) Phi

          implies the exact recurrence

            Phi' <= (1-eta)Phi+b.

          For a complete carried potential the same conclusion uses the
          additional accounting row

            Phi' <= Phi+q-p+c,

          and replaces b by b+c.  This row must price reset, residence,
          upper, compiler and every other casualty; supplier matching alone
          does not prove it.

          On one fixed child/core/matching, a capacity-faithful
          vertex-split packet atlas is a strict gammoid.  For
          occurrence-labelled menus P_u, deficient Rado gives exactly

            q*(U)=max_(X subset U)
                    (|X|-r_Gamma(union_(u in X) P_u)).

          For a host frozen before exposure, one finite master occurrence
          universe Ubar and one fixed atlas must satisfy

            r_Gamma(P(X)) >= (1-theta)|X|-gamma

          for every labelled X subset Ubar.  Repeated structural types
          cannot be identified.  A known one-shot exposure needs only the
          exact weaker cut r_Gamma(P(X))>=|X|-q.

          The joint representation-stable Rado expansion hypothesis JRRX
          binds, before the Rado quantifier, one action, recourse completion,
          child, common protected core, maximum core matching, network,
          port ground, occurrence menus and gammoid.  It also requires

            core loss <= L,
            |U| >= alpha delta-b.

          These rows imply

            delta' <= (1-alpha(1-theta))delta
                      +L+(1-theta)b+gamma.

          Near-perfect repair rank gives delta'<=L+C directly.  Conversely,
          a bank of bounded cardinality H and bounded per-packet rank s can
          improve deficiency by at most sH; it cannot contract unbounded
          deficiency by a fixed fraction.  The viable meaning of bounded
          bank is therefore an extensive bank of bounded-size packets with
          a bounded carried interface.

          Two exact obstructions prevent a weighted-matroid shortcut.
          Matching rank on optional supplier edges is non-submodular.
          Moreover, a two-head K2,2 representation-recourse example tensors
          to arbitrary deficiency: every old DM shore receives a local
          augmenting bridge while a deleted old edge creates a new singleton
          shore, so total deficiency does not fall.

          Item 2580D is consistent with this theorem.  It freezes one
          genuine finite joint presentation completion and the
          16877/16898 deficiency-21 parent, but its 114,594 structural modes
          are marginal catalogues.  They are not a common-child gammoid.
          On the fixed 16,898-head face, target 20 needs one authenticated
          16878/16898 child satisfying all shores.  If active heads change,
          use the dummy-completed semantic rank instead.

          The corrected pull clock, bare coatom owner factors, local Pascal
          pivot/relay rows, birail telescoping, zero-block collapse, bounded
          eviction and fixed-segmentation RSB remain useful inputs, but none
          proves JRRX.  Static replacement-host factors and bounded
          collision-energy deletion also need an UNPROVED same-child decode
          into disjoint supplier augmenting paths relative to one common
          core.

          Finally, if the complete recurrence holds uniformly and after
          n(k) transitions

            (1-eta)^n(k) Phi_0(k) <= C0,

          while the same literal spine has

            nu(k) <= B(k)+A Phi_n(k)+C_term,

          then

            nu(k) <= B(k)+A(C0+(b+c)/eta)+C_term.

          This is the exact conditional implication to B(k)+O(1).  JRRX,
          the complete-potential row, sufficient compatible transitions and
          their one-spine literal co-instantiation all remain UNPROVED; no
          unconditional additive bound follows.

2721ROOT. Source/helper recourse now has a capacity-faithful
          occurrence-labelled strict-gammoid representation after the exact
          necessary atomization step, together with a loss-compensated
          coatom reset theorem.

          Primitive mode feasibility is not hereditary when a source is
          invalid alone but becomes valid after a helper installs its host.
          It therefore cannot be a gammoid.  Replacing modes by raw pair
          options does not repair this: the three options

            (s1,h1), (s1,h2), (s2,h2)

          violate matroid augmentation, and this is ground-size minimal.
          The valid order of quantifiers is

            assign/atomize a private bundle bank;
            jointly materialize one child;
            fully replay the child supplier graph;
            only then form the alternating network.

          Each atom must contain its source, preassigned private helper or
          capacity-safe contracted circuit, complete occurrence and
          endpoint/address/history/reset/residence/upper/compiler closure,
          all parent-matching casualties, and its actual free-head service
          portals.  Helper options belonging to different materialized
          children cannot be united as arcs of one network.

          Fix one replayed child, a parent maximum matching M of rank r, and
          M0 subset M intersect E(child) with |M0|=r-q.  In the
          vertex-split M0-alternating network, the linkable free heads are a
          restriction of a strict gammoid and, for Z among the M0-unmatched
          left heads,

            rho(Z)=rank(child[L0 union Z,R])-|M0|
                  =|Z|-max_(Q subset L0 union Z)(|Q|-|N(Q)|).

          In particular maximal simultaneous augmentation gives exactly

            delta(child)=delta(parent)+q-rho(F).

          Add one private claim start for every occurrence-labelled
          compensation or gain obligation, with its literal menu P_u of
          free-head ports.  Deficient Rado gives

            r_pkt(X)=min_(Y subset X)(|X-Y|+rho(P(Y))).

          The exact hereditary test has a sharper cut form.  For each
          finite-cut-admissible sink-avoiding base-network side W, let c(W)
          be literal outgoing capacity and

            t_X(W)=#{u in X : P_u subset W}.

          Then

            r_pkt(X)=min_W (|X|-t_X(W)+c(W)).

          Therefore

            r_pkt(X)>=eta|X|-gamma for every X subset Ubar

          is equivalent to

            c(W)>=eta*t_Ubar(W)-gamma for every W.

          Equivalently, in the full augmented claim network, including unit
          claim-start arcs, every finite-capacity separator C must obey

            |B(C)|<=Lambda*cap(C)+Gamma.

          This is the weakest checkable same-child expansion row.  A
          bounded shared helper or owner separator is a sharp obstruction:
          arbitrarily many formal menu labels behind it still have bounded
          rank.

          Core loss is neutralized by exposing it rather than bounding it
          absolutely.  Give each of the q omitted M-edges one compensation
          claim and expose g genuine gain claims.  If their common child
          gammoid misses at most C claims, then

            p>=q+g-C,
            delta(child)<=delta(parent)-g+C.

          Thus even extensive q cancels.  A per-packet damage estimate
          q<=wg+b_q is valid only when every edge of M\M0 is completely
          attributed to one packet damage set or the boundary set; an
          arbitrary smaller retained matching cannot claim this estimate.

          With complete non-supplier casualties c_ns, the fractional form
          is

            Phi' <= [1-eta*kappa+(1-eta)*a+zeta]Phi
                    +(1-eta)b_q+eta*b_g+gamma+b_ns,

          under q<=a Phi+b_q, g>=kappa Phi-b_g and
          c_ns<=zeta Phi+b_ns.  The exact augmentation-surplus condition is

            eta*kappa>(1-eta)a+zeta.

          It is an ordinary affine contraction when the displayed
          coefficient lies in [0,1); a negative coefficient instead forces
          the current nonnegative potential already to be bounded.  Every
          owner, occurrence, endpoint, address, history, reset, residence,
          upper, compiler and chronology casualty not internally closed is
          included in c_ns.

          The Pascal/coatom input now supplies one genuine all-r abstract
          rank bound.  The odd-central containment graph has proper-shore
          slack one.  After deleting a protected matching of size t, and if
          the literal rescue graph erodes every coatom neighborhood by at
          most E, every source subfamily has helper rank at least

            |X|-C_H,  C_H=E+max(t-1,0).

          The bounded literal-erosion premise remains UNPROVED.  If the
          actual occurrence-labelled supplier menus are nested on the two
          mixed-coatom rays, the entire hereditary Rado residual is exactly
          the maximum over O(mn) prefix pairs.  Existing physical provider
          nesting does not yet imply this supplier-port nesting.

          Canonical K17 is a sharp finite calibration.  The 468 structural
          sources have q=0,1,2 in counts 226,194,48.  Each source has
          3,477--3,483 row-safe helper IDs in the 3,483 exact-common helper
          pool, so a source-saturating helper-ID matching exists and survives
          deletion of any 3,009 helper IDs.  This is only a capacity Hall
          factor.  The complete 468 x 112,621 directed occurrence face is
          now exactly empty after 52,664,349 -> 94 -> 0.  Moreover the
          single-helper three-mode extension is empty after
          10,536,324 -> 70 -> 0.  Any remaining H-containing triple must
          use both helper hosts in the source option; no such bilateral
          fork/circuit module is yet known.

          Combining the rows gives, conditionally on one child and one
          compatible spine,

            Phi' <= [1-alpha(1-theta)]Phi
                    +(1-theta)(b0+C_H)+C_G+b_ns.

          Alpha=1, theta=0 and bounded constants give a one-step O(1)
          reset.  Otherwise, if regeneration holds for N transitions with
          lambda>0 and additive term D,

            Phi_N <= (1-lambda)^N Phi_0+D/lambda.

          The terminal implication to B(k)+O(1) additionally requires
          (1-lambda)^N Phi_0=O(1), uniformly bounded terminal multiplier and
          additive cost, and a valid even terminal child on the same spine.

          Still UNPROVED are literal all-k rescue expansion, an extensive
          private anchor bank, simultaneous root/common-basis materialization
          and supplier replay, the trapped-menu/prefix supplier cuts,
          complete casualty rate theta<1, atom regeneration, enough
          transitions, and one-spine/even-child co-instantiation.  Hence no
          unconditional B(k)+O(1) is claimed.

2722ROOT. Bounded rescue depth now has an exact post-atomization theorem,
          a compensation-first contraction, and a sharper K17 obstruction:
          the simple three-mode rescue chain is itself empty.

          On the canonical e878/fa491 parent, the authenticated H-source
          two-mode face is

            52,664,349 -> 94 -> 0.

          Every exact pair survivor has one partner-host-anchored source
          option and an empty partner native-P0 occurrence menu.  The
          complete six-endpoint single-helper extension is then

            10,536,324 -> 70 -> 0.

          On all 70 phasewise survivors the third mode has zero native-P0
          tuples, so no third two-phase option exists.  The lossless
          two-branch proof shows more: in any still-possible H-containing
          triple, the selected source option must use both helper hosts.
          Hence the remaining cardinality-three candidate is a bilateral
          fork/circuit module, not a linear source<-helper<-rescuer chain.
          Its exact quotient has 21 source selected-host patterns and 645
          full host-incidence matrices: 357 same-phase-bilateral and 288
          split-only.  These are template counts, not live positives.  The
          older 2,565 count belongs only to the weaker unary external-host
          consequence.  The bilateral natural-join domain is unenumerated.
          The H theorem does not cover the 47 rank-stagnant anchors.  Their
          residual pair face is now independently closed by the exact S47
          chain

            5,268,793 directed rows -> 3 -> 0,

          covering 5,267,978 unique children.  The three rows are source
          92903 with helpers 25925,25927,25929; source menus are 1/1 and
          partner menus are respectively 0/1,0/0,0/0.  Thus no authenticated
          two-mode target-20 route remains.  Pair closure does not make an
          residual no-H S47 triple bilateral.  A hypothetical support-one
          such triple with both helpers in S union Z must use one of these
          three prefixes at source key 70, and the first
          helper's phase-0 ticket must consume the third host.  Its complete
          extension replay remains open.  Phase 1 remains transported-owner
          evidence.

          The inherited Q23 shore now supplies an all-arity source cover.
          For every endpoint-disjoint canonical family X,

            gamma_Q(X)<=sum_(e in X) gamma_e.

          All 112,099 Z modes are literal Q-shore identities.  All seven N
          modes delete supplier 14851 and share that endpoint.  Therefore
          every target-20 family of any arity contains H or S.  The union of
          H-source and S-source triple joins is globally complete on this
          parent, but all viable H/S source labels must be retained until
          physical-child projection.  Helpers may lie in H,S,Z,N; notably
          S,S,N is not rejected by the shore cut, so the S-source join must
          include N-helper subfaces.  This source cover is necessary only
          and proves no occurrence packing.  The final source-label-guarded
          theorem/audit SHAs are 7556ec953b062a88810b81f26163ff8c86616019dbaa44a6ac9ce1216d1b30ca
          and 17c9cc3ca53cf8fbda08f2d0cce4faf44d57e21169c2829a8f3e1cc53836c8ec.

          The smallest saturated split-only bilateral skeleton is, up to
          relabelling and phase exchange, the opposed 3-cycle

            sigma0(i)=i+1, sigma1(i)=i-1.

          Independently, three literally aligned mixed-coatom packets around
          an active-label 3-cycle telescope to zero named lower-value current.
          Coatom-to-ticket fusion is unproved.  A synchronized
          prospective triangle atlas has L=q(q-1), where q is the common
          three-skeleton outside pool (q=r-9 in the literal central
          triangle).  A candidate uses at most R=48d+192 counted noncommon
          U1--U4 tokens.  If every counted token has total option load at
          most D and all common skeletons are private, Haxell gives a full
          independent transversal when

            q(q-1)>=(96d+384)(D-1).

          Equality is allowed.  This is conditional: the known triangle
          repeats three lower-q1 socket colours, each twice, so it is not an
          internally strict-rainbow module.  Synchronized planting, q1
          repair, global load/privacy, occurrence/common-cap tokenization,
          compiler incidence and regeneration are unproved.

          The abstract positive theorem starts only after a bounded-size
          rescue module bank has been selected and terminally closed.  Every
          module state must be replayed in one final simultaneous child;
          non-supplier prefixes are private or retained as exact boundary
          linkage gadgets; claim prefixes are private up to declared entry
          ports; every shared capacity is downstream in one unit-split
          network; and the physical service bank is equivalent in both
          directions to vertex-disjoint linkages.  Under these hypotheses,
          occurrence-labelled claims form a restriction of one strict
          gammoid.

          A one-vertex contraction of a stateful unit module is exact only
          for a rectangular ingress/egress relation.  The diagonal relation

            {(i1,o1),(i2,o2)}

          acquires false cross transitions if collapsed to one vertex;
          splitting the states without a coupling gadget duplicates the
          physical capacity.  Thus address/history-dependent gates must
          retain their exact gadget.

          An exact linear rescue cascade has additive hereditary deficits.
          If layer i has matching deficit C_i and the terminal supplier
          gammoid has deficit C_S, then every source set X has at least

            |X|-sum_i C_i-C_S

          disjoint closed chains and terminal routes.  Bounded coatom
          erosion would give C_i=E_i+max(t_i-1,0), but the literal rescue
          layers are not yet proved to have that form.  K17's bilateral
          branch requires a fork/circuit allocator rather than this cascade.

          For one fixed exposed module bank, let Q be q compensation claims,
          G be g gain claims, and

            Delta=max_W(t_(Q union G)(W)-c(W))

          over the full augmented claim network.  Then exactly

            p=q+g-Delta,
            Phi+q-p+c_ns=Phi-g+Delta+c_ns.

          Thus the weakest one-exposure target p>=q+eta*g-gamma is exactly

            Delta <= (1-eta)g+gamma.

          This already cancels arbitrary q.  The hereditary reusable form
          chooses an independent compensation anchor I with |I|>=q-beta.
          It is equivalent to the two same-child cut rows

            c(W)>=t_I(W),
            c(W)>=t_I(W)+eta*t_G(W)-gamma

          for every finite-cut-admissible W.  Matroid basis extension gives

            p>=q-beta+eta*g-gamma.

          If I is instead a basis of Q, put beta_Q=q-r(Q) and
          h_I=r(I union G)-r(I).  Then the loss normalization is exact:

            p-q=h_I-beta_Q=g-Delta.

          Therefore, if

            g>=alpha*Phi-b0-C_H,
            c_ns<=chi*g+b_ns,
            eta>chi,

          and the complete potential row holds, then

            Phi' <= [1-alpha(eta-chi)]Phi
                    +(eta-chi)(b0+C_H)+beta+gamma+b_ns.

          Rescue depth and extensive matching loss q disappear from the
          coefficient.  The condition eta>chi is only the asymptotic sign
          row.  On one finite child the factorized bound decreases its RHS
          only when

            (eta-chi)g>beta+gamma+b_ns.

          Ordinary regenerated contraction needs
          0<lambda=alpha(eta-chi)<=1 bounded away from zero and fixed point
          K/lambda=O(1), where

            K=(eta-chi)(b0+C_H)+beta+gamma+b_ns.

          For an a priori unbounded parent, lambda=1 exactly cancels the
          one-step parent coefficient; lambda>1 instead forces the parent
          potential already bounded.  Under regenerated varying
          steps, the exact iterated bound is

            Phi_N <= Phi_0 product_i(1-lambda_i)
                     +sum_j K_j product_(i>j)(1-lambda_i).

          Pointwise eta_i>chi_i does not make the product die or the additive
          convolution bounded.  Without the compensation anchor,
          q<=omega*g+b_q
          gives instead surplus

            s_D=eta-(1-eta)omega-chi,

          so contraction needs eta>(omega+chi)/(1+omega); bounded depth alone
          can force near-perfect expansion.

          Two sharp obstructions remain.  Module footprints
          {x},{x,y},{y} violate matroid augmentation, so compatible-module
          selection is a hypergraph-packing gate.  Even perfectly private
          depth-three modules can all cross one split unit supplier vertex
          and have total rank one.  A third mode, menu abundance, or bounded
          depth is therefore insufficient without the full cut expansion.
          Likewise a mandatory same-phase occurrence row in every candidate
          collapses compatible bank size to one.  The 21/645 templates do
          not see either bottleneck.

          Mutually vertex-disjoint full compensation/gain corridors would
          give beta=gamma=0, eta=1 and Delta=0.  They do not imply chi=0:
          complete non-supplier casualty accounting is separate.  With that
          extra O(1) row one gets Phi'<=Phi-g+O(1).

          Still UNPROVED are a live bilateral K17 module, the complete S47
          three-mode lane (including N-helper subfaces and the three anchored
          S-union-Z support-one extension branches), q1 repair and
          coatom-to-bilateral-ticket fusion, a
          uniform bounded-size module allocator, synchronized/global-load
          triangle planting, one common child with an extensive private bank,
          full compensation/gain corridors, a bounded-defect compensation
          anchor, anchored full-network expansion, complete casualty surplus,
          compiler-incidence transport, regeneration, sufficient same-spine
          transitions and the even terminal transfer.  No unconditional
          B(k)+O(1) follows.

2723ROOT. The canonical no-H S47 target-capable support-one triple face is
          now exactly closed, superseding the open-S47 clause in 2722ROOT.

2724ROOT. Pure-theorem rebase: finite K17 execution is stopped.  The
          shortest honest implication to the additive conjecture has been
          isolated at the exact quantifier level.

          Within the regenerative/common-host architecture, the one missing
          theorem is the existence of one uniform co-instantiated
          bounded-charge reset spine:

            exists m0,C
            exists (g_m,a_m,C_m^odd,C_m^ev)_(m>=m0)
            forall m>=m0,

          where C_m^odd is one literal certificate for the compatible odd
          transition g_m -> g_(m+1) and the odd terminal at 2m+1,
          C_m^ev is one literal certificate for the even terminal at 2m+2,
          and both terminal charges are at most the same absolute C.

          Each certificate fixes one materialized child and one structural
          host before choosing the phase-local occurrence banks.  Those
          banks may use different physical tuples and are joined only on
          declared common flags/equalities.  The root/common-basis/cap state
          and child-local matching then belong to that same child; only after
          the word is fixed may target-specific interval witnesses be chosen.
          The odd certificate exports a genuinely regenerated child-local
          auxiliary state, not merely the same defect count.

          Existing exact lemmas give the entire implication:

            complete bounded terminal eviction and repair
              + terminal/auxiliary phase decoupling
              + the bounded-cost odd-spine theorem
              => nu(k) <= B(k)+C

          for all sufficiently large k, with finitely many initial k
          absorbed once.  Strict contraction and left-totality on every
          parent are stronger proof devices, not logically necessary.

          After one coherent child bank is fixed, the exact analytic route
          is p=q+g-Delta and

            Phi' <= Phi-g+Delta+c_ns.

          Thus the normalized same-child surplus

            g-Delta-c_ns >= rho Phi-C0

          is a sufficient contraction certificate.  The trapped-menu and
          compensation-anchor theorems factor this row, but do not select or
          materialize the bank.

          The four coordinated construction obligations are now:

          1. integral one-copy host and chronology from the proved
             fractional pull-clock/rotor law;
          2. one-child terminally closed source/helper or replacement bank;
          3. complete occurrence-labelled service and all-resource casualty
             surplus in that child; and
          4. literal regeneration with both odd and even terminal taps.

          Marginal Hall, separate phase matchings, birail value telescoping,
          bounded new debt per step, and unrelated good states in every
          dimension do not satisfy these quantifiers.  Outside the
          regenerative architecture, direct per-dimension serial terminal
          reachability with uniformly bounded charge would be shorter still.
          No unconditional new bound is claimed.

2725ROOT. The Regenerating Bilateral Bank lane now has a proof-safe pure
          fixed-child integral rotor theorem and an exact all-dimensional
          missing interface.  No finite K17 computation is used.

          Work with atomic occurrence-labelled macro records whose literal
          interiors are private and whose complete state boundary and
          localized signed resource signature are endpoint coboundaries.
          For the two helper permutations, permutation cancellation gives

            partial F = 0,   lambda(F)=0.

          If the positive-degree macro support, including every labelled
          connector/reset record, is weakly connected, it has one rooted
          packet-contiguous Euler circuit.  The helper orbit may be
          arbitrarily large; bounded orbit size is not needed when rank,
          casualty and live physical charge are bounded directly.  Twisted
          lower profiles obey the exact identity

            sum_i Delta_i = (H_O-I)U_0.

          Zero named current is not regeneration.  The exact criterion is
          one joint witness consisting of:

            one capacity-faithful physical assignment Pi,
            one rooted block-Euler word W,
            one complete continuation-state chain omega_0,...,omega_m,
            and (omega_0,omega_m) in the authenticated conjugacy K.

          The same Pi must witness every packet relation.  Separate packing
          and projected-holonomy existentials are equivalent only under a
          rectangular/fibre-product lifting property.  Every physical reset
          adapter is already in the connector bank and Pi; K itself is a
          cost-free, sort-preserving, actual-address-injective,
          exterior-fixed authentication relation.  The exported exceptional
          carrier and all live connector/reset charge are uniformly bounded
          and replaced, not accumulated.

          The quantitative contraction theorem is now:

            g >= alpha Phi-B0,
            p >= q-beta+eta g-gamma,
            c_phys <= chi g+CP,
            0 <= chi < eta <= 1

          imply, with

            s=eta-chi,
            lambda=alpha s,
            kappa=s B0+beta+gamma+CP,

            Phi' <= (1-lambda)Phi+kappa.

          The exact geometric iteration and terminal bound are frozen in
          equations (5.9)--(5.11).  To conclude B(k)+O(1), one additionally
          needs a dimension-covering compatible odd spine, an adjacent-even
          terminal map satisfying the complete physicalization inequality
          at every level, a horizon killing the initial term, bounded
          terminal Hall/compiler defect, and nonaccumulating carrier/reset
          charge.  Private full compensation/gain corridors give
          eta=1,beta=gamma=0 but do not imply chi=0.

          A new supplier-linkage theorem closes one algebraic row.  Let
          B=(G,P;E) be left h-regular with deg_B(p)<=h.  If every gp has a
          literal state-expanded claim-to-port prefix, and ports have
          suffixes to distinct unused sinks such that the complete
          concatenated path family has fractional vertex congestion at most
          one, uniform 1/h flow and max-flow integrality link every gain.
          Under strong prefix/suffix privacy this is also the direct Hall
          inequality

            h|X| <= h|N_B(X)|.

          With degree-weighted suffix congestion rho, the certified gain
          fraction is eta_rt=h/max(h,rho), uniformly usable only when
          eta_rt>chi.  After fixing the same child and all q compensation
          paths, the exact weaker supplier-router condition is the Rado cut

            r_Gamma(N_B(X)) >= |X|   for every X subseteq G,

          with uniform occurrence-prefix transparency.  Here Gamma is the
          residual port strict gammoid to the actual unused sink bank.

          At h=2, the proved ML_m small protected-factor theorem supplies

          protected bank of at most m-2 edges.  It does not supply literal
          claim prefixes or the port router.  A parent/reference factor

          A six-cycle whose suffixes all cross one unit vertex has ordinary
          factor Hall but port-gammoid rank one.  Thus the parent/reference

          The first single construction gap is the Atomic Full-State

2726ROOT. Endpoint chainization has a new unconditional pure-mathematics
          theorem, but the chronology gate remains open.  No finite K17
          search, remote run, or computer-assisted existence claim enters
          this item.

          Write

            rho=Lambda/W, a=floor(rho), b=Lambda-aW,
            D=ceil(rho), B=W+d, and D<=d+1.

          The ideal lower-owner SDR can be chosen simultaneously equitable
          and rank-simple: exactly b rank-r owners receive a+1 lower
          targets, all others receive a, and no owner receives two targets
          of one rank.  The proof is an integral rank-port flow.  A rank-s
          port has uniform fractional load

            C(r,s)/C(k-s,r-s)=C(k,s)/C(k,r)<=1,

          while every owner has total load rho.  Thus scalar imbalance and
          repeated-rank collisions are not the chainization obstruction.

          For odd k=2r-1, the same flow roots the bundles at all rank-(r-1)
          coatoms, with sizes a or a+1, and the regular middle-rank
          incidence graph attaches them to distinct containing owners.
          This still does not imply nestedness.  At k=5 an explicit exact
          2/1-equitable, rank-simple SDR has all five heavy fibres
          incomparable; with owners frozen its maximum nested retention is
          only 10/15.

          Within the odd coatom-rooted perfectly equitable route,
          chainization is exactly an adjacent-slice Hall ladder.  If A_1 is
          the coatom shore and A_2,...,A_q are the successive slices, then
          nested chains exist iff every A_(j+1) injects by strict
          containment into A_j.  The exact histogram is

            #{C: |C|>=j}=|A_j|,
            #{C: |C|=j}=|A_j|-|A_(j+1)|,

          so equity is exactly |A_1|=...=|A_a|=W and
          |A_(a+1)|=b.  Appending middle owners gives an equitable
          lower-half chain decomposition.  Any maximum-D anchored factor
          would complement-pair to a full-lattice W-chain partition of
          maximum at most 2D+1, strictly below the average plus three.  This
          is a strong one-sided additive frontier, not the full Furedi
          floor/ceiling conjecture.  The Hall ladder is exact only for this
          special equitable route; general B+O(1) geometry still allows the
          triangular endpoint-capacity profile.

          Nestedness is not chronology.  On a fixed odd rainbow
          middle-levels cycle, weak age flags lift to one MTF chronology iff

            alpha_i in D^i_(q-1),
            D^(i+1)_(t+1) subseteq D^i_t.

          This gives a conditional lower-central word of length W+q, hence
          at most B+1 when q=D, but supplies no upper targets.

          A new three-minimum aperture lemma isolates why pairwise quotient
          arcs do not compose.  For two consecutive updates exposing
          nontrivial chains with equal distinct first two minima,

            B_1 \ (B_0 union B_2) subseteq
            G_2=C_(2,1) \ B_2.

          An explicit three-chain example has both consecutive quotient
          arcs but violates this inclusion.  A separate abstract family has
          a complete slot graph and a perfectly equitable nested D-factor,
          yet no transition between distinct chains; for fixed D its N
          productive endpoints span at least 2N-1.  These are chronology
          obstructions, not Boolean-lattice no-gos.

          The exact sufficient joint object is now explicit.  If one
          partial last-occurrence state path visits all W owners, exposes
          each selected depth-D owner-chain, and exposes every upper target
          on the same path, then reverse-initializing only the first q+1
          visible flag blocks and appending W-1 update masks gives

            nu(k)<=W+D<=B(k)+1.

          Unseen coordinates cost no initialization letter.  The separate
          fixed-window trace-Euler formulation gives B+C+1 only when its
          total bridge cost C is O(1); it is stronger than, and not
          equivalent to, the partial-state theorem.

          Therefore the exact honest frontier is correlated adjacent Hall
          plus a common state lift plus upper completion on that same word.
          None has been constructed in all dimensions, and no unconditional
          B(k)+O(1) bound is claimed.
