2727ROOT. The pure-mathematics synthesis now closes the fixed-assignment
          lower factor, composite-orbit arithmetic, one-arrow common
          stabilizer, change-of-group gauge, and abstract topology parity.
          It still does not construct the all-dimensional word.

          First, simultaneous q-cell pinning has an exact interval theorem.
          For a complete cyclic Johnson carrier, fix distinct assigned cells
          and targets satisfying the individual collar/aperture rows.  For
          each coordinate x, delete from its erosion support every interval
          of an assigned cell whose target omits x.  One depth-d factor
          realizes every owner and assigned cell iff every positive aperture
          and every owner supplier interval retains one allowed occurrence.
          The coordinatewise greatest factor is explicit.  Owner failure is
          exactly d+1 consecutive forbidden erosion positions.  There is no
          residual cross-coordinate Hall condition after the assignment is
          fixed.

          The target-to-cell assignment is nevertheless genuinely integral.
          Its bare LP has a determinant-two local triangle.  Eliminating
          occurrence variables for binary assignments gives exact
          owner-cover and conditional positive-aperture cuts, but all those
          cuts can still have a literal C3 half-integral gap.  The proof-safe
          positive faces are a fixed protected occurrence signature
          (ordinary bipartite matching), nested private shells (grid flow),
          and rank-two perfect conflict graphs (clique-described stable-set
          polytopes).

          Second, an abstract regular Middle-Levels factor is now separated
          exactly from the literal supplier router.  In one fixed addressed
          post-compensation child, service is the max flow in the complete
          claim--prefix--suffix network.  On the private-prefix face it is

            r_Gamma(N_B(X)) >= |X|  for every gain set X.

          Connectivity and free symmetry do not imply this row: a symbolic
          free-equivariant ML router with one orbit of unit bottlenecks has
          exact deficiency one full orbit.  Symmetry quantizes defect; it
          does not create capacity expansion.

          Third, exact-period stratification removes the composite-k
          divisibility concern.  On the orbit-order-q stratum, C_q acts
          freely, so every addressed matching deficiency and every q-pure
          suffix corank is a multiple of q.  A uniform per-stratum bound C
          kills every q>C defect; all remaining strata contribute at most
          O(C^2).  Alternatively, all Boolean masks of orbit order at most C
          form a literal quarantine of size at most 2^(C+1)-2.  This sharper
          terminal statement requires an equivariant whole-fibre
          task-to-target bypass, q-pure capacity separation, regular private
          routers for suffix gates, and certified repair of all non-target
          exceptions.

          The same-parity arrow has a natural common growing modulus.  Put
          k=2m-1, rotate the old k coordinates, and fix the fresh pair.  An
          old subset of rank m+a has orbit order at least

            k/|2a+1|.

          Hence every O(sqrt(k)) central-band addressed object which retains
          that old label has orbit order Omega(sqrt(k)); parent middle shores
          are free and child central sectors have order at least k/3.
          Uniform bounded quotient defects therefore become exact
          eventually.  This is only a one-arrow action.  The next arrow uses
          the child's full rotation.

          A Coxeter-flat complete packing bundle is an exact sufficient
          change-of-group interface.  If adjacent coordinate-swap transports
          on complete physical fibres satisfy every translated involution,
          commutation and braid relation, they extend to one S_n action
          groupoid.  Old-coordinate and full cyclic symmetries are compatible
          subgroup restrictions.  Schreier pure gauge additionally needs
          trivial stabilizer action.  Forgetting the old fresh-pair mark is
          free only through a certified equivariant forgetful map on complete
          packed states; group theory alone does not delete future guards.

          Finally, abstract odd topology availability is solved.  Four
          private incidence C6 components support a common-exterior C8
          toggle which joins all four into one component, fixes the
          predecessor matching, rematches the successor by a 4-cycle, and
          preserves the full immediate-upper multiplicity vector.  Its local
          upper-nullity charge is exactly eight and it plants beside any
          fixed deadline-scale pivot bank for sufficiently large m.  The
          complete unrooted colour--tail--head selector has an exact
          fractional perfect matching after C dummy colours are added.
          Integrality and subtours remain.  Once a forward order is fixed,
          endpoint injectivity forces the unique consecutive path; the
          residual owner/q1 theorem is exactly an upper-surjective rooted
          Hamilton ordering, or an occurrence-labelled 3-partite perfect
          matching plus subtour cuts.

          The shortest honest remaining construction is therefore one
          compatible infinite family of one-copy upper-complete physical
          lifts carrying in the same materialized state:

            one protected actual-cell signature,
            q-pure private literal routers with uniformly bounded defect,
            one flat complete packing gauge and mark-release interface,
            the protected C8/opening sidecar,
            and literal regenerative output with both parity taps.

          The new theorems turn that one construction into
          nu(k)<=B(k)+O(1); they do not prove that construction exists.

2728ROOT. The pure-mathematics push produced two new global obstructions and
          an exact owner-layer completion interface. They do not prove the
          additive conjecture, but they materially change the construction
          target.

          First, occurrence overlap in a resident cyclic erosion factor has
          an exact energy. If P is the total coordinate-marker count, its
          P-W internal gaps have total W(r-d-1), and

            H_Z = W d (r-(d+1)/2) - sum_g binom(g,2).

          Convexity therefore gives a fractional lower-target separator.
          A union of h fixed exact or canonical sparse rails misses

            (1/(2h)-O_h(k^(-1/2))) Lambda

          lower targets. In particular, two rails miss 1/4-o(1), even
          fractionally. Bounded defect on this resident erosion-factor face
          requires

            P/(rW) >= 4/(8-pi+8 epsilon_k)-o(1),
            epsilon_k=(dW-Lambda)/W,

          and uniformly P/(rW)>=4/(16-pi)-o(1)=0.311... . Thus a bounded
          number of sparse residue rails is not merely difficult; it is the
          wrong density scale. Any proof through this face needs Omega(d)
          rails or an equivalent genuinely dense erosion schedule. This is
          scoped to coordinate-counted resident erosion capacity plus the
          standard boundary cells; it does not rule out external occurrence
          carriers.

          Second, the strongest local colour-fibre simplification is
          arithmetically impossible in most dimensions. Fix a predecessor
          matching M0 and ask every complete upper-colour occurrence fibre
          to have distinct tails and distinct heads. Around every coordinate
          this forces a punctured Steiner system

            S(m-2,m-1,2m-2).

          Its exact divisibility rows are

            A_l=(1/(l+1)) binom(m+l,l) in Z, 0<=l<=m-2,

          and all rows hold iff m is prime. Hence this ansatz is impossible
          whenever m=(k+1)/2 is composite. At k=17, m=9 and A_2=55/3; every
          M0 has aggregate local head-image deficiency at least 17, spread
          over at least three upper colours. Prime m is only divisibility
          admissibility: exact local simplicity additionally needs compatible
          punctured designs whose labelled incidences form one global perfect
          matching. On the positive side, every M0 has the canonical
          1/(m+1) fractional colour--tail--head selector, with Cat_m unused
          endpoint capacity. The obstruction is integral correlation, not
          fractional load.

          The honest owner/q1 selector is now exact. After fixing protected
          arcs and omitted tail/head copies, choose a colour-to-head injection
          eta. Dummy completion exists iff every source set X satisfies

            b_eta(X) <= |N(X)|-|X|.

          Zero-slack cuts are precisely the alternating-SCC allowed-edge
          rows; positive-slack cuts remain the irreducible joint Benders
          correlation. Any integral solution is one path plus cycles. A
          support-disjoint interlaced-C8 tree is an exact subtour absorber:
          it merges every completed component while preserving endpoints,
          protected arcs, and all actual/dummy colour tokens.

          Colour and topology have separate smallest local controls. A
          zero-nullity private C8 socket changes component parity and merely
          permutes its immediate-upper colours. A simple upper-valid C6 has
          colour overlap 0,1,or3, so its smallest nonneutral action is an

          This is not an even construction theorem.  The opened
          single-role and typed-shore cuts assume the stated diagonal or
          graded bands and pairwise-distinct no-alias banks.  Compatible
          unused post-compensation sockets remain open, and reserved native
          owners have suffix rank zero.

            MATH_THEOREM_EVEN_DIAGONAL_BILAYER_LITERAL_ROUTER_AND_BOUNDARY_LEDGER_20260803.md
              SHA 072daa9a76e4d2fccb9fa39f5bb59f3c90e0012147ea871d14ebde18d45cc9e6.
            MATH_AUDIT_EVEN_DIAGONAL_BILAYER_LITERAL_ROUTER_AND_BOUNDARY_LEDGER_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 9735564ee5cba5cff04dfebf5acb0866f1bf10a95ee3df076712883f13c59a98.

2743ROOT. The favorable macroscopic-collar codegrees do not yet trigger a
          published black-box matching theorem at the required precision.
          After rational blow-up their full normalized profile satisfies

            Delta_j/D <= (C_0/r^2)^(j-1),
            Delta_2/D = Theta(r^-2),

          while K=Theta(sqrt(r)) and the target population is
          N=Theta(W sqrt(r)).  Therefore the needed relative leave is
          o(1/K), not merely o(1).

          ABKV fails exponentially.  Pair-codegree Vu and KKMO bounds are
          formally vacuous.  Higher-codegree Vu and Gould--Kelly have
          formally strong enough main powers (respectively W r^-1/6 and
          W r^-1/2+o(1) base scales), but their logarithmic exponents and
          degree thresholds are fixed only after K is fixed.  No valid
          K=Theta(sqrt(r)) diagonal follows; Delcourt--Postle has the same
          fixed-rank problem and an additional multiplicity condition.

          The missing black box is therefore a genuinely growing-rank
          laminar-flag matching theorem with uniform error below
          r^-1/2.  Until that theorem or an object-specific absorber is
          proved, the subcritical pair scale is a structural advance rather
          than an integral o(W) rounding.

            MATH_AUDIT_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_GROWING_UNIFORMITY_MATCHING_THEOREMS_20260803.md
              SHA 2efff5ead52a036661ba66a42a95be95c7b6ed26902ca60c5f30791628b350c6.

2744ROOT. The odd occurrence-selector gate now has one exact scalar energy.
          Properly m-edge-colour the rank-(m-1)/rank-m containment graph.
          Every upper interval R induces a loopless (m+1)-regular
          multigraph H_R on the m factor colours.  For factor pair i,j,
          its compressed upper multiplicity is the pair multiplicity
          a^R_ij, and

            Delta_ij=sum_R ((mu_ij(R)-1)(mu_ij(R)-2)/2)

          is a nonnegative integer.  It vanishes exactly when the literal
          selector is upper-surjective and cap two.  Then its duplicate
          colours automatically form the simple regular Catalan design with
          coordinate degree 2Cat_(m-1).

          The total colour energy is

            sum_R (sum_(i<j) binom(a^R_ij,2)-m).

          Local zero is exactly H_R=K_m+Z_R, where Z_R is a simple spanning
          two-factor.  Conversely every desired selector pair extends to a
          full one-factorization, so the all-m selector problem is exactly
          min_F min_(i<j) Delta_ij=0.  A same-pair Kempe switch is inert;
          repair must involve a third factor colour/C6.  Zero-energy
          existence, named protected occurrences, and one-cycle topology
          are still open.

            MATH_THEOREM_ODD_SELECTOR_FACTOR_COLOR_ENERGY_AND_THREE_COLOR_GATE_20260803.md
              SHA 9a56e03152d0c5bdc69165ea651ccf257138a62d0cd25bacc0e72af946d09c1d.
            MATH_AUDIT_ODD_SELECTOR_FACTOR_COLOR_ENERGY_AND_THREE_COLOR_GATE_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 66943cf3630f81e1d2e1f3d7df6006dffa982cebcab0d743f3ac046975a14e2.

2745ROOT. The upper-turn dual-role escape now has an exact capacity
          dichotomy.  On a q1-exact diagonal the occurrence-only chains
          port--owner--upper-turn form a perfect linkage.  But in the
          literal two-boundary model every such chain traverses two distinct
          source occurrences.  W unit source capacities can therefore
          support at most floor(W/2) disjoint dual-role routes.

          This factor two is sharp: the canonical W paths load each source
          exactly twice, so source capacity two gives a full linkage.  At
          unit capacity, a private source-free owner-to-upper attachment is
          sufficient instead.  The owner itself must remain a legal
          dual-service transit vertex; if central reservation deletes it, a
          private bypass is additionally necessary.  Thus calling a
          load-bearing upper witness a socket does not itself close the
          terminal router.

            MATH_THEOREM_DIAGONAL_DUAL_ROLE_TWO_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_DICHOTOMY_20260803.md
              SHA 7a913cb0aee28ff716e16747eb08643eb90c57b340bfedc6c1339875cfdd2049.
            MATH_AUDIT_DIAGONAL_DUAL_ROLE_TWO_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_DICHOTOMY_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA b338c88d0c401165e90763f923f6c9b8863310251d6629ed45d43511f08fbffe.

2746ROOT. The proposed contiguous-collar plus parity-separated residual
          composition is now refuted by an exact Hall row.  Any exact
          adjacent-rank collar ending at middle owners has the forced
          empirical length law

            Pr(L>=j)=binom(2r,r-j)/W.

          If a residual atom contains no adjacent ranks and obeys the
          pointwise capacity |R|<=d+C-L for fixed C, take a block of 2t
          consecutive residual distances with t=floor((d+C)/2).  Stability
          and capacity give a deficit whose normalized limit is

            eta(c)=int_(delta/2)^(c+delta) exp(-x^2) dx-delta/2 > 0,
            delta=sqrt(pi)/2,

          for every c>=sqrt(log 2).  The resulting leave is
          Omega(sqrt(r) W), not o(W).  The same note gives the exact
          support-function/Strassen criterion for every alternative
          collar-conditioned stable law.

          The no-go is deliberately narrow.  It leaves two credible
          escapes: allow adjacent residual ranks but suppress collisions by
          label-sensitive Boolean structure, or abandon the contiguous
          collar.  Fixed additive slack does not rescue the refuted face.

            MATH_THEOREM_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_20260803.md
              SHA be18baddafdc79d2aeec4b17b7001d44ac6d6834f6a3c3cc80e29a60161022bb.
            MATH_AUDIT_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA c237dbc47febc0d98db8d9fc9cf16fb63f7847bf2e75057d10c78a5859ced1ce.

2747ROOT. The contiguous-collar no-go persists after stability is removed.
          For a block A_t of 2t residual ranks, every selected set obeys

            |R cap A_t| <= min(t,d+C-L)+(E_t+1)/2,

          where E_t counts selected adjacent rank pairs.  The previous Hall
          surplus therefore forces E E_t=Omega(sqrt(r)) in every
          near-complete residual law.  Averaging gives one adjacent rank
          pair with constant joint probability.

          In the uniform-order flag law this yields rho_2=Omega(1/r), and
          the forced positive mass of length-a collars gives

            K=Theta(sqrt(r)),
            K^2 rho_2=Omega(1).

          More strongly, the same codegree lower bound follows for any
          label-sensitive weighted packing by nested-chain atoms with named
          target degrees at most one.  Labels can move which cover flag
          carries the collision, but cannot erase its mass.  Therefore the
          viable lower construction must abandon the contiguous collar or
          split adjacent-rank obligations across genuinely different roles.

            MATH_THEOREM_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_ADJACENT_ENERGY_AND_CRITICAL_FLAG_SURFACE_20260803.md
              SHA 8207733725da8c20266e3bcfb6df93777b529f64eb702ac5434d5a1b7701d8f7.
            MATH_AUDIT_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_ADJACENT_ENERGY_AND_CRITICAL_FLAG_SURFACE_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 6688610b019acce77865463509a4df7665bb3ca0918d97609c763cdbe36ec706.

2748ROOT. The noncontiguous-collar escape now has an exact fractional
          realization.  Put the residual ranks on the consecutive edges of
          a path, the collar ranks on isolated edges, and cap total matching
          size by d.  The resulting cardinality-capped bipartite matching
          polytope is integral.  Thus every q<=p of total mass at most d,
          with q_s+q_(s+1)<=1 on the residual path, decomposes into rank
          sets of size at most d with no adjacent residual ranks.  A single
          common random owner ordering then realizes the collar and
          residual marks as one literal inclusion flag, with exact named
          degree q_s/p_s.

          For a=(c+o(1))sqrt(r), c>sqrt(log 2), the optimal triangular
          residual vector satisfies the path rows.  On a retained central
          residual band I={r-b,...,r-a-1}, a+1<=b=o(r), the supported
          owner/target law has rho_2=O(r^-2), so at optimal
          d=O(sqrt(r)), K^2 rho_2=O(r^-1).  This proves a subcritical
          fractional residual law but not integral named-target rounding;
          collar incidences, upper coverage, topology, common-cap routing,
          and regeneration remain outside its scope.

            MATH_THEOREM_NONCONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_RESIDUAL_RANK_MATCHING_POLYTOPE_20260803.md
              SHA b05fcb088b9513b06e499e411dad7a32a7f58d1c58e692d24d7307c32d39599b.
            MATH_AUDIT_NONCONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_RESIDUAL_RANK_MATCHING_POLYTOPE_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 49ea7bed7b7ab84f214791ea505e3a43795b28af79e46824c0f9696ed59a88e2.

2749ROOT. Fixing the first middle-levels factor now gives an exact coloured
          matching reduction.  If H=G-F_0, then H is (m-1)-regular, every
          upper colour class has exactly m+1 edges, and x_e=1/(m-1) is a
          fractional perfect matching with colour load (m+1)/(m-1).

          An integral cap-two second factor necessarily has upper load
          1+1_D, where D is a simple Cat_m-family with coordinate degree
          2Cat_(m-1).  For fixed D, existence is exactly a common base of
          three rank-W partition matroids.  Thus the selector has no
          fractional degree or colour-moment obstruction, but it is a true
          three-resource rounding problem.  At m=4 an explicit cyclic
          first factor contains a 5-by-5 odd-cycle constraint minor of
          determinant 2, ruling out the naive total-unimodularity/ordinary
          flow proof while making no claim that the Boolean RHS polytope is
          nonintegral.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FIRST_FACTOR_COLORED_MATCHING_REDUCTION_20260803.md
              SHA c70ac0f0c033675971b50aef3b07c0f91c83a0e35c732a45efc880e9afe413d8.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIXED_FIRST_FACTOR_COLORED_MATCHING_REDUCTION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA a06fc3a5f681f8afe470c7a96b45556a5a21a4302399e9a48fd728988ab6cfc7.

2750ROOT. The native q1 interval diamond supplies the previously missing
          source-free terminal attachment.  At seam i the four literal
          interval addresses and values satisfy

            p_i subset o_i,o_(i+1) subset q_i,

          and each of the two orientations p_i-o_i-q_i and
          p_i-o_(i+1)-q_i is a pairwise-disjoint full linkage over all i.
          Boundary source letters label the Hasse incidences; ordinary OR
          interval witnesses may overlap source positions, so those labels
          are not native unit-capacity transit vertices.

          Hence the existing q1 upper-turn bank gives full one-coordinate
          suffix rank with no additional W-cell socket bank whenever upper
          service and terminal service accept the same q_i occurrence and
          envelope.  The earlier floor(W/2) source cut remains sharp for
          the stronger boundary-node refinement.  The surviving common-cap
          issue is precisely two-coordinate bank separation or legal
          diagonal coalescence, together with product closure/background
          transport and regeneration.

            MATH_THEOREM_DIAGONAL_INTERVAL_DIAMOND_SOURCE_FREE_DUAL_ROLE_ROUTER_20260803.md
              SHA 2e71b1f3a7c26c23accf9e3cee9a23ba01ef17658f959b73ac69c622ce2a2802.
            MATH_AUDIT_DIAGONAL_INTERVAL_DIAMOND_SOURCE_FREE_DUAL_ROLE_ROUTER_20260803.md
              SHA 7dc53430a6c072cc45ea7f81c7cf3e080c120f1b7cdfff27d120b3ac16529aeb.

2751ROOT. The optimal noncontiguous rank inventory now rounds exactly, not
          just fractionally.  Replace every residual/collar rank edge by
          its prescribed integer multiplicity and properly edge-colour the
          resulting bipartite multigraph with W colours.  Alternating
          two-colour paths balance the colour classes, producing W rank
          patterns whose sizes differ by at most one, with exact rank
          multiplicities and no adjacent residual ranks.

          This consumes all ordinary rank-polytope integrality.  A
          coordinate-halfspace construction shows that an arbitrary
          pattern-to-owner bijection can still isolate Theta(W) named
          targets.  Thus owner labels must be chosen jointly with the
          flags.

            MATH_THEOREM_NONCONTIGUOUS_RANK_LAW_EQUITABLE_INTEGER_DECOMPOSITION_20260803.md
              SHA 72d7cdb6a6ff36ca98f254b57b135a75e1d9d48bef22790d2e7409ee7198f733.
            MATH_AUDIT_NONCONTIGUOUS_RANK_LAW_EQUITABLE_INTEGER_DECOMPOSITION_20260803.md
              SHA 9021d1fc697e710e7f29401a3cc58da8511cf6397ca88805cddf3a0a96b3c544.

2752ROOT. After rank rounding, the owner/order configuration hypergraph has
          a canonical exact fractional matching: every pattern and owner
          has degree one, while each named rank-s target has degree
          N_s/binom(2r,s).  On the retained nonadjacent band its normalized
          pair scale is O(r^-2), so K^2 rho_2=O(r^-1).

          A fixed saturated prechainization cannot round this point.  Its
          exact deficiency is max_t(A(t)-binom(2r,t))_+, and any split of
          two consecutive optimal residual ranks forces Omega(W) missing
          targets.  Cross-chain splicing is therefore necessary.

            MATH_THEOREM_EQUITABLE_PATTERN_CONFIGURATION_FRACTIONAL_MATCHING_20260803.md
              SHA 3a0e5d5c2ea85605d9898b8499e203342edd3956192073b4698a66e954346a28.
            MATH_AUDIT_EQUITABLE_PATTERN_CONFIGURATION_FRACTIONAL_MATCHING_AND_SCD_OBSTRUCTION_20260803.md
              SHA 2a7571eb5d552db68b1f248532177b82654863fcac596ee607ea237976db2ed5.

2753ROOT. Rank-separated named-target containment and equitable owner load
          are also exactly integral.  For each rank s, owners matchable to
          distinct contained s-targets form a transversal matroid.  The
          uniform vector lies in every truncated containment matroid by
          normalized Boolean shadow expansion.  Intersect their direct sum
          with the owner-capacity partition matroid and add one uniform
          dummy layer; Edmonds integrality gives every rank demand exactly
          and owner loads floor(N/W) or ceil(N/W).

          This does not nest the targets assigned at different ranks of one
          owner and does not impose the nonadjacent rank pattern.  The
          remaining lower object is precisely the correlated intersection
          of these two already-integral projections.

            MATH_THEOREM_RANK_SEPARATED_NAMED_TARGET_EQUITABLE_MATROID_INTERSECTION_20260803.md
              SHA 38b1d60b7fddd3f777dc1c7b755c39feb1c6900ba5064dade27a5f268c0cccfe.
            MATH_AUDIT_RANK_SEPARATED_NAMED_TARGET_EQUITABLE_MATROID_INTERSECTION_20260803.md
              SHA 34fd05e658fe6d9f586314fd48ec7be2b642095aa30de47ed0b5bcc8aea1c53d.

2754ROOT. Fixing the first odd middle-level factor gives an exact functional
          upper-colour model.  After contraction, the residual digraph is
          (m-1)-in/out regular, and each upper class R is the loopless
          functional map p_R on its m+1 facets.  Tail and head colour SDRs
          each exist by Hall, but may select different occurrences.

          The shortcut demanding every p_R be a permutation forces, for
          each coordinate, a Steiner S(m-2,m-1,2m-2) system and is
          impossible for even m.  At the same time every rank-(m-2) core
          has Omega(m^3) prospective full Boolean C6 supports.  This is
          local algebraic supply, not a cap-two selector.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FACTOR_FUNCTIONAL_DIGRAPH_STEINER_PARITY_AND_C6_20260803.md
              SHA 66d14b117304187df2cb1f16072a6e8cf7525f55d93a157be091e53436d379ce.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIXED_FACTOR_FUNCTIONAL_DIGRAPH_STEINER_PARITY_AND_C6_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 65870a3e552b2dea3b225a97f193b45926701a7dc5e6b23202cf21337e2c3379.

2755ROOT. The fixed-factor cap-two selector has no fractional separator:
          x_e=1/(m-1) is a fractional perfect matching and gives every
          upper colour load (m+1)/(m-1) in [1,2].  Integrally, a solution
          is exactly a rainbow one-per-colour matching plus a vertex-
          disjoint rainbow residual completion.

          For any alternating switch with signed colour change delta,

            Delta(F')-Delta(F)=<mu,delta>+||delta||^2/2.

          At one Boolean core, an incumbent occupies a prospective C6
          exactly when its local pointer has the corresponding directed
          3-cycle.  There are at most floor((m+1)/3) such occupied supports.
          The local pointer axioms permit zero, although global Boolean
          realizability of that local state is not proved.  Therefore raw
          prospective C6 supply alone cannot establish local descent.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FACTOR_CAPTWO_LP_ENERGY_AND_C6_APPLICABILITY_20260803.md
              SHA 1e60800bc78ab2c4a6f6d0fb884d42e0dcb725b2248b9c24e304ae1353cbf5f9.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIXED_FACTOR_CAPTWO_LP_ENERGY_AND_C6_APPLICABILITY_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md
              SHA 0e705f2179bc450b22b591a73bf94a164bce8529b350e7900cedabef988e1690.

2756ROOT. A cyclic upper-surjective Johnson row has a native paired
          first-exit terminal bank.  At seam i, the q1 diamond continues
          through the constant upper run to two terminal intervals with
          values R_i of rank r+1 and V_i of rank r+2.  Complete bundles at
          distinct seams are occurrence-disjoint, so after one complete
          cap/background state is fixed, two-coordinate service is exactly
          one bipartite Hall problem rather than two marginal gammoids.

          If L_j are the maximal constant-run lengths of the upper row,

            sum_i h_i=2W+sum_j binom(L_j,2)<3W.

          Averaging over cyclic cuts and using h_i>=2 yields a linear
          opening with exactly two lost bundles.  Terminal type acceptance,
          transported background, and the same-parity overlay remain
          premises.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_PAIRED_BANK_SINGLE_HALL_AND_TWO_WRAP_RESET_20260803.md
              SHA d5da9f8698cda6c4dde9c588ae104efe45124ba92ac42755d54b16690f087839.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIRST_EXIT_PAIRED_BANK_SINGLE_HALL_AND_TWO_WRAP_RESET_20260803.md
              SHA be3609ddfc165258c0a8d00f854b6535d25538c9d3b4154ad95cd51621e7797c.

2757ROOT. The missing first-exit premise is a real type obstruction, not a
          bookkeeping omission.  Canonical folded-C8 tickets are pairs of
          separately addressed, incomparable prefix/suffix cells in
          opposite phases.  Every first-exit pair is one nested Hasse pair
          in the same phase.  Relabelling or value-preserving full-block
          transport preserves these invariants, so the direct literal
          acceptance graph is empty and its deficiency is exactly 2d-2.

          If a protected value-and-phase converter produces threshold
          acceptance x~i iff h_i>=a_x, the graph is Ferrers and the exact
          deficiency becomes

            max_(t>=2) (A(t)-H_Z(t))_+.

          The run histogram is H(t)=sum_j(L_j-t+2)_+, with H(2)=W and
          H(3)=W-J<=2W/(r+1).  Thus the precise terminal target is now a
          converter, not another physical socket bank.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_TYPE_OBSTRUCTION_AND_THRESHOLD_HALL_20260803.md
              SHA 6ceb2e483fa2d9e8a278e388a91e9d70c1a4ab1715fc6b8def3bd595da146a7b.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIRST_EXIT_TYPE_OBSTRUCTION_THRESHOLD_HALL_20260803.md
              SHA e857a18a97155aa2f86116410f3125f8a47463e6f87e5ff31f327d2af9e8fb81.

2758ROOT. The canonical labelled lower-configuration host is not a direct
          application of the current Delcourt--Postle or Joos--Mubayi--
          Smith black boxes.  Its maximum degree is D_*=Wr!, its edge size
          is Theta(sqrt(r)), and the collar owner/facet codegree is
          (1-o(1))D_*/(r+1).  JMS's ambient-size, degree, and codegree rows
          force incompatible exponent inequalities.  At the useful degree
          scale DP would require beta=O(1/r), while its corollary fixes beta
          and the edge bound before the degree limit.

          Inflating the nominal degree makes the displayed guarantee only
          o(W).  This closes only the black-box route: tailored
          sparsification, collar-first factorization, and Boolean
          absorption remain live.

            MATH_THEOREM_EQUITABLE_CONFIGURATION_DP_JMS_BLACK_BOX_BOUNDARY_20260803.md
              SHA a4e8952f87b00d600d0f7f0ec2c0e6a107a71ba6a7f42a429d712c1ebd9fe156.
            MATH_AUDIT_EQUITABLE_CONFIGURATION_DP_JMS_BLACK_BOX_BOUNDARY_20260803.md
              SHA 2be718fbc2803ad4ae8254b3737b106acb39b86effe7dbe4de12e13cb57e911d.

2759ROOT. The entire named residual ideal below a
          (7/8+o(1))sqrt(r) collar now has an exact literal flag factor.
          Partition each parity of the residual ranks into blocks of d
          ranks and intersect them with any Boolean SCD.  Each nonempty
          chunk is indexed by its top set.  The normalized top mass tends
          to

            2 sum_(j>=0) exp(-(7/8+sqrt(pi)j)^2)<1.

          Uniform containment weights therefore give a Hall matching of
          every chunk into a distinct rank-r owner.  Every target is
          literal, every owner flag has at most d targets, and no flag has
          adjacent residual ranks.  Any prescribed boundary targets may be
          deleted afterward without disturbing the matching.

          This cannot be extended by merely chopping one fixed SCD.  The
          exact required flag count has normalized limit

            sum_(h>=0) exp(-pi h^2/4)>1,

          so every one-SCD-refining depth-d construction omits Omega(W)
          targets.  The only remaining lower-side object is a genuinely
          cross-SCD, capacitated attachment of the central collar to these
          exact residual flags.

            MATH_THEOREM_SPARSE_TOP_SCD_FLAG_ROUNDING_AND_SINGLE_SCD_BARRIER_20260803.md
              SHA f1381955ea94b2c5d86ec3af682d168228e86379a3dc66dad98b954388af89d1.
            MATH_AUDIT_SPARSE_TOP_SCD_FLAG_ROUNDING_AND_SINGLE_SCD_BARRIER_20260803.md
              SHA 82b340a21b7f6644d32c0796407e363900a45d88c732aba9c20cfa2fe7d3077f.

2760ROOT. Whole-chunk collar attachment now has an exact Hall formulation
          and a sharp unit barrier.  A residual flag F may use collar slot
          T exactly when max(F) is strictly below the collar bottom and
          |F|+ell_T<=D.  Hall on this literal graph is necessary and
          sufficient.

          The sparse residual construction already contains

            (exp(-(7/8+sqrt(pi))^2)-o(1))W

          full length-d chunks.  Any exact nonboundary collar coverage has
          at most W/(r+1)+b_(r-1)=o(W) zero-collar owner slots.  Hence at
          exact depth d, Omega(W) full chunks must each export at least one
          target; keeping the residual chunks whole cannot finish B(k).

          At depth d+1 there is an exact positive bridge for the top collar
          rank alone.  Uniform containment flow matches every residual
          chunk to a distinct containing rank-(r-1) cap, and all such caps
          to distinct rank-r owners.  The resulting literal flags have
          length at most d+1.  This does not place ranks r-a,...,r-2.

            MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_CAPACITATED_ATTACHMENT_UNIT_BARRIER_AND_TOP_CAP_20260803.md
              SHA e3abe5f684f64f6c3eb89d17cdc4fe6e5d42a9e2103a56d44dfb97a64a26a2cd.
            MATH_AUDIT_CROSS_SCD_CAPACITATED_ATTACHMENT_UNIT_BARRIER_AND_TOP_CAP_20260803.md
              SHA 7ad8a0d5b46adeb1134991427aaaa0bd54255c06fa2bc88cea1d0ee39d5c4633.

2761ROOT. The remaining collar yields a much stronger majorization barrier
          on the current whole-chunk face.  If H_j is the number of holes
          in collar rank r-j, then every distinguished family of A owner
          rows is forced to carry at least

            L(A)=sum_j(A-H_j)_+

          collar incidences.  This is the exact projected Gale/flow cut.
          Since 1-p_(r-j)<=j^2/r and the residual factor contains
          A=(gamma-o(1))W full length-d chunks, its first Theta(sqrt(r))
          collar ranks force

            L(A)=Omega(sqrt(r) W).

          Unchanged full chunks at depth d+C have only AC collar capacity,
          so every C=o(sqrt(r)), including every fixed additive constant,
          fails on this face.  In the designated-row, remainder-preserving
          repair model, the exported residual mass is at least L(A)-AC.
          The theorem does not obstruct a construction which globally
          dissolves and rechains those chunks; it proves that such a
          macroscopic joint rechainization is necessary.

            MATH_THEOREM_COLLAR_HOLE_MAJORISATION_AND_FIXED_SLACK_WHOLE_CHUNK_BARRIER_20260803.md

2762ROOT. The collar majorization obstruction is not a scalar/rank need for
          additive slack.  At anonymous rank-incidence level the exact
          optimum is again depth d.  Balance the residual rank multigraph
          by a proper W-edge-colouring, balance the collar incidence
          columns, and pair their heavy rows antitonely.  The combined W
          row loads differ by at most one, so total mass N<=dW gives
          maximum load d exactly.

          For a fixed residual load vector h, the least feasible depth is

            max { h_1^down,
                  max_x ceil((sum_(i<=x) h_i^down
                    +sum_j(m_j-W+x)_+)/x) }.

          Equitable h simultaneously minimizes every collar Gale cut by
          majorization.  Thus the parity-block bank fails because its
          literal flags have the wrong load distribution.  The exact
          remaining lower theorem is the named lift: assign these optimal
          anonymous rows to actual owners and distinct contained targets
          so each row is one inclusion flag.

            MATH_THEOREM_ANTITONE_BALANCED_RESIDUAL_COLLAR_RANK_COUPLING_20260803.md
              SHA 86acaccf2dd701ae757bdb0b8fb2515083b1c54f867f82186a4b3b1b0ea5fe78.
            MATH_AUDIT_ANTITONE_BALANCED_RESIDUAL_COLLAR_RANK_COUPLING_20260803.md
              SHA 95ba096a89a34659001bd1d71d47b7cde82a729a2a1cd90ea0e77a0e5b28d51a.

2763ROOT. The fixed-factor cap-two residual completion now has an exact
          integral min--max.  A rainbow base is selected by a head-colour
          master plus predecessor-fibre Hall.  After deleting it, a
          head-colour matching J has exact rainbow deficiency

            max_X (|X|-|N_J(X)|),

          and minimizing over J gives the optimum residual deficiency.
          In the Boolean specialization the fibres are exactly

            P(S_c,R)={S_b:p_R(b)=c}.

          The residual selector is common independence in one transversal
          and two crossing partition matroids.  Abstract functionality does
          not make that system a matroid: a three-edge augmentation gadget
          and a permutation-functional parity gadget give sharp warnings.
          Neither gadget is asserted to embed in the Boolean host.  The
          remaining theorem is one globally correlated Boolean base master
          whose residual master passes every fibre Hall cut.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FACTOR_RAINBOW_COMPLETION_HEADCOLOUR_HALL_AND_NONMATROID_GATE_20260803.md
              SHA 1a81158093019185be41d12012c5ae4287e971dc07119ddfe819107f7b6a25ed.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIXED_FACTOR_RAINBOW_COMPLETION_HEADCOLOUR_HALL_20260803.md
              SHA 7feee27b8fd495c2421e1b03d4cb207befbfc8177c9534fc7b15279975bf16c7.

2764ROOT. The first-exit value/phase converter has a sharp depth barrier.
          At every boundary between two upper runs, the two adjacent q1
          upper cells, intervening owner, and first-exit cap form one exact
          Boolean and interval-address diamond.  It gives a zero-new-address
          opposite-phase converter, but it equals the canonical folded
          ticket only at d=2,j=1.

          A general folded ticket with arms j and d-j needs exactly d Hasse
          edges and d+1 Boolean values.  Its longest branch has length
          max(j,d-j), and the sharp serial threshold is

            a_j=1+max(j,d-j).

          Therefore bounded-support Hasse/diamond conversion cannot prove
          exact B at growing depth.  That branch needs a full private fan
          satisfying the threshold Hall cuts, or a genuinely nonlocal
          recoding.  This makes the direct B+1 pivot interface the shorter
          current additive route.

            MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_BOUNDARY_DIAMOND_CONVERTER_AND_FAN_DEPTH_BARRIER_20260803.md
              SHA 0524a427210c5e8c92b6ff550a8f88025a57fb5cbf390b4d7f68a028efd41412.
            MATH_AUDIT_FIRST_EXIT_BOUNDARY_DIAMOND_CONVERTER_AND_FAN_DEPTH_BARRIER_20260803.md
              SHA c316edc3a12de59c183e782f9863721f00d2ae9a1ac6ee89dc23ea530614dae7.

2765ROOT. The B+1 rooted-Catalan topology gate is now an exact component-port
          Hall theorem.  If B is the protected free-port graph on C rooted
          components, then delta(B)=C-nu(B) is the minimum path-component
          count of a connector matching.  One path plus cycles exists iff
          delta<=1.  With prescribed endpoints, delete the terminal outgoing
          and source incoming ports and apply ordinary Hall.  A direct
          Hamilton path is exactly Hall in some forward ordered port graph.

          Fixed-fibre palette-preserving switches retain the selected tail
          and head banks and cannot change the path count.  Thus delta>1 is
          a hard obstruction inside that fibre.  At delta<=1, serial
          pivot-disjoint quaternary octagons absorb the remaining cycles if
          the required literal supports exist.  Immediate-upper safe opening
          is automatic outside a small pivot bank, but all-width safety is a
          separate witness condition.

            MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_PROTECTED_COMPONENT_PORT_HALL_AND_OCTAGON_HAMILTONIZATION_20260803.md
              SHA 401aa24568e869909e332c61d222e72d6a0310c585168484e0b30267d6739392.
            MATH_AUDIT_BPLUS1_PROTECTED_COMPONENT_PORT_HALL_AND_OCTAGON_HAMILTONIZATION_20260803.md
              SHA 2b612b1d7ff2b04a68e7ce25bdc4efd446c9465aa4c9984842b774a604518e90.

2766ROOT. Arbitrary-width upper preservation on the B+1 path now has an
          exact retained-witness interface.  A Hamilton-cycle opening is
          safe precisely when its cut is a duplicate-q1 occurrence outside
          the pivot and outside every target's forced-cut core.

          On the rooted-forest face, an upper-exact representative set can
          contain one old witness for every higher target iff those witnesses
          can be selected so that their union with the pivot uses at most one
          occurrence of each q1 colour.  Making that support a forest adds
          exactly one capacitated component-omission Hall family.  Ordered
          component-port Hall then adds connectors without deleting the bank,
          so every selected witness survives.  Finally, the monotone pivot
          insertion transports every old source interval with the same OR.

          The missing positive theorem is existence of this rainbow witness
          bank together with the rooted upper-exact forest; q1 redundancy
          alone does not imply it.

            MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_ALLWIDTH_RAINBOW_WITNESS_BANK_AND_SAFE_OPENING_20260803.md
              SHA f44ff6af870e6ef188444193e7c1755bb1441832f3a477a11bc0bda0505d5958.
            MATH_AUDIT_BPLUS1_ALLWIDTH_RAINBOW_WITNESS_BANK_AND_SAFE_OPENING_20260803.md
              SHA cee21191163d10e46452d3a8eee72ed52b6743321f97630d771e4347808c05b9.

2767ROOT. The named lower-side positive face now crosses independent SCDs.
          Let the collar bottom be rank t, its width a=r-t, and residual
          rank blocks B_j have |B_j|<=d-a.  If

            sum_j C(2r,max B_j)/W <= C(2r,t)/W,

          uniform containment flow matches every residual chunk to a
          different rank-t collar socket.  The residual and collar chunks
          may come from unrelated SCDs; concatenation and the final
          rank-(r-1) to rank-r matching give literal owner flags of load at
          most d.  In particular the complete central d-rank band has an
          exact named realization.  The theorem does not cover the whole
          strict lower ideal; that is the multisocket/serial frontier.

            MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_SPARSE_TOP_COLLAR_ATTACHMENT_20260803.md
              SHA a4d954e2d35e6a17e24099a3b6d28b9731f6f7d47d5a14533dad9e29ca62359e.

              SHA 3fba51ee18c3b5502b1bb2fac5c69a1e52cda931c96b64805fa21abd6fd48a13.

2768ROOT. The full lower named-flag problem now has an exact serial Hall
          formulation.  In either parity, integral lower-bounded flow gives
          one saturated descending Boolean path from every middle owner,
          with every rank-s target visited floor(W/C_s) or ceil(W/C_s)
          times.  For a fixed path bank P and adaptive boundary b_s, the
          exact deficiency is

            max_(Q subset P)
              [ sum_s(e_s(Q)-b_s)_+ - d|Q| ]_+.

          Its vanishing is equivalent to capacity-only named flags of depth
          d.  Empty, singleton, and whole-bank cuts pass at optimal even
          depth.  Marginal balance alone cannot prove the intermediate
          cuts: the rankwise reciprocal envelope exceeds d by
          Theta(sqrt(r)).  The missing property is cross-rank decorrelation,
          followed by the stronger residual-nonadjacency zero-one system.

            MATH_THEOREM_BALANCED_OWNER_PATH_MULTISOCKET_HALL_AND_RECIPROCAL_BARRIER_20260803.md
              SHA 5dc12b3da7eec6270d7f998f82a53eb9c268855e649a6923aa52b7cc5327ff62.
            MATH_THEOREM_BALANCED_OWNER_PATH_MULTISOCKET_HALL_AND_RECIPROCAL_BARRIER_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_20260803.md
              SHA 11ce91ba1aca7421766c44fe1838573579f7b07632bfc9913ae6834cf4ea0787.

2769ROOT. Fixed mixed complete-layer interfaces are integrally benign, but
          adaptive time slots are not.  Any feasible scalar rank transport
          between fixed unions of complete Boolean layers lifts by uniform
          containment weights and bipartite integrality to a named matching;
          iterating fixed interfaces gives owner-rooted ladders.  Once each
          named target may choose its time slot, the target-once rows couple
          the layers.  Already A<B<C with columns AB, BC, AC gives a strict
          Boolean determinant-two minor.  Thus fixed-slot TU cannot be used
          to round the complete named-flag configuration.

            MATH_THEOREM_MIXED_COMPLETE_LAYER_TRANSPORT_FIXED_SLOT_LADDER_20260803.md
              SHA 9fa093fa802dea9de8b72be67e248b9b5a3a1424ea20c2855c2bb335cca28cc7.

              SHA 480a03c1151593de5019e17e765e5cb1e151234a9ec6127f8c305c3721dfd487.

2770ROOT. The probabilistic lower route has been corrected from global
          density to Boolean-local density.  The multisocket cuts are
          equivalently capped union expansion.  Abstract exchangeable
          balanced partitions have an exact falling-factorial expectation,
          but coordinate stars prove that model cannot describe Boolean
          paths.  The correct local statistic is h_Q(S)/D_s.

          Its first-moment functional is monotone under ij-compression and
          has an exact weighted Johnson-boundary gap.  At rank r-1 and half
          density, coordinate halfspaces are the unique maximizers; every
          fixed-width principal coordinate star's unavoidable core passes
          the optimal Hall cut with positive margin.  The missing theorem is
          a local switching MGF plus an energy-sensitive container bound for
          realized multi-rank leakage.

            MATH_THEOREM_RANDOM_BALANCED_PATH_LOCAL_DENSITY_AND_SWITCHING_GATE_20260804.md
              SHA 0595249d93f037238d59e2bd94161af9f2144214731c4387c749f914e9a9b9dd.

              SHA da91a6421e47f3467704648f04128fae1210962eb44ad359fb175c1204028a0f.

2771ROOT. The terminal private router has an exact residual occurrence-level
          premise.  After fixing the cap state, deleting one frozen
          compensation linkage, and reserving private prefixes, claims are
          simultaneously serviceable exactly when

            r_Gamma(union_(g in X) A_g) >= |X|

          for every claim family X.  On a private occurrence lift this is
          nested Hall.  A residual typed q1 factor-diamond lift gives a full
          one-coordinate router by alternating perfect matchings.  Boolean
          value expansion alone is insufficient: one compensation path can
          erase arbitrarily large suffix rank, and two marginal routers can
          share one terminal cut.  Two-coordinate use still requires the
          exact two-Rado inequality and product closure in one state.

            MATH_THEOREM_BOOLEAN_JOHNSON_PRIVATE_SUFFIX_RADO_ROUTER_20260803.md
              SHA 55cb74c849435cf779322c3898c3d2b550361f47ccbc0f6f809d70c5a0889bb4.
            MATH_AUDIT_BOOLEAN_JOHNSON_PRIVATE_SUFFIX_RADO_ROUTER_20260803.md
              SHA 08863fb597d62c610a84de132bbf972e26ec530fe723ae7cd814c6593149c7da.

2772ROOT. The retained-old all-width forest gate is now an exact blocker/CSP
          problem.  A deletion must avoid the pivot, use every colour's
          exact quota, meet every old cycle, and avoid being a transversal
          of every higher target's witness family.  Forced-cut cores are
          exactly the singleton blockers; multi-edge forest deletion needs
          the complete minimal-transversal clutter.

          Equivalently, one occurrence variable per colour must satisfy the
          natural join of all target and component relations.  After a
          witness selector is fixed, the remaining extension is ordinary
          partition--graphic matroid intersection and equals the capacitated
          component-omission Hall min--max.  The witness-token compatibility
          system is nonmatroidal in general, so its outer minimum remains
          open.

            MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_RAINBOW_FOREST_BLOCKER_CSP_AND_MATROID_MINMAX_20260804.md
              SHA e9d32b46c907ef85bf1fb791de57d6d6918fb26746521f91ef876b4d919e4c2e.
            MATH_AUDIT_BPLUS1_RAINBOW_FOREST_BLOCKER_CSP_AND_MATROID_MINMAX_20260804.md
              SHA 818d1155e7391236f266791e0892dc98b520cf81a6399e6f5e8054ddcc1d0530.

2773ROOT. The odd pivot overlay has no token-orbit obstruction.  Relative to
          the full Pascal payload, its extra recursive interface is one
          named rank-(R-1) token H.  The exact output menu is

            {J: |H intersect J|=R-D},

          of size C(R-1,D-1)C(R,D-1); its exact-distance graph is connected.
          An outgoing token avoids a coordinate bank F exactly when
          |F intersect H|<=D-1 and |F-H|<=R-D+1, so every fixed-size bank
          can be flushed in one large relay.  The surviving obstruction is
          fresh-host, cap, and occurrence acceptance, not token reachability.

            MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_ONE_TOKEN_REGENERATIVE_OVERLAY_AND_FIXED_FIBRE_OBSTRUCTION_20260803.md
              SHA 2635e32142db89714177e0b017a5f98d2e20fb91e11864cf22905b4ec40efcdd.
            MATH_AUDIT_BPLUS1_ONE_TOKEN_REGENERATIVE_OVERLAY_20260803.md
              SHA 2717301fd4129cfe539d3b0adcdd16a89ba529398c325ef88460a697fe18b926.

2774ROOT. The weakest all-parity interface does not require even
          regeneration.  One selected odd spine with terminal charge q_o,
          plus one terminal-only even certificate of charge q_e on each
          selected odd state, gives the all-dimensional charge
          max(q_o,q_e).  For B+1 the even requirement is exactly tau<=1.

          The closed top-bit splice is not such a bounded tap.  From an odd
          word of excess q it pays

            2q+chi_K,  chi_K=2d_(K-1)-d_K in {d_K,d_K+2}=Theta(sqrt K).

          A splice-relative B+Q construction must realize an actual physical
          saving s satisfying s-R(H)>=2q+chi_K-Q.  Conditional bilayer
          chronology/router accounting is not a physical saving.

            MATH_THEOREM_WEAKEST_EVEN_TERMINAL_TAP_AND_CLOSED_SPLICE_PARITY_TOLL_20260804.md
              SHA d704f94ea276934f0b9fba4d4b6e58a3757d97110805338cd40cc284c699144e.

              SHA 4c78d07f31d296d64eff57e76912d0719699dda903657fec22fdf0666cfe4b72.

2775ROOT. The current proof-safe synthesis uses terminal charge

            tau(C)=c(C)+R(H(C)).

          Charge zero gives exact B, charge at most one gives B+1, and a
          uniform charge bound gives B+O(1).  The strongest single missing
          pivot theorem is Protected Pivot--Path Coinstantiation PPC(C): one
          compatible odd spine with terminal-only even taps in which the
          lower multisocket cuts, upper blocker/forest cuts, component Hall,
          residual typed router cuts, literal replay, and regeneration hold
          in the same materialized objects.  PPC(1) would prove B+1;
          finite-charge PPC(C) would prove B+O(1).

          Within the current folded exact architecture the corresponding
          zero-charge target is PCC(0).  Neither theorem is proved, and the
          finite status remains nu(k)=B(k) only through k=16.

            MATH_SYNTHESIS_PPC1_PCC0_EXACT_CUT_FRONTIER_20260804.md

              SHA 3095236b375b17cd98614b91fcc93317e91702c830c3e7dc93f52465347ba280.

2776ROOT. Universal fixed-factor upper selection is false even at the
          abstract interval-occurrence interface.  A four-cycle with colour
          word R,A,R,B and two disjoint two-edge target witnesses forces the
          two different R occurrences; every target is separately feasible
          and every section breaks the cycle, but no common section exists.

          The exact positive replacement is the dual target-choice CSP:
          one relation per q1 colour requires all selected witnesses using
          that colour to use the same occurrence.  Running intersection plus
          a nonempty semijoin core is exact.  An immutable menu-envelope
          reserve Hall condition then decouples component breaking; outside
          that face, an occurrence-scope blocker LLL is sufficient under its
          explicit probability and dependency inequalities.

            MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_OCCURRENCE_SECTION_DUAL_JOIN_TREE_RESERVE_HALL_AND_BLOCKER_LLL_20260804.md
              SHA 9e329db1beeb6614a7ea43e5e18b72fea9619c2c57882b010d977376b49677b9.
            MATH_AUDIT_BPLUS1_OCCURRENCE_SECTION_DUAL_JOIN_TREE_RESERVE_HALL_AND_BLOCKER_LLL_INDEPENDENT_20260804.md
              SHA 89bdcdde7ea20a36aa2a93fa31b6cab5e646115673c024d87560dfb830c082a8.

2777ROOT. The one-pivot seam and module-correlation problem now has an exact
          conditional composition theorem.  If H is the incoming
          rank-(R-1) token, D the aperture depth, and F forbidden only in the
          exported token, the eligible output count is

            C(R-1-|F intersect H|,R-D)
            C(R-|F-H|,D-1).

          A complete q1 palette makes these values unique seams.  A
          running-intersection natural join tests lower, upper, cap, and
          router choices in one state; private footprints with certified
          semantic/dual-role/seam interfaces paste one surviving tuple into
          one literal B+1 host without creating a new omission.

          The router row is weaker than full-port rank.  A left-h-regular
          claim--port factor followed by a left-q-regular port--sink factor
          routes every claim when

            sum_(f=ps) deg_B(p) <= hq

          at every sink.  Weight 1/(hq) on every two-stage incidence chain
          and max-flow integrality prove the claim.  At h=q=2 two private
          occurrence-lifted factors suffice, but two abstract factors do
          not supply the lifts, types, compensation survival, or common
          state.  Pairwise coinstantiation is insufficient: a three-relation
          equality/equality/inequality triangle has full pairwise projections
          and empty triple join.

            MATH_THEOREM_TOKEN_SPHERE_LAMINAR_PRIVATE_PIVOT_HOST_COINSTANTIATION_20260804.md
              SHA 575a89720b723b6d5f3c42c147d4c808aae667bc9856b037e9a9db5eeba33e01.
            MATH_AUDIT_TOKEN_SPHERE_LAMINAR_PRIVATE_PIVOT_HOST_COINSTANTIATION_20260804.md
              SHA 769b7fa3a8051f0b69309046707c984077c3299bd4b4857d170421b6d17d2389.

2778ROOT. Eligible pivot seams are exactly a product Johnson slice.  In
          sparse-defect coordinates they are

            C(A,h) x C(B,l).

          If the complete joined host depends on the token through one
          total coordinate footprint U,V with allowed local states L, the
          accepted count is exactly

            sum_((S,T) in L)
              C(|A|-|U|,h-|S|) C(|B|-|V|,l-|T|).

          A nonempty local join therefore extends automatically when the
          total footprint fits on both sides of each slice.  With a fixed
          occurrence exception bank E, accepted count is at least the
          displayed number minus |E|.  Hypergeometric cylinder weights give
          an alternative rare-defect DNF criterion and a defect-transversal
          container criterion.

          Bounded scope per constraint is not enough: the unary events
          "x is a hole" cover the entire fixed-size slice even though their
          supports are disjoint, and singleton physical occurrence events
          can likewise cover every seam.  The open structural row is to put
          the real lower/upper/router rejection relation into one of the
          proved total-footprint, hybrid, or rare-defect forms.

            MATH_THEOREM_PRODUCT_JOHNSON_SEAM_LOCAL_EXTENSION_AND_RARE_DEFECT_CONTAINERS_20260804.md
              SHA 8b41c84ce5d39fb8c16aff7a285a5644c66f2a5dabb71935bf71f65f0b76858a.
            MATH_AUDIT_PRODUCT_JOHNSON_SEAM_LOCAL_EXTENSION_AND_RARE_DEFECT_CONTAINERS_20260804.md
              SHA d0166cd689a85f367de47286e82cda3186adb71df21c31bfcb63a269516809a4.

2779ROOT. Tomon's published equal-chain theorem is not in the critical OR
          regime.  Its explicit hypothesis k>500c^2 permits only

            c/d(k) <= sqrt(8/(500pi))+o(1)=0.071... .

          Restricting such a partition to the strict lower ideal leaves at
          least sqrt(500pi/8)W=(14.012...+o(1))W chain fragments.  Reaching
          W+O(sqrt(k)) endpoint chains therefore needs at least
          (13.012...-o(1))W genuine cross-fragment joins, before distinct
          owner containment or source-word countdown is addressed.  This is
          a barrier to direct adaptation, not a Boolean no-go theorem.

            MATH_THEOREM_TOMON_CPARTITION_CRITICAL_COEFFICIENT_AND_SERIALIZATION_BARRIER_20260804.md
              SHA ed93a6f526ecac72489e4339335624f1a5a24baccde8e9a4b27827a0426b1895.
            MATH_AUDIT_TOMON_CPARTITION_CRITICAL_COEFFICIENT_AND_SERIALIZATION_BARRIER_20260804.md
              SHA 0a6d1e5e53456052a5bfddbcadc9133153cae1244c9e5e4ed506b8935c12f15e.

2780ROOT. The architecture-free endpoint-chain gate is sharper than a
          uniform depth bound.  At word length W+h the exact sorted right-
          endpoint capacities are

            (h repeated W+1 times, h-1,h-2,...,1),

          with total hW+C(h+1,2).  Every Boolean rank cut, every generalized
          Greene--Kleitman capacity cut, and the full rank-to-labelled-slot
          max-flow system pass for h>=d.  There is an explicit fractional
          named flag factor; under uniform capacity h its minimum mass is

            max{ C(k,r-1), Lambda/h },

          leaving at least (d-1)/2 units of fractional chain-mass slack at
          B(k).

          Integral rounding is not formal.  A disjoint-union-of-chains
          example has a perfect complete-multipartite incomparability graph,
          passes every displayed cut, and has a fractional triangular
          n-slot cover, yet needs n+1 integral bounded chains.  The remaining
          static statement is Boolean-specific integral rounding; distinct
          owners, the left-endpoint system, and countdown serialization are
          further gates.

            MATH_THEOREM_ENDPOINT_TRIANGULAR_BOUNDED_CHAIN_FRACTIONAL_EXACTNESS_20260804.md
              SHA 12b6934ab7cca5c714bc4f19117da6d044f9a2e6370528e0e51426989c121c7a.
            MATH_AUDIT_ENDPOINT_TRIANGULAR_BOUNDED_CHAIN_FRACTIONAL_EXACTNESS_20260804.md
              SHA 97aeefcc4e59c0fa639ea0dfd578ae451ab12478ffbfee24bc469f4a7c71552f.

2781ROOT. Independent rounding of the exact fractional endpoint factor is
          quantitatively wrong.  In the symmetric product distribution,
          rank r-1 alone has at least C(k,r-1)/8 uncovered named targets
          with probability 1-exp(-Omega(W)); every repair needs the same
          order of slot changes.  Global dependence is mandatory.

          A concrete dependent face has strict scalar reserve.  One SCD
          supplies the top collar and a second supplies residual chunks.
          Exact completion is one typed containment/capacity Hall matching.
          Its total capacity vacancy is sigma, and for even k the short
          socket count is

            (1-e^(-pi/4)+o(1))W > 0.544W,

          while maximal residual d-chunking uses fewer than 0.501W chunks.
          Counts and capacity therefore do not obstruct this face; literal
          Hall does.

              SHA bf4035986a30e154fd8cdc66e1b906409470328b746ef1f6d8dcc0288ff3558e.

2782ROOT. The multi-slab two-SCD receiving side is exact.  With t=r-d,
          collar owner sockets of capacity u have multiplicity

            C(k,t+u)-C(k,t+u-1),

          including W-C(k,r-1) empty full-capacity owners; the clipped
          boundary contributes one socket of each capacity 1,...,d.  For a
          declared residual chunking, literal completion is exactly Hall in
          the containment-and-capacity socket graph.  Its symmetrized
          rank-density relaxation is equivalent to

            sum_s sum_(a>=q) A_(s,a)
              <= W-C(k,t+q-1)+d-q+1  (1<=q<=d).

          Maximal d-slabs fail at q=d by Theta(W).  In fact every common
          consecutive rank-slab grid fails asymptotically in even dimension:
          its q=1 and top-slab cuts contradict in the Gaussian limit.
          Therefore any successful two-SCD proof must cut different chains
          at different ranks and then prove the stronger literal Hall cuts.

            MATH_THEOREM_MULTI_SLAB_CROSS_SCD_EXACT_HALL_AND_TOP_SLAB_CUT_20260804.md
              SHA 1d0056b9574e6363a19040d3dbd51d5893cc8fa1c2ecff245604bab4df35269b.

2783ROOT. Pair stratification gives an unconditional almost-spanning
          residence theorem.  Pair [2r] into r coordinate pairs; fixing the
          double, empty, and singleton pairs partitions J(2r,r) into induced
          cubes Q_m.  Long-run cube Gray cycles give coordinate run at least
          L on every cell with m>=L+ceil(3log_2 r).  For L=Theta(sqrt(r)),
          the uncovered owner fraction is exp(-Omega(r)).

          This cannot be completed fibrewise: even r has isolated Q_0
          cells, and odd r has Q_1 cells with no cycle.  Exact residence now
          asks for run-transparent cross-cell splicing, jointly with q1 and
          upper decoration.  High Hamilton compression, one-track structure,
          and flip balance do not imply residence: an explicit maximally
          5-symmetric balanced cycle in J(5,2) has minimum run one.

            MATH_THEOREM_PAIR_STRATIFIED_LONG_RUN_JOHNSON_FACTOR_20260804.md

2784ROOT. The pure-math wave is synthesized as an integral-correlation
          frontier.  Exact triangular endpoint capacities, every rank/GK
          cut, fractional named flags, raw two-SCD socket supply, the token
          sphere, fixed-total seam extension, and private factor-router flow
          are no longer candidate scalar obstructions.  The positive
          residence scale also holds on all but exp(-Omega(k)) of the
          central owners.

          The remaining coefficient-one construction needs, in one state:
          chain-dependent residual SCD cuts satisfying literal socket Hall;
          run-transparent decorated cross-cell splicing; a nonempty upper
          occurrence-section join with reserve forest; a localized eligible
          seam; coexisting typed private router lifts; countdown/literal
          replay; and terminal even taps.  The existing charge ledger and
          private-pushout theorem turn such a charge-C host into B+C.  No
          theorem here supplies the host, so no all-dimensional upper bound
          is claimed.

2785ROOT. Boolean interval geometry gives a polynomial dependency bound for
          upper occurrence selection.  A q1 colour of multiplicity mu_R
          belongs to at most

            mu_R (m(m-1)/2-1)

          higher-target event scopes.  This yields an exact hybrid blocker
          LLL: deterministic-safe witnesses may be frozen, while a small
          vulnerable leave receives logarithmically many random-colour-
          disjoint, bounded-repeat witnesses; component breaker events or
          an immutable private reserve map are included in the same proof.

          Uniform logarithmic menus are count-impossible already at q2.
          If V_2 targets receive t witnesses, then

            V_2/N_2 <= 6m/((m-1)(m-2)(t-1)).

          Hence the nonvacuous target is a deterministic-safe witness for
          almost every q2 target and logarithmic redundancy only on an
          O(1/(m log m)) leave.  A literal Boolean six-cycle exhibits two
          unique admissible q2 witnesses forcing different occurrences of
          the same repeated q1 colour, so individual target feasibility is
          not enough.

            MATH_THEOREM_BOOLEAN_INTERVAL_BLOCKER_LLL_AND_SIX_CYCLE_SECTION_OBSTRUCTION_20260804.md
              SHA 1113dc87d45f44b84640b11fda94affc1f001b98e4148bd89d1db81fc234eb6d.

2786ROOT. A bounded Boolean port bank has an exact one-step private suffix
          router.  Distinct rank-s ports have pairwise upper-neighbourhood
          overlap at most one.  If every port has at least L common typed
          one-coordinate extensions, |P|<=L, and at most L-1 Boolean sink
          values are forbidden after compensation/prefix pricing, then
          Bonferroni gives

            |N(X)-F| >= |X|L-C(|X|,2)-|F| >= |X|,

          so Hall supplies distinct sinks.  With an injective physical
          occurrence reservation and common type legality, this is a
          literal suffix router.  In ML_m, an O(sqrt(m)) left-2-regular
          protected factor is therefore routed whenever every distinct
          port retains m+1-O(1) typed extensions and only O(sqrt(m)) sink
          values are unavailable.  The theorem does not create the
          prefixes, distinct port values, or the common occurrence state.

            MATH_THEOREM_SMALL_PORT_BOOLEAN_ONE_STEP_PRIVATE_ROUTER_20260804.md
              SHA 5012824ff43f6baa6093eba21e18f460c598c75d103acd9ac56a5a628e3e808c.
            MATH_AUDIT_SMALL_PORT_BOOLEAN_ONE_STEP_PRIVATE_ROUTER_INDEPENDENT_20260804.md
              SHA 4aa9725e2ae197c7a87b052a386c456ff5f7c0cbc4aa4f8018358c8c434d7245.

2787ROOT. Chain-dependent two-SCD cutting is asymptotically rigid.  With
          A=sqrt(pi)/2, residual row lengths have Gaussian density

            2(A+x)e^(-(A+x)^2) dx,

          while socket capacities have density

            2(A-y)e^(-(A-y)^2) dy,  0<y<A.

          Their first moments agree exactly because A is the Gaussian
          half-integral.  Every chunk profile passing all socket threshold
          cuts, even up to uniform o(W) error, converges to the latter
          measure.  Consequently every minimum-number-of-chunks rule fails
          by Omega(W), regardless of cut positions; balanced equal-part
          cuts have a linear-versus-quadratic top-tail failure; and every
          literal coefficient-one attachment is asymptotically capacity-
          diagonal.  A successful rule must add a positive density of cuts
          and correlate both SCDs while constructing the unique Rayleigh
          fragmentation.

            MATH_THEOREM_CHAIN_DEPENDENT_SCD_GAUSSIAN_FRAGMENTATION_RIGIDITY_20260804.md
              SHA 525ac828ff2de9b1075ac841f675778fcfe25c662f7234960fb841d4f1b250ee.

2788ROOT. The limiting Rayleigh job/socket pair passes every Lorenz and
          concave-subadditive fragmentation price: after padding the job
          measure at zero, the socket measure is smaller in convex order.
          Whole-chain composition is nevertheless governed by the strictly
          stronger configuration polyhedron.  For job multiplicities n_l,
          socket multiplicities m_u, and

            Q_l={p>=0: |p|<=l<=sum_u u p_u},

          fractional feasibility is equivalent to every nonnegative price
          inequality

            sum_l n_l min_(p in Q_l) theta.p <= sum_u m_u theta_u.

          Explicit residue-sensitive examples pass scalar, majorization,
          and receiving threshold cuts but violate this dual.  Even raising
          every socket capacity by one can leave linear configuration
          deficiency.  These are abstract scope counterexamples, not a
          no-go for the smooth binomial histogram; proving its complete
          price system is the next anonymous lower gate.

2789ROOT. Fixed additive charge does not change the leading two-SCD
          geometry.  For h=d+C with fixed C, the row and socket measures
          have the same Gaussian limits as at C=0, while exact vacancy is

            sigma_C=sigma_0+CW+Cd+C(C+1)/2=O(W)=o(W sqrt(r)).

          Thus every B+C threshold-feasible cutting still converges to the
          same Rayleigh socket measure, every minimum-piece rule still
          fails by Omega(W), and every literal matching remains
          macroscopically capacity-diagonal.  Constant slack can address
          only the W-scale configuration/residue and occurrence-correlation
          layers.  The exact proof removes the empty set from the unique
          rank-zero residual chain; omitting this puncture makes the vacancy
          identity off by one.

2790ROOT. Pair-cell residence now has an exact local splice.  In one
          singleton-dimension stratum, transferring double status between
          an active pair and a full pair gives a twisted Johnson square.
          Cutting the q-edge in the first cube and the p-edge in the second
          makes the two seams use opposite physical pair members.  Two
          coherently relabelled rho-run cube cycles merge into one cycle of
          run at least rho-1; hence any matching of cells splices with zero
          additional residence debt.

          Cross-stratum m to m+2 squares require explicit p/q-free endpoint
          collars and disjoint cross-seam collars; long opened arcs alone
          are insufficient.  One splice is automatically relabellable in
          the crude range m>=4L, but not in the critical m=L+O(log r)
          window.  Naive Q_0/Q_1 triangle ears force a run-one pulse.  The
          upward owner graph has ample biregular two-port supply, so the
          unresolved row is a phase-coherent occurrence-labelled multiport
          buffer, not a scalar neighbour count.

2791ROOT. Local seam/upper/router co-instantiation is exact on an interface
          tree.  Product-Johnson seam profiles lambda have exact extension
          multiplicities n_lambda.  If lower, upper, and router modules
          share a tree of complete separators and one separator certificate
          is supported throughout profile lambda outside an occurrence
          exception bank E_lambda, then at least

            sum_lambda (n_lambda-|E_lambda|)_+

          seams admit one common literal tuple.  Pinned upper semijoin plus
          immutable reserve Hall and the degree-weighted private factor
          router substitute directly.  After attached trees are eliminated,
          one chordless interface cycle is feasible exactly when the
          composed transfer relation has a fixed point.  The binary
          equality/equality/disequality triangle is the minimal hidden
          cyclic obstruction: all modules and every pair can be feasible
          while the full host is empty.

            MATH_THEOREM_LOCALIZED_INTERFACE_TREE_UPPER_ROUTER_COINSTANTIATION_20260804.md

2792ROOT. The smooth-binomial configuration dual can be restricted exactly
          to nonnegative, nondecreasing, subadditive covering closures.
          Its signed Gaussian tail kernel has one crossing and zero
          integral, closing every increasing concave price.  More strongly,
          for A=sqrt(pi)/2 every ceiling/MIR ray passes strictly at every
          real scale a>0:

            sum_(n>=0) exp(-(A+na)^2)
              < sum_(0<=na<A) (1-exp(-(A-na)^2)).

          Thus no pure minimum-piece denomination separates the Rayleigh
          profile.  This does not generate the whole physical cone: the
          finite monotone-subadditive covering price (1,2,2,2,3) lies
          outside the conic hull of increasing concave prices and all
          ceiling rays, separated by

            2f(1)-2f(2)+2f(4)-f(5).

          Any remaining smooth separator must therefore be genuinely
          mixed-denomination.  It may have one fixed macroscopic shape or
          vary with dimension; the five-capacity cone separation does not
          decide that quantifier.  The full all-price inequality remains
          open.

            MATH_THEOREM_SMOOTH_BINOMIAL_CONFIGURATION_DUAL_AND_CEILING_PRICE_CLASSES_20260804.md
              SHA c3a2c1858f59fa32e61d2f9a9252085ad7fb01f3521ab5cb46998705123e103d.

2793ROOT. The leading Rayleigh fragmentation primal is exactly a finite
          coagulation problem.  Job intensity is e^(-pi/4), socket
          intensity is 1-e^(-pi/4), and their total workloads are equal.
          Hence any feasible trimming kernel has zero unused capacity
          almost everywhere: the socket measure must partition into finite
          groups whose exact sums have the job measure.  Equivalently, the
          Rayleigh law must decompose into finite equal-weight blocks of
          mean sqrt(pi)/2, with one above-mean point and all other points
          below the mean in each block.

          Every group-count tail obeys

            intensity{N>=n} >= exp(-pi n^2/4),

          but the sum of these forced tails is strictly below the available
          socket intensity.  Thus fragment count has strict room; the open
          continuum gate is additive coagulation itself, dual to the mixed-
          denomination covering prices in item 2792.

            MATH_THEOREM_RAYLEIGH_JOB_SOCKET_COAGULATION_EXACT_REDUCTION_20260804.md
              SHA 6449b57ba037225847fd0661f9c32c813c4110a77b56f9b05690e191bef868e8.
            MATH_AUDIT_RAYLEIGH_JOB_SOCKET_COAGULATION_EXACT_REDUCTION_20260804.md
              SHA b79e1152fbb079a8236ece8cd02779b8b88fcf9b478d4cf54d356f078f2a42a7.

2794ROOT. Three coordinate pairings remove the low-cell owner-supply
          obstruction for residence.  For one fixed owner, the singleton-
          pair dimension X under a uniform perfect pairing has exact law

            Pr(X=m)=2^m(r!)^3/[m!((r-m)/2)!^2(2r)!]

          on the parity-compatible values.  If M=L+ceil(3log_2 r) with
          L=O(sqrt(r)), then three independent frames leave some owner bad
          with probability at most

            64(r+1)^(9/2)(M+1)^3 r^(3M) 2^(-r)=o(1).

          Hence three deterministic pairings make every owner part of an
          L-resident-capable good cube cell.  More generally, for every
          fixed h, h+2 frames give at least h good choices everywhere.

          Coverage is not a factor.  The exact remaining object is a
          perfect matching in the symmetric successor-occurrence graph
          whose induced permutation has disjoint transition supports for
          the next L-1 edges.  Seam-free inheritance is a whole-cell exact
          cover.  Using all perfect pairings makes the successor-occurrence
          multigraph regular and therefore gives an ordinary topological
          perfect matching, but that matching may switch frames, violate
          the residence collar, or create an antiparallel two-cycle.  Two
          duplicated triangles sharing a vertex likewise show that even
          two choices at every owner do not imply a spanning 2-factor.  The
          unresolved row is occurrence/collar selection, not resident-
          capable owner supply.

            MATH_THEOREM_THREE_PAIRING_RESIDENCE_COVER_AND_SELECTOR_GATE_20260804.md
              SHA d081f90c720cc95bf7f01611ee085f06b7046c6cf5c16ed0b84a1140ddf1c43c.
            MATH_AUDIT_THREE_PAIRING_RESIDENCE_COVER_AND_SELECTOR_GATE_20260804.md
              SHA 31df238a77c42b15279c41363770f5b8f0ea0b1867d69ea3272a7cc5a260975c.

2795ROOT. Cross-stratum residence has an exact complementary-age law.
          If one common direction occurs at inward transition-slot ages
          i,j across a new seam, it is safe exactly when i+j>=L.  Once the
          exceptional p/q directions are absent from the relevant large-
          side collar, one seam is relabellable already at m>=L by reversing
          the age orders.
          For both seams, after fixing the common cut direction, make the
          bipartite graph whose edges satisfy both endpoint age-sum
          inequalities.  A common resident relabelling exists exactly when
          this graph has a perfect matching.

          Arbitrary endpoint histories are therefore automatically soluble
          by m>=2L-1, improving the old 4L range.  At the critical m>=L
          scale, equal support of the two endpoint collars in each cube is
          a complete certificate: old residence forces the two ages of
          every supported direction to sum to L, so the complementary
          matching works simultaneously at both seams.  The remaining
          critical gate is planting/regenerating those balanced-support
          cuts; Q_0/Q_1 triangle pulses remain a distinct small-cell issue.

            MATH_THEOREM_COMPLEMENTARY_AGE_CROSS_STRATUM_COLLARS_20260804.md
              SHA c1354230ebbcafeab4d5dce28eca9013c8c05fd4fbb192bff42ae729be94df8c.
            MATH_AUDIT_COMPLEMENTARY_AGE_CROSS_STRATUM_COLLARS_20260804.md
              SHA 50d1d4d592bb5b2a7b2605f68f6d5e5e3a88ac084ac0a1d3027763dd8728decc.

2796ROOT. The continuum mixed-price gate now has an exact carry-faithful
          finite form.  Anchored sliding-window inequalities are exactly
          monotone subadditivity, and inverse levels are nondecreasing
          superadditive clocks.  For a compact internally superadditive
          profile b, its unbounded-knapsack closure S b is the least global
          clock.  Universal positivity is equivalent to every finite table

            c_0=0<=...<=c_n,  c_(i+j)>=c_i+c_j,  c_n>=A

          having nonnegative Gaussian cost along

            V_0=0,  V_m=max_(1<=j<=min(m,n))(c_j+V_(m-j)).

          The former negative half-step pair is repaired by carry.  Every
          n=2 table passes strictly.  For n=3 the Bellman recurrence has an
          exact two-/three-coset normal form.  All of regime I is positive.
          Period monotonicity and a separately audited theta-completion
          theorem close the compact regime-II triangle with uniform margin.
          Hence every n=3 table passes strictly; a finite Bellman
          counterexample, if one exists, has grid size at least four.  The
          general Bellman inequality remains unproved.

          At n=4, maximal generator efficiency gives an exact two-coset
          form, an effective three-coset form with three exceptional
          positions, or a four-coset Apéry tail with nonperiodic prefix
          below capacity nine; this is a reduction only, and n=4 positivity
          remains open.
