2797ROOT. Local chronology inside every sufficiently large pair cell is
          explicit.  If h is a power of two with h>=4D and m>=h, a syndrome
          resolution, parity-twisted quotient, flat occurrence-bit gauge,
          and globally separated square-switch tree give a D-resident
          Hamilton cycle of Q_m.  The factor 1/4 is sharp for the chosen
          equal-column weight-two kernel basis.  This is a local good-cell
          theorem only.

          Whole-cell global selection is impossible at the required scale.
          A dimension-m pair cell has 2^m owners, while

            nu_2 C(2r,r)=s_2(r)<=floor(log_2 r)+1.

          Thus an exact cover by whole cells of dimension at least M forces
          M<=s_2(r), contradicting M=Theta(sqrt(r)) for large r even with
          all pairing frames.  The fixed-m all-frame hypergraph still has a
          symmetric fractional exact cover.  Exact two- and three-frame
          component criteria are proved.  A successful selector must use
          at least one proper block carrying the low two-adic residue, but
          arithmetic alone does not force unequal block lengths.  A
          switch-only tree on one fixed whole-cell edge union preserves
          owner multiplicities; post-selection switch trees remain valid.

            MATH_THEOREM_SYNDROME_QUOTIENT_SWITCH_TREE_RESIDENT_CUBE_20260804.md
              SHA a15b0e394d0572a7f90208a9b062b078e35bbc36781392a590011e0787dfee38.
            MATH_AUDIT_SYNDROME_QUOTIENT_SWITCH_TREE_RESIDENT_CUBE_20260804.md
              SHA b2cd47ba6110a5cf02b966f4e6c59d3659b22b57262976e8e2f3e50d0f57519c.
            MATH_THEOREM_PAIR_CELL_TWO_ADIC_SELECTOR_OBSTRUCTION_20260804.md

2806NFR. The named-containment part of the one-depth absorber now has an
          exact matroid formulation, and its small exceptional bank is
          physically liftable.  For fixed named residual chunks F and fixed
          collar socket occurrences D, the attachment graph is

            F ~ D  iff  top(F) subset bottom(D)
                         and |F| <= capacity(D).

          Thus fixed-bank feasibility is exactly ordinary Hall.  If the
          collar is co-chosen, let M_u be the inclusion-transversal matroid
          on rank-u sets represented by rank-(u-1), and K_u=M_u^*.  Bases
          of K_u are exactly legal chain-start sets at rank u.  On the
          direct sum K over the tagged collar ranks, named attachment is
          equivalent by Rado to

            r_K(N(X)) >= |X|  for every residual chunk family X.

          This is the exact all-cut gate: it simultaneously chooses socket
          bottoms and guarantees they extend to one collar chain forest.

          The protected-top Boolean surplus theorem gives eta_(u-1)>=r at
          every collar interface u<=r.  Therefore every at-most-r family of
          proposed rank-u starts is independent in K_u.  A chunk top below
          u has at least r+1 containing rank-u sets, so Hall plus this
          reserve attaches every bank having at most r chunks at each
          assigned rank.  In particular, any total O(D) exceptional bank is
          harmless for D=Theta(sqrt(r)).

          This reserve is capacity-faithful across the old D to new D+1
          shift.  Starting from h reserved distinct vanished-old-singleton/

          tops, distinct rank-b values A_i subset T_i, a residual interval
          naming in which the A_i are newly born singleton rows, and the
          same collar chainization at both depths.  The old singleton A_i
          uses occurrence T_i; after the shift it vanishes, that occurrence
          gains one capacity unit, and the new exceptional chunk uses the
          same occurrence.

2807STN. Arbitrary fixed bulk naming is false, but the exact spread
          replacement and its required socket reserve are now known.

          At start rank u, a request F with top S_F contributes

            1 / C(2r-|S_F|,u-|S_F|)

          to every containing rank-u set.  If the resulting normalized
          codegree at every T is at most H_u/C_u, uniform request flow plus
          uniform continuation flow has right load at most one.  Bipartite
          integrality then gives the exact augmented matching, hence every
          Rado cut.

          A random rankwise partition of distinct top names satisfies all
          these pointwise inequalities whenever

            (H_u-m_u)^2 d_min(u)/(C_u H_u) >= A_0 r.

          importantly, the insured D to D+1 shift can leave the necessary

            Delta_g = ceil(A sqrt(r C_(b+g) H_(b+g)/d_g)),
            d_g=C(r+D+2,g+1),

          the total reserve is O(W/r^(3/4)); every capacity tail q>=2 is
          only O(W/r^(5/4)).  Insurance affects only the q=1 piece count.
          After preassigning the actual p<=h exceptional chunks to their
          insured maximum occurrences, the exact adjacent-depth margins
          H_t,H_(t+1),...,H_r leave room for every Delta tail, and sorted-
          tail matching reassigns the transported bulk.  Thus zero-slack
          socket arithmetic and all top-to-collar cuts are closed.

          extraction creates no slack.  This refutes only automatic fixed
          naming; the random spread theorem cochooses the names.

          the spread top partition to one target-once interval-chain lift.

2809PME. Exact marginal existence is closed, while the Strong Rayleigh
          shortcut is exactly refuted inside the augmented Boolean graph.

          For any finite bipartite graph, every relative-interior point of
          its perfect-matching polytope is the edge-marginal vector of a
          positive-weight Gibbs law.  This follows by minimizing log-sum-
          exp minus the target mean on the quotient by affine constants.
          The uniform Boolean fractional point is strictly positive, hence
          relative-interior, so it has an exact-marginal maximum-entropy
          perfect-matching distribution.

          That distribution cannot be edge-Strong-Rayleigh.  In fact no
          nondegenerate law supported on the perfect matchings of any
          simple graph can be: homogeneous multiaffine stable support must
          be a matroid base family, while two distinct perfect matchings
          fail one-edge basis exchange.  For the positive-weight Boolean
          law, condition on all but two universal dummy
          assignments of any incumbent matching.  The residual face is
          K_(2,2); opposite edges occur together with probability p and
          each has marginal p, giving covariance p(1-p)>0.  Strong
          Rayleigh measures are conditionally negatively associated.

          The stable Heilmann--Lieb matching polynomial is vertex-variable;
          on perfect matchings its vertex monomials all coincide.  It says
          nothing about the edge-choice law.  Thus exact marginals are no
          longer the issue, but generic stability cannot furnish the
          required Chernoff oracle.  A microscopic positive edge
          correlation does not rule out concentration of the specific
          macroscopic Boolean owner statistics.  Item2810IMR gives such a
          theorem for the old-image projection.  The surviving target is
          arbitrary coloured assignment within that image, or scaled-loss
          regeneration.

2810IMR. The old-versus-dummy occupancy half of the Boolean rounding
          oracle is now solved exactly.

          Choose a perfect matching of J_q uniformly.  Its old and dummy
          edge marginals are exactly the uniform fractional values by
          orbit symmetry.  Project the matching to the set I of rank-q+1
          vertices occupied by old continuations.  The coefficient of y^B
          is the number of old saturated matchings with image B.  This is
          the top homogeneous part of the restricted Heilmann--Lieb
          matching polynomial, hence a stable weighted transversal-base
          polynomial.  Therefore I is Strong Rayleigh.

          For every future owner U,

            E |I cap C(U,q+1)|
              = C(2r,q)/C(2r,q+1) C(|U|,q+1)
              = (|U|-q)/(2r-q) C(|U|,q),

          and the count has the usual Chernoff tails.  The complementary
          aggregate dummy occupancy has the same concentration.  This
          exactly controls the positive-mean owner colour invisible to all
          old-only C6 switches.

          The projection cannot be refined automatically to arbitrary old
          colours.  In the literal n=4,q=1 Boolean graph, the image support
          of A={1,2,3} contains {14,23,34} and {13,24,34} but fails basis
          exchange, so it is not Strong Rayleigh.  Endpoint-forced owner-
          block permanents are real rooted because they specialize the
          stable image polynomial.  However, after a legal conditioning in
          n=8,q=1, one residual C12 with A={1,4} and U={1,2,4,5} has block
          polynomial 1+z^2.  Thus no conditioning-stable real-rooted block
          theorem can close arbitrary colours; unconditional arbitrary-
          colour block real-rootedness remains open.

2811ARB. Four generic rounding shortcuts now have exact proof-safe
          boundaries.

          AFK returns an N-o(N) matching with a polylogarithmic additive
          weight error, not an exact assignment with a mean-sensitive
          Bernstein bound.  Bansal sub-isotropic rounding would give exact
          marginals and concentration under constant rank slack, but a
          long even-cycle assignment face has rank f-1 on f variables.
          Any positive exact route therefore needs a Boolean-specific
          bounded-circuit trajectory.

          For an old colour A and future owner U, the number of sensitive
          old-only Boolean C6s is exactly

            (2r-|U|) |boundary_(J(|U|,q))(A cap C(U,q))|.

          It vanishes for A=C(U,q), despite a positive fractional mean, so
          mixed old--dummy circuits are indispensable for arbitrary
          colours.

          Finally, splitting one scheduled piece a+b changes the capacity
          tail by +1 through min(a,b), by 0 through max(a,b), and by -1
          thereafter.  The CVZ-scale loss needed for the owner-test union
          creates Theta(W) breaks across D interfaces.  The raw eta-W
          two-SCD socket surplus is only a count theorem and does not pay
          these typed tails.  Scaled loss survives only with endpoint-local
          breaks, a typed linear tail reserve, or genuine regeneration.

          The remaining exact one-step problem is now assignment of the
          arbitrary persistent old colours within the already concentrated
          old image set, with uniform edge marginals and Bernstein tails.

2812RCR. Exact uniform refresh closes the complete one-interface colour
          concentration gate, but the physical serial refresh remains an
          explicit theorem premise.

          Independently choose a uniform fixed-size labelled partition of
          the old rank-q vertices and a mutually independent uniform
          fixed-size labelled partition of the start dummies, then sample
          a uniform perfect matching of J_q independently.  Conditional on
          the matching, an old colour count is hypergeometric in the old
          preimage of an owner block and a dummy colour count is an
          independent hypergeometric variable in the complementary dummy
          preimage.

          The old image I is Strong Rayleigh and, by homogeneous duality,
          so is its complement.  Hence the old occupancy Y and K-Y have
          exact means mu and nu and Bernstein tails.  For an old colour of
          density p,

            Pr(|X-p mu| >= delta p mu)
              <= 4 exp(-delta^2 p mu/24).

          For old and dummy densities p,s, put

            theta = p mu + s nu,
            rho = min(mu,nu),
            d = |p-s|.

          The conditional complete-colour mean is

            theta_Y = theta + (p-s)(Y-mu),

          and theta >= d^2 rho.  Applying the stronger of the image and
          complement Bernstein bounds controls this random mean; the
          conditional sum of the two independent hypergeometrics is
          negatively associated.  The resulting exact bound is

            Pr(|W-theta| >= delta theta)
              <= 4 exp(-delta^2 theta/36).

          Thus every exp(Cr)-sized family is simultaneous once its old
          tests satisfy delta^2 mu >= 48(Cr+log 4), or its complete tests
          satisfy delta^2 theta >= 72(Cr+log 4).

          Scope is essential.  This is an unconditional one-interface
          theorem under the stipulated refresh distribution.  A
          multi-interface application still requires a randomized physical
          kernel which, conditional on every protected past, makes the two
          complete future-role partitions mutually independent and exactly
          uniform, leaves the next uniform J_q matching independent and
          legal, preserves every past target/residence/boundary/socket/
          compiler ticket, and regenerates the same capability.  No such
          serial typed kernel is proved here.  Eligibility-restricted
          refreshes and the deterministic-colour matching alternative are
          outside the conclusion.  Therefore this does not yet prove a
          spread chain lift, B(k)+O(1), or exact equality.

2813MLD. Birth-time whole-configuration assignment closes the ordinary
          lower chainization and weighted multi-rank Hall rows for an
          unconditioned independent Boolean path cover.

          At every rank, the augmented Boolean matching adds a newborn
          cohort of deterministic size.  Merge the transported empty-set
          path with the rank-one newborns after deleting the empty set.
          Before any future interface matching, refine each birth cohort
          uniformly into predetermined whole configurations.  Because the
          eligibility menu and cell sizes depend only on deterministic
          birth/resource data, cohortwise uniform refinement and every
          later independent uniform matching preserve multinomial Laplace
          domination.

          A configuration fixes its composition and each piece's marked
          collar rank.  Therefore at rank s the marked top family Q_(s,v)
          is a deterministic union of current MLD labels.  Cutting the
          disjoint Boolean paths gives literal target-once consecutive
          ordinary chains, and for every deterministic B subset B_s,

            E exp(theta |Q_(s,v) cap B|)
              <= (1-p+p exp(theta))^|B|.

          Cross-rank independence is unnecessary.  If each X_i has the
          sub-Poisson MGF with mean mu_i and Z=sum a_i X_i, generalized
          Hoelder with gamma_i=a_i/A, A=sum a_i, gives

            E exp(lambda(Z-mu))
              <= exp((mu/A)(exp(lambda A)-1-lambda A)),

          hence

            Pr(Z-mu >= g)
              <= exp(-g^2/(2(A mu+A g/3))).

          For the Boolean owner load, a_s=1/C(k-s,v-s) and

            a_(s-1)/a_s <= 2/3,
            sum_(s=1)^t a_s <= 3/C(k-t,v-t)=3/d_v.

          Flag counting gives exact mean m_v/C(k,v).  With
          Delta_v=H_v-m_v,

            Pr(Z_v(T)>H_v/C(k,v))
              <= exp(-Delta_v^2 d_v/(8 C(k,v) H_v)).

          There are at most 2^k owner tests.  Thus the explicit reserve

            Delta_v^2 d_v/(C(k,v) H_v) >= A_0 k,
            A_0>8 log 2,

          closes all ordinary top-to-collar Hall inequalities with positive
          probability.

          The extreme-point claim is exact only for a configuration LP
          having the D socket-tail rows as its sole aggregate resources:
          at most D jobs then have multiple positive configurations.  With
          R further independent aggregate role constraints, the bound is
          D+R (more precisely, the active non-job row rank).

          Scope remains decisive.  The exceptional maximum-capacity bank
          is not physically exposed or occurrence-attached.  Nor is it
          proved that conditioning the independent Boolean matchings on a
          central owner chronology, arbitrary-width upper coverage, or
          residence preserves MLD.  Hence this closes the unconditioned
          ordinary lower bulk, not the protected carrier, the exceptional
          absorber, B(k)+O(1), or exact equality.

2814AC. The adjacent-depth synthesis now has a proof-safe exact scope.

          Work in B_(2r), put D>=1, t=r-D, b=t-1.  The old residual
          histogram is on ranks 1,...,t-1.  Moving to depth D+1 performs
          terminal deletion: the old rank-(t-1) singleton jobs vanish and
          every other job loses its last cell, so the new MLD cutoff is
          b-1=t-2.

          The old and new collar tails are

            K_q   = W-C_(t+q-1),
            K_q^+ = W-C_(b+q-1),

          hence exactly

            K_q^+-K_q=H_(t+q-1)  (q<=D),
            K_(D+1)^+=H_r.

          An extreme point of the D-row whole-job configuration LP leaves
          at most D exceptional old jobs.  After terminal deletion, if
          L_max<=t-2, their descendants split into at most

            h=D ceil(L_max/D)<r

          pieces.  Reserving h genuine capacity-(D+1) occurrences and
          Delta_g exact-capacity-g occurrences is tail-faithful precisely
          under

            h+sum_(g>=q) Delta_g <= H_(t+q-1)  (q<=D),
            h+Delta_(D+1) <= H_r.

          The capacity types are fixed before any path geometry, birth
          cohorts are uniformly refined by complete marked configurations,
          and only then are the independent augmented Boolean matchings
          exposed.  Thus MLD is preserved.  With

            d_g=C(2r-b+1,g+1),
            Delta_g^2 d_g/(C_(b+g) H_(b+g)) >= A_0(2r),

          generalized Hoelder and the pointwise-codegree theorem attach all
          ordinary and exceptional tops jointly to distinct actual collar
          bottoms.  Every new residual target occurs exactly once and none
          is appended or discarded.

          In the coefficient-one regime D=Theta(sqrt r), the choice

            Delta_g=ceil(A sqrt(r C_(b+g)H_(b+g)/d_g))

          fits all adjacent tails.  Merely assuming D=O(sqrt r) would be too
          weak if D stayed bounded.  For even k=2r, W+D+1=B(k)+1, but this
          is only a conditional lower-side statement: any separately priced
          boundary bank and a protected upper-complete serialization remain
          premises.  Depth D+1 means owner windows of D+2 source letters,
          hence flat-owner residence floor D+2.

          At old depth D, a saturated tail A_q=K_q forbids carving out even
          one disjoint socket of capacity at least q while holding the bulk
          fixed.  Same-depth C=0 therefore needs a joint integer
          augmentation/normality theorem.  Even complete pair slices also
          rule out universal bounded-support Euler repair, but they do not
          rule out distributed zero-cost parity leakage in the full carrier.
          Thus there is a no-go for naive absorber internalization, not a
          no-go theorem for exact coefficient one.

2815PS. Protected serialization has an exact upper-first network interface.

          Fix h=D+1, an owner-once order

            P=(T_0,...,T_(W-1)),

          and a completed owner-rooted strict lower-flag system C.  Here
          completed means the canonical residual MLD forest together with
          every separately priced boundary/collar target, adjoined as a
          disjoint owner-rooted flag bank.  The raw MLD residual forest alone
          is not the complete strict lower ideal.

          For each owner T_i, make the menu of nonempty length-(h+1) source
          traces whose full union is T_i and whose proper suffix unions
          realize its named flag.  Put these traces as arcs between their
          length-h prefix and suffix states in layer i of a de Bruijn graph.
          Then the following are equivalent:

            * one source word of length W+h realizes the fixed owner order
              and every declared flag in a distinct suffix cell;
            * the W-layer graph has a source--sink path;
            * its ordinary unit-flow system is feasible.

          The node--arc matrix is totally unimodular.  Thus after P and C
          are fixed, there is no further fractional, Hall, matroid,
          common-Q, or compiler gap: the path spells the literal word.  If P
          is arbitrary-upper-complete, every witness U=union_(i=a)^b T_i
          transports to the source interval [a,b+h], and the path itself is
          the exact depth-h residence antecedent.

          This determines the quantifier reversal sharply.  Bare existential
          quantifiers commute, but the current modular theorems do not:

            exists P in U, exists C in F_low^comp,
                    path(P,C)

          is the missing row.  The upper theorem would choose P without C;
          the unconditioned MLD theorem chooses only the residual part of C;
          neither proves their intersection with layered reachability.
          Conditioning MLD on that global event is not currently justified.

          On the natural-pin face, the maximal erosion identity

            intersection_(j=0)^q T_(i+j)
              = union_(p=i+q)^(i+h) E_p

          makes all interior natural flags automatic; the final h owner
          positions and nonnatural opening/seam pins remain boundary data.
          A literal h=2 two-owner example proves that an unmarked resident
          segment plus target-disjoint contained flags and individually
          nonempty trace menus can still have an empty layered transition.

          This is an exact reduction, not a B+1 or B+O(1) proof.

2816RM. The all-price clock gate now has a sharper minimum-threshold and a
          quantitative stability boundary.

          Any negative superadditive clock can be cut at its first visit to
          zeta, the unique global minimum of K, rather than at A.  Bellman
          prefix closure only lowers the functional.  Saturating the first
          crossing gives an endpoint T with

            zeta <= T < 2 zeta.

          Crude period-N tail replacement is not enough: an explicit
          half-zero/half-(zeta-epsilon) prefix has negative period aperture.
          Its shorter high-density denomination explains the failure.  The
          proof-safe remaining scalar is therefore the exact formal
          maximum-density Apéry clock plus its finite availability shoulder.

          If U_m=lambda m+beta_(m mod g), Delta=max(-beta_r), then for
          Delta<=lambda/2,

            Phi(U) >= C(lambda)
                       -(Delta/lambda)(||K'||_1
                         +lambda Var(K')).

          Since C(lambda)=K(0)/2+O(lambda), every sufficiently small-mesh
          counterclock has either Delta>epsilon_0 lambda or adverse shoulder
          debt at least 3K(0)/16.  This is an exact either/or theorem, not a
          positivity proof: converting either defect into physical socket
          reserve remains open.

          Reciprocal combs themselves are strictly positive, and their
          normalized margin is K(0)h/2+O(h^2).  Thus h=Theta(k^-1/2)
          supplies Theta(W/sqrt k), comfortably above a polynomial rounding
          bank; there is no dimension-free normalized gap, but combs are not
          the finite-size bottleneck.

2817RL. A short two-state bank closes the same-depth anonymous
          configuration-rounding lattice, but not named coefficient zero.

          For a length-j job, the one-piece tail u^(j) and the two-piece
          tail v^(j)=(j-1,1) satisfy

            v^(j)-u^(j)=e_1-e_j.

          These vectors are a Z-basis of the complete zero-work lattice
          A_(D-1).  An extreme whole-job configuration point with only D
          active aggregate tail rows has at most D split jobs.  Choosing one
          supported integral configuration per split job gives an integral
          error e with

            sum_j e_j=0,
            |e_j|<=D L_max/j.

          Reserve R_j=ceil(D L_max/j) labelled jobs in each of the two base
          states.  If e_j>0 switch e_j copies u->v; if e_j<0 switch -e_j
          copies v->u.  Their total change is

            sum_(j>=2)e_j(e_1-e_j)=-e.

          Hence a buffered fractionally feasible residual instance rounds
          integrally at the same depth with exact aggregate tail K.  The
          bank has O(D L_max log D) jobs and O(D^2 L_max) work.

          The audit corrected two material overclaims.  First, exact tails
          give only an anonymous equal-length piece/socket bijection.  At
          zero reserve they do not force named piece-top containment Hall;
          the MLD concentration theorem still needs unused occurrence
          margin or a new exact zero-slack naming theorem.  Second, the
          exact bank dual is not |<theta,B>|.  With

            m_a(theta)=min_p <theta,p>,
            S_J(theta)=<theta,K>-sum_(a in J)m_a(theta),
            Pi_G(theta)=sum_(a in bank)
                        (<theta,bar p_a>-m_a(theta)),

          residual feasibility is equivalent to

            S_J(theta)>=Pi_G(theta) for every theta>=0.

          After workload quotient and normalization
          min theta=0,max theta=1,

            Pi_G(theta)<=2 sum_j jR_j=O(D^2 L_max).

          Therefore a positive normalized Boolean slack density would
          reserve the bank, while bare all-price nonnegativity would not.
          The precise implication is

            BFI_D => exact same-depth anonymous fragmentation.

          Named physical sockets, a separately priced boundary bank,
          zero-slack containment Hall or an empty reserve, and protected
          upper/resident serialization remain necessary before C=0.

2818ODD. The odd adjacent-depth residual absorber is now exact.  Put
          `k=2r-1`, `W=C(2r-1,r-1)=C(2r-1,r)`, old depth `D`, and
          `t=r-D`.  The old owner-socket tails are

            K_q=W-C_(t+q-1),  1<=q<=D,

          with `K_D=0`: no odd SCD chain is born at rank `r`.  At new
          bottom `b=t-1`,

            K_q^+=W-C_(b+q-1),  1<=q<=D,
            K_(D+1)^+=0,
            K_q^+-K_q=H_(t+q-1).

          In particular the increment exposes exactly

            H_(r-1)=C_(r-1)-C_(r-2)=2W/(r+1)

          genuine capacity-`D` occurrences, though still no
          capacity-`D+1` owner occurrence.  Terminal deletion is the key:
          it deletes the old top singleton jobs and makes every surviving
          rounding exception fragmentable into pieces of length at most
          `D`.  Therefore capacity `D` is exactly sufficient.  Reserving
          `h<=D ceil(L_max/D)=O(r)` of the new rank-`r-1` starts, plus the
          usual vanishing spread reserve, preserves every transported tail.
          Birth-time capacity marking, MLD--Holder concentration, and one
          joint pointwise-codegree matching attach all ordinary and
          exceptional tops to genuine named collar bottoms.

          Conditional on the odd residual all-price configuration LP, this
          gives a target-once zero-defect named residual collar at
          `B(2r-1)+1`.  It does not include a separately priced
          endpoint/Ferrers bank and does not serialize the SCD collar forest
          into one connected owner-once, resident, arbitrary-upper-complete
          word.  The feared odd maximum-socket obstruction is therefore an
          indexing illusion on the residual lower side; the real remaining
          gates are `FC_D`, boundary realization, and protected
          serialization.

2819PG. Protected serialization no longer needs to begin connected.

          Fix trace depth h<r with k>=r+h.  There is an explicit pivot
          bridge between the order-h states

            U=(lambda_1,...,lambda_(h-1),Q+lambda_h),
            V=(Q+rho_1,rho_2,...,rho_h),

          where |Q|=r-h.  Starting at U and appending a nonempty X subset Q
          followed by V traverses h+1 owners

            M_j=Q+{lambda_(j+1),...,lambda_h}
                   +{rho_1,...,rho_j},  0<=j<=h.

          They are distinct rank-r sets and form a Johnson geodesic.  The
          final state is exactly V.

          Consequently, if literal trace components have these protected
          rail endpoints, component owners plus bridge owners partition the
          rank-r layer, their flags cover the strict lower ideal target-once,
          and every upper target has a witness internal to one component,
          concatenating the components and bridges gives one universal word
          of length W+h.  Bridge owners replace owners omitted from the
          components; no owner or source position is counted twice.

          Isolated bridge supply is unconditional.  The hypergraph whose
          vertices are rank-r owners and whose (h+1)-edges are pivot banks
          is regular by full coordinate symmetry.  A maximal matching has
          size at least W/(h+1)^2.  At h=d(k)+1 this exceeds both standard
          Catalan component counts for all large dimensions: W/(r+1) in
          even dimension 2r and Cat_(r-1)=W/(2r-1) in odd dimension 2r-1.

          Leaving all bridge owners unflagged costs h(h+1)(c-1) lower
          slots.  The exact B+1 slack satisfies

            hW-Lambda >= W-binomial(h,2).

          Hence the normalized costs are pi/4+o(1) on the even Catalan
          count and pi/8+o(1) on the odd count, both below the available
          1-o(1).  Catalan component count, owner-disjoint reset supply, and
          reset distance therefore create no scalar charge beyond B+1.

          The unresolved theorem is correlated: build the protected literal
          trace factor on the complement of a prospectively reserved pivot
          bank, with the bank's exact ordered endpoint states and internal
          arbitrary-width upper witnesses.  Separate Catalan-factor, MLD,
          and bridge-bank existence does not prove this intersection.

              SHA 87a1bed8cdbcd623ca916acbe326f5c98bde5a45a37e403cf666ace276dba082.
            MATH_AUDIT_CATALAN_SCALE_PIVOT_TRACE_FACTOR_GLUING_SELF_20260805.md

2820RB. The same-depth root-lattice bank has an exact closed-price
          opportunity formula, and the Apéry defect dichotomy is not the
          missing conversion theorem.

          Assume the bank part histogram can actually be removed from the
          physical socket histogram.  After replacing an arbitrary tail
          price by its configuration closure f, the one-part bank state
          u^(j) is optimal, while the state v^(j)=(j-1,1) has exact cost

            delta_j=f(j-1)+f(1)-f(j).

          Hence

            Pi_G=sum_(j=2)^D R_j delta_j.

          Put g(q)=qf(1)-f(q).  Then g is nonnegative, nondecreasing and
          superadditive, and Delta g(q)=delta_q.  If Q_q is the physical
          socket-tail minus job-tail and total work is exact,

            S=-sum_q Q_q Delta g(q),

          so the full fixed-bank dual is exactly

            S-Pi_G=-sum_q (Q_q+R_q^*) Delta g(q).

          Thus same-depth BFI is a robust/perturbed all-price theorem on
          the reverse-window cone.  Bare all-price nonnegativity does not
          imply it; an exact D=2 physical root-pair example has complete
          slack zero and bank cost one.  The bank is free exactly when the
          closed price is workload-linear on every banked length, and no
          fixed nontrivial same-work two-state bank is free for every
          closed price.

          The proof-safe Apéry implication goes in the other direction.
          A near-arithmetic formal clock with a small adverse shoulder has
          fixed positive normalized slack and therefore pays the
          polynomial bank after the finite Rayleigh transfer.  Large
          displacement merely leaves the BV estimate inconclusive, while
          adverse shoulder debt subtracts from slack one-for-one.  Neither
          defect is itself reserve.  The unperturbed all-price theorem
          remains sufficient for the adjacent-depth B+1 absorber; the
          perturbed inequality is needed only by the fixed same-depth C=0
          route.

2821PB. The pivot bridge is locally fully flaggable, and its owner
          hypergraph has exact spread and deletion-resilience bounds.

          This item supersedes the endpoint realization and hashes in
          2819PG, but not its protected-factor conclusion.  The simpler
          reset may use singleton rail states

            U=({lambda_1},...,{lambda_h}),
            V=({rho_1},...,{rho_h})

          and append Q,V, where |Q|=r-h.  It traverses the same h+1 owner
          geodesic.  More strongly, when r-h>=2 choose distinct a,b in Q,
          put C=Q-{a}, X=Q-{b}, and use

            U_i=C+{lambda_i},   V_i=C+{rho_i}.

          The owner geodesic is unchanged, but all h(h+1) proper suffix
          cells are strict and pairwise distinct inside the bridge.  Their
          histogram is one target at rank r-h-1, h at rank r-h, and h+1 at
          every rank r-h+1,...,r-1.  Thus the local raw bridge charge is
          zero.  Mutual target-disjointness across Catalan-many bridges and
          the complementary factor remains unproved.

          For the owner-only pivot hypergraph, with s=h+1,

            |E|=W(r)_h(k-r)_h/2,
            Delta=s(r)_h(k-r)_h/2,

          and owners at Johnson distance ell have exact codegree

            lambda_ell=(h-ell+1)(ell!)^2
                       (r-ell)_(h-ell)(k-r-ell)_(h-ell).

          Hence

            lambda_ell/Delta=
              2(h-ell+1)/(h+1)/[C(r,ell)C(k-r,ell)],

          with maximum O(r^-2).  After deleting any prescribed f owners,
          a maximal matching still has size at least W/s^2-f/s.  Therefore
          an even Catalan bank can avoid any independently fixed owner bank
          of size up to W(1/s-s/(r+1))=Theta(W/sqrt(r)); the odd target has
          more room.

          Independent owner sampling at p=Theta(h/r) simultaneously
          preserves all relevant containment stars, and the expected
          induced codegree/degree ratio is O(r^-3/2).  Turning this into an
          almost-perfect sampled pivot matching still needs a quantitative
          growing-uniformity nibble.  Fixed-uniformity Pippenger--Spencer is
          not a proof of that step.

2822SP. The growing-uniformity nibble in 2821PB is unnecessary for the
          owner-side spread bank.

          Let H be any simple s-uniform Delta-regular hypergraph on N
          vertices.  Exclude a prescribed bank F with s|F|/N=o(1), mark
          every remaining edge independently with

            q=gamma/(s Delta),

          and form the intersection graph of marked edges.  Its marked-edge
          count is

            (gamma-o(1))N/s^2,

          while its expected collision count is at most

            gamma^2 N/(2s^2).

          Turan--Caro--Wei therefore gives, simultaneously with the spread
          event, a hypergraph matching of size at least

            [ (1-eps)^2 gamma /
              ((1-eps)+(1+eps)gamma) - o(1) ] N/s^2.

          For any test family A with minimum member size L satisfying

            (L/s^2)/(1+log |A|) -> infinity,

          weighted Bernstein and a union bound give

            |V(M) intersect A| <= (1+eps)gamma |A|/s

          for every A in the family.  No pair-codegree estimate and no
          fixed- or growing-uniformity matching theorem is used.

          Apply this to the pivot hypergraph and all containment stars

            O(S)={T in C([k],r): S subset T},
            |S|<=r-h-1.

          Their exact minimum size is

            L_*=C(k-r+h+1,h+1),

          so L_*/s^2 dominates log(2^k).  At gluing depth
          s=d(k)+2, s^2/r -> pi/4.  Taking gamma=5 and then eps sufficiently
          small gives limiting coefficient 5/6>pi/4.  Hence, in both
          parities, one may reserve exactly the required Catalan number of
          owner-disjoint pivot geodesics, avoid any prescribed o(W/s) owner
          bank, and still retain 1-O(1/s) of every relevant containment
          star on the complement.

          This closes the owner-only spread-bank row of 2821PB.  It does not
          make natural bridge suffix decks mutually target-disjoint, build
          the protected factor on the complement, or preserve an already
          conditioned MLD law.  The proof-safe order is bank first, lower
          randomization second.

2823JB. The prospective collar bank can simultaneously satisfy the upper-
          q1 resource constraints and the low-star spread constraints.

          Starting from the two-shore rank-r/rank-(r+1) containment graph,
          delete any independently prescribed owner bank F of size at most
          W/(64s).  Repeated residual minimum-degree extraction and the
          balanced-collar construction produce

            M=floor(W/(16s))

          collars whose s+2 owner/endpoint resources and s new upper-q1
          resources are all pairwise disjoint.  Uniformly thin this family
          to the exact parity-appropriate number b=c-1.  For a containment
          star A, block weights w_i=|E_O(i) intersect A| satisfy

            sum w_i <= |A|,   sum w_i^2 <= (s+2)|A|.

          Hoeffding's without-replacement convex comparison followed by the
          exponential-moment Bernstein bound gives

            Pr[X_A>2p|A|] <= exp(-3p|A|/[8(s+2)]),
            p=b/M.

          The smallest relevant star is

            L_*=C(k-r+h+1,h+1).

          At h=d(k)+1, log L_*=Theta(sqrt(r) log r), while there are at most
          2^k tests.  Hence one exact thinned bank has simultaneous star load
          at most 64s/(r+1) in the even case and 64s/(2r-1) in the odd case.
          It is therefore O(1/s)-spread and also globally new-upper-q1-
          disjoint.

          Independent audit is GO after one exact correction: the abstract
          thinning lemma's sufficient union-bound condition must retain the
          factor 3/8 from its Bernstein exponent.  The main theorem's much
          stronger star-growth hypothesis already implies the corrected
          condition, so no bank conclusion changes.

2824HP. The unpunctured upper-only Catalan forest is an unconditional
          half-projection of any middle-levels Hamilton cycle, and the
          fixed balanced-collar puncture is exactly reversible.

          On `Omega dot union {z}`, `|Omega|=2r`, split `ML(2r+1)` into
          the four sectors

            A=C(Omega,r), B=z+C(Omega,r-1),
            C_+=C(Omega,r+1), D=z+C(Omega,r).

          The only edges are `A-C_+`, `B-D`, and the vertical perfect
          matching `X-(z+X)`.  Suppressing every `C_+` vertex in a Hamilton
          cycle projects the `z`-free half to a spanning linear forest on
          the `W=C(2r,r)` owners.  Its `U=C(2r,r+1)=W-Cat_r` edges have
          pairwise distinct unions and enumerate the whole upper palette;
          it has exactly `Cat_r` paths, and their `2 Cat_r` endpoints are
          exactly the owners whose vertical edge was selected.  The
          opposite half separately projects to an intersection-exact
          forest; the two edge sets need not coincide.

          For `b=Cat_r-1` balanced collars and `s=h+1`, each nonrepeated
          stem `M_0-...-M_h-N` has `s` edges and `s` deleted owners
          `M_0,...,M_h`.  Deleting the initial stems from a collar-adapted
          upper-exact forest removes exactly `bs` owners and `bs` colours,
          preserves the `Cat_r` component count, and exposes `N` as the
          new initial endpoint.  Restoring those stems is the literal
          inverse.  Adding only the `b` repeated left seams then joins the
          components into one owner Hamilton path and creates exactly the
          forced `b` upper repeats.  Palette defect outside the exclusive
          stem bank is unchanged, not multiplied by `b`.

          With prescribed source bank `S` and terminal bank `T`, the
          remaining upper/owner problem is exactly an order-`U` matching in
          the balanced upper/tail/head atom system `(T union H,T,H)`,
          containing the stem atoms.  After the fixed collar arcs are
          added, absence of a directed cycle is necessary and sufficient;
          one common strict potential is sufficient to make this automatic.

          Independent audit is GO after one scope correction.  Vertical
          crossing positions certify the declared initial and terminal run
          boundaries, but do not by themselves encode the pairing/order of
          components under the formal collar arcs.  The terminal bank and
          acyclic spanning component order remain explicit hypotheses.
          The protected middle-levels Hamilton cycle containing the
          Catalan-scale prescribed stem bank remains open, as do residence,
          deeper upper witnesses, named lower flags, and the common cap.
